audits.summary: This skill includes some security considerations related to processing external Azure resource data. While these warrant review as part of standard security practices, the skill follows established Azure authentication best practices and uses official management interfaces.

skills.name: firebase-security-rules-auditor
skills.description_en: Audits Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Storage) security rules for vulnerabilities, privilege escalation, role bypasses, create vs update inconsistencies, resource exhaustion, type safety, size limits, and hasOnly ownership checks. Use when auditing/reviewing rules, running red-team rule assessments, or scoring against auditor checklists. Don't use for Firebase CLI (login, deploy), Auth, Crashlytics, Remote Config, or database queries.

zh.intro: 以审计视角检查 Firestore 和 Cloud Storage 的安全规则：权限提升、角色绕过、创建与更新规则不一致、资源耗尽、类型安全、大小限制，以及写操作里 hasOnly 式的归属校验是否可靠。正文把自己定位成红队评审，要求不要因为规则看起来复杂就假设它安全，而要主动找绕过路径，并给了一份强制检查清单，第一条就是对比创建与更新规则。作者标为 Google LLC，类别 CloudSecurity。Firebase CLI、认证、Crashlytics、Remote Config、数据库查询都不归它管。
zh.usage: 要评审或红队式检查 Firestore 与 Storage 的规则文件、按清单打分时调用；登录与部署这类 CLI 操作不在范围。
zh.notes: 只审规则本身；运行时数据查询与认证问题请另找对应技能。

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework and instructions for auditing Firebase Security Rules. It defines a persona for the agent and a specific set of security checks to perform on provided configuration files. No malicious patterns, code execution, or data exfiltration risks were identified.

skills.name: brand-guidelines
skills.description_en: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

zh.intro: 套用 Anthropic 官方品牌色和字体。主色是深色 #141413 用于正文和深色背景、浅色 #faf9f5 用于浅背景和深色上的文字、中灰 #b0aea5 用于次要元素、浅灰 #e8e6dc 用于弱背景；强调色为橙 #d97757、蓝 #6a9bcc、绿 #788c5d。字体上标题用 Poppins 回退 Arial，正文用 Lora 回退 Georgia。适合需要品牌色、风格规范或公司设计标准的产出物。
zh.usage: 产出物需要 Anthropic 的品牌配色、字体或整体视觉风格时用；公司设计规范和视觉统一相关的需求也归它，正文提醒字体最好提前装到环境里。
zh.notes: 许可条款在 LICENSE.txt；正文同时给出主色、强调色以及字体的回退方案。

audits.summary: This skill provides static design assets and formatting instructions for applying brand styling guidelines. Review shows it contains no executable code or external operations.

skills.name: firebase-ai-logic-basics
skills.description_en: Integrates Firebase AI Logic (formerly Vertex AI for Firebase) into mobile and web apps (Android, iOS, Web, and Flutter) to call Gemini models from client code. Use when provisioning or initializing Firebase AI Logic, or adding Gemini features to an app: text generation, multimodal input, chat, streaming, structured output, hybrid on-device inference, App Check protection, or switching models with Remote Config.

zh.intro: 把 Firebase AI Logic（旧名 Vertex AI for Firebase）接进移动端和 Web 应用，让客户端代码直接调用 Gemini，不用自己维护后端。正文列出支持的端：Android、iOS、Web 和 Flutter；两种模型提供方分别是 Gemini Developer API（有免费额度，适合原型）和 Agent Platform Gemini API（旧称 Vertex AI，面向规模化生产）。适用场景包括文本生成、多模态输入、对话与流式输出、结构化输出、端侧混合推理、App Check 防护，以及用 Remote Config 切换模型。作者标为 Google LLC，版本 1.0.1。
zh.usage: 要在应用里初始化 AI Logic 或加 Gemini 能力（生成、对话、多模态、结构化输出）时调用；后端由 Firebase 侧承担。
zh.notes: 两条提供方路线的额度与门槛不同，选之前先看正文里的对比。

audits.summary: This skill provides official guidance and implementation patterns for integrating Firebase AI Logic (Gemini API) across Web, Android, iOS, and Flutter platforms. It demonstrates strong security awareness by providing detailed instructions for using Firebase App Check to prevent unauthorized access and explicitly warning against hardcoding sensitive debug tokens. All tools and dependencies are official resources from the trusted vendor (Firebase/Google).

skills.name: analyze-project
skills.description_en: Rigor Analyze / Rigor Audit read-only skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when the user wants to read and understand a repository, inspect model structure and training or inference entrypoints, review configs and insertion points, or flag suspicious implementation patterns without modifying code or running heavy jobs. Do not use for active command execution, broad refactoring, speculative code adaptation, or automatic bug fixing.

zh.intro: Rigor 系列的只读分析技能：读深度学习研究仓库，看模型结构、训练与推理入口、配置文件和可插入点，并标出可疑实现，全程不改代码也不跑重任务。装量 32.7 万，8 周涨 8251%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 接手一个陌生的训练仓库，先要弄清入口在哪、配置怎么串、哪段实现可疑时用；要改代码或跑实验得换别的技能。
zh.notes: description 明确只读，不做重构和自动修 bug；三家审计均 pass。

audits.summary: The skill provides a read-only analysis tool for deep learning research repositories. It uses static analysis techniques such as AST parsing and regex-based pattern matching to map project structure and identify potential implementation risks. The skill adheres to security best practices, such as using safe YAML loading and restricted file operations, and does not exhibit any malicious behavior or unauthorized network access.

skills.name: safe-debug
skills.description_en: Rigor Debug / Rigor Audit skill for deep learning research work. Use when the user pastes a traceback, terminal error, CUDA OOM, checkpoint load failure, shape mismatch, NaN loss symptom, or training failure and wants conservative diagnosis before any patching, with debug fixes clearly separated from research contributions. Do not use for broad refactoring, speculative adaptation, automatic exploratory patching, or general repository familiarization.

zh.intro: Rigor 系列的报错诊断技能：贴上来 traceback、CUDA OOM、checkpoint 加载失败、shape 不匹配、loss 变 NaN 或训练崩，它先给保守判断再动补丁，并把 debug 修复和研究贡献分开记。装量 32.6 万，8 周涨 8384%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 训练脚本报错、想先弄清原因再改代码时用；要大规模重构或探索式乱试就别用这条。
zh.notes: description 强调的是先诊断后打补丁，不保证给出修复。

audits.summary: The skill provides a conservative debugging framework for deep learning research, emphasizing diagnosis and human oversight. No malicious code, obfuscation, or unauthorized activities were detected.

skills.name: firebase-crashlytics
skills.description_en: Comprehensive guide for Firebase Crashlytics, including provisioning and SDK usage. Use this skill when the user needs help setting up Crashlytics, adding crash reporting, or using the Crashlytics SDK in their application.

zh.intro: Firebase Crashlytics 的接入与 SDK 使用指南，覆盖 Android 和 iOS。前置条件是已有 Firebase 项目和对应平台的 Firebase 应用；客户端采集到的崩溃数据通过 Firebase CLI 里的 MCP 服务器读取。可以配合 Firebase CLI 使用但不是必需，正文按平台分成两份接入参考文档。
zh.usage: 要接入 Crashlytics、给 Android 或 iOS 应用加崩溃上报、或查询崩溃数据时用；按平台选 android_setup 或 ios_setup 参考文档看具体步骤。
zh.notes: 作者是 Google LLC；正文把 Android 与 iOS 的接入步骤分开写。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard setup instructions for Firebase Crashlytics on Android and iOS. It utilizes official Google and Firebase repositories for SDKs and versioning metadata. All operations are consistent with legitimate Firebase development workflows.

skills.name: azure-observability
skills.description_en: Azure Observability Services including Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Alerts, and Workbooks. Provides metrics, APM, distributed tracing, KQL queries, and interactive reports. USE FOR: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Alerts, Workbooks, metrics, APM, distributed tracing, KQL queries, interactive reports, observability, monitoring dashboards. DO NOT USE FOR: instrumenting apps with App Insights SDK (use appinsights-instrumentation), querying Kusto/ADX clusters (use azure-kusto), cost analysis (use azure-cost-optimization).

zh.intro: Azure 的可观测性服务集合：Azure Monitor、Application Insights、Log Analytics、Alerts 和 Workbooks，覆盖指标、APM、分布式追踪、KQL 查询和交互式报表。正文用一张表把服务、适用场景、MCP 工具和 CLI 列在一起，例如 Azure Monitor 对应 azure__monitor 与 az monitor，Application Insights 对应 azure__applicationinsights 与 az monitor app-insights，Log Analytics 对应 azure__kusto 与 az monitor log-analytics，Alerts 对应 az monitor alert。用 App Insights SDK 给应用埋点、查询 Kusto/ADX 集群和成本分析都不在范围内，分别走 appinsights-instrumentation、azure-kusto、azure-cost-optimization。
zh.usage: 要查 Azure 指标、看 APM 与分布式追踪、写 KQL 日志查询，或建告警和交互式报表时调用；按服务在表里选 MCP 工具或 CLI，例如日志用 `az monitor log-analytics`。
zh.notes: 边界写得很清楚：App Insights SDK 埋点走 appinsights-instrumentation，Kusto/ADX 查询走 azure-kusto，成本分析走 azure-cost-optimization；CLI 一列是 az 命令。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive documentation and reference guides for Azure Observability services, including Azure Monitor and Application Insights. It incorporates security-first guidance, specifically highlighting best practices for authentication and identity management. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: xcode-project-setup
skills.description_en: Safely modifies Xcode projects (.pbxproj) to add Swift Packages and link files. Use this skill whenever an iOS project needs dependencies installed (e.g. Firebase, Alamofire).

zh.intro: 安全修改 Xcode 工程文件（.pbxproj）来加入 Swift Package 和链接文件，iOS 项目要装依赖（例如 Firebase、Alamofire）时用它。正文有几条硬规则：禁止用 Ruby、Rails 或任何 Ruby gem（包括 xcodeproj），不允许写或执行 Ruby 脚本；现代 Xcode 支持文件夹同步，新增源码或资源文件直接写到磁盘对应目录就会被自动纳入工程，不要手动改 .pbxproj 加文件。需要本机装了 Swift 且是 macOS。
zh.usage: iOS 工程需要装 Swift Package 依赖或链接文件时用；本机要有 Swift 且是 macOS，不要用 Ruby 脚本改工程文件，新增文件直接放进磁盘目录。
zh.notes: 作者是 Google LLC；正文把禁止 Ruby 和不手动改 pbxproj 列为必须遵守的规则。

audits.summary: This skill provides a Swift-based utility to automate the configuration of Xcode projects, specifically for adding Swift Package Manager dependencies like Firebase and Alamofire. It employs the established XcodeProj library to safely update project files and includes specialized logic for Firebase requirements, such as linker flags and Crashlytics build phases. No malicious patterns were identified.

skills.name: expo-dev-client
skills.description_en: Build and distribute Expo development clients locally or via TestFlight for internal testing. For production TestFlight releases and store submission, use the eas-app-stores skill.

zh.intro: 用 EAS Build 构建 Expo 开发客户端，给自己或内测同事在真机上验证原生改动：改了原生代码、要测某个分支，或者用到了 Expo Go 里没有的原生模块时就得走这条路。本地构建免费；云端构建和 TestFlight 分发消耗 EAS 套餐的构建额度，真机与 TestFlight 分发还需要付费的 Apple 开发者账号。
zh.usage: Expo Go 满足不了、或要测带原生模块的分支时才需要开发客户端；构建前先确认 EAS 额度与 Apple 开发者账号。费用说明在 https://expo.dev/pricing，Expo Go 与开发构建的区别见 https://docs.expo.dev/develop/development-builds/introduction/。
zh.notes: 生产版 TestFlight 发布和商店上架不在本技能范围，正文让你转 eas-app-stores。免费的是本地构建，云端按 EAS 套餐计费。

audits.summary: This skill provides legitimate documentation and command-line instructions for building and distributing Expo development clients using EAS Build. All tools and packages referenced are official resources from the vendor.

skills.name: deploy-to-vercel
skills.description_en: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

zh.intro: vercel-labs 官方技能，把应用和站点部署到 Vercel：deploy my app、要个链接、推上线、开预览部署这类请求都归它。安装量 16.2 万，8 周涨 43.7%，Snyk 和 Runlayer 两家 warn。
zh.usage: 本地跑通了要一个能分享的预览地址；想把分支发成 preview deployment；交付时要直接给出线上链接。
zh.notes: Snyk 与 Runlayer 都 warn；部署动作直接作用到线上项目，跑之前确认作用的是对的团队。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates project deployment to Vercel, utilizing the Vercel CLI or specialized fallback scripts to package and upload application code. It includes standard security practices such as excluding sensitive environment files and requesting user confirmation for git operations.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description_en: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.

zh.intro: Anthropic 官方技能，涉及 PDF 就该调：抽文字和表格、合并拆分、转页、加水印、新建、填表单、加解密、抽图片，扫描件还能 OCR 成可搜索文本。装量 21.4 万，8 周涨 0.8%，curated 与 official 都是 true，Snyk 给 warn（MEDIUM）。
zh.usage: 给一份 .pdf 要内容、要合并几份、要填表、或要把扫描件做成可搜索的时候先调它。
zh.notes: Snyk 报 warn（MEDIUM），Gen Agent Trust Hub、Socket、Runlayer、ZeroLeaks 都 pass；OCR 是它最重的一步，别在超长扫描件上盲跑。

audits.summary: This skill provides a robust set of tools for PDF processing, including text and table extraction, form filling, and document creation. It contains security considerations related to the processing of external file content and the use of command-line utilities. These features are standard for PDF processing tasks and are used within the skill's intended functionality. See the detailed analysis for additional context.

skills.name: firebase-remote-config-basics
skills.description_en: Manages Firebase Remote Config templates, feature flags, loading strategies, and SDKs (Android, iOS). Use when downloading/deploying remoteconfig JSON templates, managing version history/feature flags, setting in-app defaults, fetchAndActivate(), real-time listeners, or SDK setup. Don't use for Firebase Hosting, Auth, Firestore, Data Connect, Crashlytics, or App Hosting.

zh.intro: Firebase Remote Config 的接入指南，覆盖 Android 和 iOS：下载与部署模板 JSON、版本历史和功能开关、应用内默认值、获取并激活配置、实时监听以及 SDK 配置。核心作用是通过云端配置模板改应用的行为和外观，不用发新版本。前置条件是已有 Firebase 项目和 Firebase 应用，模板与条件通过 Firebase CLI 管理，配合 CLI 最好用但不是必需。
zh.usage: 要下发或部署 Remote Config 模板、管功能开关与版本历史、设应用内默认值、接实时监听或配 SDK 时用；Hosting、Auth、Firestore、Data Connect、Crashlytics 和 App Hosting 不归它。
zh.notes: 作者是 Google LLC；正文明确列出不在本技能范围内的 Firebase 产品。

audits.summary: The skill provides legitimate instructions for managing Firebase Remote Config, using official Google and Firebase tools, SDKs, and repositories. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: slack-gif-creator
skills.description_en: Knowledge and utilities for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack. Provides constraints, validation tools, and animation concepts. Use when users request animated GIFs for Slack like "make me a GIF of X doing Y for Slack."

zh.intro: 做 Slack 里能用的动图 GIF：给的是 Slack 的硬限制——emoji 动图 128x128、消息动图 480x480、帧率 10-30、颜色 48-128、emoji 动图控制在 3 秒内——外加一套基于 Pillow 的构建脚本和校验工具。适合要给 Slack 做表情或带动画消息的人。
zh.usage: 用户说「给我做个 GIF 发 Slack」时用它，一般走 Python：用 `GIFBuilder(width=128, height=128, fps=10)` 建构建器，逐帧 `builder.add_frame(frame)`，最后 `builder.save('output.gif', num_colors=48, optimize_for_emoji=True)` 落盘。
zh.notes: 依赖 Python 和 Pillow（技能里用 `from PIL import Image, ImageDraw`），以及自带的 `core.gif_builder` 模块。文件越小越好：降帧率、减颜色数、缩短时长都能压体积，emoji 动图别超过 3 秒。

audits.summary: This skill provides a toolkit for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack, including utilities for frame composition and easing. It performs standard image processing tasks using well-known libraries consistent with its intended use case.

skills.name: workers-best-practices
skills.description_en: Cloudflare Workers best practices for production applications. Use when writing, reviewing, or configuring Workers.

zh.intro: Cloudflare Workers 生产应用的写法与审查要点。正文先提醒：关于 Workers 的 API、类型和配置，记忆可能已经过时，写或审代码时以检索为准，用项目实际装的版本、生成的类型和 Wrangler 兼容性设置当基线。参考材料分三份：配置与可观测性、运行时模式（流式、promise 生命周期、请求状态、服务调用、安全和运行时测试）、平台 API 校验（handler 签名、平台类、绑定访问和序列化）。
zh.usage: 写、审或配置 Cloudflare Workers 时用；改兼容性日期、动绑定、核对 handler 签名或排查运行时行为时，先按参考文件取文档对照。
zh.notes: 三份参考文件按主题拆开；正文建议拿不准就去查官方 Workers 最佳实践文档。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive set of development and security best practices for Cloudflare Workers. It emphasizes secure coding patterns, such as constant-time comparisons and proper secret management, while providing guidance on performance and observability.

skills.name: data-visualization
skills.description_en: Create effective data visualizations with Python (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly). Use when building charts, choosing the right chart type for a dataset, creating publication-quality figures, or applying design principles like accessibility and color theory.

zh.intro: 用 Python 的 matplotlib、seaborn、plotly 画图：按数据关系挑折线、柱状、堆叠、直方、散点、热力、地图、桑基或网络图，并交代配色、无障碍与出版级排版上的取舍。
zh.usage: 先说清数据关系和读者要看的重点，照正文的图表选择表定类型；再避开饼图与立体图这类容易读错的画法，并按无障碍要求检查对比度。
zh.notes: 正文按数据关系列了首选图与替代图，也说明了哪些场合不该用某种图。

audits.summary: This skill is safe. It provides architectural guidelines and standard Python code templates for generating data visualizations using established libraries. No security considerations were identified.

skills.name: firecrawl-agent
skills.description_en: Autonomously navigate websites and extract structured data across pages. Use when the task requires navigation or no suitable ready-made workflow or data provider covers it.

zh.intro: Firecrawl CLI 的自主抓取：让 agent 自己逛站点、跨页抽结构化数据，单次跑 2–5 分钟。给没有现成 workflow 或数据源、只能现场导航提取的任务用，可以按 JSON schema 出结构化结果。
zh.usage: 任务需要自主导航，或现成工具覆盖不了时才用。先跑 `firecrawl search alexandria` 找有没有现成 workflow，用 `firecrawl list` 看契约、再用 `firecrawl scrape` 执行；都没有才交给 `firecrawl agent`，结果常落到 `.firecrawl/pricing.json` 这类文件。
zh.notes: 单次 2–5 分钟，比普通抓取慢。技能只声明 Bash(firecrawl *) 和 Bash(npx firecrawl-cli *) 权限，调用前先确认这条链路可用。

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate interface for the Firecrawl CLI used for web scraping and data extraction. It carries a low risk of indirect prompt injection, which is inherent to any tool that processes untrusted content from the web.

skills.name: expo-api-routes
skills.description_en: Guidelines for creating API routes in Expo Router with EAS Hosting

zh.intro: 在 Expo Router 配 EAS Hosting 里创建 API 路由的取舍指南。适合放进路由的有：服务端密钥（API key、数据库凭据、token）、不该暴露的数据库操作、第三方 API 代理、写库前的服务端校验、Stripe 或 GitHub 这类 webhook 回调、服务端限流，以及移动端跑不动的重计算。
zh.usage: 反过来的场景就别建路由：数据本来就公开就直接 fetch 公开 API，不需要密钥的静态数据、要实时更新（走 WebSocket 或 Supabase Realtime）、简单 CRUD（考虑 Firebase、Supabase、Convex）、文件上传（直传存储，S3 预签名或 Cloudflare R2）都不适合塞进 API 路由。
zh.notes: 判断标准是服务端是否真的需要这层；只是把客户端请求转发一遍，通常不如直接调公开接口。

audits.summary: This skill provides safe guidelines and code examples for implementing API routes in Expo Router. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: stripe-best-practices
skills.description_en: Guides Stripe integration decisions across development and test environment planning (separate sandboxes vs the shared test mode sandbox), API selection (Checkout Sessions vs PaymentIntents), Connect platform setup (Accounts v2, controller properties), billing/subscriptions, tax and registrations (Stripe Tax, automatic_tax, product tax codes), Treasury financial accounts, integration options (Checkout, Payment Element), migrating from deprecated Stripe APIs, and security best practices (API key management, API key permissions, webhooks, OAuth). Use when planning, building, modifying, testing, or reviewing any Stripe integration, including choosing a development environment, accepting payments, building marketplaces, integrating Stripe, processing payments, setting up subscriptions, collecting sales tax, VAT, or GST, creating connected accounts, or implementing secure key handling.

zh.intro: 给 Stripe 接入的关键决策做导向：开发与测试环境用独立沙箱还是共享测试模式、收款用 Checkout Sessions 还是 PaymentIntents、Connect 平台账户怎么建、订阅与计费怎么接、税务登记与自动算税、财务账户、以及密钥管理、权限、webhook 和 OAuth 等安全实践。计划、开发、改造、测试或评审任何 Stripe 集成时都适用。
zh.usage: 正文要求始终使用最新 API 版本与 SDK，除非用户另有指定，当前版本号为 2026-09-30.endive。命令行工具用 `npm i -g @stripe/cli` 安装，随后可用 stripe sandbox create 开沙箱、`stripe whoami --format json` 确认身份、`stripe config --list` 看当前配置。新集成默认走独立沙箱，而不是账号自带的共享测试沙箱，因为它能把设置和测试数据与线上隔离。
zh.notes: 密钥前缀区分可发布密钥与受限密钥，正文强调不要写进代码；关键文档集中在沙箱说明、密钥管理、支付方式配置、支付方式可选项、支付 API 导览和上线清单几篇里。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive set of best practices for Stripe integrations, covering payments, billing, tax, and security. It emphasizes secure coding practices, such as using Restricted API Keys (RAKs) and environment-specific secrets vaults, and does not contain any detected security threats or malicious patterns.

skills.name: firecrawl-search
skills.description_en: Find web sources with query-relevant page excerpts and optional full-page content, and discover workflows, data APIs, and indexes. Use for web research or finding structured records, listings, transcripts, and datasets. Supports semantic tool discovery, domain matching, and progressive catalogue browsing.

zh.intro: 找网上资料：返回与问题相关的页面片段，可选带整页内容，同时能发现工作流、数据 API 和索引。用于网络调研，或找结构化记录、清单、转写文本和数据集；支持按语义发现工具、按域名匹配和逐步浏览目录。正文给的入口分工是：通用检索用 firecrawl search，已知网站用 firecrawl find-tools，结构化数据先查 firecrawl search alexandria 有没有现成工作流或数据提供方，选中契约后用 firecrawl list 看输入，再交给 scrape 执行。
zh.usage: 要查资料或找结构化数据源时调用；先判断是通用检索还是已知站点，前者走 `firecrawl search`，后者走 `firecrawl find-tools <url>`，拿到契约先 `firecrawl list <provider> <capability> --pretty` 看输入再执行。
zh.notes: 依赖 firecrawl CLI，正文声明的可用工具是 Bash(firecrawl *) 和 Bash(npx firecrawl-cli *)；结构化数据要先在 firecrawl-search 里选好契约再执行。

audits.summary: The firecrawl-search skill provides comprehensive web search and discovery capabilities through the Firecrawl platform. The skill is generally safe but is susceptible to low-severity indirect prompt injection risks because it processes and scrapes untrusted content from the web without explicit isolation or sanitization.

skills.name: stitch-loop
skills.description_en: Teaches agents to iteratively build websites using Stitch with an autonomous baton-passing loop pattern

zh.intro: 给自主前端循环用的一套接力机制：每轮从任务文件里读当前要做的事，用 Stitch 生成页面、并进站点结构，然后把下一轮的任务写回同一个文件。适合需要连续多轮生成站点的场景。
zh.usage: 每轮读一次任务文件当交接棒，生成页面后把下一轮任务写回，保持循环继续；改动前先看站点说明和设计文档。
zh.notes: 需要能访问 Stitch MCP 服务、已有或可新建的 Stitch 项目，以及站点说明和设计文档两份文件；装了 Chrome DevTools 还能顺手核对页面。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates an autonomous, iterative website-building process using the Stitch design tool. It manages project context via local markdown files and uses a task-passing system to maintain a development loop, with optional visual verification using a local server.

skills.name: django-perf-review
skills.description_en: Django performance code review. Use when asked to "review Django performance", "find N+1 queries", "optimize Django", "check queryset performance", "database performance", "Django ORM issues", or audit Django code for performance problems.

audits.summary: No security issues were identified. The skill provides a professional framework for auditing Django application performance using standard code analysis tools.

skills.name: hyperframes-animation
skills.description_en: All animation knowledge for HyperFrames — atomic motion rules, multi-phase scene blueprints, scene transitions, broader motion-design techniques, AND the seven runtime adapters (GSAP default, plus Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, CSS keyframes, Web Animations API, TypeGPU). Use for any motion or animation task: pick 2-4 rules and compose, or load a blueprint, or look up runtime-specific API (e.g. GSAP eases / Lottie player / Three.js mixer). Also covers auditing an existing composition's choreography (animation map) and 24 named text-animation effects. HyperFrames-native: single paused timeline, seek-safe, deterministic.

zh.intro: HyperFrames 的动画知识库：原子动效规则、多段场景蓝本、转场、动效设计手法，以及七套运行时适配（GSAP 默认，另有 Lottie、Three.js、Anime.js、CSS keyframes、Web Animations API、TypeGPU）。安装量 96 万，8 周涨 151.7%，正文含 24 个命名文字动效。
zh.usage: 要给一个镜头加动效但不知道用哪条规则；查某个运行时的具体 API；审已经做好的动画编排。
zh.notes: 只对 HyperFrames 项目有效，单时间轴、seek 安全、确定性渲染，脱离这套框架用不上。

audits.summary: The HyperFrames Animation skill is a comprehensive toolkit for AI agents to design and audit animations. It follows secure practices for dependency management, including user confirmation and script sandboxing for its helper tools.

skills.name: xlsx
skills.description_en: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like \"the xlsx in my downloads\") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

zh.intro: Anthropic 官方技能，凡是表格文件当主要输入或输出就走它：读写改 .xlsx/.xlsm/.xltx/.csv/.tsv，加列、算公式、格式化、画图、清脏数据，也能从零建表或换格式。安装量 18.5 万，8 周跌 0.7%，Socket 给 warn，其余四家 pass。
zh.usage: 用户甩来一个 xlsx 说要加列或修公式；脏数据要清成能直接用的表；要在表格格式之间互转。
zh.notes: Socket warn；描述明确说主产物是 Word、HTML 报告、独立脚本或数据库管道时不该用它。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive spreadsheet creation and analysis capabilities. It includes specialized logic for ensuring compatibility in restricted environments and performing document validation. The skill contains some advanced technical implementation patterns, such as runtime code compilation and library injection, which are used to support formula recalculation using LibreOffice. These patterns warrant technical review but appear to be implemented for functional purposes by a known author.

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.description_en: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).

zh.intro: MCP 服务器开发指南，目标是把外部 API 和服务包装成设计良好的工具供大模型调用。实现路线有 Python 的 FastMCP 和 Node/TypeScript 的 MCP SDK 两条，流程分四个阶段，从调研与设计开始，讨论接口覆盖面与工作流工具之间的取舍。正文给出的质量判断标准是：能否真的帮模型完成现实任务。
zh.usage: 新建 MCP 服务器、给已有服务补工具、决定工具粒度或选语言实现路线时用；把外部 API 接给模型之前也先过一遍这份流程。
zh.notes: 正文把流程拆成四个阶段；许可条款在 LICENSE.txt。

audits.summary: This skill provides a development toolkit for building and evaluating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. It includes implementation guides and an automated evaluation harness. Security considerations include the intended execution of server commands and the processing of external test data, which are standard for development tools but warrant user awareness.

skills.name: pptx
skills.description_en: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions \"deck,\" \"slides,\" \"presentation,\" or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.

zh.intro: Anthropic 官方技能，场景里只要出现 .pptx 或 .potx 就该用它：建 deck、读和抽文字、改现有演示、合并或拆分、模板与版式、演讲者备注、批注。装量 23.9 万，8 周 -11.3%，curated 与 official 都是 true，带 references。
zh.usage: 任何要产出或解析 PowerPoint 的活都先调它，哪怕抽出来的文字是拿去写邮件或摘要。
zh.notes: Socket 给 warn，Gen Agent Trust Hub、Snyk、Runlayer、ZeroLeaks 都 pass；触发面很宽，写别的文档时容易被它抢。

audits.summary: This skill provides a robust set of tools for processing and generating PowerPoint presentations, including features for slide duplication, thumbnail creation, and XML validation. It includes advanced technical mechanisms for maintaining compatibility in sandboxed environments, such as runtime compilation of a compatibility shim and the use of process injection. While these techniques are used for their intended functional purposes, they represent powerful capabilities that warrant review in a security context.

skills.name: django-access-review
skills.description_en: Django access control and IDOR security review. Use when reviewing Django views, DRF viewsets, ORM queries, or any Python/Django code handling user authorization. Trigger keywords: "IDOR", "access control", "authorization", "Django permissions", "object permissions", "tenant isolation", "broken access".

audits.summary: This skill is a security auditing tool for Django applications that uses search commands to identify access control vulnerabilities. It is safe for its intended use, although it has the inherent attack surface associated with reading and analyzing untrusted source code.

skills.name: developing-genkit-js
skills.description_en: Develop AI-powered applications using Genkit in Node.js/TypeScript. Use when the user asks about Genkit, AI agents, flows, or tools in JavaScript/TypeScript, or when encountering Genkit errors, validation issues, type errors, or API problems.

zh.intro: 用 Genkit 在 Node.js 和 TypeScript 里做 AI 应用：定义流程、工具、结构化输出和智能体，碰到报错、校验失败、类型不对或接口问题时也可以查。动手前先确认命令行工具版本够新。
zh.usage: 先检查本机 Genkit 命令行版本是否满足最低要求，不够就升级，再按正文的初始化写法建流程和工具。
zh.notes: 正文给出一个最小可跑的流程和版本门槛，新项目另有单独的搭建指引。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates Genkit JS application development by providing access to official documentation, code snippets, and automated setup procedures. It encourages security best practices, such as managing API keys through environment variables, and utilizes official, trusted packages and CLI tools from the Genkit ecosystem. No malicious patterns or unauthorized behaviors were detected.

skills.name: docx
skills.description_en: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

zh.intro: Anthropic 官方技能，专管 .docx 和 .dotx：读、改、建都做，目录、标题层级、页码、信头这类格式，插图替换、查找替换、修订记录和批注也在范围内。安装量 20.4 万，8 周跌 7.5%，curated 与 official 都标 true；Socket 给 warn，其余四家 pass。
zh.usage: 用户丢来一个 .docx 要你调格式或抽内容；要把草稿变成带目录页码的正式 Word 稿；要处理修订记录和批注。
zh.notes: Socket warn；描述里明确把 PDF、表格、Google Docs 和纯编码任务划出去了。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive suite of tools for Microsoft Word document manipulation, including creation, editing, and validation. It includes several technical security considerations such as runtime compilation and command execution, which are used to facilitate document processing in restricted environments. These patterns are consistent with the skill's purpose and are implemented with appropriate safeguards.

skills.name: developing-genkit-dart
skills.description_en: Generates code and provides documentation for the Genkit Dart SDK. Use when the user asks to build AI agents in Dart, use Genkit flows, or integrate LLMs into Dart/Flutter applications.

zh.intro: Genkit 的 Dart 版：在 Dart 或 Flutter 应用里接大模型、写流程、定义工具和结构化输出。正文指了核心用法参考文档的位置，也讲了怎么用命令行起本地开发界面来看流程和追踪。
zh.usage: 先在项目里确认 Genkit 命令行装好了，再用它启动带开发界面和追踪的运行方式来调流程。
zh.notes: 正文推荐用官方命令行起本地开发界面，跑流程、试模型和评估输出都在里面。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and code references for the Genkit Dart SDK, a development framework by Firebase/Google. It details the installation of the Genkit CLI and various plugins for integrating AI models. All external references and commands are standard for the framework's ecosystem.

skills.name: entra-agent-id
skills.description_en: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

zh.intro: 微软官方技能，用 Microsoft Graph 建 Agent Identity Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal 和按实例的 Agent Identity，再配 OAuth 2.0 token 交换（fmi_path、OBO、跨租户），还覆盖 AgentID 的 sidecar SDK。装量 32.9 万，8 周 -0.8%，curated 与 official 都是 true。
zh.usage: 给代理申请 Entra 身份、配 OBO 或跨租户换 token 时用；普通应用注册和 Foundry 内的代理编写不在它范围内。
zh.notes: Socket 给 warn，Snyk 与 Gen Agent Trust Hub pass；description 划了边界，普通 app registration 要走 entra-app-registration。

audits.summary: This skill provides detailed instructions for provisioning and managing Microsoft Entra Agent Identities. It incorporates standard identity management practices, including the use of OAuth 2.0 flows and the Microsoft Entra SDK. All external references and tools are integrated with trusted Microsoft services and repositories.

skills.name: enhance-prompt
skills.description_en: Transforms vague UI ideas into polished, Stitch-optimized prompts. Enhances specificity, adds UI/UX keywords, injects design system context, and structures output for better generation results.

zh.intro: 把含糊的界面想法改写成适合 Stitch 的提示词：补上具体度，加界面和体验相关的关键词，带上设计系统的上下文，并把结构排清楚，让生成出来的结果更接近预期。
zh.usage: 准备把界面需求发给 Stitch 之前、某条提示词生成结果不理想、或者要把一个模糊概念整理成能执行的描述时用它。动笔前先看正文里列的官方提示词指南。
zh.notes: 官方指南的内容可能比技能里写的更新，两者冲突时以官方为准。

audits.summary: The skill provides prompt enhancement for UI generation, converting simple UI ideas into structured prompts. Analysis did not reveal any security vulnerabilities or malicious patterns.

skills.name: general-video
skills.description_en: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

zh.intro: 没有专门工作流可用时的兜底：自己写或改一套 HyperFrames 合成，或者 BRIEF.md 里写了 flow: companion 时走它。适合长片、多场景、品牌片、sizzle reel、蒙太奇、静态循环、静态标题卡、素材重剪和自由搭建。安装量 64 万，8 周涨 161.5%，三家审计 provider 全 pass。
zh.usage: 片子比较长、场景多、或者需求太自由没有现成模板时用；但全新创作要先经过 hyperframes 再进到这里。
zh.notes: 别把它当第一入口：description 明确要求新任务先走 hyperframes 分流。只做一段无旁白的动效单元时改用 motion-graphics。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates video composition and editing through a structured workflow involving sub-agent orchestration and project file management. It dynamically generates instruction packets for sub-agents using data from project files, which creates a surface for indirect prompt injection, although this is mitigated by the scoped nature of the sub-agent tasks. It also uses vendor-provided tools for updates and asset discovery.

skills.name: wrangler
skills.description_en: Run or troubleshoot Wrangler CLI commands in projects that have a wrangler.jsonc, wrangler.json, or wrangler.toml file, including local development, Previews, deployment, and resource management. For new projects and projects without a Wrangler configuration file, use the cf CLI instead.

zh.intro: 在有 wrangler.jsonc、wrangler.json 或 wrangler.toml 的项目里跑或排查 Wrangler 命令行，覆盖本地开发、Previews、部署和资源管理。新项目、带 cloudflare.config.ts 的项目，或者完全没有 Cloudflare 配置的项目不要用 Wrangler，改用 cf 命令行。正文要求用项目自己的 Wrangler 版本，写命令和配置之前先取对应版本文档，并先摸清包管理器、已装版本、脚本、框架和配置文件。
zh.usage: 项目里已有 Wrangler 配置文件，要跑本地开发、预览、部署或管理资源时用；命令报错或配置不生效也用它排查，动手前先确认项目实际装的版本。
zh.notes: 正文提醒命令行参数和配置字段会变，别照搬记忆里的例子；不该用 Wrangler 的项目要改用 cf 命令行。

audits.summary: This skill provides safe and security-conscious guidelines for managing Cloudflare Worker projects using the Wrangler CLI. It includes strong emphasis on protecting secrets, managing permissions appropriately, and verifying project state, which aligns with security best practices.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description_en: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

zh.intro: 做界面时的视觉方向指导：怎么定调性、怎么挑字体、怎么让配色和排版贴住具体题目，而不是套模板默认样式。给的是取舍思路和判断标准，不是现成的组件代码。
zh.usage: 新建或重做界面时，先让模型明确产品是什么、给谁看、主要干什么，再按这套思路做字体和配色的选择。
zh.notes: 正文要求把设计当成给客户做一套别人认不错的视觉识别，题目允许时可以冒一点审美风险。

audits.summary: This skill provides aesthetic guidance and design principles for building unique frontend user interfaces. It focuses on typography, layout, and visual structure without introducing technical security risks. No malicious patterns or security vulnerabilities were identified.

skills.name: azure-reliability
skills.description_en: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: \"assess reliability\", \"check reliability\", \"zone redundant\", \"multi-region failover\", \"high availability\", \"disaster recovery\", \"single points of failure\", \"reliability posture\", \"resiliency\".

zh.intro: 微软官方技能，评估 Azure Functions 与 App Service 的可靠性：扫已部署资源有没有可用区冗余、ZRS 存储、健康探针和多区域故障转移，先给一张按功能铺开的清单，再在用户确认下做分阶段整改（CLI 或 IaC 补丁）。装量 29.2 万，8 周走平，curated 与 official 都是 true。
zh.usage: 要给 Azure 上的应用量高可用与容灾、找单点故障时用；跟 Azure 无关的部署别用，技能里全是 Azure 资源语义。
zh.notes: flags 标 needs_external_cli 和 has_references，装之前要备好 az CLI；Snyk 报 warn（MEDIUM），另两家 pass。

audits.summary: This skill provides a robust framework for assessing and improving Azure reliability posture. It incorporates strong safety practices, including mandatory user confirmation gates for all infrastructure changes and clear scoping of data queries. While it performs powerful management tasks, these are aligned with its stated purpose and follow established security best practices for Azure environments.

skills.name: azure-kusto
skills.description_en: Query and analyze data in Azure Data Explorer (Kusto/ADX) using KQL for log analytics, telemetry, and time series analysis. WHEN: KQL queries, Kusto database queries, Azure Data Explorer, ADX clusters, log analytics, time series data, IoT telemetry, anomaly detection.

zh.intro: 用 KQL 查 Azure Data Explorer（Kusto / ADX）：日志分析、遥测、时序数据、IoT 数据、异常检测。安装量 55.9 万，8 周 +0.1%，Snyk 和 Runlayer 两家都给了 warn——这四个审计里出两个 warn 的比例不算低。
zh.usage: 日志落在 ADX 里要写查询、或者要从一堆时序数据里找异常点时用；也适合把一句自然语言需求翻成 KQL。
zh.notes: Snyk、Runlayer 审计结论均为 warn。要有 ADX 集群的查询权限，否则只能生成语句跑不了。

audits.summary: This skill provides capabilities for querying and managing Azure Data Explorer. It contains security considerations related to the processing of external data and the use of command-line tools for fallback operations. These features are standard for the skill's intended purpose in cloud resource administration.

skills.name: hyperframes-keyframes
skills.description_en: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

zh.intro: 管 HyperFrames 合成里的镜头运动：推拉、变焦、重构画面、Ken Burns、机位移动、视觉匹配与 whip 转场，以及各种 seek-safe 的 2D/3D 关键帧。还覆盖 GSAP、CSS keyframes、Anime.js、WAAPI、FLIP、路径、遮罩、SVG 变形与描边、文字拖尾、3D 景深，以及 hyperframes keyframes 的诊断命令。安装量 73.1 万，8 周涨 151.5%。
zh.usage: 镜头要动、元素要入场出场、或者成片里某一帧位置不对时用；也可以用来跑 hyperframes keyframes 看关键帧哪里出了问题。
zh.notes: 不负责整体场景策略、品牌设计、素材来源、字幕和视频规划，那些走 hyperframes 的其他分支。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions and patterns for authoring video keyframe animations using the HyperFrames framework. It includes technical guidelines for GSAP, CSS, and Anime.js, and utilizes a specialized CLI tool for diagnostics. It has a low-risk surface for indirect prompt injection common to code-generation skills.

skills.name: better-auth-best-practices
skills.description_en: Configure Better Auth server and client, set up database adapters, manage sessions, add plugins, and handle environment variables. Use when users mention Better Auth, betterauth, auth.ts, or need to set up TypeScript authentication with email/password, OAuth, or plugin configuration.

zh.intro: 配置 Better Auth 的服务端和客户端：数据库适配器、会话管理、插件和环境变量，以及用 TypeScript 做邮箱密码或 OAuth 登录。正文反复强调文档版本要对上项目里装的版本：优先用户点名的版本，否则查锁文件、没有锁文件再看包清单；接上 MCP 时先解析出版本对应的文档标识，后续查询都带上它，返回的路径原样再用。没有 MCP 就从官方文档入口起步。
zh.usage: 项目里出现 Better Auth 或 auth.ts，或者要用 TypeScript 接邮箱密码、OAuth、插件配置时用；换版本或升级后要重新核对对应版本的文档。
zh.notes: 正文提醒 API 和插件名在不同发布线上会变；只有版本无法确定或用户明确要求时才用最新文档。

audits.summary: This skill provides configuration and setup instructions for the Better Auth library. It guides the agent through installation, environment variable management, and database adapter setup using official vendor resources and standard development tools. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: managing-astro-local-env
skills.description_en: Manage local Airflow environment with Astro CLI (Docker and standalone modes). Use when the user wants to start, stop, or restart Airflow, view logs, query the Airflow API, troubleshoot, or fix environment issues. For project setup, see setting-up-astro-project.

audits.summary: The skill provides official documentation and command examples for managing local Airflow environments using the Astro CLI. It utilizes vendor-supported container images and standard development practices for local setup, troubleshooting, and API interaction.

skills.name: pr
skills.description_en: Use when writing a PR body.

zh.intro: 描述为空，且 8 周涨了 987.4%，是本片涨幅最高的一条，安装量 14.7 万。属于 mattpocock 那套协作技能，同仓库有 qa、design-an-interface、request-refactor-plan 等有正文的条目，三家审计全 pass。名字 pr 只能是 pull request 相关，具体做什么没抓到。
zh.usage: 需要给改动走 PR 流程时，跟同仓库的 qa、request-refactor-plan 配合着试；正文未知，先读它自己的 SKILL.md 再决定。
zh.notes: 无描述；涨幅 +987.4% 在本片排第一，装之前先确认正文真的有用。

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured template and guidance for generating Pull Request (PR) bodies. It is purely instructional and contains no executable code, network operations, or sensitive data access.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description_en: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.

zh.intro: Anthropic 官方做技能的工具：从零建 SKILL.md、改已有技能、跑 eval 测效果、带方差分析做基准、优化 description 让触发更准。curated 且官方，安装量 42.9 万（自身 41 万），8 周跌 3.7%。审计五家里 Runlayer 给 fail（HIGH），Socket 给 warn，另三家 pass。
zh.usage: 要写第一个技能时；技能装了但老不触发、想改 description 时；想量化一版技能到底有没有变好时。
zh.notes: Runlayer 的结论是 fail / HIGH，装之前先看它的具体条目，别只看到 curated 标记就当无事。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive environment for developing, testing, and optimizing AI agent skills. It includes several areas for review, such as the use of subprocesses to call external CLI tools and the initiation of a local server for result visualization. These features are used according to standard developer practices to facilitate the skill's core functionality. See the detailed analysis for more context.

skills.name: developing-genkit-go
skills.description_en: Develop AI-powered applications using Genkit in Go. Use when the user asks to build AI features, agents, flows, or tools in Go using Genkit, or when working with Genkit Go code involving generation, prompts, streaming, tool calling, or model providers.

zh.intro: 用 Go 写 AI 功能的参考书：Genkit 初始化与插件、生成与结构化输出、流式、prompt 文件、工具调用与中断、中间件、flow 与 HTTP 暴露，以及各家模型供应商的接法。每个主题对应一份 reference，按需读，不要求一次看完。
zh.usage: 先照 Hello World 起一个 flow（`genkit.Init` 拿实例、`genkit.DefineFlow` 定义），再用 `genkit start -- go run .` 打开本地 Developer UI 调流程和看 trace。
zh.notes: 需要 Go 项目自己引 genkit 的 Go SDK；CLI 用官方脚本装，正文给的是 `curl -sL cli.genkit.dev | bash`。正文还提醒模型 ID 变化快，别硬编码。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and code examples for Genkit in Go. It includes an installation command for the Genkit CLI and demonstrates patterns for building AI flows that are susceptible to indirect prompt injection if user-provided data is not properly sanitized.

skills.name: mcp-apps-builder

It includes standard development workflows such as project scaffolding and feedback submission using official vendor tools. No security risks or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: sql-code-review

zh.usage: 对选中片段或整个项目做审查时使用；先看安全（拼接 SQL、最小权限、敏感字段暴露），再看性能（缺索引、笛卡尔积、低效子查询）与可维护性，逐条给位置、风险、影响和改法。

audits.summary: The skill is an educational guide and checklist designed to assist with reviewing SQL queries for performance, security, and best practices. It includes standard instructional content, design recommendations, formatting templates, and generic code examples for common relational databases. It contains no executable scripts, packages, or suspicious structural patterns, and constitutes a purely educational asset.

skills.name: chdb-sql
skills.description_en: Use when the user wants to run SQL — especially analytical SQL — on local files (parquet/csv/json), URLs, S3 paths, or remote databases (Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse Cloud, Iceberg, Delta Lake) without setting up a server. audits.summary: The skill provides instructions and references for 'chdb', an official in-process ClickHouse SQL engine by ClickHouse Inc. It allows the agent to run analytical SQL queries on local files (CSV, Parquet, JSON), remote databases (MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB), and cloud storage (S3, GCS). zh.intro: 在 Microsoft Foundry 上微调模型：SFT 监督微调、DPO 偏好优化、RFT 带 grader 的强化微调，覆盖数据集准备、训练任务提交、部署和评估。description 还划了界——不做不微调的模型部署（走 deploy-model）、不做 agent 创建、不做纯提示词优化。安装量 57 万，8 周 -2.5%，Socket 和 ZeroLeaks 各给了一个 warn。
zh.usage: 手上有一批标注数据要训出专用模型、要校准 grader、或者微调完要部署和评估时用。

audits.summary: This skill manages the development and deployment lifecycle for AI agents and models. It includes certain security considerations, such as the capability to execute local Python scripts for evaluation and the ingestion of logs and traces for diagnostic purposes. These functions are integral to the skill's workflow and include appropriate user warnings.

skills.name: web-perf
skills.description_en: Audit, diagnose, or optimize website loading and interaction performance, Core Web Vitals, and Lighthouse performance scores.

skills.name: firecrawl-parse

zh.usage: `firecrawl parse ./paper.pdf -o .firecrawl/paper.md` 转 markdown；加 `-S` 出 AI 摘要，加 `-Q` 让它就文档作答。
zh.notes: 要装 firecrawl CLI 且要配额。结果一定用 `-o` 落到 .firecrawl/ 再分段读，直接打 stdout 会撑爆上下文，记得把这个目录写进 .gitignore。单文件上限 50 MB，PDF 大约一页一个 credit，HTML 只算 1 个。

audits.summary: This skill is a comprehensive developer documentation suite and toolset for integrating with the Anthropic Claude API. skills.name: doc-coauthoring

zh.intro: 带用户走一套协作写文档的流程，分三个阶段：先收集上下文，再迭代打磨结构与内容，最后用读者视角做验证。适用于写文档、方案、技术规格、决策记录这类结构化内容，触发场景包括用户说写文档、起草方案、写规格，或正准备开始一项较重的写作任务。
zh.usage: 阶段一由用户倾倒全部相关上下文，同时抛出澄清性问题；阶段二按澄清、发散、筛选、查缺口、起草、迭代的次序推进，边写边做质量检查；阶段三先预测读者会问什么，再用子代理实测，根据结果修补并复跑。落盘时用 create_file 与 str_replace 操作 decision-doc.md、technical-spec.md 这类文件。
zh.notes: 流程的结束条件写在第三节末尾：要验证文档对真实读者成立，而不是作者自己觉得清楚。

skills.name: hyperframes-audio
