skills.name: agents-sdk
skills.description_en: Build, debug, or review Cloudflare Agents SDK applications using the agents package.

zh.intro: 用 agents 包写、调、审 Cloudflare Agents SDK 应用。代理本身是一个 Durable Object，状态、SQL、定时任务和调用都挂在它上面；客户端用 React hook 连进来。先确认依赖版本，再改绑定与迁移。用于给站点加对话式入口、后台定时任务、或把既有 Durable Object 改成 agent。
zh.usage: 先跑 `npm ls agents` 确认装的版本；代码参考 agents/ 目录与 @callable、setState、this.sql 的用法，绑定和迁移写 wrangler.jsonc，客户端用 useAgent。
zh.notes: 正文提到修 agent 相关报错前先查当前文档。新建绑定要用 new_sqlite_classes 走 SQLite 存储，别沿用旧的 KV 迁移写法。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive documentation and implementation guides for the Cloudflare Agents SDK. It includes instructions for state management, scheduling, and experimental features such as browser automation and dynamic code execution. While the skill describes powerful execution patterns, these are presented as documented platform features with built-in security considerations like sandboxing.

skills.name: firebase-firestore-enterprise-native-mode
skills.description_en: Comprehensive guide for Firestore enterprise native including provisioning, data model, security rules, and SDK usage. Use this skill when the user needs help setting up Firestore Enterprise with the Native mode, writing security rules, or using the Firestore SDK in their application.

zh.intro: Firestore Enterprise Native 模式的参考资料型技能，分预配、数据模型、安全规则、Web SDK 用法、Python SDK 用法和索引几块。内容拆在 `references/` 下，每块一篇：provisioning.md、data_model.md、security_rules.md、web_sdk_usage.md、python_sdk_usage.md、indexes.md。
zh.usage: 要配置 Firestore Enterprise 的 Native 模式、写安全规则、用 SDK、或者查索引类型和慢查询优化时进来，按需读对应那篇参考。Firebase CLI 可用 `npx -y firebase-tools@latest` 临时调用。
zh.notes: 本身只是索引和入口，真正的步骤全在参考文件里，不读那篇等于没有信息。最适合配 Firebase CLI 用，但不是必须。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and specialized agent instructions for managing Google Cloud Firestore in Enterprise Native Mode. It guides the agent through provisioning, data modeling, and SDK usage. It includes a comprehensive framework for generating secure Firestore Security Rules, featuring a structured analysis phase and a 'devil's advocate' testing phase to ensure the principle of least privilege. All referenced tools and libraries are official Firebase/Google components and no malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: speech-to-text
skills.description_en: Transcribe audio to text using ElevenLabs Scribe v2. Use when converting audio/video to text, generating subtitles, transcribing meetings, or processing spoken content.

zh.intro: 用 ElevenLabs 的 Scribe v2 把音频或视频转成文字，支持九十多种语言、说话人分离和词级时间戳。正文给 Python、JavaScript 和 CLI 三种调用的最短可用代码，说明通用模型与医疗模型的分工，并交代先配好密钥再写代码。
zh.usage: 要出字幕、整理会议录音或批量转写口述内容时用它；没配密钥就先跑 `npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard init`。
zh.notes: 需要联网和 ELEVENLABS_API_KEY；JavaScript 只用 @elevenlabs 自家的包。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive tools and documentation for transcribing audio and video using ElevenLabs services. It includes instructions for installing official command-line tools and software development kits from the vendor's own repositories. As the skill's primary function is processing external audio content into text, there is a potential risk of indirect prompt injection if an agent acts on the transcribed text without proper validation.

skills.name: firebase-ai-logic
skills.description_en: Official skill for integrating Firebase AI Logic (Gemini API) into web applications. Covers setup, multimodal inference, structured output, and security.

zh.intro: 用客户端 SDK 把 Gemini 接进移动端或 Web 应用：支持 Gemini Developer API（有免费额度，适合原型）和 Vertex AI Gemini API（要企业级 Blaze 计划）两个 provider，覆盖多模态推理、结构化输出和安全配置。
zh.usage: 上手前先确认本机有 Node.js 16+ 和 npm；默认选 Gemini Developer API，只有应用确实需要时才换 Vertex AI Gemini API。
zh.notes: 没配安全措施等于把配额开放给陌生人；两个 provider 别混着用，默认就是 Gemini Developer API。

audits.summary: This skill provides official guidance and code patterns for integrating Firebase AI Logic (Gemini API) into web applications. It utilizes official Firebase SDKs and CLI tools for setup and multimodal inference. No security risks or malicious behaviors were detected.

skills.name: developing-genkit-python
skills.description_en: Develop AI-powered applications using Genkit in Python. Use when the user asks about Genkit, AI agents, flows, or tools in Python, or when encountering Genkit errors, import issues, or API problems.

zh.intro: 在 Python 里用 Genkit 开发 AI 应用：Hello World 是 from genkit import Genkit 配上 GoogleAI 插件和 googleai/gemini-flash-latest 模型，然后 await ai.generate(...) 取 response.text。Python SDK 改动频繁，导入和 API 都要对着 references 或上游文档核实。
zh.usage: 前置：Python 3.14+，依赖用 `uv` 管；CLI 用 `genkit --version` 检查，缺了就 `npm install -g genkit-cli`。新项目看 `references/setup.md`，模式和代码样例看 `references/examples.md`。
zh.notes: 遇到任何报错先读正文里的 Common Errors 部分，不要凭印象改 import。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and examples for developing Python applications with Genkit. It includes standard developer practices such as environment variable persistence in shell profiles and the installation of well-known third-party tools. It also outlines an evaluation framework that presents a surface for indirect prompt injection from external datasets.

skills.name: design-md
skills.description_en: Analyze Stitch projects and synthesize a semantic design system into DESIGN.md files

zh.intro: 分析 Stitch 项目里已经画好的界面，把用到的颜色、字体和视觉描述归纳成一份 DESIGN.md，作为之后继续生成新页面的统一依据。同一个项目里页面越做越多、怕新页面跑偏时，先用它把设计语言固定下来。
zh.usage: 先确保能连上 Stitch 服务，并打开一个至少有一个设计页面的项目，让模型读取现有页面后生成这份文档；之后每次让 Stitch 出新页面都把它带上。
zh.notes: 依赖 Stitch MCP 服务和已有设计页面的项目；正文里指向 Stitch 官方的提示词指南。

audits.summary: The skill provides a safe design analysis pipeline using an integration with the official Stitch MCP server tools. It fetches project metrics/metadata, handles translation to design documentation (DESIGN.md), and interacts strictly with a well-known service infrastructure.

skills.name: stripe-projects
skills.description_en: Use when the user wants to provision infrastructure or third-party services using Stripe Projects. Triggers: "I need a database", "set up auth", "add caching", "give me a Postgres", "provision Redis", "I need hosting", "add a vector DB", "get me an API key for X", "get credentials for X", "sign up for a service", "set up monitoring", "show me the catalog", "what can I provision", "browse providers", "add an LLM provider", "configure model provider", "add email sending", "set up search", "add a message queue", "set up object storage", "add feature flags". Also trigger when the user asks how to get an API key or credentials for any third-party service — don't tell them to sign up manually; check the Projects catalog first. Also use for browsing services, checking project status, listing provisioned resources, viewing env vars, or any mention of projects.dev or adding/provisioning/connecting a cloud service.

zh.intro: 用 Stripe Projects 开通基础设施和第三方服务：数据库、鉴权、缓存、向量库、托管、监控、邮件、搜索、消息队列、对象存储、功能开关，以及去哪拿某个服务的 API key。正文的主张是别让用户自己跑去注册，先在 Projects 目录里查有没有能直接开通的服务。
zh.usage: 用户说「我要个 Postgres」「配个 Redis」「加个向量库」「拿 X 的 API key」时用它；也能查项目状态、列已开通的资源和环境变量。入口是 stripe CLI，正文的 allowed-tools 写了 `stripe *` 和 `brew install stripe/stripe-cli/stripe`，目录部分提到 projects.dev。
zh.notes: 前置是本机有 stripe CLI（正文给的安装方式是 Homebrew 那条），并按其 Bash 允许清单执行。它负责开通和拿凭据，服务怎么接进你的代码要自己写。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates the provisioning and management of third-party cloud services using the Stripe Projects CLI. It includes standard practices for software management, such as installing necessary tools, handling authentication via browser handoff, and managing environment variables locally.

skills.name: eas-update-insights
skills.description_en: Check the health of published EAS Update: crash rates, install/launch counts, unique users, payload size, and the split between embedded and OTA users per channel. Use when the user asks how an update is performing, whether a rollout is healthy, how many users are on the embedded build vs OTA, or wants to gate CI on update health.

zh.intro: 在命令行查已发布 EAS Update 的健康度：启动次数、启动失败、崩溃率、独立用户、包体积、每个 channel 上 embedded 与 OTA 用户的比例，以及各 runtime 版本里最受欢迎的更新。数据跟在 expo.dev 上更新和 channel 详情页看到的是同一份，可以出人类可读或 JSON 两种格式。
zh.usage: 更新发出去后想知道这次 rollout 健不健康、新版本是不是比上一版崩得多、有多少用户还在 embedded 构建上、要不要在 CI 里卡住发布时用它。判断某次更新崩得更多这种对比问题正合适。
zh.notes: 这是付费的 EAS 服务，用量算在你的 EAS Update 配额里，先看 https://expo.dev/pricing。只给聚合指标，要看单个用户的崩溃明细或设备级报表得换别的工具。

audits.summary: The skill provides tools for monitoring EAS Update health using the official Expo CLI. It includes a vendor-specific feedback mechanism that executes a remote package and is potentially vulnerable to indirect prompt injection from untrusted update metadata such as messages and branch names.

skills.name: sred-project-organizer
skills.description_en: Take a list of projects and their related documentation, and organize them into the SRED format for submission.

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe but carries a low risk of indirect prompt injection because it processes external and untrusted data from GitHub pull requests, Notion documents, and Linear tickets without strict boundary markers or input sanitization. This data could theoretically contain instructions designed to manipulate the agent's behavior during the summary or creation process.

skills.name: git-commit
skills.description_en: Execute git commit with conventional commit message analysis, intelligent staging, and message generation. Use when user asks to commit changes, create a git commit, or mentions "/commit". Supports: (1) Auto-detecting type and scope from changes, (2) Generating conventional commit messages from diff, (3) Interactive commit with optional type/scope/description overrides, (4) Intelligent file staging for logical grouping
skills.name_zh: 规范化的 Git 提交

zh.name_zh: 规范化的 Git 提交
zh.intro: 把改动转成 Conventional Commits 格式的提交：先看 diff 判断 type 和 scope，必要时按逻辑分组暂存文件，再生成一行标题（祈使句、72 字符内）加可选的正文和脚注，破坏性变更用感叹号或 BREAKING CHANGE 标注。
zh.usage: 在要提交时说「帮我 commit」或者打 `/commit`；它会先跑 `git diff --staged`，没暂存就看工作区 diff，再决定 message。
zh.notes: 只读仓库状态并执行提交，没有额外依赖。正文附了安全条款：不改 git config、不擅自 force 或 hard reset、不跳过 hook、提交因 hook 失败要新建提交而不是 amend。

audits.summary: The skill provides a workflow for creating semantic Git commits. It includes security best practices such as avoiding the commitment of secrets and preventing destructive Git operations.

skills.name: internal-comms
skills.description_en: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

zh.intro: 按公司惯用格式写各类内部沟通材料：状态报告、领导层更新、3P 更新、公司通讯、FAQ、事故报告和项目进展。给要写对内汇报、又不想每次重新想格式的人用。
zh.usage: 要写任何对内沟通时用它。先判断属于哪一类，再加载 `examples/` 下对应的指南：3P 更新看 `examples/3p-updates.md`，公司通讯看 `examples/company-newsletter.md`，FAQ 看 `examples/faq-answers.md`，对不上的用 `examples/general-comms.md`。
zh.notes: 正文给的是一套按沟通类型分开的指南文件，不是通用模板；选错文件会写出不合公司格式的东西。

audits.summary: This skill includes some security considerations such as indirect prompt injection. The skill is designed to ingest data from various sources (Slack, Email, Drive) to generate internal communications. While this is part of its intended functionality, it could be a potential area to review for reliability when handling untrusted or external data. See detailed analysis for context.

skills.name: pr-writer
skills.description_en: Create or refresh reviewer-facing PR titles and descriptions. Use when opening a PR, updating its title or body, or preparing branch changes for review.

audits.summary: The pr-writer skill is a specialized tool for generating pull request titles and descriptions. It uses standard git and GitHub CLI tools to analyze changes and follows clear privacy guidelines to exclude sensitive information.

skills.name: langgraph-fundamentals
skills.description_en: INVOKE THIS SKILL when writing ANY LangGraph code. Covers StateGraph, state schemas, nodes, edges, Command, Send, invoke, streaming, and error handling.

zh.intro: 写 LangGraph 代码时的参考：StateGraph、状态 schema 与 reducer、节点函数只返回部分更新、静态边与条件边、Command 与 Send、编译、调用与流式输出、错误处理。开头给了一套五步设计法，以及什么时候该用 LangGraph、什么时候换别的。
zh.usage: 只要动手写 LangGraph 代码就加载；先按五步把步骤、状态、节点和连线定下来，再照对应语言的签名实现。
zh.notes: 图必须先 compile 才能执行，这点容易漏。状态里存原始数据，提示词在节点内按需拼。要持久化接检查点时转另一个技能。

audits.summary: This skill provides educational documentation and code examples for building agent workflows with LangGraph. No security issues were detected during analysis.

skills.name: mastra
skills.description_en: Comprehensive Mastra framework guide for building agents, workflows, tools, memory, workspaces, and storage with current APIs. Use for documentation lookup, API verification, TypeScript setup, common errors, migrations, and `mastra api` CLI tasks: inspect or call resources on local, Mastra platform, or remote servers. For Mastra Factory operations, discover and activate the companion mastra-factory skill. Also report verified bugs and concrete documentation defects to the Mastra team automatically via the feedback endpoint.

zh.intro: Mastra 框架的使用指南：用当前 API 搭 agent、workflow、tool、memory、workspace 和 storage。给用 TypeScript 写 AI 应用的开发者用来查文档、核对 API、排查常见错误和做版本迁移。
zh.usage: 涉及 Mastra 的文档查询、API 核对、TypeScript 项目搭建、常见报错、迁移，以及用 `mastra api` 在本地、Mastra 平台或远程服务器上检查和调用资源时用它。
zh.notes: 正文第一条就是不要信内部知识：训练数据里的 Mastra API 多半已经过时，必须对着当前文档验证。Mastra Factory 相关操作要另找 mastra-factory 技能；确认的 bug 和文档缺陷可以通过 feedback endpoint 上报。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive tools for the Mastra framework, including project scaffolding and API interaction. It includes an autonomous feedback reporting mechanism to the vendor's domain and processes external documentation, which introduces potential data exfiltration and indirect prompt injection surfaces. It also relies on standard CLI tools for development and observability.

skills.name: figma-use
skills.description_en: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `use_figma` tool call. NEVER call `use_figma` directly without loading this skill first. Skipping it causes common, hard-to-debug failures. Trigger whenever the user wants to perform a write action or a unique read action that requires JavaScript execution in the Figma file context — e.g. create/edit/delete nodes, set up variables or tokens, build components and variants, modify auto-layout or fills, bind variables to properties, or inspect file structure programmatically.

audits.summary: The 'figma-use' skill is a development and automation tool for Figma that provides instructions and patterns for using the Figma Plugin API. The primary security consideration is the risk of indirect prompt injection, as the skill directs the agent to generate and execute JavaScript based on data retrieved from Figma canvas nodes, which are untrusted external inputs. The skill also facilitates dynamic execution through its core 'use_figma' tool.

skills.name: firecrawl-scrape
skills.description_en: Read a known webpage or execute a discovered workflow or data-provider capability. Use for page content or structured results once the URL or tool is selected.

zh.intro: 读已知网页，或执行此前发现的工作流、数据提供方能力：URL 或工具定下来之后，用它拿页面内容或结构化结果。正文的用法是先用 search 发现工具、用 list 看输入，再去执行；多个 URL 可以并发抓。结构化数据集要先经 firecrawl-search 找合适的工作流或数据提供方，已知页面直接读，选好的契约复用即可，不必重复发现。
zh.usage: 手上有确切 URL 要正文，或 search 已经选好工具时调用；基础抓取用 firecrawl scrape，结果落文件加 `-o .firecrawl/page.md`，只要正文不要导航和页脚加 `--only-main-content`，要等 JS 渲染加 `--wait-for 3000`。
zh.notes: 需要 firecrawl CLI（正文许可的工具是 Bash(firecrawl *) 与 Bash(npx firecrawl-cli *)）；结构化数据先在 firecrawl-search 里选好契约再执行。

audits.summary: This skill is a legitimate tool for scraping web content and converting it into clean markdown for AI processing. It utilizes the Firecrawl CLI to extract content, including from JavaScript-rendered pages and PDFs. While it ingests external data, which carries an inherent risk of indirect prompt injection, this is the primary intended function of the tool and is managed within the agent's execution environment.

skills.name: firecrawl
skills.description_en: Any live-web task via the Firecrawl CLI — including ordinary web research: searching the web, reading or extracting pages, gathering sources, discovering site URLs, bulk extraction, downloading a site, change alerts, or pages needing clicks/login — web only; local files route to firecrawl-parse. For US legal or regulatory questions use gov; for papers use firecrawl-research-index; for library, API, error, or bug questions use firecrawl-developer-index.

zh.intro: 用 Firecrawl CLI 处理任何联网任务，也包括普通调研：搜网页、读页面、抓正文、找来源、发现站点 URL、批量提取、整站下载、变更提醒，以及需要点击或登录的页面。只覆盖网页，本地文件交给 firecrawl-parse；美国法规问题走 gov，论文走 firecrawl-research-index，库与报错走 firecrawl-developer-index。
zh.usage: 先 `firecrawl --status` 看鉴权和剩余额度；抓页 `firecrawl scrape`，搜 `firecrawl search`。结果写进 .firecrawl/ 目录，带 -o 存 json；URL 一律加引号。
zh.notes: 正文提醒抓取前先查 .firecrawl/ 里是否已有同样数据，并把 .firecrawl/ 加进 .gitignore。搜索结果只是摘要，不保证来源权威或法律现行。

audits.summary: The skill is a tool for web scraping and research using the Firecrawl CLI. It fetches untrusted content from the web, posing a low risk of indirect prompt injection. The skill includes documentation on how to handle these risks safely using output isolation.

skills.name: cloudflare-email-service
skills.description_en: Implement or troubleshoot Cloudflare Email Sending and Email Routing integrations and their delivery configuration.

zh.intro: 用于接 Cloudflare Email Sending 与 Email Routing：把发信能力写进 Worker，把收到的邮件转发或交给处理函数。技能反复提醒这两项功能 2025 年才上线、变化快，动手前先拉官方文档而不是凭记忆写配置。文档、REST API 规格、类型包与 Agents SDK 仓库都列为事实来源，本技能只当索引，出现冲突以官方为准。
zh.usage: 先看「What Do You Need?」判断是发信还是路由，再按 Sending Workflow 配置。常用命令：`npx wrangler email sending list`、`npx wrangler email sending enable userdomain.com`；接收入站邮件时在 wrangler.jsonc 里声明 send_email 绑定，用 onEmail() 处理，转发用 message.forward()，原始内容读 message.raw。邮件解析依赖 postal-mime 时可用 `npm ls postal-mime` 核查。
zh.notes: 文档与 API 规格走 Cloudflare MCP 的 docs 工具或索引地址获取，也可用 HTTP 客户端读托管版本的 index.md；knowledge 容易过期，正文要求「优先检索、不优先预训练」。Common Mistakes 一节列了发送与路由里最容易踩的配置错误，排障先看那里。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive guide for integrating Cloudflare Email Services, including security best practices for secret management and handling untrusted email data. It encourages safe patterns like human-in-the-loop review for AI-generated replies.

skills.name: hyperframes-creative
skills.description_en: Non-animation creative direction for HyperFrames videos. Use for design spec (frame.md / design.md) handling, palettes, typography, narration, beat planning, audio-reactive visuals, composition patterns, and brand / style decisions. For atomic motion patterns and scene blueprints, use `hyperframes-animation`.

zh.intro: HyperFrames 视频里非动画的那一半归它管：设计规格（frame.md / design.md）、配色、字体、旁白、节拍规划、音频可视化、构图模式、品牌与风格取舍。安装量 87.6 万，8 周涨 120.3%，是这个仓库里跑得最快的一支。它明确不做原子动效和场景蓝图，那部分交给同仓库的 hyperframes-animation；三个审计 provider（Gen Agent Trust Hub、Socket、Snyk）结论全 pass。
zh.usage: 做品牌片、产品片之前定视觉方案时用：要先出一份能落地的 frame.md 或 design.md，或者纠结配色、字体、旁白节奏、画面怎么跟拍子对齐。真要写具体动效代码时换 hyperframes-animation。
zh.notes: 依赖 HyperFrames 这套体系，单独装它产不出视频。三家审计均 pass。

audits.summary: The skill provides creative direction and utility scripts for HyperFrames video generation. It includes design presets, audio analysis, and accessibility auditing tools. It features a custom dependency loader that installs pinned packages from the npm registry and executes system commands for media processing. Security measures like version pinning and script-execution prevention are present in the loader, though the skill does create a surface for indirect prompt injection through its template-based design picker.

skills.name: gh-review-requests
skills.description_en: Fetch unread GitHub notifications for open PRs where review is requested from a specified team or opened by a team member. Use when asked to "find PRs I need to review", "show my review requests", "what needs my review", "fetch GitHub review requests", or "check team review queue".

audits.summary: This skill is safe to use. it allows users to fetch GitHub review requests for their teams using the GitHub CLI. It follows secure coding practices for command execution and limits operations to the organization's own GitHub environment.

skills.name: firecrawl-build-scrape
skills.description_en: Integrate Firecrawl `/scrape` into product code for single-page extraction. Use when an app already has a URL and needs markdown, HTML, links, screenshots, metadata, or structured page output. Prefer this skill over broader crawl patterns when the feature is page-level.

zh.intro: 把 Firecrawl 的单页抓取接进产品代码：应用手里已经有一个具体网址、需要这一页内容时用它。默认返回 Markdown，除非确实要别的格式，可以取正文、链接、截图和元数据。
zh.usage: 先配好 API key，再按单页抓取的默认参数接进代码；只是页面级的需求就别上更大范围的爬取模式。
zh.notes: 支持自建部署、可改基础地址；正文另有关于内容新鲜度与存活判断的参考文档。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for integrating the Firecrawl scraping API. It follows standard security practices by handling API keys as inputs and refers to official vendor documentation. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: firecrawl-build-search
skills.description_en: Integrate Firecrawl `/search` into product code and agent workflows. Use when an app needs discovery before extraction, when the feature starts with a query instead of a URL, or when the system should search the web and optionally hydrate result content.

zh.intro: 把 Firecrawl 的搜索接口接进产品代码和智能体流程：功能是从一个查询词开始、先发现来源再决定要不要抓正文时用它，可以顺手把结果页的内容也一起取回来。
zh.usage: 配好 API key 后先搜出候选页面清单，再把选中的页面交给单页抓取；搜索和抽取尽量分成两步做。
zh.notes: 正文建议先把搜索当作网址发现的步骤，不要默认把搜索结果整批抓下来。

audits.summary: No security issues were detected in this skill. It provides architectural guidance and documentation for integrating Firecrawl search APIs into agent workflows and refers only to official vendor resources.

skills.name: supabase
skills.description_en: Use when doing ANY task involving Supabase. Triggers: Supabase products (Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, Queues); client libraries and SSR integrations (supabase-js, @supabase/ssr) in Next.js, React, SvelteKit, Astro, Remix; auth issues (login, logout, sessions, JWT, cookies, getSession, getUser, getClaims, RLS); Supabase CLI or MCP server; schema changes, migrations, declarative schemas, security audits, Postgres extensions (pg_graphql, pg_cron, pg_vector); debugging and troubleshooting errors or unexpected behavior on Supabase projects (HTTP errors, Postgres errors, RLS surprises, permission denied, schema cache issues, timeouts, Edge Function crashes, Realtime drops, Storage failures) and reading or querying logs (Logs Explorer, ClickHouse).

zh.intro: Supabase 官方维护的技能，description 覆盖 Database、Auth、Edge Functions、Realtime、Storage、Vectors、Cron、Queues，还包括 supabase-js 与 @supabase/ssr 在 Next.js、React、SvelteKit、Astro、Remix 里的接法，以及 RLS、迁移和日志排查。装量 33.4 万，8 周 -3.3%，curated 与 official 都是 true。
zh.usage: 只要有 Supabase 相关改动就该调它：改 schema 和迁移、RLS 报 permission denied、session 与 JWT 出问题、Edge Function 崩了要读 Logs Explorer。
zh.notes: Snyk 与 ZeroLeaks 都给 warn（MEDIUM），Gen Agent Trust Hub 和 Socket pass；触发面很宽，容易被无关请求误召。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive instructions for interacting with Supabase products and includes high-quality security guidance for users. It references documentation and status endpoints from official vendor domains, which is expected behavior for its intended functionality.

skills.name: mobile-native
skills.description_en: Make a web app feel native on a phone — the small CSS and meta-tag fixes that separate "a website in a browser" from something that feels installed. Covers sticky hover states, tap highlight flashes, the 100vh bug, inputs that zoom the page, laggy taps, pull-to-refresh hijacking scroll, content under the notch, long-press selecting button text, carousels that scroll the wrong way, mismatched status bars, and the rule that you test on real hardware. Use when a web app is being built for or reviewed on mobile, when something "works in Chrome but feels wrong on my phone", when building a PWA, a bottom sheet, a carousel, a full-screen layout, or any touch interaction. For motion itself use animate; for React Native use animate-expo.

zh.intro: 让网页在手机上像装了 App，而不是浏览器里打开的网站：一批小的 CSS 和 meta 标签改动。给正在做或要评审移动端页面的前端用，处理的是那些「桌面正常、手机别扭」的问题。
zh.usage: 移动端开发或评审时用它，尤其当「Chrome 里正常、手机上不对」时。正文覆盖 sticky hover、点按高亮闪烁、`100vh` bug、输入框自动放大页面、点按延迟、下拉刷新抢滚动、刘海遮挡内容、长按选中按钮文字、轮播方向反了和状态栏不匹配。
zh.notes: 正文的硬规矩是真机上测，不在模拟器或桌面浏览器里下结论。这里只修手感；动效本身看 animate，React Native 看 animate-expo。

audits.summary: The skill provides a collection of CSS and HTML best practices for improving the native feel of web applications on mobile devices. No security risks, malicious patterns, or obfuscation were detected.

skills.name: expo-brownfield
skills.description_en: Integrate Expo and React Native into an existing native iOS or Android app. Use for brownfield, embedding a React Native screen in SwiftUI/UIKit or Kotlin, or AAR/XCFramework packaging. Covers isolated and integrated approaches. For building or distributing a purely native app with EAS, use eas-app-stores.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions for integrating Expo into native mobile applications. It utilizes official Expo CLI tools and standard build-time scripts for project configuration and feedback reporting.

skills.name: turborepo
skills.description_en: Configure and troubleshoot Turborepo repositories. Use when working with turbo.json, task pipelines, caching, Remote Cache, the turbo CLI, filtering, environment variables, package boundaries, monorepo structure, or CI workflows.

zh.intro: Turborepo 仓库的配置与排查。完整文档随安装的 turbo 包一起发，所以正文的要求是不要靠这个技能讲框架用法，而是读捆绑文档，让文档版本与安装版本对齐；入口是 node_modules/turbo/docs/README.md，用它的任务索引挑最小相关的那页，改 turbo.json、包脚本或 CI 之前先读。node_modules 不是扁平结构或走 workspace 链接时，先用 node -p "require.resolve('turbo/package.json')" 解析包位置，再按解析出的目录读 docs/README.md。仓库里没装 turbo 时，先看它用的包管理器和现有版本约束再决定装。
zh.usage: 改 turbo.json、任务流水线、缓存、Remote Cache、turbo CLI 参数、过滤、环境变量、包边界、monorepo 结构或 CI 时调用；先读 `node_modules/turbo/docs/README.md`，按任务索引找最小相关页读完再动手。
zh.notes: 需要已安装 turbo 包（文档在包内）；非扁平 node_modules 或 workspace 链接场景要先解析包位置；不要用针对其他版本的资料改配置。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive guidance for managing monorepo workflows using Turborepo. No security issues were detected; the skill adheres to standard development practices and official documentation.

skills.name: clerk-setup
skills.description_en: Set up Clerk authentication in any project with the Clerk CLI and official framework quickstarts. Use when adding Clerk, initializing Clerk, scaffolding a new app with Clerk, or migrating an existing authentication system to Clerk.

zh.intro: 用官方命令行工具和框架快速开始把 Clerk 登录接进项目。支持给新项目初始化、给没有账号的环境先领一套可认领的临时开发密钥，也支持把现有登录系统迁移到 Clerk；原生苹果应用另有单独步骤。
zh.usage: 新增或迁移登录时用官方命令行初始化，各框架另有官方快速开始的步骤可跟。
zh.notes: 当前 SDK 要求 Node.js 20.9.0 以上；命令行工具在受支持的框架上可以不开账号就领临时开发密钥。版本号来自正文兼容性一栏。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates the setup of Clerk authentication using official tools and documentation. It adheres to security best practices, such as explicitly forbidding the agent from reading or printing sensitive environment variable files and warning against exposing secret keys. The skill uses the official Clerk CLI and fetches resources from trusted Clerk domains. A minor risk is identified regarding the processing of untrusted project files, which is a standard attack surface for coding agents.

skills.name: doc-coauthoring
skills.description_en: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

audits.summary: The skill provides a safe, structured workflow for collaborative documentation creation using standard agent tools for file management and context gathering.

skills.name: hyperframes
skills.description_en: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

zh.intro: HyperFrames 的强制入口：凡是要做、改、加动画、渲染视频或动态图形的请求都先读它。输入可以是网址、GitHub PR、Figma 链接、文字或已有素材，它恢复项目状态、装好对应工作流再往下派。安装量 108 万，8 周涨 147.7%。
zh.usage: 第一次接触 HyperFrames 项目；不确定该用哪个子技能；要接着之前的项目继续做。
zh.notes: Snyk 判 warn / MEDIUM；默认输出框架就是 HyperFrames，除非你明确指定别的。

audits.summary: Hyperframes is a video generation and orchestration skill by HeyGen. It converts inputs like website URLs, GitHub PRs, and Figma designs into video compositions. It uses external CLI tools (npx, gh) and manages modular workflow skills. The security profile is safe, with standard risks related to processing external content.

skills.name: clerk-orgs
skills.description_en: Clerk Organizations for B2B and multi-tenant apps - org switching,

zh.intro: Clerk 的 Organizations：团队和工作区切换、角色与权限、邀请成员、验证域名、企业 SSO，以及按组织隔离数据与路由。它不会默认给你开——先数项目里的信号，判断这个应用到底是不是多租户，再问你要不要上。
zh.usage: 已有项目用 `clerk enable orgs` 开通，新项目可以 `clerk init --template b2b-saas`；权限检查从 `auth()` 取 `orgId`、`orgSlug`，再用 `has({ role })` 挡路由。
zh.notes: 要在 Dashboard 里启用 Organizations。Membership required（2025-08-22 起的默认）会把所有登录用户导向选组织并关掉个人账号；B2C 与 B2B 并存必须选 optional。正文反复强调不要在没问过的情况下静默开启。

audits.summary: The clerk-orgs skill is safe and provides authoritative documentation for implementing multi-tenant B2B applications using Clerk. It includes strong security guidance for role-based access control, session-based data isolation, and URL safety.

skills.name: paper-context-resolver
skills.description_en: Rigor Paper Context helper for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use only when the README and repository files leave a narrow reproduction-critical gap and the task is to resolve a specific paper detail such as dataset split, preprocessing, evaluation protocol, checkpoint mapping, or runtime assumption from primary paper sources while recording conflicts. Do not use for general paper summary, repo scanning, environment setup, command execution, title-only paper lookup, or replacing README guidance by default.

zh.intro: 给「按 README 复现深度学习仓库」补最后一块拼图：当 README 和仓库文件之间差一个关键细节时，去论文原文里查数据集切分、预处理、评测协议、checkpoint 对应关系或运行时假设，并把冲突记下来。安装量 46.7 万，8 周涨 6220%；Snyk 给 warn（MEDIUM）。
zh.usage: 复现结果和论文差一截、怀疑是切分或评测口径不一致时；只想查某一条论文细节、不需要通读全文时。
zh.notes: description 明确排除通读总结、扫仓库、配环境、跑命令，它只补那一个缺口。Snyk 标了 MEDIUM。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines for resolving code reproduction issues using research papers. It is functionally safe but processes external repository data and papers, creating a standard surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: minimal-run-and-audit
skills.description_en: Rigor Run skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to capture or normalize evidence from the selected smoke test or documented inference or evaluation command and write standardized `repro_outputs/` files, including patch notes when repository files changed. Do not use for training execution, initial repo intake, generic environment setup, paper lookup, target selection, hidden scientific-meaning changes, or end-to-end orchestration by itself.

zh.intro: 复现流程里负责跑那一下：按选定的 smoke test 或 README 写明的推理/评测命令跑一次，把证据整理成标准的 repro_outputs/ 文件，改过仓库文件还要附 patch 说明。安装量 46.6 万，8 周涨 10213.5%；Socket 给 warn（无风险等级）。
zh.usage: 环境备好、要拿第一次运行结果当基线时；换机器后想确认复现没跑偏时。
zh.notes: 只管跑和记录，训练、装环境、选目标、最终报告都不归它。Socket 给了 warn。

audits.summary: The skill provides a specialized environment for executing and auditing deep learning experiments. It includes tools for capturing command output, git diffs, and scientific metrics to ensure research reproducibility. All identified behaviors, such as command execution and dynamic module loading, are consistent with the skill's stated purpose as a developer tool.

skills.name: firecrawl-map
skills.description_en: Discover and list a site's URLs, with search filtering. Use for "map the site" or "find the URL for" requests — when the user knows the site but not the exact page, or wants site structure.

zh.intro: 列出站点上的 URL，支持按关键词过滤，用来摸清站点结构或找到某个页面的确切地址。给知道是哪个站、但不知道具体哪一页的情况用。
zh.usage: 用户说「把站点 map 一下」或「找到某某页面的 URL」时用它。大站点用 `--search` 直接定位目标页，要全部链接就配 `--limit` 输出 JSON；常见套路是先用 `--search` 找到地址再用 scrape 抓。
zh.notes: map 必须认证，没有免密钥免费额度，无凭据会弹交互登录；输出默认写在 `.firecrawl/` 目录下。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions and examples for using the Firecrawl CLI tool to discover and map website URLs. It is safe for use and adheres to standard practices for utilizing vendor-provided utilities.

skills.name: clerk-nextjs-patterns
skills.description_en: Advanced Next.js patterns - middleware, Server Actions, caching with

zh.intro: Clerk 在 Next.js 里的进阶写法：中间件、Server Actions 与缓存怎么和鉴权配合，以及每个页面、路由处理函数和服务端函数里怎么保护路由。正文提醒要按当前 SDK 的写法来：逐处调用鉴权保护，中间件保持不带参数，已经在 Next.js 新版本里废弃的路由匹配写法不要再新增。
zh.usage: 动手前先看项目里装的 SDK 版本，正文只对核心差异做了行内标注。需要手动校验令牌的场景，也就是不挂中间件的独立接口服务，还要额外配置校验用的公钥。
zh.notes: 正文点名了几个容易过期的点：路由匹配写法在新主版本会被移除，不要往新代码里加；保护写在每个入口里，不要全压在中间件上。

audits.summary: The skill provides secure implementation patterns for integrating Clerk authentication within Next.js applications, covering middleware, server actions, and caching strategies.

skills.name: firecrawl-download
skills.description_en: Save a site or section as local files (markdown, screenshots). Use for "download the site", offline docs, or a local copy for reference.

zh.intro: 把一个站点或栏目存成本地文件，支持 markdown、links 和截图，用来做离线文档或本地参考副本。给需要长期离线查阅某站内容、或想留一份快照的场景用。
zh.usage: 用户说「把站点下载下来」、要离线文档时用它。命令在 `firecrawl x` 组下：先 map 出页面再逐页抓进 `.firecrawl/` 的嵌套目录；自动化跑必须带 `-y`，否则会卡在交互向导上等人输入。
zh.notes: 这是实验性命令。需要认证，没有免密钥免费额度。用 `--format` 同时要多种格式时，每页各存一份文件，例如 index.md、links.txt、screenshot.png。

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate tool provided by Firecrawl for downloading website content as local files. It uses the vendor's own CLI tools and performs standard file and network operations consistent with its stated purpose.

skills.name: prd
skills.description_en: Generate high-quality Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) for software systems and AI-powered features. Includes executive summaries, user stories, technical specifications, and risk analysis.

zh.intro: 写产品需求文档，流程分三段。先是发现访谈，必须问清核心问题（为什么现在做）、成功指标和约束（预算、技术栈、截止时间），不许靠假设填坑；然后是分析与定范围，梳理用户流程、明确非目标来保住工期；最后按固定 schema 起草，含执行摘要、用户故事、技术规格和风险分析。质量标准是可量化：别写「快、简单、直观」，要写「一万条数据下搜索 200 毫秒内返回」，正文给了含糊与具体的对照写法。适用于新功能立项、把模糊想法翻成技术规格、给 AI 功能定需求。
zh.usage: 要写 PRD 时先回答它关于问题、指标和约束的追问，再让它按 schema 出文档，最后逐条把含糊需求换成可测数字。
zh.notes: 采用 MIT 许可；面向软件与 AI 功能；先访谈后成文，信息不全时它继续追问而不是直接编。

audits.summary: The skill is safe to use. It is a text-based instruction template that guides an AI agent to gather information and generate structured Product Requirements Documents (PRDs). It contains no code, dependencies, external data connections, or executable capabilities.

skills.name: firecrawl-crawl
skills.description_en: Bulk-extract many pages from one site or section. Use for "crawl", "everything under /docs", or content spanning linked pages.

zh.intro: 沿链接批量抓一个站点或某个栏目下的多页内容，能限深度和页数。给要一次性拉完 /docs 这类栏目、或内容分散在多个互链页面的场景用。
zh.usage: 要「把 /docs 下面全部抓下来」时用它。配 `--include-paths` 限定栏目、`--limit` 限页数、`--wait` 直接等结果；不加 `--wait` 就拿 job ID 异步轮询。完成标准是输出落进 `.firecrawl/crawl.json` 且页数符合预期。
zh.notes: crawl 必须认证，没有免密钥免费额度，无凭据会弹交互登录。`--wait` 没有默认超时，要用 `--timeout` 自己设上限。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard documentation and instructions for bulk-extracting web data using the Firecrawl CLI. It introduces a potential indirect prompt injection surface through the ingestion of untrusted web content.

skills.name: rust-best-practices
skills.description_en: Guide for writing idiomatic Rust code based on Apollo GraphQL's best practices handbook. Use this skill when: (1) writing new Rust code or functions, (2) reviewing or refactoring existing Rust code, (3) deciding between borrowing vs cloning or ownership patterns, (4) implementing error handling with Result types, (5) optimizing Rust code for performance, (6) writing tests or documentation for Rust projects.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive guide to idiomatic Rust development based on Apollo GraphQL's best practices. It covers coding styles, error handling, performance optimization, and testing procedures using standard ecosystem tools.

skills.name: playwright-cli
skills.description_en: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

zh.intro: 微软官方技能，用 Playwright 跑浏览器交互和网页测试，也能直接维护 Playwright 测试用例。安装量 19.1 万，8 周跌 7.7%，curated 与 official 都标 true；Socket 和 Snyk 两家 warn。
zh.usage: 要在真实浏览器里复现前端问题；给页面写或修 Playwright 用例；跑一遍端到端回归。
zh.notes: Socket 与 Snyk 都 warn（MEDIUM）；描述只有一句话，具体流程得看正文，别按名字想当然。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive browser automation capabilities using Playwright. It includes built-in security considerations for handling untrusted page content and sensitive browser data, following industry best practices for automation tools.

skills.name: javascript-typescript-jest
skills.description_en: Best practices for writing JavaScript/TypeScript tests using Jest, including mocking strategies, test structure, and common patterns.

zh.intro: 写 JavaScript/TypeScript 的 Jest 测试时的约定清单。正文覆盖：测试文件用 .test.ts 或 .test.js 后缀，放在被测代码旁边或 __tests__ 目录；用例名说清预期行为，用嵌套 describe 分组；外部依赖用 jest.mock() 隔离，单个函数用 jest.spyOn()，在 afterEach 里用 jest.resetAllMocks() 复位；异步必须返回 promise 或用 async/await，慢测试用 jest.setTimeout() 放宽；快照要小而聚焦。
zh.usage: 新增或复审 JS/TS 测试、要决定怎么 mock 外部依赖，或者要把测试结构定下来时用它；正文末尾还列了常用 matcher，例如 toBe、toEqual、toThrow、toHaveBeenCalledWith。
zh.notes: 内容是一份约定清单，按测试结构、mock、异步、快照、React 组件分组，最后附常用断言。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructional content and best practices for writing JavaScript and TypeScript tests using the Jest framework. It contains no executable code, remote resource requests, or potential security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: remotion-saas
skills.description_en: Build an app with Remotion

zh.intro: 描述为空。saas 放在 Remotion 技能里通常指给 SaaS 做宣传视频的模板或约定，也可能是别的东西，输入里没写。remotion-dev 官方仓库出品，安装量 16.7 万，8 周涨 162.2%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 要给 SaaS 产品出程序化宣传片、手上有 Remotion 工程时试它；判断不了就先读正文再动。
zh.notes: 无描述；三家 pass。

audits.summary: The skill provides documentation and templates for building video-based SaaS applications using the Remotion framework. It adheres to security best practices by advising users to manage AWS credentials via environment files and warns against sharing sensitive secrets within chat interfaces.

skills.name: remotion-upgrade
skills.description_en: Upgrade Remotion, and related packages

zh.intro: 描述为空。名字 upgrade 指向版本升级这件事，remotion-dev 官方仓库出品，安装量 15.8 万，8 周涨 163.6%，是本片涨幅第三高。三家审计全 pass。

skills.name: firecrawl-build-interact
skills.description_en: Integrate Firecrawl `/interact` into product code for dynamic pages and browser actions after scraping. Use when a feature needs clicks, form fills, pagination, authentication-aware flows, or other multi-step interactions that plain `/scrape` cannot complete.

zh.intro: 把 Firecrawl 的交互接口接进产品代码，在抓取之后继续操作页面：点击、填表、翻页、登录态流程和别的多步交互。页面内容只有点开、输入或跳转之后才出现时用它，普通抓取拿不到。
zh.usage: 先用抓取，拿不到再升到交互；交互范围尽量收窄到最小的浏览器流程，只为了拿到那份数据。功能需要在抓取后留在同一个浏览器上下文里时也走它。
zh.notes: 要 Firecrawl 的 API key；自建部署可以另配服务地址。用前先想清楚哪一步真的需要动手点，能静态拿到的就别升级。

audits.summary: The skill provides architectural guidance for integrating Firecrawl's /interact API endpoint. It contains no executable code or security risks.

skills.name: faceless-explainer
skills.description_en: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

zh.intro: 把任意文本——文章、笔记、一个话题、一份 brief——变成不出镜的解说视频：没有站点可录也没有素材可用，画面要按场自己造，靠排版、抽象图形、图表和数据可视化撑住。适合话题解说、概念拆解、how-to、清单类内容。安装量 50.5 万，8 周涨 131.7%，带 has_references，三家审计 provider 全 pass。
zh.usage: 要做知识区那种纯解说、不露脸也不录屏的视频时用；从网页出片的需求得去 product-launch-video。
zh.notes: 视觉全靠生成、没有素材兜底，所以文案密度和节奏决定成片质量。需求不清楚时先回 /hyperframes。

audits.summary: This skill is a video generation tool that automates the creation of 'faceless' explainer videos. It uses a complex build pipeline involving Node.js scripts, external media processing tools like ffmpeg, and the HyperFrames CLI. The analysis identified potential risks associated with processing untrusted text and the dynamic generation of animation code, which are common for this type of creation software.

skills.name: code-simplifier
skills.description_en: Simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality. Use when asked to "simplify code", "clean up code", "refactor for clarity", "improve readability", or review recently modified code for elegance. Focuses on project-specific best practices.

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill provides instructions for simplifying and refactoring code based on established best practices and references official documentation from a trusted source.

skills.name: gemini-api-dev
skills.description_en: Use this skill when writing code that calls the Gemini API for text generation, multi-turn chat, multimodal understanding, image generation, video generation, speech generation (TTS), voice design, voice replication, streaming responses, background research tasks, function calling, structured output, or migrating from the old generateContent API. Covers SDK usage and best practices for Gemini models and agents in Python and TypeScript.

zh.intro: 写调用 Gemini API 的代码时用：文本生成、多轮对话、多模态理解、图像与视频生成、语音合成与音色设计复刻、流式输出、后台调研任务、function calling、结构化输出，以及从旧 generateContent 接口迁移。给 Python 的 google-genai 与 TypeScript 的 @google/genai 两套用法。正文直接摆出当前模型清单（含推理、flash、图像、TTS、embedding 系列）和可用的托管 agent，并说明 2.5 及更早的型号已废弃：用户点名旧型号时换成当前型号并说明替换。
zh.usage: 写 Gemini 调用前先照它列的当前模型 ID 建 client，多模态、流式、结构化输出照对应片段改，别沿用训练数据里的旧型号。
zh.notes: 正文声明其模型与 SDK 版本优先于模型自身训练数据；Python SDK 需 google-genai 2.30.1 以上。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive documentation and migration resources for the Gemini API, including support for current models, agents, and SDKs. It directs users to official developer resources and follows standard patterns for API development.

skills.name: email-best-practices
skills.description_en: Use when building email features, emails going to spam, high bounce rates, setting up SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, implementing email capture, ensuring compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL), handling webhooks, retry logic, making emails accessible (alt text, headings, contrast, screen readers), or deciding transactional vs marketing.

zh.intro: 把邮件做到能送达、合规、对用户友好。正文给出一条从注册表单到退订处理的链路：校验、双重确认、记录同意、发送前查抑制名单、幂等发送加重试、接收投递事件后回写抑制名单并做名单清理。内容按需要分主题：DNS 认证与进垃圾箱、事务邮件、订阅表单、营销邮件、合规、发送可靠性、webhook、列表管理、可访问性。
zh.usage: 邮件进垃圾箱、退信率高，要给域名配 SPF/DKIM/DMARC，或者在建订阅、事务邮件、合规、webhook 与重试时用它；新项目建议先规划需要哪些邮件，再配好 DNS 认证后才发第一封。
zh.notes: 与 resend/email-best-practices 版本内容相同。作者是 Resend，正文把各主题拆到 references 下的文件，主文件只做导航。

audits.summary: The email-best-practices skill provides comprehensive and safe guidance on building, delivering, and maintaining email features. It includes educational content on accessibility, compliance (GDPR/CAN-SPAM), deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and reliability. The skill consists entirely of documentation and standard code snippets for developer implementation, with all external links pointing to trusted vendor resources or well-known industry diagnostic tools. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: expo-deployment
skills.description_en: Deploy Expo apps to production with EAS — build and submit to the iOS App Store, Google Play Store, and TestFlight, configure eas.json build and submit profiles, manage app versions and build numbers, publish App Store metadata and ASO, and deploy web bundles and API routes via EAS Hosting. Use whenever the user is preparing a production build, running eas build or eas submit, shipping to TestFlight, releasing or rolling out to the app stores, bumping version or build numbers, or setting up store listing metadata for an Expo app.

zh.intro: 用 EAS 把 Expo 应用发到 iOS App Store、Google Play 和 TestFlight：配 eas.json 的 build 与 submit profile、管版本号与 build number、发布商店元数据与 ASO，也能用 EAS Hosting 把 web 包和 API 路由一起发出去。适合要出正式包、跑 eas build 或 eas submit、准备上架或灰度的人。
zh.usage: 先 `npm install -g eas-cli` 再 `eas login`，`npx eas-cli@latest init` 生成 eas.json；出包用 `npx eas-cli@latest build -p ios --profile production`，加 `--submit` 直接送审；快速上 TestFlight 用 `npx testflight`。
zh.notes: 提审前要配好 Apple 凭据（走 `eas credentials`）和 Google Play 的 service account。API 路由本身怎么写看 expo-api-routes，不在这条里。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard documentation and command-line instructions for deploying Expo applications. It includes references to local sensitive credential paths and third-party community tools, though it provides mitigation guidance for secure handling.

It includes a comprehensive checklist of common security pitfalls and a structured scoring system for the evaluation. There are no executable scripts, network operations, or data access concerns.

skills.name: langgraph-persistence
skills.description_en: INVOKE THIS SKILL when your LangGraph needs to persist state, remember conversations, travel through history, or configure subgraph checkpointer scoping. Covers checkpointers, thread_id, time travel, Store, and subgraph persistence modes.

zh.intro: 给 LangGraph 加持久化的做法：checkpointer 在每一步存读图状态，thread_id 区分不同会话，Store 存跨会话的用户偏好和事实，另有历史回溯和子图 checkpointer 的作用范围。附三种 checkpointer 的适用场景与生产可用性对照。
zh.usage: 需要记住对话、跨轮续跑、回放历史或给子图单独配 checkpointer 时加载；先选定 saver，在 compile 时传入，每次调用都要带 thread_id。
zh.notes: InMemorySaver 只适合测试，SqliteSaver 适合本地，生产用 PostgresSaver。短期记忆走 checkpointer，长期记忆走 store。

audits.summary: This skill provides educational and technical guidance for using LangGraph's persistence features. No security issues were detected, and the skill follows best practices for secret management.

skills.name: make-interfaces-feel-better

Use when building UI components, reviewing frontend code, implementing animations, hover states, shadows, borders, typography, icons, micro-interactions, enter/exit animations, or any visual detail work. Supports quick and full review modes. Triggers on UI polish, design details, "make it feel better", "feels off", stagger animations, border radius, optical alignment, font smoothing, tabular numbers, image outlines, box shadows, icons, icon stroke weight, icon states, motion restraint.

zh.intro: 把界面从「能用」做到「用着舒服」的设计工程清单：动画与 hover 态、阴影和边框、字号与图标描边、入场动画的错落节奏、圆角和光学对齐、数字等宽、图片描边这些细节。适合在写 UI 组件或 review 前端代码时逐条对照，有快速和完整两种审查模式。
zh.usage: 做 UI 组件、写动效、调 hover、阴影、边框、排版、图标，或者感觉界面「哪里不对劲」时用它。它不另起一套样式体系：项目用 Tailwind 就用 Tailwind，用纯 CSS 就用 CSS，用 CSS-in-JS 就沿用现有写法，不要为了一个打磨项引入第二套方案。
zh.notes: 是审美与细节原则，不是某个框架的组件库；改动必须表达在项目已有的样式体系里。审查模式下会把动效放慢逐帧看，需要能跑起来的前端环境。

audits.summary: The skill consists of design engineering principles and code examples for polishing user interfaces. No security issues or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: langchain-fundamentals
skills.description_en: Create LangChain agents with create_agent, define tools, and use middleware for human-in-the-loop and error handling.

zh.intro: 用 create_agent() 搭 LangChain 智能体、定义工具、用中间件处理人在环与错误。正文明确建智能体就用 create_agent()，其余写法都已过时。列出的配置项有 model、tools、system_prompt 与 systemPrompt、checkpointer、middleware；工具用 Python 的 @tool 装饰器或 TypeScript 的 tool() 函数定义。正文给了 Python 与 TypeScript 两种写法的代码，人工审核与错误恢复都走中间件。
zh.usage: 要新建 LangChain 智能体、给智能体加工具、接状态持久化，或要人在环审批与错误处理时用；正文只给 create_agent() 这一条路线。
zh.notes: 正文把配置参数表和 Python、TypeScript 两种写法分开列。

audits.summary: This skill serves as a guide for developing agents using the LangChain library. It includes helpful patterns for managing conversation state and implementing human-in-the-loop workflows, which are recommended security practices for agentic systems.

It includes examples for configuring agents with middleware, persistence, and filesystem access as part of its core functionality. While the framework handles file operations and dynamic loading, these patterns are presented as intended features for developers building agents.

Covers required packages, minimum versions, environment requirements, versioning best practices, and common community tool packages for both Python and TypeScript.

audits.summary: This skill provides helpful guidance and templates for managing dependencies within the LangChain ecosystem. It follows security best practices by using placeholders for API keys and recommending official, well-known packages.

skills.name: upgrade-stripe
skills.description_en: Guide for upgrading Stripe API versions, webhook endpoints, server-side SDKs, Stripe.js, and mobile SDKs

zh.intro: 把 Stripe 集成升到新版本的流程参考：API 版本、webhook 端点、服务端 SDK、Stripe.js 和移动端 SDK 都在范围内。重点是先确定目标版本，再把集成里所有钉住版本的地方都比一遍——客户端配置、单请求覆盖、webhook 端点。
zh.usage: 要升级 Stripe API 版本或 SDK 时用它：用户给了目标版本就用，没给就查 `https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning.md`，或者跑 `stripe docs /api/versioning`。连不上 docs.stripe.com 时才用内置兜底 `2026-09-30.endive`（2026-10-20 的快照，超过一个月就很可能过期）。
zh.notes: 版本号就是发布日期 YYYY-MM-DD，Stripe 每月发新的稳定版；兜底版本别当最新版用，也不要猜更新的版本号。改动前要逐个比对集成里钉住的 API 版本。

audits.summary: This skill provides guidance for upgrading Stripe integrations, including API versions, SDKs, and webhook configurations. It follows standard developer practices by referencing official documentation, verified packages, and established CLI tools from the authoring organization.

skills.name: langgraph-human-in-the-loop
skills.description_en: INVOKE THIS SKILL when implementing human-in-the-loop patterns, pausing for approval, or handling errors in LangGraph. Covers interrupt(), Command(resume=...), approval/validation workflows, and the 4-tier error handling strategy.

zh.intro: 在 LangGraph 里实现人机协同：用 interrupt 暂停图执行、把值抛给调用方，用 Command 的 resume 把人的输入送回继续跑。讲清三个前提：编译时挂 checkpointer 保存暂停状态、每次调用带同一个 thread_id、抛出的载荷能 JSON 序列化；也提醒恢复时节点会从头重跑，interrupt 之前的代码会再执行一遍。附审批与校验工作流、四层错误处理策略，Python 与 TypeScript 双语代码。
zh.usage: 需要在流程中间停下来等人批准、等校验结果，或要处理图里的错误时用。恢复前先确认暂停点之前的副作用是否幂等，否则重跑会重复执行。
zh.notes: 开发用内存版 checkpointer，生产换持久化的，比如 Postgres 版。

audits.summary: This skill provides guidance and code examples for implementing human-in-the-loop patterns using LangGraph. It is entirely instructional and does not present any security considerations or risky patterns.

skills.description_en: Build UIs with @nuxt/ui v4 — 125+ accessible Vue components with Tailwind CSS theming. Use when creating interfaces, customizing themes to match a brand, building forms, or composing layouts like dashboards, docs sites, and chat interfaces.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation and components for building user interfaces with Nuxt UI. It follows standard web development practices and uses well-known, trusted ecosystem packages.

skills.name: hyperframes-cli
skills.description_en: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, history, clean, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

zh.intro: HeyGen 那套 HyperFrames 项目的 CLI 开发循环：init、add、catalog、capture、check、render、publish、cloud、doctor 等几十条子命令，覆盖本地、HeyGen 云、AWS Lambda、Google Cloud Run 四种渲染位置。安装量 112 万，8 周涨 137.5%；flags 标 deprecated，validate / inspect / layout 已是废弃别名，改用 check。
zh.usage: 需要脚本化地跑渲染和发布；排查渲染失败；批量出片。
zh.notes: 已标 deprecated，长期项目别新建在它上面；Snyk 判 warn / MEDIUM。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive CLI interface for the HyperFrames video creation framework by HeyGen. It supports project scaffolding, asset cataloging, timeline management, and various rendering options including local, HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run. The security analysis indicates that the skill operates as expected for a developer tool, involving the installation of its own CLI from npm, downloading binary dependencies like Chromium and FFmpeg, and transmitting project data to the vendor's cloud infrastructure for rendering and telemetry. Standard precautions for handling untrusted data and anonymizing bug reports are integrated into the documentation.

skills.name: three
skills.description_en: Three.js and WebGL adapter patterns for HyperFrames. Use when creating deterministic Three.js scenes, WebGL canvas layers, AnimationMixer timelines, camera motion, shader-driven visuals, or canvas renders that respond to HyperFrames hf-seek events.

zh.intro: HyperFrames 里的 Three.js 与 WebGL 适配层：它不接管你的场景，只把 HyperFrames 的时间发出来并派发 seek 事件，让合成按指定帧渲染。做确定性的 Three.js 场景、WebGL 画布层、AnimationMixer 时间线或着色器画面时用，要求按 HyperFrames 时间渲染而不是挂钟时间。
zh.usage: 按契约写：场景、相机、渲染器和贴图尽量同步创建，监听 `hf-seek` 事件并按事件里的时间渲染，模型与 HDRI 在 seek 之前加载完。适配层每次 seek 会写 `window.__hfThreeTime` 并派发 `new CustomEvent("hf-seek", { detail: { time } })`。
zh.notes: 别把 requestAnimationFrame 或 renderer.setAnimationLoop 当作渲染的主时钟。正文的例子用 `<canvas id="three-layer">` 加 CDN 上的 three 模块。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and code patterns for integrating Three.js with HyperFrames. It uses a trusted CDN for its library dependency and standard CLI tools for validation. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: upstash-redis-js
skills.description_en: Work with the @upstash/redis TypeScript/JavaScript SDK, a serverless HTTP-based Redis client for Next.js, Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, edge runtimes, and Node.js. Use when adding a cache (cache-aside, write-through, TTL and expiration strategies), session storage and user sessions, a key-value store, leaderboards and rankings with sorted sets, counters, distributed locks, queues with lists, streams and consumer groups, sparse index-addressed arrays and ring buffers (ARSET, ARINSERT, ARRING, ARGREP, AROP), embeddings and nearest-neighbour vector search stored inside Redis (VECTOR commands via redis.vector, separate from @upstash/vector), JSON documents, pipelines and MULTI/EXEC transactions, Lua scripting, read replicas, or full-text search, typo-tolerant search, facets, aggregations, and search over Redis stream entries with Upstash Redis Search (different from regular FT.SEARCH; also available for TCP clients via @upstash/search-redis and @upstash/search-ioredis). Also use when migrating from ioredis or node-redis, when a Redis connection is needed from a serverless function without connection pooling, when integrating @upstash/ratelimit, or when the user says Redis cache, KV store, session store, serverless Redis, or Upstash Redis. Also use when building AI agents on Redis with Upstash AgentKit (agent memory, chat history, RAG tools, tool caching, chat persistence, resumable streams, distributed locks) for the Vercel AI SDK, TanStack AI, or Vercel Eve. Supports automatic serialization/deserialization of JavaScript types.

zh.intro: 围绕 @upstash/redis 这个走 HTTP 的 Redis 客户端写的用法手册：缓存（旁路、写穿、过期策略）、会话存储、有序集合作排行榜、计数器、分布式锁、列表队列、Stream 与消费组、稀疏下标数组和环形缓冲、把向量存进 Redis 做最近邻检索、JSON 文档、管道与事务、Lua 脚本、只读副本、全文与拼写容错搜索。按数据类型分章，配自动序列化的代码片段，也有从 ioredis、node-redis 迁过来的对照。
zh.usage: 按数据类型章节找对应写法：初始化后缓存、会话、排行榜各有现成示例，向量检索单独一章。
zh.notes: 需要 REST URL 和 TOKEN 两个环境变量；正文提到没有实例时可临时开一个免注册的库，3 天有效。它讲 SDK 用法，限流集成等事项看同系列别的技能。

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive guide for using the Upstash Redis JavaScript SDK. It follows security best practices for credential management by advocating for environment variables and relies on official vendor resources. While the skill facilitates data ingestion from external databases, it does so as a standard database client with no malicious patterns or unexpected behaviors detected.

Covers HumanInTheLoopMiddleware for human approval of dangerous tool calls, creating custom middleware with hooks, Command resume patterns, and structured output with Pydantic/Zod.

skills.name: firebase-firestore

zh.intro: 创建、查询与配置 Cloud Firestore 数据库，Standard 和 Enterprise 版都覆盖，包括数据建模、安全规则、索引，以及 Web、Python、iOS、Android、Flutter 各端 SDK 的接入。正文特别提醒：涉及编写或修改 firestore.rules 时，如果有子代理能力就交给 firestore-rules-author，否则用 firestore-rules-creation。作者标为 Google LLC，正文说最配 Firebase CLI，但不是必须，可以用一次性的 firebase-tools 命令。Hosting、Data Connect、认证、存储、Crashlytics、Functions、BigQuery 都不在范围内。
zh.usage: 要建库、列出库、设计集合与索引、写各端查询，或接 SDK 时调用；改规则文件请走规则作者那条路。
zh.notes: 规则编写有专门的子代理或技能，别在这里手改规则。

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe and follows established development patterns for the Firebase platform. It utilizes official Google/Firebase tools and repositories for configuration and dependency management. It includes a specific instruction for the agent to extract and read documentation from local library source archives, which constitutes a minor surface for indirect prompt injection from local build artifacts.

skills.name: opentui
skills.description_en: OpenTUI skill for building terminal user interfaces with the Core, React, or Solid APIs. Use for any TUI task including components, layout, keyboard and keymap handling, animations, and testing.

zh.intro: 用 OpenTUI 写终端界面：Core、React、Solid 三套 API 都覆盖，组件、布局、键盘与键位映射、动画和测试都在范围内。正文给了四条硬规则，其中一条是新建项目用 create-tui 且选项必须写在参数前面，另一条是别直接调 process.exit()，要用 renderer.destroy()。
zh.usage: 任何 TUI 任务都可以用它，先按正文的决策树选框架，再翻对应的参考文件（core、react、solid，以及 components、layout、keyboard、keymap、animation、testing）。建新项目要写成 `bunx create-tui -t react my-app`，写成 `bunx create-tui my-app -t react` 不生效。React/Solid 里改文字样式要用嵌套的修饰元素，不能用 props。
zh.notes: 参考文件按 core、react、solid 的 5 文件模式组织，另有单文件的横向指南。正文提示 create-tui 的选项写在参数后面会不生效。

audits.summary: This skill contains documentation and usage patterns for the OpenTUI framework, designed for building terminal user interfaces across Core, React, and SolidJS. The analysis confirmed that the skill provides legitimate development guidance; no malicious code, persistence mechanisms, or obfuscation were detected. Findings are limited to standard platform capabilities and recommended scaffolding tools.

skills.name: web-artifacts-builder
skills.description_en: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). Use for complex artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components - not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.

zh.intro: 用来做复杂、多组件的 claude.ai HTML 作品，技术栈是 React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Parcel 打包 + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui。流程是先初始化前端仓库，再改生成的代码开发，然后把代码打包成一个 HTML 文件，最后展示并按需测试。需要状态管理、路由或 shadcn/ui 组件的复杂作品才用它，简单单文件 HTML 或 JSX 不在范围内；正文还提醒别做成过度居中、紫色渐变、统一圆角加 Inter 字体那种观感。
zh.usage: 要做需要状态管理、路由或 shadcn/ui 组件的复杂 claude.ai 网页作品时用；简单单文件页面不用它，步骤是先初始化仓库，开发完打包成单个 HTML。
zh.notes: 正文给的设计提醒是避开过度居中、紫色渐变、统一圆角和 Inter 字体；许可条款在 LICENSE.txt。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive suite for building React-based web artifacts using modern frontend tools. It includes several security considerations, such as the execution of development-oriented shell commands, the installation of numerous external dependencies from public registries, and the dynamic modification of configuration files. While these behaviors are characteristic of a standard development workflow, they represent operational risks that should be reviewed. See the detailed analysis for context.

skills.name: ai-research-reproduction
skills.description_en: Rigor Reproduce compatible skill slug for README-first deep learning repository reproduction. Use when the user wants an end-to-end, minimal-trustworthy flow that reads the repository first, selects the smallest documented inference or evaluation target, coordinates intake, setup, trusted execution, optional trusted training, optional repository analysis, and optional paper-gap resolution, enforces conservative patch rules, records evidence assumptions deviations and human decision points, and writes the standardized `repro_outputs/` bundle. Do not use for paper summary, generic environment setup, isolated repo scanning, standalone command execution, silent protocol changes, score chasing, or broad research assistance outside repository-grounded reproduction.

zh.intro: Rigor 系列的复现技能：README 优先，先读仓库，再选最小的、有文档记录的推理或评测目标，串起 intake、环境、可信执行、可选训练和可选论文空白处理，产出统一的 repro_outputs/。装量 32.7 万，8 周涨 7054%，带 references。
zh.usage: 拿到论文官方仓库、要跑出能信的数字时用；写论文摘要、搭通用环境、追分数都不在它的范围内。
zh.notes: Socket 给 warn，Snyk 与 Gen Agent Trust Hub pass；它明确禁止静默改协议和追分。

audits.summary: The skill provides a framework for reproducing AI research repositories. It includes extensive security controls such as environment variable filtering, file path validation, and integrity checks. The tool's behavior is consistent with its stated purpose of research reproduction.

skills.name: mongodb-atlas-stream-processing
skills.description_en: Manages MongoDB Atlas Stream Processing (ASP) workflows. Handles workspace provisioning, data source/sink connections, processor lifecycle operations, debugging diagnostics, and tier sizing. Supports Kafka, Atlas clusters, S3, HTTPS, and Lambda integrations for streaming data workloads and event processing. NOT for general MongoDB queries or Atlas cluster management. Requires MongoDB MCP Server with Atlas API credentials.

audits.summary: The skill is safe and contains standard documentation, workflow guides, and configuration references for managing MongoDB Atlas Stream Processing workflows without any malicious patterns or vulnerabilities.

skills.name: explore-code
skills.description_en: Rigor Improve implementation leaf skill for auditable candidate implementation in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory work on an isolated branch or worktree to transplant modules, adapt a backbone, add LoRA or adapter layers, replace a head, or stitch together meaningful low-risk migration ideas with rollback-aware records in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline reproduction, conservative debugging, environment setup, verified contribution claims, or default repository analysis.

zh.intro: Rigor 系列里做候选实现的叶子技能：必须由研究者明确授权、在隔离分支或工作树上动手，搬模块、换 backbone、加 LoRA 或 adapter、换 head，并把改动和回滚方式记进 explore_outputs/。装量 32.6 万，8 周涨 11312%，Gen Agent Trust Hub 给 warn（MEDIUM）。
zh.usage: 已经跑通基线、想把别处的模块迁进来试一下时用；复现基线、保守调试、环境搭建都不是它。
zh.notes: Gen Agent Trust Hub 报 warn（MEDIUM），Socket 与 Snyk pass；动手前得自己能回滚。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates exploratory code modifications in deep learning repositories. It dynamically loads external scripts from relative file system paths and processes data from repository files and JSON payloads, creating potential surfaces for indirect prompt injection and unauthorized code execution.

skills.name: run-train
skills.description_en: Rigor Train skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when a documented or selected training command should be run conservatively for startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume, with command, config, seed, log, checkpoint, status, and metric evidence written to standardized `train_outputs/`. Do not use for environment setup, exploratory sweeps, speculative idea implementation, or end-to-end orchestration.

zh.intro: Rigor 系列的训练技能：按文档里选好的训练命令，做启动验证、短跑验证、正式开跑或续跑，把 command、config、seed、log、checkpoint、status、metric 证据写进 train_outputs/。装量 32.6 万，8 周涨 14193%，Gen Agent Trust Hub 给 warn（MEDIUM）。
zh.usage: 训练脚本已经调通、要跑一次可审计的短跑或正式训练时用；扫参搜索和想法实现不在这条里。
zh.notes: Gen Agent Trust Hub 报 warn（MEDIUM）；它假设命令已经写好，不负责踩环境。

audits.summary: The skill executes deep learning training commands and manages evidence outputs. It uses dynamic code loading to import shared utilities and parses training logs for progress tracking, which presents a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: explore-run
skills.description_en: Rigor Improve / Rigor Explore run leaf skill for bounded exploratory evidence in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory runs such as small-subset validation, short-cycle guess-and-check, batch sweeps, idle-GPU search, or quick transfer-learning trials, with fair-comparison caveats and no-overclaim summaries in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline execution, conservative training verification, default routing, verified SOTA claims, or implicit experimentation.

zh.intro: Rigor 系列里跑探索实验的叶子技能：在研究者明确授权下做小样本验证、短周期猜测式试跑、批量扫描、闲卡搜索或快速迁移试跑，产出写进 explore_outputs/，并附公平性说明和不夸大结论。装量 32.6 万，8 周涨 15417%，Gen Agent Trust Hub 给 warn（MEDIUM）。
zh.usage: 想先拿小样本探一下方向、又不打算对外声称结果时用；基线可信执行和正式训练验证要换别的技能。
zh.notes: Gen Agent Trust Hub 报 warn（MEDIUM），另两家 pass；它产出的东西不能当 SOTA 结论用。

audits.summary: The skill performs dynamic code execution by loading a Python module from a calculated file path at runtime. It also processes external JSON specifications that could influence experiment planning and downstream command execution.

skills.name: core
skills.description_en: Core package for defining schemas, catalogs, and AI prompt generation for json-render. Use when working with @json-render/core, defining schemas, creating catalogs, or building JSON specs for UI/video generation.

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for a core UI generation library. It follows security best practices for secret management and includes built-in validation utilities, though its dynamic nature presents some standard security considerations for review.

skills.name: gh-stack
skills.description_en: Manages stacked PRs and splits multi-part work into reviewable branches with gh-stack. Use for stack creation, viewing, edits, push, submit, sync, rebase, merge, or checkout; when asked to split or isolate work for review; whenever a user mentions a stack, branch layers, dependent PRs, or gh stack; or when a stack is checked out.

zh.intro: gh stack 是 GitHub CLI 扩展，用来管一串按顺序叠起来的分支和 PR：每个分支一个 PR，基于下一层分支，评审只看本层的 diff。技能给了建栈、查看、加分支、推送、提交、同步、rebase、合并、切换的命令，并指明哪些在非交互环境里会卡在菜单或全屏界面上。
zh.usage: 要拆多层 PR、查看栈结构或做栈内导航时加载；脚本和代理里一律带参数，查看用 view 加 --json，提交用 submit 加 --auto，合并用 merge 加目标名和 --yes。
zh.notes: 需要 Git 2.36 以上和已登录的 gh。多远端仓库不带 --remote 不要跑 push、submit、sync、rebase。modify 只有 TUI，没有脚本入口。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions for using the GitHub CLI 'gh-stack' extension to manage stacked pull requests. It includes guidance on setup, workflow optimization, and troubleshooting common Git scenarios. All identified external resources and commands originate from trusted sources associated with the GitHub CLI ecosystem.

skills.name: firebase-basics
skills.description_en: Provides foundational Firebase CLI setup, CLI installation, version checks (`firebase-tools@latest --version`), CLI login (including --no-localhost), project creation, project selection (`firebase use`), and app config file downloads (`google-services.json`, `GoogleService-Info.plist`). Use ONLY for CLI login, project creation/switching, or downloading app config files. Don't use for Firebase Hosting deploy, Firestore, Auth, App Hosting, Data Connect, Crashlytics, or Remote Config.

zh.intro: Firebase 的地基部分：装 firebase-tools、查版本、CLI 登录（含 --no-localhost）、建项目和用 firebase use 切项目、下载 google-services.json 与 GoogleService-Info.plist。安装量 18.7 万，8 周跌 15.1%，Socket 和 ZeroLeaks 两家 warn。
zh.usage: 新机器要装 Firebase CLI 并完成登录；要新建项目或在环境间切换；要下 Android/iOS 的配置文件。
zh.notes: 描述把范围限死在 CLI 登录、建/切项目、下配置文件；Hosting、Firestore、Auth 等一概不管。Socket 与 ZeroLeaks 都 warn。

audits.summary: This skill provides tools for setting up and managing Firebase projects within an AI agent environment. It covers CLI installation, authentication, and project configuration for Web, Android, iOS, and Flutter platforms. The skill follows established developer workflows and uses official Firebase tools. A standard indirect prompt injection surface exists where user-provided strings are used in command-line arguments, which is typical for configuration utilities.

skills.name: refactor
skills.description_en: Surgical code refactoring to improve maintainability without changing behavior. Covers extracting functions, renaming variables, breaking down god functions, improving type safety, eliminating code smells, and applying design patterns. Less drastic than repo-rebuilder; use for gradual improvements.

zh.intro: 在不改外部行为的前提下改善结构：拆长函数、拆解巨型函数、提取重复逻辑、改名、加强类型、消掉代码坏味道。规则是先有测试再动手（没有测试只是编辑不是重构）、每次小步改完就跑测试、重构和加功能不混在一起、每个安全状态前后都提交。正文给了长函数、重复代码等坏味道的对照改法，也列了不该重构的情况：不会变的代码、没有测试的生产代码、赶工期的时候。
zh.usage: 说「重构这段」「把这个函数拆开」，让它按小步走的顺序给 diff 和每一步的理由；先确认目标代码有测试，没有就先补测试。
zh.notes: 只做渐进改进，不做整仓重写；生产关键代码没测试时它应当先停下来让你补测试。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive and secure guidelines for code refactoring best practices. It contains no malicious code, dangerous commands, or data exfiltration patterns.

skills.name: remotion-studio
skills.description_en: Preview a Remotion video

zh.intro: 在写或改 Remotion 视频时把 Studio 跑起来并打开预览，让用户边看边指挥。正文说项目一旦能跑就先开 Studio，不要等合成写完。在 Cursor 里不加参数运行，浏览器会自动打开；其他宿主可以用不自动打开浏览器的方式运行，再自己打开打印出来的地址。Studio 已经开着时命令会打印地址后退出，否则是常驻进程。用禁止自动打开的参数时，要在内置浏览器里打开那个地址并确认 Studio 与视频预览都能加载。正文标注版本 4.0.537。
zh.usage: 要一边改 Remotion 合成一边看效果时用；项目能跑就先开预览，若已有实例会打印地址后退出。
zh.notes: 无法在内置浏览器里打开地址时，不要用禁止自动打开的参数。

audits.summary: This skill is safe. It enables previewing Remotion videos by providing instructions to run the standard `remotion studio` command via npx. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description_en: Security code review for vulnerabilities. Use when asked to "security review", "find vulnerabilities", "check for security issues", "audit security", "OWASP review", or review code for injection, XSS, authentication, authorization, cryptography issues. Provides systematic review with confidence-based reporting.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive security auditing tool designed to help AI agents identify vulnerabilities in codebases. It contains extensive documentation and examples of common security flaws (such as SQL injection, XSS, and supply chain attacks) to guide the analysis process. Automated scanner alerts regarding malware and code injection are false positives triggered by the inclusion of these educational examples within the documentation.

skills.name: game-engine
skills.description_en: Expert skill for building web-based game engines and games using HTML5, Canvas, WebGL, and JavaScript. Use when asked to create games, build game engines, implement game physics, handle collision detection, set up game loops, manage sprites, add game controls, or work with 2D/3D rendering. Covers techniques for platformers, breakout-style games, maze games, tilemaps, audio, multiplayer via WebRTC, and publishing games.

zh.intro: 用 HTML5、Canvas、WebGL 和 JavaScript 做网页游戏与游戏引擎：游戏循环、物理、碰撞检测、精灵管理、操作输入、2D/3D 渲染。也覆盖平台跳跃、打砖块、迷宫、瓦片地图、音频、WebRTC 联机与发布上线这些具体玩法。
zh.usage: 要在浏览器里做游戏或写游戏引擎时用它，涉及游戏循环、碰撞、精灵、渲染或联机都能对上。
zh.notes: 这批里没有抓到正文，卡片只按目录描述写。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive collection of educational resources, reference documentation, and code templates for developing web-based games using HTML5, Canvas, WebGL, and various JavaScript frameworks. It correctly references libraries from well-known content delivery networks and trusted public repositories. The templates demonstrate common game design patterns, such as loading level data from external files, and no malicious behaviors or security risks were identified during the analysis.

skills.name: firebase-data-connect
skills.description_en: Builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (aka Firebase Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL securely. Use when designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time data updates, or generating type-safe SDKs. Use when you need a relational database with Firebase, or when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect.

zh.intro: 官方技能，用 Firebase SQL Connect（Data Connect）在 PostgreSQL 上搭后端：设计表与关系、写带授权的 query 和 mutation、配实时数据、生成类型安全 SDK。安装量 16.6 万，8 周跌 15.9%，Socket 给 warn，Runlayer 直接 fail。
zh.usage: 业务需要关系型数据库而不是 Firestore 时；要给 Postgres 接一层带权限的数据接口；要生成类型安全的客户端 SDK。
zh.notes: Runlayer fail 加 Socket warn，是本片里审计最差的官方技能，装前务必自己读正文。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive environment for developing and deploying Firebase SQL Connect backends. It relies on official Firebase CLI tools and follows industry-standard security practices for relational database management, authorization, and data validation.

skills.name: react-email

Covers welcome emails, password resets, notifications, order confirmations, newsletters, transactional emails, and the embeddable email editor component.

audits.summary: The skill provides a suite of components and guidelines for building, rendering, and sending responsive HTML emails using React and Tailwind CSS. It includes support for a visual editor, internationalization, and integration with various email service providers. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: find-docs
