Use this skill whenever the user asks about a specific library, framework, SDK, CLI tool, or cloud service — even for well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. Your training data may not reflect recent API changes or version updates.

audits.summary: The skill provides a documentation lookup utility using the `ctx7` CLI tool from npm. It helps developers find API references and code examples for various libraries and frameworks. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: next-cache-components-optimizer
skills.description_en: Optimize the meaningful UI available immediately from a Next.js route on an initial load (hard navigation) or named client-side navigation (soft navigation). Encode the goal as a failing @next/playwright instant() e2e and work it to green, one verified route and entry point at a time; the shipped test then guards against regression. Use when asked to grow a static shell, fix a slow first paint or non-instant navigation, diagnose which Suspense boundary blocks useful UI, or add instant() regression coverage. Requires Next.js 16.3+ with Cache Components already adopted.

audits.summary: This skill provides a developer-focused workflow for optimizing Next.js 16+ applications by utilizing official framework testing APIs and Playwright. It facilitates a test-driven approach to improving route navigation performance and includes built-in guidance to prevent the accidental exposure of testing utilities in production environments.

skills.name: hyperframes-core
skills.description_en: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

zh.intro: HyperFrames 的组合契约：项目结构、data-* timing 属性、class="clip"、轨道、子组合、变量、媒体播放由框架接管、确定性渲染规则和校验。写组合 HTML 之前先读它。安装量 89 万，8 周涨 94.5%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 手写 HyperFrames 组合前定结构；动画时间对不齐要查 timing 属性；渲染结果不确定要查确定性规则。
zh.notes: 只对 HyperFrames 有效，普通网页 HTML 不适用。

audits.summary: The hyperframes-core skill provides technical documentation and standards for authoring video compositions using the HyperFrames framework, emphasizing deterministic rendering with HTML and GSAP.

skills.name: expo-tailwind-setup
skills.description_en: Framework (OSS). Set up Tailwind CSS v4 in Expo with react-native-css and NativeWind v5 for universal styling

zh.intro: 在 Expo 项目里接入 Tailwind CSS v4，走 react-native-css 运行时加 NativeWind v5 的 Metro 转换器，让 iOS、Android、Web 三端共用一套样式写法。正文给出依赖清单、需要固定的 lightningcss 版本、Metro 与 PostCSS 的配置改动，也说明了为什么 Expo 下不需要 autoprefixer。
zh.usage: 依赖用 `npx expo install` 装 tailwindcss v4、nativewind 预览版、react-native-css 夜间版和 @tailwindcss/postcss。然后在 package.json 里把 lightningcss 固定到 1.30.1，再改 metro.config.js 与全局样式入口；Expo 自带 postcss，不用另装。
zh.notes: 正文写明这套组合里 NativeWind v5 还是预览版、react-native-css 还是夜间版，版本号会变，装之前以仓库文档为准。

audits.summary: The skill contains no files or code to analyze and therefore poses no security risk.

skills.name: react-native-best-practices
skills.description_en: Provides React Native performance optimization guidelines for FPS, TTI, bundle size, memory leaks, re-renders, and animations. Applies to tasks involving Hermes optimization, JS thread blocking, bridge overhead, FlashList, native modules, or debugging jank and frame drops.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive performance optimization guide for React Native applications. It contains standard developer workflows using command-line tools and patterns for advanced techniques like remote code splitting, which include detailed security hardening advice.

skills.name: writing hookify rules
skills.description_en: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create a hookify rule", "write a hook rule", "configure hookify", "add a hookify rule", or needs guidance on hookify rule syntax and patterns.

zh.intro: 教怎么写 hookify 规则：带 YAML frontmatter 的 markdown 文件，定义要盯住的模式和命中后给 Claude 看的消息，规则文件放在 .claude/hookify.{rule-name}.local.md。frontmatter 里 name 必填、用 kebab-case 并以动词开头；enabled 控制开关；event 选 bash、file、stop、prompt 或 all；action 可选 warn（默认）或 block；pattern 是 Python 正则。多条件写法用 conditions 列表，全部命中才触发。
zh.usage: 要新增或调整 hookify 规则时用它，比如拦住危险命令、提示别把密钥写进环境文件；正文还讲了消息体该写什么，比如说明检测到什么、为什么有问题、有没有替代做法。
zh.notes: 正文区分基础写法（单条 pattern）与高级写法（conditions 多条件），并给出条件字段与操作符清单。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and guidance on writing 'Hookify' rules, which are defensive patterns used to warn or block potentially problematic actions. It is instructional in nature and does not contain any executable code or security risks.

skills.name: create-payment-credential
skills.description_en: Gets secure payment credentials (cards, tokens) from a Link wallet for one-time purchases and recurring payments. Use when the user says "get me a card", "buy something", "pay for X", "make a purchase", "I need to pay", "complete checkout", or asks to set up a subscription or transact on a merchant site. Use when the user asks to connect or log in to or sign up for their Link account.

audits.summary: This skill facilitates secure payments and credential management using Stripe's Link service. It incorporates robust security practices, including guidance on handling sensitive data, avoiding shell injection, and mitigating potential indirect prompt injection from third-party merchant sites.

skills.name: expo ui swiftui
skills.description_en: `@expo/ui/swift-ui` package lets you use SwiftUI Views and modifiers in your app.

audits.summary: The skill provides standard instructions for using the Expo UI library to integrate SwiftUI views into Expo projects. It uses official vendor packages and documentation.

skills.name: expo ui jetpack compose
skills.description_en: `@expo/ui/jetpack-compose` package lets you use Jetpack Compose Views and modifiers in your app.

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for integrating Jetpack Compose views into Expo applications. It facilitates the use of the @expo/ui package, referencing official documentation and local type definitions. The included commands and external links are consistent with standard developer workflows and utilize trusted resources from the Expo ecosystem.

skills.name: doc
skills.description_en: Use when the task involves reading, creating, or editing `.docx` documents, especially when formatting or layout fidelity matters; prefer `python-docx` plus the bundled `scripts/render_docx.py` for visual checks.

audits.summary: The skill is vulnerable to indirect prompt injection as it processes untrusted Word documents which can contain instructions to hijack the AI agent. It also uses an unsafe XML parsing library and executes system commands on external files, increasing the risk of denial-of-service or exploitation via malformed documents.

skills.name: media-use
skills.description_en: Agent Media OS for a HyperFrames project. Resolve BGM, SFX, image, icon, brand logo, voice, color grade, or LUT into a frozen local file or paste-ready block + ledger record (one verb, `resolve`); generate via TTS / music / image models when the catalog misses; produce voiceover, transcription, captions, and background removal through one shared audio engine; operate on media (cut / reframe / transform); and reuse assets across projects. Also use for vague feedback that real footage looks dark, flat, boring, should feel retro/camcorder/print/ASCII, needs privacy, or needs a media reveal. When the host app provides its own music or sound-effect tools, use those for music and sound effects; `resolve --type bgm` needs the heygen CLI, while `--type sfx` needs no account (Openverse, then a bundled library). When `HEYGEN_API_BASE` is set, HeyGen calls go through that host with no CLI sign-in.

zh.intro: HyperFrames 项目的素材中枢：用 resolve 一条命令把 BGM、音效、图片、图标、品牌 logo、配音、调色 LUT 落成本地文件或可粘贴片段并记账；目录里没有就现场生成，配音、转写、字幕、抠像共用一套音频引擎。安装量 99 万，8 周涨 143.9%。
zh.usage: 剪片时缺 BGM 或音效；要把一段口播转成字幕；素材想在多个项目里复用。
zh.notes: 取 BGM 需要 heygen CLI，取音效不需要账号；Socket 和 Snyk 都判 warn。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive media management system for AI agents, allowing them to resolve, generate, and process audio and visual assets. It uses a combination of vendor-specific APIs (HeyGen), trusted cloud services (Google Gemini, ElevenLabs), and local processing tools (FFmpeg, MLX-based models). Security analysis confirms the skill is safe, employing best practices such as redacting secrets from logs, validating download URLs against a private network blocklist, and avoiding shell execution when handling user-provided input.

skills.name: organization-best-practices
skills.description_en: Configure multi-tenant organizations, manage members and invitations, define custom roles and permissions, set up teams, and implement RBAC using Better Auth's organization plugin. Use when users need org setup, team management, member roles, access control, or the Better Auth organization plugin.

zh.intro: Better Auth 组织插件的多租户配置：成员与邀请、自定义角色与权限、团队划分、RBAC。接入顺序是服务端配置加 organization 插件、客户端加 organizationClient 插件、迁移数据库，然后确认 organization、member、invitation 三张表建出来了；建组织的人会自动拿到 owner 角色。
zh.usage: 要给产品加多租户组织、管成员和邀请、定义角色权限时用它。built-in adapter 用 `npx auth@latest migrate` 迁移；组织创建权用 allowUserToCreateOrganization 控制，配额用 organizationLimit 和 membershipLimit 限。
zh.notes: 服务端和客户端两边插件必须都加，少一边调用就会失败。organizationLimit 是每个用户能建的组织数，membershipLimit 是每个组织的人数上限，别配反。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions for configuring multi-tenant organizations with Better Auth. However, it recommends running a CLI command from a generic package name ('auth') not associated with the vendor's verified namespace, which presents a supply chain risk. Additionally, the email templates provided in the examples do not include data sanitization, creating a surface for content injection via user-controlled fields.

skills.name: excalidraw-diagram-generator
skills.description_en: Generate Excalidraw diagrams from natural language descriptions. Use when asked to "create a diagram", "make a flowchart", "visualize a process", "draw a system architecture", "create a mind map", or "generate an Excalidraw file". Supports flowcharts, relationship diagrams, mind maps, and system architecture diagrams. Outputs .excalidraw JSON files that can be opened directly in Excalidraw.

zh.intro: 按自然语言描述生成 .excalidraw 文件，直接能在 Excalidraw 里打开继续编辑。支持流程图、关系图、思维导图、系统架构、数据流、泳道业务流、类图、时序图和 ER 图；正文给了元素数量上限、网格与放射布局的算法、各图型模板，以及产物自检清单。还能接图标库，把云厂商图标嵌进架构图。
zh.usage: 描述清楚画什么、有哪些实体和关系即可；要用图标库得先用 `scripts/split-excalidraw-library.py` 把 .excalidrawlib 转成查找表，再用 `python scripts/add-icon-to-diagram.py diagram.excalidraw EC2 400 300 --label "Web Server"` 逐个加。
zh.notes: 生成的 id 和坐标是算出来的，元素一多容易重叠，正文建议超量时拆成多张图；图标库要用户自己从 libraries.excalidraw.com 下载后再切。

audits.summary: This skill provides templates and Python scripts for generating and modifying Excalidraw diagrams from natural language descriptions. It handles complex tasks like importing icons from libraries and drawing connections between elements. The skill implementation follows safe coding practices, including filename sanitization and unique ID generation for imported data.

skills.name: slides
skills.description_en: Create and edit presentation slide decks (`.pptx`) with PptxGenJS, bundled layout helpers, and render/validation utilities. Use when tasks involve building a new PowerPoint deck, recreating slides from screenshots/PDFs/reference decks, modifying slide content while preserving editable output, adding charts/diagrams/visuals, or diagnosing layout issues such as overflow, overlaps, and font substitution.

audits.summary: This skill provides a suite of tools for creating and validating PowerPoint presentations. It uses standard system utilities and well-known libraries to perform rendering, font detection, and layout validation in a secure manner.

skills.name: apollo-client
skills.description_en: Guide for building React applications with Apollo Client 4.x. Use this skill when: (1) setting up Apollo Client in a React project, (2) writing GraphQL queries or mutations with hooks, (3) configuring caching or cache policies, (4) managing local state with reactive variables, (5) troubleshooting Apollo Client errors or performance issues.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive reference and integration guide for Apollo Client 4.x in React applications. No security vulnerabilities, malicious code, or adversarial patterns were detected.

skills.name: voice-isolator
skills.description_en: Remove background noise and isolate vocals/speech from audio using ElevenLabs Voice Isolator (audio isolation) API. Use when cleaning up noisy recordings, removing music or background ambience from dialogue, isolating speech from field recordings, preparing audio for transcription, extracting vocals, or any "denoise / clean up / isolate voice" task.

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate utility for audio voice isolation using ElevenLabs' official services. It follows standard security practices, uses official vendor packages, and provides clear instructions for API key management.

skills.name: managed-deep-agents
skills.description_en: INVOKE THIS SKILL when building, testing, or deploying Managed Deep Agents in LangSmith. Walks a user through their first agent end to end — interviewing them about what they want to build, mapping it onto what MDA can actually do, then scaffolding and deploying it. Covers the file-based project layout; define_deep_agent / defineDeepAgent; instructions, skills, memory, identity, tools, MCP servers, connections, middleware, sandboxes, schedules, channels, and evals; the mda CLI; GitHub deployments; and Context Hub.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive guidance for building and deploying 'Managed Deep Agents' using the LangSmith platform. It incorporates several security best practices, including explicit instructions for secure credential management, warnings regarding shared memory risks, and requirements for user confirmation before destructive actions.

skills.name: limrun-ios-simulator
skills.description_en: Drive an app running on a Limrun cloud iOS simulator: launch, tap, type, read the accessibility element tree, read app logs and simulator syslog, screenshot, record video, connect the app to local services or a private tunnel, play a video file as the camera, send all traffic through the user's proxy and trust its CA, set the clipboard, read and write user defaults, post notifications, and run timed action chains. Use after a build (from any builder) when the user wants to see, test, or interact with their app on a simulator, or says 'show me a screenshot', 'tap', 'run the UI test', 'record a video', 'read the logs', 'connect localhost', 'reach my local server from the simulator', 'route all traffic through my proxy', 'trust my CA', 'mock the camera', 'paste into the app', 'change the language', 'simulate Face ID', or 'launch on simulator'. To build the app first, use limrun-xcode-bazel (Bazel workspaces) or limrun-xcode (xcodebuild projects).

zh.intro: 驱动一台 Limrun 云端 iOS 模拟器上已经装好的 App：启动、点击、输入、读无障碍元素树、看 App 日志和模拟器 syslog、截图、录屏；还能把 App 连到本地服务或私有隧道、拿视频文件当摄像头、把全部流量导到自己的代理并信任它的 CA、设剪贴板、读写 user defaults、发通知、跑定时动作链。Linux、Windows、容器里都能用，不需要本机 Xcode。它只负责驱动跑起来的 App，构建那一步交给构建技能。
zh.usage: 装 CLI 用 `npm install --global lim`，登录 `lim login` 或设 `LIM_API_KEY`；已有构建产物就 `lim ios sync` 传上去，要新开一台用 `lim ios create --attach`。
zh.notes: 正文明令不许用本机 Xcode、本机模拟器和本机 macOS 工具；构建走 `limrun-xcode` 或 Bazel 那条路。

audits.summary: The skill enables an AI agent to control a cloud-based iOS simulator using the Limrun CLI. It provides extensive capabilities for UI interaction, network monitoring, and file management. The main security considerations are the installation of a global npm package and the potential for indirect prompt injection when the agent processes untrusted data from application logs, system logs, and user interface elements.

skills.name: limrun-xcode
skills.description_en: Build an iOS / Apple app on remote Xcode with `lim xcode build` instead of local xcodebuild, run project commands with `lim xcode run`, or run its XCTest suites with `lim xcode test`, from any environment (Linux, Windows, macOS, VM, container). Use for non-Bazel projects (an `.xcodeproj` / `.xcworkspace`, an XcodeGen `project.yml` with a gitignored project, React Native / Expo native build) when the user wants to build, compile, run code generation or Make targets, test, inspect build logs, reload, produce a preview build, or ship a signed device IPA. To run, tap, screenshot, or otherwise interact with the result on a simulator, use limrun-ios-simulator. For Bazel workspaces, use limrun-xcode-bazel.

zh.intro: 在 Limrun 的远程 Xcode 上构建 Apple 项目：同步源码到远端实例、在那边编译，挂了模拟器就自动安装并重启 App，跑完你手上是一个已经跑起来的应用。除构建外还能跑项目命令、跑 XCTest、读构建日志、重载、出预览包和打签名 IPA。面向非 Bazel 工程——.xcodeproj 或 .xcworkspace、XcodeGen 的 project.yml、React Native / Expo 的原生构建，从任意系统发起都行。
zh.usage: 在工程根目录跑 `lim xcode build .`；多 scheme 或 workspace 时加 `--scheme`、`--workspace`，要构建完立刻返回用 `--detach`，日志看 `lim xcode logs`。
zh.notes: 需要 `lim` CLI 和登录；Bazel 工作区该走 `limrun-bazel`，构建完想点、截图、录屏再交给 `limrun-ios-simulator`。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive interface for building, testing, and deploying iOS applications using Limrun's remote Xcode infrastructure. It follows security best practices by emphasizing the use of environment variables for credentials and protecting sensitive user data.

skills.name: limrun-expo-development
skills.description_en: Prepare and run Expo / React Native apps on Limrun with Expo dev-client iteration. Use when the user wants an Expo dev build, Metro tunnel, hot reload, JS/TS iteration without repeated native rebuilds, or to run/test an Expo app on a remote iOS simulator or Android emulator.

zh.intro: 在 Limrun 上跑 Expo / React Native 的 dev-client 迭代：先确认是 Expo 工程并推导出 bundle id、Android package、slug、scheme 和当前分支，缺 expo-dev-client 就补上，然后走 Metro 隧道改 JS/TS，省掉反复原生重建。产物按 bundle id 加分支出名，能在同一分支上复用；当前会话动过原生依赖或原生配置就不能复用，得重建。iOS 模拟器和 Android 模拟器都覆盖。
zh.usage: 先用 `npx expo config --type introspect --json` 读出工程信息；再按分支决定复用旧包还是重建，设备用 `lim ios create` 或 `lim android create`，装包靠 `--install-asset`。
zh.notes: 构建与设备命令的细节在 `limrun-xcode`、`limrun-gradle` 里，这条只管 Expo 特有的部分；本机 Xcode 和模拟器都不许用。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates Expo and React Native development on the Limrun platform by providing instructions and automation for building, deploying, and debugging apps. It uses standard industry tools and the vendor's own CLI to manage remote simulators and emulators. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: limrun-detox-testing
skills.description_en: Configure, run, or debug Detox on Limrun iOS simulators. Use when attaching the Limrun Detox runtime to an app, wiring Detox mediator connectivity, or validating app/tester connections over destination tunnels.

zh.intro: 在 Limrun 的云端 iOS 模拟器上配、跑、调 Detox。正文把三个角色拆得很清楚：本地 Node/Jest/Detox 进程是 tester，`detox run-server` 是 mediator（一般跑在 agent 那台机器上），App 客户端由模拟器通过 `lim ios launch-app --runtime detox` 注入。要解决的问题是让 tester 和 app 在目标隧道上互相看见，正文还给了判断连上了没有的信号，以及 SwiftUI 下按 id 取元素那类坑。
zh.usage: mediator、隧道、tester 分三个终端起：先 `npx detox run-server -p 8099 -l verbose`，再 `lim ios tunnel` 加 `--detach`，然后 `npx detox test --no-start`，最后 `lim ios launch-app` 带 `--runtime detox` 重启 App。
zh.notes: `.detoxrc` 要自己读会话环境变量，Detox 不会自动吃；driver 是 `@limrun/detox/driver`，正文给了完整配置样例。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for configuring and running Detox mobile tests on Limrun iOS simulators using vendor-specific CLI tools and official examples. A potential surface for indirect prompt injection exists when the agent processes UI tree data from the simulator.

skills.name: limrun-xcode-bazel
skills.description_en: Legacy: build a Bazel iOS app with `lim xcode rbe` on a dedicated Xcode sandbox and install it on a remote iOS simulator attached to that sandbox. Use only when the workspace already runs on `lim xcode rbe` (its `.limrun/` came from `lim xcode rbe`) or the user explicitly asks for it, or when a `lim xcode rbe` build, upload, or install misbehaves. For every other Bazel build, including new workspaces, iOS or Android, and running the app on a simulator, use limrun-bazel. To tap, type, screenshot, or otherwise interact with the running app, use limrun-ios-simulator.

zh.intro: 标着 legacy 的一条：用 `lim xcode rbe` 在专用 Xcode 沙箱上构建 Bazel 的 iOS 工程，并装到挂在该沙箱上的远端模拟器。正文自己说新路径是 `lim bazel setup`，也就是 limrun-bazel 技能——不要沙箱和隧道、iOS 与 Android 都支持、全组织共用一个缓存。所以它只在工作区本来就是 `lim xcode rbe` 起的、或者用户明确点名、或者这条老路出毛病时用，其它 Bazel 构建都该换新技能。
zh.usage: 在 Bazel 工作区根目录（有 `MODULE.bazel` 或 `WORKSPACE`）跑 `lim xcode rbe`，它会配好 `.limrun/` 并打印确切的构建命令，照着执行即可；要换 Xcode 版本用 `lim xcode version set 27`。
zh.notes: 别手写 `.limrun/` 和那些 flag，CLI 会按沙箱的 Xcode 和你的系统生成；需要 `lim` CLI 与登录。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates building Apple applications using Limrun's Remote Build Execution (RBE) service. It provides instructions for installing the vendor's CLI, configuring Bazel projects for remote builds, and interacting with remote iOS simulators. The analysis identified no malicious code, only standard developer-focused functionality and expected risk surfaces common to build automation tools.

skills.name: caveman
skills.description_en: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by dropping filler, articles, and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman.

zh.intro: 一种持续生效的压缩表达模式，正文自称能把 token 用量砍掉约 75%：去掉冠词、填充词、客套和模糊限定，保留全部技术内容。规则包括技术名词照原样、代码块不动、报错原文引用，因果关系用箭头表示，能用一词就不用一句。触发词有 caveman mode、talk like caveman、less tokens、be brief，也可以直接调用 /caveman。一旦触发就每次都生效，不会因为对话变长而自动恢复。
zh.usage: 用户说 caveman mode、要求更少 token 或明确嫌啰嗦时启用；关掉必须由用户说 stop caveman 或 normal mode。
zh.notes: 正文强调不确定时也保持生效；不要自作主张切回正常风格。

audits.summary: This skill is a communication style optimizer that instructs the AI to use a terse, 'caveman' style to reduce token usage and improve efficiency. It contains no code, network operations, or security risks.

skills.name: clerk
skills.description_en: Clerk authentication router. Use when user asks about Clerk CLI operations,

audits.summary: This skill acts as a router for Clerk authentication tasks and does not contain any executable code or risky operations.

skills.description_en: Scaffold and implement authentication in TypeScript/JavaScript apps using Better Auth. Detect frameworks, configure database adapters, set up route handlers, add OAuth providers, and create auth UI pages. Use when users want to add login, sign-up, or authentication to a new or existing project with Better Auth.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive and legitimate integration guide for the Better Auth library. It facilitates the setup of authentication in TypeScript and JavaScript projects by scanning project configurations, planning feature sets, and providing standard installation and migration steps using official vendor packages and tools.

skills.name: flutter-building-layouts
skills.description_en: Builds Flutter layouts using the constraint system and layout widgets. Use when creating or refining the UI structure of a Flutter application.

audits.summary: The skill provides standard instructional content and code examples for building layouts in Flutter. No security risks were detected.

skills.name: browser-use
skills.description_en: Direct browser control via CDP for web interaction: automation, scraping, testing, screenshots, and site/app work. Also covers hosted cloud browsers for AI agents: the browser-use Python library (Browser(use_cloud=True)), Playwright, Puppeteer or any CDP client.

zh.intro: 用 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直接操作浏览器：点击、输入、跳转、截图、跑站点测试，也能连远程云浏览器。技能明确划了边界——公开页面用普通 HTTP 请求就能读的，不要动用浏览器；只有需要交互、需要用户已登录的会话、需要 JS 渲染，或页面有机器人防护时才升级到浏览器。
zh.usage: 安装后先用 `browser-use --doctor` 体检，再 `browser-use auth login` 登录云端；本地 Chrome 走本地 daemon。脚本用 heredoc 喂给 `browser-use`，里面调 page_info()、goto_url()、new_tab()、click_at_xy()；通用工具在 agent-workspace/agent_helpers.py。要录屏就 `browser-use recordings enable`，再用同一条命令查看记录。
zh.notes: 安装与连接问题看 browser-harness 仓库的 install.md。远程浏览器会走浏览器云站点的付费服务，需要 BROWSER_USE_API_KEY。域技能默认关闭，要开就设 BH_DOMAIN_SKILLS=1。

audits.summary: The skill provides powerful browser automation capabilities. It is generally safe but possesses an inherent risk of indirect prompt injection, where malicious content on a website could attempt to influence the agent's behavior during automated browsing tasks.

skills.name: limrun-gradle
skills.description_en: Build an Android app on a remote Gradle sandbox with `lim gradle build` instead of local Gradle or Android Studio, from any environment (Linux, Windows, macOS, VM, container). Use when the user wants to build an APK or AAB, sign a release with an upload key, prepare a Play Store publish, inspect build logs, or select sandbox tools and run shell commands, for native Android projects, React Native, and Expo. To run, tap, screenshot, or otherwise interact with the built APK on an emulator, use limrun-android-emulator. For iOS builds, use limrun-xcode or limrun-expo-development.

zh.intro: 在 Limrun 远端 Gradle 沙箱里编 Android 项目，任何环境都能用：Linux、Windows、macOS、VM、容器。`lim gradle build` 把源码同步到远端实例，用项目自己的 Gradle wrapper 构建，再把输出流回来。本地 Gradle、Android SDK、本地模拟器都不参与，native Android、React Native 和 Expo 项目都覆盖。
zh.usage: 要出 APK 或 AAB、用 upload key 签 release、准备发 Play Store、翻构建日志，或者干脆在沙箱里选工具跑 shell 时用它。装 CLI 是 `npm install --global lim`，认证用 `lim login`；先用 `lim gradle --help` 确认参数，别照猜的 flag 敲。
zh.notes: iOS 构建换 limrun-xcode，Expo dev-client 那套 Metro 热重载循环换 limrun-expo-development；`LIM_API_KEY` 可能已在环境里，`lim login` 之前先查一遍。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates remote Android builds using the 'lim' CLI tool. It includes instructions for code synchronization, signing, and Play Store publishing, while correctly advising the agent to avoid handling sensitive credentials directly.

skills.name: flutter-architecting-apps
skills.description_en: Architects a Flutter application using the recommended layered approach (UI, Logic, Data). Use when structuring a new project or refactoring for scalability.

zh.intro: 按 UI、Logic、Data 三层组织 Flutter 应用的官方写法：先讲分层与依赖方向，再讲单一数据源、单向数据流，以及把界面当作状态的函数来渲染。正文给出各层职责、按功能分目录的方式，和一次功能从数据层走到界面的落地顺序，适合新项目起步或重构时对照。
zh.usage: 新项目定目录与依赖边界、老项目解耦界面和业务逻辑时用它；先把三层画清楚，再决定每个状态归哪一层持有。
zh.notes: 正文要求界面层只处理动画、路由、布局约束这类界面问题，业务与取数逻辑移到逻辑层和数据层；界面靠不可变状态对象驱动，状态变化后响应式重建。

audits.summary: This skill provides architectural guidelines and best practices for structuring Flutter applications using a layered approach. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.description_en: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.

zh.intro: Anthropic 官方技能，用 Playwright 跟本地 web 应用打交道：验证前端功能、调 UI 行为、截浏览器图、看浏览器日志。安装量 18.2 万，8 周涨 3.9%，curated 与 official 都标 true；Socket、Snyk、Runlayer 三家 warn。
zh.usage: 前端改完要真的点一遍确认没坏；要抓控制台报错和截图当证据；复现只在浏览器里出现的问题。
zh.notes: 三家 warn（Socket、Snyk、Runlayer）；描述只有三句话，细节得看正文；跑起来需要 Playwright 环境。

audits.summary: This skill includes some security considerations such as command execution capabilities and interaction with external web content. While these warrant review, they are used within the skill's intended functionality for local web application testing and server management. See detailed analysis for context.

skills.name: dotnet-best-practices
skills.description_en: Ensure .NET/C# code meets best practices for the solution/project.

audits.summary: This skill provides a set of architectural and coding guidelines for .NET/C# development. It focuses on documentation, design patterns, testing, and security best practices without performing any active operations or including external scripts.

skills.name: limrun-android-emulator
skills.description_en: Drive an app running on a Limrun cloud Android emulator: install an APK, launch and terminate apps with crash reports, tap, type, read the UI element tree, screenshot, record video, inject microphone audio, shape network bandwidth, read app logs, run shell commands, transfer files, tunnel the app's network destinations through your machine with HTTP inspection and HAR capture, reach a private network through a private tunnel, send all traffic through the user's proxy, trust a custom CA certificate, and use adb over the CLI's tunnel for full logcat and interactive tools. Use after a build (from limrun-gradle or any builder) when the user wants to see, test, or interact with their app on an emulator, or says 'show me a screenshot', 'tap', 'run it on the emulator', 'check logcat', 'record a video', 'inspect network traffic', 'route all traffic through my proxy', or 'reach my local server from the emulator'. To build the APK or AAB first, use limrun-gradle.

zh.intro: 驱动跑在 Limrun 云端 Android 模拟器上的应用：装 APK、启动和结束应用并拿到崩溃报告、点按、输入、读界面元素树、截图、录视频、注入麦克风音频、限制网络带宽、读应用日志、执行 shell 命令、传文件，还能把应用的网络目的地通过本机隧道转发并做 HTTP 抓包和 HAR 记录。
zh.usage: 先用 limrun-gradle 或别的构建器把包打出来，再用它跑、点、截图、看日志、录视频或抓网络；私有网络走私有隧道，要透明抓包就把目标域名引到本机。
zh.notes: 要在代理后面跑才加证书信任，别默认开；自定义 CA 只有在应用肯吃这个证书时才有意义，遇到证书固定就只能放弃拦截。

audits.summary: This skill provides an interface to manage cloud-based Android emulators using the vendor's CLI tool. It includes capabilities for installing applications from URLs, executing shell commands on the emulator, and monitoring network traffic. The primary security consideration is the potential for indirect prompt injection if the agent processes malicious content (such as logs or UI text) from an application running on the emulator.

skills.name: firecrawl-research-papers
skills.description_en: Find and synthesize research papers, whitepapers, PDFs, technical reports, and academic sources with Firecrawl Research, using semantic paper search, related-paper expansion, and in-body verification over Firecrawl's paper index — largely biomedical and life-science literature from PubMed, bioRxiv, and medRxiv, plus arXiv preprints in CS, physics, and math. Use when the user wants a literature review, systematic review, survey of studies, paper summary, research landscape, or sourced synthesis from scholarly and industry publications, including clinical, drug, gene, disease, epidemiology, and public-health topics. Prefer this over a general web-research workflow whenever the evidence base is published papers rather than web pages.

zh.intro: 用 Firecrawl Research 做带出处的文献综述：语义论文检索、相关论文扩展，再回到正文里核实。索引以 PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv 的生物医学与生命科学文献为主，另加 arXiv 的 CS、物理、数学预印本。要文献综述、系统性综述或研究全景时用它。
zh.usage: 需要一个 Firecrawl API key，放在 `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` 环境变量里，用于托管的 Firecrawl Research、CLI、MCP 或同类工具请求。证据基础是已发表论文而不是网页，所以优先用它而不是通用网页研究流程。
zh.notes: 不是通用网页搜索的替代品：证据基础是已发表论文时才选它，索引以 PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv 和 arXiv 为主。

audits.summary: The skill is a safe workflow configuration for searching and analyzing academic research papers using official Firecrawl tools. It does not contain any malicious patterns or safety violations.

skills.name: terraform-style-guide
skills.description_en: Generate Terraform HCL code following HashiCorp's official style conventions and best practices. Use when writing, reviewing, or generating Terraform configurations.

audits.summary: This skill provides guidance for generating Terraform HCL code following official HashiCorp style and security conventions. It encourages best practices like version pinning, sensitive value marking, and the use of ephemeral resources to protect secrets. No security risks were identified.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive documentation for the LangGraph CLI, covering project scaffolding, local development, and deployment workflows. While it includes commands for building Docker images and exposing local servers, these are standard functionalities for a development tool and are used within its intended lifecycle management scope.

skills.name: git-flow-branch-creator

Its primary function is to analyze git repository states and suggest/execute branching commands. The security posture is generally strong, with no evident malicious patterns, obfuscation, or unauthorized network access. The only detected concern is a standard exposure to indirect prompt injection common in tools that process external data.

Use when asked to improve a prompt, optimize a system prompt, rewrite an agent prompt, tune prompt wording, make a prompt more reliable, port prompts between OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini, or build prompt evals.

skills.name: aws-serverless
skills.description_en: Routes serverless requests to a compute form factor and the skill that owns it. Applies first to Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, Step Functions and event-driven work while the compute, orchestration or integration choice is open — API backends, webhooks, jobs, cron, queue/stream consumers, durable workflows, event routing, Step Functions vs Durable Functions, and Pipes vs native event source mappings for queues and streams. Decides Event Functions on-demand vs Managed Instances, Web Functions, MicroVMs, EventBridge rules/Scheduler/Pipes/bus, HTTP vs REST API. Owns shared Lambda references (cold starts, SnapStart, concurrency, event sources, function URLs, throttling, troubleshooting). Defers to the specialized skill once a request commits to one form factor or service, or describes its defining feature, even unnamed (durable checkpointing and automatic step retries, Firecracker sandbox, managed instances, Node.js server). Not for EC2, ECS/EKS/Fargate or Amplify hosting.

audits.summary: This skill provides expert architectural guidance and technical references for building serverless applications on AWS. It incorporates comprehensive security best practices, such as least-privilege IAM configuration and input validation, while documenting the operational characteristics of services like AWS Lambda and API Gateway.

skills.name: talking-head-recut
skills.description_en: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

zh.intro: 给已经拍好的口播、访谈、播客视频加一层设计过的图文卡片：动态标题、人名条、数据标注、引用块、侧边栏、画中画，时间点跟转写文本对齐，画布可选 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5，底层视频本身不做改动。安装量 39.5 万，8 周涨 109.9%，是这一片涨幅最高的条目。
zh.usage: 口播视频剪完、缺信息图层的阶段用；把一段访谈重新包装成短视频平台的竖版物料。
zh.notes: 不负责普通字幕，那要另走 `/embedded-captions`；带 has_references 标记，正文依赖引用文件。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional video editing tool designed to create synchronized graphic overlays. It relies on local transcription via Whisper and rendering through the hyperframes CLI. Security analysis identifies standard behaviors for this class of media tool, such as executing video processing commands and updating its own components via npx, with minor risks associated with processing external transcript data.

skills.name: stitch-design
skills.description_en: Unified entry point for Stitch design work. Handles prompt enhancement (UI/UX keywords, atmosphere), design system synthesis (.stitch/DESIGN.md), and high-fidelity screen generation/editing via Stitch MCP.

zh.intro: 用 Stitch MCP 出高保真界面的统一入口：先把模糊需求扩写成带 UI/UX 术语的提示词（references/design-mappings.md 给对照，把「好看的头部」改成具体描述），再按生成新页、编辑现有页、写设计系统三条工作流走。项目里有 .stitch/DESIGN.md 就把它的颜色与字体 tokens 带进提示词，没有就建议先生成。生成的 HTML 和截图会下载到 .stitch/designs。提示词模板固定为整体氛围、DESIGN SYSTEM、PAGE STRUCTURE 三段。
zh.usage: 要它出一页界面时，先说清页面用途和风格，让它按三段模板扩写提示词，再调生成工具并把产物下载回来。
zh.notes: 需要有可用的 Stitch MCP server 和 projectId；没有设计系统文档时，多页之间的一致性会差。

audits.summary: The skill enables UI design workflows using the Stitch MCP server but contains a surface for indirect prompt injection and uses local commands for asset management. It analyzes existing designs to build a project's design system, which could be exploited if design files contain malicious instructions. It also uses curl to download design assets.

Generates SKILL.md files with proper frontmatter, directory structure, and optional scripts/references/assets folders.

audits.summary: This skill is a documentation-only template designed to help users scaffold new Agent Skills. It contains instructions, structure examples, and best practices with no executable code or network activity.

skills.name: hyperframes-registry
skills.description_en: Search, install, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use BEFORE hand-building any named visual — whenever a brief, a user, or a storyboard names a look, effect, treatment, or transition such as CRT scanlines, glitch, chromatic aberration, film grain, a shimmer sweep, a chart, a code or terminal window, a map, or a confetti burst — because roughly 400 hosted items already cover many of them and the search ranks all of them with nothing installed, no project, and no account. Also use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

zh.intro: 在 HyperFrames 组合里搜、装、接现成的区块和组件，约 400 个托管条目，搜索不用先装东西也不用账号。CRT 扫描线、故障、色差、胶片颗粒、地图、终端窗口、彩带这些效果先来这里找，别手搓。安装量 91 万，8 周涨 118.4%。
zh.usage: brief 里点名了某个视觉效果；要跑 hyperframes add 或 catalog；把装好的区块接进 index.html。
zh.notes: Snyk 判 warn / MEDIUM；条目质量参差，接进项目后要自己看渲染结果。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for managing video blocks and components via the HyperFrames CLI. It integrates with a remote registry hosted on the vendor's official GitHub repository. The analysis found no malicious behavior, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access. The skill utilizes well-known libraries (GSAP, Three.js) and includes built-in validation commands to ensure the integrity of the downloaded assets.

skills.name: clerk-custom-ui
skills.description_en: Custom authentication flows and component appearance - hooks (useSignIn,

zh.intro: 做自定义登录注册流程和组件外观两块：一块是用钩子自己搭登录注册界面，另一块是给预置组件换主题、颜色和字体，用于品牌化改造。动手前要确认应用外层已经包好提供方，并按 SDK 版本挑对应的参考文档。
zh.usage: 要自己写登录注册流程或改预置组件外观时用；先确认提供方已包好，再按 SDK 版本选参考。
zh.notes: 正文提示先看清单里的 SDK 版本，版本决定该用哪一套自定义流程参考；核心 2 和当前版本分开放。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and code templates for implementing custom authentication flows and styling with Clerk. It includes examples for sign-in, sign-up, and conditional rendering. All external links and packages are official Clerk resources, and the skill includes appropriate security caveats for developers.

skills.name: clerk-webhooks
skills.description_en: Clerk webhooks for real-time events and data syncing. Verify with verifyWebhook

zh.intro: 接 Clerk 的 webhook 做实时事件与数据同步：用户、会话、组织、账单和支付事件都能收到，用来做库表同步、欢迎邮件、群里提醒和第三方联动。正文强调这类投递是异步且最终一致的，会失败也会重试，所以不能把它当成同步流程的一环，刚注册完就要用的数据应当从会话令牌里读。
zh.usage: 每个处理函数都要带签名校验，用对应框架包里导出的校验函数；需要的环境变量是控制台给出的 webhook 签名密钥。事件处理按可能重复投递来写，做幂等。
zh.notes: 正文写明失败会按固定节奏重试；不要把回调当成注册流程的同步依赖，这是它最常被误用的地方。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive and secure templates for implementing Clerk webhooks across various web frameworks. It correctly mandates cryptographic signature verification for all incoming requests and demonstrates secure secret management using environment variables.

skills.name: flutter-caching-data
skills.description_en: Implements caching strategies for Flutter apps to improve performance and offline support. Use when retaining app data locally to reduce network requests or speed up startup.

audits.summary: This skill provides architectural guidance and code examples for implementing data caching and offline-first logic in Flutter applications. It promotes secure coding practices, such as using parameterized SQL queries to prevent injection vulnerabilities.

skills.name: ai-sdk
skills.description_en: Answer questions about the AI SDK and help build AI-powered features. Use when developers: (1) Ask about AI SDK functions like generateText, streamText, ToolLoopAgent, embed, or tools, (2) Want to build AI agents, chatbots, RAG systems, or text generation features, (3) Have questions about AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.), streaming, tool calling, structured output, or embeddings, (4) Use React hooks like useChat or useCompletion. Triggers on: "AI SDK", "Vercel AI SDK", "generateText", "streamText", "add AI to my app", "build an agent", "tool calling", "structured output", "useChat".

zh.intro: Vercel 的 AI SDK（npm 上的 `ai` 包）是写 AI 应用的 TypeScript 工具集：在多家模型供应商之上统一了文本生成、结构化输出、工具调用、agent、向量嵌入和前端框架集成。用 generateText、streamText、ToolLoopAgent、embed、useChat 这些接口时，或要查供应商接入、流式、结构化输出时用它。
zh.usage: 问 AI SDK 用法、要在应用里加 AI 功能、搭 chatbot 或 RAG、用 React 的 useChat 与 useCompletion 时用它。正文强调不要凭记忆答：接口在各版本之间改名、删除、新增都很频繁，答案要回仓库 https://github.com/vercel/ai 和文档 https://ai-sdk.dev/docs 核对。
zh.notes: 接口随版本变化快，正文明确要求先查文档再答。它讲的是 SDK 用法，不含模型本身的选型建议。

audits.summary: This skill provides assistance for the Vercel AI SDK and involves routine development activities. It includes patterns for retrieving up-to-date model lists from official Vercel services and managing SDK dependencies. These actions utilize trusted vendor resources and are appropriate for the skill's intended use.

skills.name: flutter-building-forms
skills.description_en: Builds Flutter forms with validation and user input handling. Use when creating login screens, data entry forms, or any multi-field user input.

audits.summary: The skill provides safe instructional content and code examples for building validated forms in the Flutter framework. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: flutter-handling-concurrency
skills.description_en: Executes long-running tasks in background isolates to keep the UI responsive. Use when performing heavy computations or parsing large datasets.

audits.summary: The skill provides safe educational content and code examples for managing concurrency in Flutter using Dart Isolates. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: sred-work-summary
skills.description_en: Go back through the previous year of work and create a Notion doc that groups relevant links into projects that can then be documented as SRED projects.

audits.summary: The skill automates the collection and organization of work history from GitHub, Notion, and Linear. While it performs legitimate administrative tasks, it processes external content which presents a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: flutter-localizing-apps
skills.description_en: Configures a Flutter app to support multiple languages and regions. Use when preparing an application for international markets and diverse user locales.

audits.summary: The skill provides legitimate technical instructions for localizing Flutter applications using official tools and packages. No security threats or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: flutter-working-with-databases
skills.description_en: Manages local data persistence using SQLite or other database solutions. Use when a Flutter app needs to store, query, or synchronize large amounts of structured data on the device.

audits.summary: The skill provides architectural guidance and best practices for implementing local data persistence in Flutter applications using SQLite. It correctly emphasizes security measures such as using parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection and follows standard industry patterns for data management.

skills.name: svelte-code-writer
skills.description_en: CLI tools for Svelte 5 documentation lookup and code analysis. MUST be used whenever creating, editing or analyzing any Svelte component (`.svelte`) or Svelte module (`.svelte.ts`/`.svelte.js`). If possible, this skill should be executed within the `svelte-file-editor` subagent for optimal results.

audits.summary: This skill provides official Svelte 5 development tools and documentation access through the @sveltejs/mcp package. It is a standard developer toolset for analyzing and fixing Svelte code.

skills.name: flutter-interoperating-with-native-apis
skills.description_en: Interoperates with native platform APIs on Android, iOS, and the web. Use when accessing device-specific features not available in Dart or calling existing native code.

audits.summary: This skill is safe. It provides standard instructions for Flutter developers to implement native interoperability using official tools like FFI and Platform Channels.

skills.name: flutter-adding-home-screen-widgets
skills.description_en: Adds home screen widgets to a Flutter app for Android and iOS. Use when providing glanceable app information or quick actions on the device home screen.

audits.summary: The skill is a technical guide for developers to implement home screen widgets in Flutter applications. It provides standard architectural patterns, code examples for Dart, Swift, and Kotlin, and uses the well-known 'home_widget' package. No malicious patterns or security vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: embedded-captions
skills.description_en: Add captions or subtitles to an existing single-subject talking-head video without editing the footage. Use for plain verbatim captions, cinematic captions embedded behind the subject, VFX captions, “炸/特效/酷炫字幕,” or a named identity from the 35-style catalog. Route by visual identity, not by backend engine. The quiet `anchor` rail is the default; embed every word only when the user explicitly wants a fully cinematic treatment. The workflow runs locally end to end, including transcription and subject matting; split multi-shot footage before applying it.

zh.intro: 给已经拍好的单人出镜口播视频加字幕，不用重剪素材：可以只是原文字幕，也可以做成藏在人物身后的电影感字幕或带特效的字幕，description 提到一套 35 种样式的目录。转录和人像抠像都在本地跑完。安装量 43.7 万，8 周涨 101.7%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 口播视频要多平台投放、需要一套统一字幕样式时；想要人物和字幕有前后遮挡关系时。
zh.notes: 只吃单个主体、单镜头的素材，多机位或多镜头必须先切开再喂给它。

audits.summary: The embedded-captions skill is a comprehensive video processing tool developed by heygen-com for adding cinematic and themed captions to videos. It automates subject matting, transcription using WhisperX, and high-quality rendering via Puppeteer, Sharp, and FFmpeg. The skill implements secure practices such as Subresource Integrity (SRI) for external assets and uses pinned versions for runtime dependencies. All external components are sourced from well-known providers and are appropriate for the tool's specialized media processing tasks. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: flutter-building-plugins
skills.description_en: Builds Flutter plugins that provide native interop for other apps to use. Use when creating reusable packages that bridge Flutter with platform-specific functionality.

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate technical guide for developing Flutter plugins. It provides standard workflows and code examples using official Flutter CLI tools without any detected security risks.

skills.name: java-springboot
skills.description_en: Get best practices for developing applications with Spring Boot.

audits.summary: No security issues detected. This skill is purely instructional, providing architectural and development best practices for Spring Boot applications without any executable scripts or suspicious patterns.

skills.name: flutter-embedding-native-views
skills.description_en: Embeds native Android, iOS, or macOS views into a Flutter app. Use when integrating complex native components like maps or web views.

audits.summary: This skill provides architectural documentation and code examples for integrating native views into Flutter applications and embedding Flutter into web environments. No security risks were detected.

skills.name: parallel-findall
skills.description_en: Discover entities (companies, people, products, etc.) matching a natural-language description. Use when the user asks to 'find all X' or 'list every Y that…' — e.g., 'Find AI startups that raised Series A in 2026', 'List roofing companies in Charlotte NC', 'Show me YC W24 dev tools companies'. Different from web-search (which returns webpages) and deep-research (which returns a narrative report). Use this when the user wants a structured list of entities.

audits.summary: This skill uses a command-line tool to discover and list entities like companies and people. It is safe for its intended use, but it does process data from external search results which could theoretically contain malicious instructions (indirect prompt injection).

skills.name: sales-pipeline-coverage-modeling
skills.description_en: Models how much pipeline a team needs relative to quota - coverage ratios derived from win rates (raw multiplier, stage-weighted, conversion-inversion), segment-level coverage targets, in-quarter timing and the point of no return, seasonality indexing, and pipeline-gap math that turns a ratio into new-pipeline-required. A macro modeling exercise for sales leadership and RevOps, covering B2B and high-velocity/B2C motions. Use whenever the user mentions pipeline coverage, 3x pipeline, a pipeline gap, forecast shortfall, or "we missed quota with 4x coverage", even without the word coverage. Do NOT use for deriving the quota itself (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting) or inspecting one deal (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-red-flags).

zh.intro: 算要完成配额需要多少管线、现在还差多少：用历史赢率推覆盖倍数，给了原始倍数、按阶段加权、按转化率反推三种算法，再按细分市场设不同目标，看季度内时间点和不可回头点，做季节性折算，最后把缺口换算成每周每个销售要新建多少管线。也用来诊断「背着 4 倍覆盖还是没完成」——分三步查：目标背后的赢率口径、三种倍数之间的差距、节奏，三者里必有一个在骗人。
zh.usage: 给出配额、细分市场、成交周期和赢率历史，让它算目标覆盖倍数和缺口；问「这季度 3.8 倍够不够安全」会先清掉不可信的管线再算。
zh.notes: 配额本身怎么定不在范围里，覆盖是个比值，没有分母时会先让你去定配额；纯自助 PLG 没有管线概念，会被直接劝退。

audits.summary: The sales-pipeline-coverage-modeling skill is a consultative framework for revenue planning and sales leadership. It provides methodologies, benchmarks, and workflows for calculating pipeline requirements without performing any high-risk operations such as network requests, file system writes, or command executions. No security vulnerabilities or malicious patterns were identified.

skills.name: sales-account-tiering
skills.description_en: Designs the tier layer downstream of an existing account fit score - where the cutoffs sit, tier names, rep-to-account capacity caps, the coverage model per tier (touch cadence, channel mix, QBR frequency, executive involvement), coverage-ratio health metrics, and the recalibration cadence. Covers B2B account tiering and B2C key-account tiering through retail/distribution channels. Use whenever the user mentions tiers, strategic/key/growth/long-tail accounts, accounts-per-rep ratios, 1:1 or 1:few or 1:many ABM coverage, or "everything drifted into Tier 1", even without the word tiering. Takes the fit score as input. Do NOT use for building that score (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-account-segmentation).

zh.intro: 在已有的账户匹配分之上设计分层：切分线画在哪、层级怎么命名、每个销售各层能带多少账户、每层给什么覆盖（触达节奏、渠道组合、QBR 频率、高管参与度）、用什么比值看覆盖健康度、多久重新校准一次。产物是一份分层章程，不重造匹配分；没有 ICP 或匹配分时先送回上游技能，否则等于把两层压成一层，切分线怎么画都救不回来。也能诊断「所有账户都掉进 Tier 1」：查容量上限和默认归属，再从容量那步重做。
zh.usage: 说「把账户分层」或「每个销售该带多少账户」，它会先确认有没有可用的匹配分，再给切分线、容量上限和各层覆盖模型。
zh.notes: 只吃现成的匹配分；B2C 直接面向消费者时不适用，走零售/分销关键账户才适用。

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill is a set of markdown-based instructions for a sales advisor, containing no code, network access, or sensitive operations.

skills.name: sales-kickoff
skills.description_en: Before starting any sales project, and before answering a sales request that spans more than one sales topic or names no skill at all, run this router first. It routes the task to exactly one skill in the sales-skills collection, or says plainly that none fits, and bootstraps or resumes the project's shared sales-context.md artifact, producing a short-list plus an ordered skill chain. Fires on the state of the conversation rather than the subject matter, at a sales project start, at a periodic sales check-in or recurring sales review, on a mid-project re-route, or on any broad or ambiguous sales request such as "which sales skill do I need" or "where do I start with sales". Covers both altitudes, CRO-altitude planning (motion, ICP, market sizing, segmentation, tiering, org structure, quota, coverage, comp) and execution (outbound, cold calling, discovery, objections, MEDDPICC, recaps, call review, hiring, career). Run it even when sibling skills are already in daily use elsewhere.

zh.intro: 27 个销售技能的分诊入口：先判断当前任务在哪个高度——CRO 层的动作设计、ICP、市场测算、分群、分层、组织、配额、覆盖、薪酬，还是执行层的陌拜、冷呼、需求挖掘、异议、MEDDPICC、复盘、招聘、职业——然后只路由到一个技能，或者直说没有合适的。同时维护项目里的 sales-context.md：文件存在就是接续，不存在就是冷启动；先做环境探测（git 历史、README、已有的 ICP 或人物画像文档），再问人，避免重复访谈。
zh.usage: 开新销售项目、或者一个问题跨了多个销售主题时先跑它，说清目标和手上已有的材料，它会给出一个技能加一条有序技能链，并写好或更新 sales-context.md。
zh.notes: 事实能从环境推出来就不该问用户；同一项目的后续会话重新跑是为了汇总和重新路由，不是重新访谈。

audits.summary: The skill is a router for sales tasks that automates context gathering by reading project files, git logs, and CRM data. This automated ingestion of untrusted local data creates a surface for indirect prompt injection. Additionally, the skill reads sensitive locations like the .github/ directory and other agent instruction files, and it persists state by modifying local project files.

skills.name: sales-hiring
skills.description_en: Employer-side hiring workflow for SDR/BDR and AE roles, producing an outcome-based scorecard, a structured interview loop with question bank, a scored mock-call work sample, and a 30-60-90 ramp plan with certification gates. Recommends SDR vs AE vs full-cycle from ACV, cycle length and inbound volume, and rests on selection-validity evidence - structured interviews, independent scoring, no brainteasers. Use whenever the user mentions hiring a rep, sales interview questions, a hiring scorecard, a mock call interview, rep onboarding, or a ramp plan, even without the word hiring. Do NOT use for candidate-side prep (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-career) or comp plan design (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-comp-design).

zh.intro: 招 SDR/BDR 和 AE 的用人方流程，产出四样东西：基于结果的岗位记分卡、结构化面试环节加题库、打过分的模拟电话工作样本、带认证关口的 30-60-90 上手计划。角色选型从 ACV、成交周期和入站量推，ACV 小周期短入站多就偏 SDR 加 AE 分工。每条基准数字都要标来源等级（同行评议、调研、众包、厂商数据），不能把厂商说法当事实；整个技能建立在结构化面试、独立打分、不出脑筋急转弯这些选人有效性证据上。
zh.usage: 说「招一个 SDR」或「设计销售面试题」，它会先问团队阶段、角色、ACV 和周期，再给记分卡、面试环路和 ramp 计划。
zh.notes: 只做用人方，候选人视角的面试准备归 sales-career；不 sourcing、不写招聘广告、不管 ATS，也不设计提成方案。

audits.summary: The skill provides a structured framework and templates for sales hiring processes. It is entirely composed of markdown documentation and contains no executable code, network operations, or external dependencies. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: add-app-clip
skills.description_en: Add an iOS App Clip target to an Expo app. Use when the user mentions App Clip, AASA, apple-app-site-association, appclips, smart app banner, or wants to ship a lightweight iOS Clip invoked from a URL alongside their parent app.

audits.summary: This skill provides legitimate instructions and code templates for adding an iOS App Clip target to an Expo project, including configuration, building, and native module implementation.

skills.name: sales-objection-handling
skills.description_en: Diagnoses what a sales objection really means and writes rebuttal scripts a rep can say out loud, or calls the deal dead when the objection is a real constraint. Covers price/budget, timing, competitor/incumbent, authority, status-quo, and trust objections for B2B and B2C, with price-specific guidance on value gap vs genuine budget limit and trading instead of discounting. Use whenever the user mentions a price objection, "too expensive", "not interested", "send me some info", "we already use a competitor", stalling, or an objection library, even without the word objection. Do NOT use for discount trade planning (mbfinotti/sales-skills@negotiation-concession-planner) or ROI math (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-value-calc).

zh.intro: 把客户那句「太贵了」「暂时不需要」「我们已经在用别家」拆开，判断它是真约束还是习惯性挡话，再给出销售能直接念出口的应答，或者干脆说这单该放弃。价格、时机、竞品在位、决策权、维持现状、信任六类异议分别处理；价格异议还会区分价值差距和预算真的到顶，并给出用交换代替打折的思路。开头先做一次预防检查：如果销售在需求没摸清前就讲功能，正文会点明异议是自己造的，让先补需求挖掘。
zh.usage: 贴出客户原话、异议出现的环节（冷呼、需求、演示、报价）和已经尝试过的回应，让它先判断真假再给应答话术。
zh.notes: 不管折扣与让步的交换方案，也不算 ROI；这两块分别指向同系列的 negotiation-concession-planner 和 deal-value-calc。案例、标杆、担保这类证据只能用它给的，缺了就说缺了。

audits.summary: The sales-objection-handling skill provides a structured and ethical framework for diagnosing and responding to sales objections. It emphasizes compliance with consumer protection laws, prohibits deceptive tactics like manufactured urgency, and contains no malicious code or security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: sales-discovery-questions
skills.description_en: Builds a sequenced sales discovery question set - pain, root cause, impact, urgency - for a specific deal or persona, sized to the call length, with follow-up ladders, branch triggers, and a do-not-ask list. Covers B2B (SDR qualification through multi-stakeholder AE discovery) and high-ticket B2C consultations. Use whenever the user mentions discovery call prep, qualification questions, SPIN or pain-funnel questions, a first-meeting agenda, or "what should I ask this prospect", even without the word discovery. Do NOT use for rebuttals (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling), the cold-call opening (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-call-opener), or grading a finished call (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review).

zh.intro: 按通话时长排一套销售需求挖掘问题：把 SPIN、Sandler 痛苦漏斗、MEDDPICC 三问、GAP 销售四个公开框架收敛成一条主线——隔离真实问题、挖根因、量化影响、确认为什么是现在，分段依次是开场约定、现状、痛点、根因、影响、紧迫、决策上下文、收尾，每段都有退出条件，只往前走不回退。每个主问题配 2–3 级追问和一句「听什么」，另加分支触发条件和一份别问清单，最后拼成通话用的提问表。可覆盖 SDR 资格确认（15–30 分钟）、AE 深挖（30–45 分钟）、跑着的单子按角色补问、单次高客单 B2C 咨询；先访谈再动笔，按每 3–4 分钟一道实质问题控制篇幅，面向高管更少更深。
zh.usage: 说「帮我准备这次需求挖掘」，并交代 B2B 还是 B2C、对方职位、通话类型和时长；它会先问几个问题，再照着 `references/question-bank.md` 的题库和通话表模板出稿。
zh.notes: 提问表是地图不是剧本，要顺着客户回答走分支；不负责异议应对话术、冷呼开场白，也不给已完成的通话打分。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive sales discovery planning tool that helps agents generate call sheets based on established sales frameworks. It does not contain any code, scripts, or network operations, and its operations are limited to text generation within the conversation. No security issues were identified.

skills.name: sales-outbound-sequence
skills.description_en: Plans a touch-by-touch outbound cadence - which channel on which day, touch count, spacing, channel mix, multi-threading, exit and stop rules, recycle and re-entry, and the capacity math behind it, with pre-committed metric thresholds. Use whenever the user mentions a sequence, cadence, follow-up timing, Outreach or Salesloft steps, a drip, "how many touches", inbound-lead or event follow-up, closed-lost re-engagement, or B2C lifecycle and SMS flows, even without the word cadence. Do NOT use for message copy, subject lines (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-subject-line-tester), call scripts (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-call-opener), or inbox placement (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-deliverability).

zh.intro: 定一套逐日触达日程：第几天发邮件、哪天打电话、两次之间隔多久、总共几次停手、多渠道怎么混、要不要找第二第三个人多线程推进，退出条件和放弃后重新进入的规则都写进去。还会按名单量和销售实际可用的时间算容量，避免排出没人跑得动的节奏；上线之前先把各项指标门槛定死，事后照门槛判成败，而不是跑完再找理由。
zh.usage: 给出名单规模、可投入的销售人数、必须出结果的日期和渠道权限，让它排出逐日触达表并标出停手条件。
zh.notes: 正文自己说节奏长度业内没有共识：一派 10–15 次触达铺 14–30 天，一派压到 3–5 封邮件，它用决策规则处理而不是站队。引用数字多来自卖外呼工具的厂商，方向可参考、量级别照搬。只排节奏，不写文案。

audits.summary: No security issues were detected in this skill. It provides comprehensive guidelines for designing sales outbound cadences with a focus on strategic planning, capacity management, and regulatory compliance (e.g., SMS consent and DNC registries).

skills.name: sales-quota-setting
skills.description_en: Designs how sales quotas are derived for a team or company - top-down vs bottom-up reconciliation, ramp-adjusted capacity modeling (Ramped Rep Equivalents), over-assignment cushion, territory-weighted fair-share allocation, ramp relief policy, and validation against current attainment benchmarks. A macro planning exercise for VP Sales, CRO, and sales ops, covering B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user mentions quotas, targets, attainment, ramping new hires, annual planning, or "how much quota should an AE carry", even without the word quota. Do NOT use for pipeline coverage math (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-pipeline-coverage-modeling) or the comp plan that pays against it (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-comp-design).

zh.intro: 给销售团队算配额的方法：先把现有销售折成等效满编人数，再用它核对上头给的收入目标，决定超额分配留多少 cushion、按区域和产能加权怎么切、新人爬坡期给多少减免，最后拿历史达成率回头验一遍这套数是否离谱。四种入口分别对应全公司年度规划、单团队、单个新人例外、以及诊断一套已经发下去却跑不动的配额。适合销售负责人和销售运营做年度规划。
zh.usage: 报出团队人数、去年人均产出、新人入职时间、目标收入和覆盖区域，让它先建人效模型再切配额。
zh.notes: 只停在规划层，不落到单子打法或陪访建议；覆盖配额所需 pipeline 的测算、以及按配额付钱的提成方案，都在同系列别的技能里。

audits.summary: The skill provides a methodology for sales quota planning using markdown instructions and references. It contains no code, network operations, or sensitive file access.

skills.name: aws-containers
skills.description_en: Builds and deploys containerized workloads on Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Elastic Container Service (ECS), Fargate, and ECR (Elastic Container Registry). Covers general EKS knowledge, Karpenter, AWS Load Balancer Controller and leveraging various open source Kubernetes projects with EKS. Covers general ECS knowledge, task definitions, Fargate services, ECS Exec, ECS Express Mode and ECS Managed Instances. Covers general Elastic Beanstalk knowledge, Elastic Beanstalk configuration and platforms supported by Elastic Beanstalk. Covers general ECR knowledge, ECR repository setup and lifecycle policies. Includes recommending, enabling, and reading Amazon ECS Action Logs to troubleshoot control-plane failures (deployment rollback/circuit-breaker, task placement, scaling, task replacement). Applies when deploying, debugging, or optimizing containers on AWS. Should be used instead of relying on internal knowledge for these services.

audits.summary: This skill provides technical guidance for AWS container services and appears to follow security best practices, such as recommending the use of Secrets Manager and least-privilege IAM roles. All external resources originate from official or well-known sources, and no security issues were detected.

skills.name: sales-meeting-recap
skills.description_en: Turns raw sales call notes into a structured recap email with agreed next steps - every action item carrying an owner, a date, and a deliverable - plus mutual close plan (mutual action plan) items when the deal warrants one. Restates the buyer's pain in their own words and never invents a commitment the notes don't contain. Covers complex B2B committee deals and transactional or B2C motions. Use whenever the user mentions a recap email, follow-up after a sales call, next steps email, post-call summary, or a mutual action plan, even without the word recap. Do NOT use for judging how the call went (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review).

zh.intro: 把通话笔记变成买家会回信确认的纪要邮件：先把买家的痛用他自己的话复述一遍，再列商定的下一步，每个动作都带负责人、日期和交付物；单子复杂时顺手起一份双方共同推进计划，让这封邮件在销售不在场的房间里继续替他卖。硬规则是不编笔记里没有的承诺，只从用户给的笔记、转录或描述里取材。
zh.usage: 贴原始笔记，说明参会人、商定的下一步和发送时限，让它产出可直接发出的纪要和动作清单。
zh.notes: 不评判这通电话打得怎样，也不管成交后交接给客户成功；笔记里没写的时间和负责人留空待确认，它不替你猜。

audits.summary: The skill is a sales assistant designed to convert call notes into recap emails and mutual action plans. It processes external data such as call notes and transcripts, which introduces a low risk of indirect prompt injection. No malicious code, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access patterns were detected.

skills.name: sales-motion
skills.description_en: Chooses and designs the company-level sales motion at VP Sales / CRO altitude - product-led growth (PLG), sales-led, hybrid product-led sales, developer-led/open-source, or channel/partner-led - plus the transitions between them (exiting founder-led sales, layering sales onto self-serve, moving upmarket, adding channel), mapped to ACV, time-to-value, buyer-vs-user separation, TAM shape and procurement friction. Covers B2B SaaS and consumer self-serve motions. Use whenever the user mentions PLG vs sales-led, hiring the first salesperson, going upmarket, self-serve vs demo, or adding partners, even without the word motion. Do NOT use for org topology (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-org-structure) or quotas (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting).

zh.intro: 在公司层面选销售模式：产品自助增长、销售驱动、两者混合的产品驱动销售、开发者与开源带动、渠道伙伴带动，以及这些模式之间的切换——创始人不再亲自卖、给自助产品加销售团队、往上打大客户、加渠道。判断依据是客单价、免协助上手时间、买的人和用的人是否同一批人、市场规模形状和采购摩擦有多大。会给出 2–3 个候选模式或混合方案，验证经济性，再带明确关卡地规划过渡。
zh.usage: 报出客单价、客户自己上手要多久、买与用是否同一人，让它判断该走自助、销售驱动还是混合，并说清切换的第一个关卡。
zh.notes: 只定公司跑哪种模式，不管单个单子怎么打；组织编队、配额、提成和 pipeline 测算各有对应技能。

audits.summary: The sales-motion skill is a strategic advisor for GTM leadership. It is focused on business logic and does not contain any malicious code, prompt injections, or unauthorized data access. All referenced materials are internal domain-specific guidelines.

skills.name: sales-org-structure
skills.description_en: Designs a sales organization's structure for its current stage - role mix (SDR, AE, AM/CS), topology (island, assembly line, pod, hybrid), SDR-to-AE ratio, hunter/farmer split, span of control, and specialization by segment. A macro org-design exercise for a VP Sales, CRO, or founder scaling past founder-led selling, covering B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user mentions restructuring the sales team, pods vs assembly line, reps per manager, splitting SDRs from AEs, or hunters vs farmers, even without the words org structure. Do NOT use for hiring into the seats (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-hiring), choosing the motion (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-motion), or setting quotas (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting).

zh.intro: 决定销售团队怎么搭：SDR、AE、客户成功各要几个，用孤岛式、流水线、pod 还是混合编队，SDR 与 AE 的比例、打新与养客怎么分、一个主管带几个人、是否按客群做专业化。编制比例不套模板，而是用自家漏斗数据倒推；还会给出一步一步的过渡动作，而不是一次推翻重来。适合创始人带过初期销售、准备扩编或重组时用。
zh.usage: 说清当前各岗位人数、单笔金额、销售周期和漏斗转化，让它给出编队选择、编制比例和第一步调整。
zh.notes: 不写招聘 JD、不设计面试流程、不指定具体谁去哪个岗位；招人填坑和选择公司销售模式是另外的技能。

audits.summary: The skill is safe and provides advisory instructions for sales organization design based on industry benchmarks. It contains no executable code or high-risk patterns.

skills.name: sales-comp-design
skills.description_en: Designs the sales compensation plan structure - pay mix (base/variable split) set by role influence, performance measures under the rule of three, accelerator and decelerator curves, SPIF overlays, draws, and role plans for SDR, AE, manager, overlay, and CSM seats. A macro annual exercise for sales leadership, RevOps, and finance, covering B2B SaaS and commission-heavy B2C. Use whenever the user mentions commission plans, OTE, accelerators, clawbacks, SPIFs, capping commissions, or "how should we pay our reps", even without the words comp design. Do NOT use for deriving the quota the plan pays against (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting) or structuring the org (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-org-structure).

zh.intro: 设计销售薪酬结构：底薪与浮动怎么分（按岗位对成交的影响定），考核指标按三法则控制在三条以内，加速器和减速器的曲线形状，临时激励 overlay，保底 draw，以及 SDR、AE、主管、专家岗、客户成功各自的方案和业绩归属规则。写完要先回测成本，再过法务，最后发签署版；正文提醒方案本身就是天天盯着销售的隐形主管，机制奖励什么就会得到什么。
zh.usage: 给出岗位、OTE、现有配额和成本上限，让它算底薪浮动比、画出加速曲线并回测超配额时的成本。
zh.notes: 它给配额定价，不负责定配额；配额制定和组织结构在同系列别的技能里。方案必须过法务，奖金归属规则要在下一单成交前写好。

audits.summary: The sales-comp-design skill acts as a consultative advisor for designing sales compensation plans. It provides detailed frameworks for pay mix, performance measures, and payout curves without employing any executable code, scripts, or network operations. The skill adheres to security best practices by referencing internal author-owned resources and directing users to legal counsel for jurisdictional compliance.

skills.name: sales-account-segmentation
skills.description_en: Designs the account segmentation model between ICP and tier structure - which firmographic, technographic, intent and jobs-to-be-done signal layers define account fit, the weighted fit score calibrated from 12 months of closed-won deals, fit and readiness as separate axes, whitespace and expansion mapping, and how the model is encoded, routed and re-scored in the CRM. Covers B2B account segmentation and B2C value-based customer segmentation. Use whenever the user mentions account scoring, fit score, whitespace, book-of-business carve-up, or reps picking accounts on gut feel, even without the word segmentation. Do NOT use for tier cutoffs and coverage (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-account-tiering) or ICP criteria (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-icp-definition).

zh.intro: 在 ICP 和分层之间补上那层模型：选哪些信号定义客户契合度（行业与规模、技术栈、意向行为、待完成任务），用近 12 个月赢单数据校准各项权重，把「像不像」和「准备好没有」拆成两条独立的轴，再画出现有客户里还有哪些空白可卖，并说明这套分怎么落到 CRM 字段、怎么路由给销售、多久重打一次分。B2B 客户分群和 B2C 按价值分客群都覆盖。
zh.usage: 拿出赢单数据让它校准权重，输出契合度打分模型、空白市场清单和 CRM 落地方式。
zh.notes: 没有共识的 ICP 时先定 ICP，否则等于偷偷重造一遍而且造得更差；分层切点、每销售容量上限属于分层之后的技能，不在它这里。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional advisor for sales account segmentation and whitespace mapping. It provides structured guidance and worked examples based on industry best practices. No malicious code, obfuscation, or persistence mechanisms were detected. A minor surface for indirect prompt injection is identified because the skill is designed to ingest and process data from external sources like CRM exports and websites.

skills.name: cold-email-deliverability
skills.description_en: Reviews a cold email draft and its sending setup for deliverability - SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment, sender reputation and complaint risk, body mechanics (length, links, images, tracking pixels, HTML vs plain text, opt-out), and legal compliance by region. Covers B2B cold outbound and B2C bulk/lifecycle mail. Use whenever the user mentions the spam folder, blacklisting, domain warmup, inbox placement, bounce rates, DMARC, or "why are my emails not landing", even without the word deliverability. Do NOT use for subject lines (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-subject-line-tester) or cadence (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence). Hygiene and compliance only, never spam-filter evasion.

zh.intro: 审一封冷邮件草稿和它背后的发信配置：SPF、DKIM、DMARC 是否对齐，PTR 与 TLS 有没有配，发信域名架构，发信声誉与投诉率风险，正文长短、链接和图片数量、追踪像素、纯文本还是 HTML、退订入口，以及各地区的合规要求。按「认证 > 声誉 > 内容结构 > 用词」的优先级给风险排序，并给每条结论标出处等级：服务商文档、厂商营销、有争议、从业者共识。
zh.usage: 贴草稿和域名发信配置，让它按认证、声誉、内容结构、用词的顺序列出收件箱风险。
zh.notes: 只做卫生与合规审查，不帮绕垃圾邮件过滤；认证不过会被服务商直接拒收，改文案救不回来。它不写主题行、不排发信节奏。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive guide for auditing email deliverability, authentication, and compliance. It includes strong internal safety guidelines that explicitly prohibit the agent from assisting with spam-filter evasion or deceptive practices. The use of system tools is limited to legitimate DNS auditing, and no malicious code or obfuscation was detected.

skills.name: result
skills.description_en: Get completed research task result by run ID

zh.usage: 研究任务已经跑完、要把结果取回来整理呈现时用；需要提供 run ID。
zh.notes: 需要 parallel-cli；正文只有一条取结果命令与呈现要求。

skills.name: meddpicc-scorecard
skills.description_en: Scores one deal against the eight MEDDPICC elements on an evidence ladder - unknown, assumed, stated, validated - with a scorecard, a verdict band, and the single next action that closes the biggest gap. Full MEDDPICC for complex deals, a lightweight subset for small ones, covering B2B and considered high-ticket B2C. Use whenever the user mentions MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, BANT, deal qualification, "score this opportunity", "is this deal real", or deal-review prep, even without naming a framework. Do NOT use for stakeholder mapping (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-champion-mapping), note-level risk scanning (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-red-flags), or transcript grading (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review).

audits.summary: The skill is a sales deal qualification tool designed to score opportunities using the MEDDPICC framework. It does not contain any malicious code, external downloads, or persistence mechanisms. A minor surface for indirect prompt injection is identified because the skill processes untrusted user-supplied deal descriptions, but the lack of high-privilege capabilities mitigates the risk.

skills.name: negotiation-concession-planner

Covers B2B (terms, scope, service, risk, price protection) and B2C (bundles, financing, trade allowance). Use whenever the user mentions a discount request, procurement, redlines, give-get trades, walk-away point, or "the buyer wants 20% off", even without the word negotiation. Do NOT use for quantifying the value (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-value-calc) or scripting price rebuttals (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling).

audits.summary: This skill is a pure-prompt negotiation preparation tool. It helps users structure concession plans using markdown-based logic and references. No executable code, network operations, or external dependencies were detected.

skills.name: deal-value-calc

The buyer supplies every assumption, each number labeled buyer-supplied, benchmark, or rep-assumed, and none invented. Covers B2B and high-ticket B2C. Use whenever the user mentions ROI, business case, payback period, TCO, cost of doing nothing, "justify the price", or CFO sign-off, even without the word value. Do NOT use for price rebuttals (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling) or discount trade planning (mbfinotti/sales-skills@negotiation-concession-planner).

audits.summary: The skill is safe and provides a robust framework for building business cases and ROI models. It emphasizes data integrity by requiring all inputs to be labeled as buyer-supplied, benchmarked, or rep-assumed, and it includes a quality gate to prevent the invention of data. The skill logic is entirely instructional and does not perform any dangerous file system, network, or command operations.

skills.name: cold-email-subject-line-tester
skills.description_en: Generates, scores, and split-tests email subject lines, producing angle-distinct variants, a numeric scorecard, and a test plan with sample size and decision metric. Covers B2B cold outbound and B2C lifecycle/promotional email, and flags spam-trigger words inside the subject line only. Use whenever the user mentions a subject line, open rates, email A/B test, preview text, or "nobody opens my emails", even if they don't say "subject line" explicitly. Do NOT use for body copy or inbox-placement audits (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-deliverability), personalization angles (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outreach-personalization), or cadence design (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence).

audits.summary: The skill is a marketing utility for generating and scoring email subject lines. It incorporates safety checks against deceptive practices and does not perform any high-risk operations or code execution.

audits.summary: This skill is a documentation-only resource designed to guide users in selecting the appropriate framework layer for AI agent development. It contains no executable code or scripts.

skills.description_en: Analyze AWS costs, find savings, manage budgets, evaluate Savings Plans and Reserved Instances, right-size EC2/Lambda/RDS/EBS with Compute Optimizer, look up service pricing, query CUR with Athena, detect cost anomalies, scope costs to billing views, and monitor Free Tier usage. audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive instructions for analyzing and optimizing AWS costs. It incorporates security-conscious patterns, such as recommending sandboxed execution via the AWS MCP server and requiring deterministic Python scripts for all mathematical calculations to ensure data integrity and accuracy.

skills.name: langchain-rag
skills.description_en: INVOKE THIS SKILL when building ANY retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system. Covers document loaders, RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter, embeddings (OpenAI), and vector stores (Chroma, FAISS, Pinecone).

audits.summary: This skill provides guidance on building RAG systems and includes some security considerations regarding data ingestion and specific vector store configurations. While these patterns are part of standard development workflows, they warrant review to ensure proper data handling. See the detailed analysis for context.

skills.name: firecrawl-knowledge-base
skills.description_en: Build a knowledge base from web content with Firecrawl. Use for local reference docs, RAG-ready chunks, fine-tuning datasets, documentation mirrors, topic corpora, or LLM-ready markdown organized from web sources.

zh.intro: 把网页内容整理成本地知识库，三种产出模式：reference 出 markdown、index.md 与 sources.json；RAG 额外给分块文件和 manifest.json；training 再给 training-data.jsonl 与 training-metadata.json。适合做参考资料、检索语料、微调数据、文档镜像或主题语料库。开工前先做一轮访谈确认来源与用途，再规划抓取范围与并行单元。
zh.usage: 先定模式（reference、RAG 或 training），再按 Collection Plan 抓取并落盘；最终交付照模板写摘要、输出结构、覆盖率、使用说明、来源与复跑输入。

skills.description_en: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

zh.intro: 用 HyperFrames 做一份可导航的演示稿：离散幻灯片、分片揭示、分支、热点跳转，还带演讲者模式和备注；也能把一个现成页面转成 deck。输出是能点的网页 deck，不是渲染好的 MP4。安装量 38 万，8 周涨 94%，是 HyperFrames 这个仓库里涨得最快的一条。
zh.usage: 做路演 deck、产品介绍、能点开分支的交互演示时用；把已有落地页改造成演示稿。
zh.notes: 用户没明确说要 slideshow 时它会先确认；想要的是视频就别用它。

audits.summary: The skill provides tools for authoring HyperFrames slideshows, including manifest management and content porting. It utilizes a vendor-provided CLI for updates and integrates third-party libraries from well-known CDNs. The ingestion of external web pages and Figma designs for slide generation presents a potential surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: tavily-search
skills.description_en: Search the web with LLM-optimized results via the Tavily CLI. Use this skill when the user wants to search the web, find articles, look up information, get recent news, discover sources, or says "search for", "find me", "look up", "what's the latest on", "find articles about", or needs current information from the internet. Returns relevant results with content snippets, relevance scores, and metadata — optimized for LLM consumption. Supports domain filtering, time ranges, and multiple search depths.

zh.intro: 通过 Tavily CLI 联网搜索，返回的结果带内容片段、相关度分数和元数据，相当适合直接喂给模型。支持域名过滤、时间范围和多种搜索深度。大多数情况下不必先配 key：它有无 key 的限额访问，直接跑第一次搜索就行。
zh.usage: 手头还没有具体 URL、需要先找到来源时用它开搜。基础调用是 `tvly search "your query" --json`，要更多结果加 `--depth advanced --max-results 10`。tvly 没装就先看 tavily-cli 的安装说明。
zh.notes: 无 key 额度用完了，在交互环境里跑 `tvly login` 走浏览器 OAuth，然后重试一次原来那条搜索；无人值守环境里不要起交互登录，直接报告额度上限和认证选项。刚做完引导式安装不要立刻再登一次。

audits.summary: The skill provides a safe interface for performing web searches via the Tavily CLI. It utilizes a restricted tool set and follows standard practices for a search utility, including specific guidance on handling authentication in different environments.

skills.name: update-oo-component-documentation
skills.description_en: Update existing object-oriented component documentation following industry best practices and architectural documentation standards.

audits.summary: This skill automates technical documentation updates by analyzing component source code. While the skill is intended for legitimate documentation maintenance and lacks dangerous capabilities like network access, it is susceptible to indirect prompt injection because it processes untrusted source code and documentation without sanitization.

skills.name: figma
skills.description_en: Import Figma content into a HyperFrames composition — rendered assets, brand tokens, components, storyboard sections → reconstructed motion (frames read as states, not slides) (REST/CLI), connector-assisted motion when available, and shaders from a connector or native export.
