Use when the user pastes a figma.com link or asks to bring a Figma design, frame, logo, brand, or animation into a video/composition.

zh.intro: 把 Figma 里的东西导进 HyperFrames 的合成里：渲染好的素材、品牌 token、组件、storyboard 段落变成动效，frame 被当成状态而不是幻灯片；有 connector 时走 connector，着色器可从 connector 或原生导出取。装量 30.4 万，8 周涨 100.8%。
zh.usage: 用户甩一个 figma.com 链接，或要把某个设计、frame、logo、品牌、动效塞进视频或合成里时用。
zh.notes: 只在 HyperFrames 这套合成工具里有意义；description 提到 REST 与 CLI 两条路径。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive integration for importing Figma designs into HyperFrames compositions, utilizing secure authentication practices and deterministic asset management. It includes robust verification scripts and follows established industry standards for telemetry and external resource handling.

skills.name: clerk-testing
skills.description_en: E2E testing for Clerk apps. Use with Playwright or Cypress for auth flow

zh.intro: 给 Clerk 应用写端到端认证测试的路数：Playwright 或 Cypress 里怎么让每个用例拿到独立的认证上下文、怎么用测试 token 跳过交互登录、怎么用 storageState 复用状态。核心是「一个测试一份新鲜会话」，别让用例互相污染。正文还列了 anti-patterns 和两个框架各自的接法。
zh.usage: 在全局 setup 里调 `clerkSetup()` 起环境，用例里用 `setupClerkTestingToken()` 绕开登录页，Playwright 侧用 `storageState` 存恢复态，再等 `[data-clerk-component]` 出现。
zh.notes: 需要 publishable key 和 CLERK_SECRET_KEY 或 CLERK_TESTING_TOKEN；没有 key 时 `npx clerk@latest init` 能生成临时开发 key，不用注册账号。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for setting up end-to-end testing for Clerk applications. It references official documentation and follows security best practices for secret management by advising the use of development-instance keys.

skills.name: revenue-kpi-framework
skills.description_en: Design the org-wide revenue KPI framework at the macro level - which metrics matter at each org level from board to IC, how they roll up through a reconciling metric tree with explicit math, who owns each branch, which guardrail counter-metrics ride alongside each owned number, and how the set is gated by company stage and business model. Use whenever the user mentions a revenue KPI framework, a metric hierarchy, a KPI tree, a North Star metric, driver metrics, guardrail counter-metrics, NRR, or which revenue metrics each org level should track - even if they never say "framework". Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use for writing the board report itself - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-reporting instead.

zh.intro: 设计公司层面的收入指标树：董事会到一线各层看哪些指标、怎么用能对账的算式层层汇总、每个分支归谁、每个数字配哪个护栏反向指标，以及整套指标如何按公司阶段和商业模式取舍。交付物是一棵带负责人和评审节奏的度量树，不是更长的一串数字。
zh.usage: 用户提到 KPI 树、指标层级、北极星指标、驱动指标、护栏指标、NRR，或问各层该看什么收入指标时加载；只做宏观设计，不建看板、不写 SQL、不写董事会报告。
zh.notes: 树的判据是父指标等于子指标的加、乘或比值，且数字能逐层对上。每个分支只能有一个负责人，跨团队的指标在交接处切开更合适。B2B 与 B2C 都覆盖。

audits.summary: This skill is an instructional framework for designing organizational Revenue KPI trees. It contains no executable code or network operations. A low-severity finding for indirect prompt injection is noted due to the ingestion of untrusted business data and the instruction to use persistent context storage to maintain the framework across sessions.

skills.name: sales-pipeline-hygiene
skills.description_en: Run a periodic, checklist-based hygiene audit over an active pipeline snapshot - stale deals (no stage, close date, or amount change, not logged touches) flagged against segment-specific stage medians, close-date push-count anomalies, and missing forecast-critical fields - producing an exception list with a disposition per flagged deal, a remediation plan, and a pass threshold. Use whenever the user mentions pipeline hygiene, a stale deal audit, pipeline cleanup before a QBR, deals that keep pushing, a close date that keeps slipping, missing fields on deals, or "our pipeline is full of junk" - even if they never say "hygiene". Covers B2B and B2C/high-velocity/PLG. Do NOT use for rewriting stage definitions - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@pipeline-stage-definition-audit instead.

zh.intro: 对当前管道快照做定期体检：按各分段阶段的中位时长挑出停滞的单，查关单日期被反复后推的单，找缺预测关键字段的单，最后给一份异常清单，每单一个处置结论，配整改与沟通计划和一个通过阈值。活跃按阶段、关单日期或金额有变动算，记了电话邮件不算。
zh.usage: QBR 前清管道、单子一直往后推、字段大面积缺时加载；RevOps 出规则和快照，一线经理做逐单处置，销售补更新和证据。
zh.notes: 不重写阶段定义，那是阶段审计的活；也不做整体预测可靠性诊断，更不设计自动提醒的时机和渠道。

audits.summary: The skill provides a methodology for auditing sales pipeline health, focusing on stale deals, push anomalies, and data completeness. It emphasizes data integrity and coaching over automation and lacks any malicious patterns or execution capabilities.

skills.name: revenue-funnel
skills.description_en: Design a company's revenue funnel model from scratch, at the macro level - the stage set, the unit of analysis (lead, buying group, account), the model purpose (process vs planning vs forecast), the cohort-based conversion assumptions behind the plan, and the ownership handoffs between marketing, sales, and CS. Use whenever the user mentions funnel design, funnel stages, a funnel model, conversion rate assumptions, a bowtie model, a demand waterfall, MQL to SQL to opportunity definitions, or marketing-sales handoff design - even if they never say "funnel". Covers B2B and high-consideration B2C. Do NOT use for auditing an existing pipeline's stage definitions - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@pipeline-stage-definition-audit instead.

zh.intro: 从零设计公司的收入漏斗模型：阶段集合、分析单元是线索还是购买组还是客户、模型用途是流程还是规划还是预测、计划背后的分组转化假设，以及市场、销售、客户成功之间的交接归属。产出是一套带版本号的制品，不是一页幻灯片。
zh.usage: 用户提到漏斗设计、阶段集合、转化率假设、领结模型、需求瀑布、MQL 到 SQL 的定义、市场销售交接时加载；先定用途和单元，再数阶段。
zh.notes: 别把三种用途挤进同一套阶段，这是多数坏设计的根源。每个转化率都要写口径，否则不能出。公开基准只用来触发排查，不用来定目标。

audits.summary: The revenue-funnel skill is a strategic design tool for RevOps professionals to build revenue models. It operates purely as an instructional framework for an AI agent and does not contain malicious code, network exfiltration, or dangerous dependencies.

skills.name: pipeline-stage-definition-audit
skills.description_en: Audit existing sales pipeline stage definitions against buyer-verifiable milestones and flag the ones built on rep activity instead. Core test - does each stage exit criterion name something the buyer did, said, or agreed to, checkable by two managers independently? Adds stage aging, conversion decay, stage-skip rate, and close-date push diagnostics. Use whenever the user mentions stage definitions, stage exit criteria, stage inflation, stages named after rep activity ("demo scheduled", "proposal sent"), "our stages don't mean anything", or "why is everything stuck in one stage" - even if they never say "audit". Covers enterprise and high-velocity pipelines, B2B and B2C. Do NOT use for designing a funnel stage set from scratch - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-funnel instead.

zh.intro: 审现有销售管道的阶段定义，看每条退出条件写的是买方做过、说过或点头答应的事，还是销售自己的动作；按严重度出报告，重写退出条件并给一份安全的迁移方案。附带阶段停留时长、转化衰减、跳阶段率和关单日期后推的诊断。
zh.usage: 有人说 demo 已约、方案已发这种按销售动作命名的阶段，或抱怨单子全卡在一个阶段时加载；先判管道类型，再逐条给退出条件打分。
zh.notes: 只审不改设计，漏斗模型本身有问题就转 revenue-funnel。阶段记录的是买方位置，不是资格打分卡。流传的预测统计不要当事实引用。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional diagnostic tool designed to audit sales pipeline stage definitions against buyer-verifiable milestones. It provides a structured analytical framework to identify subjective staging and improve forecast accuracy. The skill is entirely informational, lacks any high-risk system capabilities, and adheres to industry best practices. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or dangerous dependencies were detected.

skills.name: revops-hiring
skills.description_en: Build the complete hiring packet for a RevOps or Sales Ops role - archetype and level decision, outcome scorecard, interview stage map with a competency question bank and anchored rating scales, a work-sample exercise with rubric and debrief, and a 30-60-90 ramp plan branched on seniority and archetype. For the hiring manager or founder recruiting the hire. Use whenever the user mentions hiring a RevOps manager, sales ops interview questions, a RevOps take-home exercise, a scorecard for a first ops hire, or a 30-60-90 for a new ops hire - even if they never say "hiring packet". Does not source candidates or post jobs. Do NOT use for a candidate's own interview prep - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revops-career instead.

zh.intro: 给招聘方准备一整套 RevOps 与 Sales Ops 招聘材料：先定岗位原型和层级，写成果评分表，排面试轮次并配能力题库和锚定评分刻度，出一个带评分标准的工作样本演练，最后按资历分支给 30-60-90 天上手计划。
zh.usage: 要招第一个 ops、要 sales ops 面试题、要设计 take-home、要写评分表或上手计划时加载；先问公司阶段、团队规模、招人痛点和系统成熟度。
zh.notes: 只做招聘方一侧，候选人备面走 revops-career。不找候选人、不发岗位、不写 offer。薪酬区间只作参考，必须带来源和日期。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive toolkit for designing RevOps hiring processes. It contains no executable code, network operations, or sensitive data access. All referenced external resources are informational and trace back to the vendor or established domain-relevant sources.

skills.name: sales-forecast-diagnostic
skills.description_en: Diagnose why an existing sales forecast is unreliable and recommend fixes - stage inflation and happy ears, sandbagging, deals without verifiable buyer evidence, stale or mass-pushed close dates, wrong forecast-category assignment, zombie and duplicate opportunities, late-created deals, manager roll-up overrides, and comp incentives that reward bias - separating data-quality from behavioral from genuine demand problems. Use whenever the user mentions forecast accuracy, a forecast miss, reps sandbagging, deals that keep slipping, "why did we miss the number", or "our commit is never right" - even if they never say "forecast". Covers B2B deal-based and B2C/high-volume. Do NOT use for pipeline coverage modeling - use mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-pipeline-coverage-modeling instead.

zh.intro: 查一份销售预测为什么不准，找出该改的地方：阶段虚高和乐观汇报、藏单、没有买方证据的单、被批量后推的关单日期、预测分类填错、僵尸与重复机会、临近期末才建的单、经理汇总时改写、以及奖励偏差的提成设计。每个确认的根因归到数据、行为、真实需求三类之一。
zh.usage: 预测又打偏、commit 老是不准、单子反复往后滑时加载；先问清期限和是一次性纠偏还是建长期机制，再按根因类别定负责人和修法。
zh.notes: 只诊断不重做方法，预测分类、汇总规则和 commit 标准都是输入。不做管道覆盖度建模。最常见的错误是拿数据问题判成行为问题。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive diagnostic tool for sales forecast analysis. It is logically sound and follows best practices for sales operations, with no evidence of malicious behavior, exfiltration, or obfuscation. A minor theoretical risk exists due to the processing of external CRM data without explicit sanitization or boundary markers.

skills.name: revops-career
skills.description_en: Build and advance a RevOps or Sales Ops career from the candidate's side - place the candidate on the ladder by scope rather than title, close competency gaps, build defensible evidence of structurally invisible work, and prepare the four exercises RevOps interview loops actually run. Produces a career plan with a gap roadmap, an evidence ledger, interview readiness, and a compensation ask. Use whenever the user mentions a RevOps career, a sales ops career path, RevOps interview prep, RevOps certifications, "how do I break into RevOps", "am I ready for a RevOps manager role", or proving impact when nobody notices ops working - even if they never say "career". Candidate side only - for the hiring manager's side, use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revops-hiring instead.

zh.intro: 站在候选人这一侧规划 RevOps 与 Sales Ops 的职业路径：按管辖范围、决策权和带人规模而不是头衔定当前层级，补能力缺口，把平时看不见的运营工作做成经得起追问的证据，并准备面试轮实际会考的四类演练。产出含差距路线图、证据台账、面试准备和薪酬主张。
zh.usage: 想转进 RevOps、问自己够不够格做经理、要准备 RevOps 面试、需要证明运营工作价值时加载；先问清现状，再定级、定缺口、定证据。
zh.notes: 只做候选人一侧，招聘方一侧的岗位定义、评分表和工作样本走 revops-hiring。不出岗位列表、不代投简历。别把公司收入直接算成个人成果。

audits.summary: The skill functions as a career strategy framework for Revenue Operations professionals, providing structured guidance on competency gaps, evidence-based interview preparation, and compensation benchmarking. The analysis confirmed the skill is instructional and safe, with no detected malicious patterns, data exfiltration, or suspicious dependencies.

skills.name: crm-data-governance
skills.description_en: Design and operate CRM field-level governance - who owns each CRM field, which system is authoritative for it, how often it must be refreshed, and how the rules are enforced. Produces a field dictionary, per-field ownership, a system-of-record map with write-precedence and conflict rules, freshness SLAs, an enforcement plan, a field lifecycle, and a governance cadence. Use whenever the user mentions field ownership, single source of truth, system of record per field, data dictionary, stale CRM data, custom field sprawl, "which system wins", or "our CRM fields contradict each other" - even if they never say "governance". Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use for org-wide, object-level source-of-truth policy - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-data-governance-strategy instead.

zh.intro: 给 CRM 做字段级治理：每个字段归谁、哪个系统是它的权威来源、多久必须刷新、规则怎么落地执行。产出字段字典、逐字段负责人、带写入优先级和冲突规则的来源映射、新鲜度 SLA、执行方案、字段从申请到废弃的流程，以及固定开会节奏。
zh.usage: 用户提到字段归属、单一事实来源、某个字段该信哪个系统、脏数据、自定义字段泛滥时加载；先圈出对收入关键的字段，别想着管全部。
zh.notes: 每个字段只能有一个具名负责人，按消费方而不是录入方分配。销售不该当最后的执行手段，优先靠自动化、集成写入和默认值。

audits.summary: The skill provides a framework for CRM field-level governance, including ownership, system-of-record rules, and lifecycle management. It is technically sound and follows industry best practices. A low-severity finding is noted because the skill processes external CRM field exports, which presents a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: revenue-data-governance-strategy
skills.description_en: Set org-wide revenue data governance policy - which system is source of truth per object class (account, contact, opportunity, subscription, usage event, revenue metrics), how cross-team data contracts bind producers to consumers, where revenue metric definitions live, and who arbitrates disputes. Produces a per-object SOR/SOT designation table, an identity-resolution spine, a data-contract register, and a federated ownership model. Use whenever the user mentions source of truth, "two ARR numbers", GTM data contracts, revenue data governance, metric definition ownership, or "finance and sales report different numbers" - even if they never say "governance". Covers B2B, PLG/B2C, hybrid. Do NOT use for CRM field-level rules - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@crm-data-governance instead.

zh.intro: 定公司层面的收入数据治理政策：客户、联系人、商机、订阅、用量事件、收入指标这些对象类，各自由哪个系统写入、哪个系统作为读侧真值、谁负责、生产方和消费方怎么用数据契约绑定、争议在哪儿仲裁。产出指定表、身份归并主线、契约登记表和联邦式归属模型。
zh.usage: 出现两套 ARR、财务和销售报的数对不上、要定指标定义归谁时加载；先把来源与真值的指定表发出来，再谈买工具。
zh.notes: 记录系统和真值是两件事，要按对象类分别指定。财务与销售的数字差多半是定义问题，不是数据质量问题。不做单个 CRM 内的字段规则。

audits.summary: This skill provides strategic frameworks for revenue data governance and contains no executable code or scripts. It poses no security risks.

skills.name: firecrawl-deep-research
skills.description_en: Produce an intensive, cited analytical report: executive summary, multi-angle findings, contrarian views, open questions, and full sources. Use only when the user needs rigorous synthesis of a complex topic (scientific, technical, policy, or market-analytical) that cannot be answered with a short search, and wants a formal written report, not a recommendation list.

zh.intro: 产出带引用的长报告：执行摘要、多角度发现、反方观点、仍未解决的问题和完整来源清单。它明说只适合真正需要严谨综合的复杂题目，产品推荐、榜单、快速查资料都不该用它；证据是已发表论文的文献综述也该交给 firecrawl-research-papers。
zh.usage: 先确认用户要的是一份正式书面报告；产品推荐、榜单、快速查资料、以及不够格用它的请求都直接排除。
zh.notes: 别把自己抓的页面摘要直接堆成报告，要综合；写论文和文献综述属于 firecrawl-research-papers，它查的是论文索引不是网站。

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate research workflow designed by Firecrawl to generate cited analytical reports. It is safe for its intended purpose; however, it has an inherent surface for indirect prompt injection because it retrieves and processes untrusted content from the open web.

skills.name: chdb-datastore
skills.description_en: Use when the user has tabular data (pandas DataFrame, parquet, csv, Arrow, json) and wants to filter, group, aggregate, join, or speed up slow pandas. Provides chDB DataStore — same pandas API, ClickHouse engine underneath. Also handles reading from S3, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse Cloud, Iceberg, Delta Lake as DataFrames and joining across sources. TRIGGER when: user mentions DataFrame, parquet, csv, "fast pandas", "speed up pandas", or cross-source DataFrame joins; user imports `chdb.datastore` or `from datastore import DataStore`. SKIP this skill for raw SQL syntax (use chdb-sql instead), ClickHouse server administration, or non-Python DataStore API work.

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate tool provided by ClickHouse Inc to use the chdb DataStore API, which is an optimized, ClickHouse-backed replacement for the pandas library. It allows users to perform high-performance data analysis on various sources including local files (CSV, Parquet), cloud storage (S3, GCS), and databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL). The analysis found no evidence of malicious behavior, prompt injection, or unauthorized data exfiltration. All external resources and packages trace back to the official vendor infrastructure.

skills.name: revops-stack-rationalization
skills.description_en: Run a macro, periodic review of the full RevOps/GTM tool stack against the revenue workflows it serves and decide, tool by tool, what to keep, consolidate, replace, or cut - four-channel inventory, function-level overlap map, TIME scoring, a renewal-triggered action calendar, and re-sprawl governance. Use whenever the user mentions stack rationalization, GTM tool consolidation, a revops stack audit, a GTM stack review, SaaS sprawl, too many sales and marketing tools, cutting tooling spend, redundant GTM tools, or platform vs point solutions - even if they never say "rationalization". Covers B2B sales-led and B2C/e-commerce GTM stacks. Portfolio-level and periodic - not a pre-purchase checklist for one candidate tool, and not contract or legal negotiation.

zh.intro: 对整套 RevOps/GTM 工具栈做阶段性复盘：按四条渠道清点，画功能层重叠图，用 TIME 打分，逐个给出保留、合并、替换还是砍掉的结论，并排在各自续约窗口前，最后给防止再次膨胀的治理办法。
zh.usage: 用户提到工具栈精简、SaaS 泛滥、销售和市场工具太多、想砍工具预算、平台与单点之争时用。分析单位是整栈而不是单个采购候选，只给建议不执行迁移，也不做合同和法律谈判。
zh.notes: 结论锚在业务价值上，不能只看使用率——低频工具也可能在兜关键场景；这是周期性复盘，不是单次采购前的检查表。

audits.summary: This skill is safe for use. It provides a structured methodology for RevOps stack audits and rationalization, including fact-checking against industry benchmarks and identifying redundant tooling. No malicious code, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access patterns were detected.

skills.name: sales-to-cs-handoff
skills.description_en: Design the sales-to-CS handoff process after a deal closes - what data transfers, when, in what artifact, and who is accountable - producing a handoff spec with a gated closed-won trigger, a required handoff packet, timing SLAs, a kickoff meeting pattern, and a CS acceptance/rejection step. For RevOps and Sales Ops designing and enforcing the process, not a CSM running one handoff. Use whenever the user mentions sales to CS handoff, post-close transition, closed-won to kickoff, handoff accountability, "the CSM starts from zero", or "customers repeat themselves after signing" - even if they never say "handoff". Covers B2B high-touch through PLG/self-serve and B2C subscription. Do NOT use for account health scoring - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@customer-health-score instead.

zh.intro: 设计成交之后从销售交到客户成功手里的流程：什么数据要传、什么时候传、放在哪个交付物里、谁负责，产出含成交触发门、必需的信息包、时限 SLA、启动会模式和 CS 接受或打回环节的规格。
zh.usage: 给设计和推行流程的 RevOps、Sales Ops 用，不是让 CSM 跑单次交接。用户抱怨客户签约后还要重复讲一遍、CSM 从零开始、交接没人负责时用；管账户健康打分是另一个技能的事。
zh.notes: 设计要定六个决策：触发事件与门槛、必需数据、承载交付物、时限、启动会形式、CS 的接受或打回。

audits.summary: The sales-to-cs-handoff skill is an instructional resource for designing business processes. It contains no executable code, external dependencies, or identifiable security risks.

skills.name: blog-writing-guide
skills.description_en: Write, review, and improve blog posts for the Sentry engineering blog following Sentry's specific writing standards, voice, and quality bar. Use this skill whenever someone asks to write a blog post, draft a technical article, review blog content, improve a draft, write a product announcement, create an engineering deep-dive, or produce any written content destined for the Sentry blog or developer audience. Also trigger when the user mentions "blog post," "blog draft," "write-up," "announcement post," "engineering post," "deep dive," "postmortem," or asks for help with technical writing for Sentry. Even if the user just says "help me write about [feature/topic]" — if it sounds like it could become a Sentry blog post, use this skill.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive writing and editorial guidelines for the Sentry engineering blog. It contains no executable code, tool calls, or network operations, posing no security risk.

skills.name: lead-scoring
skills.description_en: Design, validate, and recalibrate a lead scoring model - fit and engagement signals, weighting, negative scoring and exclusions, decay, MQL/PQL threshold and tier setting, backtesting against closed-won/closed-lost outcomes, and governance; also diagnoses an existing broken model. Use whenever the user mentions lead scoring, an MQL threshold, fit vs engagement scoring, product-qualified leads, score decay, "score my leads", "our lead scores are wrong", "sales rejects our MQLs", or "too many junk MQLs" - even if they never say "scoring model". Covers B2B sales-led and B2C/PLG, rules-based design and predictive readiness. Do NOT use for assigning scored leads to reps - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@lead-routing instead.

zh.intro: 设计、验证并重校准线索评分模型：fit 轴看会不会买（行业、规模、技术栈），engagement 轴看是不是快要买（行为、产品内动作），两轴分开打分，再配权重、负分与排除规则、分数衰减、MQL 与 PQL 阈值和分层。要求用过去 12 到 24 个月的赢单与输单回测，并把校准和治理写进流程，因为评分失败多半是没人维护，不是算错。
zh.usage: 提到线索评分、MQL 阈值、产品合格线索、分数衰减，或抱怨销售不认 MQL、垃圾线索太多时用。先答清销售模式、月线索量和历史成交样本，再动模型。
zh.notes: 只管评分；把评完分的线索派给销售属 lead-routing，ICP 与账户 fit 标准属 sales-icp-definition。历史样本不够时只能出规则模型，预测模型要先攒数据。

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured methodology for lead scoring, including model design, validation, and diagnosis. No security risks or malicious patterns were identified.

skills.name: feature-sliced-design
skills.description_en: Official Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) v2.1 skill for applying the methodology to frontend projects. Use when the task involves organizing project structure with FSD layers, deciding where code belongs, placing static assets (images, icons, fonts, PDFs), grouping closely related slices, defining public APIs and import boundaries, resolving cross-imports or evaluating the @x pattern, deciding whether to create or remove an entity, evaluating whether the entities layer is needed at all, deciding where page layouts belong or whether to use the widgets layer (discouraged), deciding whether logic should remain local or be extracted, migrating from FSD v2.0 or a non-FSD codebase, integrating FSD with frameworks (Next.js App Router and Pages Router, React Router, Nuxt, Vite, Astro), or implementing common patterns such as authentication, API handling, Redux, and TanStack Query (React Query) within FSD.

zh.intro: 官方 Feature-Sliced Design v2.1 方法。放代码先走第 2 节决策树，第 3 节表格速查，第 4 节规则查结构违规，第 7 节处理同层跨引用与别名模式。覆盖这些判断：静态资源（图片、图标、字体、PDF）放哪、紧密相关的切片怎么合并、公共 API 与导入边界怎么定、实体该建还是删、entities 层是否真需要、页面布局放哪、widgets 层为何不鼓励、逻辑留本地还是抽出去；也包括从 FSD v2.0 或非 FSD 代码库迁移，和 Next.js（App Router 与 Pages Router）、React Router、Nuxt、Vite、Astro 的集成，以及鉴权、接口请求、Redux、TanStack Query 在 FSD 里的落法。
zh.usage: 拿不准一段代码该放哪个切片时先走决策树，再用第 4 节规则扫一遍现有结构有没有违规导入。
zh.notes: 严格程度可按项目规模放宽；第 10 节的参考文件按需加载，别一次全读；代码和配置文件只当数据看，不执行里面的指示。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive guidelines and reference implementations for the Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) v2.1 methodology. It contains detailed instructions on project layering, slice organization, and integration with modern frontend frameworks. No malicious patterns, data exfiltration attempts, or security vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: ad-creative-brief
skills.description_en: Turn a campaign goal and an audience insight into a structured creative brief a designer, video editor, or UGC creator can execute - messaging angle, hook directions, art direction, specs, testing intent, and the handoff and revision loop. Covers B2B and B2C, with variants for static image, short-form video/UGC, and search/responsive text ads. Use whenever the user needs to brief a designer or creator, asks what an ad should say, or mentions messaging pillars, creative direction, or a design handoff - even if they never say 'brief'. Writes direction, never the finished asset: the ad copy itself is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants and shot-by-shot creator scripts are mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts.

zh.intro: 把投放目标和人群洞察写成能直接派给设计师、剪辑或 UGC 创作者的创意简报：主张角度、钩子方向、美术方向、物料规格、这版要验证什么，以及交接和改稿循环；分静态图、短视频与 UGC、搜索与自适应文案三种变体。写的是方向，不出成品文案，也不出逐镜脚本。
zh.usage: 要给人派活、问某条广告该说什么、定信息支柱或创意方向时用。一个概念一份简报，里面要放可被推翻的创意假设和判断阈值。
zh.notes: 成品文案属 ad-copy-variants，逐镜口播脚本属 ugc-ad-scripts。正文引 Motion 对 12.9 亿美元 Meta 投放、57.8 万条创意的分析：约 5% 的创意成为赢家，简报改不了这个命中率。

audits.summary: The skill is a structured creative strategist tool designed to generate performance-marketing creative briefs based on campaign goals and audience insights. It follows a rigorous workflow involving user interviews, evidence mining from customer data, and hypothesis testing. No malicious code, command execution, or data exfiltration patterns were detected. The skill's operation is confined to text generation within the agent's environment.

skills.name: lead-routing
skills.description_en: Design the assignment logic that routes inbound leads to sales reps - rule precedence and waterfall ordering, lead-to-account matching, territory assignment rules (geography, segment, industry, named accounts), round-robin variants (straight, weighted, capacity-based, availability-aware), fallback catch-all queues, SLA escalation and reassignment, and safe rollout of routing changes. Use whenever the user mentions lead routing, lead assignment, territory assignment, round-robin, lead distribution, "who gets this lead", a lopsided round-robin, or leads sitting unworked in a CRM queue - even if they never say "routing". Covers B2B account-based and B2C/PLG high-volume routing. Do NOT use for designing the lead score itself - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@lead-scoring instead.

zh.intro: 设计把进线线索分给销售的过程：规则优先级与瀑布顺序、线索到客户的匹配、地区行业和重点客户的地域规则、轮询的几种变体（直接轮、加权、按容量、看在线）、兜底队列、SLA 升级与改派，以及改规则时怎么安全上线。
zh.usage: 用户提到线索分配、地域划分、轮询分不均、谁该拿这条线索、CRM 队列里线索没人跟进时用。注意区分：写 CRM 负责人字段是分配，从进线到有人接手整条链才是路由。做线索评分用另一个技能。
zh.notes: 讲成业界常见做法，不要包装成有名字的方法论；瀑布自上而下，第一条命中就结束，最后一定要有可监控的兜底队列。

audits.summary: The skill provides a design framework for lead routing and assignment logic. While the skill's instructions are safe, the nature of processing lead data from untrusted sources like web forms and APIs creates a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: customer-health-score
skills.description_en: Design, validate, and govern a composite customer health score - product usage and engagement signals combined into one weighted, normalized, decayed, banded account score that flags both churn risk and expansion readiness, backtested against real churn outcomes and recalibrated. Use whenever the user mentions a customer health score, health scoring model, account health, signal weighting, score bands, at-risk account flagging, churn risk score, expansion risk, or says "green accounts keep churning" - even if they never say "health score". Covers B2B account-level rollup and B2C/PLG continuous scoring. Do NOT use for discovering which indicators actually predict churn - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@customer-churn-signals instead.

zh.intro: 设计并校准一个复合客户健康分：把产品使用、活跃、支持等信号归一化、加权、加时间衰减，切成档位，既能标出往流失走的账户，也能标出可以谈增购的账户。作者的立场是权重从真实流失结果反推，而不是凭直觉挑十个指标；正文引用 ChurnZero 2025 年对约 800 位客户成功与售后负责人的调查，称 73% 的人认为现有健康分预测不了流失。
zh.usage: 提到客户健康分、账户健康度、信号加权、分档、风险账户标记，或说「绿灯客户照样流失」时用。先拿历史流失与留存账户回测，再定权重和档位线。
zh.notes: 与 customer-churn-signals 分工：那边负责找出哪些信号真能预测流失，这条只负责合成一个分并校准。不含客户成功剧本与挽留动作。

audits.summary: No security issues were detected. The skill is entirely instructional, providing a framework for designing and validating customer health scores without any executable code, external dependencies, or network requirements.

skills.name: firecrawl-workflows
skills.description_en: Run focused Firecrawl workflows for research, documentation lookup, SEO audits, QA, lead discovery and enrichment, business contacts, current jobs, fantasy decisions, brand assets, knowledge bases and website design systems. Use when the user wants a sourced answer or deliverable from a workflow rather than raw extraction or product-code integration.

zh.intro: 把「要一份带来源的成品」和「只抓原始网页」分开：这个技能按意图把活路由到 19 个专项工作流，覆盖线索生成与增强、企业公开联系人、在招职位、SEO 与 SERP 审计、线上站点 QA、竞品价格与变更监控、目录抽取、仪表盘指标、知识库与文档镜像、市场研究、产品演示走查、比价选品等；都不合适才走通用流程，并把流程沉淀成可复用模式。
zh.usage: 先挑工作流再开工：由请求推断输入、受众与产出格式，输入齐就直接做；确实缺关键信息才问 1 到 3 个问题。证据要落盘或引用，独立单元可以并行。
zh.notes: 每个工作流有自己的交付物与停止条件，联系人卡片不必写成研究报告；需要 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY，配在环境里即可。

audits.summary: The skill is a collection of guidelines and routing instructions for Firecrawl workflows. It does not contain any executable code, shell commands, or dangerous patterns. It defines standard operational procedures for research and web data extraction tasks.

skills.name: deal-desk-approval
skills.description_en: Design the deal desk approval chain and exception-handling process for non-standard B2B SaaS deals - a tiered discount approval matrix and delegation of authority across five concession levers (price, payment terms, services, contract risk, security), margin floor policy, exception intake, two SLA clocks with a sales escalation path, and precedent control. Includes the rules-driven promo/discount-policy equivalent for PLG, self-serve, and B2C. Use whenever the user mentions deal desk, discount approval, quote approval, approval matrix, delegation of authority, non-standard deals, concessions, margin floors, or discount creep - even if they never say "deal desk". Covers deal-level commercial approvals only, not general business-process approval workflows.

zh.intro: 给非标准 B2B 交易设计审批链和例外处理：价格、付款条件、服务、合同风险、安全五个让步维度各由谁批到哪一档，毛利下限怎么定，例外从哪进、两个 SLA 时钟怎么走、销售怎么升级、先例怎么控。另给 PLG、自助与 B2C 场景下的折扣政策版本。
zh.usage: 提到交易台、折扣审批、报价审批、审批矩阵、授权层级、非标合同、让步、毛利下限、折扣越滚越大时用。每条阈值都标出处。
zh.notes: 只管交易层面的商业审批；报销、采购、人事这类通用流程审批不在范围内。阈值没有行业标准，正文要求逐个标来源，别把咨询博客的数字当规范。

audits.summary: The skill is a business process design tool for deal desk approvals. It appears safe and follows domain-specific best practices, providing guidance on non-standard B2B SaaS deals without using dangerous capabilities.

skills.name: ad-creative-fatigue
skills.description_en: Decide whether a running ad creative is genuinely wearing out, or whether a confounder - budget change, learning-phase reset, audience saturation, auction CPM inflation, seasonality, tracking breakage - explains the decline, and return a verdict with confidence plus the highest-return remedy per unit of effort. Use whenever the user mentions creative or ad fatigue, wear-out, climbing frequency, dropping CTR, a rising CPA on an older ad, when to refresh creative, or whether to kill an ad - even if they never say 'fatigue'. Covers B2B and B2C across search, social, video, and native. Ends at the verdict: replacement creative belongs to mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants and mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts.

zh.intro: 判断一条在跑的创意是真在衰减，还是别的原因在拖：预算变动、学习期重置、人群饱和、竞价 CPM 上涨、季节性、追踪坏掉。按固定顺序做鉴别诊断——基线、混杂因素筛查、衰减测量、置信度，最后给结论和单位投入回报最高的补救动作。作者的提醒是多数换素材决定做得太早，只凭一个指标、没有基线。
zh.usage: 提到素材疲劳、频次上涨、点击率下滑、老广告 CPA 走高、什么时候换素材、某条广告要不要关时用。没有基线就先补基线。
zh.notes: 只到判定为止；替换素材属 ad-copy-variants 与 ugc-ad-scripts。别把平台预算改动造成的波动当成疲劳。

audits.summary: The ad-creative-fatigue skill is a specialized diagnostic tool for advertising professionals. It provides a structured workflow to analyze ad performance data, screen for confounders, and determine if an ad is experiencing genuine fatigue. The skill is purely informational and follows industry best practices for data-driven decision-making, with no identified security risks.

skills.name: ad-creative-test-plan
skills.description_en: Design a pre-launch ad creative test plan - falsifiable hypothesis, isolation level, test cells with per-cell budgets, required sample, spend and duration, and kill/scale rules pre-registered before any money moves. Every cell carries an explicit read standard, so an underpowered screen is never dressed up as an A/B test. Use whenever the user wants to test ads, mentions an A/B or split test on creative, asks how much budget or how long a test needs, or mentions sample size, statistical significance, single-variable vs big-swing testing, or test cell structure - even if they never say 'test plan'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to read results from a test already running - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-fatigue instead.

zh.intro: 上线前把创意测试设计好：可被推翻的假设、变量隔离到哪一层、每个测试单元各自的预算、需要的样本量、花费与时长，以及事先登记好的关停和放量规则。每个单元都要有明确的读数标准，避免把样本不足的粗筛包装成 A/B 测试；核心是对统计功效诚实，多数正常预算的创意测试根本达不到显著。
zh.usage: 要测广告、做素材 A/B 或分流测试、问预算要多少、要跑多久，或提到显著性、单变量与大改测试时用。先把功效算清楚再花钱。
zh.notes: 只管开跑前的设计；读已经在跑的测试结果属 ad-creative-fatigue。与 ad-creative-brief 分工：那边出简报，这边出测试结构和判定阈值。

audits.summary: The skill is a specialized ad creative testing tool that helps users design statistically sound experiments. It focuses on feasibility calculations, rigorous hypothesis testing, and pre-registering decision rules. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: ad-account-diagnostic
skills.description_en: Diagnose the root cause of an underperforming paid ad account - why the ads stopped working, why CPA went up, why ROAS dropped - instead of defaulting to 'increase the budget'. Weighs tracking, account structure, targeting, creative, bidding and budget, offer, and external forces, and returns a prioritised verdict with evidence and confidence. Covers B2B and B2C on search, paid social, video, and native. Use whenever the user mentions an ad account audit, a campaign structure review, wasted ad spend, rising cost per lead, or says their ads used to work - even if they never say 'diagnostic'. Diagnosis only, and it stops at the click: post-click page problems are mbfinotti/advertising-skills@paid-landing-page-audit and creative decay is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-fatigue.

zh.intro: 查一个跑不动的投放账户坏在哪，而不是默认去加预算。按固定顺序排查追踪、账户结构、定向、创意、出价与预算、报价、外部因素七层，每层给证据，最后出一份带置信度的优先级结论。覆盖搜索、社交、视频、原生，B2B 与 B2C 通用。
zh.usage: 要做账户审计、活动结构复盘、查浪费的广告花费、线索成本上涨，或说「以前跑得好现在不行了」时用。先验追踪，再往下游看。
zh.notes: 只管点击之前的问题；落地页问题属 paid-landing-page-audit，创意衰减属 ad-creative-fatigue。诊断本身不改账户。

audits.summary: The skill provides a structured framework for diagnosing paid ad account performance issues. It follows a rigorous workflow involving data reconciliation, fixed layer screening, and statistical validation. The skill contains no executable code, network operations, or obfuscated content. It adheres to safety best practices by implementing an 'Evidence Gate' and structured interview process to validate external data before analysis.

skills.name: ad-conversion-tracking
skills.description_en: Verify that conversion events are correctly configured, firing once, and deduplicated before a paid campaign launches, then turn the evidence into a GO / NO-GO decision. Covers tag debugging, test conversion tracing, browser/server event deduplication (including Conversions API setups), value and currency checks, conversion action status, consent handling, and test-data exclusion. Use whenever the user asks if their tracking works, mentions a pixel or tag check, conversions not showing up, duplicate conversions, or a pre-launch checklist - even if they never say 'conversion tracking'. Covers B2B lead gen and B2C ecommerce on any ad platform. Do NOT use to reconcile platform vs CRM numbers after launch - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-attribution-gap instead.

zh.intro: 投钱之前先确认转化事件真的配对了：标签是否只在该触发时触发一次、浏览器与服务端事件有没有去重（含 Conversions API 这类设置）、金额与币种对不对、转化动作状态是否正常、同意管理怎么处理、测试数据有没有排除，最后给出 GO 或 NO-GO 的结论。正文引用 GrowthSpree 的审计称 70% 到 80% 的 B2B SaaS 搜索账户至少有一处明显的追踪问题。
zh.usage: 问追踪对不对、提到像素或标签检查、转化不显示、重复转化、上线前清单时用。逐项留证据，别拿一张设置截图当验证。
zh.notes: 只做上线前验证；上线后平台数与 CRM 数对不上属 ad-attribution-gap。缺事件数据时先要导出，不要凭经验断言。

audits.summary: No security issues were detected. The skill provides a structured framework for verifying advertising conversion tracking, including checklists for deduplication, tag debugging, and test data management. It references industry-standard benchmarks and coordinates with other skills from the same author's namespace.

skills.name: revenue-reporting
skills.description_en: Define the metric set and narrative structure for an executive or board revenue report so it tells one coherent story - a small stable metric spine, locked definitions, an answer-first narrative around plan vs actual vs forecast, presenting a miss without surprising the board, the reconciliation and sign-off chain, and weekly vs monthly vs quarterly cadences. Use whenever the user mentions a board revenue report, exec deck metrics, the QBR revenue section, a monthly revenue review, an investor update, or a board deck that reads as a data dump - even if they never say "reporting". Covers B2B subscription, B2C, transactional, usage-based, and PLG. Do NOT use for designing the org-level KPI hierarchy - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-kpi-framework instead.

zh.intro: 定高管与董事会营收报告放哪些指标、按什么顺序讲：一小组稳定的指标主干，口径锁定，叙事按「计划对实际对预测」结论先行，坏消息要提前铺垫，不能让董事会在会上第一次听到；还要交代对账与签核链路，以及周报、月报、季报各自的节奏。
zh.usage: 要做董事会营收页、QBR 里的营收部分、月度营收复盘、投资人更新，或觉得现有董事会材料像数据倾倒时用。先定口径与对账，再写叙事。
zh.notes: 不管具体 BI 工具的看板搭建，也不管组织级 KPI 层级（那是 revenue-kpi-framework）；预测为什么失准先交 sales-forecast-diagnostic，再把结论写成叙事。

audits.summary: The revenue-reporting skill is a framework for executive reporting. It carries a low security risk related to indirect prompt injection because it instructs the agent to process external financial data exports using its code execution capabilities, creating a vulnerability surface for data-embedded instructions.

skills.name: ad-spend-guardrails
skills.description_en: Set the organisation's top-level paid-media spend guardrails as written policy - maximum allowable CAC, minimum ROAS/MER floor, kill-switch thresholds, counter-metrics, who owns them and who may override them - each derived from contribution margin, payback, and cash runway rather than inherited from a dashboard. Use whenever the user asks what CAC they can afford, mentions a ROAS floor, spend guardrails, a kill switch, when to stop spending, or who approves a budget increase - even if they never say 'guardrails'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to judge whether current CAC/ROAS is actually good (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@cac-roas-benchmark) or to monitor daily pacing (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing).

zh.intro: 写一份投放支出的顶层政策：能接受的最高 CAC、最低 ROAS 或 MER、止损线、反向指标，以及各项由谁负责、谁能破例。每条阈值都从贡献毛利、回收周期、现金跑道推出来，不从看板上抄；阈值要带后果、责任人、破例路径和退回的办法，否则只是一句标签。
zh.usage: 问能承受多高 CAC、提到 ROAS 下限、支出红线、止损开关、什么时候该停止投放、谁批预算时用。先算毛利再定线。
zh.notes: 不判断当前 CAC 好不好（属 cac-roas-benchmark），也不管每日花费跟踪（属 ad-budget-pacing）。只出政策，不动账户。

audits.summary: The skill is a policy architect designed to help users establish financial guardrails for advertising spend. It derives targets from business-specific margins rather than industry heuristics. No malicious patterns, unauthorized data exfiltration, or remote code execution vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: ad-audience-targeting
skills.description_en: Turn a business's ICP and buying signals into a layered ad audience targeting plan - cold/broad prospecting, interest and in-market behavioural segments, lookalike/similar, first-party lists, and retargeting pools - each sized against platform audience floors, budgeted to the learning threshold, and kept from overlapping by exclusion rules. Use whenever the user mentions ad targeting, who to target with ads, audience tiers or layers, broad vs. layered targeting, audience overlap between campaigns, or mapping an ICP onto ad audiences - even if they never say 'audience'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to pick the seed customers behind a lookalike (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@lookalike-audience-seeds) or to sequence retargeting messages (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@retargeting-funnel).

zh.intro: 把 ICP 和购买信号翻成一套分层定向：冷启动宽泛人群、兴趣与意向行为人群、相似人群、一方名单、再营销池，每层按平台人群下限核规模、按学习期门槛给预算，并用排除规则防止各层互相抢量。分层逻辑、排除纪律、重叠算法与最低预算门槛在 B2B 和 B2C 里是同一套。
zh.usage: 提到广告定向、该投给谁、受众分层或层级、宽泛与分层之别、跨活动受众重叠、把 ICP 映射成受众时用。先给 ICP 证据再排层。
zh.notes: 不出平台内的具体设置；相似人群种子属 lookalike-audience-seeds，再营销的逐层节奏属 retargeting-funnel。没有 ICP 就停下要，不要从产品描述里编一个。

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill provides professional frameworks and guidelines for advertising audience targeting, focusing on strategic planning rather than automated execution.

skills.name: paid-media-scaling
skills.description_en: Decide when a proven paid campaign has earned a budget increase, how large each step should be, how the ramp sequences over weeks and months, and how to avoid performance collapse on the way up - including readiness gates, vertical vs horizontal scaling, and rollback triggers. Use whenever the user asks whether to scale a campaign, how fast ad spend can rise, mentions a budget ramp, a scaling ceiling, or says performance collapsed after the budget was raised - even if they never say 'scaling'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to split a fixed total across campaigns (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-allocation) or to track daily spend against a set budget (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing).

zh.intro: 判断一条已经验证赚钱的投放该不该加预算、每步加多大、几周几个月怎么排、过程中怎么避免效果崩掉。把「可以放量」写成所有条件都满足的与门，而不是某个指标过线；看边际回报而不是混合回报，用加一步、观察、监控、回滚的循环来管，并预先给回滚触发条件。引用的每个数字要标明来源等级：平台文档、研究、还是同行口口相传。
zh.usage: 问要不要放量、预算能多快加、提到加预算后效果就崩、放量天花板时用。先确认验证方式、贡献毛利和可承受 CAC，再排节奏。
zh.notes: 只管放量；把固定总预算分给各活动属 ad-spend-allocation，跟踪每日花费属 ad-budget-pacing。计划照做，平台内的改动仍要人来执行。

audits.summary: The skill provides a strategic framework for scaling paid media campaigns. It follows industry best practices, including readiness gates, step-sized budget increases, and pre-committed rollback triggers. No malicious patterns or security vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: customer-churn-signals
skills.description_en: Assemble, define, validate, and rank leading indicators of customer churn from account activity, product usage, and support data into a ranked churn signal register - each signal carrying event, threshold, window, baseline, lift over base rate, lead time, and coverage. Use whenever the user mentions churn signals, churn indicators, leading indicators of churn, an early warning system for at-risk accounts, champion departure, seat utilisation drops, payment failure, or says "our health score misses churn" - even if they never say "signal". Covers B2B and B2C subscription. Do NOT use for combining signals into one composite score, weights, bands, or tiers - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@customer-health-score instead.

zh.intro: 从账户活动、产品使用、支持记录里找出流失的先行指标并排序，产出一份信号登记表：每条写清触发事件、阈值、观察窗口、基线、相对基准流失率的提升倍数、提前量、覆盖率。候选信号先过两道可执行性检验——来得及干预、且真有人能干预；拒付、降级申请、续约滑期这类晚触发事件归为确认信号，不算先行。
zh.usage: 提到流失信号、预警系统、关键人离职、席位使用下滑、支付失败，或说「健康分漏掉了流失」时用。先看手里有多少历史流失账户，再定排序方法。
zh.notes: 只管找出并排序信号；加权合成一个分、档位与配套动作属 customer-health-score。样本小只能做回测加提升度，回归类方法要数据量。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive framework for identifying and ranking customer churn signals using RevOps data. It follows best practices for data validation and statistical analysis. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or unauthorized data exfiltration attempts were detected.

skills.name: ad-spend-allocation
skills.description_en: Split a fixed total paid-media budget across campaigns, platforms, funnel stages, and audiences based on expected marginal return - the monthly or quarterly reallocation decision, for B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user asks how to split an ad budget, which channel or campaign should get more money, how to reallocate spend, how much to put behind prospecting vs retargeting, or mentions a portfolio split, marginal return, or diminishing returns - even if they never say 'allocation'. Do NOT use to raise the total budget on a proven campaign (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@paid-media-scaling), to track daily spend against a set budget (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing), or to pick channels at setup (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-platform-selection).

zh.intro: 把一笔固定总预算分到各活动、平台、漏斗阶段和人群上，依据是预期边际回报，并给出下次重新分配的判断规则。两条主线：平均 ROI 只是汇报指标，边际 ROI 才是行动指标，一个平均 ROAS 最好的渠道可能已经饱和，多投一块钱就亏；以及等边际停止规则，把钱从边际回报低的地方挪到高的地方，直到两边持平。
zh.usage: 问广告预算怎么分、哪个渠道该多给钱、怎么重新分配、拉新与再营销各投多少，或提到组合拆分、边际回报、回报递减时用。
zh.notes: 抬高一条已验证活动的总预算属 paid-media-scaling，跟踪每日花费属 ad-budget-pacing，上线时挑渠道属 ad-platform-selection。只给建议，不执行平台改动。

audits.summary: The skill is a strategic framework for advertising budget allocation based on marginal returns. It contains no code, network operations, or file system access, and it includes robust guidelines for identifying and rejecting fabricated marketing data.

skills.name: ad-budget-pacing
skills.description_en: Track daily and weekly spend against a single campaign or account budget and flag under-pacing or over-pacing before it hurts results, reporting the pacing ratio, projected period spend, and the corrective daily spend behind every alert. Use whenever the user mentions budget pacing, spend tracking, burn rate, spend vs budget, projected month-end spend, underspending or overspending, or asks whether a campaign is on pace - even if they never say 'pacing'. Covers any ad platform, B2B and B2C, calendar-month or fixed-date flights. It flags and recommends; it never changes budgets or bids. Do NOT use to plan a scale-up (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@paid-media-scaling) or to set CAC/ROAS thresholds (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-guardrails).

zh.intro: 按日、按周比对实际花费与预算，算出节奏比和本周期预计总花费，在欠投或超投伤到结果之前报警；每个警报都要给出一个具体数字：今天该把日预算改成多少。偏离先判断是不是平台投放机制本身造成的，再定因，最后只给最小可回退的调整。
zh.usage: 提到预算节奏、花费跟踪、烧钱速度、花费与预算对比、月末预计花费、超投欠投，或问某活动是否按节奏在跑时用。只报数和建议，不改预算和出价。
zh.notes: 警报不能停在「落后 12%」，要替读者把算术做完。放量规划属 paid-media-scaling，CAC 与 ROAS 阈值属 ad-spend-guardrails。

audits.summary: The ad-budget-pacing skill is an analytical guide designed to help media analysts track advertising spend against budgets. It is entirely instructional and lacks any executable code or technical capabilities. The logic provided for calculating spend ratios and diagnosing platform issues is consistent with standard industry practices. No security threats or malicious patterns were identified.

skills.name: lookalike-audience-seeds
skills.description_en: Select and size the seed customer list behind a lookalike, similar, or value-based audience - which customers to upload, how many, and whether the matched count (not the row count) clears the platform floor - with RFM and value-based selection, a negative-selection pass, a privacy and consent gate before any customer list upload, and a fallback ladder when the floor cannot be cleared. Use whenever the user mentions a lookalike or similar audience, a seed list, a customer list upload, match rate, an audience that is too small, or says their lookalike isn't working - even if they never say 'seed'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to design the whole targeting tier structure - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-audience-targeting instead.

zh.intro: 为 lookalike、similar 或价值型受众挑种子客户名单并算够不够用：上传哪些客户、传多少条、匹配后的人数能不能过平台下限。选择方式给到 RFM 与价值分层，另有排除式反选；上传客户名单前先过隐私与同意检查，够不到下限时按降级阶梯处理。正文的口径是以匹配后人数而不是上传行数对齐平台门槛——40% 匹配率下 5000 行只等于 2000 人种子，所以按目标量的 2 到 3 倍上传；同时提醒种子的同质性对效果的影响大于规模。
zh.usage: 提到相似受众、种子名单、客户名单上传、匹配率、受众规模太小，或说相似受众效果不对时用；要设计整套定向分层结构则交给 ad-audience-targeting。
zh.notes: B2B 与 B2C 都覆盖；版本 1.3.6，MIT。

audits.summary: The skill provides procedural instructions for advertising audience selection and privacy compliance. No security issues, malicious patterns, or executable code were detected.

skills.name: cac-roas-benchmark
skills.description_en: Compute a business's CAC and ROAS family metrics from real spend and outcome data, then judge whether the spend is healthy against three references - the business's own break-even, its own trailing history, and provenance-labelled external benchmarks - returning healthy, watch, unhealthy, or insufficient evidence. Use whenever the user asks whether their CAC is too high, whether a ROAS is good, what ROAS to aim for, whether ads are profitable, or mentions MER, blended CAC, payback period, or a spend health check - even if they never say 'benchmark'. Covers B2B/SaaS (cost per SQL, cost per closed-won, cohort lag) and B2C/ecommerce. Do NOT use to set those thresholds as policy - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-guardrails instead.

zh.intro: 用真实花费和结果数据算出企业的 CAC 与 ROAS 系列指标——B2B 侧有 cost per SQL、cost per closed-won 与 cohort 滞后，B2C 侧另有口径；再对三个参照物按优先级判断这笔花费健不健康：自己的盈亏平衡线、自己的历史区间、标注了来源的外部基准。结论只有健康、观察、不健康、证据不足四种。正文提醒只靠外部公开基准下判断正是它要防的错法，每个数字都要标出口径、时间窗和数据来源。
zh.usage: 用户问 CAC 是否太高、某个 ROAS 好不好、ROAS 该定多少、投放是否有利润，或提到 MER、混合 CAC、回收期时用；把阈值定成制度交给 ad-spend-guardrails。
zh.notes: 版本 1.4.1，MIT。

audits.summary: The skill is a set of analytical instructions and reference data for marketing unit economics. It contains no executable code, network operations, or sensitive file access. All external references are to related skills by the same author.

skills.name: advertising-kickoff
skills.description_en: Before starting any paid advertising work, before each recurring advertising review, and whenever routing is unclear, route the task to the right skill of the advertising-skills collection - or say plainly that none fits - and bootstrap or resume the project's shared context artifact. Use at every advertising project start, on later sessions of the same project to re-route without re-interviewing, and whenever the user mentions a new ad campaign or paid media project, asks which advertising skill they need, or wants a periodic advertising check-in - even if they name no skill at all. Prefer this whenever several skills could apply, since the collection has three colliding clusters - the hirer-vs-candidate pair, the budget cluster, the creative cluster - and it returns a short-list plus an ordered skill chain rather than a single guess. Do NOT use when the task already maps cleanly to one skill, such as a pure account audit - that is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic.

zh.intro: 付费广告任务的入口和路由器：把当前任务分派到广告技能集里合适的那一个，实在没有就直说没有。用于项目开头、每次周期性复核，以及搞不清该走哪条线的时候；同时建立或接着用项目的共享上下文文件，让下次会话不用重新访谈一遍。技能集里有三处容易撞车的地方——招聘方与候选人这一对、预算一簇、创意一簇，所以它给的是候选清单加一条有顺序的技能链，而不是一个猜测。
zh.usage: 新开广告项目、同一项目的后续会话想重新分派而不想再访谈一遍、用户问该用哪个广告技能，或想要定期广告检查时用；任务已经能明确落到某个技能时不用它。
zh.notes: 覆盖 31 个广告技能的集合；版本 1.3.7，MIT。

audits.summary: The skill serves as a project kickoff and router for an advertising-focused collection. It is designed to minimize user input by automatically reading project files, git history, and integration data from the environment. While the skill includes proactive security measures—such as forbidding the storage of PII and credentials in persistent memory—the automated ingestion of untrusted project files creates a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: ad-platform-selection
skills.description_en: Decide which paid channel families fit a business's economics, audience, funnel stage, and budget at campaign setup - paid search, paid social, short-form video, connected TV, native/discovery, retail media, programmatic display, podcast/audio, paid review listings, B2B professional networks - including whether each is affordable against allowable CAC and payback. Use whenever the user asks where to spend a new ad budget, which platform to advertise on, how to build a paid channel mix, whether a channel is worth trying, or compares two ad channels - even if they never say 'channel selection'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to split an ongoing budget across existing campaigns - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-allocation instead.

zh.intro: 在开案阶段判断企业该投哪一类付费渠道：付费搜索、付费社交、短视频、联网电视、原生与发现、零售媒体、程序化展示、播客音频、付费点评、B2B 职业网络，并按可承受 CAC 与回收期核对每类是否付得起。产出是一份渠道方案：一个拿到预算的主渠道、其余渠道被否的理由，以及一个带通过与否标准的测试。判断按渠道类别做，不按某家厂商的产品叫法，因为同一类里往往有多家厂商在跑同一套机制。
zh.usage: 问新预算该往哪投、该在哪家平台投放、怎么搭配渠道组合、某渠道值不值得试，或比较两个渠道时用；已有投放之间的预算切分交给 ad-spend-allocation。
zh.notes: 版本 1.2.6，MIT；正文强调渠道选择是算术题，不是偏好题。

audits.summary: The skill is a decision-making framework for selecting advertising channels based on business economics. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: advertising-hiring
skills.description_en: Build the complete hiring packet for a paid-advertising role - the rung decision (media buyer vs performance marketer vs growth marketer; creative strategist is its own role), an outcome scorecard, a 2-3 round interview loop with a judgment-first question bank, a time-boxed in-interview work sample, and a 30-60-90 ramp with staged spend authority. For the marketing leader or founder recruiting. Use for "hire a media buyer", "interview questions for a performance marketer", "paid media work sample", "scorecard for our first ad hire", or "30-60-90 for a new paid media hire". Does not source candidates, post jobs, run applicant tracking, or write offers, and does not cover the candidate side - that is the sibling mbfinotti/advertising-skills@advertising-career.

zh.intro: 给营销负责人或创始人搭一份付费广告岗的招聘包：先定层级（媒体买手、效果营销、增长营销分工不同，创意策略是独立角色），再做结果型评分卡、2 到 3 轮面试流程和以判断力为主的题库、限时的工作样本，最后是 30-60-90 天带分阶段放权额度的上手计划。正文把岗位定位放在第一位，理由是这个领域招错的根因多在岗位定义而不是面试技巧。
zh.usage: 用户说招一个媒体买手、给效果营销岗出面试题、要付费媒体工作样本、要第一个广告岗的评分卡，或要新人的 30-60-90 时用；不负责找候选人、发职位、跑招聘系统或写 offer。
zh.notes: 版本 1.4.9，MIT；候选人一侧交给 advertising-career。

audits.summary: This skill is a comprehensive framework for advertising role recruitment and contains no malicious code, external dependencies, or security risks. It functions entirely as a structured instruction set for generating hiring documentation based on industry best practices.

skills.name: retargeting-funnel
skills.description_en: Design a multi-stage retargeting sequence from a site's own funnel data - recency windows and behavioural-depth tiers per stage, a message and offer ladder for each stage, mutually exclusive audiences with exclusion logic, and per-stage frequency caps. Use whenever the user mentions retargeting or remarketing, cart or form abandonment, how long a retargeting window should be, frequency caps, a retargeting audience that is too small, or ads still showing to people who already bought - even if they never say 'funnel'. Covers B2B and B2C, and produces a stage-by-stage plan rather than campaigns built inside an ad platform. Do NOT use to design cold prospecting audience tiers - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-audience-targeting instead.

zh.intro: 用站点自己的漏斗数据设计多阶段再营销序列：每个阶段的回访时间窗和按行为深浅划的层级、对应的文案与优惠阶梯、互斥受众的排除逻辑，以及分阶段频次上限。产出是逐阶段的方案，不是在广告平台里建好的广告系列。正文把可用的转化事件追踪当硬前提，追踪不成立就建不出受众，先核对；它管的是阶段边界、信息意图、排除、频次和度量方案。
zh.usage: 提到再营销或 retargeting、购物车与表单放弃、再营销窗口该多长、频次上限、受众太小，或已经买过的人还在看到广告时用；冷启动的受众分层交给 ad-audience-targeting。
zh.notes: B2B 与 B2C 都覆盖；版本 1.4.9，MIT。

audits.summary: No security issues were detected. The skill is a specialized marketing design tool that operates on user-provided metrics and provides strategic planning for retargeting funnels. It leverages related skills from the same author and maintains clear boundaries between planning and execution.

skills.name: ad-buyer-group-mapper
skills.description_en: Map the likely buying committee for an offer, deal size, and industry, and give each role a messaging angle plus the ad-targeting proxy - job function and seniority, account list, account-level intent - that actually reaches them, sequenced by buying stage. Use whenever the user mentions a buying committee or buying group, decision makers, influencers or blockers, who signs off, targeting the economic buyer or a champion, per-role ad messaging, or whether one broad message beats per-role targeting - even if they never say 'buying committee'. Covers B2B committees and multi-decider household purchases. Do NOT use to size or build the audiences themselves - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-audience-targeting instead.

zh.intro: 按报价、单笔金额和行业画出可能的采购决策组，给每个角色配上信息角度，以及能在广告平台真正触达他的定向代理——职能与资历、账户名单、账户级意向，再按采购阶段排序。产出是给投放规划用的段位级角色图：某个市场段的角色形态，而不是某一单在谈生意的联系人名单，后者证据标准更严、属于另一种产出。决策组模型本身是 B2B 的，也能部分迁移到多人决策的家庭消费。
zh.usage: 提到采购决策组、决策人、影响者与阻碍者、谁签字、要触达经济买手或内部支持者、按角色写广告信息，或纠结一条泛信息还是分角色定向时用；受众的规模与搭建交给 ad-audience-targeting。
zh.notes: 版本 1.3.3，MIT。

audits.summary: The skill identifies buying committee roles by analyzing marketing context and external sales evidence such as CRM notes and customer reviews. This data ingestion creates a surface for indirect prompt injection, although the skill lacks dangerous capabilities like network access or code execution.

skills.name: advertising-career
skills.description_en: Plan and advance a paid-advertising career from the candidate side - media buyer, performance marketer, PPC specialist, creative strategist, growth marketer - covering the junior to lead ladder, the five real interview formats (live account audit, mental-maths case, metric diagnosis, take-home, behavioural), an NDA-safe results portfolio, platform certifications, in-house vs agency vs freelance, and promotion and pay conversations. Use whenever the user asks how to get into paid media or PPC, preps a media-buyer or growth interview, wants an ad portfolio, or weighs an agency vs in-house move - even if they never say 'career'. Do NOT use for the employer side of hiring - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@advertising-hiring instead.

zh.intro: 站在候选人一侧规划付费广告职业：媒体买手、效果营销、PPC、创意策略、增长营销这些岗位，从初级到负责人的阶梯，五种真实面试形式（现场看账户、心算案例、指标诊断、带回家作业、行为面），能过保密协议的业绩作品集，平台认证，以及甲方、代理商、自由职业之间的取舍和升职加薪谈话。建议按渠道类别和手艺讲，不按某家厂商的界面讲，厂商名只在认证本身是主题时出现。
zh.usage: 用户问怎么入行付费媒体或 PPC、准备媒体买手与增长岗面试、想做广告作品集，或在甲方与代理商之间权衡时用；雇主一侧的招聘交给 advertising-hiring。
zh.notes: 版本 1.2.5，MIT。

audits.summary: This career-coaching skill provides frameworks for landing and growing paid-media roles, including interview preparation and portfolio templates. The analysis found no security issues; the skill operates entirely within intended instructional bounds and uses safe industry data sources.

skills.name: build-dashboard
skills.description_en: Build an interactive HTML dashboard with charts, filters, and tables. Use when creating an executive overview with KPI cards, turning query results into a shareable self-contained report, building a team monitoring snapshot, or needing multiple charts with filters in one browser-openable file.

audits.summary: This skill facilitates the creation of interactive HTML dashboards by generating self-contained files with embedded charts and tables. It includes security considerations such as fetching charting libraries from a well-known content delivery network and processing external data sources. These practices are standard for dashboard generation tools and are implemented with common security measures like Subresource Integrity hashes.

skills.name: ad-bidding-strategy
skills.description_en: Choose the bidding policy per platform and goal - manual vs automated, cost-goal vs value/return-goal, when to switch, and how to set and move the target - written up as a policy with an evaluation window, change discipline, and a rollback trigger. Use whenever the user mentions a bid strategy, target CPA or target ROAS, smart or automated bidding, bid cap vs cost cap, portfolio bid strategies, seasonal bid adjustments, value-based bidding readiness, or delivery collapsing after a target change - even if they never say 'bidding'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to split budgets across campaigns (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-allocation) or to track spend against a budget (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing).

zh.intro: 按平台和目标定出价政策：手动还是自动、按成本目标还是按价值回报、什么时候切换、目标值怎么定和怎么挪。前提是先确认转化标签没标错，出价器只会优化账号标成转化的那个事件。三条判断贯穿全篇：出价是较晚的杠杆，获客成本高通常先查落地页、offer、人群和素材；目标值来自经济账与历史实际值，不来自愿望。产出带评估窗口、变更纪律和回滚触发的政策。
zh.usage: 讨论 target CPA、target ROAS、智能出价、出价上限与成本上限、组合出价策略、季节调整，或改完目标后投放量骤降时用。先一问一答把目标、转化量级、毛利结构和风险偏好问清，再给建议。
zh.notes: 只给建议和草稿，不动平台设置；分预算归 ad-spend-allocation，盯预算消耗归 ad-budget-pacing。

audits.summary: The skill is a strategic framework for managing advertising bidding policies. It relies on a user interview process to generate recommendations. The analysis identified a potential for indirect prompt injection from user inputs or external documentation, which is a standard architectural risk for this type of skill. No executable code, secrets, or malicious patterns were found.

skills.name: ad-hook-analyzer
skills.description_en: Score and force-rank the openings of candidate video ads - from a script, transcript, storyboard, shot list, or a description of a finished cut - to decide which hooks deserve test budget, returning a ranked shortlist within the batch rather than an absolute performance prediction. Use whenever the user mentions a hook, the first 3 seconds, an ad opening, hook rate, thumbstop, attention scoring, or asks which hook to test or whether a hook works - even if they never say 'hook analyzer'. Covers B2B and B2C on any platform. Ends at the ranking: writing the scripts themselves is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts and static copy is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants.

zh.intro: 给一批候选视频广告的开头打分并强制排名，判断哪几条值得花测试预算。素材可以是脚本、逐字稿、分镜、镜头表或成片的文字描述。方法上坦白边界：hook rate 是行业自造的派生比率，不同后台分母不一样，有机构统计它与 ROAS 呈负相关；能成爆款的素材本来就只有约 5%。所以只给同批次内的相对排序和强、够、弱三档定性判断，不编绝对预测分。
zh.usage: 纠结开头三秒怎么写、哪版钩子先投、hook rate 怎么解读时用。一次只在一个批次内比较，跨账户跨平台的分数不可比；要写新脚本或文案另找对应技能。
zh.notes: 范围到排名为止，节奏和结构改动不在内。

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill is a specialized analysis tool for evaluating video ad hooks with a focus on qualitative metrics and relative ranking, devoid of dangerous system operations or external dependencies.

skills.name: neon-auth
skills.description_en: Add authentication to a new app. Use for "add auth", "add login", Neon Auth (Managed Better Auth), identity routing, sign-up, sign-in, password reset, email OTP, magic links, organizations, phone OTP, OAuth, passkeys, MFA, trusted domains, invalid domain, and @neondatabase/auth. No existing identity: default to Managed Better Auth. Keep working Better Auth, Clerk, Supabase Auth, or another IdP. User asked to migrate from Supabase Auth: Managed Better Auth. A required plugin outside Managed support: self-managed Better Auth on a Neon Function or the existing app host. Also use for auth APIs in @neondatabase/neon-js.

zh.intro: 给新应用挑身份方案并接上：默认用 Managed Better Auth，用户、会话和认证配置存在分支库的 neon_auth schema 里，跟着数据库分支走，客户端走 @neondatabase/auth 的 Better Auth 方法。已有能用的 Better Auth、Clerk、Supabase Auth 或其他 IdP 就保留，除非用户明确要求迁移。
zh.usage: 用户说加认证、加登录，或提到注册、密码重置、邮箱 OTP、magic link、OAuth、passkey、MFA、可信域名时加载；先查现有身份和所需登录方式，再决定托管还是自管。
zh.notes: 托管版缺所需插件时，改在应用主机或 Neon Function 上自管 Better Auth，库仍用分支上的 Postgres。托管期间留在封装层，不要换成裸 better-auth/client。父技能 neon 需另装。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions for implementing authentication using Neon Auth (Managed Better Auth). It follows security best practices, including secret management and origin validation, and relies on official vendor packages and documentation.

skills.name: ad-format-fit
skills.description_en: Flag ad formats that are a poor fit or commonly misused for a given objective and platform - formats the objective does not even expose, formats built for a different funnel stage, formats the team cannot produce - then, post-launch, separate a format problem from a creative or targeting problem. Use whenever the user asks which ad format to use, mentions carousel, Stories, in-feed vs in-stream video, a funnel-stage mismatch, a pre-launch format check, or says a format 'isn't working' - even if they never say 'format fit'. Covers B2B and B2C, with explicit launch blockers. Do NOT use to choose the channel itself (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-platform-selection) or to brief the creative (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief).

audits.summary: The skill acts as a media strategist for ad format auditing and is generally safe, but it possesses an indirect prompt injection surface by processing untrusted user input during its interview phase without explicit boundary markers or sanitization. All external references are internal to the author's ecosystem.

skills.name: ad-copy-variants
skills.description_en: Turn one core value proposition into genuinely distinct ad copy variants - headline, primary text, description, and CTA combinations - each labelled with angle, awareness stage, formula, and version so test results stay attributable. A real variant is a new angle, never a reworded line. Use whenever the user asks to write ad copy, needs headline or CTA variations, wants copy to A/B test, has ads that all sound the same, or needs a search ad headline set or an ML asset pool - even if they never say 'variants'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use for video or creator scripts (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts), a designer brief (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief), or test design (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-test-plan).

audits.summary: The ad-copy-variants skill is a professional copywriting tool that generates testable ad variations while emphasizing evidence-based grounding. The main security observation is a potential surface for indirect prompt injection due to the ingestion of untrusted user data (like reviews and landing page text) without formal delimiters. The skill mitigates this through strict grounding rules that prohibit fabrication and require traceability. No malicious patterns such as obfuscation or exfiltration were found.

skills.name: iterate-pr
skills.description_en: Iterate on a PR until actionable CI passes and high/medium review feedback is addressed. Use for PR CI failures, review feedback, or green-check loops; do not wait for human approval, draft status, or merge gates.

audits.summary: The skill implements a workflow to automate pull request iteration by monitoring CI checks and categorizing review feedback using the GitHub CLI. It ingests external data (such as pull request comments and logs), which creates a potential surface for indirect prompt injection, but it contains no malicious patterns or insecure command executions.

skills.name: conversational-ad-copy
skills.description_en: Adapt ad messaging for conversational and AI-answer ad surfaces - the one-shot, context-aware ad occupying a single response slot inside an AI assistant reply or answer-engine result, where the copy is either rendered verbatim or rewritten by a model from the landing page and feed. Covers recommendation register, self-contained slot copy, situation-description targeting, grounding and disclosure discipline, and reading performance without creative-level reporting. Use whenever the user mentions ads inside ChatGPT or another AI assistant, sponsored answers, in-assistant ads, response-slot ads, or one-shot ad copy - even if they never say 'conversational ads'. Do NOT use for feed or search ad copy - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants instead.

audits.summary: The skill provides specialized copywriting instructions for conversational AI ad placements, such as those inside AI assistants or answer engines. It focuses on register shifts, factual grounding, and compliance. No security risks, malicious code, or suspicious patterns were identified.

skills.name: tavily-best-practices
skills.description_en: Build production-ready Tavily integrations with best practices baked in. Reference documentation for developers using coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to implement web search, content extraction, crawling, and research in agentic workflows, RAG systems, or autonomous agents.

audits.summary: The skill provides documentation and implementation examples for the Tavily API, enabling AI agents to perform web searches and content extraction. No malicious behaviors, obfuscation, or security risks were identified.

skills.name: claude-opus-4-5-migration
skills.description_en: Migrate prompts and code from Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, or Opus 4.1 to Opus 4.5. Use when the user wants to update their codebase, prompts, or API calls to use Opus 4.5. Handles model string updates and prompt adjustments for known Opus 4.5 behavioral differences. Does NOT migrate Haiku 4.5.

zh.intro: 把提示词和代码从 Sonnet 4.0、Sonnet 4.5 或 Opus 4.1 迁到 Opus 4.5 的一次性流程：搜出模型字符串与 API 调用、按平台替换、删掉不支持的 beta 头、补上 effort 参数，最后汇总改动。不含 Haiku 4.5。
zh.usage: 先判断代码库走哪个平台，再按表替换，例如 Anthropic API 用 `claude-opus-4-5-20251101`；同时移除 `context-1m-2025-08-07` 这个 beta 头并留注释说明。
zh.notes: 正文给了各平台目标字符串与来源字符串的对照表，effort 参数细节在 `references/effort.md`，迁移完要提示用户遇到问题可再调提示词。

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured workflow for migrating prompts and code to newer model versions. While it interacts with external codebases, which introduces a potential surface for indirect prompt injection, it mitigates this by recommending the use of organizational boundary markers like XML tags. The operations are consistent with standard developer migration tasks.

skills.name: thought-leadership-ads
skills.description_en: Plan a campaign that promotes an executive's or founder's existing organic posts as paid person-fronted ads - post selection, sequencing, audience and exclusions, permission and governance, budget, and measurement. Use whenever the user mentions thought leader ads, promoting a founder's or CEO's post, sponsoring an employee's or a creator's post, executive content amplification, running ads from a personal profile, or B2B trust ads - even if they never say 'thought leadership'. Covers B2B trust-layer campaigns on professional networks with pipeline-lens measurement, and B2C founder-led brands with direct-response measurement. Plans the campaign only, never the featured person's content: ad copy is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants.

audits.summary: No security issues were detected. The skill is composed entirely of instructional documentation and planning templates for marketing campaigns. It does not include any executable code or sensitive operations.

skills.name: documentation-writer
skills.description_en: Diátaxis Documentation Expert. An expert technical writer specializing in creating high-quality software documentation, guided by the principles and structure of the Diátaxis technical documentation authoring framework.

audits.summary: This skill is a specialized technical writing assistant based on the Diátaxis framework and contains no malicious code, dangerous execution patterns, or security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: update-llms
skills.description_en: Update the llms.txt file in the root folder to reflect changes in documentation or specifications following the llms.txt specification at https://llmstxt.org/

audits.summary: The skill updates repository documentation by summarizing existing files, which presents a low-risk surface for indirect prompt injection if the source files contain malicious instructions.

skills.name: claude-md-improver
skills.description_en: Audit and improve CLAUDE.md files in repositories. Use when user asks to check, audit, update, improve, or fix CLAUDE.md files. Scans for all CLAUDE.md files, evaluates quality against templates, outputs quality report, then makes targeted updates. Also use when the user mentions "CLAUDE.md maintenance" or "project memory optimization".

audits.summary: This skill includes some security considerations such as indirect prompt injection risks and access to local configuration files. While these warrant review, they are part of the skill's intended functionality for auditing project documentation. See detailed analysis for context.

skills.name: clickhouse-js-node-troubleshooting
skills.description_en: Troubleshoot and resolve common issues with the ClickHouse Node.js client (@clickhouse/client). Use this skill whenever a user reports errors, unexpected behavior, or configuration questions involving the Node.js client specifically — including socket hang-up errors, Keep-Alive problems, stream handling issues, data type mismatches, read-only user restrictions, proxy/TLS setup problems, or long-running query timeouts. Trigger even when the user hasn't precisely named the issue; vague symptoms like "my inserts keep failing" or "connection drops randomly" in a Node.js context are strong signals to use this skill. Do NOT use for browser/Web client issues.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive troubleshooting documentation for the ClickHouse Node.js client. It includes security best practices, such as using parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection and clear warnings against insecure TLS configurations in production environments. No malicious patterns or security risks were detected.

skills.name: aws-messaging-and-streaming
skills.description_en: Guides general use of AWS messaging and streaming services. Covers Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon MQ, Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, Amazon Data Firehose, Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink, and Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (MSK). Use when reasoning about messaging and streaming patterns. Also identifies which AWS service owns each customer communication channel: email (Amazon SES), and WhatsApp, SMS, MMS, RCS, voice and mobile push (the AWS End User Messaging family of services). Routes the request to the specialized skill for that channel. Defers to the channel's specialized skill when the user already named a specific channel. In general, use specific skills or documentation searches for detailed service-specific questions. Do NOT use for MSK or Managed Service for Apache Flink questions, prefer specific skills. Does not configure customer communication channels; defers to specific skills.

audits.summary: This skill acts as a comprehensive reference guide for AWS messaging, streaming, and customer communication services. It functions strictly as an educational and routing resource for the agent, helping distinguish between different architecture patterns and directing more specific inquiries to dedicated skills. No operational or security-sensitive code is embedded, and the reference content aligns with standard cloud security recommendations.

skills.name: terraform-test
skills.description_en: Comprehensive guide for writing and running Terraform tests. Use when creating test files (.tftest.hcl), writing test scenarios with run blocks, validating infrastructure behavior with assertions, mocking providers and data sources, testing module outputs and resource configurations, or troubleshooting Terraform test syntax and execution.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive guide for Terraform testing. It follows security best practices, particularly in its CI/CD documentation and the use of mock providers for isolated testing.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.description_en: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.

audits.summary: The skill provides utility documentation and code helpers for automated frontend testing using Playwright. It does not introduce any security vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, or unauthorized activities.

skills.name: vercel-cli
skills.description_en: Deploy, manage, inspect, and troubleshoot Vercel projects from the command line. Use for Vercel deployments, Vercel Toolbar comments, build failures, projects and teams, environment variables, domains and DNS, logs, metrics, Speed Insights, Core Web Vitals, request traces, usage, activity, alerts, firewall rules, cache, cron jobs, deploy hooks, Edge Config, feature flags (`vercel flags`), integrations, connectors, Blob storage, Container Registry (VCR), microfrontends, rolling releases, custom environments, Sandbox, agent/MCP setup, preview access, local development, or `vercel api` fallback.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive interface for the Vercel CLI tool. No security issues or malicious patterns were detected during the analysis. The commands and configurations align with standard Vercel operations and vendor practices.

skills.name: dotnet-upgrade
skills.description_en: Ready-to-use prompts for comprehensive .NET framework upgrade analysis and execution

zh.intro: 一组可直接取用的提示词，覆盖 .NET 项目升级的分析与执行：给解决方案里的项目按类型分类、查依赖兼容性、找还留在 packages.config 的项目、排升级顺序、定目标框架、改废弃 API，并跟踪构建测试部署的进度。
zh.usage: 准备把 .NET Framework 项目往新版迁时逐条取用；先做项目发现与依赖评估，再定顺序和回滚检查点。
zh.notes: 正文提到可选 Upgrade Assistant 或手工升级，取舍看项目结构。

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive set of natural language prompts designed to guide an AI agent or a developer through analyzing and upgrading legacy .NET framework projects to modern versions (e.g., .NET 8). No security issues, prompt injections, or malicious code patterns were found.

skills.name: upgrading-react-native
skills.description_en: Upgrades React Native apps to newer versions by applying rn-diff-purge template diffs, updating package.json dependencies, migrating native iOS and Android configuration, resolving CocoaPods and Gradle changes, and handling breaking API updates. Use when upgrading React Native, bumping RN version, updating from RN 0.x to 0.y, or migrating Expo SDK alongside a React Native upgrade.

audits.summary: The skill provides a standard and reliable workflow for upgrading React Native applications by applying template diffs from the community-maintained Upgrade Helper and rn-diff-purge resources. It includes comprehensive environment checks, dependency risk assessment, and platform-specific build verification steps using established ecosystem tools.

skills.name: ponytail-review
skills.description_en: Quality review of a change: is the logic right, is it safe, does it hold under real load, is risky code tested, is it fast enough, and is every line needed. Reads the connected code, not only the diff. Each finding is explained in plain English. Use for "review this", "code review", "review the last commit", "review my PR", "is this over-engineered", /ponytail-review.

zh.intro: 把一次改动当回事地审一遍：逻辑对不对、安不安全、真实负载下站不站得住、有风险的代码有没有测试、够不够快、每一行是否必要。它读的不只是差异本身，还有被改到的函数、调用方、测试和说明文件，因为改动可能弄坏它没碰的代码。优先级排得很直接：正确、安全、扛得住、有测试、快、精简。
zh.usage: 用户点名就看什么：未提交或已暂存的改动、某个分支、PR 链接或文件；什么都没说就看未提交改动，没有的话看最后一次提交。每条结论都要用大白话讲清，别只贴代码。
zh.notes: 正文强调这是用户主动要的报告，要给全，不要因为长而省略；额外的每一行代码以后都要被人读、测、修，所以精简也算质量。

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured process for performing code reviews by analyzing diffs and source code. It is susceptible to indirect prompt injection because it ingests and processes untrusted code that could contain adversarial instructions.

skills.name: resend-cli
skills.description_en: Operate the Resend platform from the terminal — send emails (including React Email .tsx templates via --react-email), manage domains, contacts, broadcasts, templates, webhooks, API keys, logs, automations, and events via the `resend` CLI.
