zh.notes: 细节拆在 references/ 下的中间件、服务端路由、组合式函数和 SSR 四份文档，按任务读对应那份。

audits.summary: The skill provides legitimate Nuxt 3 authentication patterns using the official Clerk SDK. All code snippets, configurations, and dependencies follow established best practices for secure application development.

skills.name: github
skills.description_en: GitHub patterns using gh CLI for pull requests, stacked PRs, code review, branching strategies, and repository automation. Use when working with GitHub PRs, merging strategies, or repository management tasks.

audits.summary: The skill provides workflows for managing GitHub pull requests and branches using the git and gh command-line tools. While generally safe, it presents a low risk of indirect prompt injection if untrusted pull request metadata, such as titles or branch names, is incorporated into shell commands without sanitization.

skills.name: java-junit
skills.description_en: Get best practices for JUnit 5 unit testing, including data-driven tests

zh.intro: 为 JUnit 5 单元测试提供实践建议，包括数据驱动测试的写法。适合给 Java 项目补测试、整理测试结构，或想知道 JUnit 5 惯用写法时查阅，也可以当作评审测试代码的对照清单。
zh.usage: 给 Java 项目写或补 JUnit 5 单测时用它，尤其是需要参数化数据驱动测试的场合；具体注解与写法以项目实际依赖的版本为准。
zh.notes: 目录里只留了描述，本地没有缓存正文，所以这张卡只按描述写适用场合，未涉及具体命令。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation and best practices for JUnit 5 testing in Java. No security threats or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: security-threat-model
skills.description_en: Repository-grounded threat modeling that enumerates trust boundaries, assets, attacker capabilities, abuse paths, and mitigations, and writes a concise Markdown threat model. Trigger only when the user explicitly asks to threat model a codebase or path, enumerate threats/abuse paths, or perform AppSec threat modeling. Do not trigger for general architecture summaries, code review, or non-security design work.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for performing security threat modeling on a codebase. It facilitates the identification of trust boundaries, assets, and potential abuse paths through repository analysis. The skill includes defensive instructions, such as redacting secrets and grounding all security claims in repository evidence, which align with security best practices.

skills.name: what-context-needed
skills.description_en: Ask Copilot what files it needs to see before answering a question

audits.summary: This skill functions as a template to help the AI identify which project files are needed to answer a user's request. It contains no code, network operations, or sensitive data access and is safe for use.

skills.name: update-specification
skills.description_en: Update an existing specification file for the solution, optimized for Generative AI consumption based on new requirements or updates to any existing code.

audits.summary: The skill is safe but includes a surface for indirect prompt injection because it processes external code and requirements to generate documentation.

skills.name: presentation-creator
skills.description_en: Create data-driven presentation slides using React, Vite, and Recharts with Sentry branding. Use when asked to "create a presentation", "build slides", "make a deck", "create a data presentation", "build a Sentry presentation". Scaffolds a complete slide-based app with charts, animations, and single-file HTML output.

audits.summary: A secure skill for scaffolding data-driven React presentations with Sentry branding, using trusted development tools and resources.

skills.name: product-launch-video
skills.description_en: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

zh.intro: 把产品页、营销 URL、现成脚本或 brief 变成发布或宣传视频：SaaS promo、功能揭晓、产品演示、应用和公司发布都算，商业化 URL 默认走它，站点导览和展示也归这条线。安装量 52.2 万，8 周涨 132.9%，带 has_references，Snyk 给了 warn。
zh.usage: 要发新产品、要一段能放官网首屏的 promo、或者手上只有个链接想直接出片时用。
zh.notes: Snyk 审计结论 warn。需求不清楚时 description 让你回到 /hyperframes 重新分流。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive workflow for creating product launch videos. It uses standard media tools like ffmpeg and ffprobe and incorporates robust security sanitization to prevent malicious code from being injected into the final video output.

skills.name: mongodb-connection
skills.description_en: Optimize MongoDB client connection configuration (pools, timeouts, patterns) for any supported driver language. Use this skill when working/updating/reviewing on functions that instantiate or configure a MongoDB client (eg, when calling `connect()`), configuring connection pools, troubleshooting connection errors (ECONNREFUSED, timeouts, pool exhaustion), optimizing performance issues related to connections. This includes scenarios like building serverless functions with MongoDB, creating API endpoints that use MongoDB, optimizing high-traffic MongoDB applications, creating long-running tasks and concurrency, or debugging connection-related failures.

audits.summary: The skill provides expert guidance on optimizing MongoDB connection management across various environments and driver languages. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: alliance-prioritization
skills.description_en: Rank named candidate strategic alliances and technology partnerships by expected value, effort, and risk, to decide where partner-team capacity goes  - must-pass screens, a weighted alliance scorecard with sensitivity analysis, co-innovation and platform-dependency risk checks, a ranked shortlist, and a go/no-go recommendation memo. Covers B2B tech alliances and B2C brand and creator partnerships. Use whenever the user mentions alliance prioritization, partnership ranking, partner shortlisting, or asks which of several named partners deserves investment, even if they never say prioritization. Portfolio-level comparison only. Do NOT use for modeling one partner's P&L  - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-economics instead.

zh.intro: 把几个具体候选的战略联盟和技术合作放一起排优先级：先过必过门槛，再用加权评分卡打分并做敏感性分析，加共同创新与平台依赖风险检查，最后给排序短名单和 go/no-go 建议。
zh.usage: 要决定伙伴团队的人力往哪投、几个指名候选谁先做时用它；只做组合层面比较，不建模单个伙伴的损益。
zh.notes: 正文提醒加权评分卡本身脆弱（权重随意、排序反转），所以权重要有理由，必过门槛不参与加权。

audits.summary: The skill is safe for use and implements a structured framework for alliance prioritization. It has a minor vulnerability surface for indirect prompt injection because it is designed to ingest and process data from external sources such as partner reports and web search results.

skills.name: affiliate-program-terms
skills.description_en: Draft the terms and conditions an affiliate accepts when joining a commission-based program - the affiliate program agreement, with the canonical clause set, prohibited-tactics clauses and enforcement ladder, commission validation, clawback and termination mechanics, and jurisdiction overlays (FTC endorsement rules, EU P2B, UK ASA/CAP, GDPR roles). Output is a clause-complete draft flagged for mandatory legal review, for B2B SaaS and B2C ecommerce alike. Use whenever the user mentions affiliate program terms, an affiliate agreement, prohibited tactics, or a brand-bidding policy, even if they only ask what affiliates must agree to. Do NOT use for reviewing a published post's disclosure label - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-disclosure-compliance instead.

zh.intro: 起草联盟加入时接受的条款：标准条款集、禁止手段条款与逐级处罚、佣金核验、追回与终止机制，还有 FTC 背书规则、欧盟 P2B、英国 ASA/CAP、GDPR 角色这些辖区差异。
zh.usage: 写联盟协议、补禁止手段条款、定品牌词竞价政策时用它；产出是条款完整的草稿，须标出必须法务复核，不能当法律意见。
zh.notes: 正文的原则是没明确禁止的即视为允许，所以靠穷举条款，不靠兜底条款。

audits.summary: The skill is safe to use. It provides instructions for drafting affiliate program agreements with a strong focus on legal compliance, mandatory human review, and clear attribution of risks. No malicious behavior or technical vulnerabilities were identified.

skills.name: affiliate-performance-dashboard
skills.description_en: Define the metric set and layout for an affiliate performance dashboard, delivered as a dashboard specification document - metric definitions with explicit formulas, views per audience, refresh and review cadence, and alert thresholds for top affiliates, conversion by source, and program ROI. Covers B2B SaaS recurring revenue-share and B2C ecommerce order-level CPA programs. Use whenever the user mentions affiliate program reporting, affiliate KPIs, affiliate ROI, revenue concentration, or what to put on an affiliate dashboard, even if they never say dashboard. Specifies metrics, never builds them in a BI tool. Do NOT use for one creator campaign's measurement plan - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-measurement-framework instead.

zh.intro: 定联盟项目看板看哪些指标、怎么排：指标定义带明确公式、按读者分视图、刷新与复盘节奏，以及头部联盟商集中度、按来源的转化和项目 ROI 的告警阈值。交付物是规格文档，由 BI 那边照着建。
zh.usage: 提到联盟项目报表、联盟 KPI、联盟 ROI、收入集中度，或问联盟看板该放什么时用它；只定指标，不建看板。
zh.notes: 正文要求区分归因 ROAS 与归因 ROI，并把 sourced 与 influenced 分开统计。

audits.summary: The skill is a text-based guidance tool for defining affiliate performance dashboards. No malicious code, network exfiltration, or safety bypasses were detected. It operates safely within the agent's textual context.

skills.name: affiliate-fraud-detection
skills.description_en: Build the detection rule set an affiliate program manager uses to flag fraudulent affiliate activity, plus the investigation and escalation path behind it  -  cookie stuffing, fake lead and form-fill fraud, self-referral rings, traffic-quality baselines, commission holds and clawbacks, and separating real fraud from legitimate low-incrementality coupon or cashback partners. Covers B2B SaaS lead-gen and B2C ecommerce programs. Use whenever the user mentions affiliate fraud, suspicious affiliate traffic, invalid clicks or leads, bot traffic, or an affiliate whose numbers look too good, even if they never say fraud. Do NOT use for consumer refer-a-friend gaming  -  use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@referral-abuse-guardrails instead.

zh.intro: 给联盟项目搭一套作弊识别规则，加上后续调查与升级路径：cookie 塞入、假线索与假表单、自推环、流量质量基线、佣金暂扣与追回，并把真作弊和低增量的优惠券返现伙伴分开。
zh.usage: 看到可疑联盟流量、无效点击或线索、机器人流量，或某个联盟商的数字好得反常时用它。
zh.notes: 正文说最有效的控制是 30 到 90 天的佣金暂扣与验证窗口，而不是检测算法，并借用 IAB/MRC 的 GIVT 与 SIVT 拆分。

audits.summary: The skill is a defensive framework for detecting and managing affiliate fraud. It provides a structured approach using commission holds, detection rules, and contractual controls. It correctly identifies high-leverage controls and emphasizes the importance of legal review for data privacy. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or unauthorized remote execution were detected.

skills.name: create-readme
skills.description_en: Create a README.md file for the project

audits.summary: The skill is safe but includes a minor risk of indirect prompt injection because it reads and processes content from external GitHub URLs and local workspace files.

skills.name: affiliate-onboarding-sequence
skills.description_en: Design the onboarding sequence that carries a newly approved affiliate from approval to first tracked conversion - touch plan (timing, channel, one action per touch), asset kit, time-boxed activation nudge, and never-activated follow-up branch. Covers B2B SaaS partner programs and B2C ecommerce affiliate programs. Use whenever the user mentions affiliate onboarding, an affiliate welcome email series, affiliate activation, a new-affiliate ramp, partner activation emails, or approved affiliates who never send a click or a sale, even if they never say onboarding. Starts at approval - to pitch affiliates who have not joined yet use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-recruitment-outreach.

zh.intro: 为刚通过审核的联盟推广伙伴设计从通过到首次可追踪转化的引导流程：触点节奏（时间、渠道、每次只要求一个动作）、素材包、限时激活提醒，以及始终没激活的后续分支。正文把日历节奏当起点而非标准，主张用首次点击、首次成交等行为触发覆盖固定天数。
zh.usage: 当用户要写联盟伙伴的欢迎邮件序列、问新伙伴头 30 天该收到什么、或有一批通过审核却始终没带来点击和成交的伙伴时用它。
zh.notes: 正文明确流程起点是通过审核之后；招募还没加入的伙伴属于另一个技能 affiliate-recruitment-outreach。

audits.summary: The affiliate-onboarding-sequence skill is a safe, purely instructional tool designed to help users create marketing plans. It contains no executable code, network operations, or sensitive data access.

skills.name: gemini-live-api-dev
skills.description_en: Use this skill when building real-time, bidirectional streaming applications with the Gemini Live API, or migrating legacy Live models (2.0/2.5/3.1) to Gemini 3.8 Live. Covers WebSocket-based audio/video/text streaming, voice activity detection (VAD), background reasoning (extended thinking), asynchronous function calling, session management, ephemeral tokens, live transcription, and live translation. SDKs covered - google-genai (Python), @google/genai (JavaScript/TypeScript).

zh.intro: 用 Gemini Live API 做实时双向流：音频、视频、文本走 WebSocket 推流，含人声检测、后台推理、异步函数调用、会话管理、临时令牌、实时转写和实时翻译；也讲旧版 Live 模型迁到 3.8 的差异。覆盖 Python 和 JS/TS 两套 SDK。
zh.usage: 要做语音对话、实时转写或翻译这类双向流功能时用；手上还跑着旧版 Live 模型、需要评估迁到新版要改什么时也用。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。新版是 Gemini 3.8 Live，旧版 2.0、2.5、3.1 的接口差异是迁移的主要坑。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and code examples for building real-time applications with the Gemini Live API. It follows standard development practices, including the use of official SDKs and placeholders for sensitive information. A few architectural considerations regarding real-time data processing are noted in the detailed analysis.

skills.name: partner-ecosystem-expansion
skills.description_en: Decide which partner categories to add next to a partner ecosystem and in what sequence  -  a staged partner-category expansion roadmap with readiness gates, capacity limits, and kill criteria. Covers B2B categories (tech/ISV, reseller/VAR, MSP, SI/GSI, agency, referral/affiliate, marketplace) and consumer-side equivalents (retail/wholesale, creator, licensing, co-branding). Use whenever the user mentions partner ecosystem expansion, partner category planning, a partner mix roadmap, or asks which partner type to launch next, even if they never say expansion. Category-level sequencing only. Do NOT use for ranking named candidate companies  -  use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@alliance-prioritization instead.

zh.intro: 决定下一步该加哪类合作伙伴、按什么顺序加：正文给分阶段的品类扩张路线图，每阶段设就绪门槛、容量上限和叫停条件，覆盖技术伙伴、经销、托管服务商、系统集成商、代理、联盟和市场等 B2B 类别与零售、创作者、授权等消费侧对应项。
zh.usage: 要排伙伴品类优先级、做伙伴组合路线图或定下一个该开的伙伴类型时用它；它只排品类顺序，不评估具体公司。
zh.notes: 正文先承认没有同行评议的最优扩张顺序，主要依据最小可行生态的思路；给具体候选公司排名属于另一个技能。

audits.summary: The skill is a strategic planning guide for partner ecosystem expansion. It consists entirely of documentation and contains no executable code. It is categorized as low risk due to an indirect prompt injection surface where user-supplied business data is ingested and stored in the agent's persistent memory.

skills.name: influencer-campaign-brief
skills.description_en: Draft the creative campaign brief a brand hands to an already-signed influencer or creator for one campaign - deliverables with exact specs, key messages with proof points, brand guardrails, disclosure requirements, timeline, and bounded review rounds, split into non-negotiables vs preferences. Covers B2C brand collabs and B2B creator programs. Use whenever the user mentions a creator brief, campaign brief, content brief, creator deliverables, or briefing a creator they just signed, even if they never say brief. Starts after the deal is signed and reflects its terms exactly. Do NOT use for picking or vetting the creator - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-discovery-brief instead.

zh.intro: 给已签约的创作者写单场活动的创作简报：交付物与精确规格、带证据点的核心信息、品牌红线、披露要求、时间表和有限的修改轮次，并把不可让步项与偏好项分开。正文对每条说法标注来源强度，不把任何单一厂商的模板说成行业标准。
zh.usage: 要写创作者简报、内容需求、交付清单，或刚签下创作者要交代这期怎么做时用它；挑选和背调创作者不在范围内。
zh.notes: 简报要在合同签好之后写，并严格照合同条款；正文强调不可让步项与偏好项分开是唯一被多家出版方共同印证的写法。

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill provides structured instructions and templates for drafting influencer campaign briefs based on established marketing practices and logic.

skills.name: partnerships-hiring
skills.description_en: Employer-side partnerships hiring across the field's four sub-disciplines - channel/alliance, affiliate, influencer/creator, referral. Calibrates the scorecard to company type (startup generalist, scale-up specialist, enterprise per-hyperscaler headcount, PLG integrations-first), builds the channel-manager loop with its named judgment test and negotiation role-play, sources candidates from the field's job board and communities, and gates compensation on live verification since public benchmarks disagree by 2-3x. States plainly where no documented loop exists for a sub-discipline. Use whenever the user asks how to hire a partner manager, write a partnerships job posting, design an interview loop, or source candidates. Do NOT use for candidate-side prep (mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partnerships-career).

zh.intro: 站在雇主一侧，为渠道与联盟、联盟营销、达人与创作者、推荐计划几条线搭招聘材料：按公司类型校准评分卡，设计带具名判断测试和谈判演练的面试流程，规划候选人来源，并强调薪酬判断要现场核实，因为公开基准彼此不一致。遇到没有现成流程的细分方向会直接说明。
zh.usage: 先说清招的是哪条线、公司处于什么阶段、这个岗位考核什么，再让它产出评分卡、面试流程和招聘启事；候选人一侧的准备不在范围内，要转去求职侧的对应技能。
zh.notes: 同仓库的 partnerships-career 是它的镜像技能，一个管招人一个管求职，不要混用。

audits.summary: The skill is a specialized hiring tool that uses structured workflows to create partnerships job postings and interview loops. The only minor risk identified is a vulnerability to indirect prompt injection from user responses during the interview phase, which is standard for interactive AI agents. The use of persistent storage and external benchmarking is safe and consistent with its intended purpose.

skills.name: partnerships-kickoff
skills.description_en: Before starting any partnerships work - and before routing to any other skill in the mbfinotti/partnerships-skills collection - run this router first. It matches the task (channel, alliance, co-sell, marketplace, affiliate, influencer, or referral) to exactly one sibling skill, says plainly when none fits, and bootstraps or resumes the project's shared partnerships-context.md artifact so the next session starts warm instead of cold. Use whenever the user opens a partnerships project, asks which partnerships skill they need, resumes partner work after a gap, runs a periodic partner, affiliate or influencer check-in, or describes a partner, creator or commission problem without naming a skill - even if they never say kickoff, routing or partnerships, and even when they name a downstream task directly. Routing and shared context only - it never does a sibling skill's work itself, and always emits the full owner/repo@skill target it routes to.

zh.intro: 合作项目的入口路由：把当前任务（渠道、联盟、联合销售、市场、推广伙伴、创作者或推荐）对到合集里唯一一个对口技能，对不上就直说没有，并建立或续接项目共享的 partnerships-context.md，让下一次会话从已有上下文开始而不是从零问起。
zh.usage: 开一个新的合作项目、隔了一阵要继续、或只描述伙伴与佣金问题但没点名该用哪个技能时，先跑它。
zh.notes: 它只做路由和维护共享上下文，不替任何子技能干活；每次输出都带完整的 owner/repo@skill 目标。

audits.summary: The skill acts as a router and state manager for a collection of partnership-focused tools. It maintains project continuity by reading local files and updating a context artifact, while providing specific guidelines to protect sensitive data like PII from persistent memory. A potential indirect prompt injection surface exists because the skill summarizes information from various project files, but the skill includes sufficient safety procedures to be considered safe.

skills.name: partner-economics
skills.description_en: Model the unit economics of one partner relationship - partner P&L, margin modeling, cost-to-serve, referral-fee and lifetime-value split, channel partner ROI, partner CAC vs direct CAC, ramp and payback - to decide whether to sign, scale, renegotiate, or exit that partner. Covers B2B channel and alliance partners plus B2C affiliate and creator economics. Use whenever the user mentions partnership unit economics, a single-partner business case, reseller, VAR, MSP, OEM or marketplace deal economics, revenue-share and margin-stack analysis, or asks whether a partner is worth pursuing, even if they never say economics. Do NOT use for ranking a portfolio of candidates - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@alliance-prioritization instead.

zh.intro: 为单个伙伴关系算经济账：伙伴损益、毛利建模、服务成本、推荐费与终身价值拆分、渠道伙伴 ROI、伙伴获客成本与直销获客成本对比、爬坡期与回本周期，用来判断该签约、加码、重谈还是退出。覆盖 B2B 渠道与联盟伙伴，也含 B2C 联盟营销与创作者侧算法。
zh.usage: 要判断某个伙伴值不值得投入、算单个伙伴的商业案例或分成结构时用它；给多个候选伙伴排序不归它管。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文。

audits.summary: This skill provides structured instructions and reference materials for modeling partnership economics, including financial formulas, benchmark comparisons, and business case templates. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: partner-tiering
skills.description_en: Design or redesign the tier structure inside an existing B2B partner program - qualification criteria, benefit bundles, tier count, promotion and demotion rules, review cadence for registered/silver/gold-style ladders, and migration of the current partner base. Also covers the B2C affiliate, creator and loyalty tier contrast. Use whenever the user mentions partner tiers, tier criteria, tier benefits, tier compression, demotion rules, or reseller, MSP and agency tier design, even if they never say tiering. Do NOT use for standing up a partner program from scratch - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-channel-program instead. Affiliate commission payout tiers are a separate skill.

zh.intro: 在已有的 B2B 伙伴项目里设计或重做分层：准入标准、权益组合、层级数量、升降级规则、复盘节奏，以及把现有伙伴迁到新结构。也对比 B2C 联盟、创作者和会员积分侧的分层做法。正文点明这一行没有公认的分层方法论，只把分析师与从业者的观点当结构来用。
zh.usage: 分层拥挤、没人升级、权益被忽视或长尾被落下时用它重设层级；从零搭项目请改用同仓库的 partner-channel-program。
zh.notes: 正文要求先问清现有层级分布与销售周期，因为交易注册保护窗口要按周期长度来定。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive framework for designing B2B partner tier structures. It contains no malicious code, prompt injections, or unauthorized data access. All instructions and references are focused on business logic for channel program management.

skills.name: partner-performance
skills.description_en: Measure and review the performance of individual partners in a B2B partner program - the per-partner scorecard (dimensions, weights, targets, red-flag thresholds, data sources), the review cadence and QBR structure, and the underperformance ladder from trigger through corrective action to de-tier or exit. Also covers the B2C affiliate and creator review contrast. Use whenever the user mentions a partner scorecard, partner reviews, a channel partner QBR, a partner health check, or an underperforming channel partner, even if they never say performance. One partner at a time. Do NOT use for designing the tier ladder itself - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-tiering instead.

zh.intro: 定义 B2B 伙伴项目怎么衡量和复盘单个伙伴：按伙伴维度的评分卡（维度、权重、目标、预警阈值、数据来源）、复盘节奏与 QBR 结构，以及从触发、纠正动作到降级或退出的处理阶梯。也对比 B2C 联盟营销与创作者侧的复盘方式，一次只处理一个伙伴。
zh.usage: 针对某一个伙伴做评分卡、季度复盘或健康检查时用它；设计分层阶梯请改用同仓库的 partner-tiering。
zh.notes: 正文明确说这一行没有公认的伙伴绩效方法，给出的模型只当证据输入，权重需要和用户一起定。

audits.summary: The skill provides a framework for managing B2B partner performance and does not contain any malicious code, data exfiltration patterns, or obfuscation.

skills.name: partner-channel-conflict
skills.description_en: Write the channel conflict rules that govern contested deals between direct sales and channel partners or between partners - rules of engagement, account segmentation, named-account carve-outs, deal registration as a claim instrument (protection window, tie-break, rejection grounds), compensation neutrality for direct reps, escalation and adjudication ladders, and governance cadence. Also covers consumer brands (D2C vs retail conflict, MAP policy, channel-exclusive assortment). Use whenever the user mentions channel conflict, partner disputes, deal poaching, or two routes to market claiming the same account, even if they never say conflict. Do NOT use for designing the co-sell operating model - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@co-selling-strategy instead.

zh.intro: 写清直销与渠道伙伴之间、或伙伴彼此之间争抢同一笔生意时的规则：交战规则、客户分层、具名客户例外、以交易注册作为主张凭据（保护窗口、平手裁决、驳回理由）、直销代表的薪酬中立、升级与裁决阶梯、治理节奏。也覆盖消费品品牌的 D2C 与零售冲突、MAP 政策、渠道专属货品。
zh.usage: 出现渠道冲突、伙伴争夺同一客户、两条销售路径撞单时用它写规则；设计共建销售模式不归它管。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文；共销运营模型请用同仓库的 co-selling-strategy。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional framework for designing business rules of engagement for channel partnerships. It consists entirely of documentation, logic steps, and references, with no code execution, network operations, or malicious patterns detected.

skills.name: partnerships-career
skills.description_en: Plans a partnerships career from the candidate side across the field's four sub-disciplines - channel/alliance, affiliate, influencer/creator, referral. Covers the internal-transfer entry tactic, the company-type hiring bar, channel-manager interview-loop prep including the negotiation role-play and the "same deal in December as January" judgment test, job-posting red-flag reads, and offer evaluation gated on live verification since published comp benchmarks disagree by 2-3x. States plainly that no cross-company career ladder is published for this field. Use whenever the user asks how to break into partnerships, prep a partner-manager interview, read a posting, or evaluate an offer. Do NOT use for the hiring/employer side (mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partnerships-hiring).

zh.intro: 从候选人一侧规划伙伴关系方向的职业路径，覆盖渠道与联盟、联盟营销、达人与创作者、推荐计划几条线：内部转岗的切入办法、不同公司类型的招聘门槛、渠道经理面试流程准备（含谈判演练和判断测试）、招聘启事的红旗识别，以及以现场核实为前提的 offer 评估。会明确说明这一行没有公开的跨公司晋升阶梯。
zh.usage: 准备进入这一行、准备渠道经理面试、读招聘启事或评估 offer 时用它；雇主侧招聘不归它管。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文。

audits.summary: The skill is a safe and specialized career coaching tool for the partnerships industry. It provides structured guidance through reference documents and does not perform any network calls, file system operations, or code execution. The instructions are focused on providing accurate career advice and lack any malicious patterns.

skills.name: partner-channel-program
skills.description_en: Design the overall structure of a B2B partner or channel program from scratch - a readiness gate that can conclude not yet, partner value proposition, which motions to run (referral, reseller, services, technology), tier count, benefit stack, program-wide economics envelope, governance, and success horizon. Covers B2C analogs (dealer, franchise, ambassador). Use whenever the user mentions building a partner program, channel program design, launching a channel, a partner ecosystem program, or asks whether they are ready for partners, even if they never say program. Do NOT use for reworking tiers inside a program that already exists - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-tiering instead.

zh.intro: 从零设计 B2B 伙伴或渠道项目的整体结构：可能得出「还不适合」结论的准备度门槛、伙伴价值主张、要跑哪几种模式（推荐、分销、服务、技术）、层级数量、权益栈、项目级经济包络、治理方式和成功时间线。也覆盖 B2C 的经销商、加盟、大使等类似形态。
zh.usage: 要搭伙伴项目、设计渠道、判断公司是否具备做伙伴的条件时用它；改已有项目的分层不归它管。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive framework for designing B2B and B2C partner programs. It uses a structured interview process and references detailed local documentation. No security issues were identified.

skills.name: partner-enablement
skills.description_en: Sequence the training, content, and certification a B2B partner program needs to make partners self-sufficient sellers - the partner enablement roadmap, not the training content itself. Covers the skills-gap needs assessment, enablement tracks split by partner role and type, certification design and refresh cadence, and a pilot cohort, all designed backwards from the partner's first deal. Also covers B2C analogs (franchise, dealer, ambassador education). Use whenever the user mentions partner enablement, partner certification, channel partner training, a partner onboarding curriculum, or ramping partners to a first deal, even if they never say enablement. Do NOT use for affiliate welcome emails - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-onboarding-sequence instead.

zh.intro: 排布 B2B 伙伴项目需要的培训、内容和认证顺序，让伙伴能自己卖：技能差距评估、按伙伴角色与类型分轨、认证设计与复审节奏、试点批次，全部从伙伴的第一笔成交倒推。只做路线，不写具体课程、战卡或考卷；也覆盖加盟商、经销商、大使培训等 B2C 类似形态。
zh.usage: 要规划伙伴培训体系、认证、上手课程或把伙伴带到首单时用它；联盟营销的欢迎邮件序列不归它管。
zh.notes: 正文说明这类方法论多来自教学设计领域或厂商内容，没有渠道原生的独立方法。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional instructional framework for designing B2B partner enablement roadmaps. It consists entirely of documentation and does not contain any executable code, malicious patterns, or data exfiltration risks.

skills.name: firecrawl-interact
skills.description_en: Drive a live browser on a scraped page: click, fill forms, log in, paginate, infinite-scroll. Use when content requires interaction or a scrape failed or returned incomplete content.

zh.intro: 在抓下来的页面上开一个真实浏览器去操作：点击、填表、登录、翻页、无限滚动，用来拿静态抓取拿不到的内容。抓取失败或结果不完整、页面内容要交互才会出现时用它；只做网页搜索的场合正文让你用 search，interact 是针对某个具体页面动手的。
zh.usage: 先 `firecrawl scrape "<url>"` 抓一页（scrape ID 会自动存下来），再用自然语言提示操作，比如 `firecrawl interact "Click the login button"`；要精确控制就换 `firecrawl interact --code "agent-browser click @e5" --bash`，`agent-browser snapshot -i` 能拿可交互元素清单。做完记得停掉会话。
zh.notes: 正文的 allowed-tools 限定 `firecrawl *` 和 `npx firecrawl-cli *`。首个参数是 UUID 时会被自动识别成 scrape ID。

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe but possesses an inherent threat surface for indirect prompt injection since it is designed to scrape and interact with untrusted external web content.

skills.name: referral-abuse-guardrails
skills.description_en: Define the operational guardrails that stop end customers from gaming a refer-a-friend program - reward caps, velocity limits and cooldowns, reward-hold windows tied to the refund window, eligibility rules, identity-verification gates, a published enforcement ladder, and abuse-monitoring signals. Produces a guardrail spec for B2C and B2B SaaS referral program managers. Use whenever the user mentions referral abuse, self-referral, fake accounts claiming referral rewards, referral rings, or a referral code leaking to coupon forums, even if they never say abuse. Do NOT use for professional-affiliate traffic fraud - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-fraud-detection instead.

zh.intro: 定义阻止终端客户薅推荐奖励的运营护栏：奖励上限、频次限制与冷却期、与退款窗口对齐的奖励持有期、资格规则、身份核验门槛、公开的处罚阶梯和滥用监控信号。产出给 B2C 与 B2B SaaS 的推荐项目负责人用的护栏规格。
zh.usage: 遇到自我推荐、假账号领奖、推荐小圈子或推荐码流到优惠券论坛时用它。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文；职业联盟的流量作弊另有技能处理。

audits.summary: The skill is a strategic framework for designing referral program guardrails. It provides defensive methodologies, program design advice, and compliance guidelines. It does not execute code, perform network operations, or access sensitive system resources.

skills.name: referral-incentive-design
skills.description_en: Design the reward structure of a customer refer-a-friend program - who gets rewarded (referrer, friend, or both), reward type (cash, account credit, discount, product value, status), how much to pay against LTV/CAC and gross margin, when the payout fires, and whether to build a tiered reward ladder. Use whenever the user mentions referral incentives, refer-a-friend rewards, referral bonus amounts, give-X-get-Y offers, double-sided referral rewards, or asks how big a referral reward should be, even if they never say incentive. Covers end-customer rewards only. Do NOT use for commission rates paid to professional affiliates - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-commission-structure instead.

zh.intro: 设计客户推荐朋友的奖励结构：奖给谁（推荐人、被推荐人还是双方）、奖励形式（现金、账户抵扣、折扣、产品权益、身份）、按终身价值与获客成本及毛利定金额、什么时候发放、要不要做阶梯奖励。只覆盖终端客户的奖励。
zh.usage: 要定推荐奖金金额、设计双向奖励或 give-X-get-Y 形式时用它。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文；职业联盟的佣金比例另有技能处理。

audits.summary: The skill consists of markdown-based design guidelines for referral incentives without any executable code or network operations.

skills.name: influencer-measurement-framework
skills.description_en: Design the pre-launch measurement plan for one influencer or creator campaign - KPIs matched to the objective (awareness, engagement, conversion, affiliate-linked, always-on ambassador), an attribution method and data source behind each KPI, reporting cadence per stakeholder, and declared blind spots. Delivered as a measurement plan document before launch, for B2B and B2C alike. Use whenever the user mentions influencer KPIs, creator campaign attribution, campaign reporting, or asks how to measure a creator partnership, even if they never say measurement. Do NOT use for an ongoing affiliate program dashboard - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-performance-dashboard instead.

audits.summary: The influencer-measurement-framework skill is a specialized tool for designing marketing measurement plans. It provides industry-aligned guidance based on ANA, MRC, and IAB standards, focusing on defining KPIs, attribution methods, and test designs. The skill does not contain any malicious code, obfuscation, or data exfiltration patterns. It references reputable open-source statistical tools from Meta and Google.

skills.name: update-markdown-file-index
skills.description_en: Update a markdown file section with an index/table of files from a specified folder.

audits.summary: The skill is functional for updating markdown file indexes but contains a vulnerability to indirect prompt injection. By extracting and processing file descriptions from the contents of local files without sanitization or boundary markers, a malicious file could potentially influence the agent's behavior during the indexing process.

skills.name: resend
skills.description_en: Use when working with the Resend email API — sending transactional emails (single or batch), receiving inbound emails via webhooks, managing email templates, tracking delivery events, managing domains, contacts, broadcasts, webhooks, API keys, inboxes (threads, labels, drafts, replies), automations, events, viewing API request logs, checking account usage and quotas, or setting up the Resend SDK. Always use this skill when the user mentions Resend, even for simple tasks like "send an email with Resend" — the skill contains critical gotchas (idempotency keys, webhook verification, template variable syntax) that prevent common production issues.

zh.intro: Resend 邮件接口的用法参考。能发单封或批量事务邮件，用 webhook 收来信，管模板、域名、联系人、广播、webhook、API 密钥、收件箱（会话、标签、草稿、回复）、自动化和事件，跟踪投递事件，看请求日志和账户用量配额，也讲 SDK 怎么接。正文特别点出几个生产上常踩的坑：幂等键、webhook 签名验证、模板变量语法，这些不处理会出现重复发送或验签失败。用户只要提到 Resend，哪怕只是发一封简单邮件，也先加载它。
zh.usage: 在项目里接发信前先配好密钥和 webhook 验签，再照模板变量语法写正文并带上幂等键。
zh.notes: 需要 RESEND_API_KEY，验签另需 RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET；作者是 resend，采用 MIT 许可；配额与用量以账户实际为准。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive and secure set of instructions for integrating the Resend email API. It adheres to security best practices by promoting the use of environment variables for secrets, implementing cryptographic signature verification for webhooks, and providing guidance on idempotency to prevent duplicate actions. It also includes specific warnings regarding the processing of untrusted email content.

skills.name: ux-copy
skills.description_en: Write or review UX copy — microcopy, error messages, empty states, CTAs. Trigger with "write copy for", "what should this button say?", "review this error message", or when naming a CTA, wording a confirmation dialog, filling an empty state, or writing onboarding text.

audits.summary: This skill is a UX writing assistant that helps generate interface copy. It includes security considerations regarding how it handles data from external tools, but it is safe for use as it lacks dangerous capabilities.

skills.name: swift-mcp-server-generator
skills.description_en: Generate a complete Model Context Protocol server project in Swift using the official MCP Swift SDK package.

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It acts as a template generator for creating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in Swift. It uses official and well-known libraries and follows standard development practices without any malicious behavior.

skills.name: influencer-negotiation-playbook
skills.description_en: Prepare a brand-side partnership manager to negotiate deal terms with an influencer or creator, from the creator's first positive reply to a signed contract - a written playbook of term-by-term opening positions, a concession ladder, red-flag responses, and walk-away thresholds covering rates, usage rights, exclusivity, revision limits, payment terms, and kill fees. Covers B2C brand collabs and B2B creator programs. Use whenever the user mentions creator rates, creator deal terms, usage rights, exclusivity, or negotiating with a creator's talent manager, even if they never say negotiation. Requires the user's own rate benchmarks. Do NOT use for the first-touch pitch - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-outreach instead.

audits.summary: The influencer-negotiation-playbook skill provides a framework for brand managers to prepare for creator deal-making. It operates as a structured set of instructions and reference markdown files without any identified security risks.

skills.name: tavily-extract
skills.description_en: Extract clean markdown or text content from specific URLs via the Tavily CLI. Use this skill when the user has one or more URLs and wants their content, says "extract", "grab the content from", "pull the text from", "get the page at", "read this webpage", or needs clean text from web pages. Handles JavaScript-rendered pages, returns LLM-optimized markdown, and supports query-focused chunking for targeted extraction. Can process up to 20 URLs in a single call.

zh.intro: 用 Tavily 命令行从一个或多个链接抓干净正文，输出 markdown 或纯文本：能处理前端渲染的页面，单次最多 20 个链接，可带查询词只取相关片段，也能把整份响应存成 JSON。抓不到内容时会列出失败项。
zh.usage: 手上已有具体链接、要页面文字、或要 JS 渲染页的内容时加载；直接跑 tvly extract，要精准片段就加 --query 和 --chunks-per-source。
zh.notes: 先用 basic，取不到再换 advanced。退出码是 0 也要看 failed_results。免密额度用完在交互环境里登录一次再重试。

audits.summary: This skill provides safe utility for extracting web content using the Tavily CLI. It operates within a restricted execution environment and follows security best practices for handling authentication and unattended environments. While it processes external web content, which inherently carries a minor risk of indirect prompt injection, this is a standard characteristic of web extraction tools.

skills.name: building-components
skills.description_en: Guide for building modern, accessible, and composable UI components. Use when building new components, implementing accessibility, creating composable APIs, setting up design tokens, publishing to npm/registry, or writing component documentation.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive guide for building modern UI components, focusing on accessibility, composition, and distribution patterns. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: tavily-cli
skills.description_en: Set up, authenticate, update, troubleshoot, or choose between Tavily CLI web commands. Use when the user asks about the Tavily CLI, installing Tavily skills, first-time setup, authentication, keyless limits, CLI updates, or which Tavily command to use. For an ordinary web task, use the specific search, extract, map, crawl, research, or dynamic-search skill instead.

zh.intro: Tavily 命令行工具 tvly 的安装、登录、升级和排错说明，也讲搜索、提取、站点地图、爬取、多源研究这几个子命令怎么选。搜索和提取可免登录用，但有速率上限；地图、爬取、研究必须登录。
zh.usage: 没装先用安装脚本或走 uv、pip 装；不想登录就用 tvly init --skip-auth 走免密钥模式。认证用 tvly init 或 tvly login，也可以直接给 TAVILY_API_KEY。升级前先 tvly update --check，状态用 tvly --status --json 查。
zh.notes: 地图、爬取、研究必须认证；无人值守环境别起交互式登录，改为报告限额让用户给密钥；浏览器 OAuth 回调落在本机 localhost，远程会话要保证回调可达。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for installing and using the Tavily CLI tool. It utilizes official vendor resources for installation and standard commands for web research and site crawling. No malicious behavior was detected.

skills.name: two-factor-authentication-best-practices
skills.description_en: Configure TOTP authenticator apps, send OTP codes via email/SMS, manage backup codes, handle trusted devices, and implement 2FA sign-in flows using Better Auth's twoFactor plugin. Use when users need MFA, multi-factor authentication, authenticator setup, or login security with Better Auth.

zh.intro: 用 Better Auth 的 twoFactor 插件做双因素认证：TOTP 认证器应用、邮件/短信 OTP、备份码、可信设备，以及 2FA 登录流程。服务端加 twoFactor() 并带上 issuer，客户端加 twoFactorClient()，然后跑迁移并在 user 表上确认字段存在。
zh.usage: 四步：服务端配置里加 `twoFactor()`（带 `issuer`）；客户端配置里加 `twoFactorClient()`；跑 `npx auth@latest migrate`（内置 adapter），Drizzle/Prisma 就生成再 push；最后确认 user 表上有 `twoFactorSecret` 列。
zh.notes: 客户端可以在 `onTwoFactorRedirect()` 里把用户跳转到 /2fa 页面。用 Drizzle 或 Prisma 时迁移走生成再 push，不是直接 migrate。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation and code examples for implementing two-factor authentication (2FA) using the Better Auth library. It covers TOTP, OTP, backup codes, and session management. No security risks were detected.

skills.name: bmad
skills.description_en: Answers BMad questions and recommends the next skill from what is installed. Use when the user asks bmad for help, what to do next or where to start; to set up, update, repair, doctor, migrate or check the status of the installation, or add modules; or to see or change the active initiative.

audits.summary: The BMad skill provides centralized management and guidance for its modules. It introduces a surface for indirect prompt injection by aggregating help documentation from all installed skills and instructing the agent to follow them. It also employs dynamic script loading and Jinja2 template rendering for its internal operations.

skills.name: apify-generate-output-schema
skills.description_en: Deprecated. Output schema generation moved to the apify-actor-development skill; prefer that skill whenever it is available.

audits.summary: The skill is a developer tool designed to automate the generation of Apify Actor output schemas by analyzing local source code. It follows standard development practices, performing local file operations to create and update JSON configuration files without exhibiting malicious patterns or risky behaviors.

skills.name: skill-scanner
skills.description_en: Scan agent skills for security issues. Use when asked to "scan a skill",

audits.summary: This skill is a security tool for auditing AI agent skills. It contains reference files with various malicious patterns (prompt injection, dangerous code, and obfuscation) used as a database for its detection logic. These patterns are documentation-only and do not pose a threat to the executing agent. The skill justifies its use of Bash and Python for static analysis purposes.

skills.name: tavily-crawl
skills.description_en: Crawl websites and extract content from multiple pages via the Tavily CLI. Use this skill when the user wants to crawl a site, download documentation, extract an entire docs section, bulk-extract pages, save a site as local markdown files, or says "crawl", "get all the pages", "download the docs", "extract everything under /docs", "bulk extract", or needs content from many pages on the same domain. Supports depth/breadth control, path filtering, semantic instructions, and saving each page as a local markdown file.

zh.intro: 用 Tavily CLI 爬整站或某个目录下的页面，把每页存成本地 markdown。可控层数、每页跟多少链接、总页数上限，能按正则选路径和域名，也能用一句自然语言说明要找什么，只取相关片段而不是整页。适合把文档站整段搬到本地离线看。

audits.summary: This skill enables the agent to crawl websites and extract content using the Tavily CLI. It is a legitimate tool for web-based research and data collection. As with any web-crawling tool, the agent will process untrusted content from external sources.

skills.name: typescript-mcp-server-generator

skills.name: trigger-cost-savings

audits.summary: This skill provides safe and standard documentation, best practices, and code examples for the Remotion video framework, utilizing official vendor resources and well-known technology services.

skills.name: context7-mcp

audits.summary: This skill is used to fetch and provide up-to-date documentation and code examples for various programming libraries and frameworks. It is safe to use and functions as an information retrieval tool.

skills.name: tavily-map

skills.name: typespec-create-agent
skills.description_en: Generate a complete TypeSpec declarative agent with instructions, capabilities, and conversation starters for Microsoft 365 Copilot

skills.name: remotion-docs
skills.description_en: Search Remotion documentation

zh.usage: 想弄清 Remotion 技能族之间怎么分工时先读它；要用它生成内容前，先把 Snyk 那条 warn 的指向搞清楚。

skills.name: shopify-storefront-graphql

zh.usage: 需要自建店面直接写 GraphQL 查询与购物车操作时先看这里，但正文要求改走 `shopify`；已装过这一条就按正文给的命令卸载后再装。

audits.summary: This skill serves as a deprecation notice for an older Shopify storefront tool. It provides instructions for users to migrate to the updated 'shopify' skill using standard CLI commands. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: my-pull-requests
skills.description_en: List my pull requests in the current repository

audits.summary: The skill is safe to use. It automates the listing and review of pull requests within a GitHub repository using trusted internal tools.

skills.name: better-icons

audits.summary: The skill provides tools to search and retrieve icons using the better-icons CLI and Iconify API. It includes functionality to sync icons directly into project files and set up MCP servers for AI agents.

skills.name: figma-generate-design
skills.description_en: Use this skill alongside figma-use when the task involves translating an application page, view, or multi-section layout into Figma. Triggers: 'write to Figma', 'create in Figma from code', 'push page to Figma', 'take this app/page and build it in Figma', 'create a screen', 'build a landing page in Figma', 'update the Figma screen to match code', 'convert this modal/dialog/drawer/panel to Figma'. This is the preferred workflow skill whenever the user wants to build or update a full page, modal, dialog, drawer, sidebar, panel, form, dashboard, list, table, card, header, message preview, or other composed product UI in Figma from code or a description—even when the user calls that composed UI a component. Discovers design system components, variables, and styles from Code Connect files, existing screens, and library search, then imports them and assembles views incrementally section-by-section using design system tokens instead of hardcoded values.

audits.summary: The figma-generate-design skill is a specialized design automation tool authored by Figma. It facilitates the translation of application layouts into Figma designs using design system tokens and components. The skill follows established security practices, uses trusted Figma-affiliated tools and domains, and incorporates validation steps for output accuracy.

skills.name: my-issues
skills.description_en: List my issues in the current repository

audits.summary: This skill provides natural language instructions for the agent to list and prioritize GitHub issues. It contains no executable code or malicious patterns.

skills.name: figma-create-new-file
skills.description_en: Always use this skill when the user wants to create a new Figma Design, FigJam, or Slides file. You MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `create_new_file` tool call.

audits.summary: The skill provides standard procedural instructions for an AI agent to create new Figma, FigJam, or Slides files using integrated tools. No security risks were detected.

skills.name: mongodb-natural-language-querying
skills.description_en: Generate read-only MongoDB queries (find) or aggregation pipelines using natural language, with collection schema context and sample documents. Use this skill whenever the user asks to write, create, or generate MongoDB queries, wants to filter/query/aggregate data in MongoDB, asks "how do I query...", needs help with query syntax, or discusses finding/filtering/grouping MongoDB documents. Does NOT handle Atlas Search ($search operator), vector/semantic search ($vectorSearch operator), fuzzy matching, autocomplete indexes, or relevance scoring - use search-and-ai for those. Does NOT analyze or optimize existing queries - use mongodb-query-optimizer for that. Does NOT handle aggregation pipelines that involve write operations. Requires MongoDB MCP server.

audits.summary: The skill provides a standard methodology for generating MongoDB queries from natural language. It uses vendor-provided MCP tools to fetch schema and sample documents to ensure query accuracy. No malicious behaviors or security risks were identified.

skills.name: prompt-builder
skills.description_en: Guide users through creating high-quality GitHub Copilot prompts with proper structure, tools, and best practices.

audits.summary: This skill is a structured guide designed to assist users in creating high-quality GitHub Copilot prompt files. It functions as a conversational assistant that gathers requirements and generates a template, containing no malicious code or instructions.

skills.name: email-best-practices
skills.description_en: Use when building email features, emails going to spam, high bounce rates, setting up SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, implementing email capture, ensuring compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL), handling webhooks, retry logic, making emails accessible (alt text, headings, contrast, screen readers), or deciding transactional vs marketing.

audits.summary: This skill provides safe and professional documentation, best practices, and code templates for building email systems, with a strong focus on deliverability, accessibility, and legal compliance.

skills.name: write-a-skill

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework and template for creating new AI agent skills. It contains only instructional markdown content and does not perform any sensitive operations, network requests, or code execution. No security issues were detected.

The primary security considerations involve the dynamic execution of project-local scripts and the ingestion of project files as contextual data, which creates a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: tldr-prompt
skills.description_en: Create tldr summaries for GitHub Copilot files (prompts, agents, instructions, collections), MCP servers, or documentation from URLs and queries.

audits.summary: The skill is structurally safe but handles external inputs and workspace files, which introduces a potential surface for indirect prompt injection if the processed content contains adversarial instructions.

skills.name: firecrawl-seo-audit
skills.description_en: Inspect a website's titles, meta descriptions, headings, canonicals, structured data and internal links for on-page and technical SEO issues. Excludes generic SEO explanations, standalone copywriting and functional website testing.

zh.intro: 用 Firecrawl CLI 抓页面源码，查标题、meta 描述、标题层级、图片 alt、内链、canonical、robots 指令和结构化数据，输出带出处的 on-page 与技术上 SEO 问题清单并排优先级。正文把「先拿到 rawHtml 再断言 metadata 缺失」定成硬规矩：抓不到源码就把相关检查标成未验证，而不是拿清洗后的 markdown 当完整源码。

zh.notes: 需要 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY，接受第三方数据条款才能走 provider。抓取报错不等于死链，正文要求二次确认；没有源码支撑的检查一律标未验证。

audits.summary: This skill is designed for SEO auditing and carries a low risk associated with processing external website content. It fetches data from third-party sites, which could theoretically contain instructions designed to influence the AI's audit output.

skills.name: system-design

skills.name: devrel-strategy

skills.name: bmad-prfaq

This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.

audits.summary: The skill automates Figma design system creation by analyzing external codebase files and executing generated scripts via the Figma Plugin API. It is considered low risk due to its inherent dynamic execution model and the potential for indirect prompt injection when processing unvalidated data from codebases.

skills.name: shopify-polaris-app-home
skills.description_en: Build your app's primary user interface embedded in the Shopify admin using the **iframe** model — a web app you host yourself, rendered with `@shopify/polaris-types` and App Bridge. Covers the Intents API (`shopify.intents.invoke`) for launching native workflows from App Home. For the Shopify-hosted `admin.app.home.render` extension target, use **`polaris-admin-extensions`** instead. If the prompt just mentions `Polaris` and you can't tell based off of the context what API they meant, assume they meant this API.

audits.summary: The skill is a deprecation notice informing users that this specific tool is obsolete and providing instructions to migrate to the official Shopify AI toolkit.

skills.name: github-copilot-starter
skills.description_en: Set up complete GitHub Copilot configuration for a new project based on technology stack

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It assists users in setting up GitHub Copilot configurations by retrieving official templates from GitHub's own repository. The generated configuration files and CI workflows follow industry-standard practices.

skills.name: firecrawl-lead-gen
skills.description_en: Find and qualify new prospects with Firecrawl Alexandria people and company data: people by role, seniority, company, industry, size, location or technology, target accounts that match criteria, or the right contacts at companies, returned as a ranked, sourced table or CSV. Also extracts lead lists from a database or directory the user names, and refreshes a prospect list with only new matches. Use when the user wants a lead list, prospects, target accounts or the people to reach out to at companies that fit criteria. Not for enriching people or companies the user already supplied (use firecrawl-lead-research).

zh.intro: 用 Firecrawl 的 Alexandria 人与公司数据搜符合条件的潜客，出一张排过序、每条带出处的表或 CSV：按职位、资历、公司规模、行业、地域、技术栈筛，也能先锁定目标公司再找里面的人。正文强调档案和联系方式只能来自 provider，网络只用来补线索；用户点名某个目录或数据库时先从那儿抽，再补齐缺的字段。
zh.usage: 先 `firecrawl list <provider> --json` 找 provider，再 `firecrawl list <provider> <capability> --pretty` 看它的过滤器契约，按契约只传支持的字段检索，要公司维度就换成公司类目；每条结果读 `data.alexandria[]`，字段含 `fit_reason`。
zh.notes: 需要 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 并接受第三方数据条款；正文禁止用网络结果填 provider 没给的字段，数量没到就顺着分页继续翻。

audits.summary: The skill is designed for lead generation using the Firecrawl browser to extract structured data from websites. The primary security consideration is that the skill processes untrusted content from external web sources, which creates a potential surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: create-llms
skills.description_en: Create an llms.txt file from scratch based on repository structure following the llms.txt specification at https://llmstxt.org/

audits.summary: This skill is designed to create an llms.txt documentation file by analyzing the repository's structure. It is generally safe but carries a minor risk typical of skills that process untrusted repository content.

skills.name: firecrawl-competitive-intel
skills.description_en: Monitor competitor pricing, features, changelogs, dashboards, and product changes with Firecrawl. Use for recurring competitive intelligence, pricing tier extraction, feature change tracking, or structured competitor alerts.

zh.intro: 持续盯竞品的定价页、功能页、更新日志、博客与发布说明，把套餐档位、额度、功能清单和近期改动抽成结构化结果，输出告警、逐家明细、横向量化对比以及后续该盯什么。适合按周或按月重复跑的竞争情报，而不是一次性的泛竞品分析。需要 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY。
zh.usage: 给出竞品名单、关注面 `all/pricing/features/changelog` 和节奏即可；交付按 `# Competitive Intel: [Competitors]` 固定段落，结构化输出含 `generatedAt`、`pricing`、`recentChanges`、`features`。人多时可按每竞品一个研究者并行。
zh.notes: 只能在联系销售才可见的细节要标注，不许猜；登录态仪表盘仅在用户有正当权限时抓取。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates competitive monitoring by scraping external websites such as pricing pages, blogs, and documentation using Firecrawl. While the tool is from a legitimate vendor, the process of ingesting untrusted web content introduces a standard surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: status
skills.description_en: Check running research task status by run ID

zh.intro: 按 run ID 查 Parallel 研究任务还在不在跑。正文只有一条调用：带 run ID 跑 research status 并加 `--json`，拿回 JSON 后再呈现；若本机没有 CLI，则提示用户先运行 parallel-cli 的安装命令。它只回答状态，不负责取回研究结果。
zh.usage: 要看某个研究任务跑到哪一步、是否还在运行，或要轮询状态时用；需要提供 run ID。
zh.notes: 需要 parallel-cli；正文没有额外参数说明，只给了这一条状态查询命令。

audits.summary: The skill is vulnerable to command injection because it directly inserts user-provided arguments into a shell command without sanitization. It also presents an attack surface for indirect prompt injection by processing untrusted input.

skills.name: firecrawl-shop
skills.description_en: Researches products across retailers and review sites with Firecrawl and recommends what to buy within the user's budget and preferences, with current prices and sources. Use when the user wants to compare products, find the best option or check reviews before buying, since prices and models change faster than training data. Adds to a cart only when asked and a signed-in browser profile exists.

zh.intro: 用 Firecrawl 检索电商站点、评测媒体和论坛，把候选商品的型号、价格、卖家、参数与评论信号摊开对比，最后给出在预算和偏好内最值得买的一款，并附上来源链接。只有用户明确要求、且手头有已登录的浏览器配置时才会动购物车，且停在结算之前。需要 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY。
zh.usage: 说清要买什么、预算和偏好即可开跑，产出 `# Shopping Research: [Product]` 结构的报告。要求加购时它会用 Firecrawl browser 打开站点加车，然后停下等你确认，不会自动结账。
zh.notes: 正文要求把联盟、赞助或不可靠来源标出来；API key 缺失时不要声称抓到实时价格。

audits.summary: The skill is designed for product research and shopping assistance. It presents a low security risk due to an indirect prompt injection surface, as it processes untrusted data from external websites and forums to perform shopping tasks.

skills.name: frost-sequence-camera-orbit
skills.description_en: An orbiting camera follows an ice logo as it breaks apart, reforms into two text moments, and fades. HyperFrames block, 1920×1080, 22.5s, 216 variables.

audits.summary: The skill is a professional 3D rendering component for creating ice-themed motion sequences using WebGPU and GSAP. It demonstrates secure coding practices, such as validating asset URLs to prevent unauthorized external requests and using trusted dependencies like Three.js. No malicious patterns, data exfiltration, or prompt injection vectors were detected.

skills.name: cuboid-carousel
skills.description_en: A chain of bevelled cuboids rides a travelling wave as a content carousel. HyperFrames block, 1920×1080, 6.666666666666667s, 40 variables.

audits.summary: The cuboid-carousel skill is a 3D animation block designed for displaying content in a rotating cuboid carousel. It utilizes standard web technologies like Three.js and GSAP. The skill safely processes external JSON data for card content and does not exhibit any malicious patterns or unauthorized access.

skills.name: glass-shard-title
skills.description_en: Glass shards fly in through fog and tile themselves into the headline. HyperFrames block, 1920×1080, 12.16s, 19 variables.

audits.summary: The skill is a 3D motion graphic component that renders a glass shard animation for titles using Three.js. It includes standard assets, fonts, and a build script for bundling its JavaScript source. The skill uses well-known external libraries and vendor-hosted assets. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: canopy-part-title
skills.description_en: Leaves sweep through the frame and part to reveal the headline. HyperFrames block, 1920×1080, 12s, 11 variables.

audits.summary: The skill is a 3D animation block for generating title cards and appears safe to use. It utilizes industry-standard libraries like Three.js and GSAP for graphics and animation, fetching them from well-known content delivery networks. All user-provided variables are validated or clamped to safe ranges.

skills.name: code-slice-hero
skills.description_en: A tiled headline surface flips cell by cell under a sweeping depth field to reveal the rear headline. HyperFrames block, 1920×1080, 8s, 18 variables.

audits.summary: No security issues were detected in this skill. It is a visual composition that uses WebGL 2 and the GSAP library to create a 3D headline flip effect. All external resources originate from the vendor's own infrastructure or are served locally.

skills.name: orbit-card
skills.description_en: A single feature card orbits a dot sphere on approved Blender camera motion. HyperFrames block, 1920×1080, 10s, 4 variables.

audits.summary: The orbit-card skill is a 3D animation component designed to render a feature card orbiting a sphere using Three.js and GSAP. It relies on local assets and animation data exported from Blender. The skill processes user-defined text for card content but lacks any dangerous system capabilities. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: wireframe-portal-title
skills.description_en: A wireframe portal bursts open, the title comes through, then its letters swap into a second phrase. HyperFrames block, 1920×1080, 8s, 9 variables.

audits.summary: The skill is a motion graphics template for HyperFrames that renders a 3D wireframe portal animation. It uses Three.js and GSAP from well-known CDNs and handles user-provided text safely through standard DOM and WebGL methods. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: firecrawl-company-directories
skills.description_en: Extract structured company lists with Firecrawl from any page or site that lists companies: accelerator batches, VC portfolios, member and sponsor lists, marketplaces and app directories, YC, Crunchbase, Product Hunt or G2. Use when the user wants those companies as a CSV, JSON, CRM-ready list or research table, even without an explicit request to scrape.

zh.intro: 把加速器批次、VC 投资组合、会员或赞助商名单、市场与应用目录抽成结构化公司清单，字段包括名称、简介、行业、阶段、成立年份、地点、团队规模、融资、标签、目录页与官网 URL，可直接落成 CSV、JSON 或研究表格。
zh.usage: 给出目录地址、筛选条件和目标条数即可开跑：需要筛选、翻页、无限滚动的目录走 Firecrawl browser，公开静态列表用 scrape 或 map。交付按 `# Company Directory Export: [Source]` 汇总，字段不可见就留空。
zh.notes: 正文要求去重、记录翻页进度，并标注限流、登录墙或验证码造成的缺口；看不见的字段一律不许推断。

audits.summary: This skill is designed to scrape company information from online directories using the Firecrawl service. It functions as intended for a data extraction tool, with all external references pointing to official vendor resources. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: pytest-coverage
skills.description_en: Run pytest tests with coverage, discover lines missing coverage, and increase coverage to 100%.

audits.summary: The skill is a standard developer tool that provides instructions for running pytest and increasing code coverage. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: ai-prompt-engineering-safety-review
skills.description_en: Comprehensive AI prompt engineering safety review and improvement prompt. Analyzes prompts for safety, bias, security vulnerabilities, and effectiveness while providing detailed improvement recommendations with extensive frameworks, testing methodologies, and educational content.

zh.intro: 对一段提示词做安全与质量评审：看它是否容易被绕过、有没有偏见和安全隐患、能不能稳定得到想要的结果，再给出具体改法。评审框架、测试方法和解释写得比较细，适合把提示词当产品资产来管的时候用。
zh.usage: 上线前复核提示词、被注入或越权输出困扰、或者要一份可以拿去讨论的改进清单时用。判断依据是评审对象是提示词文本本身，不是模型参数或应用代码。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。评审项与打分方式以正文为准。

audits.summary: The skill is a prompt template designed to review and improve AI prompts for safety, bias, and security. It contains no executable code, network calls, or security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: flutter-setting-up-on-windows
skills.description_en: Sets up a Windows environment for Flutter development. Use when configuring a Windows machine to run, build, or deploy Flutter applications for Windows desktop or Android.

audits.summary: This skill provides standard instructions for setting up a Flutter development environment on Windows, including SDK installation, IDE configuration, and local certificate generation for application packaging.

skills.name: playwright-generate-test
skills.description_en: Generate a Playwright test based on a scenario using Playwright MCP

zh.intro: 按给定场景用 Playwright MCP 实际操作页面，一步一个工具调用走完流程，再依据消息历史产出基于 @playwright/test 的 TypeScript 测试，写进 tests 目录并执行，调到通过为止。不允许跳过步骤、只凭场景描述就写测试代码。
zh.usage: 先给出场景，没有的话它会反问；随后逐步操作浏览器，最后生成测试文件并运行，失败就继续改到通过。
zh.notes: 正文唯一的硬约束是先执行后写码；测试必须真跑通才算完成。只覆盖 Web 页面。

audits.summary: The skill generates and executes code based on user-provided scenarios. While this is its core function, it creates a potential surface for malicious input to influence the generated code's behavior.

skills.name: rivetkit-client-javascript
skills.description_en: RivetKit JavaScript client guidance. Use for browser, Node.js, or Bun clients that connect to Rivet Actors with rivetkit/client, create clients, call actions, or manage connections.

audits.summary: The skill provides guidance and code examples for the RivetKit JavaScript client. It follows best practices and includes documentation on preventing key injection attacks.

skills.name: architecture
skills.description_en: Create or evaluate an architecture decision record (ADR). Use when choosing between technologies (e.g., Kafka vs SQS), documenting a design decision with trade-offs and consequences, reviewing a system design proposal, or designing a new component from requirements and constraints.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for creating and evaluating architectural designs through template-based instructions. No security considerations were identified during the analysis.

skills.name: legacy-circuit-mockups
skills.description_en: Generate breadboard circuit mockups and visual diagrams using HTML5 Canvas drawing techniques. Use when asked to create circuit layouts, visualize electronic component placements, draw breadboard diagrams, mockup 6502 builds, generate retro computer schematics, or design vintage electronics projects. Supports 555 timers, W65C02S microprocessors, 28C256 EEPROMs, W65C22 VIA chips, 7400-series logic gates, LEDs, resistors, capacitors, switches, buttons, crystals, and wires.

audits.summary: The skill and its associated reference files provide detailed specifications, instructions, and documentation for creating breadboard circuit mockups and working with retro electronics components like the 6502 microprocessor. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access attempts were detected.

skills.name: containerize-aspnetcore
skills.description_en: Containerize an ASP.NET Core project by creating Dockerfile and .dockerfile files customized for the project.

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe but carries a low risk of indirect prompt injection and unintended command execution due to parsing untrusted project configuration files and running local Docker build commands without input boundary markers or sanitization.

skills.name: firecrawl-qa
skills.description_en: Test a live website with Firecrawl browser and write up what's broken: links, forms, mobile layout, performance and console errors. Use for pre-launch checks, bug hunts or confirming a deployed site works.

zh.intro: 拿 Firecrawl 的浏览器把线上站点真点一遍，出一份统一的 QA 报告：链接和导航、表单与交互、内容与视觉、移动端布局、性能和控制台报错都算在内。默认按全量、表单、导航、响应式、性能几条线拆给并行任务，每条发现要带严重级别、URL、描述、证据和复现步骤。
zh.usage: 给个 URL 就能开跑，缺焦点或受保护流程需要凭据时，正文最多问三个问题。报告骨架是固定的，按 Summary、Critical Issues、Major Issues、Minor Issues、Positive Observations、Pages Tested 这几节填就好。
zh.notes: 需要 Firecrawl 浏览器与 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY；正文禁止没有证据就报疑似 bug，要求和复现步骤一起给，并跨测试者去重。

audits.summary: This skill is designed for automated QA testing of websites using Firecrawl services. It is generally safe for its intended use, though it is susceptible to indirect prompt injection because it processes content from untrusted external websites without explicit instruction to disregard embedded commands.

skills.name: financial-statements
skills.description_en: Generate financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) with period-over-period comparison and variance analysis. Use when preparing a monthly or quarterly P&L, closing the books and need to flag material variances, comparing actuals to budget, building a financial summary for leadership review, or looking up GAAP presentation requirements and period-end adjustments.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured template and workflow for generating financial statements and performing variance analysis. It follows standard accounting principles and includes helpful reference formats for GAAP compliance. No security considerations were identified.

skills.name: firecrawl-knowledge-ingest
skills.description_en: Export documentation portals, help centers and API reference sites into local markdown or JSON with Firecrawl browser, including pages that render with JavaScript, hide content behind collapsible navigation or paginate. Use when the user wants a docs site, help center or support knowledge base saved as files, even without an explicit request to scrape.

zh.intro: 用 Firecrawl 浏览器把文档门户、帮助中心、API 参考站抓成本地 markdown 或 JSON，连靠 JS 渲染、折叠导航和翻页才露出来的内容也能拿到。产出带章节统计、页数、失败页清单和来源 URL 的导出报告，适合把知识库落成可检索的本地文件。
zh.usage: 给出站点 URL、输出格式和页数上限即可开跑；正文要求先看导航，再沿侧边栏、下一页、加载更多往下抓，并抽标题、章节、更新时间、作者和标签。公开站点可以用 Firecrawl map 补 URL 清单。
zh.notes: 遇到登录墙、限流或验证码要在报告里写清；正文强调保留代码块和表格、去掉页头页脚，并守住鉴权边界。

audits.summary: This skill ingests documentation from external websites using a browser-based scraping service. The primary security consideration is the potential for indirect prompt injection, where malicious content on a scraped website could attempt to influence the agent's behavior during data processing.

skills.name: apify-ultimate-scraper
skills.description_en: Universal AI-powered web scraper for any platform. Scrape data from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Google Maps, Google Search, Google Trends, Reddit, Airbnb, Yelp, and 15+ more platforms. Use for lead generation, brand monitoring, competitor analysis, influencer discovery, trend research, content analytics, audience analysis, review analysis, SEO intelligence, recruitment, or any data extraction task.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions for orchestrating and interacting with web scrapers (Actors) via the Apify CLI. It provides structured playbooks for different data extraction workflows (B2B lead generation, brand monitoring, social media analytics, etc.) and contains standard guidelines on configuration, parameter passing, and error handling. No malicious behaviors, obfuscation techniques, or hidden actions were detected.

skills.name: chat-sdk
skills.description_en: Build multi-platform chat bots with Chat SDK (`chat` npm package). Use when developers want to scaffold a bot with create-chat-sdk, build a Slack, Teams, Google Chat, Discord, Telegram, GitHub, Linear, or WhatsApp bot, handle mentions, direct messages, subscribed threads, reactions, slash commands, cards, modals, files, or AI streaming, set up webhook routes or multi-adapter bots, send rich cards or streamed AI responses to chat platforms, or build a custom adapter or state adapter.

audits.summary: This skill provides a unified SDK for building chat bots across various platforms, referencing documentation, templates, and guides. It includes some security considerations such as external package installation and local data ingestion. These patterns are standard for developer tools and are used within the skill's intended functionality.

skills.name: firecrawl-demo-walkthrough
skills.description_en: Walk through a product's key flows with Firecrawl browser and produce a structured UX/product walkthrough. Use for signup, onboarding, pricing, docs, dashboard, product demo prep, UX teardown, and first-run experience analysis.

zh.intro: 用 Firecrawl 浏览器把产品关键流程一步步走一遍并记录：首页与营销页、注册与引导、定价与套餐、文档与开发者体验、仪表盘与核心功能、帮助与支持。产出按流程分节的走查报告，写清每屏出现什么、能做什么，再单列第一印象、亮点、摩擦点和改进建议。
zh.usage: 给出产品 URL 和关注面 `full/signup/pricing/docs/dashboard` 即可开跑；正文建议按流程拆给多个并行研究者，每人回报访问过的页面、执行的动作、观察、摩擦与来源 URL。
zh.notes: 没有明确授权时不许提交真实凭证、下单或做不可逆操作；正文要求把观察和主观评价分开写。

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe but carries a low risk of indirect prompt injection because it is designed to ingest and process untrusted content from external websites.

skills.name: shopify-customer
skills.description_en: Write and validate GraphQL operations for developers integrating Shopify's Customer Account API. Generates code for Customer Account API integrations.

audits.summary: This skill is authored by Shopify and provides tools for writing and validating GraphQL operations for the Customer Account API. It includes search and validation scripts that communicate with Shopify's official domains. The skill features a telemetry system that reports usage metrics and user prompts to the vendor to improve the product; this behavior is clearly disclosed in the privacy notices and uses vendor-controlled endpoints. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: image-manipulation-image-magick
skills.description_en: Process and manipulate images using ImageMagick. Supports resizing, format conversion, batch processing, and retrieving image metadata. Use when working with images, creating thumbnails, resizing wallpapers, or performing batch image operations.

audits.summary: This skill provides standard templates and best practices for manipulating images using the ImageMagick 'magick' utility. It includes cross-platform examples and emphasizes security best practices like path quoting to prevent command injection.

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.description_en: Build, modify, debug, migrate, review, or verify TypeScript MCP servers and MCP Apps with mcp-use. Use for tools, resources, prompts, middleware, Views, authentication, Skills over MCP, scaffolding, and advanced features.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive instructions for building and managing TypeScript MCP servers with the mcp-use framework. It is safe for its intended development purpose, with its only noted risk being the inherent potential for indirect prompt injection through the analysis of project-specific files like package.json and source code.

skills.name: bmad-correct-course
skills.description_en: Assess the impact of a significant change during sprint execution across the PRD, epics, architecture, and UX documents, and produce a sprint change proposal. Use when the user says "correct course" or "propose sprint change"

audits.summary: The skill manages sprint changes by analyzing project documents and generating structured proposals. It uses local scripts for configuration management and installs a vendor-related skill if missing. While it processes external project documents and executes config-based instructions, these activities are consistent with its primary purpose and involve vendor-owned resources.

skills.name: mapbox-style-patterns
skills.description_en: Common style patterns, layer configurations, and recipes for typical mapping scenarios including restaurant finders, real estate, data visualization, navigation, delivery/logistics, and more. Use when implementing specific map use cases or looking for proven style patterns.

audits.summary: This skill provides Mapbox map style patterns and configuration recipes. No security vulnerabilities, malicious code, or suspicious behaviors were detected. All external resource references are standard Mapbox vendor services.

skills.name: earth2studio-create-diagnostic
skills.description_en: Create Earth2Studio diagnostic model wrappers for single-step data transformations, including simple derived diagnostics, packaged AutoModel diagnostics, and generative or diffusion diagnostics. Do NOT use for prognostic time-stepping models, data sources, or installation.

audits.summary: The skill provides a development workflow and code templates for creating Earth-2 Studio diagnostic models. It includes instructions for dependency management, model loading from trusted registries such as HuggingFace and NVIDIA NGC, and standardized testing using the uv tool. No malicious patterns, data exfiltration, or obfuscation were detected.

skills.name: apple-appstore-reviewer
skills.description_en: Serves as a reviewer of the codebase with instructions on looking for Apple App Store optimizations or rejection reasons.

zh.intro: 站在 App Store 审核员的角度审一遍 iOS 工程的源码与元数据，第一轮不改代码，只输出按优先级排的拒审风险和上架优化建议。正文要求把结论对到审核指南的类别上，检查 Info.plist、entitlements、隐私清单、StoreKit 配置、引导流程和付费墙。
zh.usage: 提审前想降低被拒概率、或刚被拒要找原因时用它；正文要求联网核对指南原文，不凭记忆引用条款。
