Do NOT use for TAM/SAM/SOM sizing (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-market-sizing) or account fit scoring (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-account-segmentation).

zh.intro: 在销售负责人层面定理想客户画像：企业规模、技术栈、行为、意向四类标准，配一张带权重的打分表、明确的排除条件和刷新周期。有成交/丢单数据时从数据走，成交笔数少于约 20 就先用创始人访谈做假设版；B2B 账户和 B2C 的人群/心理画像都覆盖。做法是先访谈（每轮只问一个问题，能读官网、产品文档或 CRM 导出就先起草 v1 让人改），按成交笔数选分支，再产出标准与评分表；分群、分层、市场测算不在这里做。
zh.usage: 说「定义我们的 ICP」或「销售什么客户都追」，它会先问成交笔数等一两个问题，再给标准、权重和排除条件；有官网或 CRM 导出可以先让它起草再改。
zh.notes: 15 笔成交上跑出来的评分表只是猜想的表格化，数据薄的阶段会先给假设版并说明依据；进入新市场要单独建一份 ICP，不能把现有 ICP 放宽了凑。

audits.summary: The sales-icp-definition skill provides structured instructions and reference materials for sales leadership to define an Ideal Customer Profile. It contains no executable code, external dependencies, or security risks.

skills.name: fluentui-blazor
skills.description_en: Guide for using the Microsoft Fluent UI Blazor component library (Microsoft.FluentUI.AspNetCore.Components NuGet package) in Blazor applications. Use this when the user is building a Blazor app with Fluent UI components, setting up the library, using FluentUI components like FluentButton, FluentDataGrid, FluentDialog, FluentToast, FluentNavMenu, FluentTextField, FluentSelect, FluentAutocomplete, FluentDesignTheme, or any component prefixed with "Fluent". Also use when troubleshooting missing providers, JS interop issues, or theming.

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate guide for Microsoft's Fluent UI Blazor component library. It provides detailed documentation on setup, configuration, and usage of various UI components without any malicious patterns.

skills.name: sales-market-sizing
skills.description_en: Estimates TAM, SAM, and SOM for a market or sub-segment to ground sales capacity, territory, and quota planning - top-down, bottom-up on named accounts or population math, value theory, triangulation, a capacity-based SOM ceiling, and a per-layer refresh cadence. A macro planning exercise for sales leadership and RevOps, covering B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user mentions TAM, SAM, SOM, market size, addressable market, "how big is this market", or the number behind next year's quota, even without those acronyms. Sizes for planning, not pitching. Do NOT use for defining the ICP (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-icp-definition) or turning SOM into quotas (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting).

zh.intro: 算 TAM/SAM/SOM 来支撑销售容量、区域和配额：TAM 自下而上按具名账户或人群数量乘单价建，SAM 用 GTM 实际能用的过滤条件收窄，SOM 再用团队真实产能封顶，然后和自上而下的数字三角验证，每层定各自的刷新周期。ICP 一变就强制重算 SOM，TAM 和 SAM 除非定价、产品或打包也动了才跟着动。用来做规划，不是拿去融资讲故事。
zh.usage: 给出产品、定价和目标细分，让它做一次自下而上的 TAM/SAM/SOM；如果只是董事会要个数，会先给一个标注为背景的量级，再排完整的三角验证。
zh.notes: 不负责定义 ICP，也不把 SOM 换算成编制和配额；临时给董事会的量级不能直接进入配额和区域规划。

audits.summary: The skill is functional for sales market sizing but lacks security boundaries for processing untrusted external data, making it theoretically susceptible to indirect prompt injection from sources like CRM exports or web search results.

skills.name: parallel-monitor
skills.description_en: Continuously track the web for changes on a recurring cadence. Use when the user asks to 'monitor', 'track changes to', 'watch', or 'alert me when' something on the web changes — e.g., 'Track price changes for iPhone 16', 'Alert me when Tesla files a new 8-K', 'Monitor competitor pricing pages weekly'. Also use to list, inspect, update, or stop existing monitors, including requests to delete them.

audits.summary: This skill provides a legitimate interface for managing web monitors using the parallel-cli tool. It enables users to track web changes, list active monitors, and receive alerts. All identified security considerations, such as network delivery via webhooks and processing of external web data, are standard features aligned with the skill's intended purpose.

skills.name: sales-radar
skills.description_en: Builds and maintains a personalized watch list of sales information sources - podcasts, newsletters, communities, benchmark reports, and sales people to follow - matched to the user's role, market, and time budget, shipped as a dated verified-source snapshot with per-source status and a freshness check that catches rebranded or dead sources. Covers B2B SaaS and B2C high-ticket as separate ecosystems. Use whenever the user mentions sales newsletters, sales podcasts, who to follow in sales, sales communities, staying current in sales, or refreshing a reading list, even without the word radar. Do NOT use for career or interview prep (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-career).

zh.intro: 按角色、市场和每周能花的时间，给一份带链接的销售信息源清单：该跟的人、播客、newsletter、社群、基准报告，交付时带快照日期和每个源的状态。B2B SaaS 和 B2C 高客单被当成两个生态分开做——前者在 LinkedIn、Slack 社群、Substack，后者在 YouTube、Facebook 群和付费教练漏斗——不把一个生态的清单换个标签给另一个。还带新鲜度检查，能发现改名或已经停掉的源，正文给了一批已核验的 B2B 源作起点。
zh.usage: 说「给我几个销售播客」或「怎么跟上销售行业」，它会先问角色、市场和每周时间预算，再出一份带日期的核验清单。
zh.notes: 清单里的链接有时效，交付时看快照日期；只做信息源，不做职业规划或面试准备。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive sales resource curator that utilizes static reference files and controlled user interviews to provide tailored recommendations. It incorporates robust verification procedures and displays high awareness of common industry risks such as brand migration and promotional bias. No security issues or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: sales-career
skills.description_en: Coach one person through landing and growing a sales career - SDR/BDR entry, SDR-to-AE promotion, and beyond - across B2B SaaS and commission-heavy B2C (real estate, insurance, solar, auto). Covers sales interview prep (mock cold call, sell-me-this-pen, candidate-authored 30-60-90 plan), quantified track-record evidence, sales skill-gap roadmaps, employer diligence, and sales offer evaluation from the candidate's seat, anchored to dated benchmarks (Bridge Group, RepVue, NAR). Use for "sales career", "break into tech sales", "sdr interview prep", "sdr to ae path", "evaluate this sales offer". Does not cover the hiring side (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-hiring), job searching or auto-applying, resume file generation, or deal execution tactics.

zh.intro: 站在候选人一侧：从进第一份 SDR/BDR，到转 AE，再到之后的路径（管理、CSM、RevOps、能力建设），B2B SaaS 和佣金制高客单 B2C（房产、保险、光伏、汽车）都覆盖。内容包括冷呼模拟、卖笔题、自己写的 30-60-90 计划、把业绩量化成证据、技能差路线图、对雇主的尽调，以及从候选人角度评估 offer；建议都挂到有日期的基准上（RepVue、Bridge Group、NAR）或用户给的事实。只做策略，不代找工作也不生成简历。
zh.usage: 说「想进科技销售」「SDR 面试怎么准备」或「这个 offer 值不值」，它会先问你现在的位置和目标市场，再逐步给方案，不直接甩一份成品计划。
zh.notes: 每套排序都是默认值不是定律，会随本地人脉、技术背景、执照属地、存款跑道重新排；不覆盖用人方视角、自动投递和成交战术。

audits.summary: The skill provides structured guidance for sales career development, including interview prep and offer evaluation. It identifies a low-severity risk of indirect prompt injection because the agent processes user-provided resume bullets and interview responses without explicit boundary markers, though the skill includes procedural audits to validate this data.

skills.name: mkdocs-translations
skills.description_en: Generate a language translation for a mkdocs documentation stack.

audits.summary: The skill is structured to automate documentation translations and is generally safe, but it contains an indirect prompt injection attack surface since it processes external markdown documentation without isolation barriers.

skills.name: copilot-cli-quickstart
skills.description_en: Use this skill when someone wants to learn GitHub Copilot CLI from scratch. Offers interactive step-by-step tutorials with separate Developer and Non-Developer tracks, plus on-demand Q&A. Just say "start tutorial" or ask a question! Note: This skill targets GitHub Copilot CLI specifically and uses CLI-specific tools (ask_user, sql, fetch_copilot_cli_documentation).

audits.summary: The skill is an interactive tutorial designed to help users learn the GitHub Copilot CLI. It uses a local SQL database to track user progress and provides guidance for both developers and non-developers. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access were detected.

skills.name: react18-legacy-context
skills.description_en: Provides the complete migration pattern for React legacy context API (contextTypes, childContextTypes, getChildContext) to the modern createContext API. Use this skill whenever migrating legacy context in class components - this is always a cross-file migration requiring the provider AND all consumers to be updated together. Use it before touching any contextTypes or childContextTypes code, because migrating only the provider without the consumers (or vice versa) will cause a runtime failure. Always read this skill before writing any context migration - the cross-file coordination steps here prevent the most common context migration bugs.

audits.summary: The skill is a developer-focused migration guide for React applications. It provides instructions, templates, and static analysis commands to help developers move from legacy context APIs to modern React patterns. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: sales-outreach-personalization
skills.description_en: Turns prospect signals into 2-3 ranked personalization angles for outreach, each pairing a dated, sourced signal with the problem it implies, a one-line hook, the ask it justifies, and a confidence/recency label. Covers B2B and B2C signals and 1:1 vs 1:few vs 1:many effort tiers, and never invents a signal. Use whenever the user mentions personalization, a trigger event, a funding round, a new hire or job change, a product launch, review mining, or "find a reason to reach out", even without the word personalize. Do NOT use for drafting the message - subject lines (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-subject-line-tester), openers (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-call-opener), and cadence (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence) live elsewhere.

zh.intro: 把线索身上的信号变成 2–3 个排好序的搭话理由，每个理由都配日期、来源、它暗示的问题、一句钩子、能顺势提出的请求，以及可信度和新鲜度标注。可用的信号包括融资与财务、换岗与空降、招聘、产品发布、工具更换、对方写的内容或演讲、社区与评价里的抱怨、共同联系人；消费者侧则是购买、浏览、生命周期和忠诚事件。分 1:1 战略客户、1:few 细分、1:many 批量三档投入。
zh.usage: 列出线索信号及其来源和日期，让它排出可用的切入角度，并标出哪条证据最弱、该补什么。
zh.notes: 只给理由和一句钩子，不写正文、标题、电话开场和节奏，那些在同系列别的技能里；硬规则是不许编信号，编出来的比没有角度更糟。

audits.summary: The skill is a sales personalization tool that processes prospect signals to generate outreach angles. The primary security consideration is the ingestion of untrusted external data from users and web sources, which creates a surface for indirect prompt injection, although the skill lacks dangerous execution capabilities.

skills.name: sales-call-review
skills.description_en: Scores one sales call transcript against an anchored rubric - opener, discovery, objection handling, close - quoting the transcript for every judgement and naming one focus behaviour. Handles messy ASR transcripts, missing speaker labels, and partial calls, covering B2B deal calls and B2C/inside-sales QA, rep self-review and manager tape review. Use whenever the user mentions a call recording, transcript, Gong or Chorus review, tape review, call scoring, or "how did this call go", even without the word review. Do NOT use for writing the follow-up email (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-meeting-recap) or scoring the deal itself (mbfinotti/sales-skills@meddpicc-scorecard).

zh.intro: 拿一通销售电话的转录，按开场、需求挖掘、异议处理、收尾四段打分，每条判断都引转录原文支撑，反馈项收在有限几条内，最前面只放一个下次要改的行为。能处理语音识别出来的错字、缺说话人标签和只录到一半的电话；B2C 和高频外呼场景可加合规与话术遵循维度。全程区分独立测量和厂商自述的平台相关性数据，不把相关性说成因果。
zh.usage: 粘上转录并说明是本人自评还是主管评、属于哪类电话，让它逐段引原文打分并给一个聚焦改进项。
zh.notes: 不写跟进邮件、不评商机质量、不排季度计划，通话结果只当背景不参与打分；上次定过的改进项会先被检查有没有变化。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional sales call review tool that scores transcripts against an evidence-based rubric. It includes robust instructions for handling messy transcripts, verifying evidence through verbatim quotes, and limiting feedback to avoid overwhelming the user. The skill does not contain any malicious code, external dependencies, or dangerous system commands. A minor potential for indirect prompt injection exists due to the processing of external transcripts, but this is mitigated by the skill's strict citation requirements and lack of high-privilege capabilities.

skills.name: fabric-lakehouse
skills.description_en: Use this skill to get context about Fabric Lakehouse and its features for software systems and AI-powered functions. It offers descriptions of Lakehouse data components, organization with schemas and shortcuts, access control, and code examples. This skill supports users in designing, building, and optimizing Lakehouse solutions using best practices.

audits.summary: This skill provides technical guidance and PySpark code templates for managing Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse environments. It covers data ingestion, optimization, and security best practices without any detected malicious behavior.

skills.name: folder-structure-blueprint-generator
skills.description_en: Comprehensive technology-agnostic prompt for analyzing and documenting project folder structures. Auto-detects project types (.NET, Java, React, Angular, Python, Node.js, Flutter), generates detailed blueprints with visualization options, naming conventions, file placement patterns, and extension templates for maintaining consistent code organization across diverse technology stacks.

audits.summary: This skill is a prompt template designed to analyze and document project folder structures. It performs static analysis of local files and directories to generate a blueprint document and does not contain any malicious code, network operations, or obfuscation.

skills.name: az-cost-optimize
skills.description_en: Analyze Azure resources used in the app (IaC files and/or resources in a target rg) and optimize costs - creating GitHub issues for identified optimizations.

audits.summary: The skill analyzes Azure infrastructure and usage data to recommend cost optimizations, which are then posted as GitHub issues. It uses standard Azure and GitHub management tools and includes a mandatory human-in-the-loop confirmation step before creating issues. A potential surface for indirect prompt injection exists through the processing of untrusted IaC files and resource metadata.

skills.name: csharp-async
skills.description_en: Get best practices for C# async programming

audits.summary: The skill provides a set of best practices and guidelines for C# asynchronous programming. No malicious code, prompt injections, or security vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: cuopt-server-api-python
skills.description_en: cuOpt REST server — start server, endpoints, Python/curl client examples. Use when the user is deploying or calling the REST API.

audits.summary: The skill provides a Python client for the NVIDIA cuOpt optimization server. It is generally safe but includes minor security concerns such as the recommendation of mutable Docker tags and the use of unauthenticated network communication, both of which are documented with appropriate mitigations.

skills.name: deal-champion-mapping
skills.description_en: Builds an evidence-graded stakeholder map for one active deal from titles, call notes, email and meeting activity, and CRM contact roles, naming the likely champion, economic buyer, and blockers, each with a confidence level tied to observed behaviour rather than title. Covers B2B buying committees and high-consideration B2C households. Use whenever the user mentions a champion, economic buyer, power map, deal org chart, multi-threading, single-threaded risk, or "who actually decides", even without the word stakeholder. Do NOT use for qualification scoring (mbfinotti/sales-skills@meddpicc-scorecard) or scanning notes for general risk (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-red-flags).

zh.intro: 从一个商机已有的材料画出决策链：职位名单、通话笔记、邮件与会议往来、CRM 联系人角色，据此判断谁像真拥护者、谁是掏钱的人、谁在挡，每个人的判断都按证据强度分级而不是按头衔。会写明哪些角色还没被验证，并给每个待证角色配一个能证实或证伪的下一步动作；产品碰到客户数据时，默认存在一个可能事后否决的安全审查人。
zh.usage: 给联系人和往来记录，让它标出拥护者、决策人和阻力方，并说明每个判断的证据强度。
zh.notes: 只认人不评商机分数，也不扫笔记找一般性风险；头衔不等于影响力，证据不足的角色会标成待验证。角色定义取自 MEDDICC 和 Challenger 的说法，但它不按缩写给商机打分。

audits.summary: The 'deal-champion-mapping' skill is a tool for building stakeholder maps from sales data. It does not contain any malicious code, obfuscation, or credentials. The only identified risk is the potential for indirect prompt injection due to the processing of untrusted external data such as call notes and email activity.

skills.name: cold-call-opener
skills.description_en: Writes the opening 5-30 seconds of a live outbound cold call - a tailored opener for a named persona and pain point, with 2-3 testable variants, delivery notes, and a measurement plan. Covers B2B and B2C phone outreach, including do-not-call scrubbing. Use whenever the user mentions a cold call opener, cold call script, phone opener, dialer talk track, "what do I say when they pick up", or opening a call for a persona, even if they don't say "opener" explicitly. Do NOT use for rebuttals later in the call (use mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling), grading a recorded call (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review), or cadence planning (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence).

audits.summary: The 'cold-call-opener' skill is a professional tool designed to help sales teams draft effective and legally compliant cold call scripts. It incorporates industry research from Gong and Cognism and includes rigorous checks for B2C regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions. No security issues or malicious patterns were identified during the analysis.

skills.name: deal-red-flags
skills.description_en: Reviews one deal's free-text notes - call notes, opportunity fields, CRM activity log, email threads - for qualification red flags such as single-threaded deal, no champion, no compelling event, unverified budget, no agreed next step, or fading engagement, each graded on severity and confidence with the quoted note fragment behind it. Covers B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user mentions deal risk, a stalled or slipping deal, ghosting, forecast inspection, or "is this deal real", even without the words red flag. Reviews one deal, not a pipeline export. Do NOT use for structured qualification scoring (mbfinotti/sales-skills@meddpicc-scorecard) or stakeholder mapping (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-champion-mapping).

zh.intro: 只读一个商机的自由文本记录——通话笔记、机会字段、CRM 活动日志、邮件往来——把单线程推进、没有拥护者、缺紧迫事件、预算没核实、没有约定的下一步、互动在变冷这些风险挑出来。每条风险在严重度和证据置信度两条独立的轴上分别标，且必须引原文片段支撑；证据不足一律判为「未知」，并直接转成下一通电话该问的那句问题。
zh.usage: 粘一个商机的笔记和活动记录，让它列风险、附证据片段，并给出该补问的那一个问题。
zh.notes: 一次只审一个商机，不做结构化资质打分，也不画决策链；笔记没写不等于有问题，它会标成未知而不是风险，同时检查能洗清这条风险的证据。

audits.summary: The skill is a sales deal analysis tool designed to identify qualification risks from text notes. It functions through text processing and logic within the agent environment, without network activity, external dependencies, or dangerous command execution.

skills.name: project-workflow-analysis-blueprint-generator
skills.description_en: Comprehensive technology-agnostic prompt generator for documenting end-to-end application workflows. Automatically detects project architecture patterns, technology stacks, and data flow patterns to generate detailed implementation blueprints covering entry points, service layers, data access, error handling, and testing approaches across multiple technologies including .NET, Java/Spring, React, and microservices architectures.

audits.summary: The skill provides a template for documenting software codebases. While functional and devoid of direct malicious code, it creates a surface for indirect prompt injection because it instructs an agent to ingest and summarize untrusted source code which could contain malicious instructions designed to influence the agent's behavior.

skills.name: microsoft-docs
skills.description_en: Query official Microsoft documentation to find concepts, tutorials, and code examples across Azure, .NET, Agent Framework, Aspire, VS Code, GitHub, and more. Uses Microsoft Learn MCP as the default, with Context7 and Aspire MCP for content that lives outside learn.microsoft.com.

audits.summary: This skill facilitates searching and retrieving technical documentation from the Microsoft ecosystem, including Azure, .NET, GitHub, and VS Code. It utilizes official Microsoft CLI tools and MCP servers. All external references and downloads target trusted domains.

skills.name: transloadit-media-processing
skills.description_en: Process media files (video, audio, images, documents) using Transloadit. Use when asked to encode video to HLS/MP4, generate thumbnails, resize or watermark images, extract audio, concatenate clips, add subtitles, OCR documents, or run any media processing pipeline. Covers 86+ processing robots for file transformation at scale.

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions and configuration for using Transloadit's official media processing tools. It uses standard placeholders for API credentials and downloads packages from a well-known service. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: mcp-copilot-studio-server-generator
skills.description_en: Generate a complete MCP server implementation optimized for Copilot Studio integration with proper schema constraints and streamable HTTP support

audits.summary: This skill functions as a code generation template for building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers integrated with Microsoft Copilot Studio. It provides structural and schema guidance for developers but does not include any executable code or instructions that pose a security risk.

skills.name: dataverse-python-production-code
skills.description_en: Generate production-ready Python code using Dataverse SDK with error handling, optimization, and best practices

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines and templates for generating production-ready Python code for Microsoft Dataverse. It encourages security and stability best practices such as structured error handling, retry logic, and logging. No malicious code or exfiltration patterns were detected.

skills.name: cuopt-user-rules
skills.description_en: Base rules for end users calling NVIDIA cuOpt (routing/LP/MILP/QP/install/server). Not for cuOpt internals — use cuopt-developer for those.

audits.summary: The cuopt-user-rules skill provides safety-focused guidelines for agents assisting users with NVIDIA cuOpt. It explicitly prohibits privileged operations like sudo, mandates user consent before command execution or package installation, and establishes rigorous verification steps for problem formulation and environment setup. All external resources are hosted on official NVIDIA domains or repositories.

skills.name: create-viz
skills.description_en: Create publication-quality visualizations with Python. Use when turning query results or a DataFrame into a chart, selecting the right chart type for a trend or comparison, generating a plot for a report or presentation, or needing an interactive chart with hover and zoom.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured workflow for generating data visualizations using Python. It includes standard practices for data cleaning, chart selection, and professional design, using well-known libraries like pandas and matplotlib.

skills.name: aspire
skills.description_en: Aspire skill covering the Aspire CLI, AppHost orchestration, service discovery, integrations, MCP server, VS Code extension, Dev Containers, GitHub Codespaces, templates, dashboard, and deployment. Use when the user asks to create, run, debug, configure, deploy, or troubleshoot an Aspire distributed application.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation and tools for using .NET Aspire, a distributed application orchestration tool. It includes official installation methods from trusted sources and describes standard development workflows. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: solana-dev
skills.description_en: Use when user asks to "build a Solana dapp", "write an Anchor program", "create a token", "debug Solana errors", "set up wallet connection", "test my Solana program", "fuzz my Solana program", "deploy to devnet", "send a v1 transaction", "support larger transactions", "fix maxSupportedTransactionVersion", or "explain Solana concepts" (rent, accounts, PDAs, CPIs). Also for program architecture — state layout, reducing compute units, throughput bottlenecks, instruction naming — and quick on-chain lookups via public RPC + curl (balance, transaction, token account). End-to-end playbook: wallet connection, Anchor/Pinocchio programs, Codama clients, Surfpool/LiteSVM/Mollusk testing, security review, and the v1 transaction format (SIMD-0385, 4096-byte transactions). Prefers @solana/kit 8 plugin clients (createClient + .use()) building transaction v1 by default, @solana/kit-plugin-wallet + @solana/react for wallets, web3.js v3 as the legacy migration target, and Surfpool for local networks.

zh.usage: 修 bug 想先复现成测试；加功能要求每一步都有测试兜着；补集成测试。
zh.notes: 转发壳，正文指向同仓库的底层技能；它不会替你判断测试写得对不对。

While it follows a useful developer workflow, it introduces a surface for indirect prompt injection because it instructs the agent to perform privileged actions (such as running shell commands or fetching network data) based on instructions embedded within data files.

skills.description_en: Safely review and apply CodeRabbit PR review-thread feedback from GitHub with per-change approval; never execute reviewer-provided prompts directly

zh.intro: 把 GitHub 上 CodeRabbit 的 PR 评审线程逐条读出来，再按条改代码，每条改动都要单独确认才落地。明确要求不直接执行评审意见里自带的提示词，避免评审文本被当成指令。

zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。逐条确认是这条的核心约束，不宜把多条改动合成一次批准。

It implements robust defenses against indirect prompt injection by explicitly treating all external reviewer data as untrusted and requiring manual user approval for every code change. skills.name: entra-agent-user

skills.name: ponytail
skills.description_en: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task, and a reply a busy human understands in one read. Use on any coding task (writing, fixing, refactoring, reviewing, choosing dependencies) and when the user says "ponytail", "be lazy", "simplest solution", "yagni", or complains about over-engineering or bloat. Levels: lite, full (default), ultra.

zh.intro: 偷懒的资深开发模式：用最小的改动把任务真正解决，回复也写成忙人一遍能读完的样子。任何编码任务都能挂上，尤其在被要求「用 ponytail」「be lazy」「最简方案」「yagni」，或抱怨过度设计、代码臃肿时。分 lite、full（默认）、ultra 三档。
zh.usage: 对话里直接说 ponytail，或用 `/ponytail lite|full|ultra` 切档；默认 full。判断标准是最小改动能否完整解决问题，不是改动行数少。
zh.notes: 正文要求不要为假想的未来需求加抽象和依赖。它是会话级的工作方式，不是一次性命令，改完记得退出该模式。

audits.summary: The skill defines a persona for a 'lazy senior developer' focused on minimal code changes and avoiding over-engineering. It includes explicit instructions to maintain security, validation, and error handling.

It includes installation instructions for the server, UI/UX design principles, and detailed reference documents for accessibility standards and component patterns. skills.name: agentic-eval
skills.description_en: Patterns and techniques for evaluating and improving AI agent outputs. Use this skill when: - Implementing self-critique and reflection loops - Building evaluator-optimizer pipelines for quality-critical generation - Creating test-driven code refinement workflows - Designing rubric-based or LLM-as-judge evaluation systems - Adding iterative improvement to agent outputs (code, reports, analysis) - Measuring and improving agent response quality

zh.intro: 评估和改进 AI 代理输出的模式集：自我批评与反思循环、评估者加优化器的流水线、测试驱动的代码细化、评分标准与模型评审，以及给输出加迭代改进。适合需要量化回答质量，或给生成流程加一道自动把关的时候。
zh.usage: 要给代理输出定评分标准、搭自动评审，或加一轮自我修正时用它；先定评价维度，再选评审方式。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体模式以正文为准；正文把评估与改进分成两段，覆盖代码、报告和分析类产出。

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It provides conceptual architectural patterns and code templates for agentic evaluation, self-critique, and reflection workflows without containing any executable code or security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: update-avm-modules-in-bicep
skills.description_en: Update Azure Verified Modules (AVM) to latest versions in Bicep files.

audits.summary: The skill automates the process of updating Azure Verified Modules in Bicep files using official Microsoft resources. It is assessed as safe, with identified behaviors consistent with its primary purpose of code management and validation.

skills.name: waapi
skills.description_en: Web Animations API adapter patterns for HyperFrames. Use when authoring element.animate() motion, Animation currentTime seeking, document.getAnimations(), KeyframeEffect timing, fill modes, or native browser animations that must render deterministically in HyperFrames.

zh.intro: HyperFrames 里用 Web Animations API 做动画的适配方式：不引入 GSAP，直接拿浏览器原生关键帧加 JavaScript 造的时间控制。写 element.animate() 的动画、要用动画的 currentTime 定位、或用 document.getAnimations() 遍历时用，目标是让原生动画在渲染里按给定时间确定性呈现。
zh.usage: 契约：动画在合成初始化时同步创建，`element.animate(...)` 的 duration 和 iterations 都取有限值，`fill: "both"` 让 seek 后的状态保留，创建后暂停或交给适配层在第一次 seek 时暂停。适配层会调 `document.getAnimations()`，把每个动画的 currentTime 设成 HyperFrames 的毫秒时间再暂停。
zh.notes: 渲染关键路径上不要用回调和 promise 决定状态。正文的例子是一个带 data-start、data-duration、data-track-index 的 div 元素。

audits.summary: The skill provides patterns and best practices for using the Web Animations API (WAAPI) within the HyperFrames framework. It contains documentation, code examples, and standard developer validation commands. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: power-apps-code-app-scaffold
skills.description_en: Scaffold a complete Power Apps Code App project with PAC CLI setup, SDK integration, and connector configuration

audits.summary: This skill is a development tool for scaffolding Microsoft Power Apps Code App projects. It uses official Microsoft tools and adheres to documented development practices. No malicious behavior or high-risk patterns were identified.

skills.description_en: Optimize the performance of your Flutter app

zh.intro: 让 agent 退一步，给更大范围的上下文或更高层的视角，用在看不懂某段代码、或不清楚它在大局里处在哪的时候。flags 标了 thin_body，正文极短。装量 21.9 万，8 周涨 57.1%，三家审计 pass。

audits.summary: This skill provides a prompt to help the agent explain the architecture of a codebase. It contains no executable code, external dependencies, or dangerous instructions.

skills.name: revops-kickoff
skills.description_en: Before starting any RevOps or Sales Ops task, and at the start of every session on an ongoing RevOps project, run this first - it routes the task to exactly one skill of the revops-skills collection or says plainly that none fits, and bootstraps or resumes the project's shared, versioned context artifact so the next session starts warm instead of cold, ending in a short-list plus an ordered skill chain. Run it even when the collection's other skills are already used daily - a new project is a new context. Also use whenever the user mentions a revops kickoff, a new RevOps project, a revops project start, revops or crm skill routing, a periodic RevOps check-in, a recurring RevOps review, "which revops skill do I need", or "where do I start with RevOps" - even if they never name a skill, and even if the request looks like it already belongs to one specific skill. Do NOT use for routing quota-carrying sales tasks - use mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-kickoff instead.

zh.intro: revops-skills 那套 20 个技能的统一入口：把当前任务指到一个具体技能上，或者直接说没有合适的；同时初始化或续上项目里版本化的 revops-context.md，让下一次开会话不用从头问。判断冷启动还是热启动只看这个文件在不在，不靠猜。
zh.usage: 每个 RevOps 项目开头，或定期复盘时先跑它；它会先读 git 日志、清点已有文档和可用的连接器，再给候选清单和一条有序的技能链。
zh.notes: 新项目即使天天用着同一套技能也要重跑，因为换了项目就换了上下文。带配额的销售任务不在范围内，走 sales-kickoff。

It automates context tracking through a dedicated artifact and handles session initialization by reading local project data like git logs and documentation. The analysis identified potential risks related to indirect prompt injection from reading untrusted project files and instruction generation for future sessions.

skills.name: bmad-build
skills.description_en: Turns implementation work into working code, reviewed and verified. Use when the user delegates a feature, story, bug fix, or meaningful change; a bare story or issue link counts. Skip obvious, low-risk mechanical maintenance such as small ignore-file, typo-only, formatting-only, or configuration-hygiene edits. Explicit BMAD requests always qualify. Do not volunteer for user-directed interactive edits or version-control operations that only record existing work.

zh.intro: 把委派下来的功能、故事、修 bug 或其它有意义的改动，落成经过评审和验证的代码。只改 ignore 文件、错字、格式化之类的低风险杂活可以跳过；明确点名 BMAD 的请求则一律算数。
zh.usage: 在含 `_bmad/` 的项目根目录执行一次正文给出的 `uv run` 渲染命令；输出里写明 HALT 就按原因停下，脚本不存在说明项目还没初始化 BMad，改用 bmad 技能先装。
zh.notes: 正文强调命令只跑一次、不要切工作目录；点名 route 或 review 时用附加参数传入，不要直接跑工作流源文件。

audits.summary: The skill implements a highly structured, multi-step workflow for software development, including planning, implementation, and rigorous multi-lens review. It uses project-local scripts and subagents to perform its tasks safely within the user's repository environment.

skills.name: revenue-leakage
skills.description_en: Trace where deals and revenue silently exit one specific funnel and size the loss in recoverable (never gross) dollars - untracked steps, unworked leads, manual handoffs, mid-funnel stalls, paper-process drops, billing and renewal misses - separating real leaks from healthy disqualification and data-capture gaps. zh.usage: 用户问单子去哪了、管道怎么没了、漏斗哪里在漏时加载；锁一个漏斗、一个周期、一个进入分组，用时间戳还原实际流程而不是看流程图。

It leverages industry-standard methodologies and strictly maintains a trace-only scope to avoid unauthorized system modifications. zh.usage: 想知道该订阅哪些 newsletter、听哪些播客、进哪些社区、追哪些人时加载；它会先问时间预算和关注面，再给排序后的清单。

skills.description_en: Audit a landing page receiving paid traffic against post-click conversion best practice and return a prioritised fix list - message match to the ad, above-the-fold clarity, form friction, trust, speed, mobile, policy risk - with every finding labelled by evidence class and no statistical claims on thin data. Use whenever the user says their ads get clicks but no conversions, asks why a landing page isn't converting, or mentions post-click experience, message match, conversion friction, form friction, or CPA rising after the click - even if they never say 'landing page audit'. Covers B2B and B2C on any platform. Audit only. Do NOT use for pre-click account problems - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic instead.

zh.intro: 审计承接付费流量的落地页并给出按优先级排的修改清单：广告与页面的信息匹配、首屏是否说清、表单阻力、信任要素、加载速度、移动端，以及平台政策风险。顺序是先看钱怎么走——广告到页面的点击链路、分析漏斗、定性证据，最后才做页面本身的启发式检查；一条好看的页面如果信息匹配断了，照样白白烧钱。每条发现都标证据等级与严重程度，数据量不足时不下统计结论。
zh.usage: 用户说广告有点击没转化、问落地页为什么不转化、提到点击后体验、信息匹配、表单阻力，或点击后 CPA 上涨时用；只管点击之后的事，账户层面的问题交给 ad-account-diagnostic。
zh.notes: B2B 与 B2C、各投放平台都适用；版本 1.2.8，MIT。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional instructional prompt for performing landing page audits. It includes robust internal safety guidelines to mitigate indirect prompt injection by explicitly instructing the agent to treat audited web content as untrusted data. No malicious code, data exfiltration vectors, or risky behaviors were identified.

skills.name: containerize-aspnet-framework
skills.description_en: Containerize an ASP.NET .NET Framework project by creating Dockerfile and .dockerfile files customized for the project.

audits.summary: The skill provides a workflow for containerizing legacy ASP.NET (.NET Framework) applications using Windows containers. It contains an external resource download from a well-known infrastructure domain and possesses an indirect prompt injection attack surface due to processing user-supplied build and application configurations without strict boundaries.

skills.name: tech-debt
skills.description_en: Identify, categorize, and prioritize technical debt. Trigger with "tech debt", "technical debt audit", "what should we refactor", "code health", or when the user asks about code quality, refactoring priorities, or maintenance backlog.

audits.summary: This skill provides an informational framework for identifying and prioritizing technical debt. It contains no executable code, network operations, or external dependencies, posing no security risk.

skills.name: securing-s3-buckets
skills.description_en: Create and secure S3 buckets following AWS best practices for access control, encryption, monitoring, and remediation of misconfigurations. Use when the user wants to secure a new bucket, audit an existing bucket, fix a security finding, configure encryption, or enable logging and monitoring. Do NOT use for general S3 data operations, S3 Tables setup, or discovering existing data assets.

audits.summary: This skill implements AWS S3 security best practices for access control, encryption, and monitoring. It includes robust safety mechanisms such as policy backups, JSON validation, and permission simulation. While it interacts with infrastructure via command execution and processes external data, these are handled within a secure framework.

skills.name: vss-generate-video-report
skills.description_en: Use this skill when producing a VSS analysis report — Mode A per-clip VLM, Mode B incident-range via video-analytics. Not for standalone video summarization, real-time alerts or ad-hoc Q&A.

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It automates the generation of video analysis and incident reports by coordinating with NVIDIA Video Search and Summarization (VSS) services using standard CLI tools and API calls.

skills.name: ad-negative-keywords
skills.description_en: Build and maintain negative keyword lists from search term reports to cut wasted ad spend in paid search - n-gram query mining to surface irrelevant search terms, the right negative match types and exclusion levels (account, shared list, campaign, ad group), and a review cadence that avoids overblocking queries that convert. Use whenever the user mentions a search term or search query report, irrelevant clicks, junk traffic, wasted ad spend, or wants to exclude or block keywords - even if they never say 'negative keywords'. Covers B2B lead gen and B2C/e-commerce; needs the account's query data. Do NOT use for account-wide underperformance with no query-level evidence - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic instead.

zh.intro: 从搜索词报告里挖出该排除的词，做成否定关键词表：用 n-gram 拆查询找不相关的搜索词，选对否定匹配类型和排除层级（账户、共享列表、活动、广告组），并定复查节奏，避免把本来会转化的查询也挡掉。B2B 转化稀疏，只能用点击与花费门槛判断；B2C 数据量够，才轮到转化门槛。
zh.usage: 提到搜索词报告、不相关点击、垃圾流量、浪费的广告花费，或要给某个账户排除、屏蔽关键词时用。没有该账户的搜索词报告就不要给具体否词。
zh.notes: 只管查询层面的浪费；账户整体跑不动又缺少查询级证据时属 ad-account-diagnostic。加否词前要过一遍误挡复查。

audits.summary: The skill is designed for advertising keyword analysis and is safe for its intended use. It processes external search term reports, which introduces a minor risk of indirect prompt injection, and it suggests the use of agent-generated scripts for data tokenization.

skills.name: ad-attribution-gap
skills.description_en: Quantify and explain the discrepancy between ad platform reporting, an analytics tool, and the source of truth (CRM or order system), classifying every unit of the gap as timing, definitional, or unexplained residual. Use whenever the user says the numbers don't match, that the platform reports more conversions or revenue than the CRM or order system, or mentions cross-platform reconciliation, double-counted conversions, an attribution discrepancy, or asks whether a reporting gap is normal - even if they never say 'attribution'. Covers B2B (CRM-anchored) and B2C/ecommerce (order-system-anchored). Do NOT use to fix broken or missing tracking - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-conversion-tracking instead.

zh.intro: 量化并解释广告平台报表、分析工具与真实账本（CRM 或订单系统）之间的差额，把差额的每一块归到计时差、口径差或无法解释的残差。产出是一份对账报告：每个系统各报了多少、差多少、每一块挂到哪个具体原因。正文的立场是这种差额属于结构性存在，三个系统数字完全对上的报告只说明有人编了数；每一步都过一道检验——能不能给差额落一个数并挂上原因，不能就跳过。
zh.usage: 用户说几个系统的数字对不上、平台报的转化或收入比 CRM 高、要跨平台对账、怀疑重复计转化，或问这种差额正不正常时用；修坏掉的追踪交给 ad-conversion-tracking。
zh.notes: B2B 以 CRM 为准、B2C 电商以订单系统为准；版本 1.1.10，MIT。

audits.summary: The skill establishes a professional framework for reconciling discrepancies between ad platform reports and CRM or order systems. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: advertising-radar
skills.description_en: Build a personalised, time-budgeted watch list of paid-advertising information sources - PPC and paid-social podcasts, newsletters, ad-platform release notes, communities, industry events, and media buyers worth following - with a verification method that keeps it fresh and a disclosure of what each source is selling. Use whenever a media buyer, PPC specialist, or growth marketer asks how to stay current on Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, or Microsoft Ads changes, which PPC newsletters or paid-social podcasts to follow, which communities or conferences deserve their time, or who to follow in performance marketing - even if they never say 'radar'. Do NOT use for career planning - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@advertising-career instead.

zh.intro: 按每周能投入的时间，搭一份个性化的付费广告信息源清单：PPC 与付费社交播客、简报、平台更新日志、社区、行业会议，以及值得跟的媒体买手，另附维持清单不过期的核对方法，和每个信息源在卖什么的披露。正文点出这类清单的两个典型死法——条目失效或过期，以及漏掉某个渠道；平台变更一直在发，漏一次就直接花钱。
zh.usage: 媒体买手、PPC 或增长营销想跟上 Google Ads、Meta、LinkedIn、TikTok、Microsoft Ads 的变化，问该订哪些简报与播客、哪些社区和会议值得花时间、效果营销圈该跟谁时用。
zh.notes: 版本 1.2.5，MIT；职业规划交给 advertising-career。

audits.summary: The skill is a curation tool for advertising industry news and experts. It builds a personalized watch list for users based on their professional role, time budget, and platform interests. The skill includes a robust verification process to ensure the recommended information sources remain active by fetching their URLs and checking for recently dated content. It correctly identifies risks such as domain name collisions, parked domains, and resold domains, providing instructions to avoid linking to unrelated businesses that may share names with known advertising practitioners.

skills.name: parallel-data-enrichment
skills.description_en: Bulk data enrichment. Adds web-sourced fields (CEO names, funding, contact info) to lists of companies, people, or products. Use for enriching CSV files or inline data. Supports multi-turn: pass --previous-interaction-id from a prior research task to carry context forward.

zh.intro: 给公司、人物或产品名单补网页来源字段，比如 CEO、融资、联系方式，输入可以是 CSV 也可以是内联数据。不确定要补哪些列时先让 `enrich suggest` 出建议，把返回里的 `enriched_columns` 数组传给 `--enriched-columns`，它与 `--intent` 二选一。跑起来按行数和字段数可能要几分钟，动手前先跟用户说。接着上次研究任务做时用 `--previous-interaction-id` 承接上下文，ZDR 账户不支持就显式给上下文；增补不返回新的 interaction_id，后续还得用原来那个。
zh.usage: 要把一份公司或人物清单批量补列、给 CSV 加网页来源字段，或续着上次研究任务继续增补时用。
zh.notes: 需要 parallel-cli（`enrich suggest` 要 0.3.0 及以上）与网络；显式给列默认走 core-fast 处理器。

audits.summary: The skill is a standard data enrichment utility for the parallel-web platform. It automates the process of adding web-sourced information to company or person lists using the vendor's official command-line tools. All identified operations, including tool installation, API communication, and data handling, are consistent with the intended purpose of the skill and the vendor's infrastructure.

skills.name: parallel-web-extract
skills.description_en: CLI-backed URL extraction. Use when the user explicitly invokes this skill, needs CLI-only controls or saved JSON output, or no Parallel web_fetch MCP tool is available. When the bundled Parallel Search MCP is available, prefer its web_fetch tool for ordinary webpages, articles, PDFs, and JavaScript-heavy sites.

zh.intro: 用并行抽取把一批 URL 的正文抓下来：每个地址单独作为带引号的位置参数传，一次最多 20 个，别把多个地址塞进一个字符串。`-o` 落盘 JSON 后以文件为准，stdout 可能截断；要聚焦加 `--objective`，要完整正文加 `--full-content` 并用 `--full-content-max-chars` 限长，只要正文可用 `--no-excerpts`，相关调用用 `--session-id` 归组。失败时看退出码与逐地址的 errors，成功与失败可以同时存在，只呈现成功部分并点名失败地址与原因。
zh.usage: 用户点名要这个技能、需要 CLI 参数控制或落盘 JSON，或没有 Parallel 的 web_fetch MCP 工具时用；普通网页优先用 MCP 的 web_fetch。
zh.notes: 需要 parallel-cli 与网络；页面改名时正文建议用 `parallel-cli search` 找现址。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates web content extraction via a vendor-specific CLI tool. It introduces a surface for indirect prompt injection by processing external data without boundary markers and includes a shell command execution pattern that relies on proper sanitization of user-supplied arguments.

skills.name: product-brainstorming
skills.description_en: Brainstorm product ideas, explore problem spaces, and challenge assumptions as a thinking partner. Use when exploring a new opportunity, generating solutions to a product problem, stress-testing an idea, or when a PM needs to think out loud with a sharp sparring partner before converging on a direction.

audits.summary: This skill is safe and does not contain any security concerns or malicious patterns. It functions purely as a conceptual guidance framework for product brainstorming sessions.

skills.name: nemotron-retrieval-recipes
skills.description_en: Use when planning, debugging, tuning, evaluating, exporting, or deploying public Nemotron `embed`/`rerank` retrieval recipes.

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions and references for working with NVIDIA Nemotron embedding and reranking retrieval recipes. It includes guidance on planning, debugging, tuning, and deploying these models while emphasizing security best practices, such as preventing secret leakage and avoiding unauthorized or long-running commands. All external references and commands are limited to repo-scoped operations and official NVIDIA resources.

skills.name: clerk-backend-api
skills.description_en: Clerk Backend REST API explorer and executor. Browse tags, inspect endpoint schemas, and execute authenticated requests. Use when listing users, managing organizations, or calling any Clerk API endpoint.

zh.intro: 用来浏览和调用 Clerk 的后端 REST 接口：按标签翻端点、看每个端点的出入参结构，然后带鉴权发真实请求，常用于列用户、管组织。正文对写操作卡得很严：任何新增、修改、替换、删除类的请求之前，都必须先确认密钥存在、再看当前范围够不够，删除还要先把不可逆的后果说清楚。
zh.usage: 调用前先确认密钥环境变量已设置；再检查范围变量里有没有这次写操作需要的权限，缺权限就先问用户，不要硬发请求然后失败。删除类操作要明确告知不可逆。
zh.notes: 正文要求删除前列出到底会删掉什么，绕过范围的提权开关也要先征得用户同意再用，不允许先斩后奏。

audits.summary: The skill is a tool for interacting with the Clerk Backend API. It fetches documentation from the official Clerk GitHub repository and makes requests to Clerk's API endpoints. No malicious behavior was detected; automated alerts regarding remote code execution were found to be false positives, as the skill pipes remote data into local scripts rather than executing remote code.

skills.name: ugc-ad-scripts
skills.description_en: Turn a product brief and target audience into UGC-style short-form video ad scripts a creator can film - hook, body, CTA - with 3-5 hook variants per concept written as spoken line plus on-screen text plus opening visual, with delivery notes and disclosure lines. Use whenever the user asks for a UGC ad or creator script, a short-form vertical video ad script, a founder-led video, employee-generated content, or a customer testimonial video script - even if they never say 'UGC'. Covers B2C creator scripts and B2B formats. Do NOT use to score existing hooks (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-hook-analyzer), to write static ad copy (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants), or to brief a designer (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief).

audits.summary: The skill is designed to generate video ad scripts based on product briefs and customer reviews. It is generally safe and includes robust compliance guidelines. A minor security risk of indirect prompt injection is present because the skill is instructed to ingest and mirror external text from reviews and support tickets without specific technical boundary markers or sanitization. However, the skill contains no code or scripts and lacks high-privilege capabilities.

skills.name: tilegym-cutile-python
skills.description_en: Expert cuTile programming assistant. Write high-performance GPU kernels using cuTile's tile-based programming model with proper validation and optimization. Supports deep agent orchestration for complex multi-kernel tasks.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive coding assistant for NVIDIA's cuTile GPU programming model. It provides structured workflows for task decomposition, kernel generation, and validation. Security analysis confirms that while the skill generates and executes local scripts and downloads reference code from trusted repositories (PyTorch and TileGym), these behaviors are well-documented, targeted at official sources, and central to the skill's intended use-case as a developer tool.

skills.name: start
skills.description_en: Initialize the productivity system and open the dashboard. Use when setting up the plugin for the first time, bootstrapping working memory from your existing task list, or decoding the shorthand (nicknames, acronyms, project codenames) you use in your todos.

audits.summary: This skill initializes a productivity dashboard by analyzing user tasks, emails, and messages to build a 'memory' system. It includes security considerations regarding the ingestion of untrusted data from external sources, which is a standard surface for indirect prompt injection. These elements are consistent with the skill's initialization and bootstrapping purpose.

skills.name: flutter-routing-and-navigation
skills.description_en: Move between or deep link to different screens or routes within a Flutter application

audits.summary: The skill provides standard and safe architectural guidance for implementing navigation and routing in Flutter applications, adhering to official best practices.

skills.name: create-github-issue-feature-from-specification
skills.description_en: Create GitHub Issue for feature request from specification file using feature_request.yml template.

audits.summary: The skill processes user-provided specification files to create or update GitHub issues without adequate input sanitization, creating a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: seo-aeo-best-practices
skills.description_en: SEO and AEO best practices for metadata, Open Graph, sitemaps, robots.txt, hreflang, JSON-LD structured data, EEAT, and content optimized for search engines and AI answer surfaces. Use this skill when implementing page SEO, technical SEO, schema markup, international SEO, AI-overview readiness, or improving content for Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and similar assistants.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive best practices and code templates for Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). It includes Sanity CMS schemas, Next.js metadata implementations, and JSON-LD structured data patterns for enhancing content visibility for search engines and AI assistants. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: connecting-to-data-source
skills.description_en: Create and troubleshoot AWS Glue connections to JDBC databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, RDS), Redshift, Snowflake, and BigQuery. Gathers connection hints from user, discovers existing connections and RDS/Redshift candidates, registers credentials in Secrets Manager or IAM DB auth, configures VPC, and tests. Triggers on: connect to database, set up Glue connection, register data source, connect to Snowflake/BigQuery/RDS, connection timeout, test connection, troubleshoot connection. Do NOT use for moving data (use ingesting-into-data-lake), creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table), queries (use querying-data-lake), catalog exploration (use exploring-data-catalog), or SaaS (Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, MongoDB, Kafka).

audits.summary: This skill includes some security considerations such as dynamic script generation for troubleshooting and a surface for indirect prompt injection. While these warrant review, they are used within the skill's intended functionality to register and test data source connections. See detailed analysis for context.

skills.name: flutter-state-management
skills.description_en: Manage state in your Flutter application

audits.summary: The skill provides safe and standard architectural guidance for Flutter state management using the MVVM pattern and the provider package. No malicious patterns or security risks were detected.

skills.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
skills.description_en: Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.

zh.intro: 一次性配置技能：给仓库建好 issue tracker、triage 标签词表和领域文档目录结构，是这一整套工程技能的前置。安装量 103 万，8 周跌 4.8%，说明里要求在用其他工程技能之前先跑一次。
zh.usage: 刚 clone 下来的仓库第一次上这套技能；团队标签命名不一致需要统一。
zh.notes: 会往仓库里写配置和目录，跑之前先看清它改哪些文件、动不改得动现有 issue 模板。

audits.summary: The skill 'setup-matt-pocock-skills' is a utility designed to configure repositories for engineering workflows. It explores project structure, reads metadata, and sets up configuration files for issue tracking and documentation. It interacts with GitHub and GitLab using official CLI tools. The main security consideration is the inherent risk of processing project files that could contain malicious instructions (indirect prompt injection).

skills.name: ad-campaign-consolidation
skills.description_en: Evaluate a fragmented paid-ads account and recommend which campaigns and ad sets to merge, which splits to preserve, and how to migrate without resetting learning across the account - it plans the consolidation, it never executes it. Use whenever the user mentions too many campaigns or ad sets, merging or restructuring an ad account, ad sets stuck in learning or learning limited, budget spread too thin, account simplification, or campaigns competing with each other - even if they never say 'consolidation'. Covers B2B and B2C on search, paid social, video, and professional-network platforms. Do NOT use to find out why the account underperforms in the first place - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic instead.

audits.summary: The skill is an instructional framework designed to help an AI agent evaluate advertising accounts and provide consolidation recommendations. It is purely advisory, explicitly prohibits automated execution, and contains no code, malicious patterns, or suspicious dependencies.

skills.name: aws-iam
skills.description_en: Provides verified corrections for IAM behaviors that AI agents frequently get wrong — policy evaluation edge cases, trust policy gotchas, STS session limits, Organizations quirks, and SAML/MFA specifics. Also provides structured workflows for IAM role management and baseline policy generation from application source code or a Terraform plan JSON. Covers condition operator safety (ForAnyValue/ForAllValues with Null checks), bucket policy deny patterns (VPC endpoint restrictions, org paths), confused deputy protection, and service role creation for AWS services (Glue, CloudTrail, Lambda, ECS, etc.) with aws:SourceAccount/aws:SourceArn trust conditions. Applies when creating IAM roles, writing IAM or bucket policies, generating policies from application source code or a Terraform plan JSON, working with STS, Organizations, or condition operators, or any task needing a service or execution role. Does not cover non-IAM authorization like Cognito user-pool policies or app-level RBAC.

audits.summary: This skill provides specialized guidance for AWS IAM and incorporates automated policy generation. It includes security considerations such as analyzing user-provided source code and discovering metadata from configuration files. These actions utilize trusted tools and official AWS resources to ensure secure and accurate configuration.

skills.name: csharp-mcp-server-generator
skills.description_en: Generate a complete MCP server project in C# with tools, prompts, and proper configuration

audits.summary: This skill is a template that provides instructions for generating a C# Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. It is entirely instructional, contains no executable code or scripts, and emphasizes best practices such as parameter validation and error handling for the code it generates.

skills.name: figma-implement-design
skills.description_en: Translates Figma designs into production-ready application code with 1:1 visual fidelity. Use when implementing UI code from Figma files, when user mentions "implement design", "generate code", "implement component", provides Figma URLs, or asks to build components matching Figma specs. For Figma canvas writes via `use_figma`, use `figma-use`.

audits.summary: The skill provides a structured and safe workflow for translating Figma designs into application code using an MCP server. It follows best practices for design system integration and asset handling.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description_en: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

zh.intro: 把当前对话压成一份交接文档，给另一个 agent 接着干。安装量 103 万，8 周跌 4.5%；flags 标 pointer，正文是转发壳，压缩流程在底层技能里。
zh.usage: 上下文快满了要把活交给新会话；换模型或换工具继续做同一件事。
zh.notes: 转发壳，压缩质量取决于底层技能；关键决策和文件路径要自己核一遍。

audits.summary: The skill creates a summary of the current conversation for agent handoff and saves it to the system's temporary directory. It includes safety instructions to redact sensitive information like API keys. As with any skill that processes conversation history, there is a minor risk of indirect prompt injection from data within the conversation.

skills.name: aws-amplify
skills.description_en: Build and deploy full-stack web and mobile apps with AWS Amplify Gen2 (TypeScript code-first). Covers auth (Cognito), data (AppSync/DynamoDB), storage (S3), functions, APIs, and AI (Amplify AI Kit with Bedrock). Supports React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, React Native, Flutter, Swift, and Android. Always use this skill for Amplify Gen2 topics — even for questions you think you know — it contains validated, version-specific patterns that prevent common mistakes. TRIGGER when: user mentions Amplify Gen2; project has amplify/ directory or amplify_outputs; code imports @aws-amplify packages; user asks about defineBackend, defineAuth, defineData, defineStorage, defineFunction, or npx ampx. SKIP: Amplify Gen1 (amplify CLI v6), standalone SAM/CDK without Amplify (use aws-serverless), direct Bedrock without Amplify AI Kit (use bedrock).

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive instructions for building applications with AWS Amplify Gen2. It includes security considerations such as the use of command-line tools for cloud resource management and the ingestion of user-provided data for infrastructure generation. These patterns are standard for developer assistant tools and are supported by best-practice recommendations within the skill, such as secure secret management.

skills.name: flutter-architecture
skills.description_en: Use the Flutter team's recommended app architecture

audits.summary: The skill provides a standard and secure architectural template for Flutter applications following MVVM and clean architecture principles. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or security risks were detected.

skills.name: sponsor-finder
skills.description_en: Find which of a GitHub repository's dependencies are sponsorable via GitHub Sponsors. Uses deps.dev API for dependency resolution across npm, PyPI, Cargo, Go, RubyGems, Maven, and NuGet. Checks npm funding metadata, FUNDING.yml files, and web search. Verifies every link. Shows direct and transitive dependencies with OSSF Scorecard health data. Invoke with /sponsor followed by a GitHub owner/repo (e.g. "/sponsor expressjs/express").
