Calls `runcomfy run blackforestlabs/flux-2-klein/9b/text-to-image` (or `/4b/`) through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "flux 2 klein", "flux-2-klein", "flux klein", "BFL flux 2", or any explicit ask to generate with this model.

zh.intro: 调 Flux 2 的蒸馏快版 Flux 2 Klein 出图，命令是 runcomfy run blackforestlabs/flux-2-klein/9b/text-to-image（也可换 /4b/）。description 写它亚秒级延迟、多参考图品牌风格、要主语前置的声明式提示词，还给了步数策略（4–8 步快速迭代，约 25 步精修）和 9B 与 4B 两档的取舍。安装量 43.3 万，8 周跌 4%。
zh.usage: 提示词要试几十轮、等不起慢模型时；做品牌风格一致的批量图、需要亚秒级返图时。
zh.notes: 快是有代价的，出片精度不如 Flux 2 Pro；依赖 RunComfy CLI 与额度。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for image generation via the RunComfy platform's official CLI tool. While the functionality is standard for image-generation tasks, it includes an inherent attack surface for indirect prompt injection or command injection if user-provided prompts are not meticulously escaped during the construction of shell commands.

skills.name: fetch
skills.description_en: Use this skill when the user wants to retrieve a URL without a full browser session: fetch HTML or JSON from static pages, inspect status codes or headers, follow redirects, or get page source for simple scraping. Prefer it over a browser when JavaScript rendering and page interaction are not needed. Supports proxies and redirect control.

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate tool for fetching web content via the Browserbase API. It poses a low risk of indirect prompt injection as it processes untrusted data from the web, though it includes explicit warnings for the agent to handle this data safely.

skills.name: hyperframes-media
skills.description_en: Audio and media assets for HyperFrames compositions, produced by one shared audio engine (`scripts/audio.mjs`) — multi-provider TTS (HeyGen / ElevenLabs / Kokoro local), background music + sound effects (HeyGen audio-library retrieval by default, with local Lyria / MusicGen BGM generation and a bundled SFX library as the no-credential fallback), Whisper transcription, background removal, and caption authoring. Use for voiceover / TTS, BGM, SFX / sound effects, transcription, captions / subtitles / lyrics / karaoke / per-word styling, voice + provider selection, and music-mood prompting.

zh.intro: 为 HyperFrames 合成准备音频与媒体素材，全部走同一个音频引擎，正文给的路径是 scripts/audio.mjs：它读一份中性的音频请求文件，写出音频元数据，并把素材放进 assets 下的 voice、bgm、sfx 目录。TTS 支持 HeyGen、ElevenLabs 和本地 Kokoro 多家；背景音乐与音效用 HeyGen 音频库取，也可本地用 Lyria、MusicGen 生成，没凭据时回落到自带的音效库。另外还有 Whisper 转写、背景去除和字幕撰写，字幕支持逐词样式与卡拉OK。
zh.usage: 要给合成配旁白、背景音乐、音效或字幕时调用；先把需求写成音频请求文件交给音频引擎，别自己拼音频。
zh.notes: 没有凭据时会回落到本地或自带素材；把素材放进合成要看 core 那部分。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates media processing tasks like text-to-speech, transcription, and background removal using the HyperFrames CLI. It involves downloading machine learning models to the local file system and requires external package installations. A risk of command injection exists if user-supplied text or file content is passed unsanitized into the shell commands executed by the agent.

skills.name: react-three-fiber
skills.description_en: React Three Fiber 3D renderer for json-render. Use when working with @json-render/react-three-fiber, building 3D scenes from JSON specs, rendering meshes/lights/models/environments, or integrating Three.js with json-render catalogs.

audits.summary: This skill provides a 3D rendering interface for json-render using React Three Fiber. It includes security considerations common to media renderers, such as external asset loading, while utilizing validation schemas as a safety measure.

skills.name: wait-what
skills.description_en: Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it.

zh.intro: description 只有一句：Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it. 也就是让模型停下，把上一条没讲清楚的话重新说一遍。安装量 42.7 万，8 周跌 7.4%，三家审计全 pass；flags 标了 thin_body。
zh.usage: 模型答非所问、或者上一段话你看不懂时直接点名它；长对话里让对方把结论压缩重讲也用它。
zh.notes: thin_body：正文极短，作用是换一种说法重讲，不会补出新信息。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions to rephrase text using specific linguistic rules and project context. It does not perform any network operations, execute code, or access sensitive system files.

skills.name: video-edit
skills.description_en: Edit existing video on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Wan 2.7 Edit-Video (general restyle / background swap / packaging swap, identity + motion preservation), Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control (transfer precise motion from a reference video to a target character), or Lucy Edit Restyle (lightweight identity-stable restyle / outfit swap). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "video edit", "edit video", "restyle video", "swap video background", "motion control", "outfit swap video", or any explicit ask to transform a video.

zh.intro: RunComfy 视频改片的选型路由：通用风格重做、换背景、换包装走 Wan 2.7 Edit-Video（保人脸和动作），把参考视频里的动作精确搬到目标角色走 Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control，轻量且保身份的改风格、换装走 Lucy Edit Restyle。每家都附提示词写法。安装量 62.3 万，8 周 -4.6%。
zh.usage: 已有一段视频要改，但不知道哪个模型能保住人脸、哪个只搬动作时用；换装、换背景、动作迁移这类需求都先在这分流。
zh.notes: 需要本地 RunComfy CLI 和账号，实际调的是 runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>。

audits.summary: The skill functions as a router for the RunComfy video editing service, directing user requests to appropriate AI models via an official CLI tool. It follows standard security practices for authentication and restricts network communication to vendor-controlled domains.

skills.name: figma-create-design-system-rules
skills.description_en: Generates custom design system rules for the user's codebase. Use when user says "create design system rules", "generate rules for my project", "set up design rules", "customize design system guidelines", or wants to establish project-specific conventions for Figma-to-code workflows. Requires Figma MCP server connection.

audits.summary: This skill generates project-specific design rules by analyzing Figma design data. It is functionally sound but presents a surface for indirect prompt injection where content from a Figma design could influence the generated instruction files.

skills.name: copywriting
skills.description_en: When the user wants to write, rewrite, or improve marketing copy for any page, including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, or product pages. Also use when the user says "write copy for," "improve this copy," "rewrite this page," "marketing copy," "headline help," "CTA copy," "value proposition," "tagline," "hero section copy," "this copy is weak," "this sounds like AI," "AI slop," "make it sound human," or "help me describe my product." Drafts never use AI tells like "it's not X, it's Y" reveals, "no X, no Y, no Z" lists, or sentences that trail into extra comma clauses. For email copy, see emails. For popup copy, see popups. For editing existing copy, see copy-editing. For the offer underneath the copy (bonuses, guarantees, value framing), see offers. Claims must be supportable, and a declined claim names the evidence that would unlock it. Diagnoses the input first (blank brief, real voice, or point edit) and changes only what it calls for.

zh.intro: 写和改营销页文案：首页、落地页、定价页、功能页、关于页、产品页都覆盖。它先判断输入类型（空白 brief、有真实语气、还是逐句点改）再决定改多少，description 明确禁掉「不是 X，而是 Y」「没有 X、没有 Y」这类 AI 腔。装量 22.9 万，8 周涨 17.7%，五家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 落地页或定价页文案要重写、标题和 CTA 想不出、或者有人说这段像 AI 写的时用。
zh.notes: 要求主张可支撑，被拒的主张要指名缺哪条证据；邮件、弹窗、报价结构分别走 emails、popups、offers。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional copywriting tool that provides guidelines for creating persuasive marketing content. It focuses on clarity, benefits, and specificity while strictly avoiding patterns that identify content as AI-generated. No security vulnerabilities or malicious behaviors were detected.

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.description_en: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

zh.intro: 写给人看的文档和写给 agent 看的文档不是一个写法，这条技能专讲后者：创建或改 SKILL.md、或者改 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 时用。安装量 44.4 万，8 周跌 9.3%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 写新技能的 SKILL.md 时；给仓库补 AGENTS.md、或者发现 agent 老是不照约定做事时。
zh.notes: 管的是说明文档的写法，不涉及代码风格和工程规范。

audits.summary: This skill consists of documentation providing guidelines and best practices for writing AI agent instructions. It contains no code, executable scripts, or external dependencies, and presents no security risk.

skills.name: image-edit
skills.description_en: Edit images on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Nano Banana Edit (batch up to 20, identity-preserving default), OpenAI GPT Image 2 Edit (multilingual in-image text rewrite, multi-ref composition, layout precision), Flux Kontext Pro (single-ref high-fidelity local edit), or Z-Image Turbo Inpaint (mask-driven precise region edit). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image edit", "edit image", "image-to-image", "i2i", "swap background", "remove object", "rewrite headline", or any explicit ask to edit a single or batch of images.

zh.intro: RunComfy 上改图的总路由：按你的意图在四个模型里挑一个——Nano Banana Edit（批量最多 20 张、默认保身份）、GPT Image 2 Edit（图内多语言文字改写、多参考图）、Flux Kontext Pro（单图局部高保真）、Z-Image Turbo Inpaint（蒙版定点）。正文带各模型的提示词写法。安装量 43.4 万，8 周跌 4.6%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 需求是换背景、去物体、改标题字这类、但不知道该用哪个模型时；一次要改一批图时。
zh.notes: 底层是本地 RunComfy CLI，先装好并登录；每个模型都按次消耗额度。

audits.summary: The skill provides a router for various image editing models via the RunComfy CLI. It manages inputs for different tasks like batch editing, multilingual text, and inpainting. The analysis found no evidence of malicious patterns or security risks.

skills.name: animate
skills.description_en: Build an animation from scratch, making the decisions in the order that determines whether it feels right — should it animate at all, what purpose, which tool, which properties, which curve and duration, how it interrupts, how it exits. Writes the implementation. Use when asked to animate something, add motion, make a component feel alive, or build a transition. For critiquing existing motion use review-animations; for auditing a whole codebase use improve-animations.

zh.intro: 从零做一段动画，按决定观感的顺序做判断：该不该动、什么目的、用哪个工具、动哪些属性、哪条曲线和多长时长、怎么被打断、怎么退出，然后写出实现。装量 23.7 万（含合并 fork，自身 15.5 万），8 周涨 27.2%。
zh.usage: 让你给某个组件加动效、做过渡、让交互有点生命感的时候用；只想要批评意见就换评审那条。
zh.notes: description 自己划了分工：评审已有动效走 review-animations，审整个库走 improve-animations。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines and code recipes for building high-quality UI animations based on professional design engineering principles. It contains no malicious code, external downloads from untrusted sources, or data exfiltration risks.

skills.name: sentry-setup-ai-monitoring
skills.description_en: Setup Sentry AI Agent Monitoring in any project. Use when asked to monitor LLM calls, track AI agents, track conversations, or instrument OpenAI/Anthropic/Vercel AI/LangChain/Google GenAI/Pydantic AI/Laravel AI. Detects installed AI SDKs and configures appropriate integrations.

audits.summary: The skill provides safe and standard instructions for setting up Sentry AI monitoring. It includes appropriate privacy warnings regarding PII capture and uses standard system tools for environment detection. All external resources point to trusted Sentry infrastructure.

skills.name: typesafe-ai
skills.description_en: Build AI-powered software with TypeSafe: small units of AI intelligence you can use like programming primitives. Its System One models, including Jev, turn natural language and application state into typed judgments and probabilities that code can combine. Use when a feature needs programmable common sense, when brainstorming what AI could make possible in an app, or when an LLM prompt-and-parse step could become a structured decision. Applications include routing, ranking, extraction, verification, and interactive experiences; these are starting points, not the limits. Read live docs and cookbooks to find useful patterns and discover new combinations.

zh.intro: 把一小块 AI 判断当成编程原语来用：System One 系列模型读自然语言和应用状态，返回带类型的判断与概率，而不是生成一段文本或推理过程。工作流由代码掌握，模型只补上普通代码缺的那点语义理解能力，覆盖路由、排序、抽取、校验和交互式体验。旗舰模型是 Jev。适合某个功能需要可编程常识，或想把提示词加解析那一步换成结构化决策。
zh.usage: 正文把「读实时文档」放在第一步，明确实时文档才是事实来源，本技能只给方向。先看 https://docs.typesafe.ai/llms.txt 拿到全量索引，再按需要读概念、原语、置信度、API 与各语言 SDK 页面；Python 与 JavaScript 的接法分开成篇，迁移到 v1 也有单独页。设计时先定要哪些判断，再组合与验证。
zh.notes: 经验信息容易过期，接口和概念以线上文档为准；正文提到的路由、排序、抽取、校验只是起点，不是能力边界。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions and architectural guidance for building AI-powered software using the TypeSafe AI platform. It directs the agent to official vendor documentation and includes security best practices for handling API credentials. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: transcribe
skills.description_en: Transcribe audio files to text with optional diarization and known-speaker hints. Use when a user asks to transcribe speech from audio/video, extract text from recordings, or label speakers in interviews or meetings.

audits.summary: This skill provides functionality to transcribe audio files with optional speaker diarization using the official OpenAI API. The implementation follows standard practices for dependency management and credential safety.

skills.name: yeet
skills.description_en: Use only when the user explicitly asks to stage, commit, push, and open a GitHub pull request in one flow using the GitHub CLI (`gh`).

audits.summary: This skill includes some security considerations such as running local CLI commands and processing repository files that could contain untrusted input. While these warrant review, they are standard for the skill's intended development workflow functionality.

skills.name: sentry-python-sdk
skills.description_en: Full Sentry SDK setup for Python. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Python", "install sentry-sdk", "setup Sentry in Python", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, logging, metrics, crons, or AI monitoring for Python applications. Supports Django, Flask, FastAPI, Celery, Starlette, AIOHTTP, Tornado, and more.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions and code examples for setting up the Sentry Python SDK. It follows security best practices, such as documenting PII scrubbing and using environment variables for sensitive configuration like the DSN. All external references and dependencies are to official Sentry resources or well-known development libraries.

skills.name: napkin
skills.description_en: Visual whiteboard collaboration for Copilot CLI. Creates an interactive whiteboard that opens in your browser — draw, sketch, add sticky notes, then share everything back with Copilot. Copilot sees your drawings and text, and responds with analysis, suggestions, and ideas.

audits.summary: The skill provides a whiteboard collaboration tool that opens a local HTML file in the browser. It poses a security risk by reading the user's entire system clipboard to retrieve whiteboard data, which could inadvertently expose sensitive information like passwords or private keys to the AI agent. It also presents an indirect prompt injection surface by processing untrusted images and clipboard content.

skills.name: playwright-dev
skills.description_en: Explains how to develop Playwright - add APIs, MCP tools, CLI commands, and vendor dependencies.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive technical guidance for developing and maintaining the Playwright framework, covering API implementation, architectural patterns, and tool creation. It details standard development workflows, including dependency management, automated testing, and regression analysis.

skills.name: notion-meeting-intelligence
skills.description_en: Prepare meeting materials with Notion context and Codex research; use when gathering context, drafting agendas/pre-reads, and tailoring materials to attendees.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured workflow for preparing meeting materials by integrating context from Notion with research capabilities. A security consideration is the potential for indirect prompt injection, as the skill processes data from external documents. This is a common aspect of agents that interact with user-provided content and can be addressed through appropriate prompting boundaries.

skills.name: launchdarkly-metric-create
skills.description_en: Create a LaunchDarkly metric that measures what matters for an experiment or rollout. Use when the user wants to create a metric, track an event, measure page views, button clicks, conversion, latency, error rate, or any custom numeric or binary outcome. Instruments the event first when needed (including SDK setup and .env), then creates and verifies the metric.

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It provides a structured and legitimate workflow for creating LaunchDarkly metrics and instrumenting local applications with the LaunchDarkly SDK. It adheres to standard developer practices by managing environment variables and dependencies without evidence of malicious behavior.

skills.name: golang-grpc
skills.description_en: Provides gRPC usage guidelines, protobuf organization, and production-ready patterns for Golang microservices. Use when implementing, reviewing, or debugging gRPC servers/clients, writing proto files, setting up interceptors, handling gRPC errors with status codes, configuring TLS/mTLS, testing with bufconn, or working with streaming RPCs.

zh.intro: Go 微服务的 gRPC 使用规范、protobuf 组织和生产级写法。实现、审查或排查 gRPC 服务端与客户端时用它：写 proto 文件、挂 interceptor、用 status codes 处理 gRPC 错误、配 TLS/mTLS、用 bufconn 写测试，以及处理 streaming RPC。默认路径是 **/*.go。
zh.usage: 先定 proto 的组织方式，再补 interceptor 和错误映射，最后处理超时和 TLS。想跑 protoc 得先装 protobuf 工具链，可以用 brew 装。用 godig 和 gopls 辅助看调用关系，测试侧用 bufconn 起本地连接。
zh.notes: 它默认假设服务已经按 gRPC 分层；status codes 和 deadline 没定下来之前，先别挂 interceptor。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard best practices, templates, and evaluation tests for gRPC development in Go. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: sentry-fix-issues
skills.description_en: Find and fix issues from Sentry using MCP. Use when asked to fix Sentry errors, debug production issues, investigate exceptions, or resolve bugs reported in Sentry. Methodically analyzes stack traces, breadcrumbs, traces, and context to identify root causes.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured workflow for debugging and fixing production issues using Sentry's monitoring tools. While it processes untrusted external data (error logs and stack traces), it includes explicit security instructions to avoid executing directives found in such data.

skills.name: research
skills.description_en: Comprehensive research grounded in web data with explicit citations. Use when you need multi-source synthesis—comparisons, current events, market analysis, detailed reports.

audits.summary: This research skill uses the Tavily API to perform web searches. It includes an automated authentication flow that uses npx to download and execute remote code and scans local directories for stored credentials.

skills.name: launchdarkly-metric-choose
skills.description_en: Choose the right metrics for a LaunchDarkly experiment, guarded rollout, or release policy. Use when the user wants to know which metrics to use, which is the primary metric for an experiment, what guardrails to add, or which events to monitor in a rollout. Surfaces what will auto-attach from existing release policies before making additional recommendations.

audits.summary: This skill is a legitimate advisory tool designed to help users select appropriate metrics for LaunchDarkly experiments, rollouts, and policies. It utilizes read-only tools to inventory existing configurations and provides logic-based recommendations. No security issues or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: caveman
skills.description_en: Terse caveman voice: answer first, fluff gone, every technical fact kept. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief", "less tokens". Stays on until "stop caveman" or "normal mode".

zh.intro: 把回答切成穴居人腔：先给结论，废话全砍，技术事实一条不丢。用 /caveman 或说 caveman mode、talk like caveman、be brief、less tokens 触发，一直生效到说 stop caveman 或 normal mode。安装量 79.7 万，8 周 -17.3%，是这批里掉得比较明显的一条；四家审计 provider 全 pass。
zh.usage: 想压 token、或者嫌模型铺垫太多时挂上；连着跑长会话、赶时间只看结论的场景最合适。
zh.notes: 是文风开关，不增加能力。关掉要显式说 stop caveman 或 normal mode。

audits.summary: The 'caveman' skill is a stylistic persona extension designed to minimize token usage by enforcing terse output. It contains no malicious code, external dependencies, or data exfiltration risks, and includes safety instructions to prioritize clarity during security-sensitive operations.

skills.name: dashboarding
skills.description_en: Build, modify, and ship Grafana dashboards as JSON via the HTTP API — panel types (timeseries / stat / gauge / table / heatmap / logs / traces / node-graph), `gridPos` 24-column layout, units, thresholds, template + datasource + chained variables, transformations (`organize` / `calculateField` / `filterByValue`), panel + dashboard links with `${__field.labels.x}` / `${__from}`, and Loki/Prometheus annotations. Use when scripting dashboard creation, writing the dashboard JSON for a new service, adding a `$job` dropdown variable, computing an "Error %" column with a transformation, overlaying deploys as annotations, or pushing a dashboard via `POST /api/dashboards/db` — even when the user says "create a dashboard for this metric", "add a service dropdown", "show errors as percentage", "overlay our deploys", or "export the dashboard JSON" without naming the API or schema. After every API push, verify with the returned `version` plus a GET on the dashboard UID.

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill provides standard documentation and shell workflows for creating, modifying, and pushing Grafana dashboards via the official Grafana HTTP API.

skills.name: openapi-to-application-code
skills.description_en: Generate a complete, production-ready application from an OpenAPI specification

audits.summary: The skill is designed to generate application code from OpenAPI specifications. It is generally safe but possesses a vulnerability surface for indirect prompt injection, as it processes external, untrusted specifications that could contain malicious instructions designed to manipulate the agent's output.

skills.name: create-technical-spike
skills.description_en: Create time-boxed technical spike documents for researching and resolving critical development decisions before implementation.

audits.summary: The skill provides guidance and a markdown template for creating time-boxed technical spike documents. It does not include executable code, external scripts, or data handling mechanisms that pose a security risk.

skills.name: writing-great-skills
skills.description_en: Reference for writing and editing skills well — the vocabulary and principles that make a skill predictable.

zh.intro: 写和改 skill 的参考手册：讲的是让一个 skill 行为可预期的词汇与原则，属于文档型技能，本身不执行流程。装量 30.7 万，8 周涨 7.4%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 要改自己的 SKILL.md、或不确定触发词该怎么写时查它；写完一批技能后横向对齐风格也用得上。
zh.notes: description 只说是 reference，别指望它替你生成技能；要动手建技能得换别的条目。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive documentation and architectural guide for writing AI agent skills. It contains no executable code, network operations, or external dependencies, posing no security risk.

skills.name: ponytail-debt
skills.description_en: List every `shortcut:` comment (and older `ponytail:` ones) as a debt ledger. One-shot report, changes nothing. Use for "ponytail debt", "what did ponytail defer", "list the shortcuts", /ponytail-debt.

zh.intro: 把仓库里所有 `shortcut:` 注释（老代码里可能写成 `ponytail:`）收成一张技术债清单：每行给出文件与行号、当时简化掉了什么、天花板在哪、什么条件下该回头改。只读，不动代码。给想确认「当时省下的事有没有悄悄变成永久欠账」的人。
zh.usage: 在仓库里跑 `git grep --no-index --exclude-standard -nE '(#|//|/[*]) ?(shortcut|ponytail):'`；想换成自己的标记词就搜那个词；要在每行补上责任人，再叠 `git blame -L<line>,<line>`。
zh.notes: 只读不写；想把清单存成文件（比如 PONYTAIL-DEBT.md）得单独要求。没写升级路径或触发条件的标记会被标成 no-trigger，那几条才是会烂掉的。

audits.summary: The skill scans code comments to generate a technical debt report. It is generally safe but lacks explicit sanitization for user-provided search terms and processes repository content which could contain indirect prompt injections.

skills.name: golang-popular-libraries
skills.description_en: Golang library and framework selection — vetted production-ready options by category (web, database, testing, logging, messaging), new and experimental stdlib packages, standard-library-first tradeoffs, and maturity signals (maintenance, license, importer counts). Apply when the user asks for library suggestions, wants to compare alternatives, needs to choose a library for a specific task, or when a new dependency is being added to the project. Not for a specific library's API once chosen (→ See that library's dedicated skill, e.g. `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-lo`), nor for go.mod mechanics, upgrades, or vulnerability audits (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-dependency-management` skill).

zh.intro: samber 这套 Go 技能库里的选型卡：按 web、database、testing、logging、messaging 分类列经过筛选、可直接上生产的库和框架，也讲标准库优先的取舍，以及新出的、实验性的 stdlib 包。判断一个库是否成熟，会看维护状态、license 和 importer counts 这几个信号。
zh.usage: 要推荐库、对比几个候选、给某个具体任务挑一个库，或者项目要加新依赖时用它。流程是先定分类，再看标准库能不能顶，然后比 maturity signals；选定之后查那个库的专门技能，别在这张卡里继续挖某个库的 API。
zh.notes: go.mod 的机制、升级和漏洞审计不归它管，找 golang-dependency-management。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidance on selecting Go libraries, emphasizing standard library usage and vetting third-party options. It identifies a minor indirect prompt injection surface as it encourages fetching documentation from external sources without explicit sanitization instructions.

This skill covers all six Kling 3.0 endpoints, spanning three rendering tiers (Standard, Pro, 4K) and two modes (text-to-video, image-to-video). Calls runcomfy run kling/kling-3.0/<tier>/<mode> through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "kling", "kling 3.0", "kling v3", "kling pro", "kling 4k", "kling text to video", "kling image to video", or any explicit ask to generate or animate with Kling 3.0.

zh.intro: 调 Kling 3.0（快手第三代多镜头视频模型）在 RunComfy 上出片，覆盖全部六个端点：Standard、Pro、4K 三档乘文生视频、图生视频两种模式，命令形如 runcomfy run kling/kling-3.0/<tier>/<mode>。description 说它原生带同步音频、跨镜头保持人物一致。安装量 41 万，8 周跌 4.2%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 要多镜头且人物一致的短片时；要 4K 交付、或者用一张图起手时。
zh.notes: 档位和模式是组合关系，选错端点等于白花一次额度；依赖 RunComfy CLI 与账号额度。

audits.summary: This skill enables video generation using the Kling 3.0 model via the RunComfy CLI. It provides a structured interface for text-to-video and image-to-video workflows across multiple quality tiers. The skill follows standard security practices for CLI-based integrations, including safe credential management and clearly defined network boundaries.

skills.name: golang-swagger
skills.description_en: Golang OpenAPI/Swagger documentation with swaggo/swag — annotation comments (@Summary, @Param, @Success, @Router, @Security), swag init code generation, framework integrations (gin, echo, fiber, chi, net/http), security definitions (Bearer/JWT, OAuth2, API key), and struct tags (swaggertype, enums, example, swaggerignore). Apply when adding or maintaining Swagger/OpenAPI docs in a Go project, or when the codebase imports github.com/swaggo/swag, github.com/swaggo/gin-swagger, github.com/swaggo/echo-swagger, github.com/swaggo/http-swagger, or github.com/swaggo/files.

zh.intro: 用 swaggo/swag 的注解从 Go 源码生成 OpenAPI 文档：注解有 @Summary、@Param、@Success、@Router、@Security 等，`swag init` 负责生成 docs.go、swagger.json、swagger.yaml，UI 可挂到 gin、echo、fiber、chi 或 net/http 上，安全定义支持 Bearer/JWT、OAuth2 和 API key。
zh.usage: 在 Go 项目里新增或维护 Swagger 文档时用它。装工具走 `go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest`；生成文档和格式化注解分别是 `swag init` 和 `swag fmt`；需要覆盖字段类型或屏蔽字段时用 swaggertype、swaggerignore 这类结构体标签。
zh.notes: 需要 go 和 swag 两个命令，注解写在 handler 上而不是单独的文档文件里，改完注解要重跑生成，否则接口文档和代码对不上。

audits.summary: The golang-swagger skill, authored by samber, provides a comprehensive environment for generating OpenAPI documentation in Go projects using the swaggo library. It installs standard development tools from well-known repositories and uses platform-scoped bash tools for its operations. zh.usage: 需要时直接 `/ponytail-help` 把这张卡打出来，它只显示一次、不改模式、不落盘；在 Codex CLI 和 IDE 扩展里换成 `$ponytail:ponytail-help` 这种写法。

skills.name: golang-structs-interfaces
skills.description_en: Golang struct and interface design patterns — composition, embedding, type assertions, type switches, interface segregation, dependency injection via interfaces, struct field tags, and pointer vs value receivers. Use this skill when designing Go types, defining or implementing interfaces, embedding structs or interfaces, writing type assertions or type switches, adding struct field tags for JSON/YAML/DB serialization, or choosing between pointer and value receivers. Also use when the user asks about "accept interfaces, return structs", compile-time interface checks, or composing small interfaces into larger ones.

zh.intro: 讲 Go 的类型该怎么设计：接口保持小（一到三个方法，要更大的契约就从小接口组合）、接口定义在使用方而不是实现方、函数接受接口返回具体类型、别在没有第二个实现之前就造接口；再往下是结构体嵌入、类型断言与 type switch、接口分段、用接口做依赖注入、序列化用的字段 tag、指针接收者和值接收者怎么选。核心那句是「抽象是发现出来的，不是设计出来的」。
zh.usage: 设计新类型、拆接口、写 type switch，或在指针接收者和值接收者之间拿不定主意时问它；它也解释接受接口返回结构体到底解决什么问题。
zh.notes: 正文写明社区默认：公司内部若有明确取代它的技能，以公司那份为准。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive guidelines and design patterns for Go development, specifically focusing on structs and interfaces. skills.name: golang-google-wire

zh.usage: 代码里导入 `github.com/google/wire`，或者要在编译期用 wire.Build 装配应用依赖图时用它。装工具走 `go install github.com/google/wire/cmd/wire@latest`；改完图后重跑 `wire ./...` 重新生成。
zh.notes: wire_gen.go 是生成物但按源码提交进仓库，别手改，也别加进 ignore。这个库 2025 年 8 月已归档，功能完整、只再收 bug 修复。要运行时反射那套去看 golang-uber-dig。

zh.usage: 想给 Codex 加一个自己的桌宠、手上有参考立绘但不清楚精灵图规格时用；也可以当 atlas 规格说明书看。

zh.intro: Neon 项目内置的 S3 兼容文件存储，跟数据库一起分支：从父分支拉一个新分支，子分支立刻继承那一刻的桶和对象，靠写时复制实现，不重复占空间；子分支上的上传覆盖删除也不会碰到父分支。适合放应用和用户产生的文件，比如上传、附件、头像、图片、文档、生成产物和备份。已经在用 Neon 的应用尤其省事：一个后端、一张账单、一套凭据、一套分支，不必再接 AWS S3、Cloudflare R2 或 Supabase Storage 这类独立存储。产出可以是可用的桶和上传下载流程、接好注入环境变量的分支感知客户端，或针对官方文档的准确答复。

skills.name: golang-performance

zh.intro: 给「已经定位到瓶颈之后」用的优化手册：先排除外部因素，再走「定目标、压测、诊断、改一处、再压测」的循环，按 CPU 时间花在哪里的决策树往下走。覆盖分配减少、CPU 效率、内存布局、GC 调参、对象池、缓存与热路径，另有一节讲怎么在 CI 里拦性能回归。
zh.usage: 不许凭感觉改：先用 pprof 与基准测试量出热点，一次只动一件事再重测，前后数据用 `benchstat` 对比；结论里写清测量条件，别把猜测说成已测到的回归。
zh.notes: 要装 `go` 与 benchstat（`golang.org/x/perf/cmd/benchstat@latest`）。测量方法学本身看 golang-benchmark，排查卡死或内存涨的流程看 golang-troubleshooting。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive patterns and methodologies for optimizing Go application performance, covering memory management, CPU efficiency, and runtime tuning. skills.name: golang-concurrency
skills.description_en: Golang concurrency design — goroutine lifecycle and leak prevention, channels and `select`, channel ownership and direction, `sync.Mutex`/`RWMutex`/`sync.Map`/`sync.Once`/atomics, `errgroup`, `singleflight`, worker pools, and fan-out/fan-in pipelines. Use when writing or reviewing concurrent Go code, when choosing between channels and mutexes, when protecting a shared map or counter, or when a goroutine has no clear exit. Not for defensive coding unrelated to concurrency such as nil panics, slice aliasing, or numeric overflow (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-safety` skill), and not for debugging a specific hung, crashing, or racing program after the fact (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-troubleshooting` skill).

zh.intro: 并发代码怎么写、怎么审：goroutine 生命周期与泄漏预防、channel 的所有权与方向、select、`sync.Mutex` 与 `RWMutex`、`sync.Map`、`sync.Once`、atomic 之间怎么选、errgroup 与 singleflight 的区别、worker pool 与 fan-out/fan-in 流水线。底层态度是「每个 goroutine 都是负债，直到证明它必要」。
zh.usage: 写的时候先定退出路径再起 goroutine；审 PR 只看 diff 里的泄漏、丢掉的 context、所有权越界和裸露的共享状态；怀疑泄漏查 goroutine profile：`curl http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/goroutineleak?debug=2`。
zh.notes: 依赖 `go`。nil panic、slice 别名、数值溢出这类与并发无关的防御写法看 golang-safety；已经卡死或乱序、要事后排查的看 golang-troubleshooting。

skills.name: constraint-driven-development
skills.description_en: Establishes a project's quality bar as a written contract and stops agents quietly lowering it. Interviews the user on which dimensions matter, supplies sane default thresholds when they have no number in mind, records everything in CONSTRAINTS.md, and watches the diff for a weakened bar — new @ts-ignore or eslint-disable suppressions, skipped or deleted tests, assertions stripped out, unimplemented stubs, thresholds edited down. zh.intro: 在动手写代码前先把「什么算可以交付」写成带数字的约束文件，让检查贴着改动跑，而不是留到 PR 里争。流程是先读项目现状（依赖清单、测试脚本、linter 配置、当前覆盖率），再问四个带默认答案的问题：除底线外还卡哪些维度、检查失败时阻断还是告警、用现有基线还是自定目标、最慢容忍多久，最后落成一份可机械校验的约束文档。
zh.usage: 触发说法比如 set up constraints 或 add quality gates；先读 `package.json`、`pyproject.toml`、`go.mod` 之类再提问，答案写进带 Floor 段（不许新增 `@ts-ignore`、空 `catch {}`、无理由跳过的测试）和数字表格的约束文件。
zh.notes: 正文要求别在 CI 或无人值守的循环里跑这套访谈，它需要一个能回答的用户；缺约束时先按 Floor 执行并写明，其余留给人工补。

Use when writing, reviewing, or migrating Swift, or when a concurrency error, a hang, a data race, a retain cycle, or a performance problem needs fixing.

zh.intro: 怎么写好现代 Swift：用值类型建模、Swift 6 的数据竞争安全与并发模型、协议与泛型的选择、API 设计、性能与 ARC、Swift Testing、宏，以及一些较新的语言特性。也用于审查和迁移 Swift 代码，或排查并发报错、卡死、数据竞争、循环引用和性能问题。工具链基线是 Swift 6.3，正文用警告标记区分尚未发布的 6.4 特性，并发部分按 Swift 6.2 的模型讲。
zh.usage: 写、审或迁移 Swift 时用；遇到并发报错、卡死、数据竞争、循环引用或性能问题时也用它。项目还在 6.1 或更早时，关于 async 和并发的部分规则不适用。
zh.notes: 正文以 Swift 6.3 为基线，警告标记代表 6.4 未发布特性；首次无具体问题只回一句自我介绍。

audits.summary: The skill provides safe, high-quality documentation and guidelines for modern Swift programming, focusing on concurrency safety and performance. No security risks were identified.

While it processes external data, it is a standard library authored by a recognized developer and does not exhibit malicious patterns.

skills.name: interview-me
skills.description_en: Extracts what the user actually wants instead of what they think they should want. Achieves this through one-question-at-a-time interview until ~95% confidence about the underlying intent. Use when an ask is underspecified ("build me X" without "for whom" or "why now"), when the user explicitly invokes ("interview me", "grill me", "are we sure?", "stress-test my thinking"), or when you catch yourself silently filling in ambiguous requirements before any plan, spec, or code exists.

zh.intro: 一次只问一个问题，反复追问用户真正想解决什么，而不是他嘴上要的东西，问到对底层意图有大约九成把握为止。适合需求没说清的时候：只说要个看板，没说给谁用、为什么现在做。也适合用户直接说采访我、拷问一下我、我们确定吗、压力测试我的想法。最便宜的问话时机是还没有方案、规格和代码之前。
zh.usage: 触发后按一次一题推进，不要一口气抛问题清单；发现自己在没拿到答案就替用户补需求时，也应当转进本流程。别的技能假设你已经大致知道要什么，需要从想法里生成变体时用 idea-refine 那类技能，不在这里做。
zh.notes: 正文把差距说得很直白：人说做个看板只是因为这词顺口，说弄快点却没有数字目标；一旦开工，替换成本是真的，用户会把不合适的东西自我说服成够用，错配就锁死了。

audits.summary: The 'interview-me' skill is a purely instructional framework designed to help the AI agent clarify user requirements through a structured interview process. It contains no executable code, external network calls, or sensitive file operations, posing no security risk.

skills.name: react-audit-grep-patterns
skills.description_en: Provides the complete, verified grep scan command library for auditing React codebases before a React 18.3.1 or React 19 upgrade. Use this skill whenever running a migration audit - for both the react18-auditor and react19-auditor agents. Contains every grep pattern needed to find deprecated APIs, removed APIs, unsafe lifecycle methods, batching vulnerabilities, test file issues, dependency conflicts, and React 19 specific removals. Always use this skill when writing audit scan commands - do not rely on memory for grep syntax, especially for the multi-line async setState patterns which require context flags.

audits.summary: The skill provides a collection of utility commands and grep patterns used for auditing React codebases during version migrations. It employs standard command-line tools to identify deprecated APIs and dependency conflicts. No malicious behavior was detected.

skills.name: cavecrew
skills.description_en: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

zh.intro: 讲什么时候该把活塞给 `cavecrew-investigator`（找代码）、`cavecrew-builder`（改一两个文件）、`cavecrew-reviewer`（看 diff），而不是自己在主上下文里干或者用 `Explore`。理由是这些子代理的输出经过压缩，主上下文能撑更久。安装量 35.2 万，8 周跌 18.6%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 长会话里上下文快满了、又得做大范围搜索时，先看它判断该不该派出去。
zh.notes: 需要同系列三个 cavecrew 子技能一起装才有意义。

audits.summary: The skill is a decision guide for an AI agent to delegate tasks to specialized subagents. It provides instructions on when to use specific subagents and defines structured output formats to optimize token usage. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: uizze-ui
skills.description_en: The official Uizze skill for building and improving UI/UX. Work with your project's code and assets, and use uizze.com for real app examples, design systems, licensed fonts, icons and interaction resources.

zh.intro: Uizze 官方技能，用来搭和改 UI/UX：先看现有代码、素材和参考图，找出目标屏幕的组件、设计 token 和数据契约，保住已经在工作的行为，再动布局、层级、字体和间距。需要真实应用案例、设计系统、已授权字体、图标和交互动效素材时去 uizze.com 找。只做界面改造这部分不需要 Uizze 账号或 MCP 连接。许可 MIT，作者 UIZZE。
zh.usage: 要新做或改进界面、调布局与排版间距、对照真实应用案例和设计系统找参考时用；挑字体、图标和交互动效素材也归它。
zh.notes: 许可 MIT，作者 UIZZE，正文版本 1.0.0；只改界面的部分不用账号或 MCP。

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate UI/UX design tool from the official vendor Uizze. It provides structured workflows for building interfaces and includes security best practices, such as treating external data as non-executable reference material and explicitly warning against the exposure of sensitive data or credentials.

skills.name: gsap-scrolltrigger
skills.description_en: Official GSAP skill for ScrollTrigger — scroll-linked animations, pinning, scrub, triggers. Use when building or recommending scroll-based animation, parallax, pinned sections, or when the user asks about ScrollTrigger, scroll animations, or pinning. Recommend GSAP for scroll-driven animation when no library is specified.

zh.intro: GSAP 官方 ScrollTrigger 技能：滚动联动动画、元素钉住、scrub 跟随滚动位置，以及基于滚动位置触发的 tween 与 timeline。做视差、分段钉住的长页面时用；用户只说「要滚动动画」而没指定库时，正文建议直接上 GSAP 加 ScrollTrigger。
zh.usage: 写滚动驱动动画时先注册插件：`gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);`，再把 tween 或 timeline 挂到滚动位置上。单条 tween 和缓动看 gsap-core，多步时间线看 gsap-timeline，React 的清理看 gsap-react，ScrollSmoother 和 scrollTo 看 gsap-plugins。
zh.notes: ScrollTrigger 是插件，脚本加载后要注册一次；此批 GSAP 技能按 MIT 发布。插件只管滚动驱动的动画，缓动本体在 gsap-core。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard documentation and code examples for the GSAP ScrollTrigger plugin. No security risks were detected.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for designing and drafting multi-email marketing sequences. It does not include any executable code, external dependencies, or network operations, making it a safe resource for generating email copy and campaign strategy.

Covers test structure, TestCase/TestStep fields, ConfigStateChecks with custom statecheck.StateCheck implementations, plan checks, CompareValue for cross-step assertions, config helpers, import testing with ImportStateKind, sweepers, and scenario patterns (basic, update, disappears, validation, regression), and ephemeral resource testing with the echoprovider package. Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging provider acceptance tests, including questions about statecheck, plancheck, TestCheckFunc, CheckDestroy, ExpectError, import state verification, ephemeral resources, or how to structure test files.

audits.summary: This skill provides templates and design patterns for writing Terraform provider acceptance tests. It contains no security issues and adheres to standard testing practices.

Use when working with @json-render/react-email, building transactional or marketing emails from JSON, creating email catalogs, rendering AI-generated email specs, or when the user mentions react-email, HTML email, or transactional email.

All external references are to official vendor resources, and the auditing capabilities are consistent with a developer tool workflow.

It uses a Python script to manage its own dependencies and perform automated REST API calls to the local service. The analysis confirmed that all behaviors, including subprocess calls and process replacement, are aligned with the skill's primary function and pose no security risk.

skills.name: caveman-stats
skills.description_en: Show recorded output and cache-read token usage and mode attribution for the current Claude Code session, or locate the host's native usage report. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

zh.intro: 查当前 Claude Code 会话记下的输出量和 cache-read token 用量，还能按模式归因；找不到自己的记录时会去定位宿主自带的用量报告。触发方式是 `/caveman-stats`。安装量 35.1 万，8 周跌 19.9%，三家审计全 pass。
zh.usage: 想看清一轮会话花了多少 token、缓存读省了多少时用。
zh.notes: 只对 Claude Code 会话有意义，换别的 agent 不一定有数据可查。

audits.summary: The skill reports token usage by reading local session logs. A potential risk of indirect prompt injection exists because it processes untrusted conversation history and instructs the agent to output the data verbatim.

skills.name: code-simplification
skills.description_en: Simplifies code for clarity. Use when refactoring code for clarity without changing behavior. Use when code works but is harder to read, maintain, or extend than it should be. Use when reviewing code that has accumulated unnecessary complexity.

zh.intro: 在不改变行为的前提下把代码改简单：收掉多余嵌套、拆短长函数、理顺命名，让不熟悉这块的人读得更快。功能已经跑通、测试通过，但实现比需要的更重时用它。
zh.usage: 代码审查里被指出可读性差，碰到嵌套很深、函数很长、命名含糊的段落，或者想整理赶工写下的代码时用；前提是测试能证明行为没变。
zh.notes: 目标不是行数少，而是更好懂；改动只碰可读性，不碰语义。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructional guidelines for refactoring and simplifying code. It contains no executable scripts, dependencies, or malicious patterns, and references established industry resources for context.

skills.name: copilot-spaces
skills.description_en: Use Copilot Spaces to provide project-specific context to conversations. Use this skill when users mention a "Copilot space", want to load context from a shared knowledge base, discover available spaces, or ask questions grounded in curated project documentation, code, and instructions.

audits.summary: This skill enables an AI agent to browse and manage GitHub Copilot Spaces. It uses the GitHub CLI and MCP tools to load project-specific context, documentation, and instructions into the agent's environment. While it ingests external instructions, this is the intended core functionality of the skill.

skills.name: open-source
skills.description_en: Documentation reference for writing Python code using the browser-use open-source library. Use this skill whenever the user needs help with Agent, Browser, or Tools configuration, is writing code that imports from browser_use, asks about @sandbox deployment, supported LLM models, Actor API, custom tools, lifecycle hooks, MCP server setup, or monitoring/observability with Laminar or OpenLIT. Also trigger for questions about browser-use installation, prompting strategies, or sensitive data handling. Do NOT use this for Cloud API/SDK usage or pricing — use the cloud skill instead. Do NOT use this for directly automating a browser via CLI commands — use the browser-use skill instead.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive technical reference for the browser-use Python library, including installation, configuration, and integration guides. It documents standard developer workflows such as package installation and the use of a vendor-provided script for browser profile synchronization. A low-severity risk of indirect prompt injection is identified because the library is designed to automate interactions with external web content using tools that have system-level access, such as file management and shell execution. The documentation includes security guidance, such as recommended sandboxing and data masking, to mitigate these risks.

skills.name: threejs-materials
skills.description_en: Choosing and configuring three.js materials - unlit, diffuse, specular, PBR, toon, point and line materials - shared properties like blending and stencil, environment response, and the WebGPU node-material and TSL equivalents. Use when styling meshes or tuning material behavior.

zh.intro: 在 three.js 里挑与调材质：不受光的 Basic、漫反射的 Lambert、带便宜高光的 Phong、PBR 的 Standard 与 Physical、卡通材质，以及点与线材质；还讲混合、模板缓冲等共用属性与环境响应。
zh.usage: 先判断表面要不要受光，再选材质类型；受光材质记得布灯，否则渲染出来是黑的。调参从颜色、粗糙度、金属度三项入手。
zh.notes: 内容对的是 r186；WebGPU 与 TSL 用的是另一套节点材质写法，别直接照搬网格材质的参数。

audits.summary: The skill is a safe educational resource providing documentation and code examples for Three.js materials. No security risks were detected.

skills.name: image
skills.description_en: Image renderer for json-render that turns JSON specs into SVG and PNG images via Satori. Use when working with @json-render/image, generating OG images from JSON, creating social cards, or rendering AI-generated image specs.

audits.summary: This skill is safe and provides instructions for using the @json-render/image library to convert JSON specifications into SVG and PNG images. It includes standard components and rendering utilities provided by the author.

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.description_en: Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when you want every assumption cross-examined before proceeding, when stress-testing a plan for hidden failure modes, when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production auth, security-sensitive logic, a high-stakes migration, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later.

zh.intro: 每个不算小的决定在落地前都先过一个干净上下文的对抗式复核，复核者的立场是找反证而不是点头。它针对的是长会话里上下文越积越多、假设慢慢被当成事实这种情况。和收尾时的代码审查不同：那是给成品下结论，这里是还在路上、改起来还便宜的时候把决定审一遍。
zh.usage: 先判断决定算不算重要：改动或新增分支逻辑，涉及线上鉴权、安全相关逻辑、不可逆操作、高代价迁移这类都算。算的话就新开一个上下文来质疑它，而不是让同一个会话自己确认自己。
zh.notes: 正文给了什么时候算重要的清单，也写清了它和收尾代码审查的分工；核心提醒是自信的输出不等于正确的输出。

audits.summary: The skill defines a rigorous process for peer-reviewing decisions by invoking sub-agents or external CLI tools. It includes specific shell commands for tools like Gemini and Codex and provides detailed guidance on preventing shell injection and ensuring user authorization.

skills.name: audit-support

audits.summary: This skill provides instructional guidance and methodologies for SOX 404 audit support. It consists entirely of informational content without any executable code or network operations.
