skills.description_en: gws CLI: Shared patterns for authentication, global flags, and output formatting.

zh.intro: gws 命令行工具的公共部分：怎么登录、有哪些全局开关、输出格式怎么选，以及命令行的调用语法。跑任何 Google Workspace 的 gws 子命令之前都该先过一遍，尤其是输出格式和 --dry-run、--page-all 这类决定一次请求怎么发、结果怎么给的开关。
zh.usage: 装好 gws 并保证它在 PATH 上之后，用 `gws auth login` 走浏览器 OAuth，或给服务账号设 `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/path/to/key.json`。语法是 `gws <service> <resource> [sub-resource] <method> [flags]`；传参用 `--params '{"key": "val"}'` 与 `--json '{"key": "val"}'`，全局开关有 `--format`、`--dry-run`、`--sanitize`、`--page-all`。
zh.notes: 前置是 gws 二进制已在 PATH 上（正文的 requires.bins 里写了 gws）。`--dry-run` 只做本地校验不发请求，`--sanitize` 让响应过一遍 Model Armor。

audits.summary: This skill provides a shared reference and usage patterns for the Google Workspace (gws) command-line interface. It includes safety guidelines for agents, such as using dry-run modes, sanitizing output, and requiring user confirmation for destructive actions.

skills.name: physical-ai-people-attribute-search
skills.description_en: Use when running people attribute search (PAS) image augmentation and auto-labeling workflows on OSMO: flow selection, preflight, submit-time interpolation, monitoring, and output retrieval. Trigger keywords: people attribute search, PAS, person augmentation, attribute search, person re-identification, clothing augmentation, person crop augmentation.

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It provides a comprehensive workflow orchestrator for Person Attribute Search (PAS) on the NVIDIA OSMO platform. The skill securely handles credential configuration for Hugging Face and NVIDIA registries and manages distributed worker scripts for image augmentation and labeling.

skills.name: co-marketing
skills.description_en: When the user wants to find co-marketing partners, plan joint campaigns, or brainstorm partnership opportunities. Use when the user says 'co-marketing,' 'partner marketing,' 'joint campaign,' 'who should we partner with,' 'integration marketing,' 'cross-promotion,' 'collaborate with another company,' 'partnership ideas,' or 'co-brand.' For customer referral programs, see referrals. For launch-specific partnerships, see launch.

zh.intro: 给 SaaS 找联合营销伙伴、策划联合活动、评估合作契合度并搭合作框架。给做伙伴营销和集成营销的人用，解决「该跟谁一起做活动、怎么谈」的问题。
zh.usage: 用户说 co-marketing、partner marketing、联合活动、该找谁合作、integration marketing、互相导量、co-brand 时用它。开头先找产品营销上下文，有 `.agents/product-marketing.md` 就先读，读到了就别重复问。
zh.notes: 正文明确要按已有上下文只问没覆盖到的信息。客户推荐计划看 referrals，发布相关的合作看 launch。

audits.summary: The skill is a strategic guide for SaaS co-marketing and partnerships. It provides frameworks for partner identification, campaign planning, and outreach templates. No security risks or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: test-tui
skills.description_en: Guide for testing Codex TUI interactively

audits.summary: This skill is safe and provides instructions for interactive testing of the Codex TUI, utilizing standard development practices like environment-based logging and local command runners.

skills.name: signup
skills.description_en: When the user wants to optimize signup, registration, account creation, or trial activation flows. Also use when the user mentions "signup conversions," "registration friction," "signup form optimization," "free trial signup," "reduce signup dropoff," "account creation flow," "people aren't signing up," "signup abandonment," "trial conversion rate," "nobody completes registration," "too many steps to sign up," or "simplify our signup." Use this whenever the user has a signup or registration flow that isn't performing. For post-signup onboarding, see onboarding. For lead capture forms (not account creation), see cro.

zh.intro: 优化注册、开户和免费试用激活流程的技能：把步骤砍短、提高完成率，让注册完的人顺利进入首次使用。动手前先读产品营销上下文文件，把已经写下来的人群和定位信息拿过来，少问重复问题。适合注册漏斗表现差、试用转化率低、注册步骤太多的场景。
zh.usage: 用户说「注册转化低」「注册流失」「试用转化率」「表单太长」时用它；先确认 `.agents/product-marketing.md` 之类的上下文文件在不在，读到了就不要再问里面已有的信息。注册之后的新手引导转 onboarding，只收集线索、不建账号的表单转 cro。
zh.notes: 动手前要能拿到当前注册步骤和转化数据，正文的 Initial Assessment 一节就是收集这些的。注册后的引导看 onboarding，线索采集表单看 cro。

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe, but it possesses an indirect prompt injection surface because it reads external project files for context without specifying boundary markers or sanitization.

skills.name: sentry-sdk-skill-creator
skills.description_en: Create a complete Sentry SDK skill bundle for any platform. Use when asked to "create an SDK skill", "add a new platform skill", "write a Sentry skill for X", or build a new sentry-<platform>-sdk skill bundle with wizard flow and feature reference files.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for an AI agent to build and verify Sentry SDK integrations. It emphasizes research from official Sentry documentation and GitHub repositories. It avoids security risks by instructing the agent to direct users to perform interactive authentication and installation steps themselves rather than attempting to automate sensitive operations.

skills.name: react-best-practices
skills.description_en: React performance optimization guidelines from Mastra Engineering. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, data fetching, bundle optimization, or performance improvements.

audits.summary: The skill provides a set of React performance optimization guidelines and best practices. It consists solely of Markdown documentation and code examples for React, TypeScript, and testing patterns. No malicious code, obfuscation, or data exfiltration risks were identified.

skills.name: docstring
skills.description_en: Write docstrings for PyTorch functions and methods following PyTorch conventions. Use when writing or updating docstrings in PyTorch code.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive guidelines and best practices for writing docstrings in the PyTorch project. It follows standard Sphinx and reStructuredText conventions and includes examples for various function types. No security considerations were identified.

skills.name: debugging-dags
skills.description_en: Comprehensive DAG failure diagnosis and root-cause analysis  with structured investigation and prevention recommendations. Use when deep failure investigation is needed, a DAG fails to import/parse or 'airflow dags list' errors on a file; a task or run is failing and must be diagnosed and fixed; requests like 'why did X fail', 'my dag keeps failing — find and fix it', or fixing a broken DAG so it loads cleanly. For simple 'why did it fail / show logs', the airflow skill handles it directly.

audits.summary: Error: AI Analysis failed - API error after retries

skills.name: firecrawl-build-crawl
skills.description_en: Integrate Firecrawl `/crawl` into product code for bulk extraction across a site or site section. Use when a feature needs many related pages, such as documentation sets, help centers, or blogs, and page-by-page `/scrape` would be too manual.

audits.summary: The skill provides guidance and documentation for integrating Firecrawl's crawl feature into product code. It defines necessary API inputs but contains no executable code or malicious instructions.

skills.name: firecrawl-build-map
skills.description_en: Integrate Firecrawl `/map` into product code for URL discovery on a known site. Use when a feature needs to find pages before scraping or crawling, especially on large docs sites, blogs, or help centers where the exact target URLs are not known yet.

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and guidance for using Firecrawl's URL discovery feature. It contains no executable code or security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: image-to-ui
skills.description_en: Recreate an image, screenshot, or mockup as a 1:1 UI implementation. Match the reference rather than redesigning it, then render and compare the result to correct visible differences.

zh.intro: 把截图、设计稿或参考图还原成一致的界面代码：这张图就是视觉规格，照着复刻而不是重新设计，写完渲染出来对照，把看得见的差异改掉。
zh.usage: 拿到界面图要照着实现、或者做出来的界面和参考图对不上时用它。动手前先真的看图，文件名、文字描述和识别出来的文字都不够。
zh.notes: 图被裁过就只还原看得见的部分，别自己补看不见的区块；图不清晰就先要一张能看清的，别猜。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for recreating UI designs from images. It includes explicit safety guidelines for the agent to ignore any commands or text contained within reference images, effectively mitigating indirect prompt injection risks. The skill involves standard UI development tasks like writing code and running the interface for verification.

skills.name: account-research
skills.description_en: Research a target company and optionally a specific contact - company overview, recent news, likely priorities, and fit against your ICP. Cross-references existing CRM records. Use when the user asks to "research [company]", "look into [company]", "prospect research on [company]", "look up [person]", "intel on [prospect]", "who is [person] at [company]", or "tell me about [company]" when the company is a prospect rather than an existing account.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for conducting business research using web searches and connected enterprise tools. It is functionally focused on data synthesis and reporting and follows standard patterns for research-oriented skills.

skills.name: content-strategy
skills.description_en: When the user wants to plan a content strategy, decide what content to create, or figure out what topics to cover. Also use when the user mentions "content strategy," "what should I write about," "content ideas," "blog strategy," "topic clusters," "content planning," "editorial calendar," "content marketing," "content roadmap," "what content should I create," "blog topics," "content pillars," or "I don't know what to write." Use this whenever someone needs help deciding what content to produce, not just writing it. For writing individual pieces, see copywriting. For SEO-specific audits, see seo-audit. For social media content specifically, see social.

zh.intro: 描述为空。同属 coreyhaines31 的 marketingskills，名字对应内容策略这块，安装量 15.9 万，8 周涨 13.8%；审计里 Snyk 给 warn，其余四家 pass。
zh.usage: 要给博客或公众号定选题框架和内容支柱时；跟同仓库的营销心理学搭配，一个管讲什么、一个管为什么这么讲。
zh.notes: 无正文；Snyk warn；同仓库三条都是空描述，选之前各读一遍。

audits.summary: The skill is a safe and professional content strategy framework. It lacks any malicious code, obfuscation, or data exfiltration patterns. It processes external research data (transcripts, surveys, forum posts) as part of its core function, which is a standard but low-risk practice for this use case.

skills.name: fix-errors
skills.description_en: Guidelines for fixing unhandled errors from the VS Code error telemetry dashboard. Use when investigating error-telemetry issues with stack traces, error messages, and hit/user counts. Covers tracing data flow through call stacks, identifying producers of invalid data vs. consumers that crash, enriching error messages for telemetry diagnosis, and avoiding common anti-patterns like silently swallowing errors.

audits.summary: This skill provides developer guidelines for diagnosing and fixing unhandled errors in telemetry. It includes best practices such as data flow tracing and enriching error messages with diagnostic context while explicitly advising to truncate values to protect sensitive information. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: api-and-interface-design
skills.description_en: Guides stable API and interface design. Use when designing APIs, module boundaries, or any public interface. Use when creating REST or GraphQL endpoints, defining type contracts between modules, or establishing boundaries between frontend and backend.

zh.intro: 设计稳定、不容易被误用的接口：REST 端点、GraphQL 结构、模块边界、类型契约和组件参数。原则是所有对外可见的行为迟早都会被人依赖，连没写进文档的怪癖、报错文字和顺序都算事实契约。
zh.usage: 新设计 API 端点、定模块之间的边界、写类型契约，或者要改动已有公共接口时用它；数据库结构会决定接口形状，所以那里也要一起想。
zh.notes: 改公共行为按破坏性变更处理；正文引了 Hyrum 定律解释为什么不能只看书面承诺。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive guidance and best practices for designing stable and secure APIs and interfaces. It consists entirely of documentation and educational code examples with no executable scripts, remote downloads, or risky operations detected. It explicitly promotes secure practices such as input validation at boundaries, handling race conditions, and treating third-party data as untrusted.

skills.name: golang-observability
skills.description_en: Golang everyday observability — the always-on signals in production. Covers structured logging with slog, Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, continuous profiling with pprof/Pyroscope, server-side RUM event tracking, alerting, and Grafana dashboards. Apply when instrumenting Go services for production monitoring, setting up metrics or alerting, adding OpenTelemetry tracing, correlating logs with traces, migrating legacy loggers (zap/logrus/zerolog) to slog, adding observability to new features, or implementing GDPR/CCPA-compliant tracking with Customer Data Platforms (CDP). Not for temporary deep-dive performance investigation (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-benchmark` and `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-performance` skills).

zh.intro: 盯生产环境常开的那几路信号：用 log/slog 出结构化日志、Prometheus 指标、OpenTelemetry 分布式链路、pprof 与 Pyroscope 持续剖析、服务端 RUM 事件，以及告警和 Grafana 看板。默认模式是给新代码补可观测性，review 模式查新代码有没有导出该有的信号，audit 模式按信号开五个子代理并行查覆盖率。也管把 zap、logrus、zerolog 迁到 slog，和 CDP 场景下符合 GDPR/CCPA 的埋点。
zh.usage: 给新服务或新功能接监控时用；迁旧 logger、给功能补链路、配告警和看板都在范围内。
zh.notes: 正文提醒具体 API 签名以各库官方文档为准，别照抄记忆里的写法。

audits.summary: This skill provides best practices and instrumentation guides for Go observability, covering logging, metrics, tracing, and profiling. It promotes secure patterns like PII avoidance in logs and protected profiling endpoints. The analysis identified an indirect prompt injection attack surface due to the skill's multi-agent auditing functionality which processes external codebases, though no specific vulnerabilities or malicious intent were found.

skills.name: hsb-app
skills.description_en: Discover and run Holoscan Sensor Bridge example applications on a connected devkit. Filters available apps by the user's platform, HSB software version, board type, and sensors. Supports timed execution, failure analysis, code-edit suggestions, and iterative re-runs.

audits.summary: The hsb-app skill is designed to manage Holoscan Sensor Bridge applications on remote devkits. It uses SSH for command execution and high-privilege Docker containers to interact with hardware sensors. The skill includes mandatory confirmation gates for all operations and manages session state on the remote host to ensure user control and workflow consistency.

skills.name: ppt-visual
skills.description_en: Design presentation visuals and slide layouts. Create visual concepts, suggest graphics, and provide design specifications for impactful PowerPoint slides.

audits.summary: This skill acts as a design assistant for creating PowerPoint presentations, offering slide layout wireframes, color schemes, and typography advice. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or security risks were detected.

skills.name: referrals
skills.description_en: When the user wants to create, optimize, or analyze a referral program, affiliate program, or word-of-mouth strategy. Also use when the user mentions 'referral,' 'affiliate,' 'ambassador,' 'word of mouth,' 'viral loop,' 'refer a friend,' 'partner program,' 'referral incentive,' 'how to get referrals,' 'customers referring customers,' 'affiliate payout,' 'get more reviews,' 'G2 reviews,' 'review campaign,' or 'respond to a bad review.' Use this whenever someone wants existing users or partners to bring in new customers. For launch-specific virality, see launch.

zh.intro: 设计和优化推荐计划、联盟计划与口碑增长：推荐激励怎么设、联盟怎么结算、老带新的循环怎么转起来；也覆盖评价相关的事，比如冲 G2 评价和差评怎么回。适合想让老用户或合作伙伴带来新客户的时候。
zh.usage: 要建或改推荐与联盟项目、评估口碑策略、或者用户拿来一个差评问怎么处理时用它。它会先读 `.agents/product-marketing.md`（旧路径 `.claude/product-marketing.md`，更早的 `product-marketing-context.md`）拿产品定位，缺的信息会先问。发布活动特有的病毒传播看 launch。
zh.notes: 覆盖机制与激励设计，不包含支付或结算系统的实现；开始前会找产品营销上下文文件。发布相关的拉新看 launch 技能。

audits.summary: The skill is a strategic and operational guide for managing growth through referral, affiliate, and review programs. It provides templates, economic frameworks, and compliance advice for platform-specific rules (e.g., Google, Trustpilot, G2). The analysis found no signs of malicious code, prompt injection, or data exfiltration. The skill specifically includes instructions to maintain privacy and treat external data with caution, aligning with security best practices.

skills.name: firebase-security-rules-auditor
skills.description_en: Audits Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Storage) security rules for vulnerabilities, privilege escalation, role bypasses, create vs update inconsistencies, resource exhaustion, type safety, size limits, and hasOnly ownership checks. Use when auditing/reviewing rules, running red-team rule assessments, or scoring against auditor checklists. Don't use for Firebase CLI (login, deploy), Auth, Crashlytics, Remote Config, or database queries.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework and instructions for auditing Firebase Security Rules. It defines a persona for the agent and a specific set of security checks to perform on provided configuration files. No malicious patterns, code execution, or data exfiltration risks were identified.

skills.name: onboarding
skills.description_en: When the user wants to optimize post-signup onboarding, user activation, first-run experience, or time-to-value. Also use when the user mentions "onboarding flow," "activation rate," "user activation," "first-run experience," "empty states," "onboarding checklist," "aha moment," "new user experience," "users aren't activating," "nobody completes setup," "low activation rate," "users sign up but don't use the product," "time to value," or "first session experience." Use this whenever users are signing up but not sticking around. For signup/registration optimization, see signup. For ongoing email sequences, see emails.

zh.intro: 注册之后到用户真正用起来这段路怎么修：激活率、首次运行体验、空状态、onboarding 清单，目标是把用户尽快推到 aha moment 并形成习惯。适合「注册量还行但没人用下去」的产品。
zh.usage: 用户注册了却不回来、激活率低、没人走完设置流程时用它。它会先读 `.agents/product-marketing.md`（或旧路径 `.claude/product-marketing.md`、更早的 `product-marketing-context.md`）拿产品定位，再问缺的信息。注册流程本身的优化看 signup，后续的邮件序列看 emails。
zh.notes: 聚焦注册之后的激活和首次体验，不负责注册页转化（那是 signup），也不负责后续邮件（那是 emails）；开始前会找产品营销上下文文件。

audits.summary: The skill is an expert-level instructional guide for optimizing user onboarding and activation flows. It consists entirely of informational content and poses no security risks.

skills.name: new-user
skills.description_en: Create an admin user in Medusa

audits.summary: The skill allows creating an admin user in Medusa via the command line. It introduces a minor security risk because user inputs are directly interpolated into a shell command without explicit boundaries or sanitization instructions, creating a potential command injection surface.

skills.name: hatch-pet
skills.description_en: Create, repair, validate, visually QA, and package Codex-compatible animated pets and pet spritesheets from character art, generated images, company or prospect brand cues, or visual references. Use when a user wants a lightweight-worker Codex pet workflow, a non-pixel custom pet style, a prospect or company mascot pet, or a full 8x9 animated pet atlas with transparent unused cells, QA contact sheets, and pet.json packaging. This skill composes the installed $imagegen system skill for visual generation and uses bundled scripts for deterministic spritesheet assembly.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured workflow for creating and packaging animated pets using image generation and local processing scripts. It features security considerations such as isolating generation tasks into subagents and using deterministic scripts for image validation. A minor consideration is the ingestion of external data for brand research, which is a core part of the skill's design and is handled appropriately.

skills.name: seeker-genesis-token
skills.description_en: Verify Seeker device ownership by checking for the Seeker Genesis Token (SGT) with Sign-in-with-Solana and server-side token verification. Use when gating content or rewards to Seeker owners, verifying a user holds an SGT, adding anti-Sybil checks to a Solana mobile app, or implementing one-claim-per-device logic.

zh.intro: 校验 Seeker 设备归属的技能：用 Sign-in-with-Solana 拿到 Seeker Genesis Token，再在服务端验证它，从而把内容或奖励限定给 Seeker 持有者。也用于给移动应用加防女巫检查和一台设备只能领一次的逻辑。
zh.usage: 要给 Seeker 用户开白名单、做一机一领或加防刷检查时用它；先想清楚验证放在服务端哪一步。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令与参数以正文为准；正文把链上持有证明和服务端校验分成两段。

audits.summary: The seeker-genesis-token skill provides secure implementation patterns for verifying Seeker Genesis Token ownership. It covers server-side nonce generation, wallet signature verification using Sign-in-with-Solana (SIWS), and on-chain token metadata validation. The instructions emphasize security best practices, including input sanitization, key derivation from target addresses, and atomic transaction handling for anti-Sybil protections.

skills.name: solana-mobile
skills.description_en: Scaffold, configure, and troubleshoot Solana Mobile apps for Android using the solana-mobile CLI, Expo, and React Native. Use when creating a new Solana mobile app, picking a template, adding Solana to an existing Expo app, checking the Android toolchain, managing Android emulators or connected devices, installing a wallet APK for testing, running a local validator the device can reach, or producing a development build.

zh.intro: 用 solana-mobile 命令行、Expo 和 React Native 搭 Solana 安卓应用的技能：选模板、给已有 Expo 工程接上 Solana、检查安卓工具链、管理模拟器与真机、装测试钱包、起设备能连上的本地验证节点，以及出开发构建。
zh.usage: 新建 Solana 移动项目、给现有 Expo 应用加链上能力，或安卓环境和设备连不上时用它；先跑工具链检查，再往下搭。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令与参数以正文为准；正文把命令行工具、Expo 工程和安卓工具链分开讲。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for scaffolding and troubleshooting Solana Mobile applications. It utilizes official CLI tools and libraries from the Solana Mobile organization. It includes security best practices by explicitly warning developers not to include sensitive RPC keys in environment variables that are bundled into mobile applications. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: seeker-domains
skills.description_en: Resolve and display .skr domain names in Solana mobile apps, in both directions between names and wallet addresses. Use when showing .skr names instead of wallet addresses in profiles, friend lists, or transaction history, resolving a .skr domain to an address, reverse-looking-up an address to a domain, or validating .skr input.

zh.intro: 在 Solana 移动应用里处理 .skr 域名：把域名解析成钱包地址，也把地址反查成域名，用于个人页、好友列表和交易记录里换掉一长串地址；另外包含对用户输入的 .skr 名称做校验。
zh.usage: 界面要显示 .skr 名字、做地址反查，或核对用户填的域名时用它；先分清这一步是正查还是反查。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令与参数以正文为准；正文把正查、反查和输入校验分开讲。

audits.summary: This skill provides a secure and well-architected framework for resolving .skr domain names on Solana. It includes robust security guidance, such as protecting RPC keys through backend proxying, implementing rate limits and origin allowlists, and warning about the risks of caching payment destinations or trusting reverse-resolved names.

skills.name: polish
skills.description_en: Performs a final quality pass fixing alignment, spacing, consistency, and micro-detail issues before shipping. Use when the user mentions polish, finishing touches, pre-launch review, something looks off, or wants to go from good to great.

zh.intro: 交付前最后一轮质量过手，修对齐、间距、一致性和微细节。正文有强制准备步骤：先调用 /impeccable，它带着设计原则、反模式和 Context Gathering Protocol；还没有设计上下文时必须先跑 /impeccable teach，另外要确认质量档（MVP 还是旗舰）。之后做设计系统勘查：找设计系统文档、组件库、样式指南或 token 定义，摸清颜色 token、间距刻度、排版样式和组件 API，以及共享组件的导入方式。
zh.usage: 用户说打磨、收尾、上线前检查、看着哪里不对，或要从「能用」做到「好看」时调用；先拿到设计上下文和质量档，再对照设计系统逐项过细节。
zh.notes: 依赖 /impeccable 的设计上下文，缺上下文要先跑 /impeccable teach；参数是目标范围（argument-hint 为 [target]）。

audits.summary: This skill provides a set of instructions and a systematic checklist for performing a final quality pass on code and design assets. It focuses on aesthetics, usability, and code cleanliness without any security risks identified.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.description_en: Optimizes application performance across frontend, backend, queries, and databases. Use when performance requirements exist, when you suspect performance regressions, when Core Web Vitals or load times need improvement, when N+1 query patterns need fixing, or when profiling reveals bottlenecks.

zh.intro: 优化应用性能，前端、后端、查询和数据库都算。核心是先测量再动手，用剖析找到真正的瓶颈，改完再测一遍；没有证据就不要优化，过早优化只会添复杂度。
zh.usage: 有加载时间或响应时间指标、监控报慢、核心网页指标不达标时再用；先剖析再改，改完复测对比。
zh.notes: 正文列了核心网页指标的达标线，并明确没有证据时不该动手优化。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive performance optimization workflow. It is generally safe, although it presents an attack surface for indirect prompt injection through the analysis of external performance logs and traces.

skills.name: nextjs-on-cloudflare
skills.description_en: Build, migrate, and deploy Next.js apps on Cloudflare Workers with vinext. Use when starting a Next.js project on Cloudflare, moving an existing app to Workers, choosing between vinext and OpenNext, or setting up vinext for Workers. For setup, migration, or deployment, install vinext's upstream skills with `npx skills add cloudflare/vinext` if missing, then read and follow the applicable skill and docs.

zh.intro: 在 Cloudflare Workers 上用 vinext 搭、迁、部署 Next.js 应用。新项目默认选 vinext 而不是 OpenNext，这一点跟 Cloudflare 的 Next.js 官方指南一致。vinext 在 Vite 上重新实现了 Next.js 的 API：App Router、Pages Router、React Server Components 和受支持的 next/* 导入都在，配 Vite 的快速 HMR、原生 ESM 和插件生态。
zh.usage: 只在做新项目、从别处迁到 Workers、或者要在 vinext 和 OpenNext 之间做选择时用它。需要装 vinext 的上游技能就跑 npx skills add cloudflare/vinext，然后照它和文档走。具体的 Workers 绑定用法看官方指南。
zh.notes: 现存的 OpenNext 项目在做无关维护时保持原样，不要顺手迁；用户明确指定了方案就听用户的。

audits.summary: This skill is safe and provides guidance for deploying Next.js applications on Cloudflare Workers using the vinext framework. It includes references to official documentation and suggests installing related skills from the vendor's repository.

skills.name: golang-project-layout
skills.description_en: Golang project layout and workspace setup — cmd/internal/pkg directory conventions, module and package naming, go.work workspaces, and essential configuration files. Use when starting a new Go project, organizing an existing codebase, setting up a monorepo with multiple packages, creating CLI tools with multiple main packages, or discussing package restructuring, package splits, or module splits. Not for restructuring existing code without a layout change (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-refactoring` skill).

zh.intro: 定 Go 项目的目录和工作区：cmd/、internal/、pkg/ 各自该放什么，模块与包怎么命名，go.work 多模块怎么摆，以及那几个必备配置文件。做事方式是先问架构（clean architecture、六边形、DDD 还是扁平），再问依赖注入选哪条路（手写构造注入、samber/do、google/wire、uber-go/dig+fx 或者干脆不用），两个问题分开问、等一个答完再问下一个。它反复强调别把小项目撑大：一百行的 CLI 不需要分层和注入。
zh.usage: 起新项目、整理老仓库、拆多模块，或者判断某个包该不该挪进 `internal/` 时用；开场会先问你架构再问 DI，两个问题分开答。
zh.notes: 提问走宿主带的 question 工具，不是让你在对话里打字回答；需要 `go`。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard and useful guidance for Go project layouts and architectural decisions. However, it contains an instruction that directs the agent to modify the project's configuration files to automatically load an additional skill without requesting user confirmation, which bypasses standard interaction protocols.

skills.name: meeting-briefing
skills.description_en: Prepare structured briefings for meetings with legal relevance and track resulting action items. Use when preparing for contract negotiations, board meetings, compliance reviews, or any meeting where legal context, background research, or action tracking is needed.

audits.summary: This skill includes some security considerations such as its reliance on external data sources for meeting preparation. While these warrant review, they are used within the skill's intended functionality as a context-gathering tool. See detailed analysis for context.

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description_en: Review PyTorch pull requests for code quality, test coverage, security, and backward compatibility. Use when reviewing PRs, when asked to review code changes, or when the user mentions "review PR", "code review", or "check this PR".

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for reviewing PyTorch pull requests, focusing on code quality, testing, and infrastructure standards. It utilizes standard version control and repository management tools to automate the review process. A security consideration is the skill's design to process untrusted data from pull requests, such as descriptions and comments, which is a common pattern for review tools but introduces a potential surface for indirect prompt injection. The skill includes some helpful practices, like using boundary markers to separate data from instructions, to manage this consideration.

skills.name: at-dispatch-v2
skills.description_en: Convert PyTorch AT_DISPATCH macros to AT_DISPATCH_V2 format in ATen C++ code. Use when porting AT_DISPATCH_ALL_TYPES_AND*, AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES*, or other dispatch macros to the new v2 API. For ATen kernel files, CUDA kernels, and native operator implementations.

audits.summary: This skill is a focused refactoring tool for PyTorch C++ developers. It provides clear, legitimate instructions for migrating legacy macros to a new API. No security concerns were identified.

skills.name: frontend-ui-engineering
skills.description_en: Builds production-quality, accessible, responsive user-facing UIs. Use when building or modifying interfaces and pages, creating components, implementing layouts, meeting WCAG accessibility requirements, managing state, or when the output needs to look and feel production-quality rather than AI-generated.

zh.intro: 写面向用户的前端界面时用这条：组件怎么拆文件、目录怎么摆、响应式布局、交互与状态、无障碍要求都覆盖。目标是让页面看起来像懂设计的工程师做的，而不是一眼就能看出是 AI 生成的样子。
zh.usage: 做新组件或改现有页面时先看它的组件结构和无障碍清单，交付前按它的检查项再过一遍。
zh.notes: 正文给了组件目录的摆放结构，实现、测试和故事文件放在同一个目录下。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines and best practices for building high-quality, accessible, and responsive frontend user interfaces. No security risks, malicious patterns, or unauthorized data access were detected.

skills.name: create-phone-number
skills.description_en: Plan, provision, import, route, update, and verify Vapi phone numbers through the public API. Use for Vapi-hosted US PSTN numbers, explicitly requested SIP addresses, Twilio/Vonage/Telnyx or BYO carrier numbers, secure credential handling, assistant or squad routing, area-code requests, outbound limitations, and phone-provider troubleshooting.

audits.summary: The skill provides a set of instructions and implementation examples for managing Vapi phone numbers via their public API. It adheres to security best practices by requiring the use of environment variables for API keys, prohibiting the logging of sensitive credentials, and mandating explicit user confirmation before any chargeable actions are taken. All network operations are directed to the official vendor domain.

skills.name: call-prep
skills.description_en: Pre-call brief for an upcoming meeting - attendees, account history, prior call context from transcripts, open opportunity status, and suggested discovery questions. Use when the user asks "prep me for [meeting/company]", "call prep [company]", "I'm meeting with [company], prep me", "get me ready for [meeting]", or "what do I need to know before my [time] call".

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for preparing sales call briefs by synthesizing information from user input, web research, and optional business tool integrations. It includes considerations regarding the processing of external data from web searches and connected services.

skills.name: ai-seo
skills.description_en: When the user wants to optimize content for AI search engines, get cited by LLMs, or appear in AI-generated answers. Also use when the user mentions 'AI SEO,' 'AEO,' 'GEO,' 'LLMO,' 'answer engine optimization,' 'generative engine optimization,' 'LLM optimization,' 'AI Overviews,' 'optimize for ChatGPT,' 'optimize for Perplexity,' 'AI citations,' 'AI visibility,' 'zero-click search,' 'how do I show up in AI answers,' 'LLM mentions,' 'optimize for Claude/Gemini,' 'llms.txt,' 'llms-full.txt,' 'OKF,' 'Open Knowledge Format,' 'knowledge bundle,' 'agent-readable site,' 'agent readiness,' 'is my site agent-ready,' 'WebMCP,' 'do listicles still work for AI,' 'ChatGPT stopped citing comparison pages,' 'how do LLMs see our brand,' 'LinkedIn for AEO,' or 'AI citation format shift.' Use this whenever someone wants their content to be cited or surfaced by AI assistants and AI search engines. For traditional technical and on-page SEO audits, see seo-audit. For structured data implementation, see schema.

zh.intro: 面向 AI 搜索引擎和 AI 回答的内容优化：让内容更容易被大模型抓取、引用和转述。正文覆盖 AEO、GEO、LLMO 这些叫法，以及 llms.txt、llms-full.txt、OKF（Open Knowledge Format）这类给 agent 读的产物，还讨论零点击搜索、AI 引用格式变化、网站在 AI 回答里的曝光。传统技术 SEO 审计和结构化数据实现各有别的技能负责。正文版本 2.10.1。
zh.usage: 想让内容被 ChatGPT、Perplexity 一类 AI 回答引用，或要检查站点对 agent 是否友好时调用；传统 SEO 审计请走对应技能。
zh.notes: 与 seo-audit、schema 的分工写在正文里：这里管 AI 侧，那边管传统 SEO 与结构化数据。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive framework for AI Search Engine Optimization (AI SEO). It includes tactical guidance, content templates, and technical audit steps. The skill references well-known external tools and provides standard shell commands for site inspection. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: audit
skills.description_en: Run technical quality checks across accessibility, performance, theming, responsive design, and anti-patterns. Generates a scored report with P0-P3 severity ratings and actionable plan. Use when the user wants an accessibility check, performance audit, or technical quality review.

zh.intro: 跨无障碍、性能、主题化、响应式设计和反模式做技术质量检查，产出一份带评分的报告、P0 到 P3 的严重度分级和可执行的整改计划。正文强调这是代码层面的审计而不是设计批评，只看实现里可测量、可验证的东西，而且只记录问题不修，留给其他命令处理。诊断扫描按 5 个维度各评 0 到 4 分；无障碍一项会看对比度（正文给的门槛是 4.5:1，AAA 是 7:1）和缺少 ARIA 的交互元素。
zh.usage: 用户要做无障碍检查、性能审计或技术质量复核时调用；先按前置要求拿到设计上下文，再跑 5 个维度的打分扫描，输出分级报告而不是直接改代码。
zh.notes: 只诊断不修复，改动交给其他命令；依赖 /impeccable 的设计上下文，缺上下文要先跑 /impeccable teach。

audits.summary: This skill acts as a technical quality auditor for code and design implementations. It provides a systematic framework for evaluating accessibility, performance, responsive design, and theming without any malicious intent or risky operations.

skills.name: animate
skills.description_en: Review a feature and enhance it with purposeful animations, micro-interactions, and motion effects that improve usability and delight. Use when the user mentions adding animation, transitions, micro-interactions, motion design, hover effects, or making the UI feel more alive.

zh.intro: 复核一个功能，再加上有目的的动画、微交互和动效，用来帮助理解、提供反馈和提升体验感。正文先找该加动效的地方：没有视觉反馈的动作（按钮点击、表单提交）、生硬的过渡（显示隐藏、页面加载、路由切换），以及空间或层级关系不清楚的切换。前置同样是强制准备：先调用 /impeccable 拿设计原则、反模式和 Context Gathering Protocol，没有设计上下文先跑 /impeccable teach，另外还要确认性能约束。
zh.usage: 用户说加动画、做过渡、微交互、hover 效果，或嫌界面太死板时调用；先按前置步骤拿设计上下文和性能约束，再逐处判断该不该加动效。
zh.notes: 依赖 /impeccable 的设计上下文，缺上下文先跑 /impeccable teach；参数是目标范围（argument-hint 为 [target]）。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive guide for adding purposeful animations and micro-interactions to web interfaces, focusing on usability, performance, and accessibility. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: adapt
skills.description_en: Adapt designs to work across different screen sizes, devices, contexts, or platforms. Implements breakpoints, fluid layouts, and touch targets. Use when the user mentions responsive design, mobile layouts, breakpoints, viewport adaptation, or cross-device compatibility.

zh.intro: 把现有设计适配到不同屏幕尺寸、设备、平台和使用场景：断点、流式布局、触控目标尺寸。给要做移动端布局、视口适配和跨设备兼容的前端与设计师用，解决一套界面换个尺寸就崩的问题。
zh.usage: 用户提到响应式设计、移动端布局、断点、视口适配或跨设备兼容时用它。正文要求先调 `/impeccable` 拿设计原则和 Context Gathering Protocol；还没有设计上下文就必须先跑 `/impeccable teach`，并补上目标设备和使用场景。
zh.notes: 依赖 impeccable 主技能提供设计原则、反模式和 Context Gathering Protocol，不是一套独立的适配规则。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions and best practices for adapting UI/UX designs across various platforms and devices. No security risks or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: ralph-plan
skills.description_en: Interactive planning assistant that helps create focused, well-structured ralph-loop commands through collaborative conversation

audits.summary: The skill is a safe planning assistant designed to help users structure commands collaboratively. It contains no malicious code, obfuscation, or dangerous system commands.

skills.name: modern-javascript-patterns
skills.description_en: Master ES6+ features including async/await, destructuring, spread operators, arrow functions, promises, modules, iterators, generators, and functional programming patterns for writing clean, efficient JavaScript code. Use when refactoring legacy code, implementing modern patterns, or optimizing JavaScript applications.

audits.summary: This skill is a collection of educational resources and code examples for modern JavaScript development. It covers ES6+ features, functional programming, and asynchronous patterns without any security risks.

skills.name: ticket-triage
skills.description_en: Triage and prioritize a support ticket or customer issue. Use when a new ticket comes in and needs categorization, assigning P1-P4 priority, deciding which team should handle it, or checking whether it's a duplicate or known issue before routing.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for triaging and prioritizing support tickets. It includes a potential security consideration regarding how the agent processes untrusted issue descriptions, which is a standard characteristic of skills that handle external data. The workflow is otherwise well-defined with clear logic for categorization and routing.

skills.name: clarify
skills.description_en: Improve unclear UX copy, error messages, microcopy, labels, and instructions to make interfaces easier to understand. Use when the user mentions confusing text, unclear labels, bad error messages, hard-to-follow instructions, or wanting better UX writing.

zh.intro: 修不清楚的界面文案：错误提示、微文案、按钮标签和引导说明，让用户看懂发生了什么、下一步该做什么。给要改 UX writing 的产品和前端用，针对的是「能用但看不懂」的界面文本。
zh.usage: 用户说文案看不懂、标签含糊、报错信息莫名其妙、说明跟不上操作时用它。正文要先调 `/impeccable` 走 Context Gathering Protocol，没有设计上下文先跑 `/impeccable teach`，另外要确认用户的技术水平和当下心理状态。
zh.notes: 正文列的问题清单是行话、歧义、被动语态、太长或太短、以及默认用户已经懂了，逐条对照着改。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for improving UX copy and interface text. It does not contain any malicious code, external dependencies, or security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: optimize
skills.description_en: Diagnoses and fixes UI performance across loading speed, rendering, animations, images, and bundle size. Use when the user mentions slow, laggy, janky, performance, bundle size, load time, or wants a faster, smoother experience.

zh.intro: 诊断并修 UI 性能：加载速度、渲染、动画、图片和包体积。给遇到页面慢、卡顿、掉帧或首屏太久的前端用，排查面从 Core Web Vitals 一直铺到帧率、内存和网络请求。
zh.usage: 用户提到慢、卡、掉帧、performance、bundle size、load time 时用它。正文先量现状：`LCP`、`INP`、`CLS` 三个 Core Web Vitals、可交互时间、包体积、帧率和内存，再定位瓶颈属于首屏、交互还是动画。
zh.notes: 正文反复强调先测再改、改完再测，别做提前优化；只动可感知的瓶颈，不要所有指标一把抓。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions and best practices for diagnosing and fixing UI performance issues. No security risks or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: metal-kernel
skills.description_en: Write Metal/MPS kernels for PyTorch operators. Use when adding MPS device support to operators, implementing Metal shaders, or porting CUDA kernels to Apple Silicon. Covers native_functions.yaml dispatch, host-side operators, and Metal kernel implementation.

audits.summary: This skill provides technical guidance for writing Metal/MPS kernels for PyTorch operators. It describes standard development workflows within the PyTorch codebase and does not contain any malicious patterns or security risks.

skills.name: colorize
skills.description_en: Add strategic color to features that are too monochromatic or lack visual interest, making interfaces more engaging and expressive. Use when the user mentions the design looking gray, dull, lacking warmth, needing more color, or wanting a more vibrant or expressive palette.

zh.intro: 给过于单色、发灰、缺视觉温度的界面加颜色：有策略地用色彩表达层级和含义，而不是随手撒颜色。给觉得设计太素、想加暖色和表现力的设计师用。
zh.usage: 用户说设计太灰、缺少温暖感、想要更有表现力的配色时用它。正文要先调 `/impeccable` 走 Context Gathering Protocol，没有设计上下文先跑 `/impeccable teach`，并收集现有品牌色。
zh.notes: 正文要求先判断是纯灰阶、只有中性色，还是只有一个不敢用的强调色，再决定颜色加在哪里。

audits.summary: The 'colorize' skill is a purely instructional guide designed to help the AI agent apply color theory and design principles to monochromatic user interfaces. It contains no executable scripts, network operations, or sensitive data access.

skills.name: firebase-ai-logic-basics
skills.description_en: Official skill for integrating Firebase AI Logic (Gemini API) into web applications. Covers setup, multimodal inference, structured output, and security.

audits.summary: This skill provides official guidance and implementation patterns for integrating Firebase AI Logic (Gemini API) across Web, Android, iOS, and Flutter platforms. It demonstrates strong security awareness by providing detailed instructions for using Firebase App Check to prevent unauthorized access and explicitly warning against hardcoding sensitive debug tokens. All tools and dependencies are official resources from the trusted vendor (Firebase/Google).

skills.name: using-superpowers
skills.description_en: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions

zh.intro: superpowers 系列的门面技能：规定会话一开始怎么找技能、怎么用技能，甚至要求在任何回应之前先调用技能，连反问澄清也算回应。装量 26.7 万，8 周 -8%，Gen Agent Trust Hub 给 warn（MEDIUM），其余四家 pass。
zh.usage: 装了整套 superpowers、想让后续对话都按技能优先的顺序走时放在最前；只想临时用一个技能就别装它。
zh.notes: Gen Agent Trust Hub 报 warn（MEDIUM）；它会强制改变会话起手行为，跟别的技能抢触发时先摘掉它。

audits.summary: The skill uses imperative framing and aggressive instructions to force the agent to prioritize skill invocation over its own internal reasoning and safety filters. It also provides instructions for modifying local configuration files to enable specific platform features.

skills.name: pyrefly-type-coverage
skills.description_en: Migrate a file to use stricter Pyrefly type checking with annotations required for all functions, classes, and attributes.

audits.summary: This skill provides structured guidance for migrating Python files to stricter type-checking standards using the 'Pyrefly' tool. It emphasizes non-invasive refactoring, best practices for type annotations, and the importance of running existing unit tests to verify changes. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: aoti-debug
skills.description_en: Debug AOTInductor (AOTI) errors and crashes. Use when encountering AOTI segfaults, device mismatch errors, constant loading failures, or runtime errors from aot_compile, aot_load, aoti_compile_and_package, or aoti_load_package.

audits.summary: This skill is a technical guide for debugging AOTInductor issues and contains no security concerns. It provides standard troubleshooting steps and environment variables used in the PyTorch ecosystem.

skills.name: implement-spec
skills.description_en: Implement the result of /to-spec and /to-tickets in code.

zh.intro: description 只有一句：把 /to-spec 和 /to-tickets 的产物落进代码。flags 标了 pointer，正文是转发壳，真正的流程在别处。装量 26.2 万，8 周涨 12.2%，Snyk 给 warn（MEDIUM）。
zh.usage: 用同一套 mattpocock 技能走完 spec 和 ticket 拆分、要进入编码环节时调用。
zh.notes: pointer 加一句话 description，脱离 /to-spec、/to-tickets 单独用没有内容；Snyk 报 warn（MEDIUM）。

audits.summary: The skill coordinates subagents to implement code specifications. Its primary security surface is indirect prompt injection, as instructions within an external project specification or task ticket could influence agent behavior during the implementation and merging process.

skills.name: bolder
skills.description_en: Amplify safe or boring designs to make them more visually interesting and stimulating. Increases impact while maintaining usability. Use when the user says the design looks bland, generic, too safe, lacks personality, or wants more visual impact and character.

zh.intro: 把过于保守、平庸、没个性的设计推向更强的视觉冲击和性格，同时不掉可用性。给觉得界面一眼模板、缺记忆点的设计师用，针对的是「安全但无聊」的设计。
zh.usage: 用户说设计 bland、generic、太安全、没性格、想要更强视觉冲击时用它。正文先定位弱在哪里：系统字体和基础色这类通用选择、全都中等大小的胆怯尺度、对比不足、没有动效、一眼能猜到的套路。
zh.notes: 正文要求先调 `/impeccable`；没有设计上下文时先跑 `/impeccable teach`。放大冲击力的前提是可用性不回退。

audits.summary: The 'bolder' skill is a design-focused set of instructions aimed at helping the agent improve the visual impact of user interfaces. It is purely instructional, contains no executable code, and presents no security risks.

skills.name: sms
skills.description_en: When the user wants to plan, build, or optimize SMS, MMS, or WhatsApp marketing — including welcome flows, abandoned cart texts, post-purchase, win-back, promotional sends, or transactional/auth SMS. Also use when the user mentions "SMS marketing," "text message campaigns," "SMS sequence," "SMS automation," "abandoned cart text," "post-purchase SMS," "Klaviyo SMS," "Postscript," "Attentive," "Twilio," "A2P 10DLC," "TCPA," "SMS compliance," "short code," "toll-free SMS," "MMS campaign," "should I do SMS," "SMS vs email," "WhatsApp marketing," "WhatsApp Business API," "WhatsApp templates," or "click-to-WhatsApp." For email sequences, see emails. For SMS copy framing, see copywriting. For opt-in popups that capture phone numbers, see popups.

zh.intro: 规划、搭建和优化短信、彩信和 WhatsApp 营销：欢迎流程、弃购提醒、购后跟进、唤回和促销发送，也包括验证码一类的通知短信，以及 TCPA 和运营商那套合规要求。
zh.usage: 动手前先找产品营销背景文档，按它的口径定发送场景和节奏；合规条款和退订处理要一起想清楚。
zh.notes: 正文面向直面消费者的品牌、移动应用和 SaaS；邮件序列和文案框架另有技能。

audits.summary: The skill is focused on SMS marketing strategy and compliance. A low-severity finding relates to the potential for indirect prompt injection as the skill is designed to ingest external context files without explicit sanitization instructions.

skills.name: delight
skills.description_en: Add moments of joy, personality, and unexpected touches that make interfaces memorable and enjoyable to use. Elevates functional to delightful. Use when the user asks to add polish, personality, animations, micro-interactions, delight, or make an interface feel fun or memorable.

zh.intro: 在界面里加让人会心一笑的细节：成功态、空状态、加载态的微交互和文案，把「能用」变成记得住。给想做打磨和个性表达的产品与前端用，落点是那些用户本来就在等的片刻。
zh.usage: 用户要求加 polish、个性、动画、微交互、delight，或想让界面更有记忆点时用它。正文给的自然落点是成功态（保存、发送、发布完成）、空状态（首次使用、onboarding）和加载等待。
zh.notes: 正文要求先调 `/impeccable`，并确认玩法贴合场景——活泼、专业、古怪还是优雅，别在不该开玩笑的地方加惊喜。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines and techniques for adding personality, animations, and micro-interactions to user interfaces. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: idea-refine
skills.description_en: Refines raw ideas into sharp, actionable concepts through structured divergent and convergent thinking. Use when an idea is still vague, when you need to stress-test assumptions before committing to a plan, or when you want to expand options before converging on one. Triggers on "ideate", "refine this idea", or "stress-test my plan".

zh.intro: 用先发散再收敛的两段式思考，把还很模糊的想法整理成值得动手的方向。前半段重述想法、追问细节、生成多个变体，后半段聚类、压力测试假设，最后收敛到能接着往下写规格的程度。
zh.usage: 想法还说不清、或者要拿方案去试假设、比选项时用这条；完全不知道自己要什么应改用访谈那一类技能。
zh.notes: 方向已经定下来只差规格的阶段别用这条，应该走到写规格的流程里去。

audits.summary: The skill is safe to use and provides an interactive framework for refining concepts. It utilizes local scripts for directory setup and requires user confirmation before saving artifacts to the file system.

skills.name: prisma-orm-setup
skills.description_en: Set up Prisma ORM in an application, connect its database, or troubleshoot the connection of an existing Prisma 6, 7, or 8 app. Defaults new applications to Prisma ORM 8 and loads the package-owned prisma-8 skill; keeps existing Prisma 6/7 apps on their version with provider references for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, CockroachDB, MongoDB, and Prisma Postgres.

zh.intro: 在应用里接 Prisma ORM、连数据库，或者给已有的 6、7、8 版本排查连接问题。新应用默认上第 8 版并加载随包发布的版本化技能；老应用保持原版本，配有 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、SQL Server、CockroachDB、MongoDB 和 Prisma Postgres 的提供方参考。
zh.usage: 开工先看清单、锁文件和配置，认出 ORM 版本与数据库类型；修连接不代表要顺带做大版本升级。
zh.notes: 正文提醒只看命令行版本会认错应用版本，必须从应用依赖里判断版本。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for setting up Prisma ORM version 6, 7, and 8. It utilizes official Prisma CLI tools and packages from the vendor. Security analysis indicates the skill follows safe practices for handling credentials via environment variables and includes standard placeholder values for documentation. It also features a mechanism to synchronize and load updated guidance directly from the Prisma package.

skills.name: distill
skills.description_en: Strip designs to their essence by removing unnecessary complexity. Great design is simple, powerful, and clean. Use when the user asks to simplify, declutter, reduce noise, remove elements, or make a UI cleaner and more focused.

zh.intro: 把设计削到只剩本质：删掉多余元素、重复信息和装饰性边框阴影，让界面重新有清楚的层级。给觉得页面太挤、太吵、想减负的界面用，目标是把复杂度换成清晰度。
zh.usage: 用户说想简化、去杂乱、减噪音、删元素、让 UI 更干净更聚焦时用它。正文先找复杂度的来源：互相抢的按钮、一遍遍重复的信息、没有目的的多种颜色字体和尺寸、一次性全铺开的内容。
zh.notes: 正文要求先调 `/impeccable`；没有设计上下文时先跑 `/impeccable teach`。是简化到仍然表达完整，不是单纯删东西。

audits.summary: The 'distill' skill provides structured instructions for the agent to simplify and declutter user interface designs. It focuses on design principles such as reducing visual noise, improving hierarchy, and linearizing layouts. No security risks or malicious patterns were found in the skill's instructions or metadata.

skills.name: paywalls
skills.description_en: When the user wants to create or optimize in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, or feature gates. Also use when the user mentions "paywall," "upgrade screen," "upgrade modal," "upsell," "feature gate," "convert free to paid," "freemium conversion," "trial expiration screen," "limit reached screen," "plan upgrade prompt," "in-app pricing," "free users won't upgrade," "trial to paid conversion," or "how do I get users to pay." Use this for any in-product moment where you're asking users to upgrade. Distinct from public pricing pages (see cro) — this focuses on in-product upgrade moments where the user has already experienced value. For pricing decisions, see pricing.

zh.intro: 设计应用内付费墙和升级引导：升级弹窗、追加销售弹窗、功能门禁、试用到期页、额度用尽页都算。它盯的是用户已经体验到价值之后的那个升级时刻，跟对外的定价页不是一回事；降价涨价这类定价决策另有 pricing 处理。
zh.usage: 用户说「免费用户不升级」「试用到期怎么提示」「额度到顶的页面怎么写」「付费墙转化」时用它。对外公开定价页相关的看 cro，定价本身的决策看 pricing。
zh.notes: 正文要求先读 `.agents/product-marketing.md` 之类的产品营销上下文再提问。它给的是文案和引导时机的改法，不实现付费与订阅逻辑。

audits.summary: The skill is safe for use. It provides expert guidance on in-app paywall and upgrade screen optimization without any malicious code, external dependencies, or network operations.

skills.name: shipping-and-launch
skills.description_en: Prepares production launches. Use when preparing to deploy to production, or when asking what needs to be in place before shipping. Use when you need a pre-launch checklist, when setting up monitoring, when planning a staged rollout, or when you need a rollback strategy.

zh.intro: 上线前的准备清单：先过代码质量，含测试、构建、静态检查和类型检查，再安排监控、分批放量和回滚方案。贯穿的原则是每次上线都要可回滚、可观测、小步走，发布本身只是其中一步。
zh.usage: 要部署到生产、发大改动、迁数据或开灰度之前逐项过清单，确认监控和回滚都就位。
zh.notes: 正文的口径是「任何带风险的部署」都算，清单按代码质量、监控、放量、回滚分块。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive guidelines and checklists for safe production deployments, monitoring, and rollbacks. It contains no executable code or malicious instructions.

skills.name: cupynumeric-parallel-data-load
skills.description_en: Load a sharded, on-disk dataset (sharded .npy, Parquet/Arrow, raw binary, sharded HDF5, custom layouts) into a distributed cuPyNumeric ndarray via a manual partition + leaf @task launch with CPU/OMP/GPU variants. Use when no single-call loader fits, including when per-shard row counts differ across files. Prefer cupynumeric.load or legate.io.hdf5.from_file when they apply.

audits.summary: The skill provides a specialized utility for distributed data loading in cuPyNumeric. It manages local file I/O for sharded datasets and uses the Legate tasking model for parallelization. All operations are restricted to the intended use case of high-performance computing, and no security issues were detected.

skills.name: typescript-advanced-types
skills.description_en: Master TypeScript's advanced type system including generics, conditional types, mapped types, template literals, and utility types for building type-safe applications. Use when implementing complex type logic, creating reusable type utilities, or ensuring compile-time type safety in TypeScript projects.

zh.intro: TypeScript 高级类型系统的实操指南：泛型、条件类型、映射类型、模板字面量类型和工具类型。适用场景是搭类型安全的库或框架、写可复用的泛型组件、实现复杂类型推断、设计类型安全的 API 客户端、做表单校验、写强类型配置对象、做类型安全的状态管理，以及把 JS 代码库迁到 TS。正文分节给代码，例如泛型函数 identity<T>(value: T): T，目的是在保持类型安全的前提下让组件可复用。
zh.usage: 要写复杂类型逻辑、造可复用的类型工具，或排查编译期类型报错时调用；按泛型、条件类型、映射类型、模板字面量类型和工具类型分节找对应的写法与代码片段。
zh.notes: 以模式说明和 TS 代码片段为主，不是可直接执行的命令行工具。

audits.summary: The skill is a standard educational resource for TypeScript development and contains no security risks or malicious patterns.

skills.name: youtube-thumbnail-design
skills.description_en: YouTube thumbnail design with specific dimensions, contrast rules, and mobile preview optimization. Covers safe zones, text placement, face expression psychology, and A/B testing. Use for: YouTube thumbnails, video cover images, click-through optimization. Triggers: youtube thumbnail, thumbnail design, video thumbnail, click through rate, ctr optimization, youtube cover, video cover image, thumbnail maker, thumbnail tips, youtube design, video preview image

zh.intro: YouTube 封面图的具体规格：尺寸、对比度规则、手机端小图预览优化，还有安全区、文字摆位、人物表情心理和 A/B 测试。安装量 19 万，8 周涨 73.9%，Socket 给 warn。
zh.usage: 视频要出封面并想提点击率；封面在手机上糊成一团要重做；要拿两版封面做 A/B 对照。
zh.notes: needs_external_cli；Socket warn。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions and examples for designing YouTube thumbnails using the inference.sh CLI tool. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: eas-update
skills.description_en: Configure and use EAS Update for over-the-air JavaScript and asset updates with expo-updates and EAS CLI. Use when setting up OTA updates, running eas update:configure or eas update, publishing to preview/staging/production channels, explaining branches/channels/runtime versions, testing updates, or debugging why an installed build still shows old code. Load for TestFlight, preview, or production updates that do not appear, including questions about cold launches or reopening the app. Not for update health metrics; use eas-update-insights for adoption, crashes, and rollout monitoring.

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for managing Expo Application Services (EAS) updates using official CLI tools. It includes a feedback mechanism that interpolates user-supplied text into a shell command, which poses a minor risk of indirect prompt injection if the agent does not properly sanitize the input. All external tools and packages originate from official vendor infrastructure.

skills.name: create-an-asset
skills.description_en: Build a customer deck, one-pager or leave-behind from your account data, call notes and approved materials, with no made-up numbers. Use when the user asks for a sales asset, one-pager, deck, leave-behind, "create an asset for [prospect]", or "make something for [account]".

audits.summary: This skill facilitates the creation of sales assets by integrating research and user-provided deal context. It includes a security consideration related to the processing of external materials like transcripts, which warrants review as a potential surface for indirect prompt injection. These elements are used within the skill's intended functionality for tailoring content.

skills.name: tool-rename-deprecation
skills.description_en: Ensure renamed built-in tool references preserve backward compatibility. Use when renaming a toolReferenceName, tool set referenceName, or any tool identifier. Run on ANY change to tool registration code. Covers legacyToolReferenceFullNames for tools and legacyFullNames for tool sets.

audits.summary: The skill contains no files or code to analyze and is therefore considered safe.

skills.name: quieter
skills.description_en: Tones down visually aggressive or overstimulating designs, reducing intensity while preserving quality. Use when the user mentions too bold, too loud, overwhelming, aggressive, garish, or wants a calmer, more refined aesthetic.

zh.intro: 把过于抢眼、刺激、攻击性强的设计降下来，压掉饱和度和对比的极端值，保留效果但更耐看。给觉得界面太吵、太扎眼、想收一收的设计师用。
zh.usage: 用户说太粗、太吵、overwhelming、aggressive、花哨，或想要更平静克制的观感时用它。正文先找强度来源：过亮的色彩饱和、高对比并置、太多粗重元素互相抢、动画过量、装饰太多。
zh.notes: 正文要求先调 `/impeccable`；没有设计上下文时先跑 `/impeccable teach`。降强度不等于把设计做平，效果要留住。

audits.summary: The skill provides design guidelines for reducing visual intensity and contains no executable code, network operations, or sensitive data access.

skills.name: microsoft-agent-framework
skills.description_en: Create, update, refactor, explain, or review Microsoft Agent Framework solutions using shared guidance plus language-specific references for .NET and Python.

audits.summary: The skill is safe and provides standard development guidance for the Microsoft Agent Framework in .NET and Python using official Microsoft documentation and repositories.

skills.name: ad-creative
skills.description_en: When the user wants to generate, iterate, or scale ad creative — headlines, descriptions, primary text, or full ad variations — for any paid advertising platform. Also use when the user mentions 'ad copy variations,' 'ad creative,' 'generate headlines,' 'RSA headlines,' 'bulk ad copy,' 'creative testing,' 'write me some ads,' 'Facebook ad copy,' 'Google ad headlines,' 'LinkedIn ad text,' 'static ads,' 'ad templates,' 'iMessage ad,' 'ChatGPT ad,' 'creative strategy,' 'creative roadmap,' 'creative retro,' 'hook writing,' 'creative review page,' 'motion video ad,' 'faceless video ad,' 'UGC ad,' 'greenscreen ad,' 'TikTok/Reels ad format,' 'Meta ad format tier list,' or 'creative format taxonomy.' Use it to produce or iterate ad copy at scale. Copy avoids AI tells like 'it's not X, it's Y' reveals. For campaign strategy and targeting, see ads. For landing page copy, see copywriting. Test hypotheses must be falsifiable, naming the metric, the comparison, and the expected direction.

zh.intro: 为一个或多个付费广告平台批量产出和迭代广告创意：标题、描述、正文文案，以及整组广告变体。正文覆盖 RSA 标题、批量广告文案、创意测试与创意路线图、钩子写法、静态广告与模板、UGC 与绿幕视频广告、无真人出镜的视频广告等格式，并给了一份创意格式的分类。写出来的文案要避开 AI 味句式。测试假设必须可被证伪：写清指标、对照物和预期方向。投放策略与定向、落地页文案各由别的技能负责。正文版本 2.12.1。
zh.usage: 要为某个广告平台批量写或迭代标题、正文与变体时调用；只产出创意，投放策略与定向另找对应技能。
zh.notes: 测试假设要能被证伪，指标、对照和预期方向缺一不可。

audits.summary: The ad-creative skill is a comprehensive toolkit for generating and iterating on advertising content. It involves processing untrusted external data (customer reviews, comments, and performance metrics) to generate copy and visual artifacts like HTML review pages and videos. The use of external tools such as Playwright and ffmpeg for rendering, combined with the processing of external content, creates a surface for indirect prompt injection and potential script injection, although the skill includes specific instructions for sanitizing data in its HTML templates.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.description_en: Creates specs before coding. Use when starting a new project, feature, or significant change and no specification exists yet. Use when drafting a PRD or requirements document with objectives and scope, or when requirements are unclear, ambiguous, or only exist as a vague idea. Use when a single requirement spans several independently testable capabilities and needs decomposing into a capability map of modules before specifying.

zh.intro: 动手写代码之前先写规格：把要做什么、为什么做、怎么算做完讲清楚，让规格成为人和模型共同的依据。需求含糊、改动跨多个模块，或者估计要花半小时以上时，尤其该先写。
zh.usage: 新项目或新功能开工前先按它的分阶段流程写规格，需求不清就先补提问；单行修复和改错别字不用走这套。
zh.notes: 正文给了四个阶段的门槛式流程；一个需求拆成多个可独立验证的能力时先画能力图。

audits.summary: This skill defines a structured workflow for AI agents to create specifications and plans before writing code. It emphasizes human review at every stage and includes explicit boundaries against insecure practices like committing secrets.

skills.name: break-ui
skills.description_en: Try to break a piece of UI by feeding it worst-case data — long names, unbreakable emails, one-letter names, missing fields, huge counts, zero items, long labels, non-Latin text, emoji, extreme numbers — then render it behind a "Demo data / Worst case" toggle and report everything that broke, with the fix for each. Use when the user asks to stress-test, break, or find edge cases in a component or screen, or to "try the worst case". For visual design critique use emil-design-eng; for motion use review-animations.

zh.intro: 拿最坏的真实数据去压一个看起来正常的界面：超长姓名、拆不开的邮箱、单个字母的名字、缺字段、超大计数、零条目、超长标签、非拉丁文字、表情符号、极端数字，然后把正常数据和最坏数据放在同一个开关后面切换对比，逐条报告哪里崩了以及怎么修。适合让 agent 主动找组件和页面的边界情况。
zh.usage: 它只做这一件事，不重做设计也不评价审美：先给每个渲染值找出可信的最坏输入，把两套数据挂在正常与最坏两个状态后面，再逐条列出破绽和修法。要改设计用 prototype 类技能，要看动效另找 review-animations。
zh.notes: 正文声明它用的是 Emil Kowalski 的设计工程标准；首次触发时只回一句准备好把最坏的真实数据丢过来的话，等用户提问再往下。

audits.summary: This skill is a utility designed to stress-test UI components by generating edge-case data. While it processes external project source code which presents a surface for indirect prompt injection, it includes specific defensive instructions to mitigate this risk.

skills.name: image-to-video
skills.description_en: Still-to-video conversion guide: model selection, motion prompting, and camera movement. Covers Wan 2.5 i2v, Seedance, Fabric, Grok Video with when to use each. Use for: animating images, creating video from stills, adding motion, product animations. Triggers: image to video, i2v, animate image, still to video, add motion to image, image animation, photo to video, animate still, wan i2v, image2video, bring image to life, animate photo, motion from image

zh.intro: 静图转动图的选型与提示词指南，通过 inference.sh 的命令行工具执行。正文比较 Wan 2.5 i2v、Seedance、Fabric、Grok Video 几个模型，说明各自什么时候用，并讲运动提示词和镜头运动怎么写。适用场景是把图片做成动图、产品动效和给静帧加运动。正文的例子先从 Flux 出静图，再用图生视频模型把它动起来。工具授权只限 belt 命令。
zh.usage: 要把一张静图变成视频、或不确定该用哪个图生视频模型时调用；先登录命令行工具，再给出静图和运动描述。
zh.notes: 需要 inference.sh 的额度；效果依赖运动提示词与镜头描述的具体程度。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive guide for image-to-video generation using the inference.sh CLI tool ('belt'). It provides model selection advice, prompting best practices, and example workflows. No security risks were detected.

skills.name: gws-drive-upload
skills.description_en: Google Drive: Upload a file with automatic metadata.

zh.intro: gws 里往 Drive 传文件的子命令：自动识别 MIME 类型，默认用本地文件名作为远端名字，可以指定父文件夹、也可以改名。适合把刚生成好的报告或导出的表格直接推上去。
zh.usage: `gws drive +upload ./report.pdf` 直接传；要放进指定目录加 `--parent`，要换名字加 `--name`。
zh.notes: 写操作，正文要求确认后再执行。需要 `gws` 和 gws-shared 里的认证配置。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates file uploads to Google Drive using the gws CLI tool. It appropriately warns the agent to obtain user confirmation before performing write operations.

skills.name: popups
skills.description_en: When the user wants to create or optimize popups, modals, overlays, slide-ins, or banners for conversion purposes. Also use when the user mentions "exit intent," "popup conversions," "modal optimization," "lead capture popup," "email popup," "announcement banner," "overlay," "collect emails with a popup," "exit popup," "scroll trigger," "sticky bar," or "notification bar." Use this for any overlay or interrupt-style conversion element. For forms outside of popups, see cro. For general page conversion optimization, see cro.

zh.intro: 做转化用的弹窗和浮层：退出意图弹窗、邮件收集弹窗、公告条、吸底条、滑入式浮层都算。它的取舍点是弹出要能带来转化，又不能烦人或伤品牌，所以正文先问清弹窗是为了收集邮箱还是别的，再谈触发时机和文案。
zh.usage: 用户提到 exit intent、弹窗转化、弹窗优化、邮件收集弹窗、公告条、吸底条、通知条时用它。弹窗之外的一般表单看 cro，整页转化优化也看 cro。
zh.notes: 正文要求先读 `.agents/product-marketing.md`（老项目是 `.claude/product-marketing.md`）里的产品营销上下文再提问。它只给弹窗内容与触发时机的建议。

audits.summary: The analyzed skill is focused on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) best practices for website popups, modals, overlays, and banners. It contains guidelines for trigger strategies, copy formulas, compliance, and metrics, along with standard evaluation test cases. No security vulnerabilities or malicious behaviors were detected.

skills.name: zipcode-search
skills.description_en: Look up a Korean postcode and official English address from a known address with the official ePost integrated search page.

audits.summary: A Korean address and postcode lookup utility that queries the official Korea Post (ePost) service. It employs a vendor-maintained CLI tool and Python scripts to retrieve and parse official postal data.

skills.name: convex-quickstart
skills.description_en: Get a barebones Convex + web template running from a one-sentence idea.

zh.intro: 从一个句子级别的想法起，把一个最简的 Convex 加 Web 模板在本地跑起来。正文说它用 Next.js 加 Convex、匿名开发部署，刻意保持最小：只有本地开发服务器，没有发布步骤，也没有预置认证。流程是跑 quickstart-recipe@^2 配方（传入想法与模板），配方会建项目、装依赖、起后端和前端开发服务器，打印出开发地址后打开给用户看，之后再做模板之外的功能前要先确认。规则里写明：成功过的配方不要重跑；convex 目录下的代码交给 convex-expert；不要加 Postgres、Redis、Express，用 Convex 原语；不要在这里加托管发布和预置认证。
zh.usage: 只有一句话想法、想先把 Convex 模板跑起来看效果时调用；它建本地项目并起开发服务器，不做发布。
zh.notes: 模板刻意不含认证与发布；要扩功能先确认再动。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates the quick setup of Convex and Next.js projects by executing vendor-approved recipes and development commands. It includes built-in rules for secure code generation and relies on official vendor tools.

skills.name: gws-docs-write
skills.description_en: Google Docs: Append text to a document.

zh.intro: gws 里往 Google 文档末尾追加纯文本的子命令：给文档 ID 和要写的文本，内容插到正文结尾。只处理纯文本，需要加粗、标题、表格这类富格式得走原始的 batchUpdate 接口。
zh.usage: `gws docs +write --document DOC_ID --text 'Hello, world!'`，文本会追加到文档正文末尾。
zh.notes: 这是写操作，正文要求执行前跟用户确认。需要 `gws` 与 gws-shared 里的认证配置。

audits.summary: This skill allows the agent to append text to Google Documents using the 'gws' CLI tool. It is a legitimate utility from the vendor, but it presents a potential attack surface for indirect prompt injection and command execution because it handles user-provided document IDs and text content without explicit validation or sanitization steps.

skills.name: gpt-image-2
skills.description_en: Generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT Image 2 (ChatGPT Images 2.0) on RunComfy. Documents GPT Image 2's strengths (embedded text, logos, multilingual typography, instruction precision), its 3 fixed sizes, edit-with-preservation language, and when to route to a sibling (Flux 2 / Nano Banana Pro / Seedream) instead. Calls `runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/text-to-image` or `/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "gpt image 2", "gpt-image-2", "ChatGPT Images 2", "image 2", or any explicit ask to generate or edit with this model.

zh.intro: 在 RunComfy 上用 OpenAI GPT Image 2（ChatGPT Images 2.0）生成和编辑图片。正文记的是这个模型的强项——文字嵌入、logo、多语言排版、指令精确度——以及它只有 3 个固定尺寸、编辑时用「保留式」措辞，还有什么时候该改道兄弟模型（Flux 2、Nano Banana Pro、Seedream）。调用走本地 RunComfy CLI；触发语是 gpt image 2、gpt-image-2、ChatGPT Images 2、image 2，或用户明确要求用这个模型出图改图。主页 runcomfy.com，许可为 MIT。
zh.usage: 用户点名要 GPT Image 2 出图或改图时调用；文生图走 `runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/text-to-image`，改图走同模型的 `/edit`，先确认尺寸和保留要求。
zh.notes: 需要本地装好并配置 RunComfy CLI；模型只有 3 个固定尺寸；要更强风格或文字能力时按正文改道 Flux 2、Nano Banana Pro、Seedream。

audits.summary: This skill enables image generation and editing using GPT Image 2 via the RunComfy CLI. It follows security best practices for credential management and shell safety. The primary security consideration is the inherent risk of indirect prompt injection from user-provided text or external images, which the skill documents.

skills.name: vue-best-practices
skills.description_en: MUST be used for Vue.js tasks. Strongly recommends Composition API with `<script setup>` and TypeScript as the standard approach. Covers Vue 3, SSR, Volar, vue-tsc. Load for any Vue, .vue files, Vue Router, Pinia, or Vite with Vue work. ALWAYS use Composition API unless the project explicitly requires Options API.

zh.intro: 一条按顺序走的 Vue 工作流：默认栈定成 Vue 3 加 Composition API 加 `<script setup lang="ts">`，动手前先确认架构、先画组件边界与状态归属，再落实响应式、SFC 结构与模板安全、组件数据流、composables，行为正确之后才谈性能优化。适合任何要写或改 .vue 文件的人。
zh.usage: 开工前先读 `references/reactivity.md`、`references/sfc.md`、`references/component-data-flow.md`、`references/composables.md` 并让它们全程留在上下文里，不是出问题才翻；项目明确用 Options API 或 JSX 时改加载对应的 best-practices 技能。
zh.notes: 版本 19.0.1，作者 vuejs-ai，MIT。默认只认 Composition API，遇到老项目要显式说明走 Options API，否则它会按新栈改你的代码。

audits.summary: This skill is a comprehensive set of development guidelines for Vue.js that promotes secure and efficient coding practices. It is safe for use and explicitly recommends security measures like input sanitization to prevent common web vulnerabilities.

skills.name: storyboard-creation
skills.description_en: Film and video storyboarding with shot vocabulary, continuity rules, and panel layout. Covers shot types, camera angles, movement, 180-degree rule, and annotation format. Use for: video planning, film pre-production, ad storyboards, music video planning, animation. Triggers: storyboard, storyboarding, shot list, film planning, video planning, pre production, shot composition, camera angles, scene planning, visual script, animatic, storyboard panels, video storyboard

zh.intro: 影视分镜的那套语言：镜头类型、机位角度、运镜、180 度轴线规则，加上分镜格排版和标注格式。安装量 19 万，8 周涨 72.5%，Socket 给 warn。
zh.usage: 拍广告或 MV 前要出分镜和镜头清单；要把脚本拆成逐镜的画面说明；动画前期要定场景切分。
zh.notes: needs_external_cli；Socket warn。

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive guide for storyboard creation, utilizing the belt CLI to generate AI images and stitch them into panels. It defines cinematic terminology and continuity rules for video production planning. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: gws-calendar-insert
skills.description_en: Google Calendar: Create a new event.

zh.intro: gws 里新建日历事件的子命令：标题和起止时间必填，可以补地点、描述、多个参会人邮箱，加一个开关还能自动生成 Google Meet 链接。适合让 agent 把约好的会直接写进日历。
zh.usage: `gws calendar +insert --summary 'Standup' --start '2026-06-17T09:00:00-07:00' --end '2026-06-17T09:30:00-07:00'`，要视频会议再加 `--meet`。
zh.notes: 时间要用 RFC3339 格式。这是写操作，正文要求执行前跟用户确认；需要 `gws` 与 gws-shared 认证。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard documentation for creating Google Calendar events using the gws command-line tool. No security vulnerabilities or malicious behaviors were detected.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description_en: Drives development with tests using the red-green-refactor loop. Use when implementing any logic, fixing any bug, or changing any behavior. Use when you need to prove that code works, when a bug report arrives, or when you're about to modify existing functionality. Use when asked to add tests to a function, fix a bug in it or change its behavior, even when the code is pasted inline and the request does not mention tests.

zh.intro: 用红绿重构的循环驱动开发：先写一个会失败的测试，再写让它通过的代码，最后整理结构。修 bug 也先写出能复现问题的测试，要求拿出证据证明代码能跑，而不是看着差不多。
zh.usage: 实现任何逻辑、修任何 bug、改现有行为时用它；哪怕用户只是贴了一段代码让你改、没提测试，也先补测试再动。顺手把边界情况一起覆盖。
zh.notes: 纯配置、文档和静态内容这类没有行为变化的不必写测试；前期慢一点，换来的是改完敢合并。

audits.summary: The skill provides a methodology for Test-Driven Development and browser testing with explicit security guidance for handling untrusted content.

skills.name: offers

zh.usage: 用户提到报价、担保、价值堆叠、拆单或加购时用；先想清卖的是什么，再谈文案和落地页。

skills.name: seoul-subway-arrival
skills.description_en: Look up Seoul real-time subway arrival information with the official Seoul Open Data API. Use when the user asks when a train arrives, which trains are approaching a station, or how crowded Seoul subway timing looks right now.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description_en: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

skills.name: product-photography
skills.description_en: AI product photography with studio lighting, lifestyle shots, and packshot conventions. Covers angles, backgrounds, shadow types, hero shots, and e-commerce image requirements.
