audits.summary: This skill provides a command-line interface for the Google Sheets API using the 'gws' tool. It allows the agent to create spreadsheets, retrieve metadata, and perform batch updates on spreadsheet data.

skills.name: shape
skills.description_en: Plan the UX and UI for a feature before writing code. Runs a structured discovery interview, then produces a design brief that guides implementation. Use during the planning phase to establish design direction, constraints, and strategy before any code is written.

audits.summary: The skill is a design planning tool that facilitates a structured discovery interview to create a UI/UX design brief. It does not perform any code execution, network requests, or sensitive file access.

skills.name: fixing-metadata
skills.description_en: Audit and fix HTML metadata including page titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, Open Graph tags, Twitter cards, favicons, JSON-LD structured data, and robots directives. Use when adding SEO metadata, fixing social share previews, reviewing Open Graph tags, setting up canonical URLs, or shipping new pages that need correct meta tags.

zh.intro: 审查并修复页面元数据：title、description、canonical、Open Graph、Twitter card、favicon、manifest、JSON-LD 和 robots 指令。分八类按优先级排序，先处理重复标签和索引配置这类严重问题，并要求 title、description、canonical、og:url 四处内容指向一致。
zh.usage: 新页面要上线、做 SEO、社交分享卡片不对、要配 canonical 或加结构化数据时用。先找出元数据缺失或有错的页面，按优先级修，改完在真实域名上验证分享卡片，别用 localhost；改动只限元数据，不顺手重构。
zh.notes: 分享图必须用绝对 URL，og:url 要和 canonical 一致；暂存和预览页默认 noindex；一页只在一处定义元数据，避免多套系统互相覆盖。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard guidelines for auditing and fixing HTML metadata and SEO tags. It contains no executable code, network calls, or security risks.

skills.name: triaging-issues
skills.description_en: Triages GitHub issues by routing to oncall teams, applying labels, and closing questions. Use when processing new PyTorch issues or when asked to triage an issue.

audits.summary: This skill automates GitHub issue triage with a strong emphasis on security and validation. It includes several defensive measures, such as instructions for the agent to redact potentially risky external file links and the use of validation hooks to ensure modifications only occur on authorized targets. While the skill executes local scripts and interacts with the GitHub CLI, these actions are well-scoped and include internal checks to prevent unauthorized operations.

skills.name: python-executor
skills.description_en: Execute Python code in a safe sandboxed environment via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh). Pre-installed: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, requests, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright, MoviePy, Pillow, OpenCV, trimesh, and 100+ more libraries. Use for: data processing, web scraping, image manipulation, video creation, 3D model processing, PDF generation, API calls, automation scripts. Triggers: python, execute code, run script, web scraping, data analysis, image processing, video editing, 3D models, automation, pandas, matplotlib

zh.intro: 在托管沙箱里跑 Python：环境预装 NumPy、Pandas、Matplotlib、requests、BeautifulSoup、Selenium、Playwright、MoviePy、Pillow、OpenCV、trimesh 等上百个库，不用自己在本地装依赖。底层走 inference.sh，需要先装它的 CLI。安装量 37.7 万（本体 10.2 万），8 周涨 75.2%；Socket 与 Snyk 都给 warn，后者 MEDIUM。
zh.usage: 要用科学计算和图像、视频处理库又不想污染本机环境时；批量处理数据、出图表。
zh.notes: 依赖 inference.sh CLI 与账号；Snyk 判 warn / MEDIUM；代码离开本机在远端沙箱里跑。

audits.summary: This skill provides a sandboxed environment for executing Python code. It utilizes a documented CLI tool (belt) to run scripts remotely on a managed platform. The analysis found no malicious behavior, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access.

skills.name: agent-tools
skills.description_en: Run AI apps via inference.sh CLI - image generation, video creation, LLMs, search, 3D, Twitter automation. Models: FLUX, Veo, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Seedance, OmniHuman, Tavily, Exa, OpenRouter, and many more. Use when running AI apps, generating images/videos, calling LLMs, web search, or automating Twitter. Triggers: inference.sh, infsh, ai model, run ai, serverless ai, ai api, flux, veo, claude api, image generation, video generation, openrouter, tavily, exa search, twitter api, grok

zh.intro: 用 inference.sh 的 CLI 去跑外部 AI 应用：出图、生成视频、调 LLM、搜索、3D、Twitter 自动化，模型清单里点了 FLUX、Veo、Gemini、Grok、Claude、Seedance、OmniHuman、Tavily、Exa、OpenRouter。偏总入口性质的说明。安装量 37.7 万（本体 10.2 万），8 周涨 75.1%；Socket 与 Snyk 均 warn，Snyk 风险 MEDIUM。
zh.usage: 想知道 inference.sh 上有哪些模型可调、该用哪条命令时当索引查。
zh.notes: 需要 inference.sh CLI；Snyk 判 warn / MEDIUM。

audits.summary: This skill enables users to interact with the inference.sh CLI to run various AI models. It includes instructions for installing and using the 'belt' CLI tool. While it uses a 'curl | sh' installation pattern, this is a standard practice for developer tools from known platforms, and the documentation also provides a manual installation method with checksum verification for security-conscious users.

skills.name: tao-run-on-lepton
skills.description_en: DGX Cloud Lepton managed GPU compute platform with run/status/cancel interface. Use when submitting TAO jobs

audits.summary: The skill enables managed GPU compute on DGX Cloud via the Lepton platform, using official SDKs and utility scripts for job orchestration. It follows standard practices for cloud-based AI development and infrastructure management.

skills.name: higgsfield-product-photoshoot
skills.description_en: Generate brand-quality product images through Higgsfield product-photoshoot prompt enhancement on GPT Image 2 / gpt_image_2. Entry point for professional brand/product visuals. Use when: "product photo", "studio shot", "lifestyle image", "Pinterest pin", "hero/banner", "carousel", "ad creative", "Meta ads", "virtual try-on", "model wearing", "person holding product", "closeup with hands", "levitating/floating/splash product", "CGI/surreal product", "restyle", "seasonal/aesthetic variation", or any product, brand, or paid-social creative. Modes: product_shot, lifestyle_scene, closeup_product_with_person, moodboard_pin, hero_banner, social_carousel, ad_creative_pack, virtual_model_tryout, conceptual_product, restyle. Backend assembles the final prompt; never freehand it. NOT for: no-product text-to-image (use higgsfield-generate), branded avatar video (use higgsfield-generate Marketing Studio), marketplace listing cards (use higgsfield-marketplace-cards), Soul Character training (use higgsfield-soul-id).

zh.intro: 在 GPT Image 2 上做品牌级产品图，摄影 prompt 由后端拼装，不许自己手搓。模式分纯产品图、生活场景、人手特写、moodboard 图钉、hero banner、社媒轮播、广告素材包、虚拟试穿、超现实产品图和换风格。安装量 18.8 万，8 周跌 8.6%，Gen Agent Trust Hub 审计 fail。
zh.usage: 要出能直接投 Meta 广告的产品素材包；做 Pinterest 图钉或首屏 banner；要虚拟试穿、让模特拿着产品拍。
zh.notes: Gen Agent Trust Hub 给了 fail，装前自己读一遍正文；描述明确写 prompt 由后端组装、不支持自由发挥。

audits.summary: The skill is safe to use and follows standard vendor patterns for CLI installation and authentication. It carries a low risk of indirect prompt injection, as it processes user-provided text and images to generate creative content.

skills.name: fastapi-templates
skills.description_en: Create production-ready FastAPI projects with async patterns, dependency injection, and comprehensive error handling. Use when building new FastAPI applications or setting up backend API projects.

zh.intro: 一套可以直接照抄的 FastAPI 异步后端结构：接口层按版本分目录并单独放路由聚合，核心配置、安全、数据库各一文件，模型、数据结构、业务逻辑、数据访问四层分开放，共享依赖集中在依赖文件里。用内置的依赖注入挂数据库会话、鉴权和共享逻辑；异步覆盖路由处理、数据库操作、后台任务、中间件。依赖清单给到具体包和用途，包括异步 SQLAlchemy、异步 Postgres 驱动、JWT、口令哈希、表单解析，开发侧还有测试与异步 SQLite 内存库。测试部分用异步传输客户端直接打应用。
zh.usage: 新建 FastAPI 后端时按它的目录骨架起项目，数据库会话和鉴权用依赖注入挂上，测试用内存 SQLite 跑异步客户端。
zh.notes: 更细的实现模式在 references/details.md 里，读之前先看导航摘要够不够；依赖的版本下限要自己核对；只覆盖异步技术栈。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive templates for building FastAPI applications with modern practices. While the skill is a set of educational templates, the resulting applications process untrusted user data, which represents a potential surface for indirect prompt injection. The templates correctly implement standard security controls like password hashing and schema validation.

skills.name: higgsfield-soul-id
skills.description_en: Train a Soul Character — a personalized model on a person's face that Higgsfield uses for identity-faithful image and video generation. Use when: "create my Soul", "train my face", "make my digital twin", "build me an avatar", "learn my appearance", "create a character of me", "set up identity for video", "I want my face in generated images". Chain: train Soul (one-time, returns reference_id) → use in higgsfield-generate via `--soul-id <id>` with models like `text2image_soul_v2` or `soul_cinematic`. NOT for: one-shot face swaps (use higgsfield-generate with --image), named-character / non-photo avatars (use higgsfield-generate with prompt).

zh.intro: 用一个人的照片训练一个 Soul 角色，也就是给这张脸训练个性化模型，之后在 Higgsfield 出图和出视频时保持一致。训练是一次性的，返回 reference_id，再用 --soul-id 挂到 higgsfield-generate 上。安装量 18.7 万，8 周跌 8.5%，Snyk 给 warn。
zh.usage: 要把自己的脸固定进后续生成的图和视频；做数字分身或虚拟主播前先训练一次；视频需要身份一致时。
zh.notes: Snyk warn；它只做训练，出图要接着用 higgsfield-generate；一次性换脸和虚构角色不在它范围内。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates training personalized face models for Higgsfield's image and video generation platform. It includes a standard bootstrap procedure to install the vendor's official command-line interface tool from their public GitHub repository. The analysis found no malicious behavior or security risks beyond the inherent requirements of the tool's functionality.

skills.name: docx
skills.description_en: Comprehensive document creation, editing, and analysis with support for tracked changes, comments, formatting preservation, and text extraction. When Claude needs to work with professional documents (.docx files) for: (1) Creating new documents, (2) Modifying or editing content, (3) Working with tracked changes, (4) Adding comments, or any other document tasks

audits.summary: This skill includes security considerations such as the execution of system commands for environment setup and the analysis of external document files. While these elements are standard for the skill's document management functionality, they warrant awareness regarding command privileges and the handling of untrusted inputs.

skills.name: golang-continuous-integration
skills.description_en: GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline configuration for Golang projects — workflow files for test, lint, SAST, coverage and vulnerability-scan jobs, Dependabot and Renovate config files, GoReleaser release pipelines, Docker build/push, repository security settings, and AI-driven PR review. Use when setting up or improving Go project CI, writing or fixing `.github/workflows/*.yml`, adding a linter or security scanner as a pipeline job, wiring automated dependency-update bots, or adding quality gates. Covers wiring tools into a pipeline, not the analysis they perform: do NOT use for choosing or interpreting security findings (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-security` skill) or for choosing, upgrading, or auditing dependency versions (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-dependency-management` skill).

zh.intro: Go 项目的 GitHub Actions CI/CD 配置：test、lint、SAST、覆盖率和漏洞扫描这几类 job 的 workflow 文件怎么写，Dependabot 和 Renovate 的配置文件长什么样，GoReleaser 的发布流水线、Docker 构建与推送、仓库安全设置，以及 AI 驱动的 PR 审查。写 .github/workflows/*.yml 或加质量门禁时用它。
zh.usage: 要把它接进流水线时，先定 job 拆法，再选扫描器，然后配依赖更新机器人，最后补发布和镜像推送。需要 go、goreleaser、gh 三个 bin 在环境里。仓库安全设置和 AI PR 审查也在覆盖范围内。
zh.notes: 它只负责把工具接进流水线，不解释扫描结果；安全结论去 golang-security，依赖升级与审计去 golang-dependency-management。

audits.summary: The skill provides production-grade GitHub Actions continuous integration templates and configurations for Golang applications, adhering to standard security best practices such as least-privilege permissions, dependency validation, and strict boundary checks. No malicious indicators were found.

skills.name: json-canvas
skills.description_en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

zh.intro: 生成和修改 Obsidian 的 `.canvas` 文件：顶层只有 nodes 和 edges 两个数组，按 JSON Canvas Spec 1.0 组织，节点必填 id、type、x、y、width、height，连边用 fromNode 和 toNode 指向节点 id。适合做思维导图、流程图这类可视化画布。
zh.usage: 要建新画布、往已有 `.canvas` 加节点、或检查连线是否指向不存在的节点时用它。新建骨架是 `{"nodes": [], "edges": []}`，每个节点先生成不冲突的 16 位十六进制 id（例如 6f0ad84f44ce9c17），加完边要重新解析 JSON，确认所有 fromNode/toNode 都真的存在。
zh.notes: 只认 JSON Canvas Spec 1.0 的两个顶层数组；节点 id 必须唯一，边的 fromNode/toNode 必须指向已存在的节点，改完要重新解析 JSON 校验。文件扩展名是 `.canvas`，主要用在 Obsidian 里。

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe but presents a minor risk of indirect prompt injection due to its handling of JSON Canvas files, which can contain untrusted Markdown text, file paths, and external links.

skills.name: graphic-overlays
skills.description_en: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video by layering timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards onto the playing video — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript. The source video plays in full; the agent designs and writes each card's HTML in conversation, then renders to MP4 via hyperframes. Use when the user asks for graphic overlays, on-screen graphics / lower-thirds / data callouts / kinetic titles on a video, "package / dress up my video", "add overlay cards / graphic cards", or AI-composed graphic packaging of an existing video. NOT for plain subtitles (→ embedded-captions) or building a video from scratch (→ the creation workflows); when unsure overlays-vs-captions, see /hyperframes.

audits.summary: The skill packages videos with graphic overlays using the hyperframes CLI tool. It downloads external code from the npm registry and processes untrusted video transcripts, which presents a risk of indirect prompt injection and potential shell command injection in suggested scripts.

skills.name: triage
skills.description_en: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

zh.intro: 把 issue 和外部 PR 推进一条分诊状态机：分类、验证、必要时拷问提问人，最后写成 agent 能直接开工的简报。安装量 96 万，8 周跌 6.6%；Gen Agent Trust Hub 和 Snyk 都判 warn / MEDIUM。
zh.usage: issue 区被低质量报告淹没需要先分级；外部 PR 想先问清意图再接。
zh.notes: 两家审计判 warn / MEDIUM；它会给 issue 打标签改状态，仓库写权限别开太大。

audits.summary: The skill manages issue and PR triage by interacting with GitHub and the local codebase. It is vulnerable to indirect prompt injection from issue/PR content and involves the risky practice of executing code from untrusted external pull requests to verify them.

skills.name: higgsfield-marketplace-cards
skills.description_en: Generate marketplace product image cards through Higgsfield: compliant main image, secondary product images, and A+ style content modules. Use when the user asks for marketplace listing images, product detail cards, secondary product images, product infographics, lifestyle listing shots, A+ style content, marketplace image sets, or sales-ready product visuals. Backend owns marketplace compliance references and prompt templates; this skill only routes user intent to the CLI. NOT for generic brand product photography without marketplace/listing context (use higgsfield-product-photoshoot), video generation or UGC ads (use higgsfield-generate), or Soul Character training (use higgsfield-soul-id).

zh.intro: 描述为空，上游没抓到 SKILL.md。能确认的只有：属于 higgsfield-ai 的系列技能，安装量 18.5 万，8 周跌 8.9%，Gen Agent Trust Hub 审计 fail，Socket 和 Snyk 通过。名字里的 marketplace cards 指向电商货架卡片一类产物，除此之外没有可查的说明。
zh.usage: 只有在 higgsfield-ai 那套技能里你已确知它的位置时才装；否则先去用同仓库里有完整描述的那几条。
zh.notes: 无描述、无正文可查；Gen Agent Trust Hub fail；装前务必自己打开 SKILL.md 确认产出。

audits.summary: The skill installs an official command-line tool from the vendor's repository and uses it to process user-provided text and images. While the skill possesses an attack surface for indirect prompt injection via command-line arguments, this behavior is required for its intended functionality.

skills.name: gws-chat-send
skills.description_en: Google Chat: Send a message to a space.

zh.intro: Google Chat 发消息的一条命令封装：往指定 space 发纯文本。正文只给 usage、两个必填 flag（--space 和 --text）、一条命令写法和几条提示，并明确标成写操作，执行前要先跟用户确认。空间名不知道可以先列出 space 再挑，卡片和线程回复不在它范围内，得走原始 API。
zh.usage: 最小调用是 `gws chat +send --space spaces/AAAAxxxx --text 'Hello team!'`；空间名不确定时先 `gws chat spaces list`；完整参数用 `gws chat +send --help` 看。
zh.notes: 需先装 gws CLI 并完成授权，公共参数和鉴权在同源的 gws-shared；正文把这条明确定性为 write 命令，先确认再执行。

audits.summary: The skill is a safe implementation for sending Google Chat messages using the official Google Workspace CLI. It adheres to security best practices by explicitly requiring user confirmation for write actions.

skills.name: plannotator-compound
skills.description_en: Analyze a user's Plannotator plan archive to extract denial patterns, feedback taxonomy, evolution over time, and actionable prompt improvements — then produce a polished HTML dashboard report. Falls back to Claude Code ExitPlanMode denial reasons when Plannotator data is unavailable.

zh.intro: 分析用户的 Plannotator 计划档案，找出被驳回的模式、反馈分类和随时间的变化，再提炼成可执行的提示词改进建议，最后生成一份 HTML 看板报告。Plannotator 数据缺失时退回 Claude Code 的 ExitPlanMode 驳回理由。
zh.usage: 先确认数据源：优先读 Plannotator 的计划目录，没有就改用 Claude Code 项目目录并读随附的回退说明；各阶段跑完再出报告。
zh.notes: 报告按 v2、v3 递增命名，续跑时会以最新一份报告的修改日期作为截止点。

audits.summary: This skill analyzes user planning history to generate an improvement report and a persistent prompt hook. While it performs significant local data processing and creates a persistence mechanism, it operates entirely on local data and requests user consent for persistent changes.

skills.name: llm-security
skills.description_en: Security guidelines for LLM applications based on OWASP Top 10 for LLM 2025. Use when building LLM apps, reviewing AI security, implementing RAG systems, or asking about LLM vulnerabilities like 'prompt injection' or 'check LLM security'. IMPORTANT: Always consult this skill when building chatbots, AI agents, RAG pipelines, tool-using LLMs, agentic systems, or any application that calls an LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.) — even if the user doesn't explicitly mention security. Also use when users import 'openai', 'anthropic', 'langchain', 'llamaindex', or similar LLM libraries.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive security guidelines and code examples for building secure LLM applications, based on the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs 2025. It serves as an educational resource to help developers mitigate risks like prompt injection and sensitive data exposure. While the skill contains examples of vulnerable code with hardcoded credentials, these are clearly labeled as insecure patterns for demonstration and educational purposes, using non-functional example values.

skills.name: visual-design-foundations
skills.description_en: Apply typography, color theory, spacing systems, and iconography principles to create cohesive visual designs. Use when establishing design tokens, building style guides, or improving visual hierarchy and consistency.

zh.intro: 用字体、色彩、间距、图标四套基础搭出一致的视觉系统：字号按模块化比例排阶，行高按文本类型分（标题 1.1–1.3、正文 1.5–1.7、界面标签 1.2–1.4），间距走 8 点网格，颜色用语义 token 区分品牌、成功、警告、错误、信息与中性色阶，暗色主题也从同一套 token 派生。正文给了 CSS 变量与 Tailwind 主题扩展两种落地写法。
zh.usage: 新项目要定 design token、搭字号与间距体系、挑配对字体、做无障碍色板、设计图标系统或审视觉一致性时用。
zh.notes: 正文含 Tailwind 的 theme.extend 配置片段与中性色阶取法。

audits.summary: The analyzed skill is completely safe. It contains standard documentation, design token configurations, and code snippets related to visual design foundations, color theory, typography, spacing, and iconography with no malicious code or risk patterns detected.

skills.name: langchain-fundamentals
skills.description_en: Create LangChain agents with create_agent, define tools, and use middleware for human-in-the-loop and error handling.

audits.summary: This skill provides guidance on constructing LangChain agents and defining tools. It introduces a potential security consideration regarding dynamic code evaluation within tool definitions that warrants careful review.

skills.name: langgraph-fundamentals
skills.description_en: INVOKE THIS SKILL when writing ANY LangGraph code. Covers StateGraph, state schemas, nodes, edges, Command, Send, invoke, streaming, and error handling.

audits.summary: This skill provides fundamental documentation and code examples for building workflows with LangGraph. It follows standard programming practices and does not include any identified security risks.

skills.name: gws-workflow-standup-report
skills.description_en: Google Workflow: Today's meetings + open tasks as a standup summary.

zh.intro: 站会前一次性拿齐今天的会议和未完成任务：把日历里今天的议程和待办清单合在一起，输出一份可以直接照着说的 standup 摘要。正文声明只读、不改任何数据；输出默认 json，也能切 table、yaml 或 csv。适合每天开工前先看一眼今天要报什么。
zh.usage: 直接跑 `gws workflow +standup-report`；要表格加 `gws workflow +standup-report --format table`。
zh.notes: 需装 gws CLI 并授权 Calendar 和 Tasks；正文只有 usage、flags 和两条提示，没有更多场景说明。

audits.summary: The skill provides a read-only standup report by aggregating Google Calendar and Tasks data using the gws CLI tool. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: autobrowse
skills.description_en: Self-improving browser automation via the auto-research loop. Iteratively runs a browsing task, reads the trace, and improves the navigation skill (strategy.md) until it reliably passes. Supports parallel runs across multiple tasks using sub-agents. Use when you want to build or improve browser automation skills for specific website tasks.

audits.summary: A developer tool for self-improving browser automation. It uses an iterative 'auto-research' loop to generate, verify, and improve navigation scripts. The skill includes robust security measures such as restricting command execution to specific CLI tools and enforcing strict file permissions on sensitive session artifacts.

skills.name: tailwind
skills.description_en: Tailwind CSS v4.2 browser-runtime patterns for HyperFrames compositions. Use when scaffolding or editing projects created with `hyperframes init --tailwind`, writing Tailwind utility classes in composition HTML, adding CSS-first Tailwind v4 theme tokens, debugging v3 vs v4 syntax, or deciding when to compile Tailwind to CSS instead of using the browser runtime.

zh.intro: HyperFrames 里用 Tailwind 的浏览器运行时约定。用 `hyperframes init --tailwind` 建出来的项目跑的是钉在 `@tailwindcss/browser@4.2.4` 的浏览器运行时，要当成 Tailwind v4 而不是 v3；技能只针对 CLI 生成的 composition HTML，不管内部还用 v3 的 packages/studio。
zh.usage: 项目是用 `hyperframes init --tailwind` 建的、`index.html` 里有 `window.__tailwindReady`、或者渲染缺样式只能靠浏览器运行时兜底时用它。写工具类、加 v4 的 CSS-first 主题 token、自定义 utility、排查 v3 与 v4 的语法差异也归它，还包括判断什么时候该把 Tailwind 编译成 CSS。
zh.notes: 运行时钉在 `@tailwindcss/browser@4.2.4`，别按 v3 的写法来；这个技能不管 packages/studio（那边仍是 Tailwind v3 加 `tailwind.config.js`、PostCSS 和 `@tailwind` 指令）。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for managing Tailwind CSS v4 within the HyperFrames framework. It covers versioning, CSS-first theme tokens, and project validation using the HyperFrames CLI. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: gws-calendar-agenda
skills.description_en: Google Calendar: Show upcoming events across all calendars.

zh.intro: gws 的日历总览命令：默认把账号下所有日历接下来的日程一起列出来，可以只看今天、明天、本周或往后若干天，也能按日历名过滤、覆盖时区、换成表格输出。只读，不会改任何事件。
zh.usage: `gws calendar +agenda --today` 看今天，`gws calendar +agenda --week --format table` 出本周的表格。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 与 gws-shared 的认证。默认用 Google 账号时区，跨时区看要显式加 `--timezone`。

audits.summary: The 'calendar +agenda' skill is a read-only utility designed to list Google Calendar events using the 'gws' CLI tool. The analysis found no evidence of malicious behavior, unauthorized command execution, or data exfiltration. The skill references a local shared configuration for authentication, following standard security practices. While the skill processes external calendar data which is a theoretical surface for indirect prompt injection, this is inherent to its core functionality and mitigated by its read-only nature.

skills.name: better-interface
skills.description_en: Combines all of the `better-*` skills into a single review across accessibility, layout, writing, typography, color and UI polish.

audits.summary: This skill coordinates interface reviews by processing project documentation and code. It presents a surface for indirect prompt injection and executes project-defined testing commands, which are handled within the context of its review functionality.

skills.name: prompt-engineering-patterns
skills.description_en: This skill should be used when the user asks to "optimize a prompt", "improve prompt performance", "design a prompt template", "write better prompts", "debug prompt issues", "use chain-of-thought", "structured prompting", "few-shot prompting", or wants to apply advanced prompt engineering patterns for production LLM applications.

zh.intro: 生产环境 LLM 应用的提示词做法。少样本部分讲怎么挑样例（语义相似、多样性采样）、样例数量怎么和上下文窗口权衡、怎么从知识库动态检索样例、以及用针对性样例兜住边界情况。思维链部分覆盖零样本的逐步推理、带推理轨迹的少样本、多路径采样后自洽校验，以及验证步骤。另外还有结构化提示与 JSON 输出便于解析、带变量插值的可复用模板、专用助手的系统提示词设计，以及输出不一致时的排查与改写路径。
zh.usage: 提示词输出飘或要上生产时，先定任务是分类、抽取还是生成，再选样例策略和结构化输出格式反复对比。
zh.notes: 模式偏通用，各模型的上下文上限和分词要自己核；动态挑样例涉及检索时要自备知识库；不替代评测集。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive resource for prompt engineering patterns, including templates, documentation, and optimization utilities. It follows established best practices for LLM application development and uses standard, trusted libraries. No malicious behaviors, obfuscation, or security risks were identified.

skills.name: dotnet-backend-patterns
skills.description_en: Master C#/.NET backend development patterns for building robust APIs, MCP servers, and enterprise applications. Covers async/await, dependency injection, Entity Framework Core, Dapper, configuration, caching, and testing with xUnit. Use when developing .NET backends, reviewing C# code, or designing API architectures.

audits.summary: The skill provides high-quality documentation and templates for modern C#/.NET backend development patterns, with no security risks or malicious behaviors identified.

skills.name: better-typography
skills.description_en: Sets and reviews how text renders in your product, from the type scale and spacing to font features, wrapping, truncation and punctuation.

zh.intro: 管产品里文字怎么渲染：字号阶梯、行高、字重、字体特性、换行、截断与标点。正文给的是可直接判定的硬数值——无单位行高，展示文字 1.1、标题 1.2 到 1.3、正文 1.5 到 1.6；18px 以下字重不低于 400，100 到 300 只配 28px 以上；行宽 60 到 75 字符；iOS 输入框 16px；会变动的数值用 tabular-nums。落标就算问题。
zh.usage: 审稿时按条对：标题 `text-wrap: balance`、长段 `text-wrap: pretty`、超长词 `overflow-wrap: break-word`；大号标题字距 `-0.01em` 到 `-0.02em`，正文保持 0；数字列开 `tabular-nums`。
zh.notes: 边界划得清：措辞归 better-writing，语义标题结构归 better-accessibility，RTL 空间布局归 better-layout，对比度测量归 better-colors。别拿 font-kerning 关掉来修字距问题。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines and best practices for typography, including type scales, spacing, and font properties. No security issues or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: tao-run-deft-aoi
skills.description_en: Run the full DEFT AOI improvement loop for NVIDIA TAO VisualChangeNet / ChangeNet PCB inspection models: baseline evaluate, RCA, Cosmos AnomalyGen / AMP synthetic defects, k-NN mining, retraining, and deployment gating against a customer-defined primary metric and optional constraints. Use only when the request identifies an AOI / automated-optical-inspection, PCB-defect, VisualChangeNet, or ChangeNet workflow. Supports air-gapped/offline runs with pre-staged assets. Never infer AOI from generic iterative-improvement language. Do not use for CLIP / SigLIP image retrieval, attribute-labelled image data, standalone TAO training, one-off inference, generic anomaly generation, or RCA-only analysis.

audits.summary: This skill is an orchestration workflow for NVIDIA TAO PCB inspection models. It uses local Python scripts and Docker containers to perform model training, evaluation, and data augmentation. Security analysis shows it implements robust safety features including an air-gap execution mode and host-identity mapping for container operations.

skills.name: svelte5-best-practices
skills.description_en: Svelte 5 runes, snippets, SvelteKit patterns, and modern best practices for TypeScript and component development. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring Svelte 5 components and SvelteKit applications. Triggers on: Svelte components, runes ($state, $derived, $effect, $props, $bindable, $inspect), snippets ({#snippet}, {@render}), event handling, SvelteKit data loading, form actions, Svelte 4 to Svelte 5 migration, store to rune migration, slots to snippets migration, TypeScript props typing, generic components, SSR state isolation, performance optimization, or component testing.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive documentation and code snippets for Svelte 5 best practices, including runes, snippets, and SvelteKit patterns. It includes security guidance for handling environment variables and preventing data leaks in SSR. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: vss-generate-video-calibration
skills.description_en: Use to run AutoMagicCalib on local MP4s, RTSP, or the bundled sample dataset, and to deploy vss-auto-calibration when needed. Do not use for non-AMC calibration or runtime analytics.

audits.summary: The skill automates video calibration using NVIDIA AutoMagicCalib. It handles deployment via Docker Compose and provides workflows for local videos, RTSP streams, and sample datasets. Security considerations include the use of dynamic Python script execution via heredocs, the handling of NGC and HuggingFace credentials, and the installation of environment management tools from well-known external sources.

skills.name: recipe-review-meet-participants
skills.description_en: Review who attended a Google Meet conference and for how long.

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for using the Google Workspace CLI tool to review Google Meet conference attendance and session durations. No security issues or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: error-handling-patterns
skills.description_en: Master error handling patterns across languages including exceptions, Result types, error propagation, and graceful degradation to build resilient applications. Use when implementing error handling, designing APIs, or improving application reliability.

zh.intro: 覆盖异常、Result 类型、错误码、Option 四种风格的取舍，并按可恢复和不可恢复给错误分类。正文给的原则是：入口先校验快速失败、保留堆栈和元数据、消息写清发生了什么和怎么修、在能真正处理的那层捕获、用 try-finally 或 defer 清资源、不吞错、尽量用类型化错误。还讲了异步与并发下的错误处理、重试和断路器、降级路径，以及给用户和给开发者两套消息的写法，附带分语言的完整例子。
zh.usage: 写新的错误处理或评审一个 API 的错误契约时，把失败路径贴进来，让它按上面的原则挑模式并指出被吞掉或被过度包装的错误。

audits.summary: The skill is a safe educational resource providing reference patterns for error handling in various programming languages. It contains no malicious code, instructions, or vulnerabilities.

skills.name: pnpm
skills.description_en: Node.js package manager with strict dependency resolution. Use when running pnpm specific commands, configuring workspaces via pnpm-workspace.yaml, or managing dependencies with catalogs, patches, overrides, config dependencies, or the global virtual store.

zh.intro: 按 pnpm 12（Rust 重写的稳定版，保持 v11 的命令、参数和锁文件格式）整理的用法手册：CLI 命令、pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 camelCase 配置模型、workspace 过滤和 workspace 协议、内容寻址存储与 node linker 模式，以及 catalogs、overrides、patches、packageExtensions、allowBuilds、全局虚拟存储这些机制。核心是配置模型变了：设置只放 pnpm-workspace.yaml 和全局 config.yaml，.npmrc 只留认证和 registry，package.json 里的 pnpm 字段不再读。
zh.usage: 配 monorepo 或调依赖冲突时，把 pnpm-workspace.yaml 和报错一起贴出来；CI 里用 `pnpm ci` 或加 `--frozen-lockfile` 锁住版本。
zh.notes: v12 有几处行为差异：git 依赖走 HTTPS、全局 bin 感知项目、Linux 下 packageImportMethod 默认先硬链接、移除 --resolution-only，升级时看迁移那节。

audits.summary: This skill is a comprehensive documentation reference for the pnpm package manager. It provides detailed guides on CLI commands, monorepo management, and supply-chain security features. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: recipe-create-gmail-filter
skills.description_en: Create a Gmail filter to automatically label, star, or categorize incoming messages.

zh.intro: 一条可照做的操作配方，四步建成 Gmail 过滤器：先列出已有标签，再新建标签，然后用 criteria 和 action 建过滤器，把来自指定发件人的邮件自动打标并移出收件箱，最后列一遍过滤器确认生效。命令以 `gws gmail users settings filters create` 为主，参数走 `--params` 与 `--json`。
zh.usage: 第一步 `gws gmail users labels list --params '{"userId": "me"}' --format table` 看现有标签，再 `gws gmail users labels create` 建标签，建完 filter 用 `filters list` 复核；把 `LABEL_ID` 换成真实返回的 id。
zh.notes: 正文要求先加载 `gws-gmail` 技能；过滤器一建好就会改动收件箱投递，改条件前先确认覆盖范围。

audits.summary: This skill provides a standard recipe for creating Gmail filters using the Google Workspace (gws) CLI. It facilitates listing labels, creating a label, and setting up a filter. All operations are standard administrative tasks for the Gmail service and no security risks were identified.

skills.name: gws-gmail-triage
skills.description_en: Gmail: Show unread inbox summary (sender, subject, date).

zh.intro: Google Workspace CLI 里的一条子命令封装：把未读邮件按发件人、主题、日期列出来。适合每天早上扫一眼邮箱，或者让 agent 先摸清邮件状况再决定要不要逐封细看。输出可以切成 JSON，接 jq 直接取字段。
zh.usage: 最短一次调用是 `gws gmail +triage`；限条数并过滤用 `gws gmail +triage --max 5 --query 'from:boss'`；要结构化数据加 `--format json` 再接 jq。
zh.notes: 需要本机装好 gws CLI 并已登录，授权说明在同源的 gws-shared；参数以 `gws gmail +triage --help` 为准。

audits.summary: The skill allows an agent to retrieve summaries of unread Gmail messages using the gws CLI tool. It introduces a potential indirect prompt injection surface from processed email headers, but contains no malicious behavior.

skills.name: gws-events
skills.description_en: Subscribe to Google Workspace events.

zh.intro: 命令行直连 Google Workspace Events API（v1），可管理 subscriptions 的创建、删除、查询、更新与重新激活，也能读 operations 与 tasks。两个辅助命令把订阅包成固定流程：一个订阅事件并逐条输出 NDJSON，另一个续期或重新激活快过期的订阅。
zh.usage: 先 `gws events --help` 浏览资源与方法，再用 `gws schema events.<resource>.<method>` 查必填参数和默认值，然后拼 `--params` 与 `--json`；日常调用看 `+subscribe` 与 `+renew`。
zh.notes: 正文要求先读 `../gws-shared/SKILL.md` 拿鉴权和全局参数，缺了就 `gws generate-skills` 生成；订阅不定期续期会过期。

audits.summary: This skill provides a command-line interface for managing Google Workspace events using the vendor's 'gws' CLI tool. It allows the agent to subscribe to, list, and modify workspace notifications.

skills.name: recipe-draft-email-from-doc
skills.description_en: Read content from a Google Doc and use it as the body of a Gmail message.

zh.intro: 一个两段式小配方：先把 Google Doc 的内容取出来，再把它当成正文发一封 Gmail。正文只有三步——取文档内容、复制正文、发送，命令里把文档 ID、收件人和主题当占位符替换成实际值。适合把已经写好的公告、周报直接搬到邮件里，不用来回复制粘贴。
zh.usage: 先 `gws docs documents get --params '{"documentId": "DOC_ID"}'` 拿内容，再 `gws gmail +send --to recipient@example.com --subject 'Newsletter Update' --body 'CONTENT_FROM_DOC'` 发信。
zh.notes: 需要 gws CLI，且要先加载 gws-docs 和 gws-gmail 两个 skill 才能执行；正文没写鉴权细节，跟着 gws-shared 走。

audits.summary: The skill reads content from an external Google Document and passes it directly into a Gmail draft tool, creating a surface for indirect prompt injection or content manipulation if the source document contains adversarial text.

skills.name: recipe-organize-drive-folder
skills.description_en: Create a Google Drive folder structure and move files into the right locations.

zh.intro: 在 Drive 里建目录结构并把文件搬到位的四步配方：建项目文件夹、在父目录下建子文件夹、用 addParents 与 removeParents 移动已有文件、最后按父目录条件列出结构核对。适合季度项目归档这类一次性整理。
zh.usage: 建文件夹要显式指定 `"mimeType": "application/vnd.google-apps.folder"`；移动用 `gws drive files update --params '{"fileId": "FILE_ID", "addParents": "FOLDER_ID", "removeParents": "OLD_PARENT_ID"}'`，最后 `gws drive files list` 复核。
zh.notes: 需先加载 `gws-drive`；移动会改变别人共享链接的可达性，批量搬之前先确认目录归属和所有者。

audits.summary: This skill provides a documented recipe for organizing Google Drive folders and files using the gws command-line tool. It contains standard administrative commands with no security risks detected.

skills.name: gws-sheets-read
skills.description_en: Google Sheets: Read values from a spreadsheet.

zh.intro: gws 里读表格的子命令：给 spreadsheet ID 加一个范围，把单元格里的值取回来，只读不写，不会改动任何内容。跨所有表格操作的认证和全局参数都在 gws-shared 里，缺了就先生成。
zh.usage: `gws sheets +read --spreadsheet ID --range "Sheet1!A1:D10"`，只要整张表里一个区块时也可以只给 `--range Sheet1`。
zh.notes: 需要装 `gws` 并先按 `../gws-shared/SKILL.md` 配好认证；这个文件缺失时跑 `gws generate-skills` 生成。更细的选项走原始 values.get 接口。

audits.summary: This skill provides a way to read Google Sheets data using a CLI tool. The main security concern is the potential for indirect prompt injection from the spreadsheet data being ingested into the agent's context.

skills.name: terraform-module-library
skills.description_en: Build reusable Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI infrastructure following infrastructure-as-code best practices. Use when creating infrastructure modules, standardizing cloud provisioning, or implementing reusable IaC components.

audits.summary: This skill provides safe template examples and patterns for building Terraform modules across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.

skills.name: better-layout
skills.description_en: Helps with grouping, alignment, reading order, responsive structure and room for translated text, so a layout holds up when it is resized, translated or mirrored.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive set of design guidelines and an audit framework for improving user interface layout, focusing on grouping, alignment, responsiveness, and accessibility. It consists entirely of documentation and static code examples for CSS and HTML best practices.

skills.name: gws-events-renew
skills.description_en: Google Workspace Events: Renew/reactivate Workspace Events subscriptions.

zh.intro: 给 Workspace Events 订阅续命的命令：可以按名字重新激活单条订阅，也可以用 `--all` 把时间窗内即将到期的订阅一起续上。订阅不续期就会过期，所以正文建议配合定时任务跑。
zh.usage: 续单条：`gws events +renew --name subscriptions/SUB_ID`；批量：`gws events +renew --all --within 2d`，其中 `--within` 默认 `1h`，支持 `30m`、`2d` 这类写法。
zh.notes: 正文建议用 cron 定时跑 `--all`；执行前要先按 `../gws-shared/SKILL.md` 配好鉴权和全局参数。

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill is a standard command-line wrapper for managing Google Workspace Event subscriptions using the gws CLI.

skills.name: gws-admin-reports
skills.description_en: Google Workspace Admin SDK: Audit logs and usage reports.

zh.intro: Workspace Admin SDK 的 reports_v1 命令行封装，用来拉管理后台和 Drive 的审计活动，以及客户、实体、用户三种用量报表。正文按资源列出可用方法——activities 的 list 与 watch、channels 的 stop，还有 customerUsageReports、entityUsageReports、userUsageReport 各自的 get——并规定调用前先用 schema 命令查参数类型和默认值，再拼标志，不许凭印象写。
zh.usage: 先 `gws admin-reports --help` 浏览资源和方法，再用 `gws schema admin-reports.<resource>.<method>` 查参数，最后按结果拼 `--params` 和 `--json`。
zh.notes: 先读 `../gws-shared/SKILL.md` 拿鉴权与全局参数，缺了就 `gws generate-skills` 生成；看审计日志需要管理员权限。

audits.summary: This skill provides a legitimate interface for interacting with the Google Workspace Admin SDK using the gws CLI tool to retrieve audit logs and usage reports. No malicious code or unauthorized behaviors were detected.

skills.name: recipe-generate-report-from-sheet
skills.description_en: Read data from a Google Sheet and create a formatted Google Docs report.

zh.intro: 把 Sheet 里的数据变成一份排版好的 Docs 报告：先从指定区间读出数据，再新建文档，用批量写入接口把 Markdown 风格的标题、摘要和榜单塞进去，最后按只读权限分享给相关人。三条命令都给了具体参数，包括区间写成 `Sales!A1:D` 这种形式，分享时角色用 reader。
zh.usage: 读数据 `gws sheets +read` 带 `--range "Sales!A1:D"`，建文档 `gws docs documents create`，写内容 `gws docs +write`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-sheets`、`gws-docs`、`gws-drive`；报告结论要自己从数据里归纳，命令只负责搬运。

audits.summary: This productivity recipe automates the process of reading data from Google Sheets and generating formatted Google Docs reports. It uses the vendor-specific 'gws' CLI tool to interact with Google Workspace services and is consistent with its stated functionality.

skills.name: e2e-testing-patterns
skills.description_en: Master end-to-end testing with Playwright and Cypress to build reliable test suites that catch bugs, improve confidence, and enable fast deployment. Use when implementing E2E tests, debugging flaky tests, or establishing testing standards.

zh.intro: 用 Playwright 和 Cypress 写可靠的端到端测试。该测的是关键用户旅程（登录、结账、注册）、复杂交互（拖拽、多步表单）、跨浏览器兼容、真实接口联调和鉴权流程；不该测的是单元级逻辑、接口契约、边界用例和内部实现细节，那些放回单测和集成测试。测试金字塔里 E2E 保持少量、只压在关键路径上。实践上要求测用户行为而不是实现，用例互不依赖、结果确定、可并行；定位用 data-testid 或 data-cy，别依赖 CSS 类和 DOM 结构。更细的模式与工作样例在 references/details.md。
zh.usage: 要加 E2E 或排查不稳定用例时，先圈出关键旅程，再把选择器换成 data-testid 并让用例彼此独立。
zh.notes: 导航层的模式文档在 references/details.md，不够用时先读它；E2E 跑得慢，边界和契约仍要交给单元与集成测试。

audits.summary: This skill serves as an educational guide for end-to-end testing with Playwright and Cypress, providing standard patterns and best practices. It correctly utilizes environment variables for secret management and references well-known, official testing libraries. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: recipe-create-doc-from-template
skills.description_en: Copy a Google Docs template, fill in content, and share with collaborators.

zh.intro: 从一份 Google Docs 模板复制出新文档，把内容写进去，再把编辑权限开给协作方。做法是先复制模板并改名，从响应里拿新文档 ID，用 Docs 的批量写入接口塞正文（支持 Markdown 风格的小标题），最后用权限接口按角色、类型、邮箱授权。正文给的是可以照抄的三条命令，没有多余解释。
zh.usage: 复制模板用 `gws drive files copy` 加 `--json` 传新名字；写正文用 `gws docs +write` 带 `--document-id`；分享用 `gws drive permissions create`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-drive`、`gws-docs`；`NEW_DOC_ID` 要从复制响应里取，不能手填。

audits.summary: This skill is a productivity recipe designed to automate Google Docs creation and sharing using the 'gws' command-line tool. All operations described are consistent with the skill's stated purpose, and no malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: recipe-create-shared-drive
skills.description_en: Create a Google Shared Drive and add members with appropriate roles.

zh.intro: 建一个 Google 共享云盘再把成员加进去：创建时带一个唯一的请求 ID 防重复提交，随后用权限接口按角色和邮箱加成员，注意要带上支持共享盘的标志才能对它操作，最后列出成员核对。三个命令都是 Drive API 的直连封装，中间没有额外封装层。
zh.usage: 建盘 `gws drive drives create`，加成员 `gws drive permissions create` 把 `supportsAllDrives` 设为 true，核对 `gws drive permissions list`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-drive`；共享盘相关调用漏了 `supportsAllDrives` 会直接报错。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for creating and managing Google Shared Drives using the 'gws' command-line tool. It facilitates legitimate administrative tasks such as setting permissions and listing members within a Google Workspace environment, with no detected security risks.

skills.name: async-python-patterns
skills.description_en: Master Python asyncio, concurrent programming, and async/await patterns for high-performance applications. Use when building async APIs, concurrent systems, or I/O-bound applications requiring non-blocking operations.

zh.intro: asyncio 与并发编程的实践参考：事件循环、协程、任务、future、async with 与 async for 的用法，gather 并发、超时与取消、限流、异步队列、后台任务。开头给了一张同步与异步的选择表：网络和数据库并发用 asyncio，CPU 密集用多进程或线程池，简单脚本保持同步。
zh.usage: 写 FastAPI、aiohttp 的异步接口，或做并发抓取、WebSocket 服务时加载；先按选择表判断该不该上异步，再照模式段落的代码组织协程。
zh.notes: 核心约束是同一条调用路径要么全同步要么全异步，混着写会出现隐藏阻塞。CPU 活交给 asyncio.to_thread 或进程池，别塞进事件循环。

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate educational resource for Python asynchronous programming. It provides well-documented, standard code patterns for using the asyncio library, handling concurrency, error management, and performance optimization. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or security risks were detected.

skills.name: recipe-find-free-time
skills.description_en: Query Google Calendar free/busy status for multiple users to find a meeting slot.

zh.intro: 用 Google Calendar 的 freebusy 查询一次性问多个人的忙闲，拿到重叠的空闲窗口后直接在窗口里建会议。配方只有三步：查忙闲、人工挑重叠段、插入事件。
zh.usage: 查忙闲用 `gws calendar freebusy query --json '{"timeMin": "2024-03-18T08:00:00Z", "timeMax": "2024-03-18T18:00:00Z", "items": [{"id": "user1@company.com"}, {"id": "user2@company.com"}]}'`，再对挑出的窗口跑 `gws calendar +insert` 建会。
zh.notes: 需先加载 `gws-calendar`；时区要显式写清，示例里 Z 结尾的 UTC 和本地时间混用最容易排错。

audits.summary: This skill provides a legitimate recipe for querying calendar availability and scheduling meetings using Google Workspace tools. It uses vendor-provided commands and does not exhibit any malicious patterns or safety violations.

skills.name: expo-examples
skills.description_en: Expo's official example projects - the expo/examples repo of ~70 `with-*` integrations (Stripe, Clerk, Supabase, OpenAI, maps, Reanimated, SQLite, Skia, NativeWind, and more). Use when integrating a third-party library or service into an existing Expo app and you want the canonical, version-matched pattern to adapt, or when scaffolding a new project from one with `npx create-expo --example`.

zh.intro: 对应 expo/examples 仓库里约 70 个 with- 开头的集成范例（Stripe、Clerk、Supabase、OpenAI、地图、Reanimated、SQLite、Skia、NativeWind 等），每个只围绕一个库或服务，是 managed 项目，典型情况就一屏 100 到 200 行，所以拿来抄的是官方维护的依赖集、app.json 配置插件和最小接线，而不是整套应用架构。已有项目时按它的模式改造自己的代码，新项目时直接用 create-expo 的范例参数起。查名要用 gh api 列目录，meta.json 是改名与废弃的唯一依据，废弃的不要再推荐。
zh.usage: 要接某个第三方库时，先按名字找对应的 with 范例（支付找 with-stripe、鉴权找 with-clerk），读它的依赖和 app.json 插件配置再搬到自己项目。
zh.notes: 范例是单点集成，不提供应用架构；references/catalog.md 会漂移，需用 gh api 核对；需要 gh 已登录或能 clone 仓库。

audits.summary: The skill provides a workflow for agents to discover and adapt official Expo integration examples. It uses standard development tools to fetch code from a recognized vendor repository and includes explicit safety guidelines for handling configuration and dependencies.

skills.name: openapi-spec-generation
skills.description_en: Generate and maintain OpenAPI 3.1 specifications from code, design-first specs, and validation patterns. Use when creating API documentation, generating SDKs, or ensuring API contract compliance.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive patterns and templates for generating OpenAPI specifications from code and design inputs. It facilitates the installation of well-known API documentation tools and generates configuration files from templates. It possesses an inherent attack surface for indirect prompt injection as it processes external code to generate documentation, which is its primary function.

skills.name: recipe-bulk-download-folder
skills.description_en: List and download all files from a Google Drive folder.

zh.intro: 一个配方型技能：把 Drive 文件夹里的文件全部列出来，再逐个取下来。三步走——先按父目录 ID 过滤列出清单，再对每个文件调用取内容的接口（`alt` 传 `media`）写成本地文件，Google 原生文档则换成导出接口转成 PDF。正文开头就写明要先把 `gws-drive` 装载好才能跑，所有参数都是 `--params` 传一段 JSON。
zh.usage: 先 `gws drive files list` 带上 `FOLDER_ID` in parents 的查询把清单拉下来，再逐个跑 `gws drive files get`，原生文档用 `gws drive files export` 转 PDF。
zh.notes: 需要本机装好 `gws` CLI 并已登录，同时装载 `gws-drive` 技能；这条只给三步命令，鉴权与全局参数不在这里。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for bulk downloading files from Google Drive using the 'gws' CLI tool. It is generally safe but carries a minor risk typical of file-processing tools: it could be influenced by malicious content or filenames encountered during the folder listing process.

skills.name: recipe-watch-drive-changes
skills.description_en: Subscribe to change notifications on a Google Drive file or folder.

zh.intro: 给某个 Drive 文件或共享盘挂变更订阅：一条创建命令就把目标资源、事件类型、通知终点（Pub/Sub topic）和是否附带资源体都定下来；随后能列出当前活着的订阅，并在过期前续期。事件类型用的是 Workspace Events 的资源名写法，所以目标要写成完整的 `//drive.googleapis.com/...` 形式。
zh.usage: 建订阅 `gws events subscriptions create`，列订阅 `gws events subscriptions list`，续期 `gws events +renew` 带 `--subscription`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-events`；还要事先有可用的 Pub/Sub topic 和对应权限，正文用 `PROJECT`、`TOPIC`、`DRIVE_ID` 占位。

audits.summary: The skill is a standard administrative recipe for managing Google Drive event subscriptions using the Google Workspace CLI tool. It follows best practices by using placeholders for sensitive identifiers and interacting with official Google API endpoints.

skills.name: recipe-find-large-files
skills.description_en: Identify large Google Drive files consuming storage quota.

zh.intro: 查 Drive 里占空间的文件：一条列举命令带上按已用配额倒序的排序、页大小取前 20，字段只要 id、name、size、mimeType、owners，输出成表格看排行。正文第二步没有命令，只是让你看结果决定哪些归档或挪走。
zh.usage: 跑 `gws drive files list`，`orderBy` 用 `quotaBytesUsed desc`，配 `--format table` 看排行。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-drive`；它只负责列出来，删除和归档要另外走命令。

audits.summary: This skill is a recipe that provides instructions for identifying large Google Drive files using the 'gws' command-line tool. It does not contain executable code or malicious patterns.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description_en: Reviews code changes and provides actionable feedback. Use when the user asks to review a PR, diff, commit, or code changes. Triggers on "/review", "review this PR", "review my changes", "code review".

audits.summary: This skill provides code review capabilities and includes some standard security considerations regarding the handling of external data and command execution. These patterns are characteristic of developer tools and are generally managed through the agent platform's built-in safety guardrails.

skills.name: recipe-backup-sheet-as-csv
skills.description_en: Export a Google Sheets spreadsheet as a CSV file for local backup or processing.

zh.intro: 把 Google Sheets 表格导成本地 CSV 做备份或后续处理的三种路径：查表格元信息、用 Drive 导出并指定 `text/csv`、或者直接用 Sheets 读取命令按范围取成 CSV。适合定期快照，或者把表喂给本地脚本分析。
zh.usage: 整表导出用 `gws drive files export --params '{"fileId": "SHEET_ID", "mimeType": "text/csv"}'`；只想要某段数据就用 `gws sheets +read --spreadsheet SHEET_ID --range 'Sheet1' --format csv`。
zh.notes: 需先加载 `gws-sheets` 与 `gws-drive`；多工作表时按范围读比整表导出更精确，别把公式和格式当成已保留。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for exporting Google Sheets to CSV format using the gws command-line tool. It is a standard productivity recipe with no security issues detected.

skills.name: gws-workflow-file-announce
skills.description_en: Google Workflow: Announce a Drive file in a Chat space.
skills.name_zh: 在 Chat 空间发布文件

zh.name_zh: 在 Chat 空间发布文件
zh.intro: 一条跨服务命令：把 Drive 里的文件在指定 Google Chat 空间里公布，自动读取文件名拼出公告正文，也可以附一句自定义说明。它是写命令，会真的往空间里发消息。
zh.usage: 用法为 `gws workflow +file-announce --file-id <ID> --space <SPACE>`，例如 `gws workflow +file-announce --file-id FILE_ID --space spaces/ABC123 --message 'Check this out!'`；输出格式由 `--format` 控制，可选 json、table、yaml、csv。
zh.notes: 正文提醒先用 `gws drive +upload` 把文件传上去再公告；发送前确认是哪个空间，发错了很难收回。

audits.summary: This skill is safe. It contains documentation and usage instructions for the 'gws' command-line interface tool to announce a Google Drive file within a Google Chat space.

skills.name: recipe-plan-weekly-schedule
skills.description_en: Review your Google Calendar week, identify gaps, and add events to fill them.

zh.intro: 一条自查一周日程的配方：先看本周议程，再查忙闲找出空档，然后往空档里插入比如深度工作这类时间块，最后再看一遍更新后的安排。
zh.usage: 按 `gws calendar +agenda` 看本周，再用 `gws calendar freebusy query` 查空档，然后 `gws calendar +insert --summary 'Deep Work Block' --start '2026-01-21T14:00:00' --end '2026-01-21T16:00:00'`，最后再跑一次议程复核。
zh.notes: 需先加载 `gws-calendar`；插入前确认时区，并检查是否和既有时段冲突。

audits.summary: The skill is a benign recipe for managing Google Calendar schedules using official Workspace tools. It performs standard scheduling operations like checking agendas, querying availability, and inserting events.

skills.name: recipe-save-email-to-doc
skills.description_en: Save a Gmail message body into a Google Doc for archival or reference.

zh.intro: 把一封 Gmail 的内容存成 Google Doc：先按主题和发件人搜出邮件，取出内容，新建文档，再把发件人、主题、正文按这个顺序写进去，方便日后检索或引用。四步都是现成命令，快捷写入那一步负责处理 Docs 的格式，正文里只留了一个占位符让你换成真实邮件内容。
zh.usage: 找信 `gws gmail users messages list`，取内容 `gws gmail users messages get`，建文档 `gws docs documents create`，写正文 `gws docs +write`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-gmail`、`gws-docs`；正文位置写的是 `[EMAIL BODY]` 占位，实际要换成取回的邮件正文。

audits.summary: This skill provides a standard workflow for archiving Gmail messages into Google Docs using the official Google Workspace CLI tool. The process uses vendor-authorized tools for data management within a single ecosystem and contains no malicious code or suspicious network activity.

skills.name: limrun-bazel
skills.description_en: The default way to build any Bazel workspace on Limrun: build its iOS and Android targets on Limrun's shared build plane with `lim bazel setup` and `bazel build --config=limrun`, from any environment (Linux, Windows, macOS, VM, container, CI), with one remote cache shared across the organization. Use when the project is a Bazel workspace (MODULE.bazel) with rules_apple or rules_android and the user wants to build it remotely, run the built app on a Limrun simulator or emulator, set up Bazel remote execution in CI, or fix a `--config=limrun` build that fails on authentication, workers, or missing MODULE.bazel lines. limrun-xcode-bazel covers only the legacy `lim xcode rbe` flow; use it only when the workspace already runs on `lim xcode rbe` or the user asks for it. For non-Bazel Android builds, use limrun-gradle.

zh.intro: 把 Bazel 工作区的 iOS、Android 目标放到 Limrun 的共享构建机上跑：lim bazel setup 在 MODULE.bazel 所在目录生成被 gitignore 的 .limrun/，往 .bazelrc 加一条 try-import，之后 bazel build --config=limrun 就走远程，Apple 动作落在 Mac、Android 动作落在 Linux worker，全组织共用一个远端缓存，本机不需要装 Xcode 或 Android SDK。要求 Bazel 8 以上和 rules_apple 或 rules_android；Android 还要 rules_cc、rules_java、protobuf、hermetic_android_toolchains，缺的行会打印出来，非交互环境要加 --yes。
zh.usage: 在工作区装好 lim 后跑 `lim bazel setup`，再 `bazel build --config=limrun` 构建；CI 里补 --yes 免去确认，换 CLI 版本或开始用 Apple/Android 规则后重跑 setup。
zh.notes: 只适用于有 MODULE.bazel 且根模块声明了 rules_apple 或 rules_android 的工作区；旧的 lim xcode rbe 走 limrun-xcode-bazel，非 Bazel 的 Android 构建走 limrun-gradle。凭证只认 lim login 或 LIM_API_KEY，用 npm 全局安装才会带上 lim-bazel-credentials。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for configuring and using the Limrun build plane to perform remote Bazel builds. It covers CLI installation via npm, authentication using environment variables, and execution of remote build commands. All referenced tools and domains are official resources belonging to the vendor.

skills.name: recipe-create-task-list
skills.description_en: Set up a new Google Tasks list with initial tasks.

zh.intro: 用 Google Tasks 起一个新清单并塞进初始任务：先建列表，再往里面插任务（可以带备注和到期时间），插完用列表命令打印成表格核对。清单 ID 要写成占位符 TASKLIST_ID，创建后从响应里取真实值替换。
zh.usage: 建清单 `gws tasks tasklists insert`，加任务 `gws tasks tasks insert`，核对 `gws tasks tasks list` 带 `--format table`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-tasks`；任务的到期时间要写 RFC3339，正文用的是 `2024-04-01T00:00:00Z` 这种形式。

audits.summary: This skill provides a standard documentation recipe for creating a task list and adding tasks using the Google Workspace CLI tool. No security vulnerabilities or malicious behaviors were detected.

skills.name: improve
skills.description_en: Survey any codebase as a senior advisor and produce prioritized, self-contained implementation plans for OTHER models/agents to execute. Strictly read-only on source code — never implements, fixes, or refactors anything itself. Use when asked to audit a codebase, find improvement opportunities (bugs, security, performance, test coverage, tech debt, migrations, DX), suggest features or where to take the project next (roadmap, product direction), or generate handoff plans for another agent to implement.

zh.intro: 把当前模型当资深顾问用：通读代码库，找出价值最高的改进点，写成别人能直接执行的实施计划。它自己严格只读，不改一行业务代码，产出是按优先级排好的计划文档。定位是贵的、判断力强的模型负责理解和写计划，便宜模型负责执行，计划本身才是最终交付物。
zh.usage: 让你审一遍代码库找 bug、安全问题、性能瓶颈、测试盲区或技术债时用它，也可以让它规划项目下一步方向、生成交给别的 agent 去做的交接计划。可以用 `plans/` 目录这类约定来指定计划落到哪里。
zh.notes: 硬规则是绝不自己改源码，最多建 `plans/` 目录并往里面写计划。它不接手修复或重构。计划面向零上下文、能力更弱的执行模型，所以每条都要写清改哪个文件、怎么验收。

audits.summary: This skill acts as a senior technical advisor for code auditing and implementation planning. It contains exceptional security safeguards, including explicit 'hard rules' that prevent the reproduction of discovered secrets and instructions to treat all repository content as untrusted data to mitigate prompt injection risks.

skills.name: recipe-block-focus-time
skills.description_en: Create recurring focus time blocks on Google Calendar to protect deep work hours.

zh.intro: 在 Calendar 上建重复的专注时间块，保护整块深度工作。一条插入命令就把事办完：summary 和 description 写明用途，start 与 end 定时间段，recurrence 用 RRULE 按周一到周五重复，transparency 设成 opaque 让它在同事眼里显示为忙碌。第二步只是用 agenda 确认它真的进了日程。
zh.usage: 建块用 `gws calendar events insert`，`--json` 里带 `RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY`；建完跑 `gws calendar +agenda` 看是否显示为忙碌。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-calendar`；时间和时区是写死的占位值，不改就是别人的时间表。

audits.summary: The skill provides a straightforward recipe for creating recurring focus blocks on Google Calendar using the Google Workspace (gws) command-line tool. It uses legitimate vendor tools and follows standard scheduling practices without any malicious behavior detected.

skills.name: recipe-share-doc-and-notify
skills.description_en: Share a Google Docs document with edit access and email collaborators the link.

zh.intro: 把一份 Google Docs 以编辑权限共享给对方，再发一封邮件把链接送过去。找文档时用名字包含加 MIME 类型双重限定，权限接口按角色 writer、类型 user、邮箱授权，最后用邮件快捷发送带主题和正文，正文里直接拼上文档链接。三步都是 Drive 与 Gmail 的直连命令。
zh.usage: 找文档 `gws drive files list`，开权限 `gws drive permissions create`，发信 `gws gmail +send` 带 `--to`、`--subject`、`--body`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-drive`、`gws-docs`、`gws-gmail`；链接是 `https://docs.google.com/document/d/DOC_ID` 的形式，DOC_ID 要换成真实值。

audits.summary: The skill is a standard automation recipe for sharing a Google Doc and notifying collaborators using Google Workspace tools. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: layout
skills.description_en: Improve layout, spacing, and visual rhythm. Fixes monotonous grids, inconsistent spacing, and weak visual hierarchy. Use when the user mentions layout feeling off, spacing issues, visual hierarchy, crowded UI, alignment problems, or wanting better composition.

zh.intro: 把平淡拥挤的版面改出节奏。先按五项评估：间距是否一致还是随手填的数值、是否所有地方留白一样多导致没有松紧、眯眼后能不能认出第一和第二重要的元素、有没有一个能看出来的底层结构还是全靠运气、密度是否和内容类型匹配（数据密集的界面该紧，营销页该留白）。再给改动方案：定一套间距刻度（框架自带或自建 token 都行，关键是统一）、用空间表达层级、按内容选布局方式（一维用弹性，二维用网格，复杂区域命名）、打破千篇一律的卡片阵列。参考文件里有网格、节奏、容器查询的细则。
zh.usage: 界面看着挤或乱时，让它按间距、层级、网格、节奏、密度五项过一遍，再给一套间距刻度和具体版式改法。
zh.notes: 必须先加载 /impeccable 并按里面的上下文采集流程走，没有设计上下文时要先做那一步教学；只处理空间与结构，配色字体另算。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructional guidance on improving UI layout and spacing. It contains no malicious code, network requests, or sensitive data access.

skills.name: recipe-create-presentation

zh.intro: 一份三步的操作配方：先建一份 Google Slides 演示，从响应里取演示 ID，再给团队开编辑权限。建的时候用 json 参数带标题，授权用 Drive 的 permissions create，按 fileId 指定文件、role 给 writer、type 给 user、emailAddress 写对方邮箱。执行前要先加载 gws-slides 技能。
zh.usage: 先 `gws slides presentations create` 用 `--json` 带标题建演示并取回 ID，再 `gws drive permissions create` 用 `--params` 指 fileId、用 `--json` 给 role 与 emailAddress。
zh.notes: 配方不替你做决策：标题和共享名单要问用户；缺 gws-slides 技能先加载，否则 API 形态拼不对。

skills.name: browser-testing-with-devtools
skills.description_en: Tests in real browsers via Chrome DevTools MCP. Use when building or debugging anything that runs in a browser. Use when you need to inspect the DOM, capture console errors, analyze network requests, profile performance, or verify visual output with real runtime data.
