zh.intro: 通过 Chrome DevTools 的 MCP 把浏览器接进代理的工作流，能看 DOM、控制台报错、网络请求和性能数据。核心主张是别猜运行时发生了什么，去看真实数据，因此凡是在浏览器里渲染的东西都建议先跑一遍再下结论；后端和命令行工具不适用。
zh.usage: 在浏览器里跑的功能改完都要真实跑一遍：看控制台、翻网络请求、必要时采性能数据。
zh.notes: 需要先配好 chrome-devtools 这个 MCP 服务；后端和纯命令行改动用不上。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for browser testing using Chrome DevTools. It features comprehensive security guidelines to handle untrusted web content and maintain browser profile isolation. No malicious behavior was identified.

skills.name: web-quality-audit
skills.description_en: Run an evidence-led web quality audit covering performance, accessibility, SEO, best practices, and agentic browsing. Use when asked to "audit my site", "review web quality", "run lighthouse audit", "check page quality", or "optimize my website".

zh.intro: 带证据的网页质量审计：性能、可访问性、SEO、最佳实践、agent 能不能顺利浏览，五类一起过。有可跑的页面就先抓一次实测基线，再用运行时失败去定位源码，把实测结论和「只在代码里看着可疑」的假设分开记；按用户影响和置信度分级给具体修法，最后重跑等价自动检查并说明哪些已验证、哪些还等真实用户数据。
zh.usage: 先定审计目标，有可跑页面就读性能测量流程，用 `performance_start_trace`、`lighthouse_audit` 抓基线；源码侧用 `scripts/analyze.sh <path>` 跑静态分析；报告末尾的验证部分按 `Audit results` 的结构写。
zh.notes: 正文按 Lighthouse 13+ 的 Performance Insights 口径写，别照搬已下线的 audit ID；没有可跑页面时只能说「仅在代码中可疑」，不许断言指标不达标。

audits.summary: The skill is a safe utility for performing web quality audits on local HTML content. It provides documentation for manual audits alongside a bash script that performs local static analysis of HTML files to check for standard tags and attributes. The script operates entirely offline, performs no file modifications, and properly quotes variables to prevent command injection.

skills.name: vue-router-best-practices
skills.description_en: Vue Router 4 patterns, navigation guards, route params, and route-component lifecycle interactions.

audits.summary: This skill is a collection of educational documentation and best practices for using Vue Router 4. It contains no executable code, network operations, or sensitive data access, and is focused entirely on providing guidance for frontend development patterns.

skills.name: gsap
skills.description_en: GSAP animation reference for HyperFrames. Covers gsap.to(), from(), fromTo(), easing, stagger, defaults, timelines (gsap.timeline(), position parameter, labels, nesting, playback), and performance (transforms, will-change, quickTo). Use when writing GSAP animations in HyperFrames compositions.

zh.intro: HyperFrames 里写 GSAP 动画的参考：补间方法、缓动、错开、默认值、时间轴与位置参数、标签嵌套与播放控制，以及性能取舍。同时说明了 HyperFrames 的接入约定——同步创建一个暂停的时间轴，按作品根节点上的 data-composition-id 注册到 page 的动画表上，由 HyperFrames 接管定位。适合在 HyperFrames 作品里写动效时随时查。
zh.usage: 时间轴用 `gsap.timeline({ paused: true })` 建，键名必须与作品根节点的 data-composition-id 一致，注册到 `window.__timelines` 后由外部定位，渲染关键动效不要主动调 tl.play()。常用写法还包括 gsap.to()、gsap.from()、gsap.fromTo() 与 gsap.defaults()；用页面内嵌脚本时按正文给的 CDN 地址引入库。逐条对照 tl.to 的写法可以查看官方时间轴文档。
zh.notes: 性能一节要求优先动 transform 和 opacity、按需声明 will-change、高频更新改用 gsap.quickTo()，并给出清理建议；响应式与无障碍走 gsap.matchMedia()。正文另有明确的「不要这样做」清单。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and utility scripts for GSAP animations within HyperFrames. It includes a Python script for extracting audio data using ffmpeg and numpy, and documentation for common animation effects. No malicious behavior was detected.

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.description_en: Guides systematic root-cause debugging. Use when tests fail, builds break, something that worked yesterday broke, behavior doesn't match expectations, or you encounter any unexpected error. Use when you need to figure out what broke and why — a systematic approach to finding and fixing the root cause rather than guessing.

zh.intro: 系统化的排错流程：出问题先停手，保留报错、日志和复现步骤，再按分诊清单定位根因，修掉之后再加防护，而不是靠猜。测试失败、构建炸掉、行为和预期不符时都按这个走。
zh.usage: 测试挂了、构建失败、运行结果和预期不一样、线上出事故，或者日志里冒出没见过的错误时，先停掉加新功能的动作，收好现场，再照清单分诊。
zh.notes: 核心是停手和留证据；根因没找到之前别改代码，改了会把线索一起冲掉。

audits.summary: The skill provides a systematic framework for debugging and error recovery, including specific security guidelines to treat external error output as untrusted data. No malicious patterns or vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: better-writing
skills.description_en: Writes and reviews your interface copy, from labels and errors to empty states and confirmations, so it matches your product's voice and tells people what to do next.

audits.summary: This skill provides safe and professional guidelines for improving user interface writing and microcopy. It contains no executable code or malicious patterns.

skills.name: prompt-optimizer
skills.description_en: Turn any rough prompt, half-formed idea, or task description into a finished, ready-to-send prompt optimized for any LLM model inside a chat interface — NOT the API. Use this skill whenever the user wants to write, rewrite, optimize, improve, sharpen, or polish a prompt for chat. Trigger phrases include "rewrite this prompt", "make this a better prompt", "optimize this prompt", "turn this into a prompt", "help me prompt this", "draft a prompt that...", "I want to ask...", or whenever the user pastes a draft prompt and asks for improvements. Also trigger when the user describes a task they plan to send to an LLM model and clearly wants a reusable, well-structured prompt rather than a direct answer. The output is always a single, copy-pasteable prompt in a code block that the user sends as-is — never a template with placeholders.

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for transforming user drafts into optimized prompts for AI chat interfaces. It does not contain code, perform network requests, or access sensitive files.

skills.name: aws-transform
skills.description_en: Performs code upgrades, migrations, and transformations using the AWS Transform (ATX) CLI. Use when upgrading language versions, migrating AWS SDKs, migrating frameworks (Angular, Vue.js, Spring Boot, React), upgrading libraries, optimizing performance, migrating x86 to Graviton, analyzing codebases / generating documentation, or defining custom transformations with natural language. Runs locally on a few repositories or at scale across hundreds via AWS Batch/Fargate.

audits.summary: This skill provides standard automation for performing code upgrades and migrations using the AWS Transform CLI. It contains typical development operations such as operating system detection, package configuration, and repository management. These patterns are consistent with the skill's primary modernization and infrastructure tasks.

skills.name: design-motion-principles
skills.description_en: Motion and interaction design expert based on Emil Kowalski, Jakub Krehel, and Jhey Tompkins' techniques. Two modes — build interactive components with purposeful motion, or audit existing animations to catch AI-slop motion patterns (audit emits a branded HTML report with looping demos). Use when creating, adding, animating, or reviewing UI motion: transitions, hover states, micro-interactions, enter/exit animations, or any motion design work in React, Framer Motion, CSS, or HTML. Provides per-designer perspectives with context-aware weighting.

audits.summary: The skill provides motion design auditing capabilities. It executes local workspace commands to find files, generate reports, and open them in the system browser. It also reads untrusted workspace code, introducing an indirect prompt injection surface.

skills.name: insforge-debug
skills.description_en: Use when diagnosing problems in an InsForge project — reactive failures (SDK error object, HTTP 4xx/5xx, gateway timeout 502/503/504, edge function failure or timeout, login/OAuth/auth errors, RLS denial, realtime channel issues, slow query on one endpoint, edge function or Vercel deploy failure), proactive audits (security/RLS review, performance/index review, system health check, pre-launch readiness), or when the user has an error but doesn't know where to start.

zh.intro: 排查 InsForge 项目里的问题，按可观测面组织：日志、指标、数据库健康、顾问、策略、元数据、错误对象和部署状态。分两类场景，一类是已经报错的被动处置，比如接口 4xx、5xx、网关超时、边缘函数失败、登录鉴权错误、行级安全拒绝和慢查询；另一类是上线前主动审计。
zh.usage: 拿到具体报错时交给它做快速分诊，再按症状查对应的观测面和步骤；不知道从哪查起也可以直接问。
zh.notes: 正文要求始终用命令行工具的最新版本执行，不要全局安装；每种观测面各有一份参考文档。

audits.summary: Error: AI Analysis failed - API error after retries

skills.name: argent-qa-flows
skills.description_en: Create repeatable QA regression E2E tests as Argent flows from test cases, tickets, or acceptance criteria. Use when the user asks to generate or preserve an automated regression scenario, with deterministic setup, stable targets, executable structural or visual evidence, and two consecutive full passes. For one-off UI checks or replayable paths without acceptance criteria, use argent-test-ui-flow or argent-create-flow. Supports iOS, Android, Chromium, and Vega (Fire TV), where recorded tv-remote steps replace touch directives. Apple TV and Android TV are unsupported; use argent-tv-interact there and report the limitation.

zh.intro: 把测试用例、工单或验收标准整理成可重复执行的 Argent 回归流程：固定起始数据、用稳定选择器定位、给出结构化或截图证据，并要求同一份流程连续两次完整跑通才算完成。
zh.usage: 需要生成或保留自动化回归场景时使用；先写契约表列出起点状态、操作顺序、每行预期结果与证据，录制一次完整走查，按允许的方式补润色，再立刻用同一运行器连跑两遍。
zh.notes: 电视端用录制的遥控步骤代替触摸指令；Apple TV 与 Android TV 不在支持范围，应改用电视交互技能并说明限制。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates the creation of automated QA regression tests for mobile and TV platforms. While functionally safe for its intended purpose, it presents a minor security surface for indirect prompt injection because it generates executable test flows and scripts based on untrusted external inputs such as user-provided test cases, tickets, or acceptance criteria.

skills.name: insforge-integrations
skills.description_en: Use when wiring an external auth provider (Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS, Kinde, Stytch, Better Auth) into InsForge for JWT-based RLS, or when adding the OKX x402 payment facilitator for onchain pay-per-use billing.

zh.intro: 把第三方服务接进 InsForge，目前分两类：一类是外部登录服务商，通过令牌声明配合行级安全；一类是支付通道，走 x402 这种按次计费的链上支付协议。每个服务商都有单独一份指南，按对接方式选着看。
zh.usage: 要把外部登录接进来做基于令牌的行级安全，或者接入按次付费时用，按服务商分册查阅。
zh.notes: 外部登录服务商包括 Clerk、Auth0、WorkOS、Kinde、Stytch 和 Better Auth；支付侧目前是 OKX 的 x402。名字取自正文表格。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive guides for integrating authentication and payment providers with the InsForge platform. It uses standard practices for token management and secure secret handling. Minor security considerations include the use of a vendor-specific CLI tool via npx and a potential surface for indirect prompt injection in an AI-generated report example.

skills.name: performance
skills.description_en: Optimize web performance for faster loading and better user experience. Use when asked to "speed up my site", "optimize performance", "reduce load time", "fix slow loading", "improve page speed", or "performance audit".

zh.intro: 用真实用户信号排优先级、用浏览器 trace 找病因的网页性能做法：先建立 field 加 lab 两套基线，再挑真实用户里差的 Core Web Vitals 下刀，只改跟实测瓶颈相关的代码与资源，改完重跑同级测量并报出前后数值、条件与不确定度。给要提速站点、做性能审计的人。
zh.usage: 页面能跑就先读 `references/MEASUREMENT.md` 建基线；有 Chrome DevTools MCP 就用 `performance_start_trace` 录 trace、`performance_analyze_insight` 看聚焦结论，别拿 `lighthouse_audit` 当性能工具用。
zh.notes: 没有可跑页面时只能静态看，这时结论要标成假设并附上能验证它的命令或浏览器流程，不能当成已测到的回归来汇报。

audits.summary: The performance skill provides technical guidance and code examples for optimizing web application performance. It relies on standard browser APIs, well-known performance measurement tools from Google, and established best practices for resource delivery and runtime efficiency. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: expo-dom
skills.description_en: Use Expo DOM components to run web code in a webview on native and as-is on web. Migrate web code to native incrementally. For the end-to-end migration of a whole web app, use the expo-web-to-native skill.

audits.summary: The skill facilitates running web-based React components within native mobile environments and provides a feedback utility executed via the command line. While functional, the bridge between web content and native capabilities creates a surface for indirect prompt injection, and the feedback mechanism involves downloading and executing external code.

skills.name: react-state-management
skills.description_en: Master modern React state management with Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Jotai, and React Query. Use when setting up global state, managing server state, or choosing between state management solutions.

audits.summary: This skill is a safe, educational resource focused on modern React state management patterns. It provides code examples for industry-standard libraries and follows development best practices.

skills.name: pdf-extraction
skills.description_en: Extract text, tables, and metadata from PDFs using pdfplumber

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate utility for PDF data extraction using the pdfplumber library. It contains standard coding patterns, appropriate dependencies, and clear documentation without any malicious behavior.

skills.name: lark-apps
skills.description_en: 妙搭（Spark/Miaoda）应用开发与托管：应用创建、本地全栈开发、云端生成迭代、创意设计（UI mockup / 可交互原型 / 线框图 / 落地页 / 仪表盘 / 幻灯片 deck / 视觉探索）、AI相关能力和飞书平台能力或者其他外部能力集成、日志/Trace/监控指标/PV/UV 查询、环境变量管理、应用协作者与协作权限设置、应用角色与成员管理、自动化触发器（定时/记录变更/Webhook/飞书审批）。当用户要开发/新建一个系统·工具·平台·应用，或要本地开发 / 云端开发 / 修改 / 部署 / 发布 / 上线 / 拿可分享链接，或用 HTML 做页面·网站·部署到妙搭，或要设计 / design / mockup / prototype / wireframe / 做 PPT / deck / 视觉探索，或提到妙搭/Spark/Miaoda 应用（链接形如 `/app/app_xxx` 或 `/page/<token>`，运行时域名形如 *.aiforce.cloud）、应用数据库、应用文件存储、开放 API Key、可见范围、应用协作者/开发权限、应用角色/角色成员、线上日志、接口请求量、错误量、延迟、访问量、环境变量、给妙搭应用配自动化任务/定时触发/审批通过后自动触发时使用。不负责普通云盘文件上传（lark-drive）、飞书文档编辑（lark-doc）、原生幻灯片创建（lark-slides）。

zh.intro: 妙搭（Spark/Miaoda）应用的开发与托管。覆盖应用创建、本地全栈开发、云端生成迭代；创意设计包括 UI 稿、可交互原型、线框图、落地页、仪表盘与幻灯片 deck；还包括模型能力与飞书平台能力集成、日志与 Trace、监控指标、PV/UV 查询、环境变量、协作者与协作权限、应用角色与成员，以及定时、记录变更、Webhook、审批通过这类自动化触发器。应用链接形如 /app/ 或 /page/ 开头。云盘上传、飞书文档编辑、原生幻灯片创建不在范围内。
zh.usage: 要新建或改造一个妙搭应用、拿可分享链接、查线上日志与访问量，或给它配自动化触发时调用；默认用用户身份。
zh.notes: 应用属于用户资产，默认用户身份；缺本域权限时再单独登录一次。

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive environment for developing and managing Lark (Miaoda) applications and creative designs. It includes a variety of React-based starter components and instructions for using the lark-cli to handle application deployment, database management, and automation. All external resources and CDN links point to verified vendor domains associated with Lark and ByteDance.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.description_en: Optimizes agent context setup. Use when starting a new session, when agent output quality degrades, when switching between tasks, or when you need to configure rules files and context for a project.

zh.intro: 安排 agent 该看到的信息：上下文是影响输出质量最大的一个变量，给少了会瞎编，给多了会跑偏。做法是分清哪些内容常驻、哪些按任务加载，以及按什么顺序摆，从最持久的规则文件到最临时的片段。
zh.usage: 开新会话、发现 agent 输出质量下滑（用错模式、编不存在的接口、不守项目约定）、在代码库不同部分之间切换，或者给新项目配规则文件时用它。
zh.notes: 常驻的规则文件别塞太多；一次只装当前任务要用的规格和代码片段，做完就换掉。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructional content on context engineering and best practices for managing AI agent sessions. It includes security-positive advice such as preventing secret leakage and handling untrusted data. No malicious patterns or vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: basin
skills.description_en: Build and troubleshoot Cloudflare Basin analytics workflows with Basin Pipelines, Basin Catalog, and Basin SQL. Use for streaming data into R2 Iceberg tables, managing catalogs, or querying those tables; also use for requests using the former Data Platform, Pipelines, R2 Data Catalog, or R2 SQL names.

zh.intro: 搭和排查 Cloudflare Basin 的分析链路：Basin Pipelines 收事件并写进 R2 上的 Iceberg 表，Basin Catalog 管元数据和表维护，Basin SQL 做分布式查询。旧名 Data Platform、Pipelines、R2 Data Catalog、R2 SQL 都指向这里。
zh.usage: 要把事件流进 R2、管 Iceberg 目录、查这些表时用。先按任务表选管线、目录还是查询，再取当期文档核对限制、定价、权限和 CLI 语法；旧命令族 wrangler pipelines、wrangler r2 bucket catalog、wrangler r2 sql 仍可用。
zh.notes: 改名后资源和配置照旧；旧 API 标识和指标名可能还在用旧词，弃用细节回文档查；未发布的页面以 cloudflare-docs 的 PR 为准。

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and workflow templates for Cloudflare Basin, focusing on data ingestion, catalog management, and SQL queries. It follows standard development practices for Cloudflare services and includes security considerations such as using secrets for authentication tokens and performing client-side validation.

skills.name: remember
skills.description_en: Review the current conversation and capture valuable knowledge — best practices, coding conventions, architecture decisions, workflows, and user feedback — into persistent memory (AGENTS.md) or reusable skills. Use when the user says: (1) remember this, (2) save what we learned, (3) update memory, (4) capture learnings.

audits.summary: This skill is designed to capture information from conversations and save it into persistent memory files or new skills. While this is its intended purpose, it introduces security considerations regarding how untrusted data is stored and used to influence future agent behavior.

skills.name: core-web-vitals
skills.description_en: Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) for better page experience using field and lab evidence. Use when asked to "improve Core Web Vitals", "fix LCP", "reduce CLS", "optimize INP", "page experience optimization", or "fix layout shifts".

zh.intro: 盯 LCP、INP、CLS 三个核心指标的优化手册：先看 CrUX 的 p75 实测，再录一次浏览器性能 trace 定位原因，只分析跟失败指标相关的那几条 insight，改完重跑等价测量。阈值表写得很清楚——LCP 不超过 2.5 秒、INP 不超过 200 毫秒、CLS 不超过 0.1，按 75 分位算；还给了 Next.js、React、Vue/Nuxt 的常见改法。
zh.usage: 有可跑页面就先读性能测量流程，用 `performance_start_trace` 抓 trace、`lighthouse_audit` 做实验室复核；LCP 图在首屏就用 `fetchpriority="high"` 提优先级，预渲染场景注意 `prerenderingchange` 事件。
zh.notes: 只有源码时只能说「可能的原因」，正文禁止在没有运行时证据时断言指标不达标；改完不能声称 field 数据立刻变好，CrUX 要等新一批真实访问。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive and secure instructions for optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) using industry-standard browser APIs and development frameworks. No malicious patterns, hidden code, or security risks were detected.

skills.name: resend
skills.description_en: Emulated Resend email API for local development and testing. Use when the user needs to send emails locally, test transactional email flows, implement magic link or verification code auth, inspect sent emails, manage domains/contacts/API keys, or work with the Resend API without sending real emails. Triggers include "Resend API", "emulate Resend", "send email locally", "test email", "magic link", "verification email", "email inbox", "RESEND_BASE_URL", or any task requiring a local email API.

audits.summary: This skill provides a local development tool for emulating the Resend email API. It includes security considerations common to development environments, such as local command execution and handling of simulated email data. These features are standard for testing transactional email flows and do not represent unusual risks.

skills.name: k8s-security-policies
skills.description_en: Implement Kubernetes security policies including NetworkPolicy, PodSecurityPolicy, and RBAC for production-grade security. Use when securing Kubernetes clusters, implementing network isolation, or enforcing pod security standards.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive documentation and templates for implementing Kubernetes security policies, including RBAC, Network Policies, and Pod Security Standards. It follows industry best practices and contains no malicious code or insecure configurations.

skills.name: tdd-workflow
skills.description_en: Test-driven development workflow: write a failing test first, watch it fail, implement the smallest change to green, then refactor with 80%+ coverage across unit, integration, and E2E tests. Use when writing a new feature, fixing a bug, refactoring, or when told to write failing tests first.

audits.summary: The skill provides a structured Test-Driven Development workflow. It is generally safe and includes explicit defensive instructions to prevent indirect prompt injection from user-provided plan files, requiring human approval for command execution and providing clear boundaries for untrusted data.

skills.name: social-content
skills.description_en: When the user wants help creating, scheduling, or optimizing social media content for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, or other platforms. Also use when the user mentions 'LinkedIn post,' 'Twitter thread,' 'social media,' 'content calendar,' 'social scheduling,' 'engagement,' 'viral content,' 'what should I post,' 'repurpose this content,' 'tweet ideas,' 'LinkedIn carousel,' 'social media strategy,' 'grow my following,' 'TikTok video,' 'Reels,' 'Shorts,' 'video script,' 'video hook,' 'short-form video,' or 'create a reel.' Use this for social media content creation, repurposing, scheduling, and short-form video scripting. For broader content strategy, see content-strategy. For paid video ads, see ad-creative.

zh.intro: 做社媒内容：为 LinkedIn、Twitter/X、Instagram、TikTok、Facebook 等平台写帖子、排内容日历、把已有内容改成多平台版本，以及写短视频脚本（Reels、Shorts、TikTok）。它的定位是社媒策略与内容产出；更上层的内容策略看 content-strategy，付费视频广告看 ad-creative。
zh.usage: 用户说「LinkedIn 帖子怎么写」「Twitter 长推文串」「内容日历」「把这篇改成社媒版」「短视频脚本与 hook」时用它，排期和「我该发什么」这类问题也算。
zh.notes: 正文要求先读 `.agents/product-marketing-context.md`（老项目在 `.claude/product-marketing-context.md`）里的产品营销上下文，再动手写。

audits.summary: The skill provides a framework and reference material for social media content creation, repurposing, and strategy. No security vulnerabilities or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: rag-implementation
skills.description_en: Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for LLM applications with vector databases and semantic search. Use when implementing knowledge-grounded AI, building document Q&A systems, or integrating LLMs with external knowledge bases.

skills.name: competitor-profiling
skills.description_en: When the user wants to research, profile, or analyze competitors from their URLs. Also use when the user mentions 'competitor profile,' 'competitor research,' 'competitor analysis,' 'profile this competitor,' 'analyze competitor,' 'competitive intelligence,' 'competitor deep dive,' 'who are my competitors,' 'competitor landscape,' 'competitor dossier,' 'competitive audit,' or 'research these competitors.' For sales-specific battle cards, see sales-enablement. For researching accounts you're selling to, see prospecting.

zh.intro: 输入一批竞品网址，产出结构化的竞品档案文档：先抓取站点真实内容，再叠加搜索引擎与市场数据，最后综合成一份可比的档案，包含概况、定位与话术、产品与功能、定价、客户与口碑、内容策略、优劣势以及对自家产品的启示。适用于竞品调研、竞品分析、竞争格局梳理这类需求。

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe but is susceptible to indirect prompt injection because it processes content scraped from external websites. It includes explicit defensive instructions to the agent to treat scraped content as data only and to ignore any embedded instructions.

skills.name: gws-forms
skills.description_en: Read and write Google Forms.

zh.intro: 用 gws 读写 Google 表单：create 只能带上标题与 document_title 建一张空表单，题目得靠 batchUpdate 加，get 取表单结构，另有 setPublishSettings 改发布设置、responses 与 watches 处理答卷和监听。适合要把收问卷、读答卷这条链路脚本化的人。
zh.usage: 先 `gws forms --help` 浏览资源与方法，再用 `gws schema forms.<resource>.<method>` 查必填参数，然后拼 `--params` 与 `--json`；建一张有内容的表单要两步：先 `create` 再 `update` 加 items。
zh.notes: 依赖 `gws` 与 `../gws-shared/SKILL.md` 的鉴权说明。老式表单没有 publish_settings 字段，setPublishSettings 对它们用不了。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard integration with Google Forms using a vendor-specific CLI tool. While it interacts with external data, no malicious patterns or high-risk security concerns were identified.

skills.name: tao-train-sparse4d
skills.description_en: Prepare calibrated multi-camera data and train, evaluate, run inference, export, or quantize TAO Sparse4D 3D detection and tracking models. Includes 2D-to-3D geometric distillation with released LTT weights. Use for Sparse4D adaptation and temporal multi-camera perception workflows.

audits.summary: This skill provides functionality for training and evaluating Sparse4D 3D perception models. It contains a Python utility script that uses the 'pickle' module to process annotation files. The 'pickle' module is inherently insecure because it can execute arbitrary code during deserialization if the input file is maliciously crafted. Users should ensure that any annotation files processed by this skill originate from trusted sources. Additionally, the skill processes these files without explicit validation or boundary markers, creating a potential surface for indirect prompt injection.

zh.usage: 先 `gws meet --help` 看 v2 有哪些资源与方法，再用 `gws schema meet.<resource>.<method>` 查参数与默认值，然后拼 `--params` 与 `--json` 发请求。

skills.name: nextjs-app-router-patterns

zh.intro: Next.js 14+ 的 App Router 用法：五种渲染模式的取舍（Server Components、Client Components、Static、Dynamic、Streaming），app 目录下 layout、page、loading、error、not-found、route、template、default 各管什么，以及数据抓取与缓存、并行路由与拦截路由、Server Actions 做变更。默认从 Server Component 起步，需要交互才加 use client。
zh.usage: 先定渲染模式再写文件；抓数据就地取，慢数据配 Suspense 与 loading 文件；变更走 Server Action。更细的写法在 references/details.md。

audits.summary: The skill provides safe technical reference documentation and code snippets for implementing common Next.js 14+ App Router architectural patterns.

skills.name: gws-script-push
skills.description_en: Google Apps Script: Upload local files to an Apps Script project.

zh.intro: 把本地脚本文件整包推到 Apps Script 项目里。给项目 ID 就能跑，可选指定目录，不给就用当前目录；支持 .gs、.js、.html 和 appsscript.json，自动跳过隐藏文件和 node_modules。它做的是整体替换，不是增量同步，项目里原有的文件会被这一批覆盖，所以运行前要确认本地就是完整版本。属于写操作，执行前应当先跟用户确认。
zh.usage: 本地脚本改完后，用 gws script +push 带上项目 ID 推上去，目录不是当前路径时再加 --dir 指过去。

skills.name: python-design-patterns
skills.description_en: Python design patterns including KISS, Separation of Concerns, Single Responsibility, and composition over inheritance. Use this skill when designing a new service or component from scratch and choosing how to layer responsibilities, when refactoring a God class or monolithic function that has grown too large, when deciding whether to add a new abstraction or live with duplication, when evaluating a pull request for structural issues like tight coupling or leaking internal types, when choosing between inheritance and composition for a new class hierarchy, or when a codebase is becoming hard to test because of entangled I/O and business logic.

zh.intro: 在写新服务、拆巨型类、决定要不要抽抽象时给判断标准：KISS、单一职责、关注点分离、组合优先于继承、三次法则（出现第三处再抽象，重复往往好过过早抽象）。落到可执行的规则上——函数 20–50 行、构造注入依赖、先删死代码再考虑模式、每层单独可测、显式优于聪明。正文还带一组排障问答，比如一个类看着有多重职责但拆起来别扭时，用「变更原因」清单判断该不该拆。
zh.usage: 评审新模块或 PR 时把类和依赖关系贴进来，要它按变更原因划职责、判断该不该抽抽象，并给出组合替代继承的改法。
zh.notes: 正文把细节例子放在 references/details.md，导航层不够用时才需要读那份文件。

audits.summary: No security issues detected. This skill provides educational content and best practices for Python design patterns.

skills.name: golang-pkg-go-dev

Not for upgrading dependencies (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-dependency-management` skill), choosing a library (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-popular-libraries` skill), or local symbols and an already-used dependency's resolved source, call sites, and generic instantiations (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-gopls` skill).

zh.intro: 通过 godig 查 Go 包与模块的资料：文档、API 签名、符号、用例、可用版本、许可证、依赖有没有已知漏洞、谁在引用它。正文说明 godig 既是 CLI 也是 MCP server，操作只读且不用认证，并给了分组子命令、过滤表达式和退出码约定。
zh.usage: 要查某个 Go 库的接口怎么用、有哪些版本或谁 import 了它时用它，例如 `godig package examples github.com/samber/ro --symbol Map -o md`。
zh.notes: 升级依赖、选库或查本地符号分别属于同系列的其他技能；用前先装 godig 或接上它的 MCP server。

audits.summary: The skill enables searching and viewing Go package documentation via the godig tool. audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive workflows for AI-assisted video production. It is assessed as low risk because it ingests untrusted data from social media platforms (like TikTok and Reels) to analyze editing styles, which creates a potential surface for indirect prompt injection. Additionally, it uses dynamic code generation to render video frames from agent-produced HTML and React content.

skills.name: stock-analysis
skills.description_en: Analyze stocks and cryptocurrencies using Yahoo Finance data. Supports portfolio management (create, add, remove assets), crypto analysis (Top 20 by market cap), and periodic performance reports (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly). 8 analysis dimensions for stocks, 3 for crypto. Use for stock analysis, portfolio tracking, earnings reactions, or crypto monitoring.

audits.summary: The skill provides stock and cryptocurrency analysis by fetching data from trusted financial sources. It manages local portfolios and scans breaking news for risk factors. A surface for indirect prompt injection exists in the processing of external news headlines, although risk is mitigated by using keyword-based scoring rather than executing instructions found in the data.

skills.name: wrangler
skills.description_en: Cloudflare Workers CLI for deploying, developing, and managing Workers, KV, R2, D1, Vectorize, Hyperdrive, Workers AI, Containers, Queues, Workflows, Pipelines, and Secrets Store. Load before running wrangler commands to ensure correct syntax and best practices.

audits.summary: The skill contains no files or code to analyze and therefore poses no security risk.

skills.name: convex-authz
skills.description_en: Audit and harden a Convex app's authorization: identity-from-arg impersonation, missing per-document ownership checks, public queries leaking data by a client-supplied id, and writes into a parent/container the caller doesn't own. Scans for the 4 shapes, applies requireIdentity/requireOwner, verifies with tsc. TRIGGER on 'secure my app', 'audit auth/authz', 'who can access this data'. SKIP when there is no convex/ directory.

zh.intro: 专查 Convex 应用里的授权缺陷，盯四种形态：身份从参数传进来、改别人的文档前不校验归属、公开查询按客户端给的 id 泄露数据、往自己不属于的父容器里写子行。它先跑确定性的正则扫描，再把 requireIdentity 和 requireOwner 套到每个命中点上。
zh.usage: 扫描命中的每一处都套上 requireIdentity/requireOwner 这对加固写法，改完再重扫，确认命中归零。没有 convex/ 目录就跳过。
zh.notes: 动手前先确认有 auth.config.ts，而且有按鉴权主体建的 users 表，否则挂上去的检查形同虚设。

audits.summary: This skill acts as a security auditor for Convex applications by identifying common authorization flaws using regex-based rules, injecting standardized security helpers, and validating the resulting code with the TypeScript compiler.

skills.name: convex-migrate
skills.description_en: Migrate schema + backfill data on a deployed Convex app using @convex-dev/migrations.

zh.intro: 给已部署的 Convex 应用改 schema 并回填数据，顺序是先把新字段设为可选（这样部署不会拒绝已有行），再用 @convex-dev/migrations 写回填让旧数据变合法，跑完确认所有行都合规，最后才把校验器收紧成必填。
zh.usage: 用 @convex-dev/migrations 装依赖并写迁移；跑完之后验证新字段覆盖情况，再收紧校验器，跑前跑后都对一下行数。
zh.notes: 回填没跑完就收紧校验器会把老行判为非法、把线上应用弄挂，这是整篇里最容易犯的错。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructional guidance for migrating database schemas and performing data backfills in Convex applications using the official migrations package. It contains no executable scripts or security risks.

skills.name: convex-deploy-guard
skills.description_en: Classify + announce the target Convex deployment before any deployment-affecting command; fresh explicit consent for prod actions; session read-only mode.

zh.intro: Convex 项目通常同时有个人开发、预览和生产三个部署，事故多半源于命令打到了错的那个。这套纪律要求先识别目标、用一行明确宣告，再执行；生产环境的操作要按动作、按目标、按会话单独取得当次的明确同意。
zh.usage: 识别阶段读 .env.local 里的 `CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT`、`convex.json` 和有没有设 `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY`，宣告写成 `target: dev (joyful-capybara-123, personal dev)` 这样一行。
zh.notes: 别把「看一眼生产」和「改生产」混在一起，两个 MCP 生产开关要分开；用户说过只读之后，整场会话都算数，连看起来无害的写操作也不行。

audits.summary: The skill provides safety guardrails for Convex deployments, ensuring the agent identifies targets and seeks explicit consent before production changes. No security risks were detected.

skills.name: database-migration
skills.description_en: Execute database migrations across ORMs and platforms with zero-downtime strategies, data transformation, and rollback procedures. Use when migrating databases, changing schemas, performing data transformations, or implementing zero-downtime deployment strategies.

zh.intro: 跨 ORM 做数据库结构和数据迁移：Sequelize、TypeORM、Prisma 的迁移文件写法，含 up/down 回滚、数据转换、跨库搬数据和不停机上线策略，可用来换 ORM、重构数据模型或升级数据库版本。
zh.usage: 要改表结构、换 ORM、搬数据、加回滚方案或做不停机发版时用。正文按 ORM 分节给可改的迁移文件骨架，比如 Sequelize 在 up 里建表、down 里删表，命令行跑迁移和撤销。
zh.notes: 每种 ORM 都给了 up/down 成对写法，回滚不留空白；变更前先备份，预发环境先跑一遍再上生产。

audits.summary: The skill provides reference documentation and templates for database migrations across various Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) frameworks like Sequelize, TypeORM, and Prisma. It is completely safe and free from any security concerns.

skills.name: nv-segment-ct-finetune
skills.description_en: Runs standard or fixed-channel softmax finetuning of NV-Segment-CT VISTA3D on CT NIfTI image/label datasets, with optional MONAI-native MLflow tracking and checkpoint evidence. Uses softmax for predefined, mutually exclusive classes; keeps the standard workflow when point prompts or runtime-variable classes are needed. Not for clinical validation.

audits.summary: This skill provides a wrapper for finetuning medical imaging models using MONAI. It safely handles model assets from trusted NVIDIA repositories and includes robust dataset auditing to ensure data integrity during the training process.

skills.name: convex-expert
skills.description_en: Convex backend specialist. Use this agent for any code inside a `convex/` directory — function definitions, schemas, indexes, queries, mutations, actions, HTTP endpoints, cron jobs, file storage, auth wiring, and component installation. Knows the object-form function syntax, validator patterns, resource limits, and component ecosystem that generic Claude routinely gets wrong.

zh.intro: 碰 convex/ 目录里的代码之前先过它：函数定义、schema、索引、查询、mutation、action、HTTP 端点、定时任务、文件存储、鉴权接线和组件安装都管，重点是对象形式的函数语法、args/returns 校验器、索引与内部公开函数的纪律，这些都是通用模型写 Convex 时最常见的翻车点。
zh.usage: 改 convex/ 文件前先读 `convex/schema.ts`，函数一律写成对象形式并带上 args 和 returns 校验器；每个读路径都用 withIndex 走索引。
zh.notes: 已登录的用户别强行用匿名模式，那会把本地环境文件重新绑定掉；有值表上别直接加必填字段。

audits.summary: This skill is a specialized development assistant for the Convex platform. It provides architectural guidance and uses standard developer tools to verify code quality and deployment status. All external references and tools identified are official resources from the vendor.

skills.name: convex-reviewer
skills.description_en: Convex code reviewer — security, auth, validators, performance, and pattern checks for code in a convex/ directory. Use to review or audit Convex functions before shipping.

zh.intro: 上线前审 convex/ 目录里的代码：安全和授权、校验器、性能、schema 设计，按 Critical、Important、Suggestion 三档给结论。检查项很具体，比如公开函数是否都校验登录、资源读写前是否核对归属、有没有信客户端传来的用户 id、定时任务有没有指向内部函数而不是公开接口。
zh.usage: 先说明要审的目录、是迭代式审查还是一次性审查，再让报告聚焦到你已知的风险点，别把三遍检查合并成一遍。
zh.notes: 查询处理器里出现取当前时间会破坏响应式；无界查询上用全量收集会把读放大；文档里塞超长数组也在被点名的清单里。

audits.summary: This skill is a code review assistant for the Convex framework. It provides structured instructions for auditing Convex functions for security, performance, and best practices. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: convex-env
skills.description_en: Set and wire Convex deployment env vars / secrets for the app.

zh.intro: 管 Convex 部署的环境变量和密钥：密钥存在部署的环境变量里，在 action 里用 process.env 读，不进代码库。确认某个键设没设时只列名字，不要把值打印出来。
zh.usage: 设置用 `npx convex env set KEY value`，每个部署各设一份；确认用 `npx convex env list --names-only`。读值只能在 action 里做，查询和 mutation 里读不到。
zh.notes: 换部署就得重新设一遍；用 --names-only 就是为了避免把密钥打进对话记录里，也别把密钥提交进仓库。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for managing environment variables and secrets on the Convex platform using best security practices.

skills.name: convex-test
skills.description_en: Generate convex-test tests for the app's Convex functions.

zh.intro: 为 Convex 函数生成 convex-test + vitest 测试：跑在内存后端上，不连真实部署。覆盖参数与返回值、withIdentity 的鉴权路径、索引，以及用 t.finishInProgressScheduledFunctions 处理的定时函数。
zh.usage: 写测试时用 `convexTest(schema)` 起内存后端，通过 t.run 灌数据，再用 t.query/t.mutation 调用并断言。别忘了补鉴权和报错分支，以及 scheduled functions。
zh.notes: 规则要求测试保持确定性：不要依赖真实时间和网络。用内存实现，不要指向线上部署。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard development guidelines for generating unit tests for Convex functions using official and well-known testing libraries. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: convex-design
skills.description_en: Design and build reactive, type-safe, production-grade backends on Convex. Covers schema, queries/mutations/actions, indexes, auth, file storage, scheduling, real-time multiplayer, mobile backends, and LLM/agent workflows on Convex's one-platform stack.

zh.intro: 从一句产品需求出发设计 Convex 后端：认证、实时、文件上传、定时任务、LLM 工作流这些都覆盖，还带 15 条核心设计原则，比如默认响应式、schema 先行、ACID 事务、不要请求瀑布流、组件优先。用户还没定技术栈时会主动给出建议。
zh.usage: 先判断需求属于哪一类，再点出能解决问题的 Convex 原语并给一段五行左右的代码；用户接受搭建就转给 quickstart 技能。
zh.notes: 用户已经选了别的技术栈就别硬推；动手前先看包里有没有既存后端；LLM 聊天别自己手写消息表，用 @convex-dev/agent。

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It provides instructions for designing Convex backends using official platform tools and best practices. No malicious patterns or unauthorized behaviors were detected.

skills.name: convex-verify
skills.description_en: Prove a Convex feature works — seed, drive as multiple mocked users via convex-test, assert behavior including the negative authz cases (wrong user refused, data-scope enforced).

zh.intro: 证明一个 Convex 功能真的能用：先灌数据、再模拟多个用户去驱动、最后断言行为，包括那些反向的鉴权用例——不该被允许的用户是否真被拒、数据范围是否真的生效。整个循环在进程内跑，不需要部署。
zh.usage: 跑的是 seed → drive → assert 三步循环，用 `convex-test` 在进程内执行，不需要部署。断言里最有价值的是反向用例：调用者本该被拒绝的那些。
zh.notes: 类型检查通过只说明代码能解析，不能证明非所有者真的被拒。真实语料显示鉴权缺陷是第一大 bug，而只跑顺利路径的演示永远抓不到。

audits.summary: The skill is a testing utility for Convex applications that automates the creation and execution of unit tests using vitest and convex-test. It follows standard development practices for seeding data, mocking identities, and verifying authorization logic.

skills.name: issue-fields-migration
skills.description_en: Bulk-migrate metadata to GitHub issue fields from two sources: repo labels (e.g. priority labels to a Priority field) and Project V2 fields. Use when users say "migrate my labels to issue fields", "migrate project fields to issue fields", "convert labels to issue fields", "copy project field values to issue fields", or ask about adopting issue fields. Issue fields are org-level typed metadata (single select, text, number, date) that replace label-based workarounds with structured, searchable, cross-repo fields.

audits.summary: The skill provides a secure and structured workflow for migrating GitHub labels and Project V2 fields to Issue Fields. It utilizes the official GitHub CLI and incorporates critical security best practices including human-in-the-loop confirmations, detailed dry-run previews, and conflict resolution strategies. All network activity is restricted to GitHub's official API, and no malicious patterns or obfuscation were detected.

skills.name: convex-optimize
skills.description_en: Audit and optimize an existing Convex app: security, scale, upgrades, observability.

zh.intro: 给已有的 Convex 应用做整改：先由 launch-readiness 出一份打分的报告，再照着报告动手——升级落后组件、补上生产环境的错误捕获。它只负责对报告采取动作，不重复实现审阅和打分那几遍。
zh.usage: 先确认项目里有 convex/ 目录，再跑 `launch-readiness` 拿报告，然后 `check-updates` 查 `@convex-dev/*` 组件的过时情况。
zh.notes: 全程先只读，出计划并确认后才改文件；安全与数据丢失类风险排在最前，别在别人的生产应用上自动落地改动。

audits.summary: This skill audits and optimizes Convex applications. It is generally safe but possesses an inherent risk of indirect prompt injection, as it processes external project files that could contain malicious instructions designed to influence the agent's behavior during the optimization process.

skills.name: convex-crons
skills.description_en: Add recurring scheduled jobs (crons) to the Convex app.

zh.intro: 给 Convex 应用加周期性任务：在 convex/crons.ts 里用 cronJobs() 声明，按合适的时间间隔调度内部函数，处理逻辑写成可以反复执行也不会出错的幂等实现，每次跑的量要小。
zh.usage: 用 cronJobs() 声明任务，目标写 `internal.*` 这类内部函数，别调度公开的 `api.*`；跑完到控制台的 schedule 里确认任务确实挂上去了。
zh.notes: 别拿很短的轮询间隔去盯一个订阅就能推给你的东西；处理器要保持小且可重跑。

audits.summary: The skill provides documentation on how to set up scheduled cron jobs within a Convex application. It contains no executable code, tool definitions, or suspicious instructions.

skills.name: convex-agent
skills.description_en: Add an AI agent / RAG backend (@convex-dev/agent) to the Convex app.

zh.intro: 给 Convex 应用加 AI 代理 / RAG 后端，装 @convex-dev/agent 拿到持久化线程、消息历史、tool-calls 和向量检索。默认走 Convex AI Gateway 调模型：凭据由 Convex 保管，不用自己申请、保存或轮换 LLM key。
zh.usage: 安装 @convex-dev/agent 和 @convex-dev/ai-sdk-provider，把 agent component 加进 convex.config.ts，用 `languageModel: convexGateway("provider/model")` 定义代理的 tools 与 instructions。需要 convex 1.45+ 且跑在 Convex Cloud 付费计划上。
zh.notes: RAG 要注意：gateway 目前不提供 embedding，得把 embedding 供应商的 key 通过 `env` micro power 存起来。只有 gateway 不可用（免费版、自托管、本地后端）时才退回直接用供应商 SDK。

audits.summary: No security issues detected. This skill provides instructions for setting up an AI agent backend using official Convex libraries and follows security best practices for credential management.

skills.name: anti-reversing-techniques
skills.description_en: Understand anti-reversing, obfuscation, and protection techniques encountered during software analysis. Use this skill when analyzing malware evasion techniques, when implementing anti-debugging protections for CTF challenges, when reverse engineering packed binaries, or when building security research tools that need to detect virtualized environments.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive information and code samples for analyzing and bypassing software protections like anti-debugging and anti-VM techniques. While intended for authorized security research, it introduces a low risk via indirect prompt injection when processing untrusted binary samples and through the generation of analysis scripts.

skills.name: convex-auth
skills.description_en: Add authentication (passkeys/OAuth) to the current Convex app, including the auth.config.ts wiring.

zh.intro: 给现有 Convex 应用加上登录：默认用 passkey，也能换成 OAuth 或密码，顺带把服务端配置、客户端 hooks 和登录界面都接上。正文点名 auth.config.ts 是现实中最容易踩的坑，写错或漏写会让应用静默地一直处于未登录状态，而且不报错。
zh.usage: 先装 @convex-dev/auth 并加进 convex.config.ts，pnpm 项目还要补一条 `pnpm add jose`；密钥用 jose 无交互生成，别跑那个交互式向导，它在没有 TTY 的环境会挂住。
zh.notes: pnpm 不显式装 jose 就不会被提升；用命令行写密钥时用 NAME=VALUE 形式，以 - 开头的密钥会被当成未知参数。

audits.summary: The skill automates the configuration of authentication for Convex applications. It performs legitimate development tasks such as installing trusted packages, generating cryptographic keys locally, and updating environment variables using official CLI tools. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: convex-advisor
skills.description_en: Read the Convex deployment's 72h insights (read limits, OCC contention), root-cause each event in code, report evidence-backed perf/cost findings with fixes.

zh.intro: 直接读线上部署的健康数据来定位问题，而不是靠静态审阅猜：官方 Convex MCP 的 insights 工具会给每个函数最近 72 小时的类型化事件，包括读文档数超限、字节数逼近阈值、写入冲突重试或永久失败，每条都带表名、读到的字节数、文档 id 和重试次数这些证据。
zh.usage: 先按 deploy-guard 的步骤识别并宣告要读的部署，再调 `insights` 拿健康事件；整个过程只读，别顺手打开会写生产数据的访问。
zh.notes: 结果里没证据就说没证据，不要编发现；线上部署可以只读地看健康数据，但诊断这一趟不要申请写权限。

audits.summary: The skill analyzes Convex deployment health and code to provide performance and cost recommendations. It contains an indirect prompt injection surface because it processes external data like logs and source code, which could potentially contain malicious instructions.

skills.name: convex-migrate-rehearse
skills.description_en: Rehearse a live-app schema change + backfill on a snapshot-seeded preview deployment, verify, then promote the proven change to prod with the snapshot as rollback.

zh.intro: 在 preview 部署上先演练 schema 变更和回填：Convex 每次推 schema 都会校验所有已有文档，任何一行不符合就推失败，这个闸门最好先让它在一个演练副本上失败。做法是用 prod 快照喂 preview，在那里推新 schema、跑回填，等绿了再推到 prod。
zh.usage: 先看前置条件：preview 部署需要在 dashboard 的 Project Settings → Deploy Keys → Preview 里拿 Preview Deploy Key，导出成 `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY`，否则带 --preview-create / --preview-name 的部署都做不了。
zh.notes: 它组合了 deploy-guard 的目标分类、migrate 的「先可选后收紧」模式，以及 @convex-dev/migrations 的分批可续跑回填。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for a safe migration workflow in Convex. It describes how to rehearsal schema changes on a preview deployment using production snapshots to ensure data conformance before applying changes to production.

skills.name: convex-cost
skills.description_en: Preview Convex spend — rank functions by bytes/documents-read × call-volume from insights, project each cost driver's growth curve, name the cheapest fix; confirm-cost for paid actions.

zh.intro: 预估 Convex 应用的花费：用 insights 里的 bytes-read / documents-read 证据按调用量给函数排榜，给每个成本大头推算增长曲线，并指出最便宜的改法。另外带了 confirm-cost 纪律——任何按量计费的动作之前先报价格、拿到明确同意。
zh.usage: 成本读取是只读的，dev 和 prod 都能读，但 insights 只在 cloud + 用户鉴权下可用，preview 读不到。先声明在读哪个部署，再拉 `insights` 里的 bytes-read / documents-read 事件。
zh.notes: 成本问题通常集中在少数几个读数据远超预期的函数上，和性能问题是同一批模式。

audits.summary: The skill is designed to analyze Convex deployment telemetry to provide cost projections and optimization recommendations. It includes security measures such as a deployment guard for read-only access and mandatory user confirmation for any metered or paid actions.

skills.name: convex-backup
skills.description_en: Set up Convex backups and run a restore DRILL that proves recovery — snapshot, restore into a throwaway preview, assert the data came back — plus a schedule matched to your RPO and a gated recovery runbook.

zh.intro: 备份有两半，大多数人只做了第一半：定期导出快照，以及真的把数据恢复回来验证。这个能力两半都做——设好快照导出，再跑一次 RESTORE DRILL，把数据恢复到一次性 preview 里并断言数据完好。
zh.usage: 导出快照用 `npx convex export --path backup-<date>.zip`；如果应用存文件，再加上 `--include-file-storage`。演练的恢复目标永远是一次性 preview，不是 prod。
zh.notes: 第一步仍是 deploy-guard：先分类并声明要备份的部署。读取和导出是安全的。

audits.summary: The skill provides a legitimate workflow for managing Convex database backups and performing restoration drills. It uses official Convex CLI tools to handle data exports and imports, following security best practices such as using isolated preview environments for testing and ensuring local cleanup of sensitive snapshot files.

skills.name: convex-explain-app
skills.description_en: Explain an existing Convex app — data model + relationships, public vs internal functions, auth/ownership model, components, a request→data flow — read from the schema and function surface. Read-only.

zh.intro: 把现有 Convex 应用讲清楚：数据模型和关系、公开与内部函数、鉴权与归属模型、组件，以及一次请求到数据的流向。只读 schema 和函数表面这两类可信来源，所以又快又不容易读错。它是纯描述性的，判断交给审计能力，改动交给修复能力。
zh.usage: 先探测应用形态：有没有 `convex/` 目录、`schema.ts`，以及是否已经存在部署；如果有部署，就用官方 MCP 的 `functionSpec` / `tables` 拿线上的权威结构。
zh.notes: 它也是优化或自愈流程的合理第一步：在「改自己搭的东西」之前，先把当前架构重新解释一遍。

audits.summary: This skill is a read-only utility designed to analyze and explain the architecture of Convex applications. It instructs the agent to examine project configuration, schemas, and function definitions to generate a technical overview without performing any modifications or exfiltrating data.

skills.name: convex-launch-readiness
skills.description_en: Run every Convex audit (authz, reviewer, advisor, insights) into one scored, deduped readiness report with an ordered fix plan — Lighthouse for your backend.

zh.intro: 把 Convex 的几项审计（鉴权、reviewer、advisor、insights）各跑一遍，归一成一份去重、打分、排序的上线就绪报告，并给出一张按优先级排的行动清单。它自己不动手修，只决定修什么、按什么顺序修，再派给具体的修复能力。
zh.usage: 开头是 GUARD + SCOPE：deploy-guard 会把目标分类成 local-anonymous / dev / preview / prod 并声明出来。先判断哪些检查有前提（有没有 convex/ 目录、有没有带流量的部署、有没有鉴权基础），前提不满足的检查跳过，但要说明跳了哪些。
zh.notes: 它只做组合：发现来自 findings bus（specs/finding.schema.json），报告结构见 specs/finding-report.schema.json，每个发现都带一个 fixCapability。

audits.summary: This skill acts as a security audit aggregator. It is generally safe but possesses an indirect prompt injection surface because it processes data from external logs and code identifiers that could be manipulated by an attacker to influence the agent's output.

skills.name: convex-billing
skills.description_en: Add Stripe billing/payments to the Convex app via @convex-dev/stripe (checkout + webhook + gating).

zh.intro: 给 Convex 应用接 Stripe 计费：checkout action、由组件注册的 httpAction webhook（自动验签）、订阅状态存进组件自己的表，再用一个 query 做服务端放行判断。密钥放 Convex env，不写在代码里。
zh.usage: 先 `npm install @convex-dev/stripe`，然后在 `convex/convex.config.ts` 里 `app.use(stripe)`，再建 `convex/http.ts` 注册 webhook 路由。`STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`（sk_test_… / sk_live_…）和 `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`（whsec_…）存到 Convex env 里。
zh.notes: webhook 的签名校验由组件自动完成，不用自己写。订阅状态存在组件表里，鉴权时用 query 在服务端判断。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard instructions for integrating Stripe billing into a Convex application using the official @convex-dev/stripe component. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: convex-seed
skills.description_en: Seed or import data into the Convex database.

zh.intro: 往 Convex 数据库灌数据。少量夹具就写一个可重复运行的 internalMutation 插入样例行；批量导入则把数据整理成符合 schema 的形状再导入。要点是让灌数据幂等（先清后插或 upsert），这样重跑是安全的，最后核对行数。
zh.usage: 夹具用 internalMutation 写插入逻辑，然后 `npx convex run` 执行；批量导入用 `npx convex import`，数据要匹配 schema 校验器。灌数据要做成幂等，完成后核对行数。
zh.notes: 别把密钥或 PII 灌进共享部署。用 internalMutation 或 convex import 时都要匹配 validators。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for seeding or importing data into a Convex database using the official Convex CLI tools. It follows standard development practices and includes security warnings against handling sensitive information.

zh.intro: 用 reveal.js 做 HTML 演示稿：交互、自适应、动画、代码高亮、演讲者备注。正文给了页面骨架写法（引入 reveal.css 与主题样式、两层容器、初始化脚本）、横向与纵向幻灯片、用 data-markdown 写 markdown 页、内置主题清单、过渡动画参数，以及分片动画的写法。
zh.usage: 要做网页版演示、代码走查或带备注与动画的幻灯片时用它；先说明主题、过渡和需要的特性，再让它生成 reveal.js 演示。
zh.notes: 目录里的描述字段只有一个大于号，卡片内容按正文写；正文另提到配合 office-mcp 的 pptx_to_html 工具。

audits.summary: The skill is safe and presents no security risks. It provides a standard set of documentation, templates, and examples for generating HTML presentations using the popular open-source reveal.js framework.

skills.name: convex-domains
skills.description_en: Point a domain you already own at your Convex app (DNS records, custom-domain attach, auth-origin rebind).

zh.intro: 把已有域名指到 Convex 应用：先确认目标是静态托管站点还是部署的 HTTP actions URL，再建 DNS 记录、挂自定义域名，如果应用用了鉴权还要重绑 auth origin。全程走用户自己的注册商。
zh.usage: 如果检测到用户已经登录过某家的 DNS CLI，可以提议自动建记录：Cloudflare 用 `flarectl dns create`，Route53 用 `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets`，DigitalOcean 用 `doctl compute domain records create`，Vercel DNS 用 `vercel dns add`。动手前先用只读命令确认身份。
zh.notes: 注意 `wrangler` 本身不管理 DNS 记录，别搞混；Cloudflare 也可以直接走 API 加 token 环境变量。

audits.summary: The skill assists in configuring custom domains for Convex applications by coordinating local DNS command-line tools. It follows security best practices by requiring user confirmation for commands and strictly avoiding the handling or echoing of credentials.

skills.name: convex-monitor
skills.description_en: Watch for the next dev/prod error or request in a Convex app and react to it.

zh.intro: 等下一个事件，而不是轮询：它同时盯着本地错误日志、部署订阅和 Sentinel 的线上错误行，谁先来就返回谁，一直没有就回一个安静的心跳。事件 schema 固定且带版本，同样的触发条件给出同样的类型化事件。
zh.usage: 调用 `wait_for_event`，参数是 {project_dir, event_kinds, timeout_ms}。拿到 kind=convex_error 就解码并修；kind=prod_error 先分诊再修；kind=feature_request 就去做；kind=quiet 就继续循环。
zh.notes: 线上事件（kind=prod_error）需要已部署的 cloud 应用，并且装了 Sentinel。没有阻塞式 MCP 的环境会退化成同样事件契约的轮询循环。

audits.summary: This skill provides a workflow for monitoring and responding to events in Convex applications, such as errors or feature requests. While the instructions are standard for development tools, the skill is susceptible to indirect prompt injection as it processes external data that could contain malicious instructions designed to influence the agent.

skills.name: convex-suggest
skills.description_en: Suggest the matching Convex component when the user hand-rolls a pattern it already solves (crons, sharded-counter, rate-limiter, storage, search, presence, workflow, RAG, prosemirror-sync). Passive — suggest after the task, never interrupt. Never install without consent.

zh.intro: 当用户手写了某个 Convex 组件已经解决的模式时，给一条有指向的建议：只推一个组件、说清为什么（引用用户自己的代码或需求）、给一个具体的安装提示。用户没明确同意就不装，也不要一次推多个，除非用户主动问。
zh.usage: 被动观察 codeSnippets 和 userAsk，不要为提建议打断当前任务。匹配规则在 `generators/suggest-detector.mjs` 里：邮件/SMTP → resend，推送 → expo-push，setInterval/cron → @convex-dev/crons，共享计数自增 → @convex-dev/sharded-counter，.collect().length 扫描 → @convex-dev/aggregate。
zh.notes: 多步骤或长时间运行的 action 也在识别范围内。一次只提一个组件。

audits.summary: This skill passively observes code patterns to suggest relevant Convex components. It requires explicit user consent before initiating any installations and only recommends official vendor-provided libraries or well-known services.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description_en: Comprehensive PDF manipulation toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating new PDFs, merging/splitting documents, and handling forms. When Claude needs to fill in a PDF form or programmatically process, generate, or analyze PDF documents at scale.

audits.summary: This skill provides a robust set of tools for PDF manipulation, including text extraction, form filling, and document generation. It includes some security considerations typical of document processing tools, such as the handling of external files and minor runtime code adjustments to address library bugs. These elements are standard for the skill's intended use and do not present unusual risks.

skills.name: search
skills.description_en: Search the user's Notion workspace using the Notion MCP server. Use for finding pages, databases, and content by keywords or natural-language queries.

audits.summary: This skill enables an agent to search a user's Notion workspace using the Notion MCP server. It contains no code or scripts. The analysis identifies a surface for indirect prompt injection because the skill processes untrusted data from the Notion workspace, which is typical for search-related functionalities.

skills.name: react-doctor
skills.description_en: Diagnose and fix React codebase health issues. Use when reviewing React code, fixing performance problems, auditing security, or improving code quality.

audits.summary: This skill facilitates React codebase health checks by executing the 'react-doctor' utility via npx. It downloads the necessary package from the official NPM registry to perform diagnostics on security, performance, and code quality.

skills.name: gws-keep
skills.description_en: Manage Google Keep notes.

zh.intro: 用 gws 命令行管 Google Keep 的笔记和附件。notes 下有 create、delete、get、list，media 下有 download。list 按 page_size 分页，传 0 就让服务端自己定上限，返回的 ListNotesResponse 最多给 page_size 条，多了要翻页。
zh.usage: 命令形状是 gws keep <resource> <method> [flags]。先看 gws keep --help 摸清参数。要删笔记得对它有 OWNER 角色，删掉即刻生效、无法撤销，协作者也会跟着失去访问权。下载附件要带 alt=media，MIME 对不上会返 400。
zh.notes: 认证和全局 flag 不在这张卡里，要先读 ../gws-shared/SKILL.md；缺这个文件就跑 gws generate-skills 生成。

audits.summary: This skill allows the agent to manage Google Keep notes and media. It interacts with the Google Workspace Keep API, which involves processing user-controlled note content.

skills.name: astro
skills.description_en: Skill for building with the Astro web framework. Helps create Astro components and pages, configure SSR adapters, set up content collections, deploy static sites, and manage project structure and CLI commands. Use when the user needs to work with Astro, mentions .astro files, asks about static site generation (SSG), islands architecture, content collections, or deploying an Astro project.

zh.intro: Astro 框架速查：CLI 命令（dev、build、check、add、sync）、项目结构（src/pages 必需，components、layouts、styles 按约定）、配置项 site、页面与组件写法、内容集合、SSR 适配器接入和静态站部署步骤。
zh.usage: 碰 .astro 文件、问静态生成、islands、内容集合或要部署 Astro 项目时加载；加完插件重跑 astro sync 生成类型，先 check 再 build。
zh.notes: 正文明确以 docs.astro.build 上的最新 API 为准。适配器可用 astro add 安装，支持 vercel、node、cloudflare、netlify。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard documentation and instructions for working with the Astro web framework. All links and commands point to official Astro resources and well-known deployment platforms.

skills.name: discernment-nudge
skills.description_en: After you give a substantive answer or draft that the user may act on — advice or recommendations, drafted artifacts such as goals, plans, pitches, proposals, or emails, estimates or projections, analysis or interpretation of data, factual claims they may rely on, or a multi-step argument — invoke this skill BEFORE finalizing your reply and then, if it applies, append 2-3 short follow-up questions, each tied to something specific in what you just produced, that help the user check key facts, probe the reasoning or assumptions, and notice missing context. Do this at most once per conversation. Skip it when the user asked a trivial how-to or simple lookup, wants a purely educational explanation, asked you only to format, convert, or assemble a file from content they provided, is writing code they will run, is doing creative writing or casual chat, or already asked you to double-check, cite, or review — the skill file explains these boundaries and the exact output format.

zh.intro: 在给出用户会照着行动的实质答复后，追加两三个短问题：哪些事实值得核对、逻辑哪一步需要理由、缺了哪些上下文。普通查资料、纯格式转换、用户自己跑代码或闲聊时跳过，整个会话最多一次。
zh.usage: 写完建议、方案、估算或数据分析，定稿前对照适用边界决定是否追加问题；每个问题都要挂在答复里的具体内容上，不泛泛地问还要注意什么。
zh.notes: 正文说明了这三种自省习惯的来源与不该触发的场合，也规定了追加问题的输出格式；属于 anthropics/skills 官方技能。

audits.summary: This skill provides behavioral instructions to help users critically evaluate AI-generated content. It includes specific guidelines for when the AI should offer reflection prompts and defines a clear output format to ensure these prompts are helpful rather than intrusive. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: docker-patterns
skills.description_en: Docker and Docker Compose patterns for local development, hardened CLI installer harnesses, container security, networking, volumes, and multi-service orchestration. Use when creating or reviewing Dockerfiles and Compose services, testing installers across Linux distributions, or planning accurate native macOS and Windows validation.

zh.intro: Docker 与 Compose 的落地写法：多阶段构建区分开发与生产、用绑定挂载做热更新、服务之间按名字互相解析、命名卷保存数据，以及非 root、只读根文件系统、丢弃能力等加固手段。
zh.usage: 写或审 Dockerfile 与 Compose 服务时使用；开发环境用 override 文件叠在默认配置上，生产单独指定 prod 文件；容器里连不上别的服务时先查域名解析和网络，再查端口绑定。
zh.notes: 别用 latest 标签、别以 root 运行、别把密钥写进 Compose 文件；生产多容器编排应交给编排系统而不是 Compose。

audits.summary: This skill provides secure and well-structured Docker and Docker Compose patterns for local development and testing. It emphasizes security best practices such as non-root image configuration, the principle of least privilege for containers, and proper secret management.

skills.name: perl-security
skills.description_en: Comprehensive Perl security covering taint mode, input validation, safe process execution, DBI parameterized queries, web security (XSS/SQLi/CSRF), and perlcritic security policies. Use when reviewing Perl input handling, process execution, DBI queries, or web-facing code.

audits.summary: This skill is a security reference guide for Perl development. It provides best practices for input validation, database security, and safe process execution to prevent common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and command injection.

skills.name: expo-project-structure
skills.description_en: Folder structure for a new Expo app. Use when scaffolding or laying out a new Expo project with Expo Router, or deciding where a file should live in one. For new projects only — never restructure an existing app to match.

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines and a recommended folder structure for new Expo projects, including a vendor-provided feedback command.

skills.name: dart-use-primary-constructors
skills.description_en: Help users write syntactically and semantically correct primary constructors in Dart, and migrate/use the new constructor syntax, empty-body semicolon syntax, in-body initializer list syntax, and abbreviated concise constructor syntax.

zh.intro: Dart 主构造器（primary constructors）的写法与迁移：在类头部的参数表里同时声明字段和生成式构造函数，区分 var/final 的声明参数、this./super. 的初始化参数和只在初始化期可用的普通参数，空声明体用分号收尾，类体内的初始化列表和简写构造语法也都讲。正文标了版本门槛：Dart 3.13 起默认开启，3.12 要显式开 primary-constructors 实验（--enable-experiment 或 analysis_options.yaml），3.11 及更早不支持，并给了迁移与排错的步骤。
zh.usage: 让它把某个类改成主构造器写法时先说清 Dart 版本；3.12 需要先在 analysis_options.yaml 里开 primary-constructors 实验。
zh.notes: 低于 3.12 无法使用该语法；开实验后分析器和构建工具都要带同一个 flag，否则报错会看起来像语法错误。

audits.summary: This skill provides technical guidance and refactoring workflows for Dart's Primary Constructors and concise constructor syntax. It is a legitimate educational resource for Dart developers and does not contain any malicious patterns, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access.

skills.name: monorepo-management
skills.description_en: Master monorepo management with Turborepo, Nx, and pnpm workspaces to build efficient, scalable multi-package repositories with optimized builds and dependency management. Use when setting up monorepos, optimizing builds, or managing shared dependencies.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive and safe guidance for managing monorepos using industry-standard tools like Turborepo, Nx, and pnpm. It follows security best practices, such as recommending the use of secrets for environment variables in CI/CD pipelines.

skills.name: memory-safety-patterns
skills.description_en: Implement memory-safe programming with RAII, ownership, smart pointers, and resource management across Rust, C++, and C. Use when writing safe systems code, managing resources, or preventing memory bugs.

zh.intro: Rust、C++、C 的内存安全写法：RAII、所有权、智能指针与资源管理。列出 use-after-free、double-free、内存泄漏、缓冲区溢出、悬垂指针、数据竞争六类问题及各自的预防手段，并画出从手动管理到 GC 的安全光谱。
zh.usage: 写系统层代码或管理文件、socket、内存等资源时参考；排查内存问题时按调试工具那节来跑，例如 `cargo +nightly miri run` 或 `valgrind --leak-check=full ./program`。
zh.notes: 细粒度模式放在 `references/details.md`；Do 与 Don't 两栏强调少用裸指针、别返回局部引用、谨慎使用 unsafe。

audits.summary: The skill provides educational content and code patterns for memory-safe programming in Rust, C++, and C. No security issues or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: multi-account-isolation
skills.description_en: Verify that browser profiles are actually isolated from one another instead of assuming it - confirm each profile's timezone agrees with its own exit IP, that WebRTC exposes only the proxy, that canvas and WebGL hashes stay identical across relaunches of one profile, and that no two profiles share a persona, a cookie jar, or an address. Use when several of your own accounts or test identities run from one machine and the setup needs checking, when a profile tested clean but something still looks off, when choosing which detection suites to run (CreepJS, whoer, browserleaks WebRTC, pixelscan, liarjs), when auditing what a vendor runtime does with API and proxy credentials, or when asking which layers browser isolation cannot cover at all. Also for 'profile isolation check', 'fingerprint consistency test', 'timezone mismatch', 'WebRTC leak', 'canvas hash unstable', 'account association', 'temporary profile', '防关联', '多账号', '隔离自检'. The SDK is anti-detect-browser; MCP is browser-mcp-agent.

zh.intro: 验证浏览器 profile 之间是不是真的隔离，而不是假定隔离。要核对的点：每个 profile 的时区与它自己的出口 IP 是否一致、WebRTC 是否只暴露代理、同一 profile 重启后 canvas 与 WebGL 哈希是否稳定、任意两个 profile 是否共用同一套 persona、cookie 或地址。适合同一台机器上跑多个自有账号或测试身份、profile 自检通过但现象仍然可疑、以及要判断哪些层浏览器隔离根本盖不住。
zh.usage: 常用检测站点是 CreepJS、whoer、browserleaks WebRTC、pixelscan、liarjs；按「时区对出口 IP、RTC 不泄漏、canvas/WebGL 哈希重启后一致、profile 之间无共享」逐项过。
zh.notes: 正文提醒别把一次干净结果当成长期结论：临时 profile 不会被自动清理，会一直带着 persona 和登录态。仅限自有账号的授权场景。

audits.summary: This skill provides a guide for auditing browser profile isolation to prevent account association. It details how to verify that fingerprints, proxies, and session data are correctly separated using the anti-detect-browser SDK and various third-party verification tools.

skills.name: mobile-ios-design
skills.description_en: Master iOS Human Interface Guidelines and SwiftUI patterns for building native iOS apps. Use when designing iOS interfaces, implementing SwiftUI views, or ensuring apps follow Apple's design principles.

zh.intro: 按 Apple 人机界面指南和 SwiftUI 做 iOS 界面。三条原则是清晰（图标精确、装饰克制）、服从内容（界面不跟内容抢注意力）、用层次与动效表达层级并支撑导航。覆盖导航模式（NavigationStack、TabView、sheet）、iPhone 与 iPad 的自适应布局、SF Symbols 与系统字体、Dynamic Type 与深色模式、无障碍、iOS 手势，以及 iOS、iPadOS、visionOS 在输入方式和屏幕尺寸上的差别。布局用 VStack、HStack、Spacer 和 Grid 这类栈式写法，正文带 Swift 代码片段。
zh.usage: 设计或实现 iOS 页面时，把导航、布局和字体无障碍要求一起说明，让它按指南给出 SwiftUI 结构与检查项。
zh.notes: 面向原生 iOS 与 SwiftUI，不涉及跨平台框架；只给设计与实现指引，真机表现和审核要求仍要自己验。

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive collection of iOS Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) patterns and SwiftUI code snippets for native application design. No security risks, malicious patterns, or unsafe dependencies were identified.

skills.name: pr-address-comments
skills.description_en: Use this skill if the user asks you to help them address GitHub PR comments for their current branch of the Gemini CLI. Requires `gh` CLI tool.

audits.summary: This skill includes some security considerations related to the processing of external data from GitHub PR comments and the execution of local git and GitHub commands. While these are part of the skill's intended functionality to help users manage pull requests, they introduce a surface for potential indirect instructions from external sources.

skills.name: dart-use-ffigen
skills.description_en: Guide agents to use `package:ffigen` to automatically generate FFI bindings instead of writing them manually. Use this skill when a task involves writing new FFI bindings, extending C/Objective-C/Swift integrations, or replacing hand-crafted `dart:ffi` setups.

zh.intro: 用 package:ffigen 的 FfiGenerator 从 C 头文件生成 Dart FFI 绑定，取代手写 DynamicLibrary.lookup、@Native 外部函数和结构体类。约定：生成脚本放 tool/ffigen.dart；第三方头文件放 third_party/；用 include 正向白名单精确控制范围，不要整库导入；第三方库的产物放 lib/src/third_party/，主文件必须是 g.dart 后缀；preamble 要写清原生库的许可证、原头文件版权和不要手改的生成警告。收尾要重跑生成器确认产物有变化，并跑 dart analyze 验证。
zh.usage: 要在 Dart 里接一个 C 库时，先写 tool/ffigen.dart 配好头文件路径与 include 白名单，生成后跑 dart analyze 验证。
zh.notes: 需要本机 C 工具链与 dart analyze；头文件不在 third_party/ 或包根 src/ 时，先建议挪到标准位置再生成。

audits.summary: The skill is a developer-focused guide for automating Dart FFI bindings using the official and well-known `ffigen` package. It follows standard Dart development practices, uses official package registries, and incorporates verification steps like static analysis.

skills.name: olive-young-search
skills.description_en: upstream daiso CLI를 사용해 올리브영 매장 검색, 상품 검색, 재고 확인을 조회한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.

audits.summary: The skill utilizes an external command-line interface (CLI) to perform retail searches on Olive Young. It instructs the agent to download and execute code from third-party sources (npm and GitHub) using npx and git clone. skills.name: ast-grep

zh.intro: 把自然语言需求翻成 ast-grep 规则，按抽象语法树结构匹配代码，能找出普通文本搜索做不到的模式，比如没做错误处理的 async 函数、参数形式特殊的调用。正文给了分步做法：先写待匹代码样本存成临时文件，再写 YAML 规则，命令行验证过之后再加复杂度。
zh.usage: 要按代码结构而不是字面文本查找时用：说明要找的模式和语言，它会产出可运行的 YAML 规则并用测试文件先验证。关系匹配 inside、has 要带 stopBy: end，复杂查询拆成 all、any、not 子规则再逐步拼。
zh.notes: 完整规则语法在 references/rule_reference.md；先做最小可验证规则再扩，一次写太复杂的规则常常匹配不到。

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe but carries a low risk of indirect prompt injection as it analyzes potentially untrusted code from the local filesystem.

skills.name: post-purchase-upsell-flow
skills.description_en: Design and implement one-click post-purchase upsells and downsells that raise average order value without hurting the main conversion rate. zh.intro: 设计并落地一键式购后追加销售与降级报价：客户已经付过款、支付方式已留存，这一步的流量不再花广告费，是把客单价做上去最便宜的地方。同时给出技术前提，说明为什么很多购后加购实际上跑不起来。适用于感谢页现在只有一句「订单已提交」、或想在同一份广告预算下提高每客收入的情况。
zh.usage: 正文给的链路是：先追加互补且毛利最高的商品，接受后再考虑第二档，拒绝则降级为更小承诺的报价，两条路最后都回到感谢页。页面要有标题、三到五行单一利益点、一条具体证明、真实才划线的参考价；接受按钮写动词加结果，拒绝用朴素文字链接，确认信息里说明并入同一张订单、扣同一张卡。本地演示先 `docker compose up`，再开 http://localhost:4321 完成 /setup。
zh.notes: 主漏斗转化接近零时应先修转化，正文直言在没有流量的漏斗上做加购是零的算术。另有专节比较结账前加购与购后加购的取舍，别默认选后者。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines for implementing post-purchase upsell flows and includes instructions for setting up the Autonnel platform using Docker. It directs users to download configuration from the author's official GitHub repository. No malicious patterns or security risks were detected.

skills.name: funnel-platform-picker
skills.description_en: Choose a landing page or sales funnel platform by working out the real total cost and lock-in for a specific case - comparing ClickFunnels, CartFlows, FunnelKit, systeme.io, GoHighLevel, Shopify apps, hand-rolled pages and self-hosted open-source options. Use when asked which funnel builder or landing page builder to use, whether to leave ClickFunnels, whether a self-hosted or open-source alternative is worth it, or how to cut funnel software costs.

zh.intro: 按具体案例算清总成本与锁定风险，再在落地页和漏斗平台之间做选择，比较对象包括 ClickFunnels、CartFlows、FunnelKit、systeme.io、GoHighLevel、Shopify 应用、手写页面和自托管开源方案。正文的立场很硬：这些工具大多能搭出同样的漏斗，差别在成本曲线、数据归谁、以及停止付费后什么会坏掉。
zh.usage: 先凑齐六项输入，缺一项就不该给推荐，因为每项都会翻转结论。第二步明令不要报厂商牌价，价格变动快、过期数字比没有更糟，改为按计费模型算曲线，例如百分比平台用 base_fee 加 rate 乘月 GMV，自托管则把托管、数据库和维护工时折成钱，再用 `crossover_GMV = (flat_monthly_fee − base_fee) ÷ rate` 找平衡点。第三步核对许可证的实际声明，第四步把取舍当面说清。
zh.notes: 需要动手搭的时候接 self-hosted-funnel-launch，漏斗本身还没设计就先走 sales-funnel-blueprint。

audits.summary: This skill is a decision-support guide for choosing sales funnel platforms. It contains no malicious code, data exfiltration, or obfuscation. It includes a standard Docker command for local evaluation of a specific tool, which is benign.

It also references the author's self-hosted funnel builder (Autonnel) with instructions for manual setup via Docker. No malicious behavior or security vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: debugging-strategies

zh.intro: 把调试从猜变成流程：按科学方法走观察、假设、实验、分析、重复五步，直到找到根因；先稳定复现并压成最小复现，再收集完整堆栈、错误码、环境与依赖版本、近期改动与影响范围，然后从什么变了、哪里不一样、哪一层可能失败形成假设，用二分法缩小区间验证。心态上不信「不可能是我改的」与「我机器上是好的」，卡住就走橡皮鸭或先休息。
zh.usage: 查难复现的 bug、性能退化、内存泄漏、线上故障、崩溃与堆栈，或接手陌生代码库时用。

skills.name: swift-concurrency
skills.description_en: Diagnose Swift Concurrency issues, refactor callback-based code to async/await, and guide Swift 6 migration when working with tasks, actors, @MainActor, Sendable, data races, thread safety, or concurrency-related compiler and linter warnings.

zh.intro: 诊断 Swift 并发问题并指导 Swift 6 迁移：actor、MainActor 隔离、Sendable、数据竞争、线程安全，以及编译器和 linter 的并发相关告警；也把回调式代码改成 async/await。动手前先查 Package.swift 或工程文件，确认语言模式、严格并发级别、默认隔离和启用的 upcoming feature，再看清诊断原文和涉及的符号，判断隔离边界在哪。
zh.usage: 碰到并发告警、数据竞争，或打算迁到 Swift 6 时用。不要把加 MainActor 当万能补丁，得说清代码为什么真的绑在 UI 上；优先结构化并发，用 detached 要给出理由。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions and reference material for diagnosing and fixing Swift Concurrency issues. It includes detailed guidance on Swift 6 migration, actor isolation, and task management. No security risks or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.description_en: Make a canister's data queryable by the Caffeine Data Intelligence agent. Adds a discoverable `schema()` and a JSON `execute()` query endpoint via the `caffeineai-oql` mops package's `Expose` mixin.

zh.intro: 把 canister 里的结构化数据（Map、List、数组里的记录）变成能自然语言提问的表：给 Caffeine 数据智能 agent 提供一个可发现的 schema 入口和一个返回 JSON 的 execute 查询端点，靠 caffeineai-oql 包里的 Expose 混入实现。做法是先过一遍 actor 的非临时字段，为每个值得查询的集合声明一个 entity，相当于数据库里的一张表，再给每张表挑授权级别，默认的仅控制器可见是安全选项，对用户私有但仍可被数据智能 agent 读到。声明完自动派生出行结构，也能手写 payload 映射。
zh.usage: 在 canister 项目里加上 caffeineai-oql 依赖，为每个要查询的集合声明一个 entity 并选好授权级别，之后就能让 agent 用 schema 和 execute 提问。
zh.notes: 依赖要和第一次 import 放在同一批写入里加；自动派生要求 moc 1.11 以上；用到大 Region 时需在应用自己的构建里加 --max-stable-pages 1638400；缺导入只会对集合模块给出提示。

audits.summary: The extension-oql skill enables natural language querying of Internet Computer canister data. It provides Motoko mixins for data exposure and Node.js scripts for bulk data ingestion. The skill implements robust authorization and row-level security. No malicious patterns, exfiltration, or obfuscation were detected. A standard surface for indirect prompt injection exists due to processing external data, but it is mitigated by built-in redaction and access control features.

skills.name: hsb-flash
skills.description_en: Flash the FPGA on an HSB board connected to an NVIDIA devkit. Supports HSB Lattice boards (FPGA versions 2407, 2412, 2507, 2510) and Leopard Imaging VB1940 "all-in-one" cameras (FPGA versions 2507, 2510). Uses release-specific YAML manifests and board-type-specific program commands. Lattice and VB1940 commands must never be mixed.

audits.summary: This skill facilitates FPGA firmware flashing on NVIDIA devkits. It is assessed as MEDIUM risk because it features an autonomous self-updating mechanism that programmatically modifies its own instruction file (SKILL.md) based on external data fetched from GitHub. It also uses SSH for remote command execution and downloads firmware bitstreams from both vendor-owned and well-known services.

skills.name: simplify
skills.description_en: Simplify and refine recently modified code for clarity and consistency. Use after writing code to improve readability without changing functionality.

audits.summary: This skill is a code refactoring assistant that simplifies and refines recently modified code to improve readability and consistency. It follows project-specific standards (referencing CLAUDE.md) and is designed to operate autonomously to update code as it is written. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: lark-note
skills.description_en: 仅当用户或上游配置显式指定 lark-note 时使用，相关请求统一交由 lark-meeting 技能处理。

zh.intro: 与 lark-vc-agent 同一类的兼容入口，只是旧名不同。不处理业务，仅在用户或上游配置显式点名 lark-note 时生效，随后要求完整读取 lark-meeting 的说明并按其路由执行。正文说明它依赖 lark-meeting 技能。
zh.usage: 只有上游配置或用户点名 lark-note 时才会命中；命中后交给 lark-meeting 处理，不要在这里实现新逻辑。
zh.notes: 旧名称兼容用，能力都在 lark-meeting。

audits.summary: The lark-note skill provides an interface for interacting with Lark meeting notes and transcripts using the lark-cli tool. It facilitates fetching note details, transcripts, and associated documents while enforcing identity management rules.

skills.name: fastapi-python
skills.description_en: Expert in FastAPI Python development with best practices for APIs and async operations

zh.intro: FastAPI 后端写法约定：函数式组织路由与依赖注入，用 Pydantic 模型校验输入，异步处理数据库和外部调用，错误用 HTTPException 映射成明确的响应。
zh.usage: 写接口、拆路由模块或处理启动关闭事件时使用；纯函数用 def，异步操作才用 async def，返回类型写清楚，参数用模型校验，阻塞调用尽量下沉或改异步。
zh.notes: 别把业务塞进类里，也别忽略模型序列化的开销；启动与关闭逻辑用生命周期上下文管理。

audits.summary: This skill provides safe development guidelines and best practices for FastAPI and Python backend development.

skills.name: unslop
skills.description_en: Cut AI tells from any writing.

zh.intro: 按编号规则扫描并改写文本里的机器味，保留原意并贴合原本语气。规则分五组：内容上删掉「体现出、确保了」这类空转分词结构和没有出处的模糊归因；用词上换掉那批高频 AI 词汇、别用「充当、堪称」绕开「是」、别写「不只是 X 还是 Y」、别硬凑三连、别为同一事物轮换同义词、别造虚假区间；排版上不用破折号、不把冒号当连接词、不滥用加粗、标题用句首大写、去掉装饰性表情、直引号；交流痕迹上删掉「希望这有帮助」这类客套和谄媚开场；最后清掉填充短语和过度含糊。规则编号稳定，别的技能会引用。
zh.usage: 把要发的稿子交给它，让它按编号规则扫一遍再改写，改完可以对着编号逐条追问某处为什么删或为什么换。
zh.notes: 该技能禁用了模型自动调用，需要手动指定；规则里的标点要求（不用破折号、改直引号）与中文排版习惯不一致，中文稿要自己取舍。

audits.summary: The skill is a collection of stylistic guidelines intended to improve writing by removing common AI patterns and jargon. It contains no executable code, network requests, or sensitive file access.

skills.name: lark-meeting
skills.description_en: 飞书视频会议：查询会议记录与会议产物(纪要/逐字稿/妙记)、妙记搜索/上传/下载/编辑、机器人参与会议；查询进行中的会议、实时会议内容(发言/聊天/共享文档)问答(会上/会里)、发送会中聊天/表情；基于 meeting_id、meeting_no、event_id、note_id、minute_token、vc-node-id 或妙记 URL 查询相关信息。预约会议、忙闲和会议室管理走 lark-calendar。

zh.intro: 飞书视频会议技能：查会议记录与产物（纪要、逐字稿、妙记）、妙记的搜索上传下载编辑、机器人参会，也能查进行中的会议、对实时发言和共享文档做问答、发会中聊天和表情。支持用 meeting_id、meeting_no、event_id、note_id、minute_token、vc-node-id 或妙记 URL 查。装量 23.4 万。
zh.usage: 要从飞书会议里捞纪要、逐字稿，或让机器人在会中参与问答时用；预约会议、忙闲和会议室要走 lark-calendar。
zh.notes: skills.sh 没回传审计结论（audit 为 null），trend_pct 也是空的，装之前自己核一下来源。

skills.name: install-anti-slop
skills.description_en: Install, configure, update, or upgrade vendored anti-slop Oxlint plugins. Use when adding anti-slop, picking up upstream rules or fixes, or migrating an existing installation while preserving local customizations.

zh.intro: 把 anti-slop 这套 Oxlint 插件以 vendored 方式落进目标仓库：从技能里跑 `node <skill-directory>/scripts/install.mjs`，默认生成 tools/oxlint/anti-slop/，仓库有自己的工具目录布局时可传别的相对路径。已有安装不要覆盖，走升级或迁移流程并保住本地定制。依赖按仓库现有 oxlint 版本精确装同版本 @oxlint/plugins，别写成范围；拷过去的 vendor/eslint-stylistic/LICENSE 与 UPSTREAM.md 要留着，它们是随规则走的来源说明。
zh.usage: 要新增 anti-slop、跟进上游规则或修复、或迁移重配已有安装又不想丢本地改动时用。
zh.notes: 脚本拒绝覆盖已存在的目标目录，别用强制参数绕过；oxlint 与插件走开发依赖。

audits.summary: The skill is a developer tool designed to install, configure, and update Oxlint linting rules within a project. It utilizes a local Node.js script to manage vendored assets and leverages the NPM registry for dependency management, following standard development practices.

skills.name: postmortem-writing
skills.description_en: Write effective blameless postmortems with root cause analysis, timelines, and action items. Use when conducting incident reviews, writing postmortem documents, or improving incident response processes.

audits.summary: The skill provides templates and guidelines for writing blameless postmortems. No security risks, malicious code, or data exfiltration patterns were detected.

It covers critical security domains including authentication, input validation, data protection, and CI/CD security.
