skills.name: turnstile-spin
skills.description_en: Set up, repair, or migrate to Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification in an existing frontend and backend, including server-side Siteverify.

zh.intro: 在已有的前端和后端里接入、修复或迁移 Cloudflare Turnstile 人机验证，包含服务端 Siteverify。它把一句「set up Turnstile」变成能跑通的端到端集成：控件、每个选定插入点的前端片段、在客户现有后端里落一份规范的 siteverify，并在报告成功前真跑一次校验。正文说明 scripts/ 下的脚本持有确定性逻辑（API 调用、重试与错误处理），agent 只负责编排、读代码、确认和改前后端；产品要求以 Turnstile 官方文档为准。前端按栈给参考文件，已有 Vanilla HTML 和 Next.js App Router。
zh.usage: 要在现有站点上线、修好或迁移 Turnstile 人机验证时调用；按正文的向导逐个执行 `scripts/` 下的脚本，并根据脚本输出的 JSON 分支处理，最后跑一次真实验证再收尾。
zh.notes: 需要 Cloudflare 账号和 Turnstile 站点密钥；产品要求以官方文档为准，前端接入按现有栈选参考文件（如 Vanilla HTML、Next.js App Router）。

audits.summary: This skill provides a secure and automated way to integrate bot protection services into various web frameworks. It demonstrates high-quality security practices, particularly in its handling of sensitive API tokens and its reliance on official resources.

skills.name: llm-evaluation
skills.description_en: Implement comprehensive evaluation strategies for LLM applications using automated metrics, human feedback, and benchmarking. Use when testing LLM performance, measuring AI application quality, or establishing evaluation frameworks.

audits.summary: The skill provides educational guidelines and code examples for implementing LLM evaluation frameworks, covering automated metrics, LLM-as-judge patterns, human evaluation, and benchmarking. No security issues or malicious behaviors were detected.

skills.name: python-background-jobs
skills.description_en: Python background job patterns including task queues, workers, and event-driven architecture. Use when implementing async task processing, job queues, long-running operations, or decoupling work from request/response cycles.

zh.intro: Python 后台任务的做法：任务队列、worker 与事件驱动架构。用于实现异步任务处理、作业队列、耗时操作，或把工作从请求响应链路里拆出去。本地没有正文可核对具体框架与代码，这里只说明适用场景。
zh.usage: 需要把耗时处理挪出请求链路、引入任务队列或 worker 时用它。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，未核对具体库与版本。

audits.summary: This skill provides educational patterns and best practices for implementing Python background jobs and task queues. It contains standard architectural guidance and code examples that do not present security risks.

skills.name: expo-design-system
skills.description_en: Build and maintain a design system inside an Expo app - a reusable theme of design tokens (color, spacing, typography, radius, shadow, motion), reusable component structure with variant/size/state prop conventions, and rules for when to extract a repeated view into a shared component. Use when creating or organizing theme files and design tokens (theme.ts / theme/), extending an existing theme or styling library (NativeWind, Tamagui, Restyle, Unistyles) in its own idiom, standardizing styles so screens (including AI-generated ones) look consistent and polished, fixing an app that looks AI-generated or generic instead of native (the named native-slop tells), building an in-app component library, or auditing an app for design-system drift (hardcoded colors, spacing, fonts). For platform styling specifics (semantic colors, HIG rules, native controls) use expo-native-ui; for folder layout of a new app use expo-project-structure.

audits.summary: This skill provides design system management for Expo, including auditing tools and a feedback mechanism. The security profile is generally safe, with a low-risk exposure to indirect prompt injection common to code analysis tools.

skills.name: website-to-video
skills.description_en: Capture a general website/URL and turn it into a video OF the site — tour, showcase, or social clip built from captured screenshots and the site's own brand assets. Use for portfolio / blog / docs / landing-page showcases. Not a product launch or promo, even from a URL (/product-launch-video). Unclear → /hyperframes.

zh.intro: 把某个网址抓下来，做成一段关于这个网站本身的视频：导览、展示片或社交短片，素材来自抓取的页面截图和站点自带的品牌资源。适合作品集、博客、文档站和落地页的展示。它明确不做产品发布或推广视频，即使输入同样是一个网址；意图不明时应先回 hyperframes 主入口。
zh.usage: 先用 `npx hyperframes skills update website-to-video` 更新本技能，再看 `npx hyperframes auth status` 确认登录状态。按作品目录组织文件，用 hyperframes lint、hyperframes snapshot 和 `npx hyperframes check` 校验，分镜文件是 compositions/beat-N.html，节拍数按 max(beats × 3, ceil(duration_seconds / 2)) 估算。
zh.notes: 重点是站在访客视角介绍站点，不是推销，产品发布和讲解类内容各有对应技能（/product-launch-video、/faceless-explainer、/pr-to-video、/hyperframes）。素材清单位于 .media/manifest.jsonl，设计材料可选带 DESIGN.md。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates the automated generation of videos from website URLs by capturing site assets and orchestrating video beats. The primary security considerations involve the ingestion of untrusted external website content which could lead to indirect prompt injection, and the dynamic generation and execution of JavaScript code for video compositions.

skills.name: health
skills.description_en: Audits agent config, instruction drift, hooks or MCP, and AI maintainability. Use when Claude, Codex, or Pi setup looks wrong. Not for application bugs or PR review.

audits.summary: This skill is a comprehensive project health and security auditing tool. It includes scripts to detect instruction drift, broken references, and security vulnerabilities in other agent skills, while implementing robust redaction and sanitization to prevent leaking sensitive information from the host system.

skills.name: context-driven-development
skills.description_en: Creates and maintains project context artifacts (product.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md) in a `conductor/` directory. Scaffolds new projects from scratch, extracts context from existing codebases, validates artifact consistency before implementation, and synchronizes documents as the project evolves. Use when setting up a project, creating or updating product docs, managing a tech stack file, defining development workflows, tracking work units, onboarding to an existing codebase, or running project scaffolding.

audits.summary: This skill provides a framework for project documentation and management through structured markdown files. It contains no executable scripts or malicious code. However, it presents a low-risk surface for indirect prompt injection because it instructs the agent to read and prioritize information from user-managed text files that could potentially contain untrusted instructions.

skills.name: build-zoom-rest-api-app
skills.description_en: Reference skill for Zoom REST API. Use after choosing an API-based workflow when you need endpoint selection, resource-management patterns, OAuth requirements, rate-limit awareness, or API error debugging.

It provides structured guidance on authentication, architecture, and resource management, following official Zoom documentation standards. No security concerns were identified, and the skill promotes secure practices such as migrating to OAuth 2.0 and validating webhook signatures.

skills.name: dbs-ai-check
skills.description_en: 扫描文案中的 AI 写作特征并输出检测报告，默认只诊断不改写；用户看完报告说「我想改」后，逐条追问写法背后的意图并给出修改方向。用户要求检查 AI 味、AI 痕迹或机器化表达时使用。

zh.intro: 扫文案里的 AI 写作特征，默认只诊断不改写。做法是按文本顺序逐处指出问题，每处先引用原文，再用一两句直白的话说明问题在哪，后面标注特征编号、特征名和严重度（强、中、弱三种信号），最后给一句总结并注明体裁判断。它内置 22 个特征，例如堵住所有反驳、把知识全部倒出来、匀速排比、同一个让步模板反复用、给概念起名的仪式、情绪曲线过于光滑、替读者说蠢话再纠正、「不是 X 是 Y」高密度、精确到不真实的情绪细节、每段都收金句、句子节奏过于均匀，并提醒短视频文稿段段金句属于体裁要求而非 AI 味。
zh.usage: 发一段文案说「查下 AI 味」，先拿检测报告；想改就说「我想改」，它会一处一处问你当时想达成什么，再给修改方向而不是直接重写。
zh.notes: 它明确反对靠改写伪装成人写，不会未追问就动笔；正文没有明显 AI 味时会直说没问题，不硬找；不负责选题诊断。

audits.summary: The skill is a text analysis tool designed to identify AI writing characteristics. It is safe to use as it contains no malicious code, remote downloads, or dangerous system operations.

skills.name: expo-web-to-native
skills.description_en: Migrate an existing web React app to a native iOS/Android app with Expo. Use when the user wants to turn a website into a mobile app, port a Next.js/Vite/CRA React codebase to React Native, reuse web code on native incrementally, or asks how web idioms (the DOM, CSS, React Router, localStorage, window) map to native. This is the end-to-end migration guide; use the `expo-dom` skill for the DOM-component mechanism itself.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive migration guide for porting web applications to Expo. It provides instructions for installing and using legitimate development tools from trusted and well-known vendors, such as Vercel Labs and Software Mansion. A low-severity risk of indirect prompt injection is present because the skill requires the agent to process untrusted source code from the user's repository and possesses significant system-level capabilities to execute commands and interact with simulated environments.

skills.name: eas-observe
skills.description_en: Use for anything related to EAS Observe - adding `expo-observe` to an Expo project (AppMetricsRoot/ObserveRoot HOC, markInteractive and ObserveInteractiveMarker, the useObserve hook, the Expo Router / React Navigation integrations for per-route metrics, user-defined events via `Observe.logEvent`, error reporting via ObserveErrorBoundary and `Observe.reportError`, native crash reporting, source map upload for symbolicated stack traces, and runtime config such as sampleRate and dispatchInDebug), querying via the EAS CLI (`eas observe:metrics-summary`, `observe:metrics`, `observe:routes`, `observe:events`, `observe:session`, `observe:versions`, `observe:errors`, `observe:event`), interpreting the resulting metrics (cold/warm launch, TTR, TTI, navigation cold/warm TTR, update download, and the TTI frameRate/device/network params for triaging slow startups), or shipping an Observe integration inside a third-party package.

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive guide for integrating and querying EAS Observe app metrics. It includes standard developer-focused tools and utilities. A minor security risk exists regarding indirect prompt injection when the agent processes potentially untrusted event data from the EAS CLI.

skills.name: sentry-cli
skills.description_en: Guide for using the Sentry CLI to interact with Sentry from the command line. Use when the user asks about viewing issues, events, projects, organizations, making API calls, or authenticating with Sentry via CLI.

zh.intro: 描述为空。能确认的是：sentry 的 dev 仓库出品，名字对应 sentry-cli 这个命令行工具，安装量 16.6 万，8 周涨 39.8%。Gen Agent Trust Hub 和 Snyk 两家审计都是 fail，只有 Socket 通过，是本片里少数被两家直接判 fail 的条目。
zh.usage: 只有当项目已经在用 sentry-cli 管 source map 和 release 时才考虑；这记录足够让你先跳过它。
zh.notes: 两家 fail（Gen Agent Trust Hub、Snyk）；正文没抓到无法自查，装前必须自己读。

audits.summary: The skill executes a remote script directly into the shell from a source not included in the trusted list, posing a severe security risk.

skills.name: dbs-chatroom
skills.description_en: 根据话题推荐或接受用户指定的专家，模拟多角色对话并总结分歧。用户要求专家讨论、定向聊天室或继续当前讨论时使用。

zh.intro: 给一个话题开一场多角色讨论。没指定人物时先推荐 3 到 5 位专家，每人一句话说明理论框架和分工，停下等你确认；确认后每位专家独立发言约 200 字，第一轮附模拟声明，再由判官总结讨论质量、两人都没覆盖的盲区、以及可执行建议。选人的逻辑是先选可检验的理论再选代表人物，要求命题清楚、经过长期批评与修正、能独立验证、能处理当前变量、原始材料足够，主动排除主要靠表达和平台声量立足的人。讨论可一直追问，直到你明确说结束才退回主流程。
zh.usage: 给一个话题说「开个聊天室」，它先给候选专家名单等你确认，确认后逐轮出专家发言和判官总结，想退出就说结束聊天室。
zh.notes: 第一轮会声明内容是模拟，不复述本人原话，也不替在世人物对公司、产品或他人表态；推荐名单避开泛财经、泛商业、泛知识类博主。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates a structured expert panel discussion. It includes robust guidelines for persona simulation, including honesty rules and mandatory disclaimers. No security risks or malicious behaviors were detected.

skills.name: springboot-patterns
skills.description_en: Spring Boot architecture patterns, REST API design, layered services, data access, caching, async processing, and logging. Use for Java Spring Boot backend work. Use when building or reviewing a Spring Boot backend — REST layer, services, data access, caching, or async work.

zh.intro: 面向 Java Spring Boot 后端的架构与分层写法：REST 接口设计、分层服务、数据访问、缓存、异步处理和日志。新建一个 Spring Boot 后端，或评审现有后端的这几块时按它对照。
zh.usage: 在做或审一个 Spring Boot 后端时用它，尤其是接口层、服务层、数据访问、缓存或异步任务要定方案的时候。
zh.notes: 这批里没有抓到正文，卡片只按目录描述写；具体命令与写法请以实际正文为准。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard Spring Boot architectural patterns and boilerplate code. It includes proactive security guidance regarding client IP detection, rate limiting, and centralized error handling to prevent information disclosure.

skills.name: web-component-design
skills.description_en: Master React, Vue, and Svelte component patterns including CSS-in-JS, composition strategies, and reusable component architecture. Use when building UI component libraries, designing component APIs, or implementing frontend design systems.

zh.intro: React、Vue、Svelte 三个框架下的组件写法与组织方式：CSS-in-JS、组件组合策略、可复用组件的架构。做 UI 组件库、设计组件对外的 API，或者给项目搭一套前端设计系统时用它。
zh.usage: 在做组件库、要定组件 API 的约定，或给项目立一套前端设计系统时用它。
zh.notes: 这批里没有抓到正文，卡片只按目录描述写。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive code references and guidelines for developing accessible and maintainable web components across popular frontend frameworks. It does not introduce code dependencies, remote endpoints, or executable automation scripts, presenting no identifiable security risks.

skills.name: python-pro
skills.description_en: Use when building Python 3.11+ applications requiring type safety, async programming, or robust error handling. Generates type-annotated Python code, configures mypy in strict mode, writes pytest test suites with fixtures and mocking, and validates code with black and ruff. Invoke for type hints, async/await patterns, dataclasses, dependency injection, logging configuration, and structured error handling.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive, high-quality instructions for modern Python development. While automated scans flagged the author's documentation URL and the main skill file, manual analysis suggests these are likely false positives triggered by the skill's strict instructional format and its role in generating and executing code using standard developer tools. The skill follows best practices for security by explicitly instructing the agent not to hardcode secrets.

skills.name: query-metrics
skills.description_en: Runs metrics queries against Axiom MetricsDB via scripts. Discovers available metrics, tags, and tag values. Use when asked to query metrics, explore metric datasets, check metric values, or investigate OTel metrics data.

audits.summary: The skill provides a set of tools to interact with Axiom MetricsDB. It follows security best practices for CLI integrations, including the use of local configuration files for credentials, proper encoding for API communication, and reliance on official vendor-managed endpoints. No malicious patterns were identified.

skills.name: tsdown
skills.description_en: Bundle TypeScript and JavaScript libraries with blazing-fast speed powered by Rolldown. Use when building libraries, generating type declarations, bundling for multiple formats, or migrating from tsup.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation for tsdown, a TypeScript library bundler. It describes standard build tool functionalities, including command execution hooks, plugin integration, and environment configuration. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: archify
skills.description_en: Create validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle/state, ERD, class, tree, timeline, and waterfall diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with dark/light themes, motion and image/SVG/WebM export. Accept requirements or Mermaid; inspect repository evidence for code-backed diagrams. Use when visualizing systems, API calls, pipelines, schemas, histories, timings, or everyday steps, parts, relationships and states. Also turn an answer into a one-page explainer, with the conclusion first, structured panels, native diagrams and charts, when the user asks for a page, an explainer or an answer to share (做成一页, 用页面讲), or proactively when the user's rules opt in with an [archify explainer: ...] line. Not for dashboards.

zh.intro: 描述为空。来源 tt-a1i，安装量 16.3 万，8 周跌 24.9%，是本片跌幅第二。三家里 Socket 给 warn，另两家通过。名字只说明它跟「架构」有关，具体产出是什么形态（代码图、系统图还是别的）从输入里看不出来。
zh.usage: 要做系统架构或模块关系图、并且愿意先自己读 SKILL.md 确认产出格式时再看它；只冲安装量装容易装错。
zh.notes: 无描述；Socket warn；8 周跌 24.9%，热度在退。

audits.summary: This skill is used for generating various types of diagrams. It performs network requests to fetch brand icons and check for updates, and it executes local commands to verify repository evidence or open generated files.

skills.name: deployment-pipeline-design
skills.description_en: Design multi-stage CI/CD pipelines with approval gates, security checks, and deployment orchestration. Use this skill when designing zero-downtime deployment pipelines, implementing canary rollout strategies, setting up multi-environment promotion workflows, or debugging failed deployment gates in CI/CD.

zh.intro: 设计带审批卡点、安全检查与渐进发布的多阶段 CI/CD 流水线：确定阶段划分、健康检查深浅、门禁指标阈值、金丝雀灰度或蓝绿切换参数，并交代多环境晋级与回滚路径。
zh.usage: 先说清应用类型、部署目标、环境拓扑、可接受停机时间与门禁约束，产出会落到阶段定义、发布策略、健康检查和指标阈值上，再逐项核对。
zh.notes: 自动晋级依赖监控数据源，Prometheus、Datadog、CloudWatch 之类要先确认拿到指标。

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive set of architectural patterns and templates for CI/CD pipelines. No security issues were detected, and the skill follows industry best practices for deployment orchestration and security scanning.

skills.name: slo-implementation
skills.description_en: Define and implement Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) with error budgets and alerting. Use when establishing reliability targets, implementing SRE practices, or measuring service performance.

zh.intro: 定义并实现 SLI 与 SLO：选指标、定目标和统计窗口、算错误预算、配告警。重点是把可靠性目标写成能算出来的东西，而不是停在口号上。适合刚开始搭 SRE 指标体系，或者现有告警太吵、需要按错误预算收敛的团队。
zh.usage: 要给服务定可靠性目标、算错误预算、或者把告警太多改成按预算触发时用。判断依据是讨论的是服务可用性和指标口径，不是单次故障排查。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。指标与预算的取法以正文为准。

audits.summary: The skill provides templates and guidelines for implementing Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and indicators. No security issues were detected.

The smart-ocr skill provides intelligent text extraction from images and PDFs using the PaddleOCR engine. The analysis identified a low-severity risk related to indirect prompt injection, as the skill processes external content that could contain malicious instructions. The skill also demonstrates standard usage of network requests and library installations for its intended purpose.

skills.name: dbs-chatroom-austrian
skills.description_en: 由哈耶克、米塞斯与 Claude 从奥派经济学视角展开多角色讨论。用户要求进入奥派聊天室或用奥派分析问题时使用。

zh.intro: 固定三人的多角色讨论：哈耶克从知识分散出发，追问决策需要哪些知识、分散在谁手里，秩序是设计出来的还是自发涌现的，有没有类似价格的信号在聚合分散信息；米塞斯从人会行动这条公理出发做先验推理，追问现象的因果链，并拒绝因为现实困难而在原则上让步。两人各写 200 字以内且互不参考，第一轮开头附模拟声明，随后由判官检查有没有生搬理论、补两人都没提到的视角、给出可带走的判断或行动建议。多轮时保留最近三轮完整对话，更早的压成摘要。
zh.usage: 说「奥派聊天室」再给一个问题，哈耶克和米塞斯各出一段回应，判官随后点评并给判断，可以继续追问直到你说结束。
zh.notes: 每轮开头都有模拟声明，引号内的话是模拟表达而非本人原话；只做奥派视角，不接其他学派或用户点名的人物；判官会直接点出套公式的发言。

audits.summary: The skill is a roleplay tool that simulates a discussion between economic personas. It is safe for its intended purpose but lacks explicit security boundaries for user input, creating a minor surface for indirect prompt injection where a user might attempt to influence the internal sub-agents.

skills.name: angular-migration
skills.description_en: Migrate from AngularJS to Angular using hybrid mode, incremental component rewriting, and dependency injection updates. Use when upgrading AngularJS applications, planning framework migrations, or modernizing legacy Angular code.

audits.summary: This skill provides guidance and structural templates for migrating legacy AngularJS code to contemporary Angular versions. It does not introduce code patterns or configurations that compromise system integrity or data privacy.

skills.name: distributed-tracing
skills.description_en: Implement distributed tracing with Jaeger and Tempo to track requests across microservices and identify performance bottlenecks. Use when debugging microservices, analyzing request flows, or implementing observability for distributed systems.

audits.summary: This skill provides standard patterns and configurations for implementing distributed tracing using Jaeger and Tempo. It includes Kubernetes deployment manifests and application instrumentation examples for Python, Node.js, and Go using official OpenTelemetry libraries. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: chief-of-staff
skills.description_en: Pursue a long-running goal in a single session by co-ordinating subagents.

zh.intro: 在一个会话里盯一个长期目标，把活分给子代理去做，并配合定时任务推进。要同时想两件事：眼前这一步怎么完成，以及怎么改动环境让下一步更容易做成。
zh.usage: 拿它跑跨天的长期目标：具体活都在子代理里做，后台代理保持和用户的对话；信息尽量用指针传，别复制。
zh.notes: 正文要求把记忆写进一个维基，子代理之间只靠研究笔记、提交记录和页面互相引用。

audits.summary: The skill establishes a coordination role for managing subagents and strategic goals. It processes external data such as research notes and commit history, which introduces a potential surface for indirect prompt injection, though no immediate malicious behaviors or dangerous tool usage were detected.

skills.name: expo-animation
skills.description_en: Build animations in React Native and Expo, making the decisions in the order that determines whether they feel right — should it animate, which thread it runs on, which properties, spring or timing, how the gesture hands off, how it degrades. Writes the implementation with Reanimated, Gesture Handler, Expo Router and expo-haptics. Use when animating anything in an Expo app, adding gestures, sheets, screen transitions, press feedback or haptics, or fixing motion that stutters on device. For web animation use `animate`.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions and code recipes for building high-performance animations in Expo and React Native. It utilizes official ecosystem tools like Reanimated and Gesture Handler, adhering to mobile performance best practices. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: eas-hosting
skills.description_en: Deploy Expo websites and Expo Router API routes to EAS Hosting - export the web bundle, run eas deploy for production and PR preview URLs, manage environment secrets and custom domains, and work within the Cloudflare Workers runtime. Also covers authoring API routes (+api.ts handlers, HTTP methods, request handling, CORS). Use when deploying an Expo web app or API routes, setting up EAS Hosting, or configuring hosting environments and domains. Not for native builds or store releases - use the eas-app-stores skill for those.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation and implementation examples for EAS Hosting and Expo Router API routes. It promotes secure development practices, such as preventing secret leakage by using server-side environment variables and emphasizing the necessity of input validation. Tools and scripts referenced in the skill are consistent with the vendor's ecosystem and intended functionality.

skills.name: extension-querying-oql
skills.description_en: Quick reference for the Caffeine Data Intelligence agent to query an OQL-exposing canister (schema() + execute()) through the `icp` CLI against the project's `backend` canister: read the schema, form JSON queries (filter / order / paginate / aggregate / dotted-path edges), and parse the Candid result rows.

zh.intro: 面向 Caffeine Data Intelligence 的查询速查：用 icp 命令行打项目里的 backend canister，它暴露两个只读方法，schema 回一份 JSON 文本，列出各实体的主键、字段和边；execute 跑 JSON 编码的查询并回 Candid 的 Result 行。查询支持筛选、排序、分页、聚合和点号路径关联。调用要点：JSON 要包成 Candid 文本字面量并转义引号；schema 取一次缓存整场会话，只在重新部署后才变；加 --branch live 可直接读已部署的罐，这条分支是只读的；值里带单引号要按 shell 规则转义。
zh.usage: 先取一次 schema 摸清实体与字段，再把需求写成带筛选条件和条数上限的 JSON 查询，交给 execute 取回结果行解析。
zh.notes: 两个方法都是查询调用；罐名固定为 backend，不需要身份和 canister ID；返回的是 Candid 字面量，要先反转义再解析。

audits.summary: The skill provides a reference for querying a database via the icp command-line tool. It is functional but introduces a potential surface for indirect prompt injection by processing data from a remote source without explicit sanitization or boundary markers.

skills.name: workers-profiling
skills.description_en: Profile or debug CPU usage and memory allocation in deployed Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects. Then use this information to optimize your code.

audits.summary: This skill provides guidance on profiling and optimizing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects. It operates using official Cloudflare documentation and standard developer tools, with no security issues detected.

skills.name: langchain-architecture
skills.description_en: Design LLM applications using LangChain 1.x and LangGraph for agents, memory, and tool integration. Use when building LangChain applications, implementing AI agents, or creating complex LLM workflows.

zh.intro: 用 LangChain 1.x 和 LangGraph 搭 LLM 应用的架构参考：包分工上 langchain 做高层编排、langchain-core 放消息与提示与工具等抽象、langgraph 管 agent 编排和状态。正文讲 StateGraph 的显式状态、持久执行、人在回路、短期与长期记忆、检查点；agent 模式有 ReAct、计划再执行、多 agent 监督路由、带 Pydantic 结构的工具调用，还涉及文档加载与转换。
zh.usage: 搭带工具的 AI agent、写多步 LLM 流程、管会话记忆与状态、把模型接到外部数据源，或要做生产级 LLM 应用时用它。
zh.notes: 正文把包版本写成 1.2.x 一代，并列出记忆的几种实现与各自的适用场景。

audits.summary: This skill provides architecture patterns and boilerplate for LangChain and LangGraph applications. It follows safe practices for mathematical evaluation and uses standard placeholders for configuration. A low-severity finding is noted regarding the inherent risk of indirect prompt injection in the agent architectures described.

skills.name: sast-configuration
skills.description_en: Configure Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools for automated vulnerability detection in application code. Use when setting up security scanning, implementing DevSecOps practices, or automating code vulnerability detection.

audits.summary: The skill provides standard configuration and setup instructions for well-known Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools such as Semgrep, SonarQube, and CodeQL. No malicious patterns or security risks were detected.

skills.name: remotion-best-practices
skills.description_en: Router for all Remotion skills

audits.summary: The Remotion Best Practices skill is a comprehensive documentation and toolset for the Remotion video editing framework. It provides instructions for project scaffolding, media processing, map animations, and rendering using standard CLI tools and well-known third-party services.

skills.name: linkerd-patterns
skills.description_en: Implement Linkerd service mesh patterns for lightweight, security-focused service mesh deployments. Use when setting up Linkerd, configuring traffic policies, or implementing zero-trust networking with minimal overhead.

zh.intro: 用 Linkerd 做轻量服务网格的落地做法：安装与配置、流量策略、零信任网络，以及在尽量少占资源的前提下把服务间通信管起来。侧重安全和小开销，不追求大而全的网格功能。
zh.usage: 要给一组服务加上双向 TLS、重试、超时或流量拆分，又不想引入重型网格时用；已有 Linkerd 但要配流量策略时也用。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。

audits.summary: The skill provides templates and management commands for the Linkerd service mesh. It includes a remote installation command for the Linkerd CLI from the official project website, which is a standard and expected operation for this technology. The skill follows best practices for Kubernetes service mesh implementation.

skills.name: aso
skills.description_en: When the user wants to audit or optimize an App Store or Google Play listing. Also use when the user mentions 'ASO audit,' 'app store optimization,' 'optimize my app listing,' 'improve app visibility,' 'app store ranking,' 'audit my listing,' 'why aren't people downloading my app,' 'improve my app conversion,' 'keyword optimization for app,' or 'compare my app to competitors.' Use when the user shares an App Store or Google Play URL and wants to improve it.

zh.intro: 审 App Store 和 Google Play 的应用详情页：抓线上 listing 数据，给元数据、视觉素材和评分打分，再输出一份按优先级排的行动清单。适合用户丢来一个商店链接、或者问「为什么没人下载我的 app」的时候。
zh.usage: 用户给 App Store 或 Google Play 链接、要审或优化上架页、要跟竞品对比、或者问排名、曝光、下载转化时用它。开始前它会先读 `.agents/product-marketing.md`（旧目录 `.claude/product-marketing.md`，更早叫 `product-marketing-context.md`）拿产品定位，再问缺的信息。
zh.notes: 依赖实时抓取商店页面，抓不到就没数据可评；开始前会先找 `.agents/product-marketing.md` 这类产品营销上下文，缺失时会先问。输出是按优先级排的行动清单，不是自动改页面。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive tool for auditing App Store and Google Play listings. It includes clear instructions on fetching data, assessing brand maturity, and scoring listing dimensions. Notably, it incorporates security best practices by explicitly instructing the agent to treat fetched web data as untrusted and to ignore any instructions embedded within app descriptions or user reviews, effectively mitigating indirect prompt injection risks.

skills.name: dbs-goal
skills.description_en: 提取已有约束，只追问影响执行或验收的信息，把模糊愿望整理成可行动、可检查的交付目标。用户要明确做成什么、边界和验收标准时使用；不替代概念拆解或研究问题改写。

zh.intro: 把模糊愿望整理成能指导行动、能判断完成的交付目标。先从上下文提取已有约束：交付物、使用对象、范围、规格、完成条件、约束，不要求用户重复；信息够用就直接放行，给出交付物与下一步，不再追问。缺一项会改变交付物、执行路径或验收的信息时，只交代已经明确的部分，再问 1 个具体问题并停下等回答；只有「做个人 IP」这类愿望式表达时，每轮问 1 个缩小范围的问题。判断用五项特征：可指物性、可否证性、有完成态、语法健全、嵌在上下文里，满足三项即算可用，不设硬门槛。对「更好、深入、系统、全面」这类词做语义做工检测，看它是否改变了交付物、对象、范围格式、执行路径或验收结果，而不是看删掉后句子还通不通顺。
zh.usage: 目标说法含糊时，先让它提取已有约束出一张目标卡，被追问就每轮只答一个问题，最后确认完成条件有可识别证据。
zh.notes: 只做目标清晰化，不做概念拆解、研究问题改写、顾客购买动机分析；不替你定数字、期限与成功标准；一次只问一个问题，要逐轮回答。

audits.summary: The skill 'dbs-goal' is a goal-clarification and auditing tool designed to refine vague requests into actionable tasks. It operates purely through instructional logic within the agent's conversational context. The analysis found no evidence of malicious behavior, data exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution. It does not use any external tools, network calls, or sensitive file access.

skills.name: attack-tree-construction
skills.description_en: Build comprehensive attack trees to visualize threat paths. Use when mapping attack scenarios, identifying defense gaps, or communicating security risks to stakeholders.

zh.intro: 用攻击树把威胁路径画出来：根目标是攻击者要的结果，中间分 AND 和 OR 节点，前者要所有子条件都满足，后者任一子节点达成就够；叶子是原子攻击步骤。每个节点可标成本、耗时、所需技能和被发现的概率，用来找防御缺口、排投入优先级、给非技术方讲清风险。
zh.usage: 做威胁建模、渗透测试计划、安全架构评审，或要向管理层说明风险时用。先定清攻击者想要什么，再穷举向量并给每条标属性和对应缓解措施。
zh.notes: 更细的模板和完整案例放在技能的 references/details.md 里，需要具体模板时再读。

audits.summary: The skill provides templates and best practices for creating attack trees to visualize security threats. It includes Python templates for data modeling and analysis, which are safe for use as they do not perform network operations, file access, or command execution.

skills.name: next-best-practices
skills.description_en: Next.js best practices - file conventions, RSC boundaries, data patterns, async APIs, metadata, error handling, route handlers, image/font optimization, bundling

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive collection of best practices and architectural patterns for Next.js applications. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: baoyu-slide-deck
skills.description_en: Generates professional slide deck images from content. Creates outlines with style instructions, then generates individual slide images. Use when user asks to "create slides", "make a presentation", "generate deck", "slide deck", or "PPT".

zh.intro: 把内容做成成套幻灯片图片，定位是读和分享而不是现场演讲，所以每页自解释、纵向滚动有逻辑。流程是先分析内容、给风格方案等你确认，再出大纲、写每页提示词、逐页出图，最后合并成 PPTX 或 PDF。风格预设 17 套，也可自定义维度。
zh.usage: 用 `--style`、`--audience`、`--lang` 定风格、受众和输出语言；合并阶段跑 `${BUN_X} {baseDir}/scripts/merge-to-pptx.ts <slide-deck-dir>` 或 `merge-to-pdf.ts`，`${BUN_X}` 优先取 `bun`，否则用 `npx -y bun`。
zh.notes: 正文要求确认后才开始出图；产物目录里有 `outline.md`、`prompts/`、逐页 PNG 和最终 PPTX 或 PDF。合并脚本需要 bun 或 npx 可用。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive instructions for generating presentation slide decks using various image backends and layouts. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: cost-optimization
skills.description_en: Optimize cloud costs across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI through resource rightsizing, tagging strategies, reserved instances, and spending analysis. Use when reducing cloud expenses, analyzing infrastructure costs, or implementing cost governance policies.

zh.intro: 跨 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI 的云成本优化：先做成本可见性（分摊标签、预算告警、成本面板），再压资源规格、清闲置、上预留与节省计划、混用 Spot，并在架构侧用托管服务、缓存和数据生命周期策略。
zh.usage: 要降云账单、分析基础设施成本、给团队定成本治理规则时用它；先处理闲置与超配资源，再谈采购折扣。
zh.notes: 正文按 AWS 侧列出预留实例、节省计划、Spot 的适用负载、折扣空间和中断风险。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidance and static configuration templates for cloud cost optimization across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: parallel-feature-development
skills.description_en: Coordinate parallel feature development with file ownership strategies, conflict avoidance rules, and integration patterns for multi-agent implementation. Use this skill when decomposing a large feature into independent work streams, when two or more agents need to implement different layers of the same system simultaneously, when establishing file ownership to prevent merge conflicts in a shared codebase, when designing interface contracts so parallel implementers can build against each other's APIs before they are ready, or when deciding whether to use vertical slices versus horizontal layers for a full-stack feature.

audits.summary: The skill provides organizational strategies and architectural guidelines for coordinating multiple AI agents during parallel software development. It focuses on workflow coordination, file ownership, and integration patterns without executing code, performing network operations, or accessing sensitive data.

skills.name: supply-chain-risk-auditor
skills.description_en: Audits a project's dependencies for supply-chain risk: version-matched advisories for direct dependencies and the full lockfile tree, abandoned or archived upstreams, npm publisher concentration, and install-time script execution. Use when asked to audit dependencies, assess supply-chain or third-party package risk, or review a dependency tree before an engagement.

audits.summary: This skill is a security tool developed by Trail of Bits to audit project dependencies for supply-chain risks. It automates the collection of metadata from official sources like npm, PyPI, and GitHub to generate reports. The scripts include extensive input validation, defensive parsing of third-party manifest files, and strict encoding checks to prevent security regressions during report generation. All external network activity is directed toward official package registries, vulnerability databases, and source code forges.

skills.name: dbs-report
skills.description_en: 把多次 dbs-save 存档合并成可交付的 Markdown 报告。用户要求汇总诊断、整理报告或生成可分享材料时使用。

zh.intro: 把同一项目下多份 dbs-save 存档合并成一份 Markdown 报告，固定六段：主诉演进、已确认的结论、已否决的方向、当前未解决的问题、已确认的下一步、存档索引附录。结论后来被推翻时新旧都列，旧条目标注已被修正。写到 reports 下按项目名和带时间戳的文件，每次新生成一份、永不覆盖，方便对比不同时点的快照。只有一份存档时会先问要不要强制出报告，零份则直接说明没有可汇总内容。
zh.usage: 项目里存过两次以上诊断后，跑 /dbs-report，需要只看近期就加 --since 2026-04-01 这样的日期参数。
zh.notes: 只读存档、不修改配置；存档是本地纯文本，不做脱敏，也不出 PDF 或 HTML。

audits.summary: The skill dbs-report is a reporting utility that consolidates local diagnostic data from Markdown archives into unified reports. It uses local file system operations and a Python command for metadata formatting. The skill follows a strict data-copying logic from local project directories, which is consistent with its intended use as a document management tool.

skills.name: expo-overview
skills.description_en: Entry point and router for every Expo or EAS task. Load this skill first — before writing code and before choosing another expo-* / eas-* skill — when the request, PRD, or spec mentions Expo, EAS, Expo Go, or an expo-* package, or the project has an `expo` dependency in `package.json`. Within that gate it also covers app specs and designs to implement (tabs, stacks, maps, lists, navigation, building from a screenshot), and phrasings like 'implement a mobile app', 'make my app look native', 'add navigation', 'fetch some data', 'upgrade my SDK', 'add Expo to my existing native app', 'ship to the App Store', or 'I'm new to Expo, where do I start'. A fully specified request (SDK pinned, libraries named, layout given) still routes through here — the shared setup rules still apply. Do NOT load it when neither signal is present: a bare React Native project with no `expo` dependency is not Expo work. Detects the real goal, routes to the right expo-* / eas-* skill, and owns the shared setup rules.

audits.summary: The skill acts as a legitimate entry point and router for Expo and EAS development workflows. It uses official CLI tools, identifies SDK versions through project files, and provides a mechanism for submitting feedback via a vendor-specific package.

skills.name: coupang-product-search
skills.description_en: k-skill-proxy의 공식 Coupang Partners API 경로로 쿠팡 상품을 검색하고 로켓배송·가격 후보를 비교한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It utilizes the author's own CLI tools and proxy infrastructure to facilitate Coupang product searches while adhering to legal and affiliate disclosure requirements.

skills.name: changelog-generator
skills.description_en: Automatically creates user-facing changelogs from git commits by analyzing commit history, categorizing changes, and transforming technical commits into clear, customer-friendly release notes. Turns hours of manual changelog writing into minutes of automated generation.

audits.summary: The skill is a documentation utility that guides the agent in generating human-readable changelogs from git history. It contains no executable code, remote dependencies, or malicious instructions.

skills.name: hsb-setup
skills.description_en: Clone the latest NVIDIA Holoscan Sensor Bridge repo, ask which supported devkit is being used, configure the host per platform, build the correct demo container, run it, and verify HSB connectivity by pinging 192.168.0.2. Use for Holoscan Sensor Bridge setup, build, container launch, and first-connectivity bring-up.

audits.summary: This skill automates the end-to-end setup and validation of the NVIDIA Holoscan Sensor Bridge (HSB) environment on supported devkits. It handles repository cloning, host network configuration, Docker container builds, and connectivity verification through a structured multi-phase workflow.

skills.name: turborepo
skills.description_en: Turborepo monorepo build system guidance. Triggers on: turbo.json, task pipelines, dependsOn, caching, remote cache, the "turbo" CLI, --filter, --affected, CI optimization, environment variables, internal packages, monorepo structure/best practices, and boundaries.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive guidance for managing monorepo workflows using Turborepo. No security issues were detected; the skill adheres to standard development practices and official documentation.

skills.name: show-me
skills.description_en: Help the user understand the current topic visually with concise diagrams, code-shape sketches, and focused HTML artifacts.

zh.intro: 把当前话题讲明白：按内容的形状挑最小的一种图——算法用伪代码、运行时用调用树、UI 用组件树（带上要紧的 state 和模块边界）、目录职责用浅层文件树、交互和数据流用 Mermaid、只关心改动就用 diff。Mermaid 撑不住的布局、状态对比或信息密度，就写一个单独的 HTML 文件再打开给用户看。
zh.usage: 直接说「给我画出来」，或点名叫 show-me；HTML 产物按 `path/to/show-me-{description}.html` 命名后打开，配色字体跟随产品现有样式，桌面和手机都要能看。
zh.notes: 正文标了 disable-model-invocation，需要用户显式触发，agent 不会自己跳出来画图；图只承载当前问题或候选方案的关键形状，别塞全量信息。

audits.summary: This skill generates visual aids such as diagrams, call trees, and HTML artifacts to help explain concepts visually. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: dbs-restore
skills.description_en: 恢复由 dbs-save 保存的最近诊断状态。用户要求接着上次、查看此前结论或继续未完成诊断时使用。

zh.intro: 从本地存档里拉回最近一次诊断状态，紧凑展示主诉、已得出的结论、已否决的方向、待验证假设和上次留的下一步，末尾只问一句从哪儿继续，不替用户挑下一步，也不主动跳到别的 skill。支持按序号取、按项目名切到别的项目、以及 list 模式；「最新」按文件名前缀的时间判断，不看文件修改时间。当前项目没有存档时列出最近活跃的三个项目让用户选。用户说按上次的下一步走，才把存档内容当输入交给对应 skill。
zh.usage: 隔了几天要接着上次诊断，跑 /dbs-restore 看状态摘要，再回答从哪儿继续。
zh.notes: 只读配置、不改存档位置；不会跨目录自动搜私人文件；文件被手改坏时尽量用现有信息展示。

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe but contains a few minor technical risks. It includes instructions to execute a small Python script locally for generating timestamps and possesses an attack surface for indirect prompt injection because it reads and processes external archive files that could be tampered with to influence the agent's behavior.

skills.name: pr
skills.description_en: INVOKE THIS SKILL before creating any PR to ensure compliance with branch naming, changelog requirements, and reviewer assignment.

audits.summary: The skill provides a standard Pull Request workflow for the ActivityPub project. It includes branch naming conventions, linting commands, and PR creation steps using the GitHub CLI. All actions and references are consistent with a development environment and the skill author's organization. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: dbs-save
skills.description_en: 把当前诊断的关键状态保存到本地，并查看或设置存档位置。用户要求保存结论、跨会话续接或修改存档位置时使用。

zh.intro: 把当前对话里诊断出的主诉、已得出的结论、用户已否决的方向、待验证假设和已确认的下一步写成一个结构化 Markdown 存档：frontmatter 字段固定，正文六段按顺序，文件名带时间戳，同一状态存两次也不会冲突。同时负责存档位置：默认 ~/.dbs/，也可用项目内 .dbs/ 或指定的本地、云同步目录，只有明确执行 location 子命令才写配置。对话里还没有结论时会拒绝写空文件。list 模式列出存档的时间、标题、状态和来源。
zh.usage: 有结论要留时说「保存」，或跑 /dbs-save 加标题；要查已有记录就跑 /dbs-save list。
zh.notes: 存档是不加密的本地纯文本，可能含收入与客户信息；项目用 Git 时建议把 .dbs/ 加进 .gitignore，改前会先确认。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates saving diagnostic session states to local Markdown files. It employs utility shell commands and Python snippets for directory management and timestamp generation. The skill demonstrates security awareness by requiring user confirmation for configuration changes and providing warnings regarding the storage of sensitive business data in unencrypted local files.

skills.name: wecomcli-msg
skills.description_en: 企业微信消息技能。提供会话列表查询、消息记录拉取（支持文本/图片/文件/语音/视频）、多媒体文件获取和文本消息发送能力。当用户需要"查看消息"、"看聊天记录"、"发消息给某人"、"最近有什么消息"、"给群里发消息"、"看看发了什么图片/文件"时触发。

audits.summary: This skill allows an AI agent to manage WeCom messaging tasks like reading chat history, downloading attachments, and sending messages using the wecom-cli tool. It incorporates safety procedures such as message confirmation and transparent file path reporting, but it remains susceptible to indirect prompt injection from chat message content.

skills.name: write
skills.description_en: Rewrites and polishes Chinese or English prose, technical instructions, and product copy. Use when drafting, editing, localizing, or cutting AI tone. Not for code comments or commit messages.

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines and tools for polishing Chinese and English text, utilizing a local Python script for punctuation checks and the GitHub CLI for context. It is generally safe but carries an inherent risk of indirect prompt injection due to its primary function of processing external text, and a potential for command injection as user-supplied arguments are interpolated into shell commands.

skills.name: python-project-structure
skills.description_en: Python project organization, module architecture, and public API design. Use when setting up new projects, organizing modules, defining public interfaces with __all__, or planning directory layouts.

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill provides architectural guidelines and best practices for organizing Python projects.

skills.name: fine-dust-location
skills.description_en: 에어코리아 기반 미세먼지/초미세먼지를 지역명 또는 위치 힌트로 조회한다. 기본 경로는 k-skill-proxy의 report endpoint다.

audits.summary: This skill is a utility for checking air quality (fine dust) levels in South Korea. It fetches data from official government APIs or a vendor-provided proxy service. The skill follows security best practices for secret management, uses trusted vendor resources for its CLI operations, and contains no malicious patterns.

skills.name: lavish
skills.description_en: Turn complex or visual agent responses into rich, reviewable HTML artifacts (HTML files) the user can annotate and send feedback on, using the lavish-axi CLI. Use when about to give a plan, comparison, diagram, table, code diff, report, or anything easier to grasp visually than as prose.

zh.intro: 把计划、方案对比、图表、表格、代码 diff、报告、原型这类用文字讲不清的东西做成浏览器里打开的 HTML 页面，人在页面上圈注写意见，反馈再回到 agent 形成评审循环。工作流刻意不写在 SKILL.md 里（安装副本会过时），每步都从 CLI 现取：--help 看命令和评审循环，design 看当前设计取向，playbook 拿具体产物的写法。不必全局安装，把 HTML 文件作为参数调用就会在浏览器打开。
zh.usage: 把结论写成 HTML 后跑 `npx -y lavish-axi <html-file>` 在浏览器打开等用户标注；要给 agent 回话用 `npx -y lavish-axi reply --help` 看参数再发。
zh.notes: 依赖 npx 现取最新版 CLI；文件里的工作流说明是旧的，命令和设计规范以 CLI 输出为准，输出里以 lavish-axi 开头的后续命令也要换成 npx -y lavish-axi 形式。

audits.summary: This skill allows the agent to create visual HTML artifacts using the lavish-axi CLI tool, which is executed via npx. It instructs the agent to prioritize dynamically fetched guidance from the CLI over its own local file. While providing visualization, it introduces an indirect prompt injection surface by processing user input and conversation context without explicit sanitization.

skills.name: similarity-search-patterns
skills.description_en: Implement efficient similarity search with vector databases. Use when building semantic search, implementing nearest neighbor queries, or optimizing retrieval performance.

audits.summary: The skill provides standard implementation templates and documentation for popular vector databases, including Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector, and Weaviate. The code follows standard security practices for database interactions and uses well-known, legitimate libraries for search and machine learning tasks.

skills.name: wecomcli-schedule
skills.description_en: 企业微信日程管理技能。适用于用户对企业微信日程的各类管理需求。当用户需要：(1) 查询指定时间范围内的日程列表或获取日程详细信息（标题、时间、地点、参与者等），(2) 创建新日程并设置提醒、参与人等，(3) 修改已有日程的标题、时间、地点等信息或取消日程，(4) 添加或移除日程参与人，(5) 查询多个成员的闲忙状态并分析共同空闲时段以安排会议时使用此技能。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates the management of Enterprise WeChat schedules using a dedicated command-line interface tool. It includes clear instructions for querying, creating, and modifying calendar events while incorporating security best practices such as requiring user confirmation for destructive actions and protecting sensitive user identifiers. No malicious patterns or security vulnerabilities were identified.

skills.name: employment-contract-templates
skills.description_en: Create employment contracts, offer letters, and HR policy documents following legal best practices. Use when drafting employment agreements, creating HR policies, or standardizing employment documentation.

zh.intro: 起草劳动合同、录用通知与人事政策文档，按常见法律实践组织条款：职位与职责、薪酬与支付、工时与休假、保密与知识产权、终止与争议解决。
zh.usage: 要出新员工的合同或录用通知、或把散落的人事文件统一成模板时用它；先定用工形式与适用法域，再套条款并逐条核对；模板只是起点，正式签署前要过当地法律顾问。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准；条款按通用实践写，不构成法律意见。

audits.summary: The skill is completely safe and consists entirely of documentation and text templates for creating employment contracts, offer letters, and HR policies.

skills.name: saga-orchestration
skills.description_en: Implement saga patterns for distributed transactions and cross-aggregate workflows. Use this skill when implementing distributed transactions across microservices where 2PC is unavailable, designing compensating actions for failed order workflows that span inventory, payment, and shipping services, building event-driven saga coordinators for travel booking systems that must roll back hotel, flight, and car rental reservations atomically, or debugging stuck saga states in production where compensation steps never complete.

audits.summary: The skill is safe and contains standard software engineering templates and documentation for implementing Saga Orchestration patterns in distributed systems.

skills.name: mtls-configuration
skills.description_en: Configure mutual TLS (mTLS) for zero-trust service-to-service communication. Use when implementing zero-trust networking, certificate management, or securing internal service communication.

zh.intro: 配置双向 TLS 的技能，用于服务之间互验证书的场景：讲证书签发与轮换、客户端证书校验，以及零信任网络里服务间通信的加固方式。适合内部服务要收紧身份认证、或从单向 TLS 升级到双向的时候参考。
zh.usage: 内部服务要互验证书、排查证书链或安排轮换时用它；先确定信任根放在哪，再决定证书怎么分发。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令与配置以正文为准；正文把证书管理和零信任网络放在一起讲。

audits.summary: This skill provides configuration templates and documentation for implementing mutual TLS (mTLS) in zero-trust service mesh environments. It contains no executable scripts or dangerous code.

skills.name: msw-painter
skills.description_en: When msw-search cannot find a suitable sprite RUID, draw a pixel art sprite directly with SVG / HTML5 Canvas / HTML code, render it to PNG, and upload it via the msw-mcp asset upload tool to obtain a sprite RUID (if no upload tool is connected, guide the user to register it through Maker). Two style modes are supported: chunky pixel (retro / icon / tile feel) and maple cartoon (MapleStory-inspired character / NPC feel). Triggers: draw sprite directly, create sprite, image generation, custom graphic, pixel art, cartoon sprite, maple style, chibi character, painter, draw a sprite, make an icon, create NPC image directly, draw a slime, custom sprite.

audits.summary: The skill provides a workflow for creating pixel art sprites, rendering them to PNG using a local Puppeteer-based helper, and uploading them to a workspace. It demonstrates strong security awareness by implementing robust sanitization, network isolation for the rendering process, and secure handling of temporary upload credentials. The 'low' verdict reflects the inherent attack surface of processing user-influenced code and performing network operations, despite the excellent mitigations provided.

skills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
skills.description_en: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, Next.js pages, data fetching, bundle optimization, or performance improvements.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive set of performance optimization guidelines for React and Next.js, authored by Vercel. It consists of documentation and code examples intended to guide developers and AI agents in writing efficient code.

skills.name: projection-patterns
skills.description_en: Build read models and projections from event streams. Use when implementing CQRS read sides, building materialized views, or optimizing query performance in event-sourced systems.

zh.intro: 从事件流构建读模型与投影：CQRS 读侧怎么切、物化视图怎么建与重建、事件重放怎么保证幂等、读侧查询性能怎么调。适合事件溯源系统里读侧跟不上或查询太慢的情况。
zh.usage: 要给事件溯源系统加读侧、或现有投影重建慢、查询慢时用它；先定投影的粒度与幂等键，再考虑增量更新还是全量重建；改投影后按事件重放验证结果一致。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。

audits.summary: The skill provides safe and well-implemented code templates and guides for implementing the CQRS pattern and event-driven projections.

skills.name: msw-avatar
skills.description_en: MSW avatar management — costume (CostumeManagerComponent, 17 slots) + animation 3-layer pipeline (StateComponent → AvatarStateAnimationComponent → AvatarRendererComponent). Four-level distinction: State key (uppercase) / AvatarBodyActionStateName (lowercase) / MapleAvatarBodyActionState enum / sprite action ID (swingO1, shoot1). Two mapping systems via IsLegacy/ActionSheet/StateToAvatarBodyActionSheet. PlayerControllerComponent auto-transition conflicts with ActionStateChangedEvent resolved via RemoveActionSheet/SetActionSheet/BodyActionStateChangeEvent. Applies to any avatar-bearing entity (NPC, monster, etc.), not only DefaultPlayer. Use for costume get/set, 17 equip slots, animation state mapping, action override, weapon-specific attack motion, custom shoot/cast/dance action. Keywords: avatar, costume, animation, state, action, shoot, swing, weapon, equipment, custom action, block auto playback, remap.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation and implementation patterns for managing avatar costumes and animations within the MapleStory Worlds (MSW) developer environment. It guides the AI on project file modifications and script-based controls, adhering to platform-specific conventions. No malicious patterns or security vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: msw-general
skills.description_en: Foundation skill for MSW (MapleStory Worlds). Read this FIRST before anything else in MSW.

audits.summary: This skill is a comprehensive foundation toolkit for MapleStory Worlds (MSW) development. it provides detailed documentation, map templates, and utility scripts (builders) designed to assist AI agents in correctly authoring and modifying project-specific files like .map, .model, .ui, and .dataset. No security risks or malicious patterns were identified during the analysis.

skills.name: firecrawl-search
skills.description_en: Web search with full page content extraction. Use this skill whenever the user asks to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up, find recent news, discover sources, or says "search for", "find me", "look up", "what are people saying about", or "find articles about". Returns real search results with optional full-page markdown — not just snippets. Provides capabilities beyond Claude's built-in WebSearch.

audits.summary: The firecrawl-search skill provides comprehensive web search and discovery capabilities through the Firecrawl platform. The skill is generally safe but is susceptible to low-severity indirect prompt injection risks because it processes and scrapes untrusted content from the web without explicit isolation or sanitization.

skills.name: changelog-automation
skills.description_en: Automate changelog generation from commits, PRs, and releases following Keep a Changelog format. Use when setting up release workflows, generating release notes, or standardizing commit conventions.

skills.name: python-resilience
skills.description_en: Python resilience patterns including automatic retries, exponential backoff, timeouts, and fault-tolerant decorators. Use when adding retry logic, implementing timeouts, building fault-tolerant services, or handling transient failures.

zh.intro: Python 的容错写法：自动重试、指数退避、抖动、超时与熔断。核心是先分清瞬时故障和永久故障——网络超时、服务临时不可用可以重试，凭据错误和坏请求不该重试，且重试次数和总时长都要设上限。
zh.usage: 给外部服务调用加重试时可用 `tenacity` 的装饰器写法，正文给了 `stop_after_attempt` 与 `wait_exponential_jitter` 的组合；加抖动是为了避免大量客户端同时重试。
zh.notes: 正文按瞬时与永久故障、指数退避、抖动、有界重试四节展开，再给基础重试等模式的具体 Python 代码。

audits.summary: The skill provides safe, best-practice Python coding patterns for building resilient applications using well-known libraries. No malicious patterns or security vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: dart-use-pattern-matching
skills.description_en: Applies Dart 3 pattern matching, switch expressions, and destructuring idiomatically to validate data schemas, handle algebraic data types, and decompose control flow. Use when refactoring complex if-else chains, parsing polymorphic JSON or API responses, destructuring Lists, URI/path segments, String.split() tokens, Records, or Maps, or enforcing exhaustiveness on sealed classes. Don't use for simple boolean conditions, single-variable type promotion (use `is`), or basic collection filtering.

zh.intro: Dart 3 的模式匹配与解构：用 switch 表达式替代长 if-else 链，按 map 的判别键反序列化进 sealed 类层级，用 List 模式带 rest 元素拆路径段与 split 结果，用 Object 模式一次解出多个字段，用关系模式与逻辑模式表达区间和组合，并对 sealed 家族强制穷尽。反例也写了：单变量类型提升用 is，单纯布尔判断和普通集合过滤不必上模式。
zh.usage: 先按场景选模式再写；表达式式写成 `switch (value) { pattern => expression, }`，语句式写成 `switch (value) { case pattern: statements; }`，两者空 case 都往下穿透、非空自动 break。
zh.notes: 逻辑或两侧必须定义完全相同的变量集合，逻辑与两侧不许有重叠变量；as 模式类型不符会抛异常，别拿它做宽松匹配。

audits.summary: The skill provides idiomatic guidelines and examples for Dart 3 pattern matching, switch expressions, and destructuring. It promotes secure coding practices, including explicit path traversal checks and fail-fast validation for malformed input, with no malicious patterns detected.

skills.name: dbs-good-question
skills.description_en: 把模糊提问改写成 Agent 可推理、可批评、可验证的问题说明书，并判断自动化可解程度。用户要改进问题表述、研究问题或评估 Agent 可解性时使用；任务交付目标已明确时不重复澄清目标。

zh.intro: 把模糊提问改写成 Agent 能推理、能批评、能验证的问题说明书，并判断这件事能自动化到什么程度。先钉现象，把「为什么我做不好」换成可观察的事实；再暴露冲突，常见的有数据冲突（打开率正常但转化低）、行为冲突（说感兴趣但不付款）、预期冲突、资源冲突、约束冲突；然后补五类约束：对象、目标、变量、约束、反馈。信息不足时先说缺什么，给最多 3 个会改变判断的补充问题；断点已明确时可先给 1 到 2 个低置信候选解释，并写清成立时该看到什么信号。判断自动化程度时区分只能生成解释、能生成好解释、能解决问题三档，最后一档需要行动与反馈回流。
zh.usage: 提问太笼统时先让它把现象和冲突钉清楚，按它给的补充问题补齐，再看这项任务能交到 Agent 的哪一档。
zh.notes: 不替你做原因诊断和最终方案，任务目标已明确时不重复澄清；情绪、健康、法律、投资类不给专业意见。

skills.name: dart-resolve-package-conflicts
skills.description_en: Workflow for fixing package version conflicts. Use this when `pub get` fails due to incompatible package versions.

zh.intro: pub get 因为版本不兼容失败时的处理流程。Dart 靠 pubspec.yaml 里的版本约束而不是钉死版本，pubspec.lock 记实际解析结果保证可复现。先跑 dart pub outdated，看 Current、Upgradable、Resolvable 三列分辨能直接升的和要改约束才能升的，再用 dart pub upgrade 与 tighten 收敛下界；依赖一律用 caret 语法。
zh.usage: 排查顺序：`dart pub outdated` 看三列，`dart pub upgrade` 升可升的，`dart pub upgrade --tighten` 把下界收紧到实际版本；CI 里用 `dart pub get --enforce-lockfile` 锁定测试过的组合。
zh.notes: 改完约束要跑 `dart analyze` 复核破坏性 API 变更；实在解不开再考虑动 pubspec.lock，别一上来就删锁文件。

audits.summary: This skill provides workflow documentation for managing Dart package dependencies, updating packages, and resolving version conflicts safely without any security risks detected.

skills.name: dart-fix-runtime-errors
skills.description_en: Uses get_runtime_errors and lsp to fetch an active stack trace, locate the failing line, apply a fix, and verify resolution via hot_reload.

zh.intro: 修 Dart 的报错：定位失败行、改代码、再验证。正文重心落在静态分析的根因上——保持方法覆盖的参数逆变与返回值协变，泛型集合加显式类型标注，别把 List<dynamic> 赋给具体类型，避免 dynamic 隐式向下转换；空安全用 ?、感叹号与 required，确定先初始化才用 late；可恢复失败抓 Exception，编程 bug 类的 Error 不许抓。
zh.usage: 先用 `dart analyze . --fatal-infos` 把问题全捞出来再动手改；机械性问题交给 `dart fix --dry-run` 预览、`dart fix --apply` 落地。
zh.notes: 描述与正文有偏差：描述说走 get_runtime_errors 与 lsp 取调用栈、用 hot_reload 验证，正文实际只讲静态分析与 dart fix，没有这些工具的步骤。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard guidelines and workflows for resolving Dart static analysis errors using official Dart SDK tools. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: dart-collect-coverage

zh.intro: 用 coverage 包给 Dart 和 Flutter 项目跑测试并产出 LCOV 报告：先加 dev 依赖，再走自动脚本一步到位，或者手动开 VM service 收原始数据、再 format 成 lcov。正文还讲了 `// coverage:ignore-line` 这类行内忽略指令，以及格式化时加 --check-ignore 让忽略声明真的生效。适合接 CI 或给 review 看覆盖情况。
zh.usage: Dart 项目用 `dart pub add dev:coverage`，Flutter 用 `flutter pub add dev:coverage`；然后 `dart run coverage:test_with_coverage`，只跑部分包时把路径跟在 `--` 后面，产物默认落在 `coverage/lcov.info`。
zh.notes: coverage 要加在 dev_dependency 里，别塞进正式依赖；手动 VM service 那条路要求端口和 `.dart_tool/package_config.json` 路径对上，不然 format 会失败。

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions and examples for collecting code coverage in Dart and Flutter projects using the official coverage package. It follows standard development practices and utilizes legitimate ecosystem tools.

skills.name: dart-build-cli-app
skills.description_en: Architectural patterns, entrypoint structure, exit codes, stream routing, and subprocess spawning for Dart command-line interface (CLI) applications. Use when building CLI tools, console utilities, scripts, argument parsing with `package:args` (ArgParser or CommandRunner), handling exit codes, configuring executables in pubspec.yaml, spawning Dart subprocesses, or compiling native CLI binaries. Don't use for Flutter UI widgets, web applications, or standalone HTTP backend servers.

zh.intro: 写 Dart 命令行工具的工程规范：用 `CommandRunner` 做命令路由，`bin/` 只留很薄的入口，用 `exitCode` 而不是 `exit(N)` 以免打断异步收尾。另覆盖输出与诊断格式、`pubspec.yaml` 的 `executables:` 映射、单源版本号、缓存约定、信号与终端清理、子进程与 AOT 下的可执行路径陷阱，以及三种分发方式。
zh.usage: 新建项目用 `dart create -t console <package_name>`，再在 `pubspec.yaml` 的 `executables:` 里把命令名映射到 `bin/` 脚本。本地跑 `dart run <command>`，出独立二进制用 `dart compile exe bin/cli.dart -o <output_path>`。
zh.notes: 正文提醒：AOT 编译后 `Platform.resolvedExecutable` 指向应用自身二进制，拿它去调 `dart` 会自递归；`dart test`、`build_runner` 这类也一样。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard architectural guidelines, patterns, and code templates for building command-line interface (CLI) applications in Dart. No security vulnerabilities or malicious vectors were detected.

skills.name: dart-generate-test-mocks
skills.description_en: Define and generate mock objects for external dependencies using `package:mockito` and `build_runner`. Use when unit testing classes that depend on complex external services like APIs or databases.

zh.intro: 给依赖外部服务（HTTP API、数据库）的 Dart 类生成 mock 再写单测：先靠构造函数把外部依赖注入进来，用 @GenerateNiceMocks 标注要替身的类，跑 build_runner 生成 .mocks.dart，最后用 when 和 thenReturn 摆桩、用 verify 查调用次数。正文明确说优先用 nice mocks，别用会抛未摆桩异常的那种。
zh.usage: 装依赖 `dart pub add dev:test dev:mockito dev:build_runner`，加完注解跑 `dart run build_runner build`；测试里同步桩用 `when(mock.method()).thenReturn(value)`，异步改 `thenAnswer((_) async => value)`，最后 `dart test` 跑全套。
zh.notes: 生成的 `.mocks.dart` 是产物别手改；注解要写在测试文件里而不是源文件；URL 一律用 Uri 对象而不是字符串拼，否则 mock 匹配不上。

audits.summary: This skill provides standard guidelines and examples for unit testing and mock generation in Dart using mockito and build_runner. It follows official best practices for dependency injection and asynchronous testing.

skills.name: dart-migrate-to-checks-package
skills.description_en: Replace the usage of `expect` and similar functions from `package:matcher` to `package:checks` equivalents.

zh.intro: 把 Dart 测试从 `package:matcher` 的 `expect`/`expectLater` 迁到 `package:checks` 的 `check` 语法。逐条讲清迁移期的坑：集合相等要 `deepEquals`、`reason` 改名 `because`、正则改用 `matchesPattern`、`TypeMatcher.having` 换 `.has`、同步与异步 `throws` 区分、可空布尔、Map 键包含，并附 matcher 到 checks 的对照表和没有对应项的说明。
zh.usage: 先 `dart pub add dev:checks`，再用 `grep -rn "expect(" test/` 扫出待迁移文件。改文件时把 `import 'package:test/test.dart';` 换成 `package:test/scaffolding.dart` 加 `package:checks/checks.dart`；分批迁移可暂留 `package:test/expect.dart`。
zh.notes: 子集迁移时保留 `package:test/expect.dart` 只是过渡手段，别让它长期留在文件里；`package:matcher` 若被显式声明要移除。

audits.summary: The skill provides legitimate technical guidance for migrating Dart tests from the legacy matcher library to the modern checks library, using standard developer tools and patterns.
