zh.notes: 正文按原则、类型标注等分节，好写法与坏写法并排对照。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive reference guide for Python best practices, idioms, and standard development tooling. It contains no malicious code, credential harvesting, or unauthorized network activity. All examples provided are standard industry practices for code quality and maintainability.

skills.name: django-verification

Use when preparing a Django pull request, validating migrations or coverage, or running pre-deploy readiness checks.

zh.intro: 发布前的 Django 自检流程：环境核对、静态检查、迁移安全、单元测试与覆盖率门槛、依赖与代码安全扫描、settings 与日志复查，最后过一遍改动差异。按阶段给出通过或不通过的结论，用来决定这个 PR 能不能发。
zh.usage: 准备提 Django 的 PR、改了模型迁移、或者要跑上线前检查时用。判断依据是项目为 Django 且需要一份逐阶段的通过或不通过报告；只想跑单个测试不必走这套。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive verification loop for Django projects, automating environment checks, linting, testing, and security scanning using standard industry tools.

skills.name: regex-vs-llm-structured-text
skills.description_en: Decision framework for parsing structured text (quizzes, forms, invoices, receipts, tables) with a hybrid regex-first pipeline — regex extraction handles 95%+ cheaply, a confidence scorer flags low-confidence items, and an LLM validator fixes only the edge cases. Use when choosing between regex and LLM for text extraction, building a cheap document parser, or optimizing extraction cost and accuracy.

audits.summary: The skill provides a framework for structured text parsing using a hybrid regex and LLM approach. While functional, it is vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because it interpolates untrusted input text directly into LLM prompts without adequate boundary markers or sanitization.

skills.name: kotlin-testing
skills.description_en: Kotlin testing patterns with Kotest, MockK, coroutine testing, property-based testing, and Kover coverage. Follows TDD methodology with idiomatic Kotlin practices. Use when writing Kotlin tests with Kotest or MockK, or testing coroutines and checking coverage.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive and safe documentation for Kotlin testing patterns using standard industry tools like Kotest, MockK, and Kover. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access were detected.

skills.name: clickhouse-io
skills.description_en: ClickHouse database patterns, query optimization, analytics, and data engineering best practices for high-performance analytical workloads. Use when writing ClickHouse schemas or queries, or when an analytical query is too slow.

zh.intro: 面向 ClickHouse 的建表与查询写法：MergeTree 系列引擎怎么选、分区与排序键怎么排、聚合与窗口函数怎么写、物化视图与批量写入怎么用，以及慢查询怎么从 system.query_log 里查。
zh.usage: 写建表语句时先定引擎与分区：明细表用 `ENGINE = MergeTree()`，按 `PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(date)` 切月；写入走 `@clickhouse/client` 的批量 insert，查慢查询看 `system.query_log`。
zh.notes: 正文还讲了 ReplacingMergeTree、AggregatingMergeTree、投影与物化视图，并列出要避开的写法：SELECT *、FINAL、过多 JOIN、小批频繁写入。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard patterns, optimization techniques, and best practices for working with ClickHouse databases. No security risks or vulnerabilities were found.

skills.name: recipe-save-email-attachments
skills.description_en: Find Gmail messages with attachments and save them to a Google Drive folder.

zh.intro: 一条横跨 Gmail 和 Drive 的配方：先按带附件条件搜索邮件，取回消息详情拿到附件 id，下载附件，再用上传命令把文件放进指定 Drive 文件夹。四步都给出可直接替换占位符的命令。
zh.usage: 搜索用 `gws gmail users messages list --params '{"userId": "me", "q": "has:attachment from:client@example.com"}' --format table`，取详情后 `attachments get` 下载，再 `gws drive +upload --file ./attachment.pdf --parent FOLDER_ID`。
zh.notes: 需先加载 `gws-gmail` 和 `gws-drive`；上传前确认目标文件夹 ID，别把客户附件放进共享目录。

audits.summary: The skill is a safe automation recipe that demonstrates how to search for Gmail messages with attachments and save them to a Google Drive folder using the official Google Workspace (gws) CLI utility.

skills.name: gws-events-subscribe
skills.description_en: Google Workspace Events: Subscribe to Workspace events and stream them as NDJSON.

zh.intro: 订阅 Google Workspace 事件并以 NDJSON 逐条拉取：可指定目标资源 URI、事件类型和 GCP 项目，也能复用已有的 Pub/Sub 订阅。支持单次拉取、按间隔轮询、把每条事件写成独立 JSON 文件，以及退出时清理自己创建的资源。
zh.usage: 例：`gws events +subscribe --target '//chat.googleapis.com/spaces/SPACE' --event-types 'google.workspace.chat.message.v1.created' --project my-project`；只拉一次加 `--once`，要落盘加 `--cleanup --output-dir ./events`。
zh.notes: 正文把这条标成写命令，执行前要跟用户确认；不加 `--cleanup` 时 Pub/Sub 资源会留着以便重连，也会留下计费对象。

audits.summary: This skill provides a secure interface for subscribing to Google Workspace events using the gws CLI tool. It follows security best practices by referencing centralized auth/security rules and including safety warnings for state-changing commands.

skills.name: cost-aware-llm-pipeline
skills.description_en: Cost optimization patterns for LLM API usage — model routing by task complexity, budget tracking, retry logic, and prompt caching. Use when LLM spend needs to come down, or when routing tasks across model tiers and budgets.

zh.usage: 要在模型档位之间分流、给一批处理设预算上限、或者排查重试把成本放大时用。判断依据是讨论的是调用成本与路由策略，不是模型效果调优。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。分档规则与预算记法以正文为准。

audits.summary: The skill provides architectural patterns and code snippets for managing LLM costs and routing. It contains no executable code or security risks.

skills.name: vercel-react-best-practices

skills.name: recipe-sync-contacts-to-sheet
skills.description_en: Export Google Contacts directory to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

zh.intro: 把 Google 通讯录的域内目录导出成 Sheets：先调 People 的目录列举接口，`readMask` 只要姓名、邮箱、电话三个字段，来源限定为域内目录，一次拉 100 条；然后写表头，再一行一行追加。正文只有这三步命令，分页和去重没讲，也没有多余说明。
zh.usage: 拉通讯录用 `gws people people listDirectoryPeople` 带 `--format json`；写表用 `gws sheets +append` 带 `--range 'Contacts'` 和 `--values`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-people`、`gws-sheets`；正文没写分页，目录人数超过 `pageSize` 时要自己翻页。

audits.summary: This skill provides a recipe to export Google Contacts to a Google Sheet using the Google Workspace CLI (gws). It is a standard administrative task using vendor-provided tools and does not exhibit malicious behavior.

skills.name: cloud-run-basics
skills.description_en: Manages Cloud Run services, jobs, and worker pools. Use when you need to deploy applications responding to HTTP requests (services), run event-triggered or scheduled tasks (jobs), or handle always-on pull-based background processing (worker pools).

zh.intro: 在 Cloud Run 上部署三类资源：响应 HTTP 请求的服务、手动或定时跑完就退的作业、常驻拉取的后台工作池（如 Kafka、Pub/Sub、RabbitMQ 消费者）。含开启 API、部署、扩容和排错的命令行做法。
zh.usage: 要发服务、跑批任务、起常驻消费者时用。执行 gcloud、REST 或 MCP 命令前先读用量归因说明，并给终端里的 gcloud 加归因环境变量和 User-Agent 后缀；命令直接在终端跑，别写进生成的脚本或 Terraform。

audits.summary: This skill provides standard tools and documentation for managing Google Cloud Run resources. It follows official practices for deployment, infrastructure management via Terraform, and usage of vendor-provided client libraries. The skill includes security considerations related to managing deployment permissions and handling source code, which are inherent to the platform's functionality.

skills.name: agentic-engineering
skills.description_en: Operate as an agentic engineer using eval-first execution, decomposition, and cost-aware model routing. Use when planning or executing engineering work that agents will carry out end to end.

skills.name: persona-exec-assistant

zh.usage: 先加载 `gws-gmail`、`gws-calendar`、`gws-drive`、`gws-chat`；日常按 `gws workflow +standup-report` 到 `+meeting-prep` 再到分诊排期的顺序跑，收件箱精选用 `gws gmail +triage --max 10`，周一用 `gws calendar +agenda --week` 做周计划。
zh.notes: 正文要求动日历前先跟本人确认；`--format table` 只是方便扫读，不代表有权限控制。

audits.summary: The skill acts as an executive assistant using Google Workspace tools to manage emails, calendar, and communications. It is safe for its intended use, though it processes external content like emails and meeting descriptions which carries a minor risk of indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: recipe-compare-sheet-tabs
skills.description_en: Read data from two tabs in a Google Sheet to compare and identify differences.

zh.intro: 最短的一条配方：从同一个 Google 表格的两个页签各读一段范围，然后比对差异，适合月度数据这类结构相同、内容有变动的表。配方只负责把两份数据取出来。
zh.usage: 两次读取：`gws sheets +read --spreadsheet SHEET_ID --range "January!A1:D"` 与 `gws sheets +read --spreadsheet SHEET_ID --range "February!A1:D"`，再比较两份输出。
zh.notes: 需先加载 `gws-sheets`；差异判定、字段对齐和容差都得自己定，命令本身不会告诉你哪格变了。

skills.name: iterative-retrieval

zh.usage: 子代理跑出来的结论缺依据、要它改代码却找不到相关文件、或者需要反复追问同一件事时用。判断依据是一次检索的命中率明显偏低，缺的是上下文而不是任务描述本身。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。本条目只写适用场景和判断依据，未引用正文里的轮次划分与步骤。

audits.summary: The skill documentation describes a pattern for iterative context retrieval in multi-agent workflows. It does not contain executable code or malicious commands. However, the pattern relies on processing external codebase content without explicit boundary markers or sanitization, which creates a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: sdf

skills.name: recipe-reschedule-meeting
skills.description_en: Move a Google Calendar event to a new time and automatically notify all attendees.

zh.intro: 把 Calendar 上的会议挪到新时间，并自动通知所有参与者。三步：先用 agenda 找到那场会，再按 calendarId 和 eventId 取出详情确认没找错，最后用 patch 只改 start 和 end（带时区），并把通知开关设成全员，让系统把改期通知发出去。命令里的时间是占位日期，实际改期只需替换这两段。
zh.usage: 找会 `gws calendar +agenda`，取详情 `gws calendar events get`，改时间 `gws calendar events patch` 并把 `sendUpdates` 设为 `all`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-calendar`；正文用的是 `primary` 日历和 `America/New_York` 时区，换账套要一起改。

skills.name: research

Use it for "how does X work", "where is Y used", "what's the root cause of Z", "summarize this PR/log" style questions, and reach for it liberally before reading a pile of files inline.

zh.intro: 把「为了回答一个问题要翻一堆文件」的活儿派给子代理，自己只收回结论和支撑证据，让读进来的噪声留在子代理那边。适合查某段代码怎么工作、某个符号在哪些地方被调用、某个测试为什么挂、几千行的 PR 改了什么。正文给了判断标准：产出答案的成本远高于答案本身才值得派；并说明要用带搜索能力的模型起子代理，以及派几个、怎么派。
zh.usage: 遇到要读几十个文件或长日志才能回答的问题，先派子代理去查，只让它带回答案和引用来源。
zh.notes: 已知只需读两三个文件、只有一次搜索、或下一步就要动手改这些文件时别派，省不下上下文还多一轮延迟。

skills.name: architecture-decision-records

zh.intro: 把架构决策写成编号的 ADR 文件放进 docs/adr/：背景、备选方案、后果，外加一份索引 README。决策随写随记，不用等事后补文档，也不会只留在聊天记录里。

skills.description_en: Searches the Azure skills catalog and recommends installable agent skills by matching an Azure task to skill metadata and plugin installation guidance. WHEN: before starting any task that involves an Azure or Microsoft-cloud service, product, or data source, when no currently loaded skill or tool already covers it.

zh.intro: 动手碰任何 Azure 或微软云服务之前，先去官方技能目录里查有没有现成的：列插件目录、列每个插件下的技能、按 SKILL.md 的描述逐层筛掉不相关的，最后给出该装哪个插件以及对应的安装命令。目的是别在没加载对技能的情况下硬做，正文把这些步骤固定成四步。
zh.usage: 按四步来：从 GitHub Contents API 列插件目录，再列每个插件下的 skills，再读候选的 `SKILL.md` 描述筛一遍，最后读 `.plugin/plugin.json` 拿真实插件名，再给出安装命令。
zh.notes: 它会调 api.github.com 拉目录，网络不通就退化成按名字猜。插件名和插件目录名可能不一样，装之前必须读 plugin.json，别拿目录名拼命令。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates the discovery and installation of Azure-related agent skills from official Microsoft repositories. It includes standard practices for fetching catalog metadata and providing installation guidance for various agent platforms.

skills.name: persona-sales-ops
skills.description_en: Manage sales workflows — track deals, schedule calls, client comms.

audits.summary: The skill defines a sales operations persona using Google Workspace tools. No malicious code or hidden patterns were detected. It possesses a standard indirect prompt injection surface common to agents that process external data such as emails and spreadsheets.

skills.name: continuous-agent-loop
skills.description_en: Patterns for continuous autonomous agent loops with quality gates, evals, and recovery controls. Use when running an agent loop that must self-check, gate on evals, and recover from failures.

audits.summary: This skill serves as a documentation-only resource, providing architectural patterns for autonomous agent loops. It contains no executable code, scripts, network operations, or sensitive commands, and presents no security risk.

skills.name: laravel-verification
skills.description_en: Verification loop for Laravel projects: env checks, linting, static analysis, tests with coverage, security scans, and deployment readiness. Use when verifying a Laravel project before merge or deploy — lint, static analysis, tests, coverage, security.

audits.summary: The skill provides a standard and secure set of verification steps for Laravel projects, including linting, testing, and deployment checks.

skills.name: persona-customer-support
skills.description_en: Manage customer support — track tickets, respond, escalate issues.

audits.summary: This skill defines a customer support persona that integrates with Google Workspace tools to manage tickets and communications. No malicious patterns were detected. It handles external data from emails, which is a standard operational requirement for this use case.

skills.name: recipe-log-deal-update
skills.description_en: Append a deal status update to a Google Sheets sales tracking spreadsheet.

audits.summary: The skill automates the process of logging sales deal updates into a Google Sheets spreadsheet using the Google Workspace (gws) toolset. It facilitates finding the target file, reading pipeline data, and appending new records. It is generally safe but includes a low-risk vulnerability for indirect prompt injection as it ingests and processes data from external spreadsheets.

skills.name: content-hash-cache-pattern
skills.description_en: Cache expensive file processing results using SHA-256 content hashes — path-independent, auto-invalidating, with service layer separation. Use when repeated file processing is slow and results should be cached and invalidated by content rather than path.

audits.summary: The skill provides a design pattern for content-hash-based caching in Python, using SHA-256 for integrity and JSON for safe serialization. It follows best practices for file processing and memory management. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: persona-event-coordinator
skills.description_en: Plan and manage events — scheduling, invitations, and logistics.

audits.summary: The skill is safe and functions as an event coordinator persona using Google Workspace commands without any security risks detected.

skills.name: urdf
skills.description_en: URDF robot description authoring and validation. Use when creating, editing, inspecting, validating, or debugging `.urdf` files, robot links, joints, limits, inertials, visual/collision geometry, mesh references, frame conventions, or robot-description artifacts. Use the SRDF skill for MoveIt2 semantic groups and IK/path-planning semantics; use the CAD skill for STEP/STL/3MF/DXF/GLB outputs. Open and visually review existing URDF files in CAD Viewer.

zh.intro: 写和检查 URDF 机器人描述文件的技能：link、joint、限位、惯性、视觉与碰撞几何、mesh 引用和坐标系约定，既用于从零写模型，也用于排查加载失败或姿态错乱。语义分组和运动规划语义交给 SRDF 技能，CAD 导出交给 CAD 技能。
zh.usage: 要写 .urdf、调关节限位和惯性，或排查模型加载报错时用它；先确认问题在描述文件还是在规划语义那边。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令与工具以正文为准；正文把 SRDF 与 CAD 相关需求划给别的技能。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates the authoring and validation of URDF robot description files. It uses the cadgen utility (a vendor-provided tool) via the uv package runner for validation, snapshot rendering, and local visualization. It also supports the use of Python helper scripts for mathematical computations related to link inertials and mass properties.

skills.name: quality-nonconformance
skills.description_en: Quality control and non-conformance management for regulated manufacturing (FDA 21 CFR 820, IATF 16949, AS9100): NCR lifecycle and disposition, 5-Why/Ishikawa/fault-tree/8D root cause analysis, CAPA systems, SPC interpretation, AQL sampling, and supplier quality audits. Use when investigating non-conformances, performing root cause analysis, managing CAPAs, interpreting SPC data, or handling supplier quality issues.

audits.summary: The skill is a non-executable knowledge base and persona definition for quality engineering in regulated manufacturing environments. It contains no code, commands, or network operations, and no security threats were identified.

skills.name: production-scheduling
skills.description_en: Codified expertise for production scheduling, job sequencing, line balancing, changeover optimization, and bottleneck resolution in discrete and batch manufacturing. Informed by production schedulers with 15+ years experience. Includes TOC/drum-buffer-rope, SMED, OEE analysis, disruption response frameworks, and ERP/MES interaction patterns. Use when scheduling production, resolving bottlenecks, optimizing changeovers, responding to disruptions, or balancing manufacturing lines.

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive framework for production scheduling and manufacturing operations. It is purely instructional and does not contain any executable code, network operations, or sensitive data access.

skills.name: seo-geo
skills.description_en: Audit and improve content for AI Overviews and answer engines, including citability, entity clarity, crawler access, brand signals, and passage structure.

audits.summary: The skill performs SEO and GEO audits by analyzing content from user-provided URLs. It is susceptible to indirect prompt injection because it processes untrusted external data without using boundary markers. Additionally, it executes a local script to retrieve SEO core update information, which is a core part of its functionality.

skills.name: enterprise-agent-ops
skills.description_en: Operational controls for long-lived or cloud-hosted agent systems — runtime lifecycle (start, pause, stop, restart), observability (logs, metrics, traces), least-privilege safety scopes and kill switches, and rollout/rollback change management with audit logs and success/cost metrics. Use when running production agent fleets on PM2, systemd, or containers that need monitoring, incident response, or deployment gates.

audits.summary: The skill provides operational guidelines and best practices for managing long-lived agents. It contains no executable code and advocates for security controls like least-privilege and secret management. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: review
skills.description_en: Review a vendor agreement, NDA, or SaaS subscription against your playbook. Identifies the agreement structure from titles, routes to the right review skill (vendor-agreement-review, nda-review, saas-msa-review), and integrates the output into a single memo. Use when the user says "review this contract", "check this MSA", "is this NDA okay", "look at this SaaS agreement", or attaches an inbound agreement for review.

audits.summary: This skill facilitates the review of legal documents by routing them to specialized sub-skills based on their content. It includes some security considerations regarding the ingestion of external data and local file system access for configuration. These patterns are consistent with the skill's intended use in a legal workflow. See the detailed analysis for more information.

skills.name: baoyu-format-markdown
skills.description_en: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

audits.summary: The skill is functional and generally safe, but it contains an indirect prompt injection surface because it reads and processes arbitrary user-supplied documents without explicit boundary delimiters or content isolation.

skills.name: google-cloud-waf-cost-optimization
skills.description_en: Evaluates Google Cloud workloads for cost efficiency and FinOps alignment using the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework Cost Optimization pillar. Use when the user asks to analyze Google Cloud spend, reduce cloud bills, rightsize resources (for example, Compute, GKE, Storage, Databases), evaluate discount options (for example, CUDs, SUDs, Spot VMs), or eliminate idle capacity. Do not use for standalone product pricing lookups or non-cost architecture design.

zh.intro: 按 Google Cloud 架构框架的成本优化支柱评估工作负载：分析账单构成、判断计算、集群、存储与数据库资源是否过大，比较承诺折扣与竞价方案，清理闲置容量，给出可执行的降本方向。
zh.usage: 用户要求分析 Google Cloud 花费、降低账单、给资源调规格、评估折扣或竞价实例、清理闲置资源时使用；单纯查产品价格或做与成本无关的架构设计不适用。
zh.notes: 本地没有抓到该技能正文，用法按目录描述整理。

audits.summary: This skill provides architectural guidance for Google Cloud cost optimization based on the Well-Architected Framework. It is a consultative resource that does not contain executable code or sensitive operations.

skills.name: foundation-models-on-device
skills.description_en: Apple FoundationModels framework for on-device LLM — text generation, guided generation with @Generable, tool calling, and snapshot streaming in iOS 26+. Use when adding on-device LLM features with Apple FoundationModels on iOS 26+.

audits.summary: The skill provides technical documentation and Swift code examples for integrating Apple's on-device FoundationModels framework in iOS. No security risks or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: skill-vetter
skills.description_en: Security-first vetting for OpenClaw skills. Use before installing any skill from ClawHub, GitHub, or other sources.

audits.summary: This skill is a security vetting tool designed to help users audit other agent skills for malicious patterns. It operates with minimal permissions (read-only) and lacks network or command execution capabilities, making it safe for its intended purpose of identifying risks in external skill files.

skills.name: sendcutsend
skills.description_en: Review DXF and STEP/STP uploads for SendCutSend.com orders using its ordering guide, catalog, and specs. Use only for SendCutSend.com preflight reports covering upload readiness, selected material/SKU/thickness/service availability, and service-specific checks for laser cutting, CNC routing, bending, tapping, countersinking, hardware insertion, and finishing.

audits.summary: This skill is designed to validate CAD files (DXF and STEP) against official manufacturing specifications from SendCutSend.com. It fetches reference data from official domains and uses standard geometry libraries for local inspection. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: carrier-relationship-management
skills.description_en: Manage truckload, LTL, and intermodal carrier portfolios: sourcing and FMCSA vetting, freight rate and fuel-surcharge negotiation, RFPs and routing guides, carrier scorecards, allocation, and renewals. Use when onboarding carriers, running freight RFPs, negotiating rates, evaluating carrier performance, reallocating freight, or building freight strategy.

audits.summary: The skill provides a detailed instructional framework for carrier relationship management, including vetting, negotiation, and performance tracking. It is purely informational and contains no code or security risks.

skills.name: ai-regression-testing
skills.description_en: Regression testing strategies for AI-assisted development. Sandbox-mode API testing without database dependencies, automated bug-check workflows, and patterns to catch AI blind spots where the same model writes and reviews code. Use when adding regression coverage to AI-assisted code, or when the same model both wrote and reviewed a change.

audits.summary: This skill provides automated regression testing patterns and workflows for AI-assisted development, focusing on catching common AI errors like sandbox/production mismatches and missing database fields. It contains no malicious code, remote downloads, or dangerous command executions.

skills.name: remotion-video-creation
skills.description_en: Best practices for Remotion - Video creation in React. 29 domain-specific rules covering 3D, animations, audio, captions, charts, transitions, and more. Use when building video in React with Remotion — animations, audio, captions, charts, or transitions.

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive set of rules and best practices for creating videos using the Remotion framework. It includes code for fetching dynamic properties and metadata from external URLs, which creates a potential surface for indirect prompt injection, though no malicious behavior was identified.

skills.name: recipe-create-vacation-responder
skills.description_en: Enable a Gmail out-of-office auto-reply with a custom message and date range.

audits.summary: The skill safely configures a Gmail vacation responder using the workspace CLI tool with no security risks identified.

skills.name: persona-project-manager
skills.description_en: Coordinate projects — track tasks, schedule meetings, and share docs.

zh.intro: 把 gws 的 Drive、Sheets、Calendar、Gmail、Chat 五个能力捏成一个「项目经理」角色：周初拉 standup 报告和周概览，项目进度记进表格，交付物传到 Drive 再发公告，定期会议排进日历，状态更新发给干系人。正文给的是几组固定套路串起这些命令，不是新实现的命令。
zh.usage: 周初先跑 `gws workflow +standup-report` 和 `gws workflow +weekly-digest`；分享交付物用 `gws workflow +file-announce`，记进度用 `gws sheets +append`；任何写操作前先加 `--dry-run` 预演。
zh.notes: 需先装好 gws-drive、gws-sheets、gws-calendar、gws-gmail、gws-chat 这几个子 skill；正文只有套路清单，具体参数各自看对应 skill。

audits.summary: The skill is a persona for project management that coordinates various Google Workspace tools. It is generally safe but is flagged for a potential indirect prompt injection surface as it ingests untrusted data from external sources like emails and files and has the capability to perform write operations.

skills.name: stitch::extract-design-md
skills.description_en: Extract a comprehensive design system (DESIGN.md) directly from frontend source code — React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, plain HTML/CSS, or any web framework. Analyzes component files, stylesheets, Tailwind configs, theme definitions, and design tokens to produce a rich, Stitch-compatible design system document. Use this skill whenever the user wants to reverse-engineer a design system from an existing codebase, audit the visual language of a project, extract design tokens from source files, or understand the styling patterns in a frontend repo — even if they just say "what does this app look like?" or "pull out the design from this code."

zh.intro: 从前端源码反向整理出一份设计系统文档：读组件文件、样式表、Tailwind 配置、主题定义和设计 token，归纳出配色、字体、间距、圆角这类规则，产出能被 Stitch 读的文档。React、Vue、Svelte、Angular 和纯 HTML/CSS 都在处理范围内。
zh.usage: 接手陌生前端仓库想快速知道它长什么样、要把散落的样式收成 token 清单、或者改造前留一份视觉基线时用。判断依据是源码在手且要的是文档，不是改代码。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。产出文件的命名与结构以正文为准。

audits.summary: This skill analyzes local frontend source code to extract design system specifications into a markdown file. It uses standard file and shell operations to perform this analysis. No malicious behaviors, exfiltration patterns, or obfuscation techniques were detected.

skills.name: visa-doc-translate
skills.description_en: Translate visa document images (bank deposit, employment, income, and retirement certificates; HEIC, PNG, or JPG) into English via OCR and produce a bilingual PDF pairing the original image with a formatted certified-style translation. Use when a visa application needs a document translated to English, an official certificate OCR'd and translated, or a bilingual translation PDF for immigration paperwork.

audits.summary: The skill automates the translation of sensitive visa documents by using OCR and generating PDF reports. While functional, it possesses a surface for indirect prompt injection from document text and utilizes dynamic script execution to create output files.

skills.name: nestjs-patterns
skills.description_en: NestJS architecture patterns for modules, controllers, providers, DTO validation, guards, interceptors, config, and production-grade TypeScript backends. Use when building or reviewing a NestJS backend — modules, providers, DTO validation, guards, or interceptors.

audits.summary: This skill provides standard, high-quality development patterns for NestJS applications. It focuses on modular architecture, robust input validation, and secure defaults for TypeScript backends. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: rules-distill
skills.description_en: Scan skills to extract cross-cutting principles and distill them into rules — append, revise, or create new rule files. Use when the same principle keeps recurring across skills and belongs in a rule file instead.

audits.summary: The skill automates the extraction of cross-cutting principles from multiple AI agent skills to update or create shared rule files. It uses local bash scripts to inventory files and requires manual user approval for all filesystem modifications, providing a safe management workflow.

skills.name: logistics-exception-management
skills.description_en: Codified freight-exception handling expertise for shipment delays, damages, losses, shortages, and carrier disputes, with escalation protocols, carrier-specific behaviors by mode, claims procedures, and eat-the-cost vs fight-the-claim judgment frameworks. Use when handling shipping exceptions, freight claims, delivery issues, or carrier disputes.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive guide for handling logistics exceptions such as shipping damages or delays. It consists entirely of text-based instructions and decision frameworks without any executable code, external scripts, or network requests. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: returns-reverse-logistics
skills.description_en: Codified expertise for returns authorization, receipt and inspection, disposition decisions, refund processing, fraud detection, and warranty claims management. Informed by returns operations managers with 15+ years experience. Includes grading frameworks, disposition economics, fraud pattern recognition, and vendor recovery processes. Use when handling product returns, reverse logistics, refund decisions, return fraud detection, or warranty claims.

audits.summary: The skill provides a professional framework for handling returns, reverse logistics, and fraud detection. It consists entirely of instructional markdown content and contains no executable code or security risks.

skills.name: swift-protocol-di-testing
skills.description_en: Protocol-based dependency injection for testable Swift code — mock file system, network, and external APIs using focused protocols and Swift Testing. Use when Swift code needs testing and file system, network, or external APIs must be mocked.

audits.summary: The skill provides educational patterns and code snippets for implementing protocol-based dependency injection in Swift. It contains no executable code, external dependencies, or security risks.

skills.name: dmux-workflows
skills.description_en: Multi-agent orchestration using dmux (tmux pane manager for AI agents). Patterns for parallel agent workflows across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other harnesses. Use when running multiple agent sessions in parallel or coordinating multi-agent development workflows.

audits.summary: The skill provides patterns for multi-agent orchestration using tmux and git worktrees. It features a helper script that executes commands defined in a JSON configuration file, which creates an indirect prompt injection surface if the configuration is sourced from untrusted inputs.

skills.name: team-builder
skills.description_en: Interactive picker that discovers available agent personas via the claude agents command and agents/ markdown globs, groups them into domains, has the user select up to five, dispatches them in parallel on one task, and synthesizes agreements and conflicts into a unified report. Use when composing a team of agents, browsing available agent personas, or running several specialist agents in parallel.

audits.summary: This skill acts as a workflow orchestrator that discovers and executes local agent personas. While it provides useful utility for managing multi-agent teams, it lacks sanitization for the content of the agent files it processes, creating a surface for indirect prompt injection if malicious files are present in the discovery path.

skills.name: deepstream-sop
skills.description_en: Use this skill when building, deploying, evaluating, debugging, or measuring latency for the DeepStream SOP Inference Microservice — a GPU-accelerated FastAPI service that detects whether operators perform assembly-line steps in order via event boundary detection (GEBD) plus VLM classification. Trigger even if the user does not name it: verify operator step sequence, detect missing or out-of-order SOP steps, score factory/work-cell video for procedure compliance, run VLM-based SOP checking on industrial cameras, or call /v1/chat/completions with a file, RTSP, or Basler camera. Also trigger for its internals: SOPVideoProcessor, DeepStream GEBD model (e.g. DDM) via Triton CAPI, nvds_custom_postprocess, Cosmos Reason 1/2 vLLM, SSE streaming, Kafka NvProto/JSON output, Basler/Pylon camera + emulation, Docker compose, chunk-level latency. Do NOT trigger for generic DeepStream pipelines, object detection/tracking, NIM imports, or video summarization.

audits.summary: This skill provides a framework for building an industrial SOP monitoring microservice. It uses multi-stage processing, including Vision-Language Models and custom logic. Security observations include dynamic code generation based on configuration files, execution of build scripts via subprocess, and reliance on external research repositories for model weights and code.

skills.name: baoyu-compress-image
skills.description_en: Compresses images to WebP (default) or PNG with automatic tool selection. Use when user asks to "compress image", "optimize image", "convert to webp", or reduce image file size.

audits.summary: A utility skill for compressing images into WebP, PNG, or JPEG formats using system tools or the Sharp library. It follows security best practices for command execution and file handling.

skills.name: customs-trade-compliance
skills.description_en: Codified customs and trade compliance expertise — HS/HTS tariff classification with GRI rules, commercial invoices and entry documentation, Incoterms 2020, FTA qualification and duty optimization (USMCA, RCEP, FTZs, drawback), denied-party screening, and penalty mitigation across US, EU, UK, and APAC jurisdictions. Use when classifying goods, preparing import/export documentation, screening restricted parties, responding to customs audits or CF-28/penalty notices, or optimizing duties.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive instructional guide for simulating a senior trade compliance specialist role. It contains purely informational content and procedural guidelines with no executable code, scripts, or network operations, posing no security risk.

skills.name: ralphinho-rfc-pipeline
skills.description_en: Split an RFC into a multi-agent execution DAG — decompose into work units with dependencies and acceptance tests, run research, plan, implement, test, and review per unit, then merge through a queue with re-based branches and final system verification. Use when a feature is too large for a single agent pass, orchestrating RFC-driven multi-agent execution, or managing merge queues across agent-built units.

audits.summary: The skill is a process-oriented documentation file that describes a workflow for multi-agent task execution. It contains no executable code, scripts, or tool calls, and does not pose any security risks.

skills.name: energy-procurement
skills.description_en: Procure electricity and natural gas for commercial and industrial facilities: tariff and rate-schedule optimization, demand-charge mitigation, supplier RFPs, fixed/index/block-and-index hedging, renewable PPA and REC evaluation, and sustainability reporting. Use when procuring energy, optimizing utility tariffs, managing demand charges, evaluating PPAs, or building energy budgets and hedge strategies.

audits.summary: No security issues were detected. The skill is a comprehensive knowledge base and set of role-playing instructions for energy procurement and contains no executable code or malicious patterns.

skills.name: click-path-audit
skills.description_en: Trace every user-facing button/touchpoint through its full state change sequence to find bugs where functions individually work but cancel each other out, produce wrong final state, or leave the UI in an inconsistent state. Use when: systematic debugging found no bugs but users report broken buttons, or after any major refactor touching shared state stores.

audits.summary: The skill provides a manual and structured blueprint for diagnosing and auditing sequential code states and race conditions within user interfaces. It does not introduce code patterns, prompt overrides, or configuration bypasses.

skills.name: healthcare-phi-compliance
skills.description_en: Protected Health Information (PHI) and PII compliance patterns for healthcare applications: data classification, row-level access control, tamper-proof audit trails, schema tagging, and common leak vectors such as logs, URLs, and browser storage. Use when code touches patient or clinician data, when implementing HIPAA or GDPR access controls, or when auditing a healthcare system for data exposure.

audits.summary: The skill provides instructional patterns and documentation for Healthcare PHI/PII compliance. No security issues were detected as the content consists of educational code snippets and guidelines for secure data handling.

skills.name: swift-concurrency-6-2
skills.description_en: Swift 6.2 Approachable Concurrency — single-threaded by default, @concurrent for explicit background offloading, isolated conformances for main actor types. Use when adopting Swift 6.2 concurrency — offloading with @concurrent or resolving main-actor isolation.

audits.summary: This skill is a documentation resource providing patterns and best practices for Swift 6.2 concurrency features. It contains only educational markdown content with no executable code, network operations, or security risks.

skills.name: nuxt4-patterns
skills.description_en: Nuxt 4 app patterns for hydration safety, performance, route rules, lazy loading, and SSR-safe data fetching with useFetch and useAsyncData. Use when building or reviewing a Nuxt 4 app, or debugging hydration mismatches and SSR-safe data fetching.

audits.summary: The skill provides architectural patterns and best practices for building applications with Nuxt 4. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: council
skills.description_en: Convene a four-voice council for ambiguous decisions, tradeoffs, and go/no-go calls. Use when multiple valid paths exist and you need structured disagreement before choosing.

audits.summary: The skill provides a structured decision-making framework using multiple AI perspectives to surface tradeoffs and risks. It includes safety-conscious instructions regarding subagent isolation and persistence of data through official channels.

skills.name: nanoclaw-repl
skills.description_en: Operate and extend NanoClaw, ECC's zero-dependency session-aware REPL, with persistent markdown-backed sessions and slash commands for model switching, skill loading, session branching, cross-session search, history compaction, and export. Use when running or extending scripts/claw.js, or when resuming, branching, compacting, searching, or exporting a NanoClaw session.

audits.summary: The skill provides operational guidance for a local session-aware REPL. No security risks, malicious patterns, or external dependencies were identified.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description_en: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

audits.summary: This skill provides design and aesthetic guidelines for generating high-quality frontend code. It does not contain any executable code, perform network operations, or access sensitive data.

skills.name: santa-method
skills.description_en: Multi-agent adversarial verification: two independent reviewers with the same rubric must both pass before output ships, with a fix-and-re-review convergence loop and human escalation cap. Use when gating publishing, production deploys, compliance or brand-sensitive content, or hallucination-prone claims before they ship.

audits.summary: The skill implements a multi-agent verification framework. While architecturally sound, it is susceptible to indirect prompt injection because it processes untrusted generated content within the context of review agents without specific sanitization.

skills.name: ai-first-engineering
skills.description_en: Engineering operating model for teams where AI agents generate a large share of implementation output. Use when setting team process, review gates, or ownership rules for a codebase largely written by agents.

zh.intro: 给大部分实现由 AI 生成的团队定工程规则：谁负责哪块、评审卡在哪几道、流程怎么排。面向的是代码库主要由 agent 写出来的情况，不是偶尔用一下补全。
zh.usage: 团队里 AI 写的代码占比已经很高，要定评审关卡、归属和流程时用；想查出流程里哪些地方还按人写代码的假设设计时也用。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。

skills.name: flutter-use-http-package
skills.description_en: Use the `http` package to execute GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE requests. Use when you need to fetch from or send data to a REST API.

zh.intro: 用 http 包把 GET、POST、PUT、DELETE 发出去，并把响应映射成强类型 Dart 对象。正文按顺序给到四件事：装依赖与改平台权限、请求怎么带 header 与 JSON 负载、状态码怎么判、以及把重解析丢到后台 isolate。适合要给 Flutter 应用接 REST API、又不想自己重写一遍错误处理的人。
zh.usage: 先 `flutter pub add http`，在 Dart 文件里 `import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;`；URL 一律走 `Uri.parse('your_url')`，POST 与 PUT 的 body 用 `jsonEncode()` 编码；解析重就把 `compute(parsePhotos, response.body)` 丢到后台 isolate。
zh.notes: 漏配置会直接失败：Android 要在 AndroidManifest.xml 里加 INTERNET 权限，macOS 要在 DebugProfile.entitlements 与 Release.entitlements 里都加 network client 键。状态码只把 200 与 201 当成功。

audits.summary: This skill provides standard instructions and examples for implementing REST API requests in Flutter using the official `http` package. It follows development best practices for networking, permissions, and performance.

skills.name: ckm:ui-styling

It uses standard development tools and vendor-owned scripts to process project files and upload them to a centralized design system.

skills.name: google-cloud-waf-reliability

audits.summary: The skill acts as an automated forge/factory that helps AI agents create reusable Skill packages containing custom web scraping and automation configurations (SKILL.md and Python script wrappers) by leveraging the `browser-act` tool to explore websites. It follows normal developer tool logic, restricts data to the user's local machine, and operates safely within standard authorization limits without incorporating any malicious patterns, prompt injections, or unauthorized data exfiltration.
