skills.name: planning-with-files-zh
skills.description_en: 用于多步骤 AI 代理工作的持久化文件规划系统。将 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md 保存在磁盘上，生命周期钩子会注入选定的项目规划上下文。自动恢复只读取项目规划文件。只有显式运行 session-catchup.py --metadata 才会检查本机同项目的会话元数据；--replay 可输出有长度限制且由 nonce 框定的同项目摘录。可选门禁仅在宿主支持时请求继续，绝不执行 Markdown 中声明的命令。本技能没有网络上传路径。适用于研究或需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作。触发词：任务规划、项目计划、制定计划、分解任务、多步骤规划、进度跟踪、文件规划、帮我规划、拆解项目

zh.intro: 把多步骤工作的计划落到磁盘上：task_plan.md 记任务拆解，findings.md 存调研结果，progress.md 记进度；生命周期钩子在提示提交和工具调用前后把选中的规划内容注入上下文。续跑时只读项目内的规划文件，只有显式运行 session-catchup.py 加 --metadata 才会去碰本机会话元数据。适合需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作。
zh.usage: 提到任务规划、拆项目、多步骤立项或进度跟踪时加载；先建 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件，按步回写，下一轮会话先读它们再动手。
zh.notes: 同一套模板覆盖 11 种 IDE 与语言变体；钩子脚本找不到时会提示一次并关闭注入，可用 PWF_SCRIPT_DIR 指到 scripts 目录。没有网络上传路径。

audits.summary: This skill implements a localized persistence system for multi-step AI planning. It manages local Markdown files and includes advanced security features such as SHA-256 plan attestation to prevent unauthorized context injection and robust framing with nonces to mitigate indirect prompt injection risks.

skills.name: gitops-workflow
skills.description_en: Implement GitOps workflows with ArgoCD and Flux for automated, declarative Kubernetes deployments with continuous reconciliation. Use when implementing GitOps practices, automating Kubernetes deployments, or setting up declarative infrastructure management.

zh.intro: 用 ArgoCD 或 Flux 做声明式 Kubernetes 持续交付：期望状态放进 Git，由代理自动拉取并持续对账。覆盖集群接入、仓库目录结构、应用定义、自动同步策略、多集群与渐进发布，以及 GitOps 下的密钥管理。
zh.usage: 搭 GitOps 时先按 OpenGitOps 四条原则核对：声明式、版本化不可变、自动拉取、持续对账；ArgoCD 的安装命令与初始密码取法在正文代码块里，细节看 `references/argocd-setup.md`。
zh.notes: 正文用一份 gitops-repo 目录样例说明 apps、infrastructure 与 argocd 三类内容该怎么放，并指向更细的搭建文档。

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive guide for implementing GitOps workflows using ArgoCD and Flux CD. It includes standard installation procedures, configuration manifests, and secret management best practices. All external downloads and remote execution patterns target official, well-known project domains and repositories associated with established Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) projects.

skills.name: google-workspace-ops
skills.description_en: Operate across Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides as one workflow surface for plans, trackers, decks, and shared documents. Use when the user needs to find, summarize, edit, migrate, or clean up Google Workspace assets without dropping to raw tool calls.

audits.summary: The skill provides a specialized workflow for Google Workspace operations. It does not contain malicious code or unauthorized access patterns. It is flagged as LOW due to the inherent indirect prompt injection surface associated with reading and processing user documents.

skills.name: openclaw-persona-forge
skills.description_en: 为 OpenClaw AI Agent 锻造完整的龙虾灵魂方案。根据用户偏好或随机抽卡， 输出身份定位、灵魂描述(SOUL.md)、角色化底线规则、名字和头像生图提示词。 如当前环境提供已审核的生图 skill，可自动生成统一风格头像图片。 当用户需要创建、设计或定制 OpenClaw 龙虾灵魂时使用。 不适用于：微调已有 SOUL.md、非 OpenClaw 平台的角色设计、纯工具型无性格 Agent。 触发词：龙虾灵魂、虾魂、OpenClaw 灵魂、养虾灵魂、龙虾角色、龙虾定位、 龙虾剧本杀角色、龙虾游戏角色、龙虾 NPC、龙虾性格、龙虾背景故事、 lobster soul、lobster character、抽卡、随机龙虾、龙虾 SOUL、gacha。 Use when creating, designing, or customizing an OpenClaw lobster persona — identity, SOUL.md, name, or avatar prompt.

audits.summary: The skill is a creative utility for generating character persona files (SOUL.md and IDENTITY.md). It uses a local Python script for random attribute generation and follows standard practices for file creation and external skill interaction. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: terminal-ops
skills.description_en: Evidence-first repo execution workflow for ECC. Use when the user wants a command run, a repo checked, a CI failure debugged, or a narrow fix pushed with exact proof of what was executed and verified.

audits.summary: This skill defines a secure workflow for repository operations, debugging, and code fixes. It emphasizes an evidence-first approach with clear safety guardrails, including pre-modification inspections and avoiding destructive commands. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: fullstack-developer
skills.description_en: Modern web development expertise covering React, Node.js, databases, and full-stack architecture. Use when: building web applications, developing APIs, creating frontends, setting up databases, deploying web apps, or when user mentions React, Next.js, Express, REST API, GraphQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or full-stack development.

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive set of instructions for a Full-Stack Developer persona. It follows industry best practices and contains no malicious code, obfuscation, or security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: recall
skills.description_en: Search agentmemory for past observations, sessions, and learnings about a topic using hybrid BM25 plus vector plus graph search. Use when the user says "recall", "what did we do about", "did we ever", "have we seen", or needs context from past sessions.

zh.intro: 在 agentmemory 里按主题检索过去的观察、会话与经验，走 BM25 加向量加图谱的混合检索；只呈现工具真正返回的记录，查不到就直说，不编会话号也不编重要度。
zh.usage: 调用 `memory_smart_search`，query 用用户原话、limit 一般给 10；要引用全文或说明出处时再带上选中 id 展开，作用域按 project 或 agentId 收窄。
zh.notes: 结果是相关命中，不是全量清单；重要度低的条目别抬到结论前面，扩展失败要说明这条限制。

audits.summary: The skill provides a mechanism for searching and retrieving past agent observations and sessions from a memory tool. Analysis reveals no malicious patterns or security risks.

skills.name: hipaa-compliance
skills.description_en: HIPAA-specific entrypoint for healthcare privacy and security work. Use when a task is explicitly framed around HIPAA, PHI handling, covered entities, BAAs, breach posture, or US healthcare compliance requirements.

audits.summary: This skill serves as a set of instructional guardrails for handling HIPAA-regulated healthcare data. It provides safety protocols for Protected Health Information (PHI) management and auditability without introducing any executable code or network risks.

skills.name: opencli-adapter-author
skills.description_en: Build or improve an OpenCLI JS adapter using observed site behavior, existing adapters and browser API evidence. For ad-hoc browser interaction, see opencli-browser.

audits.summary: The skill provides a detailed framework for creating web adapters, including reconnaissance, API discovery, and data decoding. It incorporates strong security practices such as advice on redacting sensitive data, using synthetic fixtures, and validating network contracts.

skills.name: devops-engineer
skills.description_en: Creates Dockerfiles, configures CI/CD pipelines, writes Kubernetes manifests, and generates Terraform/Pulumi infrastructure templates. Handles deployment automation, GitOps configuration, incident response runbooks, and internal developer platform tooling. Use when setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications, managing infrastructure as code, deploying to Kubernetes clusters, configuring cloud platforms, automating releases, or responding to production incidents. Invoke for pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, Terraform, GitHub Actions, on-call, or platform engineering.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive DevOps assistant designed for CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and site reliability engineering (SRE) tasks. It includes templates for powerful automation scripts and deployment strategies. Security measures like mandatory user approval for production changes and strict secrets management are explicitly defined. All identified behaviors align with the intended DevOps role and follow industry best practices.

skills.name: gan-style-harness
skills.description_en: GAN-inspired Generator-Evaluator agent harness for building high-quality applications autonomously. Based on Anthropic's March 2026 harness design paper. Use when a feature should be built autonomously through generator and evaluator iteration until it clears a quality bar.

audits.summary: This skill defines a multi-agent orchestration harness for autonomous software development. It uses an adversarial 'Generator-Evaluator' loop to improve code quality. Security considerations are limited to the standard risks of autonomous coding agents, specifically the execution of shell commands and the potential for indirect prompt injection via the project files it processes.

skills.name: social-graph-ranker
skills.description_en: Weighted social-graph ranking for warm intro discovery, bridge scoring, and network gap analysis across X and LinkedIn. Use when the user wants the reusable graph-ranking engine itself, not the broader outreach or network-maintenance workflow layered on top of it.

audits.summary: The social-graph-ranker skill is a mathematical engine used to score social connections for outreach. It contains only instructional content and scoring logic, with no executable code or security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description_en: CrewAI architecture decisions and project scaffolding. Use when starting a new crewAI project, choosing between LLM.call() vs Agent.kickoff() vs Crew.kickoff() vs Flow, scaffolding with 'crewai create flow', setting up YAML config (agents.yaml, tasks.yaml), wiring @CrewBase crew.py, writing Flow main.py with @start/@listen, building experimental conversational Flows with handle_turn()/chat(), or using {variable} interpolation.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive technical guide for the CrewAI framework, detailing project scaffolding, architecture, and tool integration. It contains no malicious code, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access. The external resources, such as MCP servers and CLI commands, are standard for the platform and originate from trusted or well-known organizations.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description_en: Review the changed lines of a single file in a pull request for bugs, correctness, error handling, security, and maintainability, and return structured findings.

audits.summary: This skill provides a code review framework for Cloudflare Workers, using standard static analysis tools and promoting secure coding practices. While it processes external code, which is a potential surface for indirect instructions, its use of localized linting and type-checking is consistent with safe development workflows.

skills.name: transitions-polish
skills.description_en: Polish and refine existing motion against the transitions.dev motion-token scale — duration, distance, scale, blur, and easing — plus the rules for WHEN each token applies (open/close asymmetry, hover-in vs hover-out, stagger offsets, and intent delays). An add-on to the transitions-dev skill, focused on tuning what already animates rather than adding new transitions. Use when the user asks to "polish my transitions", "refine the motion", "tune the timing / easing", "make the animation feel better / less janky", "tighten the durations", "fix the stagger", "align to the motion tokens", "audit the motion", "review my animations", "scan for ad-hoc transitions", "tokenize my animations", or runs the commands transitions review or transitions polish. Also drives the Refine panel's Small refinement feature. Triggers on "motion polish", "transition polish", "refine motion", "timing feels off", "too slow / too fast", "stagger", "delay", "open close timing", "hover in out".

zh.intro: 按 transitions.dev 的运动刻度（时长、位移、缩放、模糊、缓动）校准已有动画，并说明每个刻度在什么场景用：开关不对称、悬停进出差别、错峰偏移、意图延迟。只调已经动起来的部分，不加新转场。
zh.usage: 动画已经写出来但节奏发飘、太慢太快、错峰和延迟不对时，按刻度对齐；想先审一遍哪里是手写参数再统一时也用。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。它是 transitions-dev 的附加技能，管调参不管新建动画。

audits.summary: The transitions-polish skill is a developer tool designed to audit and refine UI animations within a project. It scans source code for motion-related values (duration, easing, distance, etc.) and suggests or applies replacements using a standardized token set from transitions.dev. The skill operates locally on project files and requires user confirmation for edits. No malicious behavior or data exfiltration risks were identified.

skills.name: unified-notifications-ops
skills.description_en: Operate notifications as one ECC-native workflow across GitHub, Linear, desktop alerts, hooks, and connected communication surfaces. Use when the real problem is alert routing, deduplication, escalation, or inbox collapse.

audits.summary: The skill provides a framework for managing notification workflows across multiple platforms. It is purely instructional and contains no executable code, remote dependencies, or security risks.

skills.name: evm-token-decimals
skills.description_en: Prevent silent decimal mismatch bugs across EVM chains. Covers runtime decimal lookup, chain-aware caching, bridged-token precision drift, and safe normalization for bots, dashboards, and DeFi tools. Use when handling token amounts across EVM chains, or when a balance, price, or transfer amount is off by orders of magnitude.

audits.summary: This skill provides educational examples and best practices for handling EVM token decimals safely in development. It contains no executable code, external dependencies, or sensitive operations.

skills.name: remember
skills.description_en: Save an insight, decision, or learning to agentmemory's long-term storage with searchable concept tags. Use when the user says "remember this", "save this", "note that", "don't forget", or wants to preserve knowledge for future sessions.

zh.intro: 把一条结论、决定或经验存进长期记忆，并打上可检索的概念标签；保存时保留用户原话，标签取具体词组而不是泛化分类，方便以后按关键词找回来。
zh.usage: 用户说记住这个、存一下、别忘时使用；先从内容里抽出几个具体的小写概念词和涉及的文件路径，调保存接口，并回显用到的标签让用户知道按什么词能找回。
zh.notes: 要更正事实就整条重存，新记录会盖住旧记录但留在版本链里；标签太泛会导致以后检索不到。

audits.summary: The skill functions as a memory management utility for storing user-provided insights. It identifies a minor risk of indirect prompt injection because it ingests and persists untrusted user input into long-term storage without explicit sanitization or instruction-data separation markers.

skills.name: design-agent
skills.description_en: CrewAI agent design and configuration. Use when creating, configuring, or debugging crewAI agents — choosing role/goal/backstory, selecting LLMs, assigning tools, tuning max_iter/max_rpm/max_execution_time, enabling planning/delegation, setting up knowledge sources, using guardrails, or configuring agents in YAML vs code.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive documentation and templates for designing CrewAI agents. It identifies capabilities for code execution and tool integration which are standard for the framework. A low-severity finding relates to the potential for indirect prompt injection in the provided code examples if they are used with untrusted inputs.

skills.name: readout
skills.description_en: Produce a polished, self-contained HTML "readout" document under ~/.readouts (with an auto-maintained index page), either by snapshotting the findings accumulated in the current conversation or — when invoked fresh, e.g. "/readout on how github webhook events are processed" — by sharpening scope with clarifying questions and researching the codebase before documenting. The work runs in a child agent so the main conversation's context stays clean. Use whenever the user invokes /readout, says "write this up", "turn this into a doc/page", "make a readout", or asks for a readable, shareable document capturing findings or explaining how something works.

zh.intro: 把一次调查变成能长期阅读的自包含 HTML 文档，放在 ~/.readouts 下并自动维护索引页。两种入口：对话进行到一半时把已有结论整理成文，或从零开始先提问收窄范围再研究代码库。写作在子代理里跑，不占主对话上下文。
zh.usage: 用户说写成文档、做个页面、生成 readout，或直接调用 /readout 时用。主代理只负责问清范围、给子代理一份好简报然后退出，挖掘和写作交给子代理。
zh.notes: 成品要让人几周后不看原对话也读得懂；索引页由技能自己维护，不用手工更新。

audits.summary: This skill provides a secure framework for generating self-contained HTML documentation ('readouts') from AI agent investigations. It uses isolated child agents for processing and includes well-documented scripts for maintaining a local documentation index and embedding code snippets.

skills.name: improve-ui
skills.description_en: Audit an existing product surface against its own design evidence, identify verified UI problems, and write self-contained implementation plans for another agent. Strictly read-only on product source. Use when asked to review, refine, improve, or clean up an interface without replacing its identity; investigate design-system drift; or prepare a design handoff.

audits.summary: The skill is a UI auditing tool with robust safety constraints, including a strict read-only policy. It possesses a minor surface for indirect prompt injection via the documentation it analyzes.

skills.name: design-task
skills.description_en: CrewAI task design and configuration. Use when creating, configuring, or debugging crewAI tasks — writing descriptions and expected_output, setting up task dependencies with context, configuring output formats (output_pydantic, output_json, output_file), using guardrails for validation, enabling human_input, async execution, markdown formatting, or debugging task execution issues.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive guide for designing and configuring CrewAI tasks. It focuses on best practices for task descriptions, expected outputs, dependency management, and structured output formats. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: wecomcli-doc
skills.description_en: 企业微信在线 doc 文档技能。能够新建 doc、导入本地 .doc/.docx/.txt 为 doc、读取 doc 内容、向 doc 追加或覆盖写入。仅当用户明确出现「doc」「docx」「word」「在线文档」「office 文档」等强类型词，或提供 https://doc.weixin.qq.com/doc/xxx 链接时才使用本技能。用户说"文档""新建文档""写文档""整理成文档""输出到文档"等未指定类型的泛化表达，一律使用 wecomcli-smartpage。

zh.intro: 用 wecom-cli 管企业微信 doc 文档：新建、把本地 .doc、.docx、.txt 导入成 doc、读取内容、追加或全量覆盖写入。追加与覆盖有明确裁定：中性动词（写入、写到、记录、补充、加进去）默认走追加，不动原文；只有明说覆盖、重写、替换、清空重写才走覆盖。触发条件也写死了：只有用户提到 doc、docx、word、在线文档、office 文档，或给出 doc.weixin.qq.com 下的 doc 链接时用；说「文档」「新建文档」这类没指定类型的泛化表达要走 wecomcli-smartpage，docid 以 a1 或 b1 开头的也归那边。
zh.usage: 要把本地 Word 或 txt 变成企微 doc，或往已有 doc 追加一段时，先过公共前置检查再按路由表选追加还是覆盖。
zh.notes: 依赖 wecom-cli 可执行文件，执行任何命令前必须先完成 wecomcli-shared 的前置检查；搜索、改权限、重命名、加成员归 wecomcli-doc-manage，表格归 wecomcli-sheet 或智能表技能。

audits.summary: The skill provides tools for managing Enterprise WeChat (WeCom) documents. It includes a Python script for generating Word documents with robust sandboxing, symlink protection, and strict input validation. No malicious patterns or security risks were detected.

skills.name: cloud-sql-basics
skills.description_en: This file generates or explains Cloud SQL resources. Use this file when the user asks to create a Cloud SQL instance or database for MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive documentation and administrative patterns for managing Google Cloud SQL resources. It includes security-focused guidance on the principle of least privilege, IAM-based authentication, and secure connectivity practices. While the skill references external package installations and powerful administrative tools, these are standard components of the service and are documented alongside relevant security considerations.

skills.name: forget
skills.description_en: Delete selected durable memories from agentmemory after showing them and getting explicit confirmation. Use when the user says "forget this", "delete memory", "remove that note", or wants to scrub specific data for privacy.

zh.intro: 按要求从 agentmemory 里删掉指定记忆：先检索出命中的条目，把 id、标题和范围列出来，等用户明确确认后再按记忆 id 删除。观察记录和整段会话不支持用这条路径擦除。
zh.usage: 先用 `memory_smart_search` 检索，targetLayer 取 memory、limit 给 20，选中后调 `memory_governance_delete`，memoryIds 用逗号串，可附 reason 说明原因。
zh.notes: 删除不可逆，沉默或一句随便不算确认；经验条目要用 memory_lesson_delete 单独删，别把局部删除说成清空会话。

audits.summary: This skill provides a secure workflow for managing and deleting agent memories with mandatory human-in-the-loop confirmation steps.

skills.name: google-cloud-recipe-onboarding
skills.description_en: Guides a developer's first steps on Google Cloud, covering account creation, billing setup, project management, and deploying a first resource. Use when a new developer wants to initialize their first Google Cloud project, configure billing, and verify deployment. Don't use for enterprise organization setup (use Google Cloud Setup guided flow for that instead). Don't use for complex multi-project architectures.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured guide for onboarding developers to Google Cloud. It includes several safety-oriented design patterns, such as silent pre-execution audits and a mandatory human-in-the-loop consent gate before any resource creation or billing changes. It also correctly distinguishes between personal and enterprise environments to prevent misconfiguration. No malicious patterns or security risks were detected.

skills.name: recap
skills.description_en: Summarize the last N agent sessions for the current project, grouped by date, with highlight observations per session. Use when the user asks "recap", "what have we been doing", "today", "this week", or wants a rollup of recent work.

zh.intro: 把当前项目最近若干次 agent 会话按日期分组汇总，每组列出会话号前八位、标题或首条提示、观察条数与状态，再用检索取出每条会话里值得看的要点。
zh.usage: 调用 `memory_sessions`、limit 给 30，再对留下的会话逐个调 `memory_recall` 取要点；参数留空按最近 10 次算，today 指当天、this week 指最近七天。
zh.notes: 窗口里没有记录就如实说没有，不要凭印象补活动；末尾交一句会话数、天数和观察条数的汇总。

audits.summary: The skill is a utility for summarizing recent agent sessions by retrieving data from local memory tools. It does not perform any high-risk operations like network access, file writing, or code execution.

skills.name: commit-history
skills.description_en: List recent git commits linked to agent sessions, optionally filtered by branch or repo. Use when the user asks "show agent commits", "what has the agent shipped", "list linked commits", or wants commits with their session context.

zh.intro: 按分支、仓库、条数过滤出与 agent 会话关联的提交并倒序列出：每条给短 sha、分支、提交时间、消息首行、关联会话 id 与观察条数，响应里带文件信息时再补文件数。裸数字当条数，默认 100、上限 500；结果为空说明过滤没命中，不代表没干活，这时建议去掉分支或仓库条件。REST 兜底必须把参数做 URL 编码，否则带问号或井号的分支名会把查询串弄坏。
zh.usage: 用户问 agent 交付了什么、要看关联提交、或按分支与仓库查提交及其会话上下文时用。
zh.notes: 依赖 agentmemory：先调 `memory_commits`；工具不可用时正文指向 TROUBLESHOOTING.md。

audits.summary: This skill provides functionality to list git commits linked to agent sessions. It includes security-minded instructions to ensure data is properly encoded and does not contain any malicious patterns or unauthorized access attempts.

skills.name: redis-patterns
skills.description_en: Redis data structure patterns, caching strategies, distributed locks, rate limiting, pub/sub, and connection management for production applications. Use when adding caching, a distributed lock, rate limiting, or pub/sub with Redis, or when key design needs review.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive reference guide for implementing Redis patterns such as caching, rate limiting, and distributed locking. The code snippets follow industry best practices and do not contain any malicious behavior or security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: gke-basics
skills.description_en: Manages core GKE cluster provisioning, credentials, Autopilot vs Standard selection, and workload deployment. Use when creating GKE clusters, fetching kubectl credentials, or deciding between Autopilot and Standard modes. Don't use for Workload Identity (use gke-workload-identity), GKE networking (use gke-networking), security hardening (use gke-platform-security or gke-workload-security), or cluster upgrades (use gke-upgrades).

zh.intro: GKE 集群的日常操作：在 Autopilot 与 Standard 之间做选择、建集群、取 kubectl 凭据、部署负载，并提醒私有集群、资源请求对齐与凭据区域这几处容易踩错的地方。
zh.usage: 建集群或取凭据时使用；默认选 Autopilot，只有需要自定义内核参数、节点污点或 hostPath 挂载才用 Standard；私有集群要同时关掉公网控制平面并限制授权网段，取凭据时显式带上区域或可用区。
zh.notes: Autopilot 的 CPU 请求按 250m 递增，未对齐会向上取整且请求即上限；工作负载身份、网络、安全加固与升级各有专门技能。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive guide for managing Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) clusters, following Google Cloud's established best practices for security and provisioning. It includes potential considerations regarding the handling of Kubernetes manifests and external libraries, which are standard for cloud infrastructure management tools.

skills.name: commit-context
skills.description_en: Trace a file, function, or line back to the agent session that produced its current commit. Use when the user asks "why is this code here", "what was the agent doing when this changed", "who wrote this", or wants context on a specific location in the codebase.

zh.intro: 把一个文件、函数或行段追溯回产生当前提交的那次 agent 会话：先用 blame 或 log 拿到提交号，再查出关联会话与重要度较高的观察，最终讲清这段代码当时在做什么。
zh.usage: 按范围选 `git blame -L 40,52 src/auth/refresh.ts` 或 `git log -L`，拿到提交号后调 `memory_commit_lookup`；查不到就说提交早于会话关联。
zh.notes: 查询返回 commit 为 null 时只报 git show 显示的事实，不推断动机；会话细节照抄查询结果。

audits.summary: The 'commit-context' skill is a utility for developers to trace code changes back to their original agent sessions. It correctly uses standard git commands and platform-provided memory tools, including explicit instructions to avoid fabricating information when data is missing.

skills.name: wecomcli-contact
skills.description_en: 使用 wecom-cli 按姓名、拼音、英文名或别名搜索企业微信通讯录中的人员，并查询匹配人员的 userid、部门和职务。适用于查找联系人、区分同名人员、获取用户 userid，以及列出全部同名人员。

zh.intro: 用 wecom-cli 按姓名、姓名拼音、英文名或别名模糊搜企业微信通讯录，一次最多 10 个关键词，多个关键词之间是 OR。返回 userid、中文姓名、别名、邮箱、管理职务（注意不是职位）和部门路径（从大到小，主部门在前），每条还带命中的关键词。默认只回最相关的候选；要完整名单时显式传 list 模式，用于「一共有几个张三」「列出全部同名」这类清点。同一关键词候选超过 5 位只展示前 5 位并提示可查看更多，展示顺序必须按接口原序不重排；返回里提示字段非空时要告知用户结果不完整。
zh.usage: 要找某人 userid 或区分同名时，用姓名配部门或职务一起搜，命中超过五条再按提示决定是否展开完整名单。
zh.notes: 依赖 wecom-cli，执行前要过 wecomcli-shared 的前置检查；关键词是字面匹配，不做语义联想；缺关键词且推不出时应追问而不是猜。

audits.summary: This skill allows the agent to search for enterprise contact information using the wecom-cli tool. While it accesses employee data like names and emails, this is its intended function. A minor security risk exists if employee directory information contains malicious text designed to trick the AI, though this is a common risk for tools that process external data.

skills.name: session-history
skills.description_en: Show what happened in recent past sessions on this project as a clean timeline. Use when the user asks "what did we do last time", "session history", "past sessions", or wants an overview of previous work.

zh.intro: 把本项目最近几次会话按时间倒序列成干净的时间线：每条给出会话号前八位、所属项目、开始时间、状态和观察条数，有会话摘要时再带出标题与关键决定。
zh.usage: 调用 `memory_sessions`，project 用记录在案的准确标识、limit 可取 20；要翻页就沿 nextCursor 继续并保持同样的过滤条件，别换成别的项目。
zh.notes: 空历史本身就是答案，不要凭印象补；只显示了部分页时要说清楚这是片段。

audits.summary: This skill provides a timeline of recent project sessions by fetching data from a dedicated session memory tool. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: bash-defensive-patterns
skills.description_en: Master defensive Bash programming techniques for production-grade scripts. Use when writing robust shell scripts, CI/CD pipelines, or system utilities requiring fault tolerance and safety.

zh.intro: 写生产级 Bash 的防御做法：开头 `set -Eeuo pipefail`，变量一律加引号防分词，条件用 `[[]]`，加错误捕获，校验输入的文件存在性与权限，函数化复用，日志带时间戳与级别，支持 dry-run，临时文件用 mktemp 并靠 trap 清理，脚本要可重复执行。查可执行文件用 `command -v` 而不是 which，输出优先 printf，跨平台时更可预期。
zh.usage: 写生产自动化脚本、CI/CD 管线脚本、系统管理工具，或要让脚本安全处理边界情况并跨平台运行时用。
zh.notes: 更细的写法与成品放在正文引用的 references/details.md。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation and templates for writing robust, production-grade Bash scripts using defensive programming techniques.

skills.name: tailwind-css-patterns
skills.description_en: Provides comprehensive Tailwind CSS utility-first styling patterns including responsive design, layout utilities, flexbox, grid, spacing, typography, colors, and modern CSS best practices. Use when styling React/Vue/Svelte components, building responsive layouts, implementing design systems, or optimizing CSS workflow.

zh.intro: Tailwind CSS 的写法参考，覆盖响应式断点、flex 与 grid 布局、间距、字号、颜色和暗色模式，按 v4.1 的 CSS-first 配置来写，给的是能直接抄的片段：居中容器、响应式卡片网格、带 hover 的按钮。
zh.usage: 写 React、Vue、Svelte 组件或搭响应式布局时用。先写移动端基础样式，再用 sm、md、lg 前缀适配大屏；复用间距和颜色标度，重复模式抽成组件类，主题变量写在 tailwind.config.js 或用 @theme 声明。
zh.notes: 改完在各断点用开发者工具的响应式模式看一遍，检查视觉回归和无障碍问题再提交。

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill provides legitimate technical documentation and design patterns for Tailwind CSS development, including responsive design, accessibility, and performance optimization guides.

skills.name: secrets-management
skills.description_en: Implement secure secrets management for CI/CD pipelines using Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or native platform solutions. Use when handling sensitive credentials, rotating secrets, or securing CI/CD environments.

zh.intro: 在 CI/CD 流水线里安全地管密钥：接 Vault、AWS Secrets Manager 或平台自带的方案。处理敏感凭据、做密钥轮换、给流水线环境加固时用它。
zh.usage: 当流水线里要放数据库口令、API key 一类敏感凭据，或者要把硬编码的密钥挪出去并定期轮换时用它。
zh.notes: 这批里没有抓到正文，卡片只按目录描述写。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation and best practices for secure secrets management across various CI/CD platforms and cloud providers. It encourages the use of specialized tools, automated rotation, and secret scanning to prevent credential exposure.

skills.name: nature-writing
skills.description_en: Draft or restructure scientific manuscript arguments, sections, and initial-submission materials from author-provided evidence. Use for 论文写作、章节起草、论证重构、正文压缩、首次投稿材料. Use nature-polishing for language-only edits to existing prose and nature-response for post-decision correspondence.

audits.summary: The skill is a professional scientific writing assistant designed to draft and restructure manuscript sections. It is safe for its intended use, with the only noted finding being a standard vulnerability surface for indirect prompt injection common to tools that process user-supplied text.

skills.name: argent-lens
skills.description_en: Propose multiple visual design variants for on-screen elements and let the human pick in the Argent Lens window. Use when the user asks for design alternatives / options / A-B choices for a screen or component, or any time you have produced more than one candidate look for an element and want a human decision before committing.

zh.intro: 同一屏要几个视觉方案时，逐个方案真做出来、逐个截图，再一次性推进 Argent Lens 窗口：每个方案是一张浮卡，用细线连到界面上对应的真实元素，人按元素逐个挑，还能给元素留自由批注，按完成后结果一次返回给代理。硬规则是一个方案对应一张真机渲染出来、彼此不同的截图，没做出来的、或者两张图一模一样的方案不算数。
zh.usage: 需要人来做视觉取舍时，先把每个变体做出来并截图，再让真人在 Argent Lens 里逐个元素点选。
zh.notes: 要先运行 `argent enable argent-lens` 打开开关，默认是关的；每次都建议带上模拟器 id，预览窗会直接串那台设备，人不用自己再选。

audits.summary: The skill defines a visual design review workflow that allows an agent to propose multiple UI variants and await user selection. It uses platform-provided tools for screenshots and device interaction as intended and contains no malicious patterns or security risks.

skills.name: asc-metadata-sync
skills.description_en: Sync, validate, and apply App Store metadata and store assets with asc. Use when updating localizations, keywords, App Clip or preview assets, Asset Library media and placements, or migrating legacy fastlane metadata.

audits.summary: The skill is safe and provides instructions for managing App Store metadata using the `asc` command-line tool, following best practices like dry runs and validation.

skills.name: stitch::react-native
skills.description_en: Convert Stitch HTML designs to React Native components, or syncs/updates existing native components to align with the latest Stitch designs, using StyleSheet.

audits.summary: This skill automates the conversion of Stitch designs into React Native components. It uses local shell scripts to download design assets and a Node.js validation tool to ensure code quality and architectural consistency. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: nature-academic-search
skills.description_en: Search literature across sources, verify or manage citations, and build MeSH strategies or citation-impact audits. Use for 文献检索、引文核对、参考文献管理、严格他引 and evidence-backed citer profiles; not for translating a paper or drafting manuscript prose.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive academic literature search and management tool. It is generally safe, but carries a minor risk of indirect prompt injection due to its processing of external scholarly data (e.g., abstracts and paper metadata) from public APIs and user documents. It also performs standard local installation tasks and accesses local configuration files for academic service credentials.

skills.name: k8s-manifest-generator
skills.description_en: Create production-ready Kubernetes manifests for Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Secrets following best practices and security standards. Use when generating Kubernetes YAML manifests, creating K8s resources, or implementing production-grade Kubernetes configurations.

zh.intro: 按 Kubernetes 惯例和云原生实践，逐步产出可用于生产的清单：Deployment、Service、ConfigMap、Secret 和持久卷声明，含资源请求与上限、健康检查、安全上下文、镜像标签和命名规范，也顾及多环境部署。
zh.usage: 要新建 K8s 资源清单、补健康检查与资源限制、设计多环境部署时用它；排障可查正文里的 `kubectl describe pod` 一类命令。
zh.notes: 更细的模式在 references/details.md；正文另附 Pod 起不来、Service 访问不通、配置没加载的排查顺序。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive guide and template library for generating Kubernetes manifests following security best practices. It does not contain any malicious code, obfuscation, or data exfiltration patterns.

skills.name: fastapi-patterns
skills.description_en: FastAPI best practices covering project structure, Pydantic v2 schemas, dependency injection, async handlers, authentication, authorization, transactional service layers, and testing with httpx and pytest. Use when building or reviewing FastAPI apps — Pydantic schemas, dependencies, async handlers, auth, or tests.

audits.summary: The skill provides a set of high-quality, secure development patterns for FastAPI, including project structure, authentication, and database management. No security threats or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description_en: Guide for creating effective skills for AI coding agents working with Azure SDKs and Microsoft Foundry services. Use when creating new skills or updating existing skills.

audits.summary: This skill provides a robust framework and development utilities for creating specialized Azure SDK skills. It explicitly promotes secure coding practices, such as utilizing Entra ID for authentication and avoiding hardcoded secrets. The included utility scripts for initialization and validation are designed with security in mind, employing safe YAML parsing to protect the development environment.

skills.name: mobile-app-ui-design
skills.description_en: Design high-quality mobile app UI/UX screens, flows, and components. Use this skill whenever the user asks to design a mobile app screen, create app mockups, build mobile UI components, improve an existing mobile app design, create onboarding flows, design mobile navigation, or requests any mobile-first interface work. Also trigger when the user mentions app design, mobile UI, mobile UX, screen design, app mockups, wireframes, or wants to build React Native / Flutter / SwiftUI style interfaces as visual prototypes. Even if the user just says "design an app" or "make this screen look better", use this skill.

zh.intro: 按成熟应用的通行做法设计移动端界面：正文先用三个问题定目标（用户要完成什么、该有什么感受、第一眼该看到什么），再按上下文、结构、视觉的顺序推进，并给行业惯例、组件与动效约定，覆盖 React Native、Flutter、SwiftUI 风格的原型。
zh.usage: 要出新页面、做 onboarding 流程、改一版界面或画应用原型时用它；行业惯例清单在 `references/industry-conventions.md`。
zh.notes: 正文把可读性、留白与层级放在花哨效果之前，并要求每个间距和颜色都有理由。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive UI/UX design guide for mobile apps. It contains no executable code, scripts, or commands. It provides frameworks for visual hierarchy, spacing, and emotional design. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: interview-prep-generator
skills.description_en: Generate STAR stories, practice questions, and talking points from resume

zh.intro: 从简历里反推面试会问什么：按 STAR 结构把经历整理成能讲的段落，配一批练习题和可以主动提的谈资，让回答有具体事例而不是空话。
zh.usage: 拿到面试通知、要按简历过一遍可能被追问的点时用；准备行为面试、想把项目经历讲成完整故事时也用。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。

audits.summary: The interview-prep-generator skill is a template-driven tool designed to help users prepare for job interviews through structured text generation. It contains no executable code, network access, or sensitive file operations, and poses no security risk.

skills.name: okx-sentiment-tracker
skills.description_en: Use this skill when the user asks about: 'any crypto news', 'latest news', 'market update', 'daily briefing', 'BTC news', 'ETH news', 'news on SOL', 'search SEC ETF', 'regulation news', 'Bitcoin halving', 'is BTC bullish or bearish', 'coin sentiment', 'sentiment trend', 'trending coins', 'top bullish coins', 'bearish sentiment', 'social buzz', 'market mood', 'fear and greed', 'full article', 'read more', 'economic calendar', '经济日历', 'macro data', '宏观数据', 'NFP', 'nonfarm', '非农', 'CPI', 'GDP', 'FOMC', '利率决议', 'interest rate decision', 'PMI', 'unemployment rate', '失业率', 'economic events', '经济事件', or any request for crypto news, market intelligence, sentiment analysis, social trend data, or macro-economic calendar. Requires API credentials. Do NOT use for market prices/candles (okx-cex-market), placing orders (okx-cex-trade), or account info (okx-cex-portfolio).

audits.summary: The skill tracks crypto news and sentiment using the OKX CLI. It ingests external news content which could theoretically contain instructions intended to influence the agent's behavior (Indirect Prompt Injection).

skills.name: clanker-discipline
skills.description_en: Catches state bloat, grab-bag models, and mutation ambiguity from AI coding agents. Use when reviewing state types, boolean flags, optional-field models, or mutable data patterns.

audits.summary: This skill provides a set of architectural and coding guidelines for AI agents to improve code quality, specifically focusing on state management, type safety, and function purity. It contains no executable code or dangerous instructions.

skills.name: cmux
skills.description_en: End-user control of cmux topology and routing (windows, workspaces, panes/surfaces, focus, moves, reorder, identify, trigger flash). Use when automation needs deterministic placement and navigation in a multi-pane cmux layout.

audits.summary: The cmux skill provides tools for terminal and workspace management, including the ability to execute arbitrary shell commands. This core functionality presents a security risk if the agent is directed to process untrusted data, potentially leading to unauthorized command execution or the exposure of browser history and application settings.

skills.name: heroui-react
skills.description_en: HeroUI v3 React component library (Tailwind CSS v4 + React Aria). Use when building UIs with HeroUI — creating Buttons, Modals, Forms, Cards; installing @heroui/react; configuring dark/light themes with oklch variables; or fetching component docs. Keywords: HeroUI, Hero UI, heroui, @heroui/react, @heroui/styles.

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It provides installation guidelines and helper scripts for interacting with the official HeroUI v3 API and documentation. The reported installation shell pipe belongs to standard ecosystem onboarding scripts from the primary vendor, and all network calls target official company endpoints.

skills.name: onboarding
skills.description_en: Configure the LaunchDarkly hosted MCP server during onboarding. Use when the parent LaunchDarkly onboarding skill reaches the MCP offer, after the first flag works. Supports Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and other MCP-compatible agents. OAuth authentication; no API keys for the hosted server.

audits.summary: The skill provides a guided, multi-step onboarding workflow to integrate LaunchDarkly SDKs into a project. It strictly enforces safe defaults such as isolated git branches, avoiding hardcoded secrets by guiding users on environment variable setup with explicit consent, and leverages standard tools or hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations with no hazardous behaviors identified.

skills.name: error-handling
skills.description_en: Patterns for robust error handling across TypeScript, Python, and Go. Covers typed errors, error boundaries, retries, circuit breakers, and user-facing error messages. Use when designing error types, retries, circuit breakers, or user-facing failure messages in TypeScript, Python, or Go.

audits.summary: The skill provides standard coding patterns and best practice guidelines for error handling across TypeScript, Python, and Go. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: agent-architecture-audit
skills.description_en: Full-stack diagnostic for agent and LLM applications. Audits the 12-layer agent stack for wrapper regression, memory pollution, tool discipline failures, hidden repair loops, and rendering corruption. Produces severity-ranked findings with code-first fixes. Essential for developers building agent applications, autonomous loops, or any LLM-powered feature. Use when an agent or LLM feature misbehaves and the failing layer is unknown, or before shipping an agent stack.

audits.summary: The skill is a professional diagnostic tool for auditing AI agent architectures and identifying common failure patterns in LLM-powered applications. It uses standard search and file analysis tools to audit codebases for flaws like memory pollution or tool discipline failures. While the skill processes external content (source code), which is a common surface for indirect prompt injection, it contains no malicious instructions, obfuscation, or exfiltration patterns.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description_en: Resume the most recent agent session for the current working directory, leading with any unanswered question. Use when the user says "where were we", "resume", "handoff", "pick up where I left off", or starts a session with no fresh context.

zh.intro: 接回当前目录上一次的 agent 会话：先列会话，挑 cwd 与本项目在目录边界上对得上的最近一条，再用 recall 拉关键概念。上次若停在用户没答的问题上，先把它摆最前面；然后给标题、关键文件、关键决定与错误，最后落成一个具体的下一步。匹配要按目录边界而非字符串前缀，否则 /repo-a 会把 /repo-a-staging 认成同一个项目；找不到就直说，别拿别的项目顶替。
zh.usage: 用户说我们上次做到哪、继续、交接、接着上次的活，或新会话没有上下文要接上时用。
zh.notes: 依赖 agentmemory 的 MCP 工具；空会话要如实说明，可提议重新开始。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates resuming previous AI agent sessions by retrieving context from internal memory tools. It implements directory-boundary checks to ensure sessions are matched to the correct project. A low-severity risk of indirect prompt injection is present as the skill processes historical session data without explicit boundary markers.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description_en: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive instructions and best practices for Test-Driven Development (TDD). It guides users through the Red-Green-Refactor cycle and offers strategies to avoid common testing anti-patterns. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: dbs-content-risk-check
skills.description_en: 面向创作者的内容发布风险检查。逐句检查自媒体、社交媒体和内容平台的标题、正文、图片文字、字幕、口播、评论、账号资料及视频画面，分别判断平台机器可能识别什么、内容本身存在什么实质问题，并给出具体位置和最小修改动作；需要明确视频语境边界时，额外生成真实准确的三行贴片小字。用户询问「检查敏感词」「发布前排雷」「这篇内容哪里可能违规」「这条小红书能不能发」「视频上放什么声明」时使用。保留强观点、情绪张力、个人风格和传播钩子。

audits.summary: The skill is a content risk assessment tool that identifies platform review triggers and substantive violations in user-provided content. It includes specific safety guardrails against generating bypass techniques and does not exhibit any malicious behaviors such as data exfiltration or unauthorized code execution.

skills.name: git-workflow
skills.description_en: Git workflow patterns including branching strategies, commit conventions, keeping history clean and readable, tidying local commits before merging, merge vs rebase, conflict resolution, and collaborative development best practices for teams of all sizes. Use when choosing a branching strategy, writing commit conventions, cleaning up history before a pull request, deciding merge versus rebase, or resolving conflicts.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive guide to Git workflows and best practices. It promotes security by recommending the use of .gitignore for sensitive files and providing examples of pre-commit hooks that scan for secrets.

skills.name: vite-patterns
skills.description_en: Vite build tool patterns including config, plugins, HMR, env variables, proxy setup, SSR, library mode, dependency pre-bundling, and build optimization. Activate when working with vite.config.ts, Vite plugins, or Vite-based projects.

audits.summary: This skill provides secure and comprehensive patterns for configuring and optimizing the Vite build tool. It includes explicit security guidance on environment variable handling and build-time safety.

skills.name: hermes-imports
skills.description_en: Convert local Hermes operator workflows into sanitized ECC skills and release-pack artifacts. Use when preparing a Hermes workflow for public ECC reuse without leaking private workspace state, credentials, or local-only paths.

audits.summary: This skill is a defensive utility designed to help users sanitize workflows by removing private data, credentials, and local environment details. It promotes security best practices and contains no malicious code.

skills.name: nature-shared
skills.description_en: Internal shared-reference support package for installed Nature Skills, including nature-writing, nature-polishing, nature-response, nature-reader, and nature-paper2ppt. Do not invoke it as a standalone user workflow. Load only the specific core or journal-format file requested by another Nature skill.

audits.summary: This skill is a support package providing editorial guidelines and a mechanical consistency checker for Nature Portfolio manuscripts. It contains reference materials and a local Python script for auditing terminology and numeric precision. No malicious patterns or data exfiltration risks were detected.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description_en: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

audits.summary: This skill provides creative design guidelines for frontend development and does not contain any security vulnerabilities or malicious code.

skills.name: data-quality-frameworks
skills.description_en: Implement data quality validation with Great Expectations, dbt tests, and data contracts. Use when building data quality pipelines, implementing validation rules, or establishing data contracts.

zh.intro: 用 Great Expectations、dbt 测试和数据契约把数据质量校验落到管道里：正文按完整性、唯一性、有效性、准确性、一致性和时效性六个维度列出对应断言，给检查的金字塔分层、期待套件与检查点的搭法，以及在 CI 里自动跑校验的做法。

skills.name: react:components
skills.description_en: Converts Stitch designs into modular Vite and React components using system-level networking and AST-based validation.

zh.intro: 把 Stitch 里的设计稿转成模块化的 Vite 加 React 组件，靠 MCP 取设计数据、用 AST 做校验。技能要求先发现命名空间前缀，再取屏设计 JSON，落盘前先看本地是否已有同页的设计文件，避免重复下载覆盖掉手工改动。产出的组件放在约定的目录里，配套样式指南和架构检查清单。
zh.usage: 先跑 `list_tools` 找到 Stitch MCP 的前缀，再用该前缀调取屏方法拿设计 JSON。下载设计资源用 `bash scripts/fetch-stitch.sh "[htmlCode.downloadUrl]" ".stitch/designs/{page}.html"`。依赖装好后用 `npm install`，写组件时参考 resources/component-template.tsx 和 resources/style-guide.json，最后跑 `npm run validate <file_path>` 做校验，预览用 `npm run dev`。
zh.notes: 正文提醒 AI 自带的抓取工具在云存储域名上可能失败，所以给了脚本兜底；如果本地已存在 .stitch/designs/{page}.html 与对应图片，必须先问用户是重新拉取还是复用。

audits.summary: The skill is a design-to-code utility for React developers that converts design assets into modular components. It uses local shell and Node.js scripts for file retrieval and AST-based code validation. No security issues were detected.

zh.usage: 建模型、排队列任务或加 Sanctum 鉴权时，把需求和数据关系说明清楚，按它给的模型、迁移和测试顺序落地。
zh.notes: 假定 Laravel 10 以上加 PHP 8.2；85% 覆盖是它的默认要求，团队标准不同要自己调；不负责前端框架选型。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional guide for Laravel development but has been flagged by automated scanners for a malicious URL and a suspicious file reputation. While manual inspection suggests these may be false positives related to vendor documentation and standard development tools, the skill's ability to execute shell commands necessitates caution.

skills.name: python-observability
skills.description_en: Python observability patterns including structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing. Use when adding logging, implementing metrics collection, setting up tracing, or debugging production systems.

zh.intro: Python 服务的可观测做法：JSON 结构化日志、Prometheus 指标、跨服务链路追踪，以及贯穿一条请求的 correlation id。指标标签要有界，别把用户 ID 这类高基数值当标签，否则存储成本会失控。

zh.notes: 正文按四大黄金信号逐服务边界打点：延迟、流量、错误、饱和度。

audits.summary: This skill provides standard patterns and code examples for implementing observability (logging, metrics, and tracing) in Python applications using well-known libraries.

skills.name: nature-reviewer

zh.intro: 从审稿人一侧出一份 Nature 风格的评估包：按原创性、科学重要性、跨学科可读性、技术可靠性、对非本行读者的可读性五条轴评，技术关注清单只当内部覆盖表。默认返回 3 份互盲审稿报告加 1 份复审综述，每位审稿人只拿到同一份稿件与各自侧重点，且各自在独立上下文里跑；报告先冻结再比较，比较后再单独跑一遍一致性核查，查算术、指标边界、重复呈现与可复现性。意见分 Major Concerns 与 Minor Comments，每条带稳定编号与可核对的证据位置，不设条数配额。
zh.usage: 投稿前自审、要审稿人视角评估、模拟同行评审，或预判会被挑什么问题，就用这个；写作者回复（rebuttal）不在范围内，正文指向 `nature-response`。
zh.notes: 上下文不能真正隔离时要明说互盲不成立；报告一旦冻结就不许按比较结果回改。

audits.summary: The nature-reviewer skill provides a structured simulation of the Nature-style peer review process for scientific manuscripts. skills.name: simple-english
skills.description_en: Write or rewrite text in plain, layman-readable English in the spirit of ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, active voice, simple tenses, one word one meaning, condition before command, every technical term defined at first use, no AI slop. Default mode is Plain. Strict mode applies full STE vocabulary compliance when the user names STE, ASD-STE100, or compliance. Use for documentation, READMEs, runbooks, procedures, error messages, release notes, incident reports, API guides, and explanations for readers outside the field. Also use when the user says "STE", "Simplified Technical English", "ASD-STE100", "plain English", "layman's terms", "explain it simply", "no jargon", "de-slop", "make this readable", "write for non-native readers", or asks for docs that translate well. The same rules govern the reply: answer first, prose only.

zh.intro: 把文档或回信改写成读者一遍就能看懂的平实英语。规则取自航空维修手册所用的受控语言 ASD-STE100：句子短、主动语态、只用简单时态、一个词只表示一个含义、条件写在命令前面、术语第一次出现时用十个词以内说清。默认走 Plain 模式；用户点名 STE、ASD-STE100 或提出合规要求时切到严格模式，套完整词汇表。文档和聊天回复是两套规则，各自约束。
zh.usage: 写或改 README、运行手册、操作步骤、错误信息、发布说明、事故报告、API 指南，或者要给外行与非母语读者解释某个概念时用它；用户说「用大白话」「别用行话」也走这条。正文同时约束回复本身：先给答案，再写正文。
zh.notes: 正文把规则按文体拆成两份：要写或要改的文档，以及聊天回复；严格模式只在用户点名 STE 时才启用。

skills.description_en: Generates a single standardized submission-style CTF writeup for competition handoff and organizer review. Use after solving a CTF challenge to document the solution steps, tools used, and lessons learned in a structured format.

audits.summary: The skill is designed to automate CTF writeup generation by scanning the filesystem for challenge artifacts and solving scripts. The primary security concern is indirect prompt injection, as the agent processes untrusted data from challenge files which could contain hidden instructions to influence agent behavior.

skills.name: happyhorse
skills.description_en: Generate and edit videos with Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via inference.sh CLI. Models: HappyHorse T2V, I2V, R2V, Video Edit. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing with natural language, character preservation, 720P/1080P, up to 15 seconds. Use for: physically realistic video, video editing, character-consistent content, product demos, social media. Triggers: happyhorse, happy horse, alibaba video, happyhorse 1.0, dashscope video, alibaba happyhorse, video editing ai, ai video editor

audits.summary: This skill provides a legitimate interface and instructions for interacting with Alibaba's HappyHorse 1.0 video generation and editing models through the inference.sh CLI platform. No malicious behavior or security risks were identified.

skills.name: genshijin-commit
skills.description_en: 超圧縮コミットメッセージ生成。Conventional Commits形式で件名≤50文字、 「何を」より「なぜ」を重視。日本語・英語両対応。 「コミットメッセージ作って」「/commit」「/genshijin-commit」で起動。 ステージング変更時に自動起動候補。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions for generating git commit messages and does not contain any executable code or pose security risks.

skills.name: genshijin-compress
skills.description_en: 自然言語メモリファイル（CLAUDE.md, todos, 設定）を原始人形式に圧縮し入力トークン削減。 技術内容・コード・URL・構造は完全保持。圧縮版が原ファイルを上書き、人間可読版は FILE.original.md として保存。「/genshijin-compress <filepath>」「メモリファイル圧縮」で起動。

audits.summary: The skill compresses local text and markdown files by sending their content to the Anthropic API. While it includes a comprehensive blacklist to prevent the transmission of sensitive files (like keys and environment variables), it performs external data transfer and executes a local CLI tool as a fallback mechanism.

skills.name: gemini-interactions-api
skills.description_en: Guides the usage of Gemini Interactions API on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Use when the user wants to use the stateful, server-managed Interactions API for multi-turn conversations, background execution, streaming, structured output, and function calling on the Agent Platform.

zh.intro: 在 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 上用 Interactions API：会话状态由服务端保存，支持多轮对话、后台执行、流式输出、结构化输出和函数调用。要求走统一的 Google Gen AI SDK，旧版 SDK 与旧模型不在支持范围内。也讲模型和托管代理分别怎么指向。
zh.usage: 多轮对话想交给服务端存状态、要流式输出或结构化结果、需要函数调用时用。调用写在 `client.interactions.create` 里，模型用 `gemini-3.8-flash`，续接上一轮靠 `previous_interaction_id`；Python 端要 `google-genai >= 2.3.0`。
zh.notes: 与 google-gemini/gemini-skills、google-gemini/gemini-skill 下的同名技能重名，来源不同。正文要求说明旧版 SDK 不受支持。

audits.summary: This skill provides guidance and code examples for the Gemini Interactions API on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. It focuses on authentication via Google Cloud, client initialization, and stateful conversation patterns. All external references and dependencies are within the vendor's own ecosystem.

skills.name: ios-hig-design
skills.description_en: Design native iOS interfaces following Apple Human Interface Guidelines. Use when the user mentions "iPhone app", "iPad layout", "SwiftUI", "UIKit", "Dynamic Island", "safe areas", "HIG compliance", "SF Symbols", "haptic feedback", "iOS accessibility", "make my app feel native", or "follow Apple design guidelines". Also trigger when building tab bars, navigation stacks, sheets, or modals for iOS, implementing dark mode, or adapting layouts across screen sizes. Covers navigation patterns, accessibility, SF Symbols, and platform conventions. For general UI polish, see refactoring-ui. For affordance design, see design-everyday-things.

audits.summary: This skill is a comprehensive documentation set providing design guidelines and Swift/UIKit code examples for building native iOS applications aligned with Apple's Human Interface Guidelines. The analysis confirmed the skill contains only design patterns, accessibility checklists, and system integration guides with no evidence of malicious code, data exfiltration, or obfuscation.

skills.name: design-system
skills.description_en: Guide for using Sentry's layout and text primitives. Use when implementing UI components, layouts, or typography. Enforces use of core components over styled components.

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive developer guide for using Sentry's internal design system primitives. It establishes coding standards, promotes the use of core components, and includes specific safety instructions for the agent to seek user confirmation before creating code abstractions.

skills.name: dbs
skills.description_en: dontbesilent 商业工具箱的技能调度台，根据当前问题和反馈选择下一步，在对话中直接执行、澄清、组合或对照尝试 Skill。用户不知道从哪里开始、需要调整处理方法、第一次使用 dbskill、输入三位编号或查询隐藏款目录时使用；仅需推荐或可复制提示词时按请求交付。

audits.summary: The 'dbs' skill acts as a central hub for the dontbesilent business toolbox, coordinating other specialized skills and providing numbered prompt execution. It includes mechanisms for version checking and fetching prompt content from the author's official GitHub repository, incorporating integrity verification via SHA-256 hashes. No malicious behavior or unauthorized data exfiltration patterns were identified.

skills.name: genshijin-help
skills.description_en: 全 genshijin モード・スキル・コマンドのクイックリファレンスカード。 1回限り表示・モード変更なし・状態永続化なし。 「/genshijin-help」「原始人ヘルプ」「原始人の使い方」で起動。

audits.summary: This skill is a documentation and help resource for 'genshijin' mode. It provides usage instructions, command triggers, and configuration methods. The skill references the author's own GitHub repository and standard configuration paths. No security risks were identified.

skills.name: genshijin-review
skills.description_en: 超圧縮PRレビューコメント。1行1指摘: 位置・問題・修正。前置き削除、シグナル優先。 日本語対応。「PRレビューして」「コードレビュー」「/review」「/genshijin-review」で起動。 プルリクエストレビュー時に自動起動候補。

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It only contains instructions for formatting pull request review comments into a concise style and does not execute any code or access external systems.

skills.name: twitter-api
skills.description_en: A Twitter API alternative and X API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no OAuth and no developer application. Use when the user wants to search tweets by keyword, hashtag, or advanced operators (from:, to:, since:, until:, min_faves:, filter:), scrape a Twitter/X profile by handle, pull a user's tweets, replies, followers, or followings, fetch a single tweet with its replies or retweeters, read a Twitter List's members or tweets, check trending topics by country, or search for X accounts by name. Also covers Twitter data pipelines, competitor monitoring, hashtag tracking, sentiment analysis input, or follower export without the official X API's pricing tiers or app-review process.

audits.summary: The skill provides a direct interface to fetch Twitter/X data through a third-party proxy service. While the skill's code and instructions are safe, it ingests untrusted content from social media, which introduces a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: setup-webhook
skills.description_en: Configure Vapi server URLs and webhooks to receive real-time call events, transcripts, tool calls, and end-of-call reports. Use when setting up webhook endpoints, building tool servers, or integrating Vapi events into your application.

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions and code examples for setting up Vapi webhooks and server URLs. It includes commands for installing the Vapi CLI via a shell script and integrating an MCP server for documentation access. While the skill facilitates data ingestion from external call transcripts, which introduces a risk of indirect prompt injection, all external resources trace back to the vendor's infrastructure.

skills.name: genshijin-crew
skills.description_en: 原始人スタイル subagent への委譲判断ガイド。`genshijin-investigator` (コード位置特定)、 `genshijin-builder` (1-2ファイル編集)、`genshijin-reviewer` (diff レビュー) を inline作業 or vanilla `Explore` の代わりにスポーンするタイミングを示す。subagent 出力は原始人圧縮 → 主コンテキストに戻る tool-result が約60%縮小 → 長セッション持続。 Trigger: 「subagent 委譲」「genshijin-crew 使用」「investigator/builder/reviewer 起動」「コンテキスト節約」「圧縮 agent 出力」。

zh.intro: 把 subagent 委派判断写成对照表的技能：investigator 负责定位代码位置、builder 只改一两个文件、reviewer 审 diff。三者的输出都被压缩成「原始人」格式，回到主上下文的 tool-result 体积明显变小，长会话因此能撑下去。
zh.usage: 委派前照表选人：查定义与调用点用 `genshijin-investigator`，范围明确的少量文件改动用 `genshijin-builder`，diff 审查用 `genshijin-reviewer`；文件还没定位就别直接叫 builder。
zh.notes: 正文给了三种输出契约与链式用法，也列了禁止事项，例如跨五个文件的改造会让 builder 直接返回 too-big.。

audits.summary: The skill provides architectural and formatting guidelines for context-efficient subagent delegation. It contains no executable code, network requests, or security-sensitive operations.

skills.name: genshijin-stats
skills.description_en: 現セッションのリアルトークン使用量と推定削減量を表示。Claude Code セッションログから直接読込 — AI 推定なし。 `/genshijin-stats` で起動。出力は mode-tracker フックが注入し、モデル自身は数値計算しない。

zh.intro: 显示当前会话的真实 token 用量与估算节省量，数据直接读 Claude Code 会话日志，不靠模型推算。输出由 mode-tracker 钩子注入，模型本身不参与计算，用户马上就能看到数字。
zh.usage: 输入 `/genshijin-stats` 看当前会话；加 `--share` 得到一行可分享摘要，加 `--all` 看累计统计，`--since 7d` 或 `--since 24h` 指定区间。
zh.notes: 正文只有参数列表，并说明它由 `hooks/genshijin-stats.js` 提供，mode-tracker 检测到命令后以 block 决策回注结果。

audits.summary: This skill calculates and displays token usage statistics by reading Claude Code session logs. It relies on external JavaScript hooks to process the data. A low-risk vulnerability exists where adversarial content within the session logs could potentially influence the agent's behavior (indirect prompt injection) when the stats are displayed.

skills.name: shellcheck-configuration
skills.description_en: Master ShellCheck static analysis configuration and usage for shell script quality. Use when setting up linting infrastructure, fixing code issues, or ensuring script portability.

zh.intro: 配置并使用 ShellCheck 做 shell 脚本静态检查：在 CI 里跑、按目标 shell 选方言、为具体项目调规则集、抑制误报时写清原因，让脚本的质量门槛统一。
zh.usage: 给 CI/CD 加 shell 检查、排查脚本里的错误码与告警、把脚本迁到统一质量门禁时用它；别把 bash 脚本当 sh 分析。
zh.notes: 正文建议用 `--enable=all` 配合谨慎的排除项，并保持 ShellCheck 版本更新以拿到新检查。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive documentation and configuration examples for ShellCheck, a standard static analysis tool for shell scripts. It covers configuration files, CI/CD integration, and common error resolutions without introducing any security risks.

skills.name: write-agentmemory-skill
skills.description_en: The house format and rules for writing or updating an agentmemory skill. Use when adding a new skill, restructuring an existing one, or reviewing a skill contribution for consistency.

zh.intro: agentmemory 仓库里写技能的统一格式：目录里放 SKILL.md，可选的 REFERENCE.md 与 EXAMPLES.md；正文顺序固定，依次是快速上手、原则、流程、反模式、检查清单、相关链接；正文控制在 100 行内。
zh.usage: 新增或改技能时照格式来：description 写两句话，第二句以 Use when 起头列触发场景；正文压到 100 行内；生成类事实别手写，改完源文件跑 `npm run skills:gen`，CI 用 `npm run skills:check` 查漂移。
zh.notes: 这是写技能本身的规范，不是某个具体技能；风格要求写明不写竞品名、不用 emoji、不用长破折号。

audits.summary: This skill serves as a documentation and style guide for creating other agent skills. It contains no executable code, remote downloads, or instructions that would compromise system security.

skills.name: seo-geo
skills.description_en: SEO & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for websites. Analyze keywords, generate schema markup, optimize for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude) and traditional search (Google, Bing). Use when user wants to improve search visibility, search optimization, search ranking, AI visibility, ChatGPT ranking, Google AI Overview, indexing, JSON-LD, meta tags, or keyword research.

zh.intro: 同时管传统搜索与生成式引擎里的可见性：做关键词分析、生成结构化数据标记，并按 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Copilot、Claude 这类 AI 搜索的引用习惯调整内容，兼顾 Google 与 Bing。核心观点是 AI 搜索不给你排名，它引用来源，能被引用就等于过去的排在第一位。
zh.usage: 第一步做站点体检，正文给的免费脚本是 `python3 scripts/seo_audit.py "https://example.com"`，检查标题、meta、H1、robots、站点地图和加载耗时，不需要 API。之后再按 GEO 的思路补事实、结构与可核对的出处。
zh.notes: 正文强调 AI 搜索按来源引用而不是排名，所以 GEO 的做法偏向把事实和出处写清楚；关键词研究与站点审计可以分开跑，别混成一步。

audits.summary: The seo-geo skill provides a comprehensive toolkit for SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), enabling users to perform keyword research, SERP analysis, and technical audits. It utilizes the DataForSEO API for search data and includes Python scripts for local parsing and reporting. The skill follows best practices for credential management by using environment variables for API authentication and performs web analysis through standard command-line tools and scripts.

skills.name: agentmemory-architecture
skills.description_en: How agentmemory is built, the iii engine primitives it runs on, its storage model, ports, and the viewer. Use when reasoning about how memory is stored or retrieved end to end, when extending the system, or when answering how agentmemory works under the hood.

audits.summary: The skill is purely informational documentation describing the architecture, retrieval model, and storage lifecycle of the agentmemory system. It contains no executable code, script files, or external network dependencies.

skills.name: scrape
skills.description_en: Scrape web content as clean markdown/HTML/JSON via the Bright Data CLI (`bdata scrape`). Use when the user wants to fetch a page, extract content from a list of URLs, or crawl paginated listings. Hands off to `data-feeds` for supported platforms (Amazon, LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, etc.) and to `search` when URLs must be discovered first. Requires the Bright Data CLI; proactively guides install + login if missing.

audits.summary: This skill provides a set of tools and best practices for web scraping using the Bright Data CLI. It allows for fetching content in various formats (markdown, HTML, JSON, screenshots) and includes robust shell patterns for batch processing and error recovery. While it processes untrusted external content, which presents an indirect prompt injection surface, this is an inherent aspect of its functionality as a scraping tool and is managed through suggested verification steps.

skills.name: agently-mail
skills.description_en: 通过 agently-cli 命令行工具操作邮件：发送、回复、转发、搜索、读取、下载附件、管理收件箱。当用户需要进行任何邮件相关操作时使用此 skill。

zh.intro: 通过 agently-cli 收发和管理邮件：发送、回复、转发、搜索、读信、下载附件、整理收件箱，凭据走 OAuth 授权后存在本机。任何邮件相关的操作都可以走它，后台管理在 agent.qq.com；授权必须在浏览器里完成，CLI 会把授权链接打出来。
zh.usage: 首次用先装 CLI 再授权：`npm install -g @tencent-qqmail/agently-cli`、`agently-cli auth login`，之后用 `agently-cli +me` 确认当前授权的邮箱。技能本身可以用 `npx skills add https://agent.qq.com --skill -g -y` 安装。`agently-cli auth status` 看状态，`agently-cli auth logout` 清本机凭据。
zh.notes: 授权是交互式长命令，正文要求在后台（pty）运行，把它输出的原始授权 URL 原样发给用户，不做编码或拼接改动；失败或超时不要重试，直接把错误反馈回去。

skills.name: service-mesh-observability
skills.description_en: Implement comprehensive observability for service meshes including distributed tracing, metrics, and visualization. Use when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency issues, or implementing SLOs for service communication.

zh.intro: 给服务网格补可观测性的技能：分布式追踪、指标采集和可视化三块，借助网格自身的遥测能力定位跨服务延迟，并把服务间通信的 SLO 落到具体指标上。适合刚接网格要建监控，或延迟问题查不出在哪一跳的时候。
zh.usage: 网格刚上线要建监控、跨服务调用变慢，或要给服务间通信定 SLO 时用它；先确定埋点和采样，再看面板。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令与配置以正文为准；正文把追踪、指标、可视化当作一套来讲。

audits.summary: The skill provides safe templates, configurations, and commands for implementing observability in service meshes such as Istio and Linkerd. No malicious patterns or security risks were detected.

skills.name: nft-standards
skills.description_en: Implement NFT standards (ERC-721, ERC-1155) with proper metadata handling, minting strategies, and marketplace integration. Use when creating NFT contracts, building NFT marketplaces, or implementing digital asset systems.

zh.intro: 实现 NFT 标准的技能，围绕 ERC-721 和 ERC-1155 讲元数据处理、铸造策略与市场对接：元数据存放方式、批量铸造与懒铸造的取舍、授权和交易接口的对接要点。适合要写 NFT 合约或搭交易市场的时候参考。
zh.usage: 要写 NFT 合约、定元数据方案，或接市场协议时用它；先定 ERC-721 还是 ERC-1155，再谈铸造方式。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体合约细节以正文为准；正文把元数据、铸造与市场集成分开讲。

audits.summary: The skill provides standard Solidity smart contract templates and documentation for NFT standards (ERC-721, ERC-1155) and metadata implementation. No security issues or malicious patterns were found.

skills.name: zoom-mcp
skills.description_en: Guidance for the bundled Zoom MCP connectors. Use after routing to an MCP workflow when planning or troubleshooting tool-based access to meetings, recordings, meeting assets, or transcripts. Route Zoom Docs requests to the dedicated Docs MCP server and Whiteboard-specific requests to `zoom-mcp/whiteboard`.

audits.summary: This skill provides clear configuration guidelines and workflow instructions for integrating the Zoom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. It outlines standard security practices such as utilizing per-user OAuth tokens rather than server-to-server configurations and managing credentials locally through environment variables. No security issues or risky programmatic practices were detected.

skills.name: extension-stripe
skills.description_en: Payment support based on Stripe, supporting credit cards and debit cards. Checkout and session status use HTTP outcalls. For inbound Stripe webhooks (POST to the canister), also load extension-http-endpoints.

audits.summary: This skill provides a standard Stripe payment integration for the Caffeine AI platform. It handles checkout sessions and payment status tracking using established vendor-specific libraries and follows security best practices such as admin-only configuration for API secrets and proper error handling for redirects. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: extension-http-outcalls
skills.description_en: HTTP outcalls performed by the backend canister (not in the frontend), including mandatory local verification of external REST API requests. Canister → internet only. For inbound webhooks / curl endpoints served by the canister, use extension-http-endpoints instead.

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions and Motoko code templates for performing HTTP outcalls on the Internet Computer. It emphasizes security best practices for canisters, including mandatory response bounding and local verification using curl and a compliance check tool. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: code-review-expert
skills.description_en: Expert code review of current git changes with a senior engineer lens. Detects SOLID violations, security risks, and proposes actionable improvements.

zh.intro: 以资深工程师视角审当前 git 改动，默认只出评审意见不改代码：先用 `git status -sb`、`git diff --stat` 与 `git diff` 圈定范围，再按 P0 到 P3 分级，P0 是安全漏洞、数据丢失或正确性 bug，必须挡合并。检查面包括 SOLID 与架构味道、可删代码（分清现在能删与留计划删）、安全与可靠性（XSS、注入、SSRF、路径穿越、鉴权缺口、密钥泄漏、竞态）。diff 超过 500 行先按文件汇总再分批审。
zh.usage: 要审当前改动、判断这次提交能不能合、找 SOLID 违规或安全风险时用；要顺手改代码得另外说明。
zh.notes: 正文引用 references/solid-checklist.md、removal-plan.md 与 security-checklist.md 三份清单。

audits.summary: The 'Code Review Expert' skill provides structured analysis of code changes, focusing on security, performance, and design principles. It operates using local git tools and requires user approval before making any changes to the codebase, maintaining a safe and transparent workflow.

skills.name: extension-qr-code
skills.description_en: QR code scanner using the camera.

audits.summary: The skill provides a QR code scanning interface using the device camera. It dynamically loads the jsQR library from a public CDN and provides scanned data to the agent. This introduces a surface for indirect prompt injection, as the agent may process malicious instructions contained within scanned QR codes.

skills.name: mo-qa
skills.description_en: Run and control Mo QA sessions with Momentic's `qa` CLI. Use for bug bashes, status checks, report export, replies to Mo, file transfer, or repairs based on Mo findings.

zh.intro: Mo 在托管沙箱里跑浏览器 QA，文件和进程都在远端，用 qa 命令行起会话、控场和取结果：bug bash、查状态、导出报告、回复 Mo、传文件、按发现做修复。开工前先看版本，缺或旧就照安装参考装，鉴权报错看鉴权参考，本地或私有目标先看隧道参考。给 Mo 的 brief 要交代目标地址（含路径和查询）、用户目标与已知需求、登录方式和测试账号标签、允许的测试数据、禁止改动的动作与数据、要测和要排除的范围；默认让 Mo 自己规划流程、用例和子代理编排，别塞检查清单或指定用例数。Mo 跑的时候要保持被测版本稳定，别热重载、重启、部署或改共享测试数据。发现用状态查询带完整模式取回，bug 类已经独立复现过，flag 类是拼写这类单帧静态问题、没复现，用例结论分已验证、有问题、被阻塞三档；向用户汇报要带名称、证据、状态和网页地址。
zh.usage: 要跑一轮浏览器 QA 或查进度时，先确认版本和登录，再把目标地址、禁改项和测试账号交代清楚，让 Mo 自己排计划。
zh.notes: 需要 qa 命令行和能访问的目标；Mo 使用期间不能改动被测版本或共享测试数据；本地与私有目标要先配隧道；缺权限或范围时问用户，别自己编。

audits.summary: The skill uses a high-risk installation method (piping a remote script to the shell) and instructs the use of a generic NPM package, which could lead to supply chain risks. Additionally, it processes remote data that could be used for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: vision
skills.description_en: See and understand images when you (the current model) have no native vision. Use this WHENEVER you need to look at, read, describe, OCR, or reason about the contents of an image, screenshot, photo, diagram, chart, UI mockup, or scanned page — including when the user references a local image file or an image URL and you cannot view it yourself. Also triggers on: 看图 / 识图 / 截图 / 图片内容 / OCR 文字识别 / 这张图是什么. Delegates the actual seeing to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision model via a small script.

audits.summary: The skill provides image understanding by delegating tasks to a remote vision model. It uses a script that reads local files or remote URLs and sends their content to a configurable API. The security risks include the potential for arbitrary file reading and transmission if the tool is misused, and an attack surface for indirect prompt injection via malicious image content.

skills.name: eas-app-stores
skills.description_en: Build and submit iOS and Android apps with EAS to TestFlight, the App Store, or Google Play. Supports Expo and other React Native projects, plus existing native apps. Use for eas.json setup, release pipelines, signing, app versions and build numbers, store submissions, and listing metadata. For Expo websites and API routes, use eas-hosting; for adding React Native screens to a native app, use expo-brownfield.

zh.intro: 用 EAS 构建并提交 iOS、Android 应用到 TestFlight、App Store 或 Google Play：eas.json 配置、发布流水线、签名、版本号和 build number、商店提交与商店页元数据。Expo 和其他 React Native 项目都行，已有原生应用也能只把它当发布通道，不必引入 RN 运行时；纯 SwiftUI/UIKit 项目要先看原生 iOS 的说明，保留 Xcode 工程作为源头。正文反复提醒：构建成功或提交排队不等于苹果已接受，处理和可用性要另外查。
zh.usage: 说「发布到 TestFlight」并给出 bundle id 和当前版本号，它会按对应参考文件给构建和提交步骤；CI 里的自动发布看 workflows 那份参考。
zh.notes: EAS 云构建会消耗套餐额度，Apple 开发者账号和 Google Play 会员另算；原生 Android 目前只有提交到 Play 的说明，没有独立的原生 Android 配置走查。

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions and tools for deploying iOS and Android apps using EAS (Expo Application Services). It follows standard security practices for credential management and uses official Expo tooling.

skills.name: firecrawl-crawl
skills.description_en: Bulk extract content from an entire website or site section. Use this skill when the user wants to crawl a site, extract all pages from a docs section, bulk-scrape multiple pages following links, or says "crawl", "get all the pages", "extract everything under /docs", "bulk extract", or needs content from many pages on the same site. Handles depth limits, path filtering, and concurrent extraction.

audits.summary: The skill provides standard documentation and instructions for bulk-extracting web data using the Firecrawl CLI. It introduces a potential indirect prompt injection surface through the ingestion of untrusted web content.

skills.name: firecrawl-map
skills.description_en: Discover and list all URLs on a website, with optional search filtering. Use this skill when the user wants to find a specific page on a large site, list all URLs, see the site structure, find where something is on a domain, or says "map the site", "find the URL for", "what pages are on", or "list all pages". Essential when the user knows which site but not which exact page.

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions and examples for using the Firecrawl CLI tool to discover and map website URLs. It is safe for use and adheres to standard practices for utilizing vendor-provided utilities.

skills.name: pr
skills.description_en: Open a pull request for the current feature

audits.summary: The skill automates pull request creation and management for the Remotion project. It utilizes standard development tools like Git, GitHub CLI, and Bun, and follows security best practices by using file-based inputs to prevent shell injection vulnerabilities.

skills.name: k-skill-setup
skills.description_en: Install the k-skill bundle, use the unified CLI, resolve credentials, verify the runtime, and optionally configure update checks and GitHub starring.

audits.summary: The skill performs system setup tasks including downloading tools from the author's registry and configuring automated update checks. It uses a dynamic instruction model where the agent is told to follow instructions fetched at runtime from a CLI tool, and it establishes persistence on the host machine through cron jobs or scheduled tasks.

skills.name: n8n-mcp-tools-expert
skills.description_en: Expert guide for using n8n-mcp MCP tools effectively. Use when searching for nodes, validating configurations, accessing templates, managing workflows, organizing workflows into folders, managing credentials, auditing instance security, or using any n8n-mcp tool. Provides tool selection guidance, parameter formats, and common patterns. IMPORTANT — Always consult this skill before calling any n8n-mcp tool — it prevents common mistakes like wrong nodeType formats, incorrect parameter structures, and inefficient tool usage. If the user mentions n8n, workflows, nodes, or automation and you have n8n MCP tools available, use this skill first.

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive configuration and usage guide for the n8n-mcp server tools. Analysis of the instructions and documentation found no security threats, malicious behavior, or policy violations.

skills.name: agents-sdk
skills.description_en: Build AI agents on Cloudflare Workers using the Agents SDK. Load when creating stateful agents, durable workflows, real-time WebSocket apps, scheduled tasks, MCP servers, or chat applications. Covers Agent class, state management, callable RPC, Workflows integration, and React hooks.

audits.summary: This skill provides documentation and implementation patterns for the Cloudflare Agents SDK. It features an experimental 'Code Mode' that allows an AI to generate and execute JavaScript code to orchestrate complex tasks. This capability presents a high security risk as the generated code is derived from model outputs that can be influenced by untrusted data such as inbound emails or third-party Model Context Protocol (MCP) server outputs.

skills.name: plannotator-setup-goal
skills.description_en: Turn an idea or objective into a goal package for /goal. Interviews the user, builds a reviewed fact sheet via Plannotator, then explores the codebase to produce an execution plan.

audits.summary: The skill facilitates goal planning by interviewing the user via the Plannotator tool and exploring the codebase. It is generally safe but carries a low risk of indirect prompt injection because it processes user-provided interview responses to generate implementation plans.

skills.name: n8n-node-configuration
skills.description_en: Operation-aware node configuration guidance. Use when configuring nodes, understanding property dependencies, determining required fields, choosing between get_node detail levels, or learning common configuration patterns by node type. Always use this skill when setting up node parameters — it explains which fields are required for each operation, how displayOptions control field visibility, and when to use patchNodeField for surgical edits vs full node updates.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive and secure guidance for configuring n8n nodes. It promotes security best practices, such as the use of parameterized SQL queries to prevent injection attacks and iterative validation to ensure correct configuration.

skills.name: dbs-action
skills.description_en: 用阿德勒心理学框架诊断执行阻滞。用户知道该做什么却迟迟不做、反复拖延或行动中断时使用。

audits.summary: This skill is a structured diagnostic framework based on Adlerian psychology designed to help users identify and overcome execution blockage. It is entirely instructional and does not contain any executable code, scripts, or network operations. The skill also includes built-in safety protocols to handle mentions of self-harm or psychological crisis appropriately.

skills.name: remove-image-watermark
skills.description_en: Remove visible watermarks from an image with the Pilio developer API. Use when the user wants to clean a PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP image, remove image watermark overlays, or automate image watermark removal through Pilio.

audits.summary: The skill uses the official Pilio CLI tool to remove watermarks from images via their developer API. It follows security best practices by utilizing environment variables for API keys and restricting their exposure.

skills.name: byted-ark-seedream-skill
