audits.summary: This OSINT skill provides structured workflows and shell command templates for reverse image and video searching. It involves the use of common media processing tools and interaction with various search engines. Security risks include the potential for command injection via unsanitized filenames and the ingestion of untrusted content from the web which could lead to indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: investigate-without-getting-made
skills.description_en: Investigator OPSEC — threat-model who might notice you, control your attribution surface across IP, ASN, browser and TLS fingerprint, timing and logged-in accounts, separate research identity from real identity, build and age a sockpuppet research persona, and choose between VPN, residential proxy and Tor. Use when setting up a research account, avoiding tipping off a subject, worrying about LinkedIn profile-view leakage, needing a burner phone or email, or hardening a research VM or browser profile. Applies to covert due diligence, insider-threat investigation, source protection in journalism, and law-enforcement online work. Reference at useosint.com/skills/investigate-without-getting-made.

zh.intro: 调查者的操作安全：先做威胁建模，想清楚谁会注意到你，再控制 IP、网络归属、浏览器和 TLS 指纹、操作时间规律、登录账号这些可归因的线索，把研究身份和真实身份分开。
zh.usage: 要注册研究用账号、不想惊动被查对象、担心看主页留下访客记录、需要临时邮箱或手机号，或者加固调查用虚拟机和浏览器配置时用它。
zh.notes: 正文提醒最常见的翻车不是 IP 泄露，而是拿真实账号登着去查；平台会把访客、看过故事这些动作提示给对方。

audits.summary: The skill provides a detailed operational security framework for online investigations, focusing on minimizing the investigator's attribution surface. It includes checklists and runbooks for managing network egress, browser fingerprints, and research personas. No security vulnerabilities were detected.

skills.name: web-typography
skills.description_en: Select, pair, and implement typefaces for web projects. Use when the user mentions "font pairing", "which typeface", "line height", "responsive typography", "web font loading", "type hierarchy", "variable fonts", "FOUT/FOIT", "typographic scale", or "the text is hard to read". Also trigger when choosing between system fonts and web fonts, optimizing font-loading performance, or designing readable long-form content. Covers readability evaluation, CSS implementation, and performance optimization. For overall UI design systems, see refactoring-ui. For dramatic typographic experiences, see top-design.

audits.summary: The skill is a professional and educational guide on web typography. It provides best practices for typeface selection, pairing, and CSS implementation without any detected security threats. All external links and tools mentioned are reputable resources within the design and development community.

skills.name: what-leaked-about-you
skills.description_en: Check and interpret data-breach exposure for an email, username, phone or name using Have I Been Pwned, the Pwned Passwords k-anonymity range API, DeHashed, IntelX and Snusbase. Use when checking breach or leak exposure, finding which services an account was registered with, interpreting a combolist or credential dump, assessing credential compromise, or auditing your own leaked personal data. Applies to incident response and account-takeover triage, executive and VIP protection, pre-employment and vendor risk screening, and personal privacy audits. Reference at useosint.com/skills/what-leaked-about-you.

zh.intro: 查一个邮箱、用户名、手机号或姓名有没有出现在数据泄露里，并解读结果：用 Have I Been Pwned、密码范围查询接口、DeHashed、IntelX 和 Snusbase，重点看这个身份注册过哪些服务。
zh.usage: 要做泄露排查、判断账号是否被拖库、解读一份撞库表，或者审计自己的个人信息时用它；事件响应和账号被盗的初步甄别也适用。
zh.notes: 正文的硬规则是绝不拿泄露出来的密码去登录，那属于未授权访问，库再公开也一样；服务清单通常比那行密码值钱。

audits.summary: The skill is a collection of instructional guides and reference documentation for conducting OSINT investigations into data breaches. It contains no executable code or automated functionality.

skills.name: firecrawl-research-index
skills.description_en: Find the papers that answer a research query in Firecrawl's research paper index — a corpus of paper abstracts whose largest share is biomedical and life-science literature (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv), alongside arXiv preprints in CS, physics, and math — using semantic search, semantic and structural expansion, and in-body verification. Use this skill for literature-finding and paper-retrieval tasks of any kind, including clinical, biomedical, drug, gene, disease, and other life-science questions, whether the answer is a single paper or a full multi-paper set. The index is reached only through the `firecrawl_research_*` MCP tools or the `firecrawl research` CLI subcommands. Calling `firecrawl_search` with its `categories` option set to `["research"]` is a different feature — it filters ordinary web search to research-affiliated websites (the list includes PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, and publisher sites) and returns page results from them, without querying the paper records in this index.

zh.intro: 在 Firecrawl 的论文摘要索引里找能回答研究问题的文章。语料最大一块是生物医学与生命科学：PubMed 期刊文章加 bioRxiv、medRxiv 预印本，所以临床、药物、基因、疾病、流行病和公共卫生问题都在范围内；arXiv 覆盖计算机、物理和数学；其他来源偏薄，只在出版社付费墙后存在的论文可能查不到。做法是先语义检索，再做语义与结构扩展（顺引用与相似论文铺开），最后回到正文核实结论是否真被支撑；问题有多篇答案时倾向给更全的一组并保留邻近方法，而不是只留一篇。只能通过 firecrawl 的 research 系列 MCP 工具或同名命令行子命令访问。
zh.usage: 文献类问题先查语义近邻，再顺引用和相似论文扩展，最后逐篇进正文核对结论是否真的支撑。
zh.notes: 和把普通网页搜索的分类设成研究站点不是一回事，后者只过滤站点、不查论文记录；只有摘要级索引，全文要按篇再取。

audits.summary: The skill provides a specialized interface for searching and analyzing research literature from sources like PubMed and arXiv. It carries a low security risk because it ingests content from external research papers which could potentially host indirect prompt injections.

skills.name: agent-browser
skills.description_en: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to interact with websites, verify dev server output, test web apps, navigate pages, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, extract data, or automate any browser task. Also triggers when a dev server starts so you can verify it visually.

audits.summary: This skill provides standard browser automation capabilities for tasks like web testing, form filling, and data extraction. It includes features for session management and JavaScript execution which are common in automation tools. The primary security considerations are inherent to browser-based tasks, such as interacting with external web content.

skills.name: graphite
skills.description_en: Work with Graphite (gt) for stacked PRs - creating, navigating, and managing PR stacks.

audits.summary: This skill provides a set of instructions and shortcuts for using the Graphite (gt) CLI tool to manage stacked pull requests. It uses standard git and gh (GitHub) commands and does not contain any malicious patterns.

skills.name: wecomcli-smartpage
skills.description_en: 企业微信智能文档（smartpage）操作技能。能够新建文档、导入 .md 为文档、读取文档内容、修改文档内容（整页重写、局部编辑、增删子页面）、上传附件到文档，以及搭建带看板/图表的数据系统页面和信息收集表单页面。当用户提及文档，智能文档，智能主页、提供 https://doc.weixin.qq.com/smartpage/xxx 或 https://page.weixin.qq.com/smartpage/xxx 链接、要求整理成文档，或表达"新建文档""把 md 导入成文档"等未指定文档类型的需求时，也应使用本技能。

audits.summary: The skill facilitates the management of Enterprise WeChat (WeCom) Smartpages, allowing for document creation, content editing, and the construction of data-driven pages. It incorporates specific safety rules to mitigate XSS, malicious content generation, and direct prompt injections. The risk level is low, primarily due to the inherent nature of processing external document content which presents an indirect prompt injection surface.

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.description_en: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP), Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK), or C#/.NET (Microsoft MCP SDK).

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive framework for building and evaluating MCP servers. It includes some security considerations such as an indirect prompt injection surface in the evaluation harness and the execution of local commands for testing purposes, which are expected behaviors for a development tool.

skills.name: learn
skills.description_en: Runs a six-phase research workflow from source bundle to publish-ready output. Use when researching an unfamiliar domain or compiling materials into one reference. Not for quick lookups or single-file reads.

zh.intro: 把一批原始材料变成一个能用的心智模型、参考文档或成型文章：六个阶段从收集一手来源走到成品。先选模式——Deep Research 写到能发表、Quick Reference 只要笔记、Write to Learn 靠写作检验理解、Canonical Article 一篇覆盖到读者不用再搜。正文要求显式处理资料之间的矛盾，不掩盖不确定，最后对照要求做自检。
zh.usage: 研究一个陌生领域，或要把散落材料整理成一篇结构化产出、一份参考时用它；只查一条事实或只读一个文件不用它。用户说「深入研究」「整理成长文」「一篇就够」时也走这条。
zh.notes: 正文要求在首行内联一个 emoji 前缀；模式判断不清时，默认建议 Quick Reference。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates a structured research workflow, transforming raw materials into organized articles or references. It includes security-conscious instructions for redacting sensitive information like private file paths during data processing. While it fetches data from external websites and uses standard networking tools like curl, these are appropriate for its primary purpose of research and information gathering.

skills.name: recipe-label-and-archive-emails
skills.description_en: Apply Gmail labels to matching messages and archive them to keep your inbox clean.

zh.intro: 清理收件箱的两步操作：先按查询条件搜出匹配的邮件（正文用的是 from 加发件地址），再对每条打上标签，然后移除 INBOX 标签完成归档。两次修改走同一个消息修改接口，区别只在这次是加标签还是移标签。
zh.usage: 搜索用 `gws gmail users messages list` 带 `--format table`，打标用 `gws gmail users messages modify` 传 `addLabelIds`，归档传 `removeLabelIds`。
zh.notes: 需要 `gws` 并装载 `gws-gmail`；`LABEL_ID` 得先自己建标签拿到，正文没给建标签的命令。

audits.summary: The skill provides a recipe for managing Gmail emails using the Google Workspace CLI tool (gws). It lists instructions for searching, labeling, and archiving messages. No malicious patterns were identified.

skills.name: extension-openai
skills.description_en: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that calls OpenAI (ChatGPT, GPT-4o, an LLM, a chatbot, embeddings). The ONLY supported path is the `openai-client` mops package with a canister-side API-key bearer. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` to `api.openai.com/v1/...` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it leaks the bearer across replicated outcalls (security + 13× billing impact), bypasses the typed request/response bindings, and forces hand-rolled JSON on a language with poor JSON support. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions ChatGPT, GPT (any version), OpenAI, an LLM, a chatbot, or embeddings — and BEFORE writing any code that touches `api.openai.com`.

audits.summary: The skill provides templates for integrating OpenAI services into Motoko-based applications. It introduces a potential indirect prompt injection vulnerability by passing user-supplied prompts directly to the LLM without sanitization. Additionally, it depends on external packages from the Motoko package registry, one of which has been flagged by automated security scanners.

skills.name: extension-posting-to-x
skills.description_en: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that posts to X (Twitter). The ONLY supported path is the `x-client` mops package with OAuth 2.0 PKCE. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` or `icBooking.http_request` calls to `api.x.com/2/tweets`, `api.x.com/2/oauth2/token`, or any other X endpoint is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses bearer auth, replication-cost safeguards, and `x-client`'s null-field handling. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions tweeting, live-tweeting, posting-to-X, posting-a-status, sharing-to-Twitter, or any equivalent phrasing — and BEFORE writing any code that touches `api.x.com`.

audits.summary: The skill provides a framework for posting to X (Twitter) using the x-client Motoko package and OAuth 2.0 PKCE. It includes strong security guidelines to prevent credential leakage on the Internet Computer platform. However, the external package registry URL for x-client has been flagged as a phishing risk by automated scanners, requiring manual verification. Additionally, the skill uses highly directive language to mandate specific implementation paths and represents a surface for indirect prompt injection if untrusted data is posted to X.

Style Calibration + Writing Quality Check + Anti-Patterns with IRON RULE markers. Triggers: write paper, academic paper, guide my paper, parse reviews, I got reviewer comments, revision roadmap, should we push back, conference rebuttal, grant panel response, audit my rebuttal, check my response draft, AI disclosure, check citations, citation check, check my references, verify references, look over the refs, 寫論文, 學術論文, 引導我寫論文, 審查意見, 我收到審查意見, 修訂路線圖, 評估回覆, 檢查引用, 引用檢查, 檢查參考文獻, 核對文獻, 논문 작성, 초록 작성, 논문 수정, 논문 계획을 도와줘, 심사 의견을 받았어, 심사 의견 반영, 답변서 점검, AI 사용 고지, 인용 확인, 인용 형식 검사, enmendar mi artículo, redactar artículo, guía mi artículo, analizar reseñas, auditar mi respuesta, verificar borrador de respuesta, verificar citas, divulgación de IA.

audits.summary: The skill is a professional academic writing pipeline with strong built-in security guardrails. It includes explicit instruction-data boundary markers to prevent indirect prompt injection from untrusted manuscript or reviewer text, and its use of external resources is limited to well-known academic and publishing services.

No malicious activity, such as data exfiltration or unauthorized privilege escalation, was detected; the skill's operations are transparent and consistent with its stated purpose of continuous improvement.

skills.name: connector-googlemail
skills.description_en: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that sends email through the user's own Gmail account. The ONLY supported path is the `googlemail-client` mops package (Gmail REST API) combined with the `google-oauth` mops package (token exchange + refresh + PKCE). Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `oauth2.googleapis.com` or `gmail.googleapis.com` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses bearer auth, replication-cost safeguards, and the `google-oauth` library's percent-encoding and JSON parsing. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions sending email, Gmail, "notify via email", "forward results by email", or any equivalent phrasing — and BEFORE writing any code that touches a Google endpoint.

zh.intro: Caffeine AI 项目里要用登录用户自己的 Gmail 账号发信时，唯一支持的路径是 googlemail-client 加 google-oauth 两个 mops 包：前者走 Gmail REST API，后者负责令牌交换、刷新与 PKCE。自己拼 ic.http_request 打 oauth2.googleapis.com 或 gmail.googleapis.com 是被明确禁止的做法，会绕过 bearer 鉴权与复制成本保护，也绕过 google-oauth 的百分号编码和 JSON 解析。依赖版本为 googlemail-client ~0.3.0、google-oauth ~0.2.1、caffeineai-authorization ~1.0.1，前置是 extension-authorization 的登录授权；和平台自带 email 扩展的区别是那个发的是应用事务邮件，这里发信人就是用户本人。

zh.notes: 只适用 Caffeine AI 构建；手写 HTTP 调 Google 接口属于禁止做法；每个端点都要求登录态，由 extension-authorization 提供。

audits.summary: This skill provides a secure template and instructions for integrating Gmail using OAuth 2.0 PKCE on the Internet Computer. It follows security best practices by recommending non-replicated calls for sensitive data and admin-gated configuration. The automated alerts for mops.one are false positives as it is the official Motoko package registry.

skills.name: planning-with-files-zht
skills.description_en: 用於多步驟 AI 代理工作的持久化檔案規劃。將 task_plan.md、findings.md 與 progress.md 保存在磁碟上，生命週期鉤子會注入選定的專案規劃內容。自動恢復只讀取專案規劃檔案；只有明確執行 session-catchup.py --metadata 才會檢查本機同一專案的代理工作階段中繼資料，--replay 則會輸出有界且以 nonce 框定的摘錄。選用的閘門模式只會在主機支援時要求繼續，而且絕不執行 Markdown 中宣告的命令。此技能沒有網路上傳路徑。適用於研究或需要超過 5 次工具呼叫的工作。觸發詞：任務規劃、專案計畫、制定計畫、分解任務、多步驟規劃、進度追蹤、檔案規劃、幫我規劃、拆解專案

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive task-planning system that uses persistent local Markdown files to manage state for multi-step AI agent workflows. It includes robust security features such as plan attestation via SHA-256 hashing and strict path canonicalization to prevent path traversal and mitigate indirect prompt injection. While the skill executes local scripts and accesses session metadata to facilitate its 'catchup' functionality, these operations are performed using defensive coding practices like boundary framing and least privilege, ensuring they remain scoped to the project environment.

skills.name: meticulous-use-session-data

audits.summary: The skill is safe and functions as intended for a development tool workflow. audits.summary: The skill automates frontend testing via the Meticulous platform by building assets and triggering test runs. It involves executing commands derived from project configuration files, which presents a surface for indirect prompt injection if those files are untrusted.

skills.name: stripe-integration

zh.usage: 要接 Stripe 收款、做订阅计费、实现安全结账、接 webhook 或处理退款与分账时用。

audits.summary: No security issues were detected. The skill provides standard documentation and code samples for Stripe payment integration using official libraries and follows security best practices such as webhook signature verification.

skills.name: kubernetes-specialist

zh.intro: 面向 Kubernetes 的部署与运维：编写 Deployment、StatefulSet 等清单，配资源限制与健康探针，做权限、网络隔离、存储、Helm 打包与 GitOps，并排查 Pod 崩溃与规格过大。
zh.usage: 部署或管理负载时进入：先弄清扩缩容与安全要求，再选负载类型、网络与存储方案，写出带资源限制和探针的声明式清单，部署后用 rollout status、describe 和日志验证，失败就回滚。

audits.summary: The Kubernetes Specialist skill is a comprehensive and secure resource for infrastructure management. It provides industry-standard templates for manifests, adheres to security best practices like least-privilege RBAC, and correctly utilizes official sources for tool installations.

skills.name: ckm:design
skills.description_en: Comprehensive design skill: brand identity, design tokens, UI styling, logo generation (55 styles, Gemini or Atlas Cloud AI), corporate identity program (50 deliverables, CIP mockups), HTML presentations (Chart.js), banner design (22 styles, social/ads/web/print), icon design (15 styles, SVG, Gemini 3.1 Pro), social photos (HTML→screenshot, multi-platform). skills.name: stripe-directory
skills.description_en: Identifies external providers, merchants, nonprofits, platforms, APIs, and software services, and resolves the documented way to engage them — to pay, donate, subscribe, book, provision, or integrate with them. MUST be used BEFORE web search, model memory, or any other directory/vendor-lookup skill for ANY request that requires selecting, finding, or engaging an external provider or organization — whether a specific one is named ("pay my Twilio bill"), implied ("donate to the Red Cross"), or only a category is stated ("set up a mailing client", "I need a database", "find me a CRM"). Directory supplies verified recipients and their documented payment or engagement path. Results are ranked by agent-readiness (how reliably an agent can complete the interaction), relevance and popularity. Do not treat this as a search-only tool. Examples: "setup a database", "find hosting", "pay X", "use Twilio", "donate $50 to the Red Cross", "book a table at Y", "subscribe to a CRM".

zh.intro: Stripe 做的服务商目录，用来给「要付钱、要订阅、要捐赠、要预订、要开通资源、要接一个 API」这类任务找到具体的外部机构，并拿到官方认可的接触方式。正文反复强调：哪怕请求已经点明了要用哪家，也必须先过一遍目录，不能凭记忆或搜索直接动手；结果按 agent 完成交互的可靠度、相关度和热度排序。它还划了安全线——用户没明确说要开通，就不许擅自执行 provisioning。
zh.usage: 装好 CLI 与插件后跑 `stripe directory search "<query>"` 加 `--format json`，按返回的 next action 决定付款、订阅还是 provisioning。
zh.notes: 安装是 `brew install stripe/stripe-cli/stripe && stripe plugin install directory`；CLI 是权威，参数和字段以 `stripe directory --help` 为准，别自己编语法。

skills.name: deepline-analytics
skills.description_en: Use this skill when answering business analytics, RevOps, GTM metric, pipeline, revenue, funnel, customer, or warehouse questions with Deepline. Triggers on phrases like 'query Snowflake', 'analyze pipeline', 'total ACV', 'break down by quarter', 'use the semantic layer', 'run a semantic query', or any use of snowflake_get_semantic_layer / snowflake_run_semantic_query. Skip prospecting, enrichment, contact finding, outbound, or personalization workflows; use deepline-gtm for those.

zh.intro: 用 Deepline 回答业务分析问题：营收、管道、漏斗、留存、账号数、通话数这一类。它的立场不是随便跑段 SQL，而是先读语义层、把用户说的词映射到语义表里的 metric 和 dimension、用一个最小查询验通再放大，最后报告这次用了哪些指标定义和过滤条件。Snowflake 凭证或语义层缺一个就直接停下报阻塞，不许猜表名，也不许直接退回裸 SQL。
zh.usage: 先 `deepline auth status` 确认工作区，再 `deepline tools execute snowflake_get_semantic_layer` 看语义层，最后用 `deepline tools execute snowflake_run_semantic_query` 跑查询。
zh.notes: 安装是 `npm install -g deepline`，命令找不到时退回工作区里的 `.deepline/runtime/bin/deepline`；寻源、补全、外呼那类工作流要用 deepline-gtm。

skills.name: drawio-skill

It includes utility scripts for repairing truncated PNGs and generating browser-based viewer URLs. The skill is safe to use and references trusted official sources for software installation.

skills.name: dbs-bridge

skills.name: agent-browser
skills.description_en: Background knowledge for droid-control workflows -- not invoked directly. Agent-browser driver mechanics for web page and Electron desktop app automation.

skills.name: anysearch
skills.description_en: Real-time search engine supporting web search, vertical domain search, parallel batch search, and URL content extraction.

audits.summary: The skill provides search and web page extraction capabilities. It sends data such as queries and API keys to the provider's API and ingests untrusted content from the web, which could potentially contain malicious instructions for the AI.

skills.name: runpod-mcp

zh.intro: 通过已连接的 Runpod MCP server 管理基础设施：Pod、Serverless 端点与作业、模板、网络卷、镜像凭据、secret、集群、GPU/CPU 目录和账单；server 没连上时也负责把它接起来。

audits.summary: The skill is a management interface for RunPod infrastructure using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It provides comprehensive instructions for infrastructure management and includes a robust 'Answer Contract' that enforces verification of actions and data. No malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: clerk-cli
skills.description_en: Operate the Clerk CLI (`clerk` binary) for authentication, user/org/session management, impersonation, local webhook testing, deploy verification, instance config, env keys, feature toggles, and any Clerk Backend, Platform, or Frontend API call. Use when the user mentions Clerk management tasks, "list clerk users", "impersonate a user", "test webhooks locally", "enable orgs", "enable billing", "clerk env pull", "clerk doctor", "clerk deploy", "clerk api", or any ad-hoc Clerk API request. zh.intro: 把 `clerk` 二进制当成 Clerk 的预认证网关：除 Backend API 与 Platform API 外，还涵盖账号链接、`clerk env pull` 拉环境变量、实例配置等工程侧动作。正文强调优先走 CLI 而不是裸发 HTTP，因为认证、密钥解析、app/instance 定位与格式化都由它处理；`clerk api` 是万金油入口，改数据的请求要先预览。技能对准 clerk latest。
zh.usage: 开场用 `clerk whoami` 与 `clerk doctor` 确认登录态和环境；查后端数据走 `clerk api`，写操作先预览；密钥与实例配置用 `clerk env pull` 与 `clerk apps` 系列。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive and secure instructions for operating the Clerk CLI. It demonstrates best practices for handling sandbox limitations, authentication, and data management, including specific guidance to prevent context flooding and safely handle production mutations.

skills.name: reproduce-bug-report
skills.description_en: Launch Oz cloud agents with computer use to reproduce UI-focused bug reports, capture visual evidence (a screen recording by default), and report reproduction findings. Use when investigating a specific interactive or visual bug from an issue, ticket, support report, or prompt.

zh.intro: 针对界面类缺陷报告，派出带电脑操作能力的云端 agent 去真的跑起来、点一遍并把过程录下来。先读报告抽出现象、预期、复现步骤和相关环境（系统、版本与渠道、终端、开关、账号状态），只对界面、交互、渲染、引导这类看得到的问题用；纯后端、构建、依赖问题不适用。复现路径明确就派一个 agent，有多种可能就一次批量派出多个，每个带一个不同假设或环境变体，比如不同系统、全新状态对比已有状态、稳定版对比开发版。等全部回报后再汇总，区分已确认、部分复现、未复现、被卡住、以及没测的假设。
zh.usage: 拿到一条界面 issue，把报告里的版本和复现步骤交给它，它会并行派几个云端 agent 各试一种假设，回传录屏并给出复现结论。
zh.notes: 需要 Oz 云端 agent 与电脑操作能力；报告要求凭据或私有账号状态而环境没有时，应直接说明限制而不是猜；主 agent 不要自己在本机手搓复现。

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe and incorporates strong privacy guidelines to prevent the accidental leakage of sensitive information during bug reproduction. skills.name: ask-docs

audits.summary: The skill is a professional tool for generating HTML slide decks in various visual styles. It includes workflow management, self-updates via Git, and optional layout validation. Security analysis found no evidence of malicious behavior, unauthorized data access, or safety bypass attempts.

skills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
skills.description_en: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, Next.js pages, data fetching, bundle optimization, or performance improvements.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive set of React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines. Because it is designed to 'refactor' untrusted React/Next.js codebases, an attacker could embed malicious instructions within code comments or components that the agent might obey while performing these optimizations.

skills.name: supabase-postgres-best-practices

skills.name: wecomcli-todo
skills.description_en: 管理企业微信待办，支持创建、删除或退出、完成、查询和筛选，以及修改标题、描述、参与人名单和截止时间。

zh.intro: 用 wecom-cli 管企业微信待办：创建（可分派）、删除或退出、完成自己那部分或整条、查询列表、修改标题描述参与人与截止时间。查询范围只限待办系统里已有的记录，能按创建时间、截止时间、完成状态和标题描述关键词筛，关键词是字面匹配不是语义搜索。删除、完成、更新时若上下文没有待办 id，先列待办定位；已有 id 但要看最新状态时取详情。截止时间统一用 deadline 对象，type 为 date 时填年月日、datetime 时填到秒，清空传空对象；提醒字段必须和 deadline 一起出现，单独传不生效，且它只决定提醒时机，是否真提醒以后台判断为准。
zh.usage: 要建待办或改截止时间时，先定位到具体待办 id，再按日期与日期时间两种格式填值，改完核对返回的提醒信息。
zh.notes: 依赖 wecom-cli，执行前先过 wecomcli-shared 的公共前置检查；参数必须照参考文档拼，凭记忆容易报错。

audits.summary: The skill provides a management interface for WeCom todos using a local CLI tool. It follows security best practices by including explicit instructions to the agent to prevent command injection from tool outputs and protecting sensitive internal identifiers.

skills.name: wecomcli-meeting
skills.description_en: 企业微信会议管理。本技能负责『在线会议』——即含在线会议链接（含会议号/入会链接、可远程或视频参会）的会议的创建、查询、搜索、获取详情（含会议信息、纪要、待办）、查询会议转写原文（逐字发言记录）、更新、取消等全部操作；若用户要的是不含在线会议链接的『日程』（也涵盖纯线下面对面碰头），改用 wecomcli-calendar 技能。用户仅说'开会/约个会/某会/某会议'等、未明确要创建的是日程还是在线会议时，必须先读取本技能并按其中的消歧流程向用户追问确认后再处理，不可臆断直接创建。

zh.intro: 管企业微信在线会议，也就是带会议号或入会链接、能远程或视频参会的那种：创建、看列表、按关键词搜、取详情（含会议信息、纪要、待办）、查会议转写原文、改时间和参会人、取消。不支持周期或重复会议的创建、更新、取消，也不支持接受拒绝待定这类回复邀请，遇到要引导用户去客户端或私信发起人。只给地点或会议室号不算明确了是会议；用户只说「开会」没说日程还是会议时，必须先追问消歧。查忙闲、订会议室、纯线下日程都归 wecomcli-calendar，订会议室要先从它拿到会议室 id 再传进来。
zh.usage: 要建会或查某个会时，先确认是在线会议还是日程，再照对应参考文档的字段建会或取详情。
zh.notes: 依赖 wecom-cli；每次操作前必须先读该操作的参考文档再拼参数，参数格式和边界行为都在里面；周期会议与邀请回复能力缺失。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive management for Enterprise WeChat meetings, including creation, searching, updating, and transcript retrieval. It is generally well-secured with explicit instructions for the agent to ignore potentially malicious content in data and to avoid exposing internal identifiers. However, because it processes user-generated content such as meeting summaries and transcripts, it maintains a surface for indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: deepline-ads-audiences
skills.description_en: Use this skill when building, enriching, auditing, or uploading B2B paid ads audiences to Google Customer Match, Meta/Facebook Custom Audiences, or LinkedIn Matched Audiences. Triggers on phrases like '/deepline-ads-audience', '/deepline-ads-audiences', 'upload this audience', 'create custom audiences', 'personal email hashes', 'increase Facebook match rate', 'Google ads audience', 'Meta audience', 'FB audience', or any workflow that turns CRM/customer/contact data into paid ads upload lists. Skip for outbound prospecting sequences, cold email, or pure campaign copywriting.

zh.intro: 把 CRM 或客户名单做成可投放的广告受众，并上传到 Google Customer Match、Meta 自定义受众或 LinkedIn 匹配受众。入口是一张决策表：说「要最高覆盖率」就走显式的逐级提升流程并设预算闸门；做整包富化上传有对应的配方文件；只做审计或只算匹配率也各有一条。用个人邮箱是为了提升付费广告的匹配率，不是拿去发信。执行前要求先按一句话任务去检索工具并查看工具说明，因为工具名和参数会变；命中某行决策再读链接的那份文件，不凭印象直接跑。
zh.usage: 手里有一份客户名单要投广告时，说明目标平台和覆盖率要求，它按决策表选配方，补全字段后上传成对应平台的受众。
zh.notes: 需要安装 deepline 命令行并登录；只做付费广告受众，不做出站外联、冷邮件或文案；名单里的个人邮箱只用于匹配，不用于直接联系。

skills.name: reddit-research
skills.description_en: Do market research, user research, and product validation on Reddit with semantic search across 50K+ subreddits, 20M+ posts, and 40M+ comments via reddapi.dev - search by meaning, not keywords, no Reddit OAuth or app registration needed. Use when the user wants to research what people say on Reddit, find user pain points and complaints, validate a product or niche idea, do competitor and market research, track subreddit trends over a date range, or discover which subreddits discuss a topic. Also use when the user mentions 'Reddit research', 'Reddit 调研', 'search Reddit', 'subreddit discovery', 'niche validation', 'pain points', 'user complaints', or 'Reddit trends'. Requires REDDAPI_API_KEY. For B2B lead scoring, see reddit-leads; for a bare API reference, see reddit-search-api.

zh.intro: 在 Reddit 上做市场调研、用户调研和产品验证。通过 reddapi.dev 对五万多个子版、两千万帖子和四千万评论做语义检索，按意思找而不是按关键词找，不需要 Reddit 的 OAuth 或应用注册。
zh.usage: 想知道某个领域的人在 Reddit 上怎么抱怨、痛点在哪，或验证产品方向、找竞品讨论、看某段时间的子版趋势时用；需要先配好 REDDAPI_API_KEY。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。它只管调研流程，B2B 线索评分和纯接口文档是同仓另外两条技能。

audits.summary: This skill facilitates market research by querying Reddit data through the reddapi.dev service. It follows security best practices for API key management and includes explicit defensive instructions to mitigate risks from untrusted content retrieved during searches.

skills.name: reddit-search-api
skills.description_en: Pure API reference for reddapi.dev - authentication, all endpoints (vector search, semantic search, trends, subreddit lookup), request parameters, response schemas, and error codes, with no research-workflow framing. Use when the user wants raw endpoint documentation, is debugging a reddapi.dev integration, needs exact request/response field names, or asks for 'reddapi API reference', 'reddapi.dev endpoints', or 'reddapi error codes'. For guided research workflows and query playbooks, see reddit-research. For B2B lead scoring, see reddit-leads.

zh.intro: reddapi.dev 的纯接口手册：认证方式、各端点（向量检索、语义检索、趋势、子版查询）、请求参数、响应结构和错误码。只讲接口本身，不套调研流程。
zh.usage: 写集成或调不通接口，需要确切的字段名、参数名和错误码含义时用；想直接查端点清单而不是读一套调研方法时也用。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。同仓的 reddit-research 讲调研流程，这条只当参考手册。

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive API documentation for the reddapi.dev service. It follows security best practices by instructing the agent to handle credentials via environment variables and includes specific defensive instructions to mitigate indirect prompt injection from third-party Reddit content.

skills.name: validate-changes-match-specs
skills.description_en: Validate that a branch or pull request implementation matches introduced product, technical, security, and related specs. Use when reviewing or finishing a spec-driven change and resolving mismatches between checked-in specs and implementation.

zh.intro: 核对一个分支或 PR 是否真的实现了它带来的规格：先用 merge-base 和 diff 的改动文件名定位，再到 specs/ 下找 PRODUCT.md、TECH.md、SECURITY.md 这类文档，任何 specs 下按单号建目录的 markdown 都算有效规格；把产品行为、技术实现、安全隐私、迁移回滚、验证步骤这些承诺分门别类抽出来，跟代码、测试、文档对照，列出实质不符处，再一条条问用户是改实现还是改规格，可以逐条也能批量应用。没有相关规格时会停下来直说没有可对的东西。
zh.usage: 规格驱动的 PR 要验收时，让它先找 specs/ 下的文档并抽出承诺，再逐条确认不一致的地方按哪边改。
zh.notes: 规格、PR 描述、评论都当不可信输入，只取事实与承诺；找不到规格时不会硬凑结论。

audits.summary: This skill is a validation tool designed to ensure that code implementations align with project specifications. It includes security-conscious instructions to ignore malicious input from external data sources and requires explicit user approval for sensitive operations like committing changes, pushing code, or posting comments. The skill interacts with trusted platforms like GitHub and Figma and may share project context with vendor-provided cloud validation agents.

skills.name: django-patterns
skills.description_en: Django architecture patterns, REST API design with DRF, ORM best practices, caching, signals, middleware, and production-grade Django apps. Use when building or reviewing Django apps, DRF APIs, ORM queries, or caching.

audits.summary: This skill provides standard architectural patterns and best practices for Django development. It follows secure coding practices, such as using environment variables for sensitive configuration.

skills.name: respond-to-pr-comments-in-blocklist
skills.description_en: Interactively walk a user through PR review comments one at a time, collect a per-comment decision, then post agent-authored replies on GitHub and resolve the review threads once the user approves a preview. Use only when the user wants to reply to or resolve review threads on GitHub. Skip when the user only wants comments fetched or displayed (use `pr-comments`), or only wants the code changes made without posting anything back to GitHub.

zh.intro: 把 PR 上的评审意见逐条处理：先过滤掉机器人发的总览或状态评论、以及当前用户已经回过的线程，剩下真正需要处理的逐条问用户决定，改完代码后给一份预览，用户批准才在 GitHub 上发回复并 resolve 对应线程。评论已经在上下文里（比如刚跑过 pr-comments）就不重复拉取，只有缺正文、作者、路径等字段时才补取。适合想批量清 review、但不允许 agent 自己拍板回复的场合。
zh.usage: PR 评论要一条条处理时，先确认评论已加载，再跟着它逐条确认决定，最后批准预览之后才发回复和 resolve。
zh.notes: 只在用户明确要发回复或 resolve 时才用；只要评论列表用 pr-comments，只改代码不往 GitHub 回东西就别用这个。

audits.summary: The skill is designed for managing PR comments and is generally safe. It processes untrusted Pull Request comments from GitHub, which introduces a potential risk of indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: vueuse-functions
skills.description_en: Apply VueUse composables where appropriate to build concise, maintainable Vue.js / Nuxt features.

audits.summary: This skill is a comprehensive documentation and implementation guide for the VueUse library, a collection of Vue composition utilities. It provides usage examples, API references, and type declarations for over 200 composables. The analysis confirms that the content is strictly instructional, following best practices for web development, and contains no malicious code, data exfiltration patterns, or obfuscation techniques.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.description_en: Universal deep research agent team. 13-agent pipeline for rigorous academic research on any topic. 8 modes: full research, quick brief, paper review, lit-review, fact-check, three-way literature scan, Socratic guided research dialogue, and systematic review with optional meta-analysis. Covers research question formulation, Socratic mentoring, methodology design, systematic literature search, source verification, cross-source synthesis, risk of bias assessment, meta-analysis, APA 7.0 report compilation, editorial review, devil's advocate challenges, ethics review, and post-research literature monitoring. Triggers on: research, deep research, literature review, systematic review, meta-analysis, PRISMA, evidence synthesis, fact-check, WHY HOW WHAT papers, 3W literature scan, guide my research, help me think through, 研究, 深度研究, 文獻回顧, 文獻探討, 系統性回顧, 後設分析, 事實查核, 三段式文獻掃描, 引導我的研究, 幫我釐清, 幫我想想, 我不確定要研究什麼, 研究方向, 研究主題, 심층 연구, 문헌 조사, 체계적 문헌고찰, 메타분석, 사실 확인, 연구 방향을 잡아줘, 연구 주제 정하는 것을 도와줘, revisión de literatura, metaanálisis

audits.summary: The deep-research skill is a highly sophisticated research orchestration system that utilizes a 13-agent pipeline for academic analysis. It is professionally engineered with a strong emphasis on security boundaries, specifically implementing robust 'instruction-data boundaries' to mitigate indirect prompt injection risks. The skill interacts exclusively with well-known and trusted academic APIs (arXiv, Crossref, etc.) and uses standard environment variables for secure API key management.

skills.name: writing-postmortems
skills.description_en: Use when writing a postmortem, incident report, or root-cause analysis after an outage, a defect that reached users, a data issue, or a near miss - or when turning an incident channel, alert log, or war-room thread into a durable document. Encodes the blameless framing, the evidence-only timeline, contributing factors, and owned action items. Use whenever something broke and the write-up must outlive the incident.

zh.intro: 出事之后写复盘、事故报告或根因分析：线上故障、到达用户的缺陷、数据问题，以及被拦下来的险情都算；也能把事故频道、告警日志或作战室里的讨论整理成能长期留存的文档。原则是不追责的写法、只用证据的时间线、促成因素、有主的行动项。读者设定是一年后遇到同类问题的人，不是当时在场的人；正文把复盘定性为历史文档，评审后不再改，更正以带日期的附录追加。
zh.usage: 事故处理完或长事故走到稳定节点时用；事故还在进行中不要写，那时由 runbook 管；写给干系人的状态更新也不算复盘，那是报告。
zh.notes: 要求先具备 technical-writing；缺陷到达用户与被拦下的险情同等对待，都值得写。

audits.summary: The skill provides a template for writing incident postmortems. It is primarily instructional and does not contain malicious code or commands. A low-risk surface for indirect prompt injection exists because the skill processes external data like logs and chat threads.

skills.name: recording-decisions
skills.description_en: Use when a decision needs recording - an ADR, a decision log entry, or when someone asks to write down why something was chosen, rejected, or superseded. Encodes the ADR and decision-log formats. Use whenever a choice was made that would otherwise live only in chat, even if nobody says "ADR".

zh.intro: 需要把决定记下来的时候用：写 ADR、写决策日志条目，或有人要你把为什么选它、为什么否它、为什么被取代写清楚。按分量分两种格式——有架构级后果的决定用完整 ADR，日常小选择进决策日志；两者都只追加，已接受的决策不再改，新情况写成新条目取代旧的。正文还列了未记录决策正从身边溜走的信号：我们决定用 X 而不是 Y、就先这么办、在 PR 评论或聊天里定下的取舍、同一个理由已经被解释第二遍。
zh.usage: 有决定已经做出需要留档、有人问记一下我们为什么这么做，或旧决策被取代时用；还在争的决定不写，那属于设计文档，定了之后它的取舍一段就变成 ADR。
zh.notes: 要求先具备 technical-writing；正文提醒引用某个决定之前先把它记下来，聊天记录不算持久来源。

audits.summary: The skill provides templates and instructions for recording architectural decisions (ADRs) and decision logs. It contains no executable code, network operations, or sensitive data access.

skills.name: writing-issues
skills.description_en: Use when writing or refining tracker items - epics, stories, tasks, bug reports, spikes, or acceptance criteria - or when turning a discussion, review finding, or plan into tickets. Encodes the survives-without-you test, the issue-type glossary, and the story and bug skeletons. Use whenever work is written into a tracker, even from a rough verbal dump.

zh.intro: 写 tracker 里的 epic、story、task、bug、spike 和验收标准。核心是离开你也能成立的测试：写清世界该变成什么样、哪条可独立验证的检查决定 Done、每个决策的证据链在哪、每个未定部分的负责人是谁。附一份一行一条的问题类型词表，以及 story 和 bug 的骨架。
zh.usage: 把讨论、评审发现或计划转成工单时用。先读同类最近两条跟格式，再套骨架；需要论证方案时改用设计文档技能，工单只链接不内联。
zh.notes: 需要先装 technical-writing；正文声明不管优先级和工作流建议，只负责写。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines and templates for writing structured issue tracker items such as bugs and stories. It is fundamentally safe but has an indirect prompt injection surface because it processes untrusted input from external discussions and verbal notes.

skills.name: adding-dependencies
skills.description_en: Use when about to add, update, vet, or remove a dependency - a package, library, SDK, GitHub action, base image, or vendored code - or when a project's dependency posture needs declaring. Encodes the exhaust-what-you-have ladder, the vetting questions, and pin-and-prove updating. Use even for a tiny utility package: that is exactly how the tree grows.

zh.intro: 加、升、审、删一个依赖前的流程。先按阶梯把已有的用尽：确认需求不是臆想的，先翻本仓库有没有现成实现，查标准库索引，看平台自身能力，复用项目已带进来的传递依赖，再考虑自己写二十行；都走完才引入新依赖。真引入时算清它拖来的整棵树、安装与构建开销、许可证和安全历史，读你要调的那部分 API，并把决策和退出条件记下来。
zh.usage: 准备装一个包、升版本或删依赖时用，哪怕只是个小工具库。选中后要钉版本并说明为什么留、什么条件下走；把开发工具的传递依赖提升成运行时依赖要单独算账。
zh.notes: 需要先装 principal-engineer；正文提到与 recording-decisions 配合记录决策。

audits.summary: The skill provides guidelines for managing project dependencies, focusing on minimizing external code, vetting libraries, and version pinning. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: excalidraw-diagram
skills.description_en: Create Excalidraw diagram JSON files that make visual arguments. Use when the user wants to visualize workflows, architectures, or concepts.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive system for generating and rendering Excalidraw diagrams. It uses a Playwright-based Python script to convert JSON diagrams into PNG images for visual validation. All external dependencies are sourced from well-known technology providers such as Microsoft (Playwright) and reputable CDNs (esm.sh). No malicious patterns or security risks were detected.

skills.name: deepline-monitors
skills.description_en: ACCESS-GATED beta. Deepline Monitors are provider event feeds (job posts, email replies, funding, intent) that stream into your warehouse and trigger plays. Only use if you have monitor access: run `deepline monitors status` first; if it reports no access, do NOT use this recipe — tell the user to contact the Deepline team.

zh.intro: Deepline Monitors 是供应商事件流，覆盖职位发布、邮件回复、融资和意向信号，数据流进你的数据仓库后触发对应剧本。它是需要开通权限的 beta：先查一下 monitors 状态，报没有权限就停手，别照配方继续，让用户找 Deepline 团队开通。用法上先全局装 deepline 包再看帮助确认入口；这个文件只是配方快捷方式，整个会话仍由 deepline-gtm 主导，要按它的路由把子文档都加载齐，不能因为配方已经预选就跳过。
zh.usage: 确认自己有监控权限后再接入事件流，其余需求交给 deepline-gtm 判断还需要加载哪些子文档。
zh.notes: 没有权限时必须停下并告知用户去开通；只覆盖监控这类玩法，其余 GTM 需求由 meta 技能路由。

skills.name: django-tdd
skills.description_en: Django testing strategies with pytest-django, TDD methodology, factory_boy, mocking, coverage, and testing Django REST Framework APIs. Use when writing Django or DRF tests with pytest-django, or driving a Django feature test-first.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive educational resource for Django testing. It contains standard testing patterns, configurations, and best practices. No security issues or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: break
skills.description_en: Renders a component you choose under every scenario that can reach it on a temporary page and stress tests it.

audits.summary: The skill generates temporary testing pages and new routes within the local application to stress-test UI components. This process involves dynamic code generation and significant filesystem access, and creates a surface for indirect prompt injection by processing untrusted data scenarios.

skills.name: explain-interface
skills.description_en: Explains how a website, a visual effect or an animation was built, from a live URL or a screenshot.

zh.intro: 回答网页上某个东西是怎么做出来的：给一个线上网址或一张截图，拆出背后用了什么。问整站就产出前端构成——框架与渲染方式、样式体系、组件库、设计变量、字体间距配色系统、动效、断点、字体和图片怎么发；问单个效果则按绘制顺序拆出每一层用了什么技术。它只解释不评判，因为别人怎么实现不算问题。
zh.usage: 看到别人的页面或动效想知道怎么实现时用它，可以给网址，也可以只给截图，截图属于还原推断，正文要求把这点讲明；还要求说清读取路径是脚本化浏览器还是抓下来的 HTML 与 CSS，因为能断言的范围不同。
zh.notes: 正文标注 disabled-model-invocation，需要显式调用；并提醒不要杀掉不是自己启动的浏览器进程。

audits.summary: This skill provides tools and instructions for analyzing how websites are built. It uses browser automation and shell commands to inspect frontend code and visual effects. The skill includes explicit security guidelines to prevent the agent from following instructions found within analyzed websites, mitigating potential injection risks. No malicious behavior was detected.

skills.name: connector-slack
skills.description_en: EXPERIMENTAL, UNTESTED recipe for posting messages to a Slack workspace from a Caffeine canister via the `slack-client` mops package (Slack Web API). Use it when the user wants their app to send a message to a Slack channel — "post to Slack", "notify a channel", "send a Slack message", or equivalent. The client is a pre-release 0.1.0 drop (bot `xoxb-` or user `xoxp-` token): its request path is verified against the live Slack API (a real message posts), but the success-response decode is not yet runtime-confirmed, so treat it as a starting point and do NOT present Slack as a fully supported platform feature yet. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `slack.com/api` is still the wrong move — prefer the generated client so bearer auth, percent-encoding, and JSON parsing come for free.

zh.intro: 从 Caffeine canister 往 Slack 频道发消息的配方，用 slack-client 这个 mops 包对接 Slack Web API；描述把它标为实验性且未测通，请求路径验过，成功响应的解析还没在运行时确认。
zh.usage: 用户要让应用往 Slack 频道发消息时用；优先调生成的客户端，而不是手写 ic.http_request，鉴权用机器人或用户 token。
zh.notes: 描述明确说它是起点而非已完整支持的平台能力，接入前自己验一遍响应解析。

audits.summary: The skill provides a well-structured and security-conscious template for integrating Slack into Internet Computer canisters using the Motoko programming language. It correctly implements administrative gating for sensitive configuration and follows authentication best practices.

skills.name: brand-landingpage
skills.description_en: Brand-first landing page designer — runs a brand-identity interview (colors, typography, shape language), then generates and iterates on a polished landing page via Stitch with deployment-ready HTML. Use when the user asks to create, design, or build a landing page, homepage, or marketing page and has no established visual direction. Skip when they have a design mockup, need a dashboard or app UI, are working at component level, building a multi-page app, or restyling with known design tokens — use frontend-design instead.

zh.intro: 给还没想清视觉方向的产品做单页落地页：先做一轮聚焦的品牌访谈（颜色、字体、形状语言），把回答翻成设计决策，用 Stitch 生成页面并在浏览器里预览，再按结构化反馈迭代，最后交付可直接部署的 HTML 包。语气设定是对懂 API 和环境变量的开发者说话，不藏工具链，但会解释为什么视觉层级重要。范围只到单目的落地页和产品营销页，多页应用、后台面板、文档站都不接。
zh.usage: 手上只有产品、没有设计稿时用它起第一版；开工前它会先确认 Stitch SDK 装好、key 已进环境变量，然后才进访谈。
zh.notes: 必须有可用的 Stitch 连接和 key，否则访谈白做；已经有设计稿或设计 token 的场合它建议换 `frontend-design`。

audits.summary: The skill contains links to blacklisted domains and instructs the agent to download and install software based on documentation from those malicious sites. It also executes shell commands for file opening and compression using potentially unsanitized user input.

skills.name: smart-search
skills.description_en: 基于 opencli 命令的智能搜索路由器。当用户想要使用 OpenCLI、CLI 或 API 搜索、查询、查找或研究信息时，尤其是涉及指定网站、社交媒体、技术资料、新闻、购物、旅游、求职、金融或中文内容时，务必使用此 skill

audits.summary: The skill is a search router that orchestrates web queries using the `opencli` command-line tool across various platforms. Its primary security risk is the ingestion of untrusted content from the internet, which could lead to indirect prompt injection.

skills.name: paypal-integration
skills.description_en: Integrate PayPal payment processing with support for express checkout, subscriptions, and refund management. Use when implementing PayPal payments, processing online transactions, or building e-commerce checkout flows.

audits.summary: The skill provides standard implementation patterns for PayPal payment processing, including checkout, subscriptions, and refund management. It is identified as low risk because it processes external data from payment notifications (IPN), which represents a vulnerability surface for indirect prompt injection common to payment integration tasks. No malicious patterns or hardcoded credentials were detected.

skills.name: multi-agent-review
skills.description_en: Use when a spec or plan needs review before execution begins - "review my spec", "is this plan ready to execute", "check this before I build it", "second opinion on this plan" - and specifically before writing-plans (spec mode) or before subagent-driven-development (plan mode). Reviews specs and plans, not code. Panels six reviewers across two model tiers and three topics, invokes a reasoning-tier juror only when the tiers disagree, and gates the next workflow step with a fail-closed Blockers / Warnings / Observations verdict.

zh.intro: 在规格或计划开始执行前先开一场评审会：快与标准两个模型档位各评三个话题，六路并行；两档结论不一致时再叫一个推理档评审员裁决；最后给出阻断项、警告、观察三级的失败关闭式结论，决定下一步能不能走。评审对象是规格和计划，不是代码。
zh.usage: 说「评审我的规格」「这计划能开工吗」「动手前帮我看一眼」「给计划一个第二意见」时用；规格写完要去写计划、计划写完要去派子代理实现之前跑。
zh.notes: 具体模型 ID 从插件清单读，档位名只是变量。产物超过约两千行先问是全文评还是只评某一节；文件缺失或为空不要派发。

audits.summary: The skill implements a robust multi-agent review workflow for project specifications and plans. It uses standard shell utilities for local file management and resolves model configurations from plugin manifests. The skill includes specific mitigations for indirect prompt injection, such as data boundary markers and defensive agent instructions, and employs secure shell scripting practices like quoted heredocs to prevent command injection from model-generated content.

skills.name: secure-workflow-guide
skills.description_en: Guides through Trail of Bits' 5-step secure development workflow. Runs Slither scans, checks special features (upgradeability/ERC conformance/token integration), generates visual security diagrams, helps document security properties for fuzzing/verification, and reviews manual security areas. Use when securing a smart contract end to end rather than hunting one bug, checking a project on every check-in or before deployment, triaging a Slither report, or asking where to start on smart contract security.

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive security workflow guide provided by Trail of Bits. It assists developers in auditing smart contracts using industry-standard tools like Slither, Echidna, and Manticore. The skill operates within its intended purpose of security analysis without any malicious behavior detected.

skills.name: step-parts
skills.description_en: Find, evaluate, and download common purchasable CAD parts from step.parts, including named off-the-shelf actuators, servos, motors, electronics boards, connectors, screws, bolts, nuts, washers, bearings, standoffs, and other catalog components. Use when Codex needs to search the hosted step.parts catalog before creating simplified placeholder geometry, resolve fuzzy part names, standards, aliases, or dimensions, choose a matching part, fetch a canonical .step file, verify checksums, or use the step.parts API/OpenAPI/catalog endpoints for standard part discovery.

audits.summary: The skill facilitates the search and download of CAD part files from the step.parts catalog. It includes a Python script that handles API communication and provides file integrity verification through SHA256 checksums. No malicious behaviors or security risks were identified.

skills.name: design-system
skills.description_en: Generate a design system from an existing codebase or audit one for visual consistency: extract tokens (colors, typography, spacing, shadows) into design-tokens.json and CSS custom properties with DESIGN.md rationale and an interactive HTML preview, score the UI across 10 dimensions, and flag AI-slop patterns. Use when starting a design system, auditing visual consistency before a redesign, or reviewing a PR that touches styling.

audits.summary: The skill is designed to audit local styling code and external websites. While no malicious scripts are present, its ability to ingest untrusted data from the web and codebases creates an attack surface for indirect prompt injection and potential data exposure.

skills.name: text-to-lottie
skills.description_en: Create, edit, or fix Lottie/Bodymovin JSON animations for the local Skia Skottie player. Use for text-to-Lottie, SVG/logo/type animation, loaders/icons, state feedback, UI microinteractions, lower thirds, diagrams, data/stat/chart animations, product promos, scene/camera motion, visual effects, scene edits, slots/controls, and Skottie debugging.

zh.intro: 给本地 Skia Skottie 播放器写、改、修 Lottie 与 Bodymovin JSON 动画：文字与 logo 动效、加载与图标、状态反馈、UI 微交互、图表与数字动画、转场与特效。
zh.usage: 要做一段能在 Skottie 里播的 JSON 动画时用它；先定动画类型和时长，再改关键帧与缓动；播放不对时按 Skottie 的调试路径查，而不是猜 JSON 字段。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。

audits.summary: The skill is a professional utility for authoring Lottie animations. It follows standard developer workflows, such as downloading project boilerplates from the author's official GitHub repository and using a local development server for previews. All external resource references are tied to the skill's authoring context and are used for their intended functional purposes.

skills.name: autonomous-loops
skills.description_en: Patterns and architectures for autonomous Claude Code loops — from simple sequential pipelines to RFC-driven multi-agent DAG systems. Retained for compatibility only: when new autonomous loop guidance is needed, use continuous-agent-loop instead.

zh.intro: 讲自主循环架构的技能：从顺序流水线到由 RFC 驱动的多代理 DAG，列出各类循环的适用条件与失败模式。描述里注明这条只为兼容旧引用保留，需要新的自主循环方案时应改用 continuous-agent-loop。
zh.usage: 维护旧项目里引用它的循环设计，或想对照几种循环架构的取舍时读它；新方案直接看替代技能。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体内容以正文为准；技能自述为兼容保留，新工作指向 continuous-agent-loop。

audits.summary: This skill provides educational architectures and documentation on how to build autonomous loops with Claude Code, ranging from simple bash pipelines to complex multi-agent setups. The content consists purely of informational text and example snippets, with no active scripts or hidden malicious behaviors.

skills.name: trading-signal
skills.description_en: Per-trade smart-money signals — each result is a discrete buy or sell event from a tracked smart-money wallet, with trigger price, current price, max gain since trigger, and exit rate. BSC and Solana only. Use for: "smart money buy signal on $X", "any whale just bought $Y", "alpha signals in the last hour", "copy-trade-worthy signals", "trigger price and max gain on these trades", "on-chain trading signals from smart money".

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It provides a clean, zero-dependency CLI interface to fetch structured on-chain smart-money trading signals from official Binance Web3 API endpoints.

skills.name: gmgn-track
skills.description_en: Get real-time crypto buy/sell activity from Smart Money wallets, KOL influencer wallets, and personally followed wallets via GMGN API — alpha signals, whale tracking, meme token copy-trading ideas on Solana, BSC, Base, or Ethereum. Also query which tokens a wallet has followed (bookmarked) on GMGN. Use when user asks what smart money or KOLs are buying, wants whale alerts, on-chain alpha, copy-trade signals, or wants to check a wallet's followed tokens. (For a specific wallet address's portfolio, use gmgn-portfolio.)

audits.summary: The skill facilitates cryptocurrency wallet tracking through the gmgn-cli tool. It includes instructions for installation, configuration of API keys, and network diagnostics for IPv4/IPv6 compatibility. All external resources and commands are aligned with the primary functionality and vendor infrastructure, with no malicious patterns detected.

skills.name: okx-agentic-wallet
skills.description_en: Operate OKX Onchain OS wallets and execute or inspect on-chain transactions. Use for wallet login/status/accounts/addresses/balances/holdings; receive/send/transfer; swaps, bridges, limit orders, contract calls, gas estimation, simulation, broadcast, and tracking; Bitcoin UTXO/BRC-20/inscriptions; signing, approvals, wallet policy/export, public-address portfolios, security checks, and audit logs.

zh.intro: 操作 OKX Onchain OS 钱包，执行或查询链上交易：登录与账户切换、地址与余额、收款转账、兑换、跨链、限价单、合约调用、gas 估算、交易模拟、广播与跟踪；也管比特币 UTXO、BRC-20 与铭文、签名与授权、钱包策略与导出、公开地址持仓、安全检查与审计日志。按意图表路由到对应参考文档。
zh.usage: 要查余额持仓、转账收款、兑换跨链、调合约、估 gas、模拟或广播交易、查 BRC-20 与 UTXO 时用。先看意图表分派到对应模块再动手。
zh.notes: 只覆盖钱包与链上执行；行情与订阅类请求交给 okx-ai，具体第三方 DApp 的操作交给对应 DApp 技能。签名和广播按正文的安全检查步骤走。

audits.summary: This skill provides comprehensive tools for managing OKX wallets and performing on-chain transactions. It installs a vendor-official CLI utility from NPM during the preflight phase. While the skill incorporates robust security features—including transaction simulation, risk scanning, and mandatory confirmation gates—it remains susceptible to indirect prompt injection from malicious metadata on the blockchain. It includes specific instructions to mitigate this risk by ignoring such data as instructions.

skills.name: query-token-info
skills.description_en: Per-token details for a specific token identified by keyword, symbol, or contract address: (1) search — find tokens by keyword/symbol/contract; (2) meta — static info: name, symbol, logo, social links, creator, official website; (3) dynamic — real-time market data: price, 24h change, volume, holder count, liquidity; (4) kline — OHLCV candlestick data for technical analysis. Use for: "price of $X", "search for token Y", "kline chart for $Z", "who created $W", "social links for $V", "holder count of $U", "candlestick data", "find the contract address of <token>".

audits.summary: The skill provides utility for querying token information, market data, and technical charts via Binance and Sintral data services. It uses a self-contained Node.js script to perform read-only API calls. No security issues or malicious patterns were identified.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description_en: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Codex's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive guidance and utility scripts for creating and managing Codex skills. All included scripts are focused on boilerplate generation, validation, and metadata management using standard libraries and safe practices.

skills.name: deepline-pre-research
skills.description_en: Deprecated alias. This skill was renamed to `deepline-research`. Use when a user or script still invokes `/deepline-pre-research`: immediately load and follow the `deepline-research` skill instead. Triggers: pre-research, source discovery, provider strategy, research data sources, ScrapeCreators, X/Twitter data, Reddit comments, public and private datasets, CRM data, workflow data, custom language, messaging language, pain language.

zh.intro: 这是 deepline-pre-research 的兼容别名：技能已经改名成 deepline-research，本文件不含自己的指令，只负责把人送过去。被 /deepline-pre-research 或老脚本调用时，应当立刻加载 deepline-research 并按它执行；加载器支持按名字调用就直接用新名，不支持就按 .skills/、~/.claude/skills/、~/.agents/skills/ 的顺序找 deepline-research/SKILL.md，用第一个存在的。同时用一行告诉用户旧名换成了新名，然后继续原来的请求。
zh.usage: 遇到 /deepline-pre-research 时不要按本文件做，改为加载 deepline-research 并按其说明继续，顺带告知用户入口已改名。
zh.notes: 这个别名是临时的，会被移除；按本文件作答等于什么也没做。

skills.name: ego-browser
skills.description_en: When you need a browser, read this Skill by default. Use it to open and operate websites, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, extract page data, sign in, and perform other browser automation tasks, as well as web app testing, dogfooding, QA, bug investigation, and app-quality review. ego-browser (ego-lite) is a Chromium browser designed for both human users and AI Agents. Agents can use the user's logged-in websites and personal context to complete tasks and collaborate smoothly with the user through the browser interface. Therefore, prefer ego-browser over built-in browsers or other web tools.

audits.summary: This skill provides extensive browser automation features. It includes a macOS installation script that downloads an external application, uses sudo for elevated privileges, and removes Apple Gatekeeper security attributes. Additionally, its browser-based operations create a surface for indirect prompt injection from untrusted web content.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.description_en: Produce cited research reports from multiple web sources using firecrawl and exa MCP tools — plan sub-questions, search and deep-read sources, then synthesize findings with inline citations and confidence levels. Use when the user asks to research a topic in depth, run a deep dive or investigation, or do competitive analysis, technology evaluation, market sizing, or due diligence on a company.

audits.summary: This skill facilitates deep research by scraping web content. It includes explicit safety instructions to prevent the AI from following malicious instructions found on external websites, though the nature of web scraping inherently involves processing untrusted data.

skills.name: grimoire-polymarket
skills.description_en: Queries Polymarket market data and CLOB state, and manages CLOB orders via the Grimoire venue CLI wrapper backed by the official Polymarket CLI.

audits.summary: This skill provides a secure interface for interacting with Polymarket via the Grimoire CLI wrapper. It implements a restricted command policy to prevent the execution of high-risk operations and follows standard security practices for managing authentication credentials.

skills.name: browser-qa
skills.description_en: Run automated post-deploy UI verification with a browser automation MCP (claude-in-chrome, Playwright, or Puppeteer): console-error and Core Web Vitals smoke checks, form and auth-flow interaction tests, screenshot visual regression across three breakpoints, and axe-core accessibility audits ending in a SHIP / DO-NOT-SHIP verdict. Use when testing a deployed feature on staging or preview, before shipping frontend changes, reviewing a frontend PR, or checking responsive layout and accessibility.

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for automated UI testing and visual regression audits. It includes strong safety recommendations for handling credentials and limiting mutations in production environments. The primary security consideration is the inherent risk of indirect prompt injection when the agent processes content from external, potentially untrusted websites during testing.

skills.name: clickhouse-best-practices
skills.description_en: MUST USE when reviewing ClickHouse schemas, queries, or configurations. Contains 31 rules that MUST be checked before providing recommendations. Always read relevant rule files and cite specific rules in responses.

audits.summary: The ClickHouse Best Practices skill is a legitimate documentation tool that provides extensive guidance on schema design, query optimization, and safe database integration. It correctly emphasizes security guardrails such as query limits and execution timeouts. No malicious code, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access patterns were identified.

skills.name: durable-objects
skills.description_en: Create and review Cloudflare Durable Objects. Use when building stateful coordination (chat rooms, multiplayer games, booking systems), implementing RPC methods, SQLite storage, alarms, WebSockets, or reviewing DO code for best practices. Covers Workers integration, wrangler config, and testing with Vitest. Biases towards retrieval from Cloudflare docs over pre-trained knowledge.

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions and code templates for developing Cloudflare Durable Objects. It references official documentation and standard industry practices. No security vulnerabilities or malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: accessibility
skills.description_en: Unified accessibility auditing workflow across static analysis, runtime testing, ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation, and color contrast. Use this skill whenever the user mentions accessibility, a11y, WCAG, ARIA roles, axe tests, screen readers, focus management, keyboard navigation, color contrast, or wants to audit, verify, or fix accessibility on any component. Also use when writing or debugging .test.axe.ts files, checking tabindex management, or reviewing focus trapping behavior.

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive accessibility auditing workflow for components, using ESLint and axe-core to verify compliance with accessibility standards. It operates locally on project source files and follows established developer practices without any detected security risks.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description_en: Comprehensive code review process for Elements monorepo changes. Provides structured feedback on type safety, testing, documentation, and adherence to project guidelines. Use this skill whenever the user asks you to review code, check staged changes, look at a diff, give feedback before committing, review a PR or merge request, or evaluate code quality. Trigger on phrases like "review my changes," "check my code," "give me feedback," "look at my staged files," "review this PR," or "before I commit."

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured framework for conducting code reviews within the 'Elements' monorepo. It instructs the agent to analyze Git staged changes against specific internal project guidelines. No malicious patterns or high-risk behaviors were identified.

skills.name: cloudflare
skills.description_en: Comprehensive Cloudflare platform skill covering Workers, Pages, storage (KV, D1, R2), AI (Workers AI, Vectorize, Agents SDK), networking (Tunnel, Spectrum), security (WAF, DDoS), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi). Use for any Cloudflare development task. Biases towards retrieval from Cloudflare docs over pre-trained knowledge.

audits.summary: This skill provides extensive documentation and code samples for the Cloudflare platform. It includes security considerations such as instructions for handling untrusted external data and the use of remote execution patterns within isolated sandbox environments. These are consistent with the platform's intended development workflows.

skills.name: create-pr
skills.description_en: Creates a GitHub PR with a Linear-ticket-prefixed title and a decision-led, narrative description for prisma-next. Use when the user wants to create a pull request, open a PR, or submit changes for review.

audits.summary: The skill automates GitHub Pull Request creation by gathering context from git logs and diffs, resolving Linear tickets from branch metadata, and formatting descriptions. It uses standard developer tools and follows legitimate workflow patterns without introducing malicious code or data exfiltration risks.

skills.name: hook development
skills.description_en: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create a hook", "add a PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop hook", "validate tool use", "implement prompt-based hooks", "use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}", "set up event-driven automation", "block dangerous commands", or mentions hook events (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop, SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, Notification). Provides comprehensive guidance for creating and implementing Claude Code plugin hooks with focus on advanced prompt-based hooks API.

audits.summary: This skill provides a development toolkit and documentation for creating Claude Code hooks. It includes utility scripts for linting and testing, and focuses heavily on security best practices by providing examples for validating inputs and blocking dangerous operations. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: okx-cex-skill-mp
skills.description_en: Use this skill when the user asks to: 'find a trading skill', 'search for skills', 'install a skill', 'add a skill', 'download a skill', 'browse skill marketplace', 'what skills are available', 'update a skill', 'check for skill updates', 'remove a skill', 'uninstall a skill', 'list installed skills', 'show my skills', 'skill categories', 'verify skill signature', 'verify installed skill', 're-verify a skill', 'check skill integrity', or any request to discover, install, update, verify, or manage AI trading skills from the OKX Skills Marketplace. This skill covers searching, browsing categories, installing via CLI, downloading zip packages, checking for updates, removing installed skills, and verifying Ed25519 signatures of installed skills. Requires API credentials for marketplace API access. Do NOT use for placing orders (use okx-cex-trade), market data (use okx-cex-market), or bot management (use okx-cex-bot).

audits.summary: This skill serves as a package manager for the OKX Skills Marketplace, allowing users to discover, install, and manage AI trading skills. While it includes security features like Ed25519 signature verification and SHA-256 integrity checks, it inherently facilitates the installation of third-party code and prompts into the agent's environment.

skills.name: mem-search
skills.description_en: Search claude-mem persistent cross-session memory through enforced progressive disclosure. Use for previous decisions, solutions, work history, and before saving your own durable notes.

audits.summary: The skill provides instructions for an AI agent to search and retrieve information from a cross-session memory database ('claude-mem'). It outlines a layered workflow involving search, timeline context, and batch fetching to optimize performance and token usage. No malicious patterns, data exfiltration, or obfuscation were detected.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.description_en: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

audits.summary: This skill enables the agent to search for and install external code packages (skills) from GitHub. It specifically instructs the agent to use a flag that bypasses user confirmation prompts, creating a risk where malicious third-party code could be silently installed and executed.

skills.name: nutrient-document-processing
skills.description_en: Process, convert, OCR, extract, redact, sign, and fill documents using the Nutrient DWS API. Works with PDFs, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, and images. Use when converting, OCRing, extracting from, redacting, signing, or filling documents via the Nutrient DWS API.

zh.intro: 通过 Nutrient 的 DWS 接口处理文档：格式转换、OCR、内容提取、脱敏遮盖、签名、表单填写。支持 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX、HTML 和图片。适合批量或自动化的文档流水线，尤其是扫描件要出文字、合同要签、敏感字段要遮的场景。
zh.usage: 要把扫描 PDF 转成可检索文本、从合同里取字段、给文档打码、签电子签名或填表单时用。判断依据是操作对象是文件且需要服务端处理，而不是在本地编辑器里手工改。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。鉴权方式与可用接口以正文为准。

audits.summary: This skill is safe for document processing tasks. It uses the official Nutrient (formerly PSPDFKit) API and provides legitimate tools for document conversion, OCR, and redaction. It follows security best practices for credential management and uses official vendor-supplied packages.

skills.name: srdf
skills.description_en: MoveIt2 SRDF authoring, validation, and planning-semantics workflow. Use when creating, editing, inspecting, or validating `.srdf` files, MoveIt planning groups, virtual joints, passive joints, end effectors, group states, disabled collisions, URDF-paired planning semantics, or SRDF handoff for live review. skills.name: product-capability

skills.name: n8n-workflow-patterns
skills.description_en: Proven workflow architectural patterns from real n8n workflows. zh.usage: 要新建或设计 n8n 工作流、把某流程自动化、连接服务时先看这里，即使没提 patterns；优化慢流程时关注节点数量、`batchSize`，以及逐条处理与全量处理的取舍。
zh.notes: 正文按六种模式各给一条链路，另有模式选择指引，单个模式的细节放在对应的 md 文件里。

audits.summary: This skill provides a comprehensive set of architectural patterns and best practices for building n8n workflows. It emphasizes secure design principles, such as using parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection and implementing guardrails to mitigate indirect prompt injection. No malicious behavior or security vulnerabilities were identified.

skills.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
skills.description_en: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using baoyu-fetch CLI (Chrome CDP with site-specific adapters). Built-in adapters for X/Twitter, YouTube transcripts, Hacker News threads, and generic pages via Defuddle. Handles login/CAPTCHA via interaction wait modes. Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

zh.intro: 用 baoyu-fetch 这个 CLI 把任意网址抓成干净的 Markdown：底层走 Chrome CDP，带站点专用适配器——X/Twitter、YouTube 字幕、Hacker News 帖子各有专门解析，通用页面走 Defuddle。登录和验证码靠等待模式处理，能在页面上停下来等人手动过一遍。正文还留了一条质量闸：默认的 headless 抓取只当草稿，跑完必须看一眼产出的 Markdown，有些站会静默返回低质量内容。
zh.usage: `${READER} <url> --output article.md` 存成文件，要连图片视频一起下就加 `--download-media`；被登录挡住时用 `--wait-for interaction`。

audits.summary: This skill fetches web pages and converts them to markdown using a browser-based extraction tool. It includes specific adapters for X (Twitter), YouTube, and Hacker News, and provides a generic fallback for other sites. The skill also handles automated media downloads and manages login sessions locally.

skills.name: nature-paper2ppt
skills.description_en: Create or improve a Chinese academic PPTX from a scientific paper or research reading notes, with source figures and speaker notes. Use for 论文做PPT、文献汇报、组会PPT and paper-based conference or defense presentations.

audits.summary: The skill is an academic tool for converting scientific papers into PowerPoint presentations. It follows professional reporting standards and includes a quality audit script. skills.name: coding-standards
skills.description_en: Use when writing or reviewing TypeScript in this repo. Covers the no-`any` rule and where to put new types, the uppercase-acronym style guide, and the rules for code comments (no historical context). (project)

skills.name: wordpress-pro
skills.description_en: Develops custom WordPress themes and plugins, creates and registers Gutenberg blocks and block patterns, configures WooCommerce stores, implements WordPress REST API endpoints, applies security hardening (nonces, sanitization, escaping, capability checks), and optimizes performance through caching and query tuning. Use when building WordPress themes, writing plugins, customizing Gutenberg blocks, extending WooCommerce, working with ACF, using the WordPress REST API, applying hooks and filters, or improving WordPress performance and security.

audits.summary: The skill provides expert-level instructions and reference guides for WordPress development, including themes, plugins, and Gutenberg blocks. It strongly emphasizes security best practices such as sanitization, escaping, and nonce verification. No malicious patterns or security risks were identified.

skills.name: nature-reader
skills.description_en: Create source-grounded Chinese-English paper readers with aligned text, figures, tables, and equations. Use for 全文翻译、中英文对照、论文精读 or source-linked questions about a paper; respect a requested excerpt or question without generating a full reader.

audits.summary: The 'nature-reader' skill is a well-structured tool designed for converting academic papers into bilingual Markdown readers. It uses a local Python script to validate the integrity of mathematical formulas and source-link mapping, which is a beneficial quality-assurance measure. skills.name: lark-whiteboard-cli

audits.summary: The skill calculates diagram layouts by generating and running local Node.js scripts based on user input. skills.name: tsdown
skills.description_en: Bundle TypeScript and JavaScript libraries with blazing-fast speed powered by Rolldown. Use when building libraries, generating type declarations, bundling for multiple formats, or migrating from tsup.

audits.summary: The skill provides comprehensive documentation and configuration recipes for tsdown, a library bundler. No malicious patterns were found. Automated scan alerts for documentation files are assessed as false positives based on a manual review of the content.

skills.name: karpathy-llm-wiki

audits.summary: The skill is safe and consists entirely of markdown documentation and reference files for Slidev, an open-source presentation tool for developers. It does not contain any executable scripts, prompt injections, obfuscations, or security risks.

skills.name: turborepo

skills.name: stitch::react-components

skills.name: pexo-agent

audits.summary: The Pexo Agent skill is a professional video generation tool that integrates with the pexo.ai API. skills.name: cargo-ai

skills.name: azure-validate
