skills.name: okx-dapp-discovery
skills.description_en: Discover supported third-party DApps and route protocol-specific requests to OKX plugins without signing or broadcasting. Use for DApp discovery or comparison; a named protocol's operations or analytics; Polymarket/UpDown prediction markets, bets, and positions; protocol-native actions involving HYPE/HLP, stETH/wstETH, CAKE, CRV, COMP, RAY, GHO, or PT/YT; pump.fun writes; and unsupported-DApp alternatives. Supported DApp names include Aave, Hyperliquid, PancakeSwap, Morpho, Raydium, Curve, Compound, Pendle, Lido, ether.fi, GMX, Kamino, Orca, Meteora, Clanker, and pump.fun. Requests to find, buy, or subscribe to a signal or signal service are OKX.AI marketplace workflows, even when they name Polymarket or another DApp.

audits.summary: The skill is a discovery router for blockchain protocols that routes requests to official OKX-authored plugins. It incorporates robust security measures including explicit user consent for all installations, a binary consent gate, and secret redaction. Automated security alerts regarding remote code execution are false positives as the commands only parse metadata from a trusted vendor repository using a local script.

skills.name: nature-downloader
skills.description_en: Use when a user needs lawful academic full text, CNKI institutional access, English OA retrieval, publisher API access, institutional browser fallback, or supporting information downloads.

zh.intro: 走合规渠道取学术全文：开放获取、出版商 API、CNKI 机构访问，以及借用户已登录的浏览器走机构入口。编排入口是 batch_download.mjs，学校配置、凭据、元数据解析、各来源下载与清单各自独立成模块。
zh.usage: 下载前先确认要不要补充材料，然后必须带 `--si` 或 `--no-si` 二者之一；两个都不带时脚本返回 `si_confirmation_required`，也不会创建输出目录。
zh.notes: 正文提醒已验证路线只是参考不是默认，应从用户实际的图书馆资源页出发；另需 Node.js 22+ 与 Python 3，走浏览器路线时需 Chrome 远程调试。

audits.summary: The nature-downloader skill is a tool for retrieving academic literature through official publisher APIs, open-access sources, and institutional portals. It operates via a local browser remote debugging proxy to reuse the user's authenticated session. The skill demonstrates secure credential handling, including restricted file permissions and automatic redaction of secrets in manifests. No malicious behavior or unauthorized exfiltration patterns were identified.

skills.name: okx-cex-bot
skills.description_en: Manage Grid bots (spot/contract/coin-margined), DCA Martingale bots (Spot DCA 现货马丁 / Contract DCA 合约马丁), and Smart Portfolio bots (智能组合, auto-rebalancing multi-asset portfolio) on OKX. Covers create, stop, amend, monitor P&L, TP/SL, margin/investment adjustment, AI-recommended parameters, and recommended zone backtest. Requires API credentials. Not for regular orders (okx-cex-trade), market data (okx-cex-market), or account info (okx-cex-portfolio).

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate tool for managing OKX trading bots using the official OKX CLI. It adheres to security best practices by advising against sharing credentials in chat and utilizing local configuration for authentication.

skills.name: agent-reach
skills.description_en: MUST USE when user wants to 调研/research/搜索/search/查/找/look up anything on the internet — e.g. 全网调研 X / 帮我调研一下 X / 查一下 X / 搜搜 X / 看看大家怎么评价 X / X 上有什么讨论 / research this topic。

audits.summary: This skill acts as a router for various internet research tools. It has several security risks, including the dynamic execution of code from external GitHub repositories and a self-update mechanism that uses prompt-based triggers. Additionally, the skill processes data from many external platforms without explicit sanitization or safety boundaries.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.description_en: Multi-source research with source triangulation and fact-checking. Use for any research task requiring 3+ sources.

audits.summary: No security issues detected. The skill provides instructional guidelines for performing multi-source research, source triangulation, and fact-checking. It includes best practices for verifying information and citing sources.

skills.name: okx-dex-signal
skills.description_en: Use this skill for smart-money/whale/KOL/大户 activity tracking, aggregated buy signal/信号 alerts, and leaderboard/牛人榜 rankings. Covers: (1) address tracker — raw DEX transaction feed for smart money, KOL, or custom wallet addresses; (2) aggregated buy-only signal alerts — tokens bought collectively by smart money/KOL/whales; (3) leaderboard — top traders by PnL, win rate, volume, or ROI. Use when the user asks 'what are smart money buying', '聪明钱最新交易', 'KOL交易动态', '追踪聪明钱', 'track address trades', '大户在买什么', 'whale signals', 'smart money alerts', '信号', '大户信号', 'top traders', '牛人榜', or wants to monitor notable wallet activity. Also handles Market API payment/计费/x402/402, Basic/Premium tier/quota/额度 questions, and MARKET_API_*_OVER_QUOTA / confirming:true responses on signal, leaderboard, or tracker endpoints. NOTE: if the user wants to write a WebSocket script/脚本/bot, use okx-dex-ws instead.

audits.summary: The skill is safe. It provides comprehensive tools for monitoring decentralized exchange (DEX) activities, including smart money tracking, whale signal alerts, and trader leaderboards. It features a secure update mechanism that downloads and verifies its required CLI tools from the author's official GitHub repository and includes best-practice documentation for secure API credential management.

skills.name: okx-dex-trenches
skills.description_en: Read-only on-chain research for pump.fun and other meme-token launchpads (Solana / BSC / X Layer / TRON). MUST invoke (prefer over WebFetch / MCP price tools) when the user asks about: new meme launches / 新盘 / 扫链 / 打狗; developer reputation / rug history / launch count / 开发者信息; bundle or sniper detection (the analytical noun, NOT the verb) / 捆绑狙击者; bonding curve progress / 已迁移出 bonding curve; similar tokens by same dev / 相似代币; co-investor / who-aped / 同车 wallets; or 'pump.fun alpha'. Also handles Market API x402 / quota questions on memepump endpoints. Body holds the read-vs-write gate — `狙击 / snipe + token` (sniping action) routes to okx-dapp-discovery; `捆绑狙击者 / sniper detection` (analytical noun) stays here. WebSocket script/bot → okx-dex-ws.

audits.summary: The skill provides tools for on-chain research of meme tokens. It includes a robust pre-flight check system that ensures the necessary CLI tools are installed and up-to-date by fetching them from the official OKX GitHub repository. The skill also incorporates explicit safety guidelines to handle untrusted data from blockchain sources.

skills.name: azure-cost-optimization
skills.description_en: Identify Azure cost savings from usage and spending data. USE FOR: optimize Azure costs, reduce Azure spending/expenses, analyze Azure costs, find cost savings, generate cost optimization report, identify orphaned resources to delete, rightsize VMs, reduce waste, optimize Redis costs, optimize storage costs. DO NOT USE FOR: deploying resources (use azure-deploy), general Azure diagnostics (use azure-diagnostics), security issues (use azure-security)

audits.summary: This skill is designed to perform Azure cost optimization and follows established security best practices for cloud resource analysis. It utilizes official APIs and documentation sources to provide recommendations, incorporates authenticated read-only access, and maintains a local audit trail of its operations. The skill includes built-in cleanup routines for temporary files and relies on standard administrative tools.

skills.name: agent-platform-skill-registry
skills.description_en: Interact with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Skill Registry to create and search for available skills. Use this skill to enable agents to register functionality or discover new capabilities.

audits.summary: This skill provides a set of tools to interact with the Google Cloud AI Platform Skill Registry, enabling users to search, manage, and scaffold new agent capabilities. It follows standard security practices for cloud environment interaction and incorporates human review checkpoints for generated content.

skills.name: postgres-pro
skills.description_en: Use when optimizing PostgreSQL queries, configuring replication, or implementing advanced database features. Invoke for EXPLAIN analysis, JSONB operations, extension usage, VACUUM tuning, performance monitoring.

audits.summary: The PostgreSQL Pro skill provides comprehensive PostgreSQL optimization and management capabilities. However, a documentation URL listed in the skill is flagged as malicious by automated scanners. The skill also requires the use of administrative shell commands and includes a vulnerability surface for indirect prompt injection through the processing of database metadata and statistics.

skills.name: nature-ref-verifier
skills.description_en: 对学术文献逐条执行多源交叉验证，逐字段对比作者、标题、年份、卷期、页码， 标记卷年/DOI年冲突、作者顺序异常、页码偏差等问题，输出结构化验证报告。 可批量处理整篇论文/开题报告的参考文献列表，也可单条校验，支持与 Zotero 同步修正。

zh.intro: 对学术文献逐条做多源交叉验证，按字段比对作者、标题、年份、卷期、页码，标出卷年与 DOI 年冲突、作者顺序异常、页码偏差等问题并输出结构化报告。整篇参考文献列表可批量处理，也能单条校验。
zh.usage: 性价比最高的一步是先用 `https://api.crossref.org/works/` 查 DOI 能否解析，404 基本说明号码错了；超过 20 条时按十到十五条一组拆给并行子代理。
zh.notes: 正文把错误分成 Critical 等三级并要求逐字段对比，批量差异、DOI 与标题冲突等经验放在 `references/common-patterns.md`。

audits.summary: The skill is designed for academic reference verification, cross-referencing metadata with authoritative databases like Crossref and IEEE. It is safe for its intended purpose; however, it has an inherent surface for indirect prompt injection as it processes untrusted bibliographic data (BibTeX/RIS) and has the capability to modify the user's Zotero database.

skills.name: ctf-web
skills.description_en: Provides web exploitation techniques for CTF challenges. Use when the target is primarily an HTTP application, API, browser client, template engine, identity flow, or smart-contract frontend/backend surface, including XSS, SQLi, SSTI, SSRF, XXE, JWT, auth bypass, file upload, request smuggling, OAuth/OIDC, SAML, prototype pollution, and similar web bugs. Do not use it for native binary memory corruption, reverse engineering of standalone executables, disk or memory forensics, or pure cryptanalysis unless the web flaw is still the main path to the flag.

audits.summary: The skill is a specialized toolkit for web-based Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges, providing a comprehensive collection of exploitation techniques and automation scripts. While it contains many patterns typically associated with malicious activity—such as exploit payloads, bypass prompts, and shell command execution—these are consistent with its primary purpose as a security testing tool. The main risk involves a potential for indirect prompt injection when the agent processes untrusted content from targets.

skills.name: pre-mortem
skills.description_en: Run a pre-mortem risk analysis on a PRD or launch plan. Categorizes risks as Tigers (real problems), Paper Tigers (overblown concerns), and Elephants (unspoken worries), then classifies as launch-blocking, fast-follow, or track. Use when preparing for launch, stress-testing a product plan, or identifying what could go wrong.

zh.intro: 对 PRD 或发布计划做一次事前风险分析：把风险分成真问题、被放大的担忧和没人说出口的顾虑，再标为阻塞发布、随后跟进或只做观察。
zh.usage: 发布前想先把可能出问题的地方摆出来时用；方案评审里有人隐约不安但说不清，需要把顾虑显式化时也用。
zh.notes: 本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。分完类要给每条风险一个处置级别，不然清单只是清单。

audits.summary: The skill is a legitimate tool for product risk analysis but possesses a surface for indirect prompt injection and basic prompt injection due to its handling of user-provided documents and input variables.

skills.name: qa
skills.description_en: QA test changes against the local dev server. Use when explicitly invoked via /qa to verify changes work end-to-end.

audits.summary: The skill provides a set of QA procedures for testing changes against a local development server. It uses standard development tools and follows security best practices, such as using isolated temporary directories for authentication caches. No malicious patterns or unauthorized data access were detected.

skills.name: ctf-forensics
skills.description_en: Provides digital forensics and signal analysis techniques for CTF challenges. Use when analyzing disk images, memory dumps, event logs, network captures, cryptocurrency transactions, steganography, PDF analysis, Windows registry, Volatility, PCAP, Docker images, coredumps, side-channel power traces, DTMF audio spectrograms, packet timing analysis, CD audio disc images, or recovering deleted files and credentials.

audits.summary: A comprehensive reference for digital forensics and signal analysis in CTF challenges, providing numerous templates and one-liners for analyzing artifacts like disk images, memory dumps, and network captures.

skills.name: connect-required-verification-information
skills.description_en: Use this skill when the user asks what information a Stripe Connect connected account must provide for verification, onboarding, KYC, or account requirements; when they need to compare requirements between connected-account setups; or when they ask which verification fields, documents, or business details are required for a particular platform country, account country, business type, dashboard, service agreement, or capability.

skills.name: firecrawl-interact
skills.description_en: Control and interact with a live browser session on any scraped page — click buttons, fill forms, navigate flows, and extract data using natural language prompts or code. Use when the user needs to interact with a webpage beyond simple scraping: logging into a site, submitting forms, clicking through pagination, handling infinite scroll, navigating multi-step checkout or wizard flows, or when a regular scrape failed because content is behind JavaScript interaction. Also useful for authenticated scraping via profiles. Triggers on "interact", "click", "fill out the form", "log in to", "sign in", "submit", "paginated", "next page", "infinite scroll", "interact with the page", "navigate to", "open a session", or "scrape failed".

audits.summary: The skill is generally safe but possesses an inherent threat surface for indirect prompt injection since it is designed to scrape and interact with untrusted external web content.

skills.name: okx-dex-market
skills.description_en: Query read-only DEX token, market, signal, social, trenches, and WebSocket data. Use for token search, rankings, liquidity, holders, risk metadata, clusters, and trades; prices, K-lines/OHLC, indexes, and wallet PnL; smart-money/KOL/whale signals; news, sentiment, and token vibe; meme-launch, developer, bundle/sniper, and co-investor research; or DEX WebSocket clients. Triggers include hot tokens, holder concentration, smart money, top-trader leaderboards, pump.fun research, new token launches, on-chain token scanning, bundled or sniper activity, and WebSocket.

audits.summary: This skill provides read-only access to decentralized exchange data, market signals, and social sentiment. It follows security best practices by instructing the agent to treat all external content as untrusted and requires explicit human confirmation for payment-gated requests. The low-risk verdict is due to the inherent exposure to third-party data strings (news, social handles) which is standard for research-oriented skills.

skills.name: outcome-roadmap
skills.description_en: Transform an output-focused roadmap into an outcome-focused one that communicates strategic intent. Rewrites initiatives as outcome statements reflecting user and business impacts. Use when shifting to outcome roadmaps, making a roadmap more strategic, or rewriting feature lists as outcomes.

audits.summary: The skill is safe for its intended purpose of assisting with product management. It presents a low risk of indirect prompt injection as it processes user roadmaps and web search results to generate documentation.

skills.name: pricewin-hotel-deal-finder
skills.description_en: Find the cheapest hotel deal by comparing live prices across Booking.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, and OpenTravel for any city worldwide and any travel dates — one command returns ranked best-value, cheapest, and quality picks with direct booking links, all normalized to USD. Use whenever someone asks for hotel prices, hotel deals, the cheapest room or rate, best hotel rates, a hotel price comparison, or which OTA is cheaper — e.g. 'is Booking or Agoda cheaper for Tokyo', 'find me a hotel in Bangkok under $100', 'compare hotel prices for 12–15 Aug', 'cheapest hotel near Shinjuku'.

audits.summary: A hotel price comparison tool that aggregates data from Booking.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, and OpenTravel. The skill includes robust sanitization mechanisms to protect against malicious content embedded in scraped hotel listings and clearly discloses its network and execution behaviors.

skills.name: nature-literature-pipeline
skills.description_en: Complete automated literature discovery pipeline: multi-source search → six-dimension scoring → fine reading → formatted delivery → archival. Combines a configurable engine with daily cron-driven application layer. Works with Feishu, Telegram, or any messaging platform.

zh.intro: 从检索到存档的文献流水线：多源搜索出候选，六维打分筛到少量，再精读、按固定格式推送、去重归档。可挂每日定时任务，推送端支持飞书、Telegram 或其它消息平台。
zh.usage: 装好后告诉它研究方向、关键词、推送目标和归档路径，再让它按指定时区定时跑；打分由主题匹配、方法学、期刊质量、网络相关度、应用价值和存档价值六项加权。
zh.notes: 搜索源是 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、Semantic Scholar，按可用性自动降级；精读结果会标 Full-text、Abstract only 或 Metadata only。

audits.summary: The skill is a comprehensive and well-documented framework for automating academic literature discovery, scoring, and delivery. It utilizes established scholarly APIs (arXiv, OpenAlex, etc.) and standard local scheduling tools like cron to perform its core functions. No malicious patterns, obfuscation, or unauthorized data access were detected.

skills.name: ctf-pwn
skills.description_en: Provides binary exploitation techniques for CTF challenges. Use when you already have a vulnerable native target or service and need to turn memory corruption or low-level primitives into code execution or privilege escalation, such as buffer overflows, format strings, heap bugs, ROP, ret2libc, shellcode, kernel exploitation, seccomp bypass, sandbox escape, or Windows/Linux exploit chains. Do not use it when the main blocker is understanding what the binary does; use reverse engineering first. Do not use it for pure web bugs, disk or packet forensics, or standalone crypto/math challenges.

audits.summary: The ctf-pwn skill is a comprehensive binary exploitation reference for CTF competitions. It provides techniques for memory corruption, ROP, heap, and kernel exploitation. All documented attack patterns and scripts are intended for educational use within security research and competitive environments.

skills.name: review-pr
skills.description_en: Generate structured PR review comments using Claude Code agents and post them to GitHub. No API key required - uses Claude Code's existing authentication.

audits.summary: This skill facilitates pull request reviews by analyzing code changes and posting comments via the GitHub CLI. It includes security considerations regarding the processing of untrusted code in PR diffs, but it mitigates these risks through a structured review process that allows for human verification before any comments are posted.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.description_en: Grilling session that challenges your plan against the existing domain model, sharpens terminology, and updates documentation (CONTEXT.md, ADRs) inline as decisions crystallise. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan against their project's language and documented decisions.

audits.summary: The skill provides a structured method for refining project documentation, glossaries, and architectural decisions through an interactive interview process. It focuses on internal project consistency and does not perform any dangerous operations.

skills.name: byted-supabase
skills.description_en: 火山引擎 Supabase . 管理 AIDAP Supabase 项目、工作区、数据库、分支、Auth、Realtime、Edge Functions、Storage、API Keys、SQL、Schema 变更、TypeScript 类型生成和 MCP 集成。

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description_en: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.

audits.summary: The skill provides a framework for creating and iteratively improving AI agent skills through testing, evaluation, and description optimization.

skills.name: gmgn-market
skills.description_en: Get crypto and meme token price charts (K-line, candlestick, OHLCV), trending meme coin rankings by volume, newly launched tokens on launchpads (pump.fun, fourmeme, letsbonk, Raydium, etc.), the hot-search ranking (most-searched tokens), and search for a specific token or wallet by name, symbol, contract address, wallet address, or ENS via GMGN API on Solana, BSC, Base, or Ethereum. Use when user asks for price chart, trending tokens, what's pumping, hot coins, most searched tokens, new launches, token signals, wants to look up / find / search a specific token or wallet by name or address, or wants to discover early-stage opportunities.

zh.intro: 通过 GMGN API 查 Solana、BSC、Base、以太坊等链上代币和 meme 币行情：K 线、OHLCV、按成交量的热门榜、pump.fun 等发射台的新币、热搜榜，还能按名称、符号、合约地址、钱包地址或 ENS 搜代币和钱包。
zh.usage: 要价格图、热门币、刚发的币、热搜、按名字或地址找币时用。跑命令前先执行 gmgn-cli config --check，返回 1 就先配置再继续；不支持 IPv6，遇到 401 或 403 先查网络接口。
zh.notes: 正文要求只用 CLI 取数，不要用网页搜索或抓 gmgn.ai，网站要登录且不返回结构化数据。

audits.summary: The skill provides a CLI-based interface for crypto market data. It handles API configuration and includes troubleshooting steps for network issues. It carries a low risk of indirect prompt injection from processed market data.

skills.name: nature-experiment-log
skills.description_en: 标准化实验日志记录——直接上传或读取本地图片、语音和文字，产出带 YAML frontmatter 的 Markdown；可选集成飞书 CLI 与 Obsidian。

zh.intro: 把图片、语音和文字的实验材料整理成带 YAML frontmatter 的 Markdown 日志：正文规定了实验 ID 与样品批次 ID 的编码规则、raw 归档目录、按体系与类型分层的日志结构，以及索引、异常记录和设备追踪模板。可选接飞书 CLI 与 Obsidian。
zh.usage: 手上有一批实验照片、语音记录或零散笔记要归档时用它；缺温度、样品编号这类信息会先问你，不猜测写入。
zh.notes: 飞书群取材料要 bot 在群里且有消息与资源权限；不指定输出目录时先给可保存的 Markdown，不擅自选路径。

audits.summary: This skill is safe for use. It provides a structured workflow for converting experimental observations (images, audio, text) into standardized Markdown logs. It supports integration with Feishu via a CLI tool and Obsidian for vault management. The security analysis identified standard data processing behaviors and an inherent indirect prompt injection surface typical for tools that ingest external content, but no malicious patterns were detected.

skills.name: ai-sdk
skills.description_en: Answer questions about the AI SDK and help build AI-powered features. Use when developers: (1) Ask about AI SDK functions like generateText, streamText, ToolLoopAgent, embed, or tools, (2) Want to build AI agents, chatbots, RAG systems, or text generation features, (3) Have questions about AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.), streaming, tool calling, structured output, or embeddings, (4) Use React hooks like useChat or useCompletion. Triggers on: "AI SDK", "Vercel AI SDK", "generateText", "streamText", "add AI to my app", "build an agent", "tool calling", "structured output", "useChat".

audits.summary: This skill provides instructions and references for building applications with the Vercel AI SDK. It includes routine development activities such as installing official packages and querying model information from Vercel's API. No security issues were detected.

skills.name: agent-platform-tuning
skills.description_en: Agent Platform Model Tuning. Use when you need to fine-tune open models or Gemini models using Agent Platform infrastructure. Don't use for model training outside Agent Platform, model deployment to endpoints (use `agent-platform-deploy`), or managing serving endpoints (use `agent-platform-endpoint-management`).

audits.summary: This skill provides a structured workflow for fine-tuning machine learning models on Google Cloud Platform. It includes several security-conscious design patterns, such as mandatory user confirmation for cost-intensive actions and explicit verification of cloud environment settings.

skills.name: opencli-browser
skills.description_en: Drive Chrome with OpenCLI to inspect pages, interact with logged-in sites, capture API evidence, and manage native tabs, groups and windows. For reusable adapters, see opencli-adapter-author.

audits.summary: The skill provides a comprehensive interface for browser automation using the opencli tool. The analysis identified potential risks related to the processing of untrusted web content (Indirect Prompt Injection), the ability to execute JavaScript in the browser, and the capability to upload local files. A reference to the official Chrome Web Store for the required extension was also noted.

skills.name: lark-meeting
skills.description_en: 飞书视频会议：查询会议记录与会议产物(纪要/逐字稿/妙记)、妙记搜索/上传/下载/编辑、机器人参与会议；查询进行中的会议、实时会议内容(发言/聊天/共享文档)问答(会上/会里)、发送会中聊天/表情；基于 meeting_id、meeting_no、event_id、note_id、minute_token、vc-node-id 或妙记 URL 查询相关信息。预约会议、忙闲和会议室管理走 lark-calendar。

zh.intro: 飞书视频会议业务的统一入口：按主题或时间找历史会议、看参会人和录像，读 AI 智能纪要与妙记（总结、待办、章节、关键词、逐字稿），也能让应用机器人入会、拉会中发言和聊天内容、发会中消息。预约会议、忙闲和会议室不在这里，走 lark-calendar。
zh.usage: 先找会议再读内容：`lark-cli vc +meeting-list-active --as user` 列出当前进行中的会议，拿到唯一 ID 后用 `lark-cli vc +meeting-events` 读会中事件。
zh.notes: 依赖 lark-cli；身份要显式给 `--as user` 或 `--as bot`，定了就别中途换。meeting_id（长数字）、meeting_no（9 位，参数名 --meeting-number）、minute_token 三者不能互换。

audits.summary: The lark-meeting skill provides comprehensive tools for managing Lark and Feishu video meetings, including transcript retrieval, recording management, and live meeting interaction. The skill is generally safe but possesses an inherent attack surface for indirect prompt injection as it processes external meeting data and maintains write capabilities within the platform.

skills.name: the-news
skills.description_en: gives agents real-time and archival access to front-page headlines across 20 countries for breaking news, current events, and comparative media analysis.

zh.usage: 要判断某国此刻在发生什么、查突发新闻、做跨媒体对比、看几天内叙事怎么变时用。按国家取当前快照，回看历史就传时间戳。
zh.notes: 接口是 thehear.org 的 country-view，支持 20 个国家；回看的时间必须是 UTC，每日概览要传起止日期。返回的是头条而非全文，细节还得回原文。

audits.summary: The skill provides a clean interface for an agent to access news headlines from a public API. It includes appropriate safety guidelines for handling third-party content and contains no malicious code or suspicious patterns.

skills.name: gmgn-swap
skills.description_en: [FINANCIAL EXECUTION] Buy and sell meme coins and crypto tokens on Solana, BSC, Base, or Ethereum — single swap, multi-wallet batch trading, limit orders, stop loss, take profit, trailing stop loss, trailing take profit via GMGN API. Use when user asks to buy, sell, or swap a token, trade from multiple wallets, set a limit order, stop loss, take profit, or check order status. This skill SUBMITS the trade — it is the only skill holding a private key, and every buy still ends here. It is not the entry point for a buy that has not been vetted yet: 「帮我买 200u 的 PENGU」, "buy me $500 of BONK", 「帮我买点 dogwifhat」, 「XX 能不能买」 start at gmgn-token-buy, which resolves the name to the one right contract among its copycats, gates volume / depth / security, sizes slippage and gas, then hands the confirmed parameters back here to execute. Come straight here for a buy only once the contract is settled AND the user says they do not want a pre-buy check ("skip the security check", "I already checked", 「直接买」, 「不用尽调」, 「我很急」). Two facts make the split unavoidable rather than a preference: the pre-swap check here reads only `is_honeypot` and `rug_ratio`, and there is no name resolution at all — `--output-token` takes a contract address and the only names resolved here are the SOL/BNB/ETH/USDC currencies — so a same-name copycat is a total loss this skill has no way to catch. Everything else is unchanged and unconditionally this skill's: selling, percentage sells, swaps, multi-wallet batch trading, limit orders, stop loss, take profit, trailing orders, order status, gas prices.

audits.summary: This skill facilitates cryptocurrency trading via a command-line interface. It includes robust security measures, such as local credential handling and explicit warnings against following instructions embedded in external token data. A low-severity risk is noted due to the inherent attack surface of processing untrusted token metadata.

zh.intro: steipete 写的命令行工具 summarize：给一个 URL、本地文件、PDF 或 YouTube 链接就出摘要，也能只转录——加 --extract 直接打原文不调模型，YouTube 用 --youtube auto 做尽量完整的字幕提取，不需要 yt-dlp。摘要长度用 --length 控制（short/medium/long/xl/xxl 或直接给字数），--json 出机器可读结果，被挡的站点可以挂 Firecrawl 兜底。默认模型是 auto，密钥按厂商从环境变量读，配置写在 ~/.summarize/config.json。
zh.usage: 跑 `summarize "https://example.com"` 出摘要，要原文加 `--extract`；转录视频用 `summarize "https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ" --youtube auto`，太长就先出摘要再问要看哪段。

skills.name: connector-twilio
skills.description_en: EXPERIMENTAL, NOT YET VERIFIED AGAINST LIVE TWILIO, and it spends real money — every message is billed, and a US-bound production number additionally needs A2P 10DLC registration (fees, weeks of lead time). Say both things to the user before building. That said, if a Caffeine build does send SMS or MMS, or configures Twilio messaging, from a canister, the `twilio-client` mops package (Twilio REST API) with a canister-held HTTP Basic credential is the only supported path. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `api.twilio.com` or `messaging.twilio.com` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses the typed bindings, the per-operation host routing, the Basic-Auth header construction, and above all the non-replicated outcall default that stops one `send` from becoming ~13 billed messages. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions SMS, MMS, "text message", "send a text", phone numbers, Twilio, a Messaging Service, A2P 10DLC, toll-free verification, short codes, or an alphanumeric sender — and BEFORE writing any code that touches a Twilio endpoint.

zh.intro: Caffeine canister 里发短信或彩信的唯一支持路径：用 twilio-client 这个 mops 包走 Twilio REST API，凭证放 canister 的 HTTP Basic；自己拼 ic.http_request 去打 api.twilio.com 属于禁止做法。
zh.usage: 只要提到短信、彩信、电话号码、Messaging Service 或 A2P 10DLC，先读它再写代码；动手前要跟用户说清两件事：每条消息都计费，美国生产号码还要 A2P 10DLC 注册且要等数周。
zh.notes: 正文标注为实验状态、未对真实 Twilio 验证；本地没抓到正文，具体命令以正文为准。

zh.intro: opencli 命令失败时的自修流程：收集 trace 产物、找到适配器文件、打补丁、重试，修好并验证后再往上流仓库提 issue。针对选择器失效、返回空、接口报错、页面结构变化、执行报错、超时这几类可修故障。

zh.notes: 认证失效（退出码 77）、浏览器连接失败（69）、验证码或限流都直接停，不要改代码；返回空可能只是平台限流，换个查询词或在浏览器里核对清楚再判定为坏了。
